namespace DevExpress.Utils.Internal
{
	public class FontDescriptor
	{
		private TTFontInfo fontInfo;

		private readonly FontFamily fontFamily;

		private readonly Stream fontStream;

		private readonly FontStyle fontStyle;

		private static readonly object locker = new object();

		public FontFamily FontFamily => fontFamily;

		public TTFontInfo FontInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (fontInfo == null)
				{
					lock (locker)
					{
						if (fontInfo == null)
						{
							FontStream.Position = 0L;
							try
							{
								fontInfo = new TTFontInfo(FontStream);
							}
							catch (NotSupportedException innerException)
							{
								if (fontFamily != null)
								{
									throw new NotSupportedException("Unable to load TTFontInfo, fontFamily.Name=" + fontFamily.Name, innerException);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return fontInfo;
			}
		}

		public Stream FontStream => fontStream;

		public FontStyle FontStyle => fontStyle;

		public FontDescriptor(FontFamily fontFamily, FontStyle fontStyle, Stream fontStream)
		{
			this.fontFamily = fontFamily;
			this.fontStyle = fontStyle;
			this.fontStream = fontStream;
		}
	}
	public class TTFontInfo
	{
		private static readonly int ErrorGlyphWidth = 2000;

		private TTFHeader header;

		private CMAPTable cmap;

		internal ushort[] widths;

		internal KernTable kernTable = new KernTable();

		public TTFWeightClass WeightClass => header.WeightClass;

		public byte[] Panose => header.Panose;

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public ushort[] Widths => widths;

		public TTFontInfo(Stream stream)
		{
			BigEndianStreamReader reader = new BigEndianStreamReader(stream);
			header = new TTFHeader();
			header.Read(reader);
			if (!header.IsInternal)
			{
				ReadCMAPTable(reader);
				ReadHMetrics(reader);
				ReadKerning(reader);
				return;
			}
			ReadCMAPTableInternal(reader);
			if (header.Version == -1f)
			{
				ReadHMetricsInternalV1(reader);
			}
			else
			{
				ReadHMetricsInternalV2(reader);
			}
			if (header.IsSupportKerningInternal)
			{
				ReadKerningInternal(reader);
			}
		}

		public void WriteInternal(Stream stream)
		{
			BigEndianStreamWriter writer = new BigEndianStreamWriter(stream);
			header.WriteInternal(writer);
			WriteCMAPTableInternal(writer);
			WriteHMetricsInternal(writer);
			WriteKerningInternal(writer);
		}

		private void ReadCMAPTable(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			reader.Stream.Position = header.Tables["cmap"].Offset;
			cmap = new CMAPTable();
			cmap.Read(reader);
		}

		private void ReadCMAPTableInternal(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			cmap = new CMAPTable();
			cmap.ReadInternal(reader);
		}

		private void WriteCMAPTableInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			cmap.WriteInternal(writer);
		}

		private void ReadHMetrics(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			reader.Stream.Position = header.Tables["hmtx"].Offset;
			int hMetricsCount = header.HMetricsCount;
			int glyphsCount = header.GlyphsCount;
			widths = new ushort[glyphsCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < glyphsCount; i++)
			{
				if (i >= hMetricsCount)
				{
					widths[i] = widths[0];
					continue;
				}
				widths[i] = reader.ReadUShort();
				reader.Stream.Seek(2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			}
		}

		private void ReadHMetricsInternalV2(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			int glyphsCount = header.GlyphsCount;
			ArrayStreamHelper<ushort> arrayStreamHelper = new ArrayStreamHelper<ushort>();
			widths = arrayStreamHelper.ReadArray(reader, glyphsCount, (BigEndianStreamReader r) => r.ReadUShort());
		}

		private void ReadHMetricsInternalV1(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			int num = reader.Stream.ReadByte();
			if (num > 0)
			{
				ReadHMetricsInternalCompressedFormat(reader);
			}
			else
			{
				ReadHMetricsInternalDefaultFormat(reader);
			}
		}

		private void ReadHMetricsInternalDefaultFormat(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			int glyphsCount = header.GlyphsCount;
			widths = new ushort[glyphsCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < glyphsCount; i++)
			{
				widths[i] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
		}

		private void ReadHMetricsInternalCompressedFormat(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			int glyphsCount = header.GlyphsCount;
			widths = new ushort[glyphsCount];
			int num = 0;
			while (num < glyphsCount)
			{
				int num2 = reader.ReadUShort();
				ushort num3 = reader.ReadUShort();
				int num4 = num + num2;
				for (int i = num; i < num4; i++)
				{
					widths[i] = num3;
				}
				num = num4;
			}
		}

		private void WriteHMetricsInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			ArrayStreamHelper<ushort> arrayStreamHelper = new ArrayStreamHelper<ushort>();
			arrayStreamHelper.WriteArray(writer, widths, delegate(BigEndianStreamWriter w, ushort value)
			{
				w.WriteUShort(value);
			});
		}

		private void ReadKerning(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			if (header.Tables.ContainsKey("kern"))
			{
				reader.Stream.Position = header.Tables["kern"].Offset;
				if (reader.ReadUShort() != 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = reader.ReadUShort();
				if (num > 0)
				{
					kernTable = new KernTable(reader);
					return;
				}
			}
			kernTable = new KernTable();
		}

		private void ReadKerningInternal(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			kernTable = new KernTable();
			kernTable.ReadInternal(reader);
		}

		private void WriteKerningInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			kernTable.WriteInternal(writer);
		}

		private int AlternativeMeasureChar(char c, double fontSize)
		{
			return ErrorGlyphWidth;
		}

		public SizeF MeasureText(string str, double fontSize)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
			{
				return SizeF.Empty;
			}
			SizeF result = new SizeF(MeasureTextWidth(str, fontSize), header.Ascent + header.Descent + header.LineGap);
			result.Width = (float)((double)result.Width * fontSize / (double)header.UnitsPerEm);
			result.Height = (float)((double)result.Height * fontSize / (double)header.UnitsPerEm);
			return result;
		}

		private float MeasureTextWidth(string str, double fontSize)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			float num = 0f;
			int glyphIndex = GetGlyphIndex(str[0]);
			for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				int num2 = glyphIndex;
				num = ((widths.Length > num2 && num2 >= 0) ? (num + (float)(int)widths[num2]) : (num + (float)AlternativeMeasureChar(str[i], fontSize)));
				if (i != str.Length - 1)
				{
					glyphIndex = GetGlyphIndex(str[i + 1]);
					num += (float)kernTable[num2, glyphIndex];
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public SizeF MeasureMultilineText(string str, double availableWidth, double fontSize)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
			{
				return new SizeF(0f, (float)((double)(header.Ascent + header.Descent + header.LineGap) * fontSize / (double)header.UnitsPerEm));
			}
			availableWidth *= (double)header.UnitsPerEm / fontSize;
			bool flag = str.IndexOf('\r') >= 0 || str.IndexOf('\n') >= 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				str = str.Replace("\r\n", "\n").Replace('\r', '\n');
			}
			SizeF result = default(SizeF);
			int num = 1;
			string[] array = ((!flag) ? new string[1] { str } : str.Split('\n'));
			float num2 = 0f;
			int num3 = array.Length;
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
			{
				int num4 = 0;
				num2 = 0f;
				flag2 = false;
				if (i > 0)
				{
					result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, num2);
					num++;
				}
				while (true)
				{
					string nextWord = GetNextWord(array[i], num4);
					if (nextWord == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					flag2 = false;
					float num5 = MeasureTextWidth(nextWord, fontSize);
					if ((double)(num2 + num5) > availableWidth)
					{
						if (num2 == 0f)
						{
							num5 = MeasureTextWidth(nextWord.Trim(), fontSize);
							result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, num2 + num5);
							num++;
							num2 = 0f;
							flag2 = true;
						}
						else
						{
							num5 = MeasureTextWidth(nextWord.Trim(), fontSize);
							if ((double)(num2 + num5) <= availableWidth)
							{
								result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, num2 + num5);
								num++;
								num2 = 0f;
								flag2 = true;
							}
							else
							{
								result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, num2);
								num++;
								num2 = num5;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num2 += num5;
					}
					num4 += nextWord.Length;
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				num = Math.Max(1, num - 1);
			}
			result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, num2);
			result.Height = num * (header.Ascent + header.Descent + header.LineGap);
			result.Width = (float)((double)result.Width * fontSize / (double)header.UnitsPerEm);
			result.Height = (float)((double)result.Height * fontSize / (double)header.UnitsPerEm);
			return result;
		}

		private string GetNextWord(string str, int position)
		{
			int length = str.Length;
			if (position >= str.Length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = position;
			while (position < length && IsSpaceOrLineSeparator(str[position]))
			{
				position++;
			}
			if (position >= length)
			{
				return str.Substring(num);
			}
			while (position < length && !IsSpaceOrLineSeparator(str[position]))
			{
				position++;
			}
			if (position >= length)
			{
				return str.Substring(num);
			}
			while (position < length && IsSpaceOrLineSeparator(str[position]))
			{
				position++;
			}
			if (position >= length)
			{
				return str.Substring(num);
			}
			return str.Substring(num, position - num);
		}

		private bool IsSpaceOrLineSeparator(char ch)
		{
			return char.IsWhiteSpace(ch);
		}

		public Rectangle[] MeasureCharacterBounds(string str, double fontSizeInUnits)
		{
			Rectangle[] array = new Rectangle[str.Length];
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
			{
				return array;
			}
			int height = FUnitsToFontSizeUnits(header.Ascent + header.Descent + header.LineGap, fontSizeInUnits);
			int glyphIndex = GetGlyphIndex(str[0]);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				int num2 = glyphIndex;
				int num3 = ((widths.Length <= num2 || num2 < 0) ? ErrorGlyphWidth : widths[num2]);
				if (i != str.Length - 1)
				{
					glyphIndex = GetGlyphIndex(str[i + 1]);
					num3 += kernTable[num2, glyphIndex];
				}
				num3 = FUnitsToFontSizeUnits(num3, fontSizeInUnits);
				array[i] = new Rectangle(num, 0, num3, height);
				num += num3;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public int GetGlyphIndex(char chr)
		{
			return cmap.GetGlyphIndex(chr);
		}

		public int FUnitsToFontSizeUnits(int valueInFUnits, double fontSizeInUnits)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round((double)valueInFUnits * fontSizeInUnits / (double)header.UnitsPerEm);
		}

		protected void SetAscent(int value)
		{
			header.Ascent = value;
		}

		}

		public Size[] GetCharSegments()
		{
			return cmap.GetCharSegments();
		}

	internal class KernTable
	{
		private uint[] keys;

		private int[] values;

		internal bool isHorizontal;

		internal bool isMinimum;

		internal bool isCrossStream;

		internal bool isOverride;

		public bool IsHorizontal => isHorizontal;

		public bool IsMinimum => isMinimum;

		public bool IsCrossStream => isCrossStream;

		public bool IsOverride => isOverride;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (keys == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return keys.Length;
			}
		}

		public int this[int left, int right] => this[GetIndex(left, right)];

		public int this[uint key]
		{
			get
			{
				int num = IndexOfKey(key);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return values[num];
			}
		}

		public KernTable()
		{
		}

		public KernTable(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
			: this()
		{
			Read(reader);
		}

		public void Read(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			if (reader.ReadUShort() != 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("kern subtable version");
			}
			reader.ReadUShort();
			ushort coverage = reader.ReadUShort();
			if (ReadFlags(coverage) != 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("only format0 kern tables are supported");
			}
			int num = reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.Stream.Seek(6L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			keys = new uint[num];
			values = new int[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				keys[i] = reader.ReadUInt32();
				values[i] = reader.ReadShort();
			}
		}

		private int ReadFlags(ushort coverage)
		{
			isHorizontal = (coverage & 1) == 1;
			isMinimum = (coverage & 2) == 2;
			isCrossStream = (coverage & 4) == 4;
			isOverride = (coverage & 8) == 8;
			return coverage & 0xF0;
		}

		private void WriteFlagsInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			ushort num = 0;
			if (isHorizontal)
			{
				num |= 1;
			}
			if (isMinimum)
			{
				num |= 2;
			}
			if (isCrossStream)
			{
				num |= 4;
			}
			if (isOverride)
			{
				num |= 8;
			}
			writer.WriteUShort(num);
		}

		private uint GetIndex(int left, int right)
		{
			return (uint)(((left & 0xFFFF) << 16) | (right & 0xFFFF));
		}

		private int IndexOfKey(uint value)
		{
			if (keys == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = keys.Length - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num >> 1);
				if (keys[num3] == value)
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (keys[num3] < value)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void WriteInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			WriteFlagsInternal(writer);
			writer.WriteInt32(Count);
			if (Count != 0)
			{
				uint[] array = new uint[Count];
				uint num = 0u;
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = keys[i] - num - 1;
					num = keys[i];
				}
				ArrayStreamHelper<uint> arrayStreamHelper = new ArrayStreamHelper<uint>();
				arrayStreamHelper.WriteArray(writer, array, delegate(BigEndianStreamWriter w, uint value)
				{
					ArrayStreamHelper<uint>.WriteUIntCompressed(w, value);
				});
				ArrayStreamHelper<int> arrayStreamHelper2 = new ArrayStreamHelper<int>();
				arrayStreamHelper2.WriteArray(writer, values, delegate(BigEndianStreamWriter w, int value)
				{
					w.WriteShort((short)value);
				});
			}
		}

		public void ReadInternal(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			ReadFlags(reader.ReadUShort());
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (num == 0)
			{
				keys = new uint[0];
				values = new int[0];
			}
			ArrayStreamHelper<uint> arrayStreamHelper = new ArrayStreamHelper<uint>();
			uint[] array = arrayStreamHelper.ReadArray(reader, num, (BigEndianStreamReader r) => ArrayStreamHelper<uint>.ReadUIntCompressed(r));
			ArrayStreamHelper<int> arrayStreamHelper2 = new ArrayStreamHelper<int>();
			values = arrayStreamHelper2.ReadArray(reader, num, (BigEndianStreamReader r) => r.ReadShort());
			keys = new uint[num];
			uint num2 = 0u;
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < num; num3++)
			{
				num2 += array[num3] + 1;
				keys[num3] = num2;
			}
		}
	}
	public class BigEndianStreamReader
	{
		private Stream stream;

		public Stream Stream => stream;

		public BigEndianStreamReader(Stream stream)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
		}

		public float ReadFixed32()
		{
			int num = ReadShort();
			int num2 = ReadUShort();
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num2 *= -1;
			}
			return Convert.ToSingle(num) + Convert.ToSingle(num2) / 65535f;
		}

		public short ReadShort()
		{
			int num = stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = stream.ReadByte();
			return (short)((num << 8) | num2);
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public ushort ReadUShort()
		{
			return (ushort)ReadShort();
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public ushort ReadUInt16()
		{
			return (ushort)ReadShort();
		}

		public int ReadInt32()
		{
			int num = stream.ReadByte();
			int num2 = stream.ReadByte();
			int num3 = stream.ReadByte();
			int num4 = stream.ReadByte();
			return (num << 24) | (num2 << 16) | (num3 << 8) | num4;
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public uint ReadUInt32()
		{
			return (uint)ReadInt32();
		}

		public string ReadFixedString(int length)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[length];
			stream.Read(array, 0, length);
			return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(array, 0, length);
		}

		internal byte ReadByte()
		{
			return (byte)stream.ReadByte();
		}
	}
	public class ArrayStreamHelper<T> where T : struct
	{
		public T[] ReadArray(BigEndianStreamReader reader, int count, Func<BigEndianStreamReader, T> readItemAction)
		{
			if (reader.ReadByte() != 0)
			{
				return ReadArrayCompressedFormat(reader, count, readItemAction);
			}
			return ReadArrayDefaultFormat(reader, count, readItemAction);
		}

		private T[] ReadArrayDefaultFormat(BigEndianStreamReader reader, int count, Func<BigEndianStreamReader, T> readItemAction)
		{
			T[] array = new T[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = readItemAction(reader);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private T[] ReadArrayCompressedFormat(BigEndianStreamReader reader, int count, Func<BigEndianStreamReader, T> readItemAction)
		{
			T[] array = new T[count];
			int num = 0;
			while (num < count)
			{
				uint num2 = ReadUIntCompressed(reader);
				T val = readItemAction(reader);
				int num3 = 0;
				while (num3 < num2)
				{
					array[num] = val;
					num3++;
					num++;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public void WriteArray(BigEndianStreamWriter writer, T[] items, Action<BigEndianStreamWriter, T> writeItemAction)
		{
			byte[] array;
			using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
			{
				BigEndianStreamWriter writer2 = new BigEndianStreamWriter(memoryStream);
				WriteArrayCompressedFormat(writer2, items, writeItemAction);
				array = memoryStream.ToArray();
			}
			byte[] array2;
			using (MemoryStream memoryStream2 = new MemoryStream())
			{
				BigEndianStreamWriter writer3 = new BigEndianStreamWriter(memoryStream2);
				WriteArrayDefaultFormat(writer3, items, writeItemAction);
				array2 = memoryStream2.ToArray();
			}
			if (array.Length < array2.Length)
			{
				writer.WriteByte(1);
				writer.Stream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.WriteByte(0);
				writer.Stream.Write(array2, 0, array2.Length);
			}
		}

		private void WriteArrayDefaultFormat(BigEndianStreamWriter writer, T[] items, Action<BigEndianStreamWriter, T> writeItemAction)
		{
			int num = items.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				writeItemAction(writer, items[i]);
			}
		}

		private void WriteArrayCompressedFormat(BigEndianStreamWriter writer, T[] items, Action<BigEndianStreamWriter, T> writeItemAction)
		{
			T val = default(T);
			int num = items.Length;
			uint num2 = 0u;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!items[i].Equals(val))
				{
					if (num2 != 0)
					{
						WriteUIntCompressed(writer, num2);
						writeItemAction(writer, val);
					}
					val = items[i];
					num2 = 1u;
				}
				else
				{
					num2++;
				}
			}
			if (num2 != 0)
			{
				WriteUIntCompressed(writer, num2);
				writeItemAction(writer, val);
			}
		}

		internal static uint ReadUIntCompressed(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			byte b = reader.ReadByte();
			if (b < 254)
			{
				return b;
			}
			if (b == 254)
			{
				return reader.ReadUShort();
			}
			return reader.ReadUInt32();
		}

		internal static void WriteUIntCompressed(BigEndianStreamWriter writer, uint equalItemsCount)
		{
			if (equalItemsCount > 65535)
			{
				writer.WriteByte(byte.MaxValue);
				writer.WriteUInt32(equalItemsCount);
			}
			else if (equalItemsCount >= 254)
			{
				writer.WriteByte(254);
				writer.WriteUShort((ushort)equalItemsCount);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.WriteByte((byte)equalItemsCount);
			}
		}
	}
	public class BigEndianStreamWriter
	{
		private Stream stream;

		private byte[] buffer;

		public Stream Stream => stream;

		public BigEndianStreamWriter(Stream stream)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
			buffer = new byte[4];
		}

		public void WriteFixed32(float value)
		{
			short num = (short)value;
			float num2 = Math.Abs(value - (float)num);
			WriteShort(num);
			WriteUShort((ushort)(num2 * 65535f));
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public void WriteUShort(ushort value)
		{
			WriteShort((short)value);
		}

		public void WriteShort(short value)
		{
			buffer[0] = (byte)(value >> 8);
			buffer[1] = (byte)value;
			Stream.Write(buffer, 0, 2);
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public void WriteUInt32(uint value)
		{
			WriteInt32((int)value);
		}

		public void WriteInt32(int value)
		{
			buffer[0] = (byte)((value >> 24) & 0xFF);
			buffer[1] = (byte)((value >> 16) & 0xFF);
			buffer[2] = (byte)((value >> 8) & 0xFF);
			buffer[3] = (byte)(value & 0xFF);
			Stream.Write(buffer, 0, 4);
		}

		internal void WriteByte(byte value)
		{
			Stream.WriteByte(value);
		}
	}
	internal enum TTFIndexToLocFormat
	{
		Short,
		Long
	}

		SemiBold = 600,
		Bold = 700,
		ExtraBold = 800,
		Black = 900
	}

		UltraExpanded
	}
	internal class TTFHeader
	{
		public const float InternalFormatVersion = -1f;

		public const float InternalFormatVersion2 = -2f;

		private float version;

		private Dictionary<string, TTFTableRecord> tables;

		private int glyphsCount;

		private int unitsPerEm;

		private int hMetricsCount;

		private int lineGap;

		private int ascent;

		private int descent;

		private int strikeOutSize;

		private int strikeOutPosition;

		private int underlineSize;

		private int underlinePosition;

		private TTFIndexToLocFormat indexToLocFormat;

		private short glyphDataFormat;

		private short caretOffset;

		private bool isNonLinearScaling;

		private int subscriptXSize;

		private int subscriptXOffset;

		private int subscriptYSize;

		private int subscriptYOffset;

		private int superscriptXSize;

		private int superscriptXOffset;

		private int superscriptYSize;

		private int superscriptYOffset;

		private TTFWeightClass weightClass;

		private TTFWidthClass widthClass;

		private byte[] panose = new byte[10];

		public bool IsInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (Version != -1f)
				{
					return Version == -2f;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSupportKerningInternal => Version == -2f;

		public float Version => version;

		public int GlyphsCount => glyphsCount;

		public int UnitsPerEm => unitsPerEm;

		public short GlyphDataFormat => glyphDataFormat;

		public TTFIndexToLocFormat IndexToLocTableFormat => indexToLocFormat;

		public Dictionary<string, TTFTableRecord> Tables => tables;

		public bool IsNonLinearScaling => isNonLinearScaling;

		public int Ascent
		{
			get
			{
				return ascent;
			}
			internal set
			{
				ascent = value;
			}
		}

		public int Descent
		{
			get
			{
				return descent;
			}
			internal set
			{
				descent = value;
			}
		}

		public int LineGap
		{
			get
			{
				return lineGap;
			}
			internal set
			{
				lineGap = value;
			}
		}

		public short CaretOffset => caretOffset;

		public int HMetricsCount => hMetricsCount;

		public int SubscriptXSize => subscriptXSize;

		public int SubscriptXOffset => subscriptXOffset;

		public int SubscriptYSize => subscriptYSize;

		public int SubscriptYOffset => subscriptYOffset;

		public int SuperscriptXSize => superscriptXSize;

		public int SuperscriptXOffset => superscriptXOffset;

		public int SuperscriptYSize => superscriptYSize;

		public int SuperscriptYOffset => superscriptYOffset;

		public TTFWeightClass WeightClass => weightClass;

		public TTFWidthClass WidthClass => widthClass;

		public int StrikeOutSize => strikeOutSize;

		public int StrikeOutPosition => strikeOutPosition;

		public int UnderlineSize => underlineSize;

		public int UnderlinePosition => underlinePosition;

		public byte[] Panose => panose;

		public void Read(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			version = reader.ReadFixed32();
			if (version == 1f)
			{
				ReadV10(reader);
				return;
			}
			if (version == -1f || version == -2f)
			{
				ReadInternal(reader);
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException($"version={version}, expected versions: {1.0}, {-1f}, {-2f}");
		}

		private void ReadV10(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			int numTables = reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.Stream.Seek(6L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			ReadTableRecords(reader, numTables);
			ReadMAXPTable(reader);
			ReadHEADTable(reader);
			ReadHHEATable(reader);
			ReadOS2Table(reader);
			ReadPOSTTable(reader);
		}

		private void ReadInternal(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			glyphsCount = reader.ReadUShort();
			unitsPerEm = reader.ReadUShort();
			ascent = reader.ReadShort();
			descent = reader.ReadShort();
			lineGap = reader.ReadShort();
			caretOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			subscriptXSize = reader.ReadShort();
			subscriptXOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			subscriptYSize = reader.ReadShort();
			subscriptYOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			superscriptXSize = reader.ReadShort();
			superscriptXOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			superscriptYSize = reader.ReadShort();
			superscriptYOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			strikeOutPosition = reader.ReadShort();
			strikeOutSize = reader.ReadShort();
			underlinePosition = reader.ReadShort();
			underlineSize = reader.ReadShort();
			StreamHelper.FillBuffer(reader.Stream, panose, 0, 10);
		}

		public void WriteInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteFixed32(-2f);
			writer.WriteUShort((ushort)GlyphsCount);
			writer.WriteUShort((ushort)UnitsPerEm);
			writer.WriteShort((short)Ascent);
			writer.WriteShort((short)Descent);
			writer.WriteShort((short)LineGap);
			writer.WriteShort(CaretOffset);
			writer.WriteShort((short)SubscriptXSize);
			writer.WriteShort((short)SubscriptXOffset);
			writer.WriteShort((short)SubscriptYSize);
			writer.WriteShort((short)SubscriptYOffset);
			writer.WriteShort((short)SuperscriptXSize);
			writer.WriteShort((short)SuperscriptXOffset);
			writer.WriteShort((short)SuperscriptYSize);
			writer.WriteShort((short)SuperscriptYOffset);
			writer.WriteShort((short)StrikeOutPosition);
			writer.WriteShort((short)StrikeOutSize);
			writer.WriteShort((short)UnderlinePosition);
			writer.WriteShort((short)UnderlineSize);
			writer.Stream.Write(Panose, 0, Panose.Length);
		}

		private void ReadTableRecords(BigEndianStreamReader reader, int numTables)
		{
			tables = new Dictionary<string, TTFTableRecord>(numTables);
			for (int i = 0; i < numTables; i++)
			{
				TTFTableRecord tTFTableRecord = new TTFTableRecord();
				tTFTableRecord.Read(reader);
				Tables.Add(tTFTableRecord.Tag, tTFTableRecord);
			}
		}

		private void ReadMAXPTable(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			SeekToTable(reader, "maxp");
			float num = reader.ReadFixed32();
			if ((double)num != 1.0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("maxp table version");
			}
			glyphsCount = reader.ReadUShort();
		}

		private void ReadHEADTable(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			SeekToTable(reader, "head");
			float num = reader.ReadFixed32();
			if ((double)num != 1.0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("head table version");
			}
			reader.Stream.Seek(12L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			ushort flags = reader.ReadUShort();
			ParseFlags(flags);
			unitsPerEm = reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.Stream.Seek(30L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			indexToLocFormat = (TTFIndexToLocFormat)reader.ReadShort();
			glyphDataFormat = reader.ReadShort();
		}

		private void ReadHHEATable(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			SeekToTable(reader, "hhea");
			float num = reader.ReadFixed32();
			if ((double)num != 1.0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("hhea table version");
			}
			ascent = reader.ReadShort();
			descent = -reader.ReadShort();
			lineGap = reader.ReadShort();
			reader.Stream.Seek(12L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			caretOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			if (reader.ReadUInt32() != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("corrupted hhea table: no zero padding");
			}
			if (reader.ReadUInt32() != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("corrupted hhea table: no zero padding");
			}
			if (reader.ReadShort() != 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("metric data format");
			}
			hMetricsCount = reader.ReadUShort();
		}

		private void ReadOS2Table(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			SeekToTable(reader, "OS/2");
			reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.Stream.Seek(2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			weightClass = (TTFWeightClass)reader.ReadUShort();
			widthClass = (TTFWidthClass)reader.ReadUShort();
			reader.Stream.Seek(2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			subscriptXSize = reader.ReadShort();
			subscriptYSize = reader.ReadShort();
			subscriptXOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			subscriptYOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			superscriptXSize = reader.ReadShort();
			superscriptYSize = reader.ReadShort();
			superscriptXOffset = reader.ReadShort();
			superscriptYOffset = -reader.ReadShort();
			strikeOutSize = reader.ReadShort();
			strikeOutPosition = reader.ReadShort();
			reader.ReadShort();
			StreamHelper.FillBuffer(reader.Stream, panose, 0, 10);
		}

		private void ReadPOSTTable(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			if (SeekToTable(reader, "post"))
			{
				reader.Stream.Seek(8L, SeekOrigin.Current);
				underlinePosition = -reader.ReadShort();
				underlineSize = reader.ReadShort();
			}
		}

		public bool SeekToTable(BigEndianStreamReader reader, string name)
		{
			if (!Tables.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			reader.Stream.Seek(Tables[name].Offset, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return true;
		}

		private void ParseFlags(ushort flags)
		{
			isNonLinearScaling = (flags & 0x10) == 16;
		}
	}
	internal class TTFTableRecord
	{
		private string tag;

		private uint offset;

		private uint length;

		public string Tag => tag;

		public uint Offset => offset;

		public uint Length => length;

		public void Read(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			tag = reader.ReadFixedString(4);
			reader.Stream.Seek(4L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			offset = reader.ReadUInt32();
			length = reader.ReadUInt32();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Tag + ":" + Length + " bytes at " + Offset;
		}
	}
	internal class CMAPTable
	{
		private CharMapper4 mapper;

		public int GetGlyphIndex(char chr)
		{
			if (mapper == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("cmap table isn't loaded");
			}
			return mapper.GetGlyphIndex(chr);
		}

		public void Read(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			if (reader.ReadUShort() == 0)
			{
				ReadV0(reader);
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("invalid cmap table version");
		}

		private void ReadV0(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			long num = reader.Stream.Position - 2;
			ushort numRecords = reader.ReadUShort();
			List<EncodingRecord> encodingRecords = ReadEncodingRecords(reader, numRecords);
			EncodingRecord encodingRecord = FindEncodingRecord(encodingRecords, Platform.Windows, 1);
			if (encodingRecord == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("only Windows Unicode cmap tables are supported");
			}
			reader.Stream.Seek(num + encodingRecord.Offset, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			reader.ReadUShort();
			mapper = new CharMapper4();
			mapper.Read(reader);
		}

		public void ReadInternal(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			mapper = new CharMapper4();
			mapper.ReadInternal(reader);
		}

		public void WriteInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			mapper.WriteInternal(writer);
		}

		private List<EncodingRecord> ReadEncodingRecords(BigEndianStreamReader reader, ushort numRecords)
		{
			List<EncodingRecord> list = new List<EncodingRecord>(numRecords);
			for (ushort num = 0; num < numRecords; num++)
			{
				list.Add(new EncodingRecord(reader));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private EncodingRecord FindEncodingRecord(IEnumerable<EncodingRecord> encodingRecords, Platform platform, ushort encodingID)
		{
			foreach (EncodingRecord encodingRecord in encodingRecords)
			{
				if (encodingRecord.Platform == platform)
				{
					return encodingRecord;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Size[] GetCharSegments()
		{
			CharMapper4Segment[] segments = mapper.Segments;
			int num = segments.Length;
			Size[] array = new Size[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new Size(segments[i].StartCode, segments[i].EndCode);
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	internal enum Platform
	{
		Unicode = 0,
		Mac = 1,
		Windows = 3
	}
	internal class EncodingRecord
	{
		public Platform Platform;

		public ushort EncodingID;

		public uint Offset;

		public EncodingRecord()
		{
		}

		public EncodingRecord(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
			: this()
		{
			Read(reader);
		}

		public void Read(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			Platform = (Platform)reader.ReadUShort();
			EncodingID = reader.ReadUShort();
			Offset = reader.ReadUInt32();
		}
	}
	internal class CharMapper4
	{
		private CharMapper4Segment[] segments;

		public CharMapper4Segment[] Segments => segments;

		public int GetGlyphIndex(char chr)
		{
			if (segments == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("you should load char mapper first");
			}
			int num = IndexOfSegment(chr);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return segments[num].GetGlyphIndex(chr);
		}

		public void Read(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			reader.Stream.Seek(4L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			int num = reader.ReadUShort();
			if (num % 2 != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid data");
			}
			num /= 2;
			reader.Stream.Seek(6L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			segments = new CharMapper4Segment[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				segments[i] = new CharMapper4Segment();
				segments[i].EndCode = reader.ReadUShort();
				if (i == num - 1 && segments[i].EndCode != ushort.MaxValue)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("corrupted data: last segment's endCount have to be 0xFFFF");
				}
			}
			if (reader.ReadUShort() != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("corrupted data: zero pad is missing");
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				segments[j].StartCode = reader.ReadUShort();
				if (segments[j].StartCode > segments[j].EndCode)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("corrupted data: invalid startCount");
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
			{
				segments[k].IdDelta = reader.ReadShort();
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
			{
				ushort num2 = reader.ReadUShort();
				if (num2 != 0)
				{
					long position = reader.Stream.Position;
					reader.Stream.Seek(num2 - 2, SeekOrigin.Current);
					CharMapper4Segment charMapper4Segment = segments[l];
					charMapper4Segment.IndexArray = new ushort[charMapper4Segment.EndCode - charMapper4Segment.StartCode];
					for (int m = 0; m < charMapper4Segment.IndexArray.Length; m++)
					{
						charMapper4Segment.IndexArray[m] = reader.ReadUShort();
					}
					reader.Stream.Seek(position, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ReadInternal(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadUShort();
			segments = new CharMapper4Segment[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				segments[i] = new CharMapper4Segment();
				segments[i].ReadInternal(reader);
			}
		}

		public void WriteInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			int num = segments.Length;
			writer.WriteUShort((ushort)num);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				segments[i].WriteInternal(writer);
			}
		}

		protected int IndexOfSegment(char chr)
		{
			if (segments == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			ushort num = chr;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = segments.Length - 1;
			while (num2 <= num3)
			{
				int num4 = num2 + (num3 - num2 >> 1);
				CharMapper4Segment charMapper4Segment = segments[num4];
				if (charMapper4Segment.StartCode <= num && num <= charMapper4Segment.EndCode)
				{
					return num4;
				}
				if (num > charMapper4Segment.EndCode)
				{
					num2 = num4 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = num4 - 1;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal class CharMapper4Segment
	{
		public ushort StartCode;

		public ushort EndCode;

		public short IdDelta;

		public ushort[] IndexArray;

		public bool IsCharFallInRange(ushort chrIndex)
		{
			if (chrIndex >= StartCode)
			{
				return chrIndex <= EndCode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int GetGlyphIndex(char chr)
		{
			if (IndexArray != null)
			{
				int num = chr - StartCode;
				if (num < 0 || num >= IndexArray.Length)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return IndexArray[chr - StartCode];
			}
			ushort num2 = chr;
			return (ushort)(num2 + (ushort)IdDelta);
		}

		public void WriteInternal(BigEndianStreamWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteUShort(StartCode);
			writer.WriteUShort(EndCode);
			writer.WriteShort(IdDelta);
			if (IdDelta == 0)
			{
				writer.WriteUShort((ushort)IndexArray.Length);
				for (int i = 0; i < IndexArray.Length; i++)
				{
					writer.WriteUShort(IndexArray[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ReadInternal(BigEndianStreamReader reader)
		{
			StartCode = reader.ReadUShort();
			EndCode = reader.ReadUShort();
			IdDelta = reader.ReadShort();
			if (IdDelta == 0)
			{
				int num = reader.ReadUShort();
				IndexArray = new ushort[num];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					IndexArray[i] = reader.ReadUShort();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IndexArray = null;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "[" + StartCode + ", " + EndCode + "] -> [" + (StartCode + IdDelta) + ", " + (EndCode + IdDelta) + "]";
		}
	}
	public interface IFontBasedElement
	{
		void OnFontsChanged();
	}
	public class FontDescriptorManager
	{
		private readonly FontFamily fontFamily;

		private readonly Stream normalFontStream;

		private readonly Stream boldFontStream;

		private readonly Stream italicFontStream;

		private readonly Stream boldItalicFontStream;

		private readonly FontDescriptor[] fontDescriptors;

		public FontDescriptorManager(string fontFamilyName, Stream normalFontStream, Stream boldFontStream, Stream italicFontStream, Stream boldItalicFontStream)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)normalFontStream, "normalFontStream");
			fontFamily = new FontFamily(fontFamilyName);
			fontDescriptors = new FontDescriptor[4];
			this.normalFontStream = normalFontStream;
			this.boldFontStream = boldFontStream;
			this.italicFontStream = italicFontStream;
			this.boldItalicFontStream = boldItalicFontStream;
		}

		public FontDescriptor GetFontDescriptor(bool bold, bool italic)
		{
			return GetFontDescriptor(GetFontStyle(bold, italic));
		}

		private FontDescriptor GetFontDescriptor(FontStyle fontStyle)
		{
			FontDescriptor fontDescriptor = fontDescriptors[(int)fontStyle];
			if (fontDescriptor == null)
			{
				fontDescriptor = CreateFontDescriptor(fontStyle);
				fontDescriptors[(int)fontStyle] = fontDescriptor;
			}
			return fontDescriptor;
		}

		private FontDescriptor CreateFontDescriptor(FontStyle fontStyle)
		{
			return fontStyle switch
			{
				FontStyle.Regular => CreateFontDescriptorCore(FontStyle.Regular, normalFontStream), 
				FontStyle.Bold => CreateFromStreamOrDefault(FontStyle.Bold, boldFontStream), 
				FontStyle.Italic => CreateFromStreamOrDefault(FontStyle.Italic, italicFontStream), 
				FontStyle.Bold | FontStyle.Italic => CreateBoldItalicFontDescritpor(), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("fontStyle"), 
			};
		}

		private FontDescriptor CreateFromStreamOrDefault(FontStyle fontStyle, Stream fontStream)
		{
			if (fontStream != null)
			{
				return CreateFontDescriptorCore(fontStyle, fontStream);
			}
			return GetFontDescriptor(FontStyle.Regular);
		}

		private FontDescriptor CreateBoldItalicFontDescritpor()
		{
			if (boldItalicFontStream != null)
			{
				return CreateFontDescriptorCore(FontStyle.Bold | FontStyle.Italic, boldItalicFontStream);
			}
			if (boldFontStream != null)
			{
				return GetFontDescriptor(FontStyle.Bold);
			}
			if (italicFontStream != null)
			{
				return GetFontDescriptor(FontStyle.Italic);
			}
			return GetFontDescriptor(FontStyle.Regular);
		}

		private FontDescriptor CreateFontDescriptorCore(FontStyle fontStyle, Stream fontStream)
		{
			return new FontDescriptor(fontFamily, fontStyle, fontStream);
		}

		private FontStyle GetFontStyle(bool bold, bool italic)
		{
			FontStyle fontStyle = FontStyle.Regular;
			if (bold)
			{
				fontStyle |= FontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (italic)
			{
				fontStyle |= FontStyle.Italic;
			}
			return fontStyle;
		}
	}

	public class FontManager
	{
		public const string DefaultFontFamilyName = "Arial";

		private static string[] PredefinedFontFamilyNamesWin;

		private static string[] PredefinedFontFilesWin;

		private static Dictionary<string, FontDescriptorManager> customFontDescriptorCache;

		private static Dictionary<string, FontDescriptorManager> predefinedFontDescriptorCache;

		private static List<WeakReference> ElementsToNotify;

		static FontManager()
		{
			PredefinedFontFamilyNamesWin = new string[45]
			{
				"Arial", "Arial Black", "Comic Sans MS", "Courier New", "Georgia", "Lucida Sans Unicode", "Times New Roman", "Trebuchet MS", "Verdana", "MS Mincho",
				"MS PMincho", "SimSun", "SimSun-ExtB", "Calibri", "Book Antiqua", "Bookman Old Style", "Cambria", "Candara", "Century", "Century Gothic",
				"Century Schoolbook", "Consolas", "Cordia New", "Franklin Gothic Book", "Garamond", "Gill Sans MT", "Impact", "Lucida Console", "Lucida Sans", "MingLiU",
				"MingLiU_HKSCS", "MS Gothic", "Palatino Linotype", "PMingLiU-ExtB", "PMingLiU", "Rockwell", "Segoe UI", "Shruti", "Simhei", "Sylfaen",
				"Tahoma", "Tunga", "TW Cen MT", "Vrinda", "Angsana New"
			};
			PredefinedFontFilesWin = new string[45]
			{
				"Arial", "ArialBlack", "ComicSansMS", "CourierNew", "Georgia", "LucidaSansUnicode", "Times", "TrebuchetMS", "Verdana", "MSMincho",
				"MSPMincho", "SimSun", "SimSunExtB", "Calibri", "BookAntiqua", "BookmanOldStyle", "Cambria", "Candara", "Century", "CenturyGothic",
				"CenturySchoolbook", "Consolas", "CordiaNew", "FranklinGothicBook", "Garamond", "GillSansMT", "Impact", "LucidaConsole", "LucidaSans", "MingLiU",
				"MingLiU_HKSCS", "MSGothic", "PalatinoLinotype", "PMingLiU-ExtB", "PMingLiU", "Rockwell", "SegoeUI", "Shruti", "Simhei", "Sylfaen",
				"Tahoma", "Tunga", "TWCenMT", "Vrinda", "AngsaNew"
			};
			customFontDescriptorCache = new Dictionary<string, FontDescriptorManager>();
			predefinedFontDescriptorCache = new Dictionary<string, FontDescriptorManager>();
			ElementsToNotify = new List<WeakReference>();
			RegisterPredefinedFonts();
		}

		private static void RegisterPredefinedFonts()
		{
			string[] predefinedFontFamilyNamesWin = PredefinedFontFamilyNamesWin;
			string[] predefinedFontFilesWin = PredefinedFontFilesWin;
			for (int i = 0; i < predefinedFontFamilyNamesWin.Length; i++)
			{
				FontDescriptorManager fontDescriptorManager = CreateFontDescriptorManager(predefinedFontFamilyNamesWin[i], predefinedFontFilesWin[i]);
				if (fontDescriptorManager != null)
				{
					predefinedFontDescriptorCache.Add(predefinedFontFamilyNamesWin[i], fontDescriptorManager);
				}
			}
		}

		private static FontDescriptorManager CreateFontDescriptorManager(string familyName, string fileName)
		{
			try
			{
				return new FontDescriptorManager(familyName, GetPredefinedFontStream(fileName), GetPredefinedFontStream(fileName + "B"), GetPredefinedFontStream(fileName + "I"), GetPredefinedFontStream(fileName + "BI"));
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static Stream GetPredefinedFontStream(string name)
		{
			return typeof(FontManager).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("DevExpress.Office.FontEngine.FontManager.Fonts." + name + ".fmx");
		}

		public static FontDescriptor GetFontDescriptor(string familyName, bool bold, bool italic)
		{
			if (customFontDescriptorCache.TryGetValue(familyName, out var value))
			{
				return value.GetFontDescriptor(bold, italic);
			}
			if (predefinedFontDescriptorCache.TryGetValue(familyName, out value))
			{
				return value.GetFontDescriptor(bold, italic);
			}
			return GetFontDescriptor("Arial", bold, italic);
		}

		public static void RegisterFontBasedElement(IFontBasedElement element)
		{
			ElementsToNotify.Add(new WeakReference(element));
		}

		public static IEnumerable<string> GetFontFamilyNames()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(customFontDescriptorCache.Keys);
			foreach (string key in predefinedFontDescriptorCache.Keys)
			{
				if (!list.Contains(key))
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			return list;
		}

		public static void RegisterFontFamily(string familyName, Stream normalFontStream)
		{
			RegisterFontFamily(familyName, normalFontStream, null, null, null);
		}

		public static void RegisterFontFamily(string familyName, Stream normalFontStream, Stream boldFontStream, Stream italicFontStream, Stream boldItalicFontStream)
		{
			if (!customFontDescriptorCache.ContainsKey(familyName))
			{
				customFontDescriptorCache.Add(familyName, new FontDescriptorManager(familyName, normalFontStream, boldFontStream, italicFontStream, boldItalicFontStream));
				RaiseFontFamilyNamesChanged();
			}
		}

		public static void UnregisterFontFamily(string familyName)
		{
			if (customFontDescriptorCache.ContainsKey(familyName))
			{
				customFontDescriptorCache.Remove(familyName);
				RaiseFontFamilyNamesChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void RaiseFontFamilyNamesChanged()
		{
			foreach (WeakReference item in ElementsToNotify)
			{
				IFontBasedElement fontBasedElement = item.Target as IFontBasedElement;
				fontBasedElement.OnFontsChanged();
			}
		}
	}
	public class FontSurrogate
	{
		public float Size { get; set; }

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public DXFontStyle Style { get; set; }

		public bool Regular
		{
			get
			{
				return Style == DXFontStyle.Regular;
			}
			set
			{
				Style = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			}
		}

		public bool Bold
		{
			get
			{
				return ExistsStyle(DXFontStyle.Bold);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					SetStyle(DXFontStyle.Bold);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearStyle(DXFontStyle.Bold);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Italic
		{
			get
			{
				return ExistsStyle(DXFontStyle.Italic);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					SetStyle(DXFontStyle.Italic);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearStyle(DXFontStyle.Italic);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Underline
		{
			get
			{
				return ExistsStyle(DXFontStyle.Underline);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					SetStyle(DXFontStyle.Underline);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearStyle(DXFontStyle.Underline);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Strikeout
		{
			get
			{
				return ExistsStyle(DXFontStyle.Strikeout);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					SetStyle(DXFontStyle.Strikeout);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearStyle(DXFontStyle.Strikeout);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Name == string.Empty && Size == 0f)
				{
					return Style == DXFontStyle.Regular;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static FontSurrogate FromFont(Font font)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				return new FontSurrogate
				{
					Name = string.Empty,
					Size = 0f,
					Style = DXFontStyle.Regular
				};
			}
			return new FontSurrogate
			{
				Name = font.Name,
				Size = font.Size,
				Style = (DXFontStyle)font.Style
			};
		}

		public static Font ToFont(FontSurrogate surrogate)
		{
			return new Font(surrogate.Name, surrogate.Size, (FontStyle)surrogate.Style);
		}

		public static FontSurrogate FromDXFont(DXFont font)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				return new FontSurrogate
				{
					Name = string.Empty,
					Size = 0f,
					Style = DXFontStyle.Regular
				};
			}
			return new FontSurrogate
			{
				Name = font.Name,
				Size = font.Size,
				Style = font.Style
			};
		}

		public static DXFont ToDXFont(FontSurrogate surrogate)
		{
			return new DXFont(surrogate.Name, surrogate.Size, surrogate.Style);
		}

		private bool ExistsStyle(DXFontStyle flag)
		{
			return (Style & flag) > DXFontStyle.Regular;
		}

		private void SetStyle(DXFontStyle flag)
		{
			Style |= flag;
		}

		private void ClearStyle(DXFontStyle flag)
		{
			Style &= ~flag;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is FontSurrogate fontSurrogate)
			{
				if (Name == fontSurrogate.Name && Size == fontSurrogate.Size)
				{
					return Style == fontSurrogate.Style;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
}

	public abstract class OfficeDataControllerAdapterBase : IDisposable
	{
		private EventHandler onCurrentRowChaned;

		private EventHandler onDataSourceChanged;

		public abstract bool IsReady { get; }

		public abstract int ListSourceRowCount { get; }

		public abstract int CurrentControllerRow { get; set; }

		public abstract object DataSource { get; set; }

		public abstract string DataMember { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler CurrentRowChanged
		{
			add
			{
				onCurrentRowChaned = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onCurrentRowChaned, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onCurrentRowChaned = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onCurrentRowChaned, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler DataSourceChanged
		{
			add
			{
				onDataSourceChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onDataSourceChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onDataSourceChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onDataSourceChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public abstract int GetColumnIndex(string name);

		public abstract object GetCurrentRowValue(int columnIndex);

		public abstract object GetCurrentRow();

		protected virtual void RaiseCurrentRowChangedEvent()
		{
			if (onCurrentRowChaned != null)
			{
				onCurrentRowChaned(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseDataSourceChanged()
		{
			if (onDataSourceChanged != null)
			{
				onDataSourceChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
		}
	}

		{

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (fieldsMapDataListener != null)
				{
					UnsubscribeFieldsMapDataEvents();
					((NotificationCollectionChangedListenerBase<FieldMapData>)(object)fieldsMapDataListener).Dispose();
				}
				fieldsMapDataListener = null;
				fieldsMapData = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeFieldsMapDataEvents()
		{
			((NotificationCollectionChangedListenerBase<FieldMapData>)(object)fieldsMapDataListener).Changed += OnFieldsMapDataChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeFieldsMapDataEvents()
		{
			((NotificationCollectionChangedListenerBase<FieldMapData>)(object)fieldsMapDataListener).Changed -= OnFieldsMapDataChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void OnFieldsMapDataChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int count = ((DXCollectionBase<FieldMapData>)(object)FieldsMapData).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FieldMapData fieldMapData = ((DXCollection<FieldMapData>)(object)FieldsMapData)[i];
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldMapData.MappedName))
				{
					mapFieldMappedName.Add(fieldMapData.MappedName, fieldMapData);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldMapData.ColumnName))
				{
					mapColumnName.Add(fieldMapData.ColumnName, fieldMapData);
				}
			}
			RaiseFieldsMapDataChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseFieldsMapDataChanged()
		{
			if (fieldsMapDataChanged != null)
			{
				fieldsMapDataChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public virtual FieldMapData FindMapDataByColumnName(string columnName)
		{
			if (mapColumnName.TryGetValue(columnName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual FieldMapData FindMapDataByMapName(string mappedFieldName)
		{
			if (mapFieldMappedName.TryGetValue(mappedFieldName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class OfficeDataController : GridDataController
	{
		protected override IList GetListSource()
		{
			if (((BaseGridController)this).DataSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (((BaseGridController)this).DataSource is DataSet dataSet && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((BaseGridController)this).DataMember) && dataSet.Tables != null)
			{
				int num = dataSet.Tables.IndexOf(((BaseGridController)this).DataMember);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					IListSource listSource = dataSet.Tables[num];
					if (listSource != null)
					{
						return listSource.GetList();
					}
				}
			}
			return ((GridDataController)this).GetListSource();
		}
	}
	public abstract class OpenDocumentImporterBase : DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter, IDisposable
	{
		private PackageFileCollection packageFiles;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, OfficeNativeImage> packageImages;

		public PackageFileCollection PackageFiles => packageFiles;

		public Dictionary<string, OfficeNativeImage> PackageImageStreams => packageImages;

		public override string RelationsNamespace => string.Empty;

		public override string DocumentRootFolder { get; set; }

		public override OpenXmlRelationCollection DocumentRelations => null;

		protected OpenDocumentImporterBase(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
			packageImages = new Dictionary<string, OfficeNativeImage>();
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposePackageFiles();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual void DisposePackageFiles()
		{
			if (PackageFiles != null)
			{
				int count = ((List<PackageFile>)(object)PackageFiles).Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					((List<PackageFile>)(object)PackageFiles)[i].Stream.Dispose();
				}
				((List<PackageFile>)(object)PackageFiles).Clear();
				packageFiles = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual void OpenPackage(Stream stream)
		{
			packageFiles = GetPackageFiles(stream);
		}

		protected internal virtual PackageFileCollection GetPackageFiles(Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			InternalZipFileCollection val = InternalZipArchive.Open(stream);
			int count = ((List<InternalZipFile>)(object)val).Count;
			PackageFileCollection val2 = new PackageFileCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				InternalZipFile val3 = ((List<InternalZipFile>)(object)val)[i];
				((List<PackageFile>)(object)val2).Add(new PackageFile(val3.FileName.Replace('\\', '/'), val3.FileDataStream, (int)val3.UncompressedSize));
			}
			return val2;
		}

		public virtual XmlReader GetPackageFileXmlReader(string fileName)
		{
			Stream packageFileStream = GetPackageFileStream(fileName);
			if (packageFileStream == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateXmlReader(packageFileStream);
		}

		public virtual Stream GetPackageFileStream(string fileName)
		{
			PackageFile packageFile = GetPackageFile(fileName);
			if (packageFile == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return packageFile.Stream;
		}

		protected internal virtual PackageFile GetPackageFile(string fileName)
		{
			if (PackageFiles == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			fileName = fileName.Replace('\\', '/');
			if (fileName.StartsWith("./"))
			{
				fileName = fileName.Substring(2);
			}
			else if (fileName.StartsWith("/"))
			{
				fileName = fileName.Substring(1);
			}
			int count = ((List<PackageFile>)(object)PackageFiles).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				PackageFile val = ((List<PackageFile>)(object)PackageFiles)[i];
				if (string.Compare(val.FileName, fileName, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void ThrowInvalidFile()
		{
			throw new Exception("Invalid OpenDocument file");
		}

		protected override void PrepareOfficeTheme()
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ApplyXmlReaderSettings(XmlReaderSettings settings)
		{
			base.ApplyXmlReaderSettings(settings);
			settings.IgnoreWhitespace = false;
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeImportMainDocument()
		{
			base.BeforeImportMainDocument();
			ApplyDefaultProperties();
			ImportStyles();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ImportStyles()
		{
			string text = "styles.xml";
			XmlReader packageFileXmlReader = GetPackageFileXmlReader(text);
			if (packageFileXmlReader != null)
			{
				ImportStylesCore(packageFileXmlReader, text);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ImportStylesCore(XmlReader reader, string contentFileName)
		{
			if (ReadToRootElement(reader, "document-styles", "urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0"))
			{
				base.DestinationStack = new Stack<Destination>();
				ImportContent(reader, CreateRootStyleDestination(), contentFileName);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ApplyDefaultProperties()
		{
		}

		public virtual OfficeImage LookUpImageByFileName(string fileName)
		{
			if (packageImages.TryGetValue(fileName, out var value))
			{
				return new OfficeReferenceImage(base.DocumentModel, value);
			}
			Stream stream = LookupImageStreamByFileName(fileName);
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				OfficeReferenceImage officeReferenceImage = base.DocumentModel.CreateImage(stream);
				packageImages.Add(fileName, officeReferenceImage.NativeRootImage);
				return officeReferenceImage;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual Stream LookupImageStreamByFileName(string fileName)
		{
			PackageFile packageFile = GetPackageFile(fileName);
			if (packageFile == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[packageFile.StreamLength];
			StreamHelper.FillBuffer(packageFile.Stream, array, 0, array.Length);
			return new MemoryStream(array);
		}

		public override bool ConvertToBool(string value)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (bool.TryParse(value, out result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			ThrowInvalidFile();
			return false;
		}

		public override string ReadAttribute(XmlReader reader, string attributeName)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public override string ReadAttribute(XmlReader reader, string attributeName, string ns)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		protected internal override bool ProcessCurrentDestination(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (base.DestinationStack.Count > 0)
			{
				return base.ProcessCurrentDestination(reader);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal abstract Destination CreateRootStyleDestination();
	}
	public class RtfDocumentEncodingHelper
	{
		public static Encoding CreateDefaultEncoding()
		{
			Encoding encoding = DXEncoding.Default;
			if (encoding.CodePage == 65000 || encoding.CodePage == 65001 || encoding.CodePage == 1200 || encoding.CodePage == 1201)
			{
				if (FrameworkVersions.IsNetCore3AndAbove())
				{
					return GetEncodingSafe(1252);
				}
				return DXEncoding.GetEncoding(1252);
			}
			return encoding;
		}

		private static Encoding GetEncodingSafe(int codePage)
		{
			try
			{
				return Encoding.GetEncoding(codePage);
			}
			catch (NotSupportedException)
			{
				return DXEncoding.Default;
			}
		}
	}
	public class TranslationTable<T> where T : struct
	{
		private Collection<TranslationTableEntry<T>> innerCollection = new Collection<TranslationTableEntry<T>>();

		public Collection<TranslationTableEntry<T>> InnerCollection => innerCollection;

		public void Add(T key, string value)
		{
			TranslationTableEntry<T> item = new TranslationTableEntry<T>(key, value);
			innerCollection.Add(item);
		}

		public T GetEnumValue(string str, T defaultValue, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			if (!caseSensitive)
			{
				str = str.ToLowerInvariant();
			}
			foreach (TranslationTableEntry<T> item in innerCollection)
			{
				if (str == item.Value)
				{
					return item.Key;
				}
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public T GetEnumValue(string str, T defaultValue)
		{
			return GetEnumValue(str, defaultValue, caseSensitive: false);
		}

		public string GetStringValue(T key, T defaultKey)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (TranslationTableEntry<T> item in innerCollection)
			{
				if (key.Equals(item.Key))
				{
					return item.Value;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && defaultKey.Equals(item.Key))
				{
					text = item.Value;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	public class TranslationTableEntry<T> where T : struct
	{
		private T key;

		private string value;

		public T Key => key;

		public string Value => value;

		public TranslationTableEntry(T key, string value)
		{
			this.key = key;
			this.value = value;
		}

	public abstract class DocumentModelImporter
	{
		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly ProgressIndication progressIndication;

		private readonly CancellationProvider cancellationProvider;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		protected internal ProgressIndication ProgressIndication => progressIndication;

		public CancellationProvider CancellationProvider => cancellationProvider;

		protected DocumentModelImporter(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			progressIndication = new ProgressIndication(documentModel);
			cancellationProvider = new CancellationProvider(documentModel);
		}

		public abstract void ThrowInvalidFile();
	}
	public abstract class DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter : DestinationBasedImporter
	{
		private Stream baseStream;

		private IDocumentModel actualDocumentModel;

		private UnitsConverter unitsConverter;

		private readonly ILogUnsupportedContentService logUnsupportedContentService;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, UriBasedOfficeImage> uniqueUriBasedImages = new Dictionary<string, UriBasedOfficeImage>();

		protected internal Stream BaseStream
		{
			get
			{
				return baseStream;
			}
			set
			{
				baseStream = value;
			}
		}

		public IDocumentModel ActualDocumentModel
		{
			get
			{
				return actualDocumentModel;
			}
			set
			{
				actualDocumentModel = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CreateEmptyDocumentOnLoadError => true;

		public abstract string RelationsNamespace { get; }

		public abstract string DocumentRootFolder { get; set; }

		public abstract OpenXmlRelationCollection DocumentRelations { get; }

		protected virtual bool ThrowExceptionOnReaderError => false;

		public bool AbortImport { get; set; }

		public UnitsConverter ValueUnitsConverter => unitsConverter;

		protected string CurrentContentFileName { get; set; }

		public virtual bool AllowIntPercentage => false;

		public virtual bool AllowUniversalMeasureValues => false;

		protected DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
			actualDocumentModel = base.DocumentModel;
			unitsConverter = new UnitsConverter(base.DocumentModel.UnitConverter);
			logUnsupportedContentService = base.DocumentModel.GetService<ILogUnsupportedContentService>();
		}

		public virtual XmlReader CreateXmlReader(Stream stream)
		{
			return SafeXml.CreateReader(stream, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)ApplyXmlReaderSettings);
		}

		protected internal virtual void ApplyXmlReaderSettings(XmlReaderSettings settings)
		{
			settings.IgnoreComments = true;
			settings.IgnoreWhitespace = true;
		}

		public virtual bool ReadToRootElement(XmlReader reader, string name)
		{
			try
			{
				return reader.ReadToFollowing(name);
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ReadToRootElement(XmlReader reader, string name, string ns)
		{
			try
			{
				return reader.ReadToFollowing(name, ns);
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual void ImportContent(XmlReader reader, Destination initialDestination, string contentFileName)
		{
			int count = base.DestinationStack.Count;
			base.DestinationStack.Push(initialDestination);
			string currentContentFileName = CurrentContentFileName;
			CurrentContentFileName = contentFileName;
			ImportContent(reader);
			CurrentContentFileName = currentContentFileName;
			while (base.DestinationStack.Count > count)
			{
				base.DestinationStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		public virtual int BeginImportContent(XmlReader reader, Destination initialDestination)
		{
			int count = base.DestinationStack.Count;
			base.DestinationStack.Push(initialDestination);
			return count;
		}

		public virtual void EndImportContent(XmlReader reader, int destinationCount)
		{
			while (base.DestinationStack.Count > destinationCount)
			{
				base.DestinationStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void ImportContent(XmlReader reader)
		{
			byte b = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					reader.Read();
				}
				catch
				{
					if (ThrowExceptionOnReaderError)
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
				if (reader.ReadState != ReadState.EndOfFile && reader.ReadState != ReadState.Error && !AbortImport)
				{
					if (BaseStream != null && b == 0)
					{
						ImportContentProgressIndication();
					}
					ProcessCurrentDestination(reader);
					b++;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ImportContentProgressIndication()
		{
			base.ProgressIndication.SetProgress(GetProgressPercentage());
		}

		private int GetProgressPercentage()
		{
			return (int)(BaseStream.Position * 100 / BaseStream.Length);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ProcessCurrentDestination(XmlReader reader)
		{
			do
			{
				if (ProcessDestination(reader, base.DestinationStack.Peek()))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			while (reader.ReadState != ReadState.EndOfFile);
			return false;
		}

		public T MoveNextImportContent<T>(XmlReader reader, Func<T> getCurrentItem)
		{
			T val;
			do
			{
				try
				{
					reader.Read();
				}
				catch
				{
					if (ThrowExceptionOnReaderError)
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
				if (reader.ReadState == ReadState.EndOfFile || reader.ReadState == ReadState.Error)
				{
					return default(T);
				}
				if (AbortImport)
				{
					return default(T);
				}
				ProcessCurrentDestination(reader);
				val = getCurrentItem();
			}
			while (object.Equals(val, default(T)));
			return val;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ProcessDestination(XmlReader reader, Destination currentDestination)
		{
			if (reader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.EndElement)
			{
				Destination val = PopDestination();
				if (!val.ForbidProcessElementOpenClose)
				{
					val.ProcessElementClose(reader);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (currentDestination.ShouldProcessWhitespaces(reader))
			{
				return PeekDestination().ProcessText(reader);
			}
			if (reader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Text || reader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.SignificantWhitespace || reader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.CDATA)
			{
				return PeekDestination().ProcessText(reader);
			}
			Destination val2 = currentDestination.ProcessCurrentElementInternal(reader);
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				LogUnsupportedContent(reader);
				reader.Skip();
				return false;
			}
			if (reader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element)
			{
				if (reader.IsEmptyElement)
				{
					val2.ProcessElementOpen(reader);
					val2.ProcessElementClose(reader);
				}
				else
				{
					PushDestination(val2);
					if (!val2.ForbidProcessElementOpenClose)
					{
						val2.ProcessElementOpen(reader);
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void LogUnsupportedContent(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (logUnsupportedContentService != null)
			{
				logUnsupportedContentService.Log(CurrentContentFileName, reader.LocalName, reader.NamespaceURI, reader.Prefix);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ImportMainDocument(XmlReader reader, Stream baseStream, string contentFileName)
		{
			this.baseStream = baseStream;
			BeginProgressIndication();
			try
			{
				BeginSetMainDocumentContent();
				try
				{
					ImportMainDocument(reader, contentFileName);
				}
				catch
				{
					if (CreateEmptyDocumentOnLoadError)
					{
						SetMainDocumentEmptyContent();
					}
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					EndSetMainDocumentContent();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				this.baseStream = null;
				EndProgressIndication();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void BeginProgressIndication()
		{
			if (baseStream != null)
			{
				base.ProgressIndication.Begin(OfficeLocalizer.GetString(OfficeStringId.Msg_Loading), 0, 100, GetProgressPercentage());
			}
			else
			{
				base.ProgressIndication.Begin(OfficeLocalizer.GetString(OfficeStringId.Msg_Loading), 0, 1, 0);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void EndProgressIndication()
		{
			base.ProgressIndication.End();
		}

		protected internal virtual void BeforeImportMainDocument()
		{
		}

		public abstract void BeginSetMainDocumentContent();

		public abstract void EndSetMainDocumentContent();

		public abstract void SetMainDocumentEmptyContent();

		protected internal virtual void ImportMainDocument(XmlReader reader, string contentFileName)
		{
			BeforeImportMainDocument();
			base.DestinationStack = new Stack<Destination>();
			ImportContent(reader, CreateMainDocumentDestination(), contentFileName);
			AfterImportMainDocument();
		}

		public virtual void BeginImportMainDocument()
		{
			BeforeImportMainDocument();
			base.DestinationStack = new Stack<Destination>();
		}

		public virtual void EndImportMainDocument()
		{
			AfterImportMainDocument();
		}

		protected internal virtual void AfterImportMainDocument()
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract Destination CreateMainDocumentDestination();

		public virtual OfficeImage LookupImageByRelationId(IDocumentModel documentModel, string relationId, string rootFolder)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal OpenXmlRelation LookupExternalRelationById(string relationId)
		{
			OpenXmlRelation val = DocumentRelations.LookupRelationById(relationId);
			if (StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(val.TargetMode, "external") != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected internal virtual OfficeImage LookupExternalImageByRelation(OpenXmlRelation relation, string rootFolder)
		{
			if (uniqueUriBasedImages.TryGetValue(relation.UnescapeTarget(), out var value))
			{
				return new UriBasedOfficeReferenceImage(value, 0, 0);
			}
			return CreateUriBasedImageCore(relation.UnescapeTarget(), 0, 0);
		}

		public virtual UriBasedOfficeImageBase LookupExternalImageByRelationId(string relationId, string rootFolder)
		{
			OpenXmlRelation val = DocumentRelations.LookupRelationById(relationId);
			if (StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(val.TargetMode, "external") != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (uniqueUriBasedImages.TryGetValue(val.UnescapeTarget(), out var value))
			{
				return new UriBasedOfficeReferenceImage(value, 0, 0);
			}
			return CreateUriBasedImageCore(val.UnescapeTarget(), 0, 0);
		}

		private UriBasedOfficeImage CreateUriBasedImageCore(string uri, int pixelTargetWidth, int pixelTargetHeight)
		{
			UriBasedOfficeImage uriBasedOfficeImage = new UriBasedOfficeImage(uri, pixelTargetWidth, pixelTargetHeight, base.DocumentModel, asyncImageLoading: false);
			uniqueUriBasedImages.Add(uri, uriBasedOfficeImage);
			return uriBasedOfficeImage;
		}

		{

			return GetIntegerValue(attribute, NumberStyles.Integer, defaultValue);
		}

		public int GetIntegerValue(string value, NumberStyles numberStyles, int defaultValue)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			if (int.TryParse(value, numberStyles, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (long.TryParse(value, numberStyles, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result2))
			{
				return (int)result2;
			}
			if (int.TryParse(value, numberStyles | NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(value, numberStyles | NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result3))
			{
				return (int)result3;
			}
			if (AllowUniversalMeasureValues)
			{
				ValueInfo valueInfo = StringValueParser.TryParse(value);
				if (valueInfo == null)
				{
					return defaultValue;
				}
				return (int)Math.Round(unitsConverter.ValueUnitToModelUnitsF(valueInfo, AllowUniversalMeasureValues));
			}
			if (AllowIntPercentage && value.EndsWith("%"))
			{
				value = value.Remove(value.Length - 1);
				if (int.TryParse(value, numberStyles, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result))
				{
					return result * 1000;
				}
			}
			if (IgnoreParseErrors)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			ThrowInvalidFile();
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public int? GetIntegerNullableValue(XmlReader reader, string attr)

			return GetIntegerValue(value, NumberStyles.Integer, int.MinValue);
		}

		{
			foreach (T key in table.Keys)
			{
				string text = table[key];
				if (value == text)
				{
					return key;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
