			return value2;
		}

		public abstract string ReadAttribute(XmlReader reader, string attributeName);

		public abstract string ReadAttribute(XmlReader reader, string attributeName, string ns);

		public virtual string DecodeXmlChars(string val)
		{
			return XmlCharsDecoder.Decode(val);
		}

		protected virtual void ImportThemeCore(XmlReader reader, string contentFileName)
		{
			PrepareOfficeTheme();
			Destination val = (Destination)(object)new OfficeThemeDestination(this);
			val.ProcessElementOpen(reader);
			ImportContent(reader, val, contentFileName);
			ActualDocumentModel = base.DocumentModel;
		}

		protected abstract void PrepareOfficeTheme();

		protected internal virtual Stream GetPackageFileStream(PackageFileCollection packageFiles, string fileName)
		{
			PackageFile packageFile = GetPackageFile(packageFiles, fileName);
			if (packageFile == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return packageFile.Stream;
		}

		protected internal virtual PackageFile GetPackageFile(PackageFileCollection packageFiles, string fileName)
		{
			if (packageFiles == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			fileName = fileName.Replace('\\', '/');
			if (fileName.StartsWith("/"))
			{
				fileName = fileName.Substring(1);
			}
			int count = ((List<PackageFile>)(object)packageFiles).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				PackageFile val = ((List<PackageFile>)(object)packageFiles)[i];
				if (string.Compare(val.FileName, fileName, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal void ImportVbaProject(PackageFileCollection packageFiles, OpenXmlRelationCollection relations, string rootFolder, Action<string, byte[]> action = null)
		{
			foreach (OpenXmlRelation item in (List<OpenXmlRelation>)(object)relations)
			{
				if (item.Type == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/relationships/vbaProject")
				{
					string text = OpenXmlImportRelationHelper.CalculateRelationTarget(item, rootFolder, string.Empty);
					PackageFile packageFile = GetPackageFile(packageFiles, text);
					if (packageFile != null)
					{
						ImportVbaProject(packageFile.SeekableStream);
						action?.Invoke(text, packageFile.SeekableStream.ToArray());
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ImportVbaProject(Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PackageFileReader val = new PackageFileReader(stream);
			try
			{
				VbaProjectImportHelper.ImportVbaProject(base.DocumentModel, val, string.Empty);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class UnitsConverter
	{
		private readonly DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter;

		public UnitsConverter(DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
		}

		public float ValueUnitToModelUnitsF(ValueInfo info, bool strictOpenXml = false)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.Unit))
			{
				return info.Value;
			}
			string text = info.Unit.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			switch (text)
			{
			case "km":
				return unitConverter.CentimetersToModelUnitsF(info.Value * 100000f);
			case "m":
				return unitConverter.CentimetersToModelUnitsF(info.Value * 100f);
			case "ft":
				return unitConverter.InchesToModelUnitsF(info.Value * 12f);
			case "mi":
				return info.Value / 100f;
			case "%":
				if (!strictOpenXml)
				{
					return info.Value / 100f;
				}
				return info.Value * 50f;
			default:
				return ValueUnitToModelUnitsFCore(text, info.Value, info.Value);
			}
		}

		public float ValueUnitToModelUnitsF(ValueInfo info, float defaultValue)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.Unit))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			string text = info.Unit.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			if (text == "pi")
			{
				return unitConverter.PicasToModelUnitsF(info.Value);
			}
			return ValueUnitToModelUnitsFCore(text, info.Value, defaultValue);
		}

		private float ValueUnitToModelUnitsFCore(string unit, float value, float defaultValue)
		{
			return unit switch
			{
				"cm" => unitConverter.CentimetersToModelUnitsF(value), 
				"mm" => unitConverter.MillimetersToModelUnitsF(value), 
				"in" => unitConverter.InchesToModelUnitsF(value), 
				"pt" => unitConverter.PointsToModelUnitsF(value), 
				"pc" => unitConverter.PicasToModelUnitsF(value), 
				"inch" => unitConverter.InchesToModelUnitsF(value), 
				_ => defaultValue, 
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class DestinationBasedImporter : DocumentModelImporter, IDestinationImporter
	{
		private Stack<Destination> destinationStack;

		protected virtual bool IgnoreParseErrors => false;

		public Stack<Destination> DestinationStack
		{
			get
			{
				return destinationStack;
			}
			set
			{
				destinationStack = value;
			}
		}

		protected DestinationBasedImporter(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
			destinationStack = new Stack<Destination>();
		}

		public void PushDestination(Destination destination)
		{
			DestinationStack.Push(destination);
		}

		public Destination PopDestination()
		{
			return DestinationStack.Pop();
		}

		public Destination PeekDestination()
		{
			Destination val = DestinationStack.Peek();
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.Peek();
			}
			return val;
		}

		public abstract void LogUnsupportedContent(XmlReader reader);
	}

	public static class DocumentModelDpi
	{
		public static readonly float DpiX = GetDpi();

		public static readonly float DpiY = GetDpi();

		public static readonly float Dpi = GetDpi();

		private static bool useFallbackValue;

		private static float GetDpi()
		{
			try
			{
				return useFallbackValue ? 96f : GraphicsDpi.Pixel;
			}
			catch
			{
				useFallbackValue = true;
				return 96f;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class UndoableIndexBasedObject<T, TActions> : IIndexBasedObject<TActions>, IBatchUpdateable, IBatchUpdateHandler, IBatchInit, IBatchInitHandler, ISupportsSizeOf where T : ICloneable<T>, ISupportsCopyFrom<T>, ISupportsSizeOf where TActions : struct
	{
		protected internal delegate TActions SetPropertyValueDelegate<U>(T info, U newValue);

		private readonly IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart;

		private int index;

		private BatchUpdateHelper<T> batchUpdateHelper;

		public T Info
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsUpdateLocked)
				{
					return InfoCore;
				}
				return batchUpdateHelper.DeferredNotifications;
			}
		}

		protected T DeferredInfo => batchUpdateHelper.DeferredNotifications;

		public IDocumentModelPart DocumentModelPart => documentModelPart;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModelPart.DocumentModel;

		public T InfoCore => GetCache(DocumentModel)[Index];

		public int Index => index;

		protected internal bool IsDirectNotificationsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsUpdateLocked)
				{
					return batchUpdateHelper.IsDirectNotificationsEnabled;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsIndexRecalculationOnEndInitEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsUpdateLocked)
				{
					return batchUpdateHelper.IsIndexRecalculationOnEndInitEnabled;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		BatchUpdateHelper IBatchUpdateable.BatchUpdateHelper => (BatchUpdateHelper)(object)batchUpdateHelper;

		public bool IsUpdateLocked
		{
			get
			{
				if (batchUpdateHelper != null)
				{
					return ((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).IsUpdateLocked;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected UndoableIndexBasedObject(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModelPart, "documentModelPart");
			this.documentModelPart = documentModelPart;
		}

		protected internal abstract UniqueItemsCache<T> GetCache(IDocumentModel documentModel);

		public void SuppressDirectNotifications()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.SuppressDirectNotifications();
		}

		protected internal void ResumeDirectNotifications()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.ResumeDirectNotifications();
		}

		public void SuppressIndexRecalculationOnEndInit()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.SuppressIndexRecalculationOnEndInit();
		}

		protected internal void ResumeIndexRecalculationOnEndInit()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.ResumeIndexRecalculationOnEndInit();
		}

		public void SetIndexInitial(int value)
		{
			index = value;
		}

		int IIndexBasedObject<TActions>.GetIndex()
		{
			return index;
		}

		void IIndexBasedObject<TActions>.SetIndex(int value, TActions changeActions)
		{
			if (index != value)
			{
				OnIndexChanging();
				index = value;
				ApplyChanges(changeActions);
				OnIndexChanged();
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract void ApplyChanges(TActions changeActions);

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				batchUpdateHelper = new BatchUpdateHelper<T>((IBatchUpdateHandler)(object)this);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).BeginUpdate();
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).EndUpdate();
		}

		public void CancelUpdate()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndUpdate);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).CancelUpdate();
		}

		public void BeginInit()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				batchUpdateHelper = new BatchInitHelper<T>(this);
			}
			if (!(batchUpdateHelper is BatchInitHelper<T>))
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidBeginInit);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).BeginUpdate();
		}

		public void EndInit()
		{
			if (!(batchUpdateHelper is BatchInitHelper<T>))
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndInit);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).EndUpdate();
		}

		public void CancelInit()
		{
			if (!(batchUpdateHelper is BatchInitHelper<T>))
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndInit);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).CancelUpdate();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnFirstBeginUpdate()
		{
			OnFirstBeginUpdateCore();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnBeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnEndUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnLastEndUpdate()
		{
			OnLastEndUpdateCore();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnCancelUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnLastCancelUpdate()
		{
			OnLastCancelUpdateCore();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnFirstBeginUpdateCore()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.DeferredNotifications = ((ICloneable<T>)InfoCore/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnLastCancelUpdateCore()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndUpdate);
			}
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnLastEndUpdateCore()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndUpdate);
			}
			if (!ReplaceInfo(batchUpdateHelper.DeferredNotifications, GetBatchUpdateChangeActions()) && batchUpdateHelper.FakeAssignDetected)
			{
				NotifyFakeAssign();
			}
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnFirstBeginInit()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.DeferredNotifications = ((ICloneable<T>)InfoCore/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnBeginInit()
		{
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnEndInit()
		{
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnCancelInit()
		{
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnLastEndInit()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper.IsIndexRecalculationOnEndInitEnabled)
			{
				index = GetInfoIndex(batchUpdateHelper.DeferredNotifications);
			}
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnLastCancelInit()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper.IsIndexRecalculationOnEndInitEnabled)
			{
				index = GetInfoIndex(batchUpdateHelper.DeferredNotifications);
			}
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetPropertyValue<U>(SetPropertyValueDelegate<U> setter, U newValue)
		{
			T infoForModification = GetInfoForModification();
			TActions changeActions = setter(infoForModification, newValue);
			ReplaceInfo(infoForModification, changeActions);
		}

		public T GetInfoForModification()
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return batchUpdateHelper.DeferredNotifications;
			}
			return ((ICloneable<T>)Info/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
		}

		public bool ReplaceInfo(T newValue, TActions changeActions)
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int infoIndex = GetInfoIndex(newValue);
			return ChangeIndex(infoIndex, changeActions);
		}

		private bool ChangeIndex(int newIndex, TActions changeActions)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = DocumentModel;
			if (newIndex != Index)
			{
				ChangeIndexCore(newIndex, changeActions);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void ChangeIndexCore(int newIndex, TActions changeActions)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = DocumentModel;
			documentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				OnBeginAssign();
				try
				{
					IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<TActions> indexChangedHistoryItemCore = CreateIndexChangedHistoryItem();
					indexChangedHistoryItemCore.OldIndex = index;
					indexChangedHistoryItemCore.NewIndex = newIndex;
					indexChangedHistoryItemCore.ChangeActions = changeActions;
					documentModel.History.Add(indexChangedHistoryItemCore);
					indexChangedHistoryItemCore.Execute();
				}
				finally
				{
					OnEndAssign();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				documentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected virtual IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<TActions> CreateIndexChangedHistoryItem()
		{
			return new IndexChangedHistoryItem<TActions>(DocumentModelPart, this);
		}

		public void CopyFromCore(UndoableIndexBasedObject<T, TActions> obj)
		{
			if (Index != obj.Index)
			{
				((IIndexBasedObject<TActions>)this).SetIndex(obj.Index, GetBatchUpdateChangeActions());
			}
		}

		public int GetInfoIndex(T value)
		{
			return GetCache(DocumentModel).GetItemIndex(value);
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(UndoableIndexBasedObject<T, TActions> obj)
		{
			if (obj.DocumentModel != DocumentModel)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidCopyFromDocumentModel);
			}
			if (IsUpdateLocked || obj.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				CopyFrom(obj.Info);
			}
			else if (Index != obj.Index)
			{
				ChangeIndex(obj.Index, GetBatchUpdateChangeActions());
			}
			else
			{
				NotifyFakeAssign();
			}
		}

		public void CopyFrom(T newInfo)
		{
			T infoForModification = GetInfoForModification();
			((ISupportsCopyFrom<T>)infoForModification/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).CopyFrom(newInfo);
			if (!ReplaceInfo(infoForModification, GetBatchUpdateChangeActions()))
			{
				NotifyFakeAssign();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void NotifyFakeAssign()
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				batchUpdateHelper.FakeAssignDetected = true;
				return;
			}
			DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				OnBeginAssign();
				try
				{
				}
				finally
				{
					OnEndAssign();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnBeginAssign()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnEndAssign()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnIndexChanging()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnIndexChanged()
		{
		}

		public abstract TActions GetBatchUpdateChangeActions();

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return ObjectSizeHelper.CalculateApproxObjectSize32(this, ignoreStringSize: true);
		}
	}
	public abstract class IndexBasedObject<TInfo, TOptions> : IBatchUpdateable, IBatchUpdateHandler, ISupportsSizeOf where TInfo : ICloneable<TInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<TInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf where TOptions : ICloneable<TOptions>, ISupportsCopyFrom<TOptions>, ISupportsSizeOf
	{
		protected internal delegate void SetPropertyValueDelegate<U>(TInfo info, U newValue);

		protected internal delegate void SetOptionsValueDelegate(TOptions options, bool newValue);

		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private BatchUpdateHelper<TInfo, TOptions> batchUpdateHelper;

		private int infoIndex;

		private int optionsIndex;

		public TInfo Info
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsUpdateLocked)
				{
					return InfoCore;
				}
				return batchUpdateHelper.DeferredInfoNotifications;
			}
		}

		public TOptions Options
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsUpdateLocked)
				{
					return OptionsCore;
				}
				return batchUpdateHelper.DeferredOptionsNotifications;
			}
		}

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		protected internal TInfo InfoCore => InfoCache[InfoIndex];

		protected internal TOptions OptionsCore => OptionsCache[OptionsIndex];

		protected internal abstract UniqueItemsCache<TInfo> InfoCache { get; }

		protected internal abstract UniqueItemsCache<TOptions> OptionsCache { get; }

		public int InfoIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return infoIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				infoIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public int OptionsIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return optionsIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				optionsIndex = value;
			}
		}

		BatchUpdateHelper IBatchUpdateable.BatchUpdateHelper => (BatchUpdateHelper)(object)batchUpdateHelper;

		public bool IsUpdateLocked
		{
			get
			{
				if (batchUpdateHelper != null)
				{
					return ((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).IsUpdateLocked;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected IndexBasedObject(IDocumentModel documentModel, int formattingInfoIndex, int formattingOptionsIndex)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			if (!InfoCache.IsIndexValid(formattingInfoIndex))
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("formattingInfoIndex", formattingInfoIndex);
			}
			if (!OptionsCache.IsIndexValid(formattingOptionsIndex))
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("formattingOptionsIndex", formattingOptionsIndex);
			}
			infoIndex = formattingInfoIndex;
			optionsIndex = formattingOptionsIndex;
		}

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				batchUpdateHelper = new BatchUpdateHelper<TInfo, TOptions>((IBatchUpdateHandler)(object)this);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).BeginUpdate();
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).EndUpdate();
		}

		public void CancelUpdate()
		{
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).CancelUpdate();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnFirstBeginUpdate()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.DeferredInfoNotifications = ((ICloneable<TInfo>)InfoCore/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
			batchUpdateHelper.DeferredOptionsNotifications = ((ICloneable<?>)OptionsCore/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnBeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnEndUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnLastEndUpdate()
		{
			ReplaceInfo(batchUpdateHelper.DeferredInfoNotifications, batchUpdateHelper.DeferredOptionsNotifications);
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnCancelUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnLastCancelUpdate()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetPropertyValue<U>(SetPropertyValueDelegate<U> setter, U newValue, SetOptionsValueDelegate optionsSetter)
		{
			TInfo infoForModification = GetInfoForModification();
			TOptions optionsForModification = GetOptionsForModification();
			setter(infoForModification, newValue);
			optionsSetter(optionsForModification, newValue: true);
			ReplaceInfo(infoForModification, optionsForModification);
		}

		public void SetIndexInitial(int infoIndex, int optionsIndex)
		{
			this.infoIndex = infoIndex;
			this.optionsIndex = optionsIndex;
		}

		public TInfo GetInfoForModification()
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return batchUpdateHelper.DeferredInfoNotifications;
			}
			return ((ICloneable<TInfo>)Info/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
		}

		public TOptions GetOptionsForModification()
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return batchUpdateHelper.DeferredOptionsNotifications;
			}
			return ((ICloneable<?>)Options/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
		}

		public void ReplaceInfo(TInfo newInfo, TOptions newOptions)
		{
			if (!IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				ReplaceInfoCore(GetInfoIndex(newInfo), GetOptionsIndex(newOptions));
			}
		}

		protected void ReplaceInfoCore(int newInfoIndex, int newOptionsIndex)
		{
			optionsIndex = newOptionsIndex;
			infoIndex = newInfoIndex;
		}

		protected internal int GetInfoIndex(TInfo value)
		{
			return InfoCache.GetItemIndex(value);
		}

		protected internal int GetOptionsIndex(TOptions value)
		{
			return OptionsCache.GetItemIndex(value);
		}

		protected internal void OnChanging()
		{
		}

		protected internal void OnChanged()
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is IndexBasedObject<TInfo, TOptions> indexBasedObject))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (indexBasedObject.DocumentModel == DocumentModel)
			{
				if (InfoIndex == indexBasedObject.InfoIndex)
				{
					return OptionsIndex == indexBasedObject.OptionsIndex;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return PropertyEquals(indexBasedObject);
		}

		protected abstract bool PropertyEquals(IndexBasedObject<TInfo, TOptions> other);

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.Calculate(InfoIndex, OptionsIndex);
		}

		public void CopyFrom(IndexBasedObject<TInfo, TOptions> obj)
		{
			CopyFromCore(obj.Info, obj.Options);
		}

		public void CopyFromCore(TInfo newInfo, TOptions newOptions)
		{
			TInfo infoForModification = GetInfoForModification();
			TOptions optionsForModification = GetOptionsForModification();
			((ISupportsCopyFrom<TInfo>)infoForModification/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).CopyFrom(newInfo);
			((ISupportsCopyFrom<?>)optionsForModification/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).CopyFrom(newOptions);
			ReplaceInfo(infoForModification, optionsForModification);
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return ObjectSizeHelper.CalculateApproxObjectSize32(this, ignoreStringSize: true);
		}
	}
	public abstract class MultiIndexObject<TOwner, TActions> : IBatchUpdateable, IBatchInit, IBatchUpdateHandler, IBatchInitHandler, ISupportsSizeOf where TOwner : MultiIndexObject<TOwner, TActions> where TActions : struct
	{
		protected internal delegate TActions SetPropertyValueDelegate<TInfo, U>(TInfo info, U newValue);

		protected internal delegate TActions SetPropertyValueDelegateForStruct<TInfo, U>(ref TInfo info, U newValue);

		private MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper batchUpdateHelper;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => GetDocumentModel();

		BatchUpdateHelper IBatchUpdateable.BatchUpdateHelper => (BatchUpdateHelper)(object)batchUpdateHelper;

		protected MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper BatchUpdateHelper => batchUpdateHelper;

		public bool IsUpdateLocked
		{
			get
			{
				if (batchUpdateHelper != null)
				{
					return ((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).IsUpdateLocked;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions>[] IndexAccessors { get; }

		public int IndexAccessorsCount => IndexAccessors.Length;

		protected abstract IDocumentModel GetDocumentModel();

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				batchUpdateHelper = CreateBatchUpdateHelper();
			}
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidBeginUpdate);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).BeginUpdate();
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndUpdate);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).EndUpdate();
		}

		public void CancelUpdate()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndUpdate);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).CancelUpdate();
		}

		public void BeginInit()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				batchUpdateHelper = CreateBatchInitHelper();
			}
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidBeginInit);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).BeginUpdate();
		}

		public void EndInit()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndInit);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).EndUpdate();
		}

		public void CancelInit()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidEndInit);
			}
			((BatchUpdateHelper)batchUpdateHelper).CancelUpdate();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnFirstBeginUpdate()
		{
			OnFirstBeginUpdateCore();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnBeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnEndUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnLastEndUpdate()
		{
			OnLastEndUpdateCore();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnCancelUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnLastCancelUpdate()
		{
			OnLastCancelUpdateCore();
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnFirstBeginInit()
		{
			int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				IndexAccessors[i].InitializeDeferredInfo(GetOwner());
			}
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnBeginInit()
		{
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnEndInit()
		{
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnCancelInit()
		{
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnLastEndInit()
		{
			OnLastEndInitCore();
		}

		void IBatchInitHandler.OnLastCancelInit()
		{
			OnLastEndInitCore();
		}

		private void OnLastEndInitCore()
		{
			if (batchUpdateHelper.IsIndexRecalculationOnEndInitEnabled)
			{
				int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					IndexAccessors[i].SetIndex(GetOwner(), IndexAccessors[i].GetDeferredInfoIndex(GetOwner()));
				}
			}
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnFirstBeginUpdateCore()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.Transaction = new HistoryTransaction(DocumentModel.History);
			int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				IndexAccessors[i].InitializeDeferredInfo(GetOwner());
			}
			BatchUpdateHelper.BeginUpdateDeferredChanges();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnLastCancelUpdateCore()
		{
			BatchUpdateHelper.CancelUpdateDeferredChanges();
			batchUpdateHelper.Transaction.Dispose();
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnLastEndUpdateCore()
		{
			BatchUpdateHelper.EndUpdateDeferredChanges();
			bool flag = true;
			int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				flag = !IndexAccessors[i].ApplyDeferredChanges(GetOwner()) && flag;
			}
			if (flag && batchUpdateHelper.FakeAssignDetected)
			{
				NotifyFakeAssign();
			}
			batchUpdateHelper.Transaction.Dispose();
			batchUpdateHelper = null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void NotifyFakeAssign()
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				batchUpdateHelper.FakeAssignDetected = true;
				return;
			}
			DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				OnBeginAssign();
				try
				{
				}
				finally
				{
					OnEndAssign();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnBeginAssign()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnEndAssign()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetPropertyValue<TInfo, U>(IIndexAccessor<TOwner, TInfo, TActions> indexHolder, SetPropertyValueDelegate<TInfo, U> setter, U newValue) where TInfo : ICloneable<TInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf
		{
			DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SetPropertyValueCore(indexHolder, setter, newValue);
			}
			finally
			{
				DocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetPropertyValueCore<TInfo, U>(IIndexAccessor<TOwner, TInfo, TActions> indexHolder, SetPropertyValueDelegate<TInfo, U> setter, U newValue) where TInfo : ICloneable<TInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf
		{
			TInfo infoForModification = GetInfoForModification(indexHolder);
			TActions changeActions = setter(infoForModification, newValue);
			ReplaceInfo(indexHolder, infoForModification, changeActions);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetPropertyValueForStruct<TInfo, U>(IIndexAccessor<TOwner, TInfo, TActions> indexHolder, SetPropertyValueDelegateForStruct<TInfo, U> setter, U newValue) where TInfo : ICloneable<TInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf
		{
			TInfo info = GetInfoForModification(indexHolder);
			TActions changeActions = setter(ref info, newValue);
			ReplaceInfoForFlags(indexHolder, info, changeActions);
		}

		public virtual TInfo GetInfoForModification<TInfo>(IIndexAccessor<TOwner, TInfo, TActions> indexHolder) where TInfo : ICloneable<TInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return indexHolder.GetDeferredInfo(BatchUpdateHelper);
			}
			return ((ICloneable<TInfo>)indexHolder.GetInfo(GetOwner())/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
		}

		public virtual bool ReplaceInfo<TInfo>(IIndexAccessor<TOwner, TInfo, TActions> indexHolder, TInfo newValue, TActions changeActions) where TInfo : ICloneable<TInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int infoIndex = indexHolder.GetInfoIndex(GetOwner(), newValue);
			return ChangeIndex(indexHolder, infoIndex, changeActions);
		}

		protected internal virtual int ValidateNewIndexBeforeReplaceInfo(int newValue)
		{
			return newValue;
		}

		public virtual bool ReplaceInfoForFlags<TInfo>(IIndexAccessor<TOwner, TInfo, TActions> indexHolder, TInfo newValue, TActions changeActions) where TInfo : ICloneable<TInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf
		{
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				indexHolder.SetDeferredInfo(BatchUpdateHelper, newValue);
				return false;
			}
			int infoIndex = indexHolder.GetInfoIndex(GetOwner(), newValue);
			return ChangeIndex(indexHolder, infoIndex, changeActions);
		}

		private bool ChangeIndex(IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions> indexHolder, int newIndex, TActions changeActions)
		{
			if (newIndex != indexHolder.GetIndex(GetOwner()))
			{
				ChangeIndexCore(indexHolder, newIndex, changeActions);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void ChangeIndexCore(IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions> indexHolder, int newIndex, TActions changeActions)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = DocumentModel;
			documentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				OnBeginAssign();
				try
				{
					IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<TActions> indexChangedHistoryItemCore = indexHolder.CreateHistoryItem(GetOwner());
					indexChangedHistoryItemCore.OldIndex = indexHolder.GetIndex(GetOwner());
					indexChangedHistoryItemCore.NewIndex = newIndex;
					indexChangedHistoryItemCore.ChangeActions = changeActions;
					documentModel.History.Add(indexChangedHistoryItemCore);
					indexChangedHistoryItemCore.Execute();
				}
				finally
				{
					OnEndAssign();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				documentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void SetIndexCore(IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions> indexHolder, int value, TActions changeActions)
		{
			if (indexHolder.GetIndex(GetOwner()) != value)
			{
				indexHolder.SetIndex(GetOwner(), value);
				ApplyChanges(changeActions);
			}
		}

		public void CloneCore(TOwner clone)
		{
			int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions> indexAccessorBase = IndexAccessors[i];
				indexAccessorBase.SetIndex(clone, indexAccessorBase.GetIndex(GetOwner()));
			}
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return ObjectSizeHelper.CalculateApproxObjectSize32(this, ignoreStringSize: true);
		}

		private void CopyFromSameModel(MultiIndexObject<TOwner, TActions> obj)
		{
			if (DocumentModel != obj.DocumentModel)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException(OfficeStringId.Msg_InvalidCopyFromDocumentModel);
			}
			int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!ChangeIndex(IndexAccessors[i], obj.IndexAccessors[i].GetIndex(obj.GetOwner()), GetBatchUpdateChangeActions()))
				{
					NotifyFakeAssign();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(MultiIndexObject<TOwner, TActions> obj)
		{
			if (DocumentModel == obj.DocumentModel)
			{
				CopyFromSameModel(obj);
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				CopyFromDeferred(obj);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public virtual void CopyFromDeferred(MultiIndexObject<TOwner, TActions> obj)
		{
			int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions> indexAccessorBase = IndexAccessors[i];
				indexAccessorBase.CopyDeferredInfo(GetOwner(), obj.GetOwner());
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is MultiIndexObject<TOwner, TActions> multiIndexObject))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions> indexAccessorBase = IndexAccessors[i];
				if (indexAccessorBase.GetIndex(GetOwner()) != indexAccessorBase.GetIndex(multiIndexObject.GetOwner()))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			CombinedHashCode combinedHashCode = default(CombinedHashCode);
			int num = IndexAccessors.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				combinedHashCode.AddInt(IndexAccessors[i].GetIndex(GetOwner()));
			}
			return combinedHashCode.CombinedHash32;
		}

		public abstract TOwner GetOwner();

		protected abstract MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper CreateBatchUpdateHelper();

		protected abstract MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper CreateBatchInitHelper();

		public abstract TActions GetBatchUpdateChangeActions();

		protected internal abstract void ApplyChanges(TActions actions);
	}
	public class MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper : BatchUpdateHelper
	{
		private HistoryTransaction transaction;

		private int suppressIndexRecalculationOnEndInitCount;

		private bool fakeAssignDetected;

		internal HistoryTransaction Transaction
		{
			get
			{
				return transaction;
			}
			set
			{
				transaction = value;
			}
		}

		public bool FakeAssignDetected
		{
			get
			{
				return fakeAssignDetected;
			}
			set
			{
				fakeAssignDetected = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsIndexRecalculationOnEndInitEnabled => suppressIndexRecalculationOnEndInitCount == 0;

		public MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper(IBatchUpdateHandler handler)
			: base(handler)
		{
		}

		public void SuppressIndexRecalculationOnEndInit()
		{
			suppressIndexRecalculationOnEndInitCount++;
		}

		public void ResumeIndexRecalculationOnEndInit()
		{
			suppressIndexRecalculationOnEndInitCount--;
		}

		public virtual void BeginUpdateDeferredChanges()
		{
		}

		public virtual void CancelUpdateDeferredChanges()
		{
		}

		public virtual void EndUpdateDeferredChanges()
		{
		}
	}
	public interface IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions> where TOwner : MultiIndexObject<TOwner, TActions> where TActions : struct

		void SetIndex(TOwner owner, int value);

		bool IsIndexValid(TOwner owner, int index);

		int GetDeferredInfoIndex(TOwner owner);

		void InitializeDeferredInfo(TOwner owner);

		void CopyDeferredInfo(TOwner owner, TOwner from);

		IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<TActions> CreateHistoryItem(TOwner owner);
	}
	public interface IIndexAccessor<TOwner, TInfo, TActions> : IIndexAccessorBase<TOwner, TActions> where TOwner : MultiIndexObject<TOwner, TActions> where TInfo : ICloneable<TInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf where TActions : struct
	{
		int GetInfoIndex(TOwner owner, TInfo value);

		TInfo GetInfo(TOwner owner);

	public interface IReadOnlyCollection<T> : IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
	{
		int Count { get; }
	}
	public interface IReadOnlyList<T> : IReadOnlyCollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
	{
		T this[int index] { get; }
	}
	public abstract class SimpleCollection<T> : ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IReadOnlyList<T>, IReadOnlyCollection<T>
	{
		private List<T> innerList;

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		public int Capacity
		{
			get
			{
				return innerList.Capacity;
			}
			set
			{
				innerList.Capacity = value;
			}
		}

		public T this[int index] => innerList[index];

		public List<T> InnerList => innerList;

		public T First
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count <= 0)
				{
					return default(T);
				}
				return InnerList[0];
			}
		}

		public T Last
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count <= 0)
				{
					return default(T);
				}
				return InnerList[Count - 1];
			}
		}

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		protected SimpleCollection()
		{
			innerList = new List<T>();
		}

		public virtual bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return innerList.Contains(item);
		}

		public void ForEach(Action<T> action)
		{
			innerList.ForEach(action);
		}

		public virtual int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			return innerList.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public virtual void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			T item = this[index];
			innerList.RemoveAt(index);
			OnItemRemoved(index, item);
		}

		public virtual bool Remove(T item)
		{
			int num = innerList.IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public virtual int Add(T item)
		{
			int num = AddWithoutNotification(item);
			OnItemInserted(num, item);
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual int AddWithoutNotification(T item)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)item, "Item");
			InnerList.Add(item);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		void ICollection<T>.Add(T item)
		{
			Add(item);
		}

		public virtual IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return InnerList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				InnerList.Clear();
				OnModified();
			}
		}

		public virtual void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			innerList.Insert(index, item);
			OnItemInserted(index, item);
		}

		protected virtual void OnModified()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemInserted(int index, T item)
		{
			OnModified();
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(int index, T item)
		{
			OnModified();
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			innerList.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public virtual void Sort(int index, int count, IComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			innerList.Sort(index, count, comparer);
		}
	}
	public class UndoableCollection<T> : SimpleCollection<T>
	{
		private readonly IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart;

		private readonly bool supportsHistoryObjects;

		private UndoableCollectionAddEventHandler onAdd;

		private UndoableCollectionRemoveAtEventHandler onRemoveAt;

		private UndoableCollectionInsertEventHandler onInsert;

		private UndoableCollectionClearEventHandler onClear;

		private UndoableCollectionAddRangeEventHandler onAddRange;

		private UndoableCollectionMoveEventHandler onMove;

		private EventHandler onModified;

		public new T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				SetItem(index, value);
			}
		}

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModelPart.DocumentModel;

		public IDocumentModelPart DocumentModelPart => documentModelPart;

		protected internal virtual bool SupportsHistoryObjects => supportsHistoryObjects;

		public event UndoableCollectionAddEventHandler OnAdd
		{
			add
			{
				onAdd = (UndoableCollectionAddEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onAdd, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onAdd = (UndoableCollectionAddEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onAdd, value);
			}
		}

		public event UndoableCollectionRemoveAtEventHandler OnRemoveAt
		{
			add
			{
				onRemoveAt = (UndoableCollectionRemoveAtEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onRemoveAt, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onRemoveAt = (UndoableCollectionRemoveAtEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onRemoveAt, value);
			}
		}

		public event UndoableCollectionInsertEventHandler OnInsert
		{
			add
			{
				onInsert = (UndoableCollectionInsertEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onInsert, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onInsert = (UndoableCollectionInsertEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onInsert, value);
			}
		}

		public event UndoableCollectionClearEventHandler OnClear
		{
			add
			{
				onClear = (UndoableCollectionClearEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onClear, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onClear = (UndoableCollectionClearEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onClear, value);
			}
		}

		public event UndoableCollectionAddRangeEventHandler OnAddRange
		{
			add
			{
				onAddRange = (UndoableCollectionAddRangeEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onAddRange, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onAddRange = (UndoableCollectionAddRangeEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onAddRange, value);
			}
		}

		public event UndoableCollectionMoveEventHandler OnMove
		{
			add
			{
				onMove = (UndoableCollectionMoveEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onMove, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onMove = (UndoableCollectionMoveEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onMove, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler Modified
		{
			add
			{
				onModified = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onModified, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onModified = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onModified, value);
			}
		}

		public UndoableCollection(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			this.documentModelPart = documentModelPart;
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			supportsHistoryObjects = typeFromHandle.IsClass || typeFromHandle.IsInterface;
		}

		public override int Add(T item)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)item, "item");
			UndoableCollectionAddHistoryItem<T> undoableCollectionAddHistoryItem = new UndoableCollectionAddHistoryItem<T>(DocumentModel, this, item);
			DocumentModel.History.Add(undoableCollectionAddHistoryItem);
			undoableCollectionAddHistoryItem.Execute();
			return base.InnerList.Count - 1;
		}

		public override void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)item, "item");
			ValueChecker.CheckValue(index, 0, base.Count, "index");
			UndoableCollectionInsertHistoryItem<T> undoableCollectionInsertHistoryItem = new UndoableCollectionInsertHistoryItem<T>(DocumentModel, this, index, item);
			DocumentModel.History.Add(undoableCollectionInsertHistoryItem);
			undoableCollectionInsertHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public override void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index value out of range");
			}
			ValueChecker.CheckValue(index, 0, base.Count - 1, "index");
			UndoableCollectionRemoveAtHistoryItem<T> undoableCollectionRemoveAtHistoryItem = new UndoableCollectionRemoveAtHistoryItem<T>(DocumentModel, this, index);
			DocumentModel.History.Add(undoableCollectionRemoveAtHistoryItem);
			undoableCollectionRemoveAtHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			if (base.Count != 0)
			{
				UndoableCollectionClearHistoryItem<T> undoableCollectionClearHistoryItem = new UndoableCollectionClearHistoryItem<T>(DocumentModel, this);
				DocumentModel.History.Add(undoableCollectionClearHistoryItem);
				undoableCollectionClearHistoryItem.Execute();
			}
		}

		public void Move(int sourceIndex, int targetIndex)
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index value out of range");
			}
			ValueChecker.CheckValue(sourceIndex, 0, base.Count - 1, "sourceIndex");
			ValueChecker.CheckValue(targetIndex, 0, base.Count - 1, "targetIndex");
			if (sourceIndex != targetIndex)
			{
				UndoableCollectionMoveHistoryItem<T> undoableCollectionMoveHistoryItem = new UndoableCollectionMoveHistoryItem<T>(DocumentModel, this, sourceIndex, targetIndex);
				DocumentModel.History.Add(undoableCollectionMoveHistoryItem);
				undoableCollectionMoveHistoryItem.Execute();
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetItem(int index, T value)
		{
			UndoableCollectionSetItemHistoryItem<T> undoableCollectionSetItemHistoryItem = new UndoableCollectionSetItemHistoryItem<T>(DocumentModel, this, index, value);
			DocumentModel.History.Add(undoableCollectionSetItemHistoryItem);
			undoableCollectionSetItemHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public virtual int AddWithoutHistoryAndNotifications(T item)
		{
			return AddWithoutNotification(item);
		}

		public virtual int AddCore(T item)
		{
			RaiseAdd(item);
			return AddInternal(item);
		}

		public virtual int AddInternal(T item)
		{
			return base.Add(item);
		}

		public virtual void AddRangeCore(IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			RaiseAddRange(collection);
			base.InnerList.AddRange(collection);
		}

		protected internal virtual void InsertCore(int index, T item)
		{
			RaiseInsert(index, item);
			InsertInternal(index, item);
		}

		protected internal virtual void InsertInternal(int index, T item)
		{
			base.Insert(index, item);
		}

		public virtual void RemoveAtCore(int index)
		{
			RaiseRemoveAt(index);
			RemoveAtInternal(index);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RemoveAtInternal(int index)
		{
			base.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public virtual void ClearCore()
		{
			RaiseClear();
			base.Clear();
		}

		public virtual void MoveCore(int sourceIndex, int targetIndex)
		{
			RaiseMove(sourceIndex, targetIndex);
			T item = base.InnerList[sourceIndex];
			RemoveAtInternal(sourceIndex);
			InsertInternal(targetIndex, item);
		}

		protected override void OnModified()
		{
			base.OnModified();
			RaiseModified();
		}

		protected internal void SetItemCore(int index, T value)
		{
			base.InnerList[index] = value;
		}

		protected virtual EventArgs CreateAddEventArgs(T item)
		{
			return new UndoableCollectionAddEventArgs<T>(item);
		}

		protected virtual EventArgs CreateInsertEventArgs(int index, T item)
		{
			return new UndoableCollectionInsertEventArgs<T>(index, item);
		}

		protected virtual EventArgs CreateAddRangeEventArgs(IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			return new UndoableCollectionAddRangeEventArgs<T>(collection);
		}

		protected internal void RaiseAdd(T item)
		{
			if (onAdd != null)
			{
				onAdd(this, CreateAddEventArgs(item));
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseRemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (onRemoveAt != null)
			{
				onRemoveAt(this, new UndoableCollectionRemoveAtEventArgs(index));
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseInsert(int index, T item)
		{
			if (onInsert != null)
			{
				onInsert(this, CreateInsertEventArgs(index, item));
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseClear()
		{
			if (onClear != null)
			{
				onClear(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseAddRange(IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			if (onAddRange != null)
			{
				onAddRange(this, CreateAddRangeEventArgs(collection));
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseMove(int sourceIndex, int targetIndex)
		{
			if (onMove != null)
			{
				onMove(this, new UndoableCollectionMoveEventArgs(sourceIndex, targetIndex));
			}
		}

		public virtual void RaiseModified()
		{
			if (onModified != null)
			{
				onModified(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RegisterItem(IHistoryWriter writer, T item)
		{
			writer.RegisterObject(item);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SerializeItem(IHistoryWriter writer, T item)
		{
			if (SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				writer.Write(writer.GetObjectId(item));
			}
		}

		public virtual T DeserializeItem(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			return default(T);
		}
	}
	public abstract class UndoableClonableCollection<T> : UndoableCollection<T>, ICloneable<UndoableClonableCollection<T>>, ISupportsCopyFrom<UndoableClonableCollection<T>>
	{
		protected UndoableClonableCollection(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
			: base(documentModelPart)
		{
		}

		public UndoableClonableCollection<T> Clone()
		{
			UndoableClonableCollection<T> newCollection = GetNewCollection(base.DocumentModelPart);
			newCollection.CopyFrom(this);
			return newCollection;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(UndoableClonableCollection<T> value)
		{
			ClearCore();
			int count = value.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				AddInternal(GetCloneItem(value[i], base.DocumentModelPart));
			}
		}

		public abstract UndoableClonableCollection<T> GetNewCollection(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart);

		public abstract T GetCloneItem(T item, IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart);

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is UndoableClonableCollection<T> undoableClonableCollection))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Count != undoableClonableCollection.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!base[i].Equals(undoableClonableCollection[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = GetType().GetHashCode() ^ base.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				num ^= base[i].GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class UndoableCollectionSetItemHistoryItem<T> : HistoryItem
	{
		private readonly UndoableCollection<T> collection;

		private readonly int index;

		private readonly T newItem;

		private T oldItem;

		public UndoableCollectionSetItemHistoryItem(IDocumentModel documentModel, UndoableCollection<T> collection, int index, T item)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			this.collection = collection;
			newItem = item;
			this.index = index;
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			collection.SetItemCore(index, oldItem);
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			oldItem = collection[index];
			collection.SetItemCore(index, newItem);
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return collection;
		}

		public override void Register(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			base.Register(writer, undone);
			if (collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				collection.RegisterItem(writer, newItem);
				collection.RegisterItem(writer, oldItem);
			}
		}

		public override void WriteObjects(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			if (collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				writer.WriteObject(undone ? newItem : oldItem);
			}
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(index);
			collection.SerializeItem(writer, newItem);
			collection.SerializeItem(writer, oldItem);
		}

		public override void Read(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			base.Read(reader);
			oldItem = collection.DeserializeItem(reader);
		}
	}
	public class UndoableCollectionAddHistoryItem<T> : HistoryItem
	{
		private readonly UndoableCollection<T> collection;

		private T item;

		public UndoableCollectionAddHistoryItem(IDocumentModel documentModel, UndoableCollection<T> collection, T item)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			this.collection = collection;
			this.item = item;
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			int index = collection.Count - 1;
			collection.RemoveAtCore(index);
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			collection.AddCore(item);
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return collection;
		}

		public override void Register(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			base.Register(writer, undone);
			if (collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				collection.RegisterItem(writer, item);
			}
		}

		public override void WriteObjects(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			if (undone && collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				writer.WriteObject(item);
			}
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			collection.SerializeItem(writer, item);
		}
	}
	public class UndoableCollectionInsertHistoryItem<T> : HistoryItem
	{
		private UndoableCollection<T> collection;

		private int index;

		private T item;

		public UndoableCollectionInsertHistoryItem(IDocumentModel documentModel, UndoableCollection<T> collection, int index, T item)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			this.collection = collection;
			this.index = index;
			this.item = item;
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			collection.RemoveAtCore(index);
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			collection.InsertCore(index, item);
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return collection;
		}

		public override void Register(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			base.Register(writer, undone);
			if (collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				collection.RegisterItem(writer, item);
			}
		}

		public override void WriteObjects(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			if (collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				writer.WriteObject(item);
			}
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(index);
			collection.SerializeItem(writer, item);
		}
	}
	public class UndoableCollectionRemoveAtHistoryItem<T> : HistoryItem
	{
		private UndoableCollection<T> collection;

		private int index;

		private T item;

		public T Item => item;

		public UndoableCollectionRemoveAtHistoryItem(IDocumentModel documentModel, UndoableCollection<T> collection, int index)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			this.collection = collection;
			this.index = index;
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			collection.InsertCore(index, item);
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			item = collection[index];
			collection.RemoveAtCore(index);
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return collection;
		}

		public override void Register(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			base.Register(writer, undone);
			if (collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				collection.RegisterItem(writer, item);
			}
		}

		public override void WriteObjects(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			if (!undone && collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				writer.WriteObject(item);
			}
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(index);
			collection.SerializeItem(writer, item);
		}

		public override void Read(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			base.Read(reader);
			item = collection.DeserializeItem(reader);
		}
	}
	public class UndoableCollectionClearHistoryItem<T> : HistoryItem
	{
		private readonly UndoableCollection<T> collection;

		private List<T> itemList;

		public UndoableCollectionClearHistoryItem(IDocumentModel documentModel, UndoableCollection<T> collection)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			this.collection = collection;
			itemList = new List<T>();
			itemList.AddRange(this.collection.InnerList);
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			collection.AddRangeCore(itemList);
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			collection.ClearCore();
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return collection;
		}

		public override void Register(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			base.Register(writer, undone);
			if (!collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (T item in itemList)
			{
				collection.RegisterItem(writer, item);
			}
		}

		public override void WriteObjects(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			if (undone || !collection.SupportsHistoryObjects)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (T item in itemList)
			{
				writer.WriteObject(item);
			}
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(itemList.Count);
			foreach (T item in itemList)
			{
				collection.SerializeItem(writer, item);
			}
		}

		public override void Read(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			base.Read(reader);
			itemList.Clear();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				itemList.Add(collection.DeserializeItem(reader));
			}
		}
	}
	public class UndoableCollectionMoveHistoryItem<T> : HistoryItem
	{
		private readonly UndoableCollection<T> collection;

		private int sourceIndex;

		private int targetIndex;

		public UndoableCollectionMoveHistoryItem(IDocumentModel documentModel, UndoableCollection<T> collection, int sourceIndex, int targetIndex)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			this.collection = collection;
			this.sourceIndex = sourceIndex;
			this.targetIndex = targetIndex;
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			collection.MoveCore(targetIndex, sourceIndex);
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			collection.MoveCore(sourceIndex, targetIndex);
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return collection;
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(sourceIndex);
			writer.Write(targetIndex);
		}
	}

	public abstract class UniqueItemsCache<T> : ISupportsSizeOf where T : ICloneable<T>, ISupportsSizeOf
	{
		private readonly List<T> items;

		private Dictionary<T, int> itemDictionary;

		protected IDocumentModel workbook;

		private DXCollectionUniquenessProviderType uniquenessProviderType = (DXCollectionUniquenessProviderType)1;

		public T this[int index] => items[index];

		public T DefaultItem => items[0];

		public int Count => items.Count;

		protected List<T> Items => items;

		protected Dictionary<T, int> ItemDictionary => itemDictionary;

		protected DXCollectionUniquenessProviderType UniquenessProviderType
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return uniquenessProviderType;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0012: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)value == 0)
				{
					value = (DXCollectionUniquenessProviderType)1;
				}
				if (uniquenessProviderType != value)
				{
					if ((int)value == 2)
					{
						SwitchToDictionaryMethod();
					}
					else
					{
						SwitchToIndexOfMethod();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected UniqueItemsCache(IDocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter, IDocumentModel workbook)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)workbook, "workbook");
			items = new List<T>();
			this.workbook = workbook;
			InitItems(unitConverter);
		}

		protected UniqueItemsCache(IDocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			items = new List<T>();
			InitItems(unitConverter);
		}

		protected UniqueItemsCache(IDocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter, DXCollectionUniquenessProviderType uniquenessProviderType)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			items = new List<T>();
			UniquenessProviderType = uniquenessProviderType;
			InitItems(unitConverter);
		}

		private void SwitchToIndexOfMethod()
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			itemDictionary = null;
			uniquenessProviderType = (DXCollectionUniquenessProviderType)1;
		}

		private void SwitchToDictionaryMethod()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			itemDictionary = CreateDictionary();
			uniquenessProviderType = (DXCollectionUniquenessProviderType)2;
			int count = Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				itemDictionary.Add(items[i], i);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual Dictionary<T, int> CreateDictionary()
		{
			return new Dictionary<T, int>();
		}

		public bool IsIndexValid(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				return index < items.Count;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void InitItems(IDocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			T val = CreateDefaultItem(unitConverter);
			if (val != null)
			{
				AppendItem(val);
			}
		}

		protected abstract T CreateDefaultItem(IDocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter);

		public int GetItemIndex(T item)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				int num = LookupItem(item);
				return (num >= 0) ? num : AddItemCore(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual int AddItemCore(T item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return AppendItem(((ICloneable<T>)item/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone());
		}

		public int AddItem(T item)
		{
			int num = LookupItem(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return AddItemCore(item);
			}
			return num;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int UnsecureAddItem(T item)
		{
			return AddItemCore(item);
		}

		protected int LookupItem(T item)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)uniquenessProviderType == 2)
			{
				if (itemDictionary.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			return items.IndexOf(item);
		}

		protected int AppendItem(T item)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int count = Count;
			items.Add(item);
			if ((int)uniquenessProviderType == 2)
			{
				itemDictionary.Add(item, count);
			}
			return count;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			int num = ObjectSizeHelper.CalculateApproxObjectSize32(this);
			int count = Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num += this[i].SizeOf();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(UniqueItemsCache<T> source)
		{
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			items.Clear();
			if (itemDictionary != null)
			{
				itemDictionary.Clear();
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (T item in source.Items)
			{
				T val = ((ICloneable<T>)item/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).Clone();
				items.Add(val);
				if ((int)uniquenessProviderType == 2)
				{
					itemDictionary.Add(val, num);
				}
				num++;
			}
		}
	}

		}

			: this(screenDpiX, screenDpiY, screenDpiX)

		}

		public static OfficeMouseEventArgs Convert(PortableMouseEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			OfficeMouseEventArgs e2 = e as OfficeMouseEventArgs;
			if (e2 == null)
			{
				e2 = new OfficeMouseEventArgs(e.Button, e.Clicks, e.X, e.Y, e.Delta);
			}
			return e2;
		}

		public OfficeMouseEventArgs(PortableMouseButtons button, int clicks, int x, int y, int delta, bool horizontal)
			: base(button, clicks, x, y, delta)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.horizontal = horizontal;
		}

		public OfficeMouseEventArgs(PortableMouseButtons button, int clicks, int x, int y, int delta)
			: this(button, clicks, x, y, delta, horizontal: false)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

	}

	public enum MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyType
	{
		ServiceBased,
		CrossPlatform,
		WindowsPlatform
	}
	public static class MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyTypeHelper
	{
		public static MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyType CalculateType()
		{
			if (PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.TextRender != null)
			{
				return MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyType.ServiceBased;
			}
			if (CrossPlatformFontCacheManager.ShouldUse())
			{
				return MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyType.CrossPlatform;
			}
			return MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyType.WindowsPlatform;
		}
	}
