	public static class HyperlinkUriHelper
	{
		private const string FileNamePattern = "^file:[\\\\/]*(?<path>(?<root>[A-Za-z]:[\\\\/]+)?[^:\\*\\?<>\\|]+)$";

		private const string UrlPattern = "^((?<prefix>http|https|ftp|news)\\:[\\\\/]*)(?<url>[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\.]+(\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,3})?(\\:\\d{1,5})?([\\\\/]\\S*)?)$";

		private const string RelativePathPattern = "^(?:\\.{1,2}[\\\\/])*[^:\\*\\?<>\\|\\.\\\\/][^:\\*\\?<>\\|]*$";

		private const string LocalPathPattern = "^[A-Za-z]:[\\\\/]+[^:\\*\\?<>\\|]*$";

		private const string RemotePathPattern = "^\\\\{2,}(?<path>[^:\\*\\?<>\\|]+)$";

		private const string MailAddressPattern = "^mailto:(?<email>\\S+)$";

		private const string TooltipQuotesPattern = "\"";

		private const string FromHyperlinkUriPattern = "\\\\\\\\";

		private const string SlashPattern = "[\\\\/]+";

		private static Regex RemotePathRegex = new Regex("^\\\\{2,}(?<path>[^:\\*\\?<>\\|]+)$");

		private static Regex LocalPathRegex = new Regex("^[A-Za-z]:[\\\\/]+[^:\\*\\?<>\\|]*$");

		private static Regex RelativePathRegex = new Regex("^(?:\\.{1,2}[\\\\/])*[^:\\*\\?<>\\|\\.\\\\/][^:\\*\\?<>\\|]*$");

		private static Regex FileNameRegex = new Regex("^file:[\\\\/]*(?<path>(?<root>[A-Za-z]:[\\\\/]+)?[^:\\*\\?<>\\|]+)$");

		private static Regex UrlRegex = new Regex("^((?<prefix>http|https|ftp|news)\\:[\\\\/]*)(?<url>[a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\.]+(\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,3})?(\\:\\d{1,5})?([\\\\/]\\S*)?)$");

		private static Regex MailAddressRegex = new Regex("^mailto:(?<email>\\S+)$");

		private static Regex TooltipQuotesRegex = new Regex("\"");

		private static Regex FromHyperlinkUriRegex = new Regex("\\\\\\\\");

		private static Regex BackslashRegex = new Regex("\\\\");

		public static string EscapeHyperlinkFieldParameterString(string value)
		{
			return BackslashRegex.Replace(value, "\\\\");
		}

		public static string ConvertToHyperlinkUri(string uri)
		{
			return BackslashRegex.Replace(uri, "\\\\");
		}

		public static string PrepareHyperlinkTooltipQuotes(string value)
		{
			return TooltipQuotesRegex.Replace(value, "\\\"");
		}

		public static string ConvertFromHyperlinkUri(string uri)
		{
			return FromHyperlinkUriRegex.Replace(uri, "\\");
		}

		public static string ConvertToUrl(string uri)
		{
			if (IsLocalPath(uri))
			{
				return Regex.Replace($"file:///{uri}", "\\\\+", "/");
			}
			if (IsRemotePath(uri))
			{
				return Regex.Replace($"file://{GetRemotePath(uri)}", "\\\\+", "/");
			}
			return uri;
		}

		private static string GetRemotePath(string uri)
		{
			return RemotePathRegex.Match(uri).Groups["path"].Value;
		}

		public static string EnsureUriIsValid(string uri)
		{
			if (IsFileUri(uri))
			{
				return EnsureFileUriIsValid(uri);
			}
			if (IsUrl(uri))
			{
				return EnsureUrlIsValid(uri);
			}
			if (IsLocalPath(uri))
			{
				return EnsureLocalPathIsValid(uri);
			}
			if (IsRemotePath(uri))
			{
				return EnsureRemotePathIsValid(uri);
			}
			if (IsMailAddress(uri))
			{
				return EnsureMailAddressIsValid(uri);
			}
			if (IsRelativePath(uri))
			{
				return EnsureRelativePathIsValid(uri);
			}
			return uri;
		}

		private static string EnsureFileUriIsValid(string uri)
		{
			Match match = FileNameRegex.Match(uri);
			string[] value = Split(match.Groups["path"].Value, "[\\\\/]+");
			string text = string.Join("\\", value);
			if (match.Groups["root"].Success)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return $"\\\\{text}";
		}

		private static string EnsureUrlIsValid(string uri)
		{
			Match match = UrlRegex.Match(uri);
			string value = match.Groups["url"].Value;
			string text = match.Groups["prefix"].Value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = "http";
			}
			return string.Format("{0}://{1}", text, Regex.Replace(value, "\\\\+", "/"));
		}

		private static string EnsureLocalPathIsValid(string uri)
		{
			string[] array = Split(uri, "[\\\\/]+");
			string text = string.Join("\\", array);
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				return text + "\\";
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static string EnsureRemotePathIsValid(string uri)
		{
			Match match = RemotePathRegex.Match(uri);
			string[] value = Split(match.Groups["path"].Value, "[\\\\/]+");
			return string.Format("\\\\{0}", string.Join("\\", value));
		}

		private static string EnsureMailAddressIsValid(string uri)
		{
			Match match = MailAddressRegex.Match(uri);
			return string.Format("mailto:{0}", match.Groups["email"].Value);
		}

		private static string EnsureRelativePathIsValid(string uri)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(Split(uri, "[\\\\/]+"));
			list.RemoveAll((string item) => item.Equals(".", StringComparison.Ordinal));
			return string.Join("\\", list);
		}

		public static string ConvertRelativePathToAbsolute(string uri, string baseUri)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(Split(baseUri, "[\\\\/]+"));
			list.RemoveAt(list.Count - 1);
			list.AddRange(Split(uri, "[\\\\/]+"));
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (list[i] == ".")
				{
					list.RemoveAt(i);
				}
				else if (list[i] == "..")
				{
					if (i == 0)
					{
						list.RemoveAt(0);
						continue;
					}
					list.RemoveRange(i - 1, 2);
					i--;
				}
				else
				{
					i++;
				}
			}
			return EnsureLocalPathIsValid(string.Join("\\", list));
		}

		internal static bool IsFileUri(string uri)
		{
			return FileNameRegex.IsMatch(uri);
		}

		internal static bool IsUrl(string uri)
		{
			return UrlRegex.IsMatch(uri);
		}

		internal static bool IsMailAddress(string uri)
		{
			return MailAddressRegex.IsMatch(uri);
		}

		public static bool IsLocalPath(string uri)
		{
			return LocalPathRegex.IsMatch(uri);
		}

		internal static bool IsRemotePath(string uri)
		{
			return RemotePathRegex.IsMatch(uri);
		}

		public static bool IsRelativePath(string uri)
		{
			return RelativePathRegex.IsMatch(uri);
		}

		internal static string[] Split(string uri, string pattern)
		{
			return Regex.Split(uri, pattern);
		}
	}
	public struct PropertyKey : IEquatable<PropertyKey>, IConvertToInt<PropertyKey>
	{
		public static PropertyKey Undefined = new PropertyKey(int.MinValue);

		public static PropertyKey Empty = default(PropertyKey);

		private readonly int id;

		private bool isInitialized;

		internal bool IsEmpty => !isInitialized;

		public static PropertyKey Create(Type forType)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(PropertyKey);
			FieldInfo[] fields = forType.GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in fields)
			{
				if (fieldInfo.FieldType == typeFromHandle)
				{
					PropertyKey propertyKey = (PropertyKey)fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
					if (!propertyKey.IsEmpty)
					{
						list.Add(propertyKey.id);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new PropertyKey(0);
			}
			list.Sort((int x, int y) => y - x);
			int num = list[0];
			return new PropertyKey(num + 1);
		}

		public PropertyKey(int id)
		{
			this.id = id;
			isInitialized = true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is PropertyKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((PropertyKey)obj);
		}

		public bool Equals(PropertyKey other)
		{
			if (id == other.id)
			{
				return isInitialized == other.isInitialized;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return id;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(PropertyKey key1, PropertyKey key2)
		{
			return key1.Equals(key2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(PropertyKey key1, PropertyKey key2)
		{
			return !key1.Equals(key2);
		}

		public static PropertyKey operator |(PropertyKey key1, PropertyKey key2)
		{
			return new PropertyKey(key1.id | key2.id);
		}

		public static PropertyKey operator &(PropertyKey key1, PropertyKey key2)
		{
			return new PropertyKey(key1.id & key2.id);
		}

		public static PropertyKey operator ^(PropertyKey key1, PropertyKey key2)
		{
			return new PropertyKey(key1.id ^ key2.id);
		}

		public static PropertyKey operator ~(PropertyKey key)
		{
			return new PropertyKey(~key.id);
		}

		public static implicit operator PropertyKey(int id)
		{
			return new PropertyKey(id);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (this == Undefined)
			{
				return "Undefined";
			}
			if (this == Empty)
			{
				return "Empty";
			}
			return id.ToString();
		}

		int IConvertToInt<PropertyKey>.ToInt()
		{
			return id;
		}

		PropertyKey IConvertToInt<PropertyKey>.FromInt(int value)
		{
			return new PropertyKey(value);
		}
	}
	public class OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public PropertyKey PropertyKey { get; private set; }

		public bool Handled { get; set; }

		public OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs(PropertyKey propertyKey)
		{
			PropertyKey = propertyKey;
		}
	}
	public interface IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged;
	}
	public class PropertyChangedNotifier
	{
		private readonly object owner;

		public EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> Handler;

		public PropertyChangedNotifier(object owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyKey parentPropertyKey, object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			bool flag = OnPropertyChanged(parentPropertyKey);
			if (!flag)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged(sender, args);
			}
			args.Handled = flag;
		}

		public bool OnPropertyChanged(PropertyKey propertyKey)
		{
			return OnPropertyChanged(owner, new OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyKey));
		}

		private bool OnPropertyChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			Handler?.Invoke(sender, args);
			return args.Handled;
		}
	}
	public class SizeOfInfo
	{
		private readonly string displayName;

		private readonly int sizeOf;

		private readonly int count;

		public string DisplayName => displayName;

		public int SizeOf => sizeOf;

		public int Count => count;

		public SizeOfInfo(string displayName, int sizeOf, int count)
		{
			this.displayName = displayName;
			this.sizeOf = sizeOf;
			this.count = count;
		}
	}
	public static class ObjectSizeHelper
	{
		private static Dictionary<Type, int> primitiveTypesSizeOfTable = CreatePrimitiveTypesSizeofTable();

		public static SizeOfInfo CalculateTotalSizeOfInfo(List<SizeOfInfo> list, string displayName)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num += list[i].SizeOf;
			}
			return new SizeOfInfo(displayName, num, -1);
		}

		public static List<SizeOfInfo> CalculateSizeOfInfo(object obj)
		{
			List<SizeOfInfo> list = new List<SizeOfInfo>();
			FieldInfo[] fields = obj.GetType().GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			FieldInfo[] array = fields;
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
			{
				object value = fieldInfo.GetValue(obj);
				if (value is ISupportsSizeOf supportsSizeOf)
				{
					list.Add(new SizeOfInfo(fieldInfo.Name, supportsSizeOf.SizeOf(), CalculateCount(value)));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(new SizeOfInfo(fieldInfo.Name, CalculateApproxObjectSize32(value), CalculateCount(value)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static int CalculateApproxObjectSize32(object obj)
		{
			return CalculateApproxObjectSize32(obj, ignoreStringSize: true);
		}

		public static int CalculateApproxObjectSize32(object obj, bool ignoreStringSize)
		{
			if (obj is ValueType)
			{
				return CalculateApproxObjectSize32Core(obj, ignoreStringSize);
			}
			return CalculateApproxReferenceObjectSize32Core(obj, ignoreStringSize);
		}

		private static int CalculateCount(object obj)
		{
			PropertyInfo property = obj.GetType().GetProperty("Count");
			if (property != null)
			{
				return (int)property.GetValue(obj, null);
			}
			if (obj is ICollection collection)
			{
				return collection.Count;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private static int CalculateApproxObjectSize32Core(object obj, bool ignoreStringSize)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return 4;
			}
			if (obj is ValueType)
			{
				if (obj is Enum)
				{
					return CalculateApproxValueObjectSize32(Enum.GetUnderlyingType(obj.GetType()));
				}
				return CalculateApproxValueObjectSize32(obj.GetType());
			}
			return CalculateApproxReferenceObjectSize32Core(obj, ignoreStringSize);
		}

		private static int CalculateApproxReferenceObjectSize32Core(object obj, bool ignoreStringSize)
		{
			if (obj is IDocumentModel)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (obj is string text)
			{
				if (ignoreStringSize)
				{
					return 4;
				}
				return 4 + text.Length * 2;
			}
			int num = 0;
			FieldInfo[] fields = obj.GetType().GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);
			FieldInfo[] array = fields;
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
			{
				object value = fieldInfo.GetValue(obj);
				if (value is ISupportsSizeOf supportsSizeOf)
				{
					return supportsSizeOf.SizeOf();
				}
				num += CalculateApproxObjectSize32Core(value, ignoreStringSize);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static int CalculateApproxValueObjectSize32(Type type)
		{
			if (!primitiveTypesSizeOfTable.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return Marshal.SizeOf(type);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static Dictionary<Type, int> CreatePrimitiveTypesSizeofTable()
		{
			Dictionary<Type, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<Type, int>();
			dictionary.Add(typeof(bool), 1);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(byte), 1);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(sbyte), 1);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(char), 2);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(short), 2);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(ushort), 2);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(int), 4);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(uint), 4);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(long), 8);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(ulong), 8);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(decimal), 16);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(float), 4);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(double), 8);
			return dictionary;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Office.Design
{
	public class EnumLikeStructTypeConverter<T> : TypeConverter
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<T, FieldInfo> fieldsTable = CreateFieldsTable();

		private static readonly Dictionary<T, PropertyInfo> propertiesTable = CreatePropertiesTable();

		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			foreach (T key in fieldsTable.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			foreach (T key2 in propertiesTable.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key2);
			}
			return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected internal virtual InstanceDescriptor ConvertToInstanceDescriptor(ITypeDescriptorContext context, T value)
		{
			if (fieldsTable.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				return new InstanceDescriptor(value2, null);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return ConvertToStringCore(context, culture, (T)value);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return ConvertToInstanceDescriptor(context, (T)value);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value.GetType() == typeof(string))
			{
				return ConvertFromStringCore(context, culture, (string)value);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		private static Dictionary<T, FieldInfo> CreateFieldsTable()
		{
			Dictionary<T, FieldInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<T, FieldInfo>();
			FieldInfo[] fields = typeof(T).GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			int num = fields.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				FieldInfo fieldInfo = fields[i];
				if (fieldInfo.FieldType == typeof(T) && fieldInfo.IsInitOnly)
				{
					object[] customAttributes = fieldInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(BrowsableAttribute), inherit: true);
					if (customAttributes == null || customAttributes.Length == 0 || ((BrowsableAttribute)customAttributes[0]).Browsable)
					{
						T key = (T)fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
						dictionary.Add(key, fieldInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static Dictionary<T, PropertyInfo> CreatePropertiesTable()
		{
			Dictionary<T, PropertyInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<T, PropertyInfo>();
			PropertyInfo[] properties = typeof(T).GetProperties(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			int num = properties.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = properties[i];
				if (propertyInfo.PropertyType == typeof(T) && propertyInfo.CanWrite)
				{
					T key = (T)propertyInfo.GetValue(null, new object[0]);
					dictionary.Add(key, propertyInfo);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected internal virtual string ConvertToStringCore(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, T value)
		{
			if (fieldsTable.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				return value2.Name;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		protected internal virtual T ConvertFromStringCore(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, string value)
		{
			foreach (FieldInfo value2 in fieldsTable.Values)
			{
				if (value2.Name == value)
				{
					return (T)value2.GetValue(null);
				}
			}
			return default(T);
		}
	}
	public class EncodingComparer : IComparer<Encoding>
	{
		public int Compare(Encoding x, Encoding y)
		{
			return Comparer<string>.Default.Compare(x.EncodingName, y.EncodingName);
		}
	}
	public class EncodingConverter : EnumLikeStructTypeConverter<Encoding>
	{
		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			EncodingInfo[] encodings = Encoding.GetEncodings();
			int num = encodings.Length;
			List<Encoding> list = new List<Encoding>(num);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				list.Add(encodings[i].GetEncoding());
			}
			list.Sort(new EncodingComparer());
			return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}

		protected internal override string ConvertToStringCore(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, Encoding value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return value.EncodingName;
			}
			return base.ConvertToStringCore(context, culture, value);
		}

		protected internal override Encoding ConvertFromStringCore(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, string value)
		{
			EncodingInfo[] encodings = Encoding.GetEncodings();
			int num = encodings.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Encoding encoding = encodings[i].GetEncoding();
				if (string.Compare(encoding.EncodingName, value, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
				{
					return encoding;
				}
			}
			return Encoding.Default;
		}
	}

	public static class PaperKindDescriptionHelper
	{
		public static string CalculateDescription(DXPaperKind paperKind, string displayName, DocumentUnit unit, Dictionary<DocumentUnit, UnitConverter> unitConverters, DocumentModelUnitConverter documentModelUnitConverter)
		{
			unit = ((unit == DocumentUnit.Document) ? DocumentUnit.Inch : unit);
			UnitConverter unitConverter = unitConverters[unit];
			Size size = PaperSizeCalculator.CalculatePaperSize(paperKind);
			UIUnit uIUnit = new UIUnit(unitConverter.FromUnits(documentModelUnitConverter.TwipsToModelUnits(size.Width)), unit, UnitPrecisionDictionary.DefaultPrecisions);
			UIUnit uIUnit2 = new UIUnit(unitConverter.FromUnits(documentModelUnitConverter.TwipsToModelUnits(size.Height)), unit, UnitPrecisionDictionary.DefaultPrecisions);
			return $"{displayName}\r\n{uIUnit.ToString()} x {uIUnit2.ToString()}";
		}
	}
	public class UIUnitConverter
	{
		private readonly UnitPrecisionDictionary unitPrecisionDictionary;

		public UIUnitConverter(UnitPrecisionDictionary unitPrecisionDictionary)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitPrecisionDictionary, "unitPrecisionDictionary");
			this.unitPrecisionDictionary = unitPrecisionDictionary;
		}

		public UIUnit ToUIUnit(int value, DocumentUnit type)
		{
			return ToUIUnit(value, type, isValueInPercent: false);
		}

		internal UIUnit ToUIUnit(int value, DocumentUnit type, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			return ToUIUnitF(value, type, isValueInPercent);
		}

		public UIUnit ToUIUnitF(float value, DocumentUnit type)
		{
			return ToUIUnitF(value, type, isValueInPercent: false);
		}

		public UIUnit ToUIUnitF(float value, DocumentUnit type, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			if (isValueInPercent)
			{
				UIUnit uIUnit = new UIUnit(value, type, unitPrecisionDictionary);
				uIUnit.IsValueInPercent = true;
				return uIUnit;
			}
			return type switch
			{
				DocumentUnit.Centimeter => new UIUnit(Units.TwipsToCentimetersF(value), DocumentUnit.Centimeter, unitPrecisionDictionary), 
				DocumentUnit.Inch => new UIUnit(Units.TwipsToInchesF(value), DocumentUnit.Inch, unitPrecisionDictionary), 
				DocumentUnit.Millimeter => new UIUnit(Units.TwipsToMillimetersF(value), DocumentUnit.Millimeter, unitPrecisionDictionary), 
				DocumentUnit.Point => new UIUnit(Units.TwipsToPointsF(value), DocumentUnit.Point, unitPrecisionDictionary), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal int ToInt(double value)
		{
			if (value > 2147483647.0)
			{
				return int.MaxValue;
			}
			if (value < -2147483648.0)
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			return (int)value;
		}

		internal int ToTwipsUnit(UIUnit value)
		{
			return ToTwipsUnit(value, isValueInPercent: false);
		}

		public int ToTwipsUnit(UIUnit value, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			float num = ToTwipsUnitF(value, isValueInPercent);
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				return ToInt(Math.Floor(num));
			}
			return ToInt(Math.Ceiling(num));
		}

		public float ToTwipsUnitF(UIUnit value)
		{
			return ToTwipsUnitF(value, isValueInPercent: false);
		}

		internal float ToTwipsUnitF(UIUnit value, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			if (isValueInPercent)
			{
				return value.Value;
			}
			return value.UnitType switch
			{
				DocumentUnit.Centimeter => Units.CentimetersToTwipsF(value.Value), 
				DocumentUnit.Inch => Units.InchesToTwipsF(value.Value), 
				DocumentUnit.Millimeter => Units.MillimetersToTwipsF(value.Value), 
				DocumentUnit.Point => Units.PointsToTwipsF(value.Value), 
				_ => 0f, 
			};
		}

		public UIUnit CreateUIUnit(string text, DocumentUnit defaultUnitType)
		{
			return CreateUIUnit(text, defaultUnitType, isValueInPercent: false);
		}

		internal UIUnit CreateUIUnit(string text, DocumentUnit defaultUnitType, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			return UIUnit.Create(text, defaultUnitType, unitPrecisionDictionary, isValueInPercent);
		}
	}

	public class UIUnit
	{
		private static readonly UnitAbbreviationDictionary unitAbbreviationDictionary;

		private readonly UnitPrecisionDictionary unitPrecisionDictionary;

		private static readonly UnitCaptionDictionary unitCaptionDictionary;

		private DocumentUnit unitType;

		private string stringValue;

		private bool isNegative;

		private bool isValueInPercent;

		public static UnitAbbreviationDictionary UnitAbbreviationDictionary => unitAbbreviationDictionary;

		public UnitPrecisionDictionary UnitPrecisionDictionary => unitPrecisionDictionary;

		public static UnitCaptionDictionary UnitCaptionDictionary => unitCaptionDictionary;

		public static char DecimalSeparator => CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator[0];

		public DocumentUnit UnitType => unitType;

		protected internal bool IsValueInPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return isValueInPercent;
			}
			set
			{
				isValueInPercent = value;
			}
		}

		internal string OperationValidStringValue => GetValidValueString(stringValue, UnitPrecisionDictionary[UnitType]);

		internal string StringValue => TrimInsignificantZeros(stringValue);

		internal string RoundedStringValue => TrimInsignificantZeros(OperationValidStringValue);

		public bool IsNegative => isNegative;

		public float Value
		{
			get
			{
				float result = 0f;
				if (!float.TryParse(StringValue, out result))
				{
					return 0f;
				}
				if (IsNegative)
				{
					return -1f * result;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsValidValue
		{
			get
			{
				float result = 0f;
				if (float.TryParse(StringValue, out result) && !float.IsInfinity(result))
				{
					return !float.IsNaN(result);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		static UIUnit()
		{
			unitAbbreviationDictionary = new UnitAbbreviationDictionary();
			unitCaptionDictionary = new UnitCaptionDictionary();
		}

		public static UIUnit operator ++(UIUnit unit)
		{
			string operationValidStringValue = unit.OperationValidStringValue;
			if (unit.IsNegative && unit.RoundedStringValue != unit.StringValue)
			{
				unit.TruncValue();
				return unit;
			}
			if (IsZeroValue(operationValidStringValue))
			{
				unit.SetIsNegative(isNegative: false);
			}
			if (unit.isNegative)
			{
				operationValidStringValue = Decrement(operationValidStringValue);
				if (IsZeroValue(operationValidStringValue))
				{
					unit.SetIsNegative(isNegative: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				operationValidStringValue = Increment(operationValidStringValue);
			}
			unit.SetStringValue(operationValidStringValue);
			return unit;
		}

		public static UIUnit operator --(UIUnit unit)
		{
			string operationValidStringValue = unit.OperationValidStringValue;
			if (IsZeroValue(operationValidStringValue))
			{
				unit.SetIsNegative(isNegative: true);
			}
			if (!unit.IsNegative && unit.RoundedStringValue != unit.StringValue)
			{
				unit.TruncValue();
				return unit;
			}
			operationValidStringValue = ((!unit.isNegative) ? Decrement(operationValidStringValue) : Increment(operationValidStringValue));
			unit.SetStringValue(operationValidStringValue);
			return unit;
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string text, DocumentUnit defaultUnitType, out UIUnit result)
		{
			return TryParse(text, defaultUnitType, out result, isValueInPercent: false);
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string text, DocumentUnit defaultUnitType, out UIUnit result, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			result = null;
			DocumentUnit type = defaultUnitType;
			string unitTypeAndStringValue = GetUnitTypeAndStringValue(text, defaultUnitType, out type, isValueInPercent);
			bool flag = false;
			string resultStringValue = string.Empty;
			if (!TryParseFloatValue(unitTypeAndStringValue, out resultStringValue, out flag))
			{
				return false;
			}
			result = new UIUnit(resultStringValue, type, flag);
			result.IsValueInPercent = isValueInPercent;
			return true;
		}

		protected static bool TryParseFloatValue(string sourceStringValue, out string resultStringValue, out bool isNegative)
		{
			isNegative = false;
			resultStringValue = "0";
			string text = DecimalSeparator.ToString();
			text.Replace(".", "\\.");
			string pattern = $"^(?<sign>\\+|-)?(?<value>\\d*{text}?(\\d+)?)$";
			Match match = Regex.Match(sourceStringValue.Trim(), pattern);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return false;
			}
			GroupCollection groups = match.Groups;
			Group obj = groups["sign"];
			Group obj2 = groups["value"];
			if (obj.Success && obj.Value == "-")
			{
				isNegative = true;
			}
			resultStringValue = obj2.Value.Trim();
			if (resultStringValue.Length == 0 || (resultStringValue.Length == 1 && resultStringValue[0] == DecimalSeparator))
			{
				isNegative = false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static UIUnit Create(string text, DocumentUnit defaultUnitType, UnitPrecisionDictionary unitPrecisionDictionary)
		{
			return Create(text, defaultUnitType, unitPrecisionDictionary, isValueInPercent: false);
		}

		public static UIUnit Create(string text, DocumentUnit defaultUnitType, UnitPrecisionDictionary unitPrecisionDictionary, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			DocumentUnit type = defaultUnitType;
			string unitTypeAndStringValue = GetUnitTypeAndStringValue(text, defaultUnitType, out type, isValueInPercent);
			UIUnit uIUnit = new UIUnit(unitTypeAndStringValue, type, unitPrecisionDictionary);
			uIUnit.IsValueInPercent = isValueInPercent;
			return uIUnit;
		}

		private static string GetUnitTypeAndStringValue(string text, DocumentUnit defaultUnitType, out DocumentUnit type, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			type = defaultUnitType;
			string result = text;
			foreach (DocumentUnit key in UnitAbbreviationDictionary.Keys)
			{
				string text2 = GetTextAbbreviation(key, isValueInPercent).Trim();
				int num = text.LastIndexOf(text2);
				if (num != -1 && num == text.Length - text2.Length)
				{
					result = text.Substring(0, num);
					type = key;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal static string GetTextAbbreviation(DocumentUnit unitType)
		{
			return GetTextAbbreviation(unitType, isValueInPercent: false);
		}

		protected internal static string GetTextAbbreviation(DocumentUnit unitType, bool isValueInPercent)
		{
			if (isValueInPercent)
			{
				return OfficeLocalizer.GetString(OfficeStringId.UnitAbbreviation_Percent);
			}
			return OfficeLocalizer.GetString(UnitAbbreviationDictionary[unitType]);
		}

		protected internal static string GetTextCaption(DocumentUnit unitType)
		{
			return OfficeLocalizer.GetString(UnitCaptionDictionary[unitType]);
		}

		private static bool IsZeroValue(string resultValue)
		{
			string text = resultValue.Trim('0');
			if (text.Length != 0)
			{
				return text == DecimalSeparator.ToString();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static string Increment(string number)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (int num = number.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				char c = number[num];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '9':
					text = "0" + text;
					break;
				case '0':
				case '1':
				case '2':
				case '3':
				case '4':
				case '5':
				case '6':
				case '7':
				case '8':
				{
					char c2 = (char)(c + 1);
					return number.Substring(0, num) + c2 + text;
				}
				default:
					text = c + text;
					break;
				}
			}
			return "1" + text;
		}

		private static string Decrement(string number)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (int num = number.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				char c = number[num];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '0':
					text = "9" + text;
					break;
				case '1':
				case '2':
				case '3':
				case '4':
				case '5':
				case '6':
				case '7':
				case '8':
				case '9':
				{
					char c2 = (char)(c - 1);
					return number.Substring(0, num) + c2 + text;
				}
				default:
					text = c + text;
					break;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public UIUnit(string stringValue, DocumentUnit type, UnitPrecisionDictionary unitPrecisionDictionary)
		{
			this.unitPrecisionDictionary = unitPrecisionDictionary;
			unitType = GetValidType(type);
			TryParseFloatValue(stringValue, out this.stringValue, out isNegative);
			this.stringValue = GetValidValueString(this.stringValue, UnitPrecisionDictionary[UnitType] + 1);
			this.stringValue = TrimInsignificantZeros(StringValue);
			isValueInPercent = false;
		}

		public UIUnit(float value, DocumentUnit type, UnitPrecisionDictionary unitPrecisionDictionary)
		{
			this.unitPrecisionDictionary = unitPrecisionDictionary;
			unitType = GetValidType(type);
			float value2 = (float)Math.Round(value, UnitPrecisionDictionary[UnitType] + 1);
			stringValue = Math.Abs(value2).ToString();
			isNegative = value < 0f;
			isValueInPercent = false;
		}

		protected UIUnit(string value, DocumentUnit type, bool isNegative)
		{
			stringValue = value;
			unitType = GetValidType(type);
			this.isNegative = isNegative;
			isValueInPercent = false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string arg = (IsNegative ? "-" : string.Empty);
			string arg2 = TrimInsignificantZeros(StringValue);
			return $"{arg}{arg2}{GetTextAbbreviation(UnitType, IsValueInPercent)}";
		}

		private DocumentUnit GetValidType(DocumentUnit type)
		{
			if (type == DocumentUnit.Document)
			{
				return DocumentUnit.Inch;
			}
			return type;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetIsNegative(bool isNegative)
		{
			this.isNegative = isNegative;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetStringValue(string stringValue)
		{
			this.stringValue = stringValue;
		}

		private string TrimInsignificantZeros(string stringValue)
		{
			string text = TrimEndInsignificantZeros(stringValue);
			return TrimBeginInsignificantZeros(text);
		}

		private string TrimEndInsignificantZeros(string stringValue)
		{
			if (stringValue.IndexOf(DecimalSeparator) == -1)
			{
				return stringValue;
			}
			string text = stringValue.TrimEnd('0');
			int length = text.Length;
			if (text[length - 1] == DecimalSeparator)
			{
				return text.Substring(0, length - 1);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string TrimBeginInsignificantZeros(string stringValue)
		{
			int length = stringValue.Length;
			int num = 0;
			for (num = 0; num < length && stringValue[num] == '0'; num++)
			{
			}
			if (num == length || num == 0)
			{
				return stringValue;
			}
			if (!char.IsDigit(stringValue[num]))
			{
				num--;
			}
			return stringValue.Substring(num, length - num);
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetValidValueString(string stringValue, int maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(stringValue))
			{
				return CreateZeroStringValue(maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator);
			}
			string[] array = stringValue.Split(DecimalSeparator);
			int num = array.Length;
			if (num > 2)
			{
				return CreateZeroStringValue(maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator);
			}
			string text = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[0]) ? "0" : array[0]);
			string rightPart = GetRightPart(array, maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator);
			if (!IsIntegerValue(text) || (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rightPart) && !IsIntegerValue(rightPart)))
			{
				return CreateZeroStringValue(maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator);
			}
			rightPart = GetValueOfDesiredLength(rightPart, maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator);
			if (maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator < 1)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return $"{text}{DecimalSeparator}{rightPart}";
		}

		private bool IsIntegerValue(string value)
		{
			int length = value.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = value[i];
				if (c < '0' || c > '9')
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetRightPart(string[] stringValueParts, int maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator)
		{
			int num = stringValueParts.Length;
			if (num != 2)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return stringValueParts[1];
		}

		private string GetValueOfDesiredLength(string value, int desiredLength)
		{
			if (value.Length > desiredLength)
			{
				return value.Substring(0, desiredLength);
			}
			int count = desiredLength - value.Length;
			return value + new string('0', count);
		}

		private string CreateZeroStringValue(int maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator)
		{
			string text = "0";
			if (maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator > 0)
			{
				text += DecimalSeparator;
				string text2 = new string('0', maxDigitsAfterDecimalSeparator);
				text += text2;
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal void TruncValue()
		{
			stringValue = OperationValidStringValue;
		}
	}
}

	public class OfficeRectBrickExporter : VisualBrickExporter
	{
		protected override void DrawBackground(IGraphics gr, RectangleF rect)
		{
			DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter = (((BrickExporter)this).Brick as OfficeRectBrick).unitConverter;
			RectangleF rectangleF = unitConverter.DocumentsToLayoutUnits(rect);
			GdiGraphics val = (GdiGraphics)(object)((gr is GdiGraphics) ? gr : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				rectangleF = CorrectBounds(rectangleF, val);
			}
			((VisualBrickExporter)this).DrawBackground(gr, rectangleF);
		}

		internal RectangleF CorrectBounds(RectangleF bounds, GdiGraphics graphics)
		{
			DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform;
			graphics.ResetTransform();
			PointF[] array = new PointF[2]
			{
				new PointF(0f, 0f),
				new PointF(bounds.Width, bounds.Height)
			};
			graphics.Graphics.TransformPoints(CoordinateSpace.Device, CoordinateSpace.World, array);
			float x = Math.Max(array[1].X - array[0].X, 1f);
			float y = Math.Max(array[1].Y - array[0].Y, 1f);
			array = new PointF[2]
			{
				new PointF(0f, 0f),
				new PointF(x, y)
			};
			graphics.Graphics.TransformPoints(CoordinateSpace.World, CoordinateSpace.Device, array);
			bounds.Width = array[1].X - array[0].X;
			bounds.Height = array[1].Y - array[0].Y;
			graphics.Transform = transform;
			return bounds;
		}
	}

	public class GdiGraphicsModifier : GraphicsModifier
	{
		private delegate void DrawStringExtTextOutDelegate(IntPtr hdc, string text, Rectangle bounds, IntPtr fontHandle, Win32.RECT clipRect, StringFormat format);

		private delegate void ExtTextOutAction(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, StringFormat format, int textHeight);

		private struct ExtendedGcpResults
		{
			public Win32.GCP_RESULTS Results { get; set; }

			public int TextHeight { get; set; }
		}

		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter;

		private HdcDpiToDocuments dpiModifier;

		private HdcZoomModifier zoomModifier;

		private Graphics measureGraphics;

		private HdcDpiToDocuments measureDpiModifier;

		private DrawStringExtTextOutDelegate extTextOut;

		private Win32.EtoFlags etoFlagsForTextOutput = Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_CLIPPED;

		private GraphicsState previousGraphicsState;

		private GraphicsToLayoutUnitsModifier modifier;

		private const float defaultZoomFactor = 1f;

		private float zoomFactor = 1f;

		public bool UsePdy { get; set; }

		public bool UseGlyphs
		{
			get
			{
				return extTextOut == new DrawStringExtTextOutDelegate(DrawStringExtTextOutGlyph);
			}
			set
			{
				if (UseGlyphs != value)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						extTextOut = DrawStringExtTextOutGlyph;
					}
					else
					{
						extTextOut = DrawStringExtTextOutText;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool UseGdiPlusDrawString { get; set; }

		public bool UseClipBoundsWithoutGlyphs
		{
			get
			{
				return etoFlagsForTextOutput == Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_CLIPPED;
			}
			set
			{
				if (UseClipBoundsWithoutGlyphs != value)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						etoFlagsForTextOutput = Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_CLIPPED;
					}
					else
					{
						etoFlagsForTextOutput = Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_NONE;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public GdiGraphicsModifier(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
			UseGlyphs = true;
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			if (measureGraphics != null)
			{
				measureGraphics.Dispose();
				measureGraphics = null;
			}
			CleanupTransforms();
		}

		public override void OnGraphicsDispose()
		{
			CleanupTransforms();
		}

		protected internal virtual void CleanupTransforms()
		{
			if (measureDpiModifier != null)
			{
				((HdcDpiModifier)measureDpiModifier).Dispose();
				measureDpiModifier = null;
			}
			if (dpiModifier != null)
			{
				((HdcDpiModifier)dpiModifier).Dispose();
				dpiModifier = null;
			}
			if (zoomModifier != null)
			{
				zoomModifier.Dispose();
				zoomModifier = null;
			}
			zoomFactor = 1f;
		}

		public override void SetPageUnit(Graphics gr, GraphicsUnit value)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Expected O, but got Unknown
			gr.PageUnit = value;
			dpiModifier = new HdcDpiToDocuments(gr, new Size(4096, 4096));
			if (measureGraphics == null)
			{
				measureGraphics = Graphics.FromHwnd(IntPtr.Zero);
			}
			measureGraphics.PageUnit = value;
			measureDpiModifier = new HdcDpiToDocuments(gr, new Size(4096, 4096));
			float num = gr.Transform.Elements[0];
			zoomModifier = new HdcZoomModifier(gr, num);
			zoomFactor = num;
		}

		public void SwitchToLayoutUnits(Graphics gr)
		{
			previousGraphicsState = gr.Save();
			modifier = new GraphicsToLayoutUnitsModifier(gr, unitConverter);
			gr.ScaleTransform(zoomFactor, zoomFactor);
			zoomModifier = new HdcZoomModifier(gr, zoomFactor);
		}

		public void SwitchToDocuments(Graphics gr)
		{
			zoomModifier.Dispose();
			modifier.Dispose();
			gr.Restore(previousGraphicsState);
		}

		protected virtual IntPtr GetFontHandle(Font font, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			return WindowsPlatformFontInfo.CreateGdiFont(font, unitConverter);
		}

		protected virtual void DrawStringGdiPlus(Graphics gr, string text, Font font, Brush brush, RectangleF bounds, StringFormat format)
		{
			gr.DrawString(text, font, brush, bounds, format);
		}

		public override void DrawString(Graphics gr, string text, Font font, Brush brush, RectangleF bounds, StringFormat format)
		{
			if (UseGdiPlusDrawString)
			{
				DrawStringGdiPlus(gr, text, font, brush, bounds, format);
				return;
			}
			RectangleF clipBounds = gr.ClipBounds;
			float num = gr.Transform.Elements[0] / zoomFactor;
			HdcZoomModifier hdcZoomModifier = null;
			if (num != 1f)
			{
				hdcZoomModifier = new HdcZoomModifier(gr, num);
			}
			IntPtr hdc = gr.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				if (brush is SolidBrush solidBrush)
				{
					Win32.SetTextColor(hdc, solidBrush.Color);
				}
				Win32.SetBkMode(hdc, Win32.BkMode.TRANSPARENT);
				IntPtr fontHandle = GetFontHandle(font, unitConverter);
				IntPtr hGdiObj = Win32.SelectObject(hdc, fontHandle);
				GdiPainter.SetClipToHDC(Rectangle.Ceiling(clipBounds), hdc);
				try
				{
					if ((format.FormatFlags & StringFormatFlags.NoWrap) == 0)
					{
						DrawStringDrawTextEx(hdc, text, Win32.RECT.FromRectangle(Rectangle.Ceiling(bounds)), format);
						return;
					}
					RectangleF value = unitConverter.DocumentsToLayoutUnits(bounds);
					value.Intersect(clipBounds);
					Win32.RECT clipRect = Win32.RECT.FromRectangle(Rectangle.Ceiling(value));
					extTextOut(hdc, text, Rectangle.Ceiling(bounds), fontHandle, clipRect, format);
				}
				finally
				{
					GdiPainter.ExcludeClipFromHDC(Rectangle.Ceiling(bounds), hdc);
					Win32.SelectObject(hdc, hGdiObj);
					Win32.DeleteObject(fontHandle);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
				hdcZoomModifier?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void DrawStringDrawTextEx(IntPtr hdc, string text, Win32.RECT rect, StringFormat format)
		{
			Win32.DrawTextFlags flags = CalculateDrawTextFlags(format);
			int num = CalculateDrawTextVerticalOffset(hdc, text, rect, format, flags);
			rect.Top += num;
			Win32.DrawTextEx(hdc, text, ref rect, flags);
		}

		private int CalculateDrawTextVerticalOffset(IntPtr hdc, string text, Win32.RECT rect, StringFormat format, Win32.DrawTextFlags flags)
		{
			if ((format.FormatFlags & StringFormatFlags.NoWrap) != 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (format.LineAlignment == StringAlignment.Near)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int height = rect.Height;
			flags &= ~(Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_VCENTER | Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_BOTTOM);
			int num = Win32.DrawTextEx(hdc, text, ref rect, flags | Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_CALCRECT);
			if (format.LineAlignment == StringAlignment.Center)
			{
				return (height - num) / 2;
			}
			return height - num;
		}

		private Win32.DrawTextFlags CalculateDrawTextFlags(StringFormat format)
		{
			Win32.DrawTextFlags drawTextFlags = Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_NOPREFIX;
			drawTextFlags = (((format.FormatFlags & StringFormatFlags.NoWrap) != 0) ? (drawTextFlags | Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_SINGLELINE) : (drawTextFlags | Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_WORDBREAK));
			switch (format.Alignment)
			{
			case StringAlignment.Near:
				drawTextFlags |= Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_TOP;
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Center:
				drawTextFlags |= Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_CENTER;
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Far:
				drawTextFlags |= Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_RIGHT;
				break;
			}
			if ((drawTextFlags & Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_SINGLELINE) != Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_TOP)
			{
				switch (format.LineAlignment)
				{
				case StringAlignment.Near:
					drawTextFlags |= Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_TOP;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Center:
					drawTextFlags |= Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_VCENTER;
					break;
				case StringAlignment.Far:
					drawTextFlags |= Win32.DrawTextFlags.DT_BOTTOM;
					break;
				}
			}
			return drawTextFlags;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private ExtendedGcpResults CalculateTextHeightAndGlyphs(string text, IntPtr fontHandle)
		{
			ExtendedGcpResults result = default(ExtendedGcpResults);
			Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults = new Win32.GCP_RESULTS
			{
				lStructSize = Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(Win32.GCP_RESULTS)),
				lpOutString = IntPtr.Zero,
				lpOrder = IntPtr.Zero,
				lpDx = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(4 * text.Length),
				lpCaretPos = IntPtr.Zero,
				lpClass = IntPtr.Zero,
				lpGlyphs = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(2 * text.Length),
				nGlyphs = text.Length
			};
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				Marshal.WriteInt16(gcpResults.lpGlyphs, 0);
			}
			lock (measureGraphics)
			{
				IntPtr hdc = measureGraphics.GetHdc();
				try
				{
					Win32.SelectObject(hdc, fontHandle);
					int num = Win32.GetCharacterPlacement(hdc, text, text.Length, 0, ref gcpResults, Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_USEKERNING | Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_LIGATE);
					if (num == 0 && text.Length > 0)
					{
						num = MeasureWithGetCharacterPlacementSlow(hdc, text, ref gcpResults);
					}
					result.TextHeight = num >> 16;
				}
				finally
				{
					measureGraphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
				}
			}
			result.Results = gcpResults;
			return result;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void DrawStringExtTextOutText(IntPtr hdc, string text, Rectangle bounds, IntPtr fontHandle, Win32.RECT clipRect, StringFormat format)
		{
			ExtendedGcpResults extendedGcpResults = CalculateTextHeightAndGlyphs(text, fontHandle);
			ExtTextOut(hdc, bounds, clipRect, text, format, extendedGcpResults.TextHeight);
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(extendedGcpResults.Results.lpGlyphs);
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(extendedGcpResults.Results.lpDx);
		}

		private void ExtTextOut(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, string text, StringFormat format, int textHeight)
		{
			int yOffset = CalculateYOffset(bounds, textHeight, format.LineAlignment);
			switch (format.Alignment)
			{
			case StringAlignment.Near:
				ExtTextOutAlignLeft(hdc, bounds, clipRect, text, format, yOffset);
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Center:
				ExtTextOutAlignCenter(hdc, bounds, clipRect, text, format, yOffset);
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Far:
				ExtTextOutAlignRight(hdc, bounds, clipRect, text, format, yOffset);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ExtTextOutAlignLeft(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, string text, StringFormat format, int yOffset)
		{
			ExtTextOutCore(hdc, bounds.Left, bounds.Top + yOffset, clipRect, text);
		}

		private void ExtTextOutAlignCenter(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, string text, StringFormat format, int yOffset)
		{
			int value = Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, format);
			try
			{
				ExtTextOutCore(hdc, (bounds.Left + bounds.Right) / 2, bounds.Top + yOffset, clipRect, text);
			}
			finally
			{
				Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, value);
			}
		}

		private void ExtTextOutAlignRight(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, string text, StringFormat format, int yOffset)
		{
			int value = Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, format);
			try
			{
				ExtTextOutCore(hdc, bounds.Right, bounds.Top + yOffset, clipRect, text);
			}
			finally
			{
				Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, value);
			}
		}

		private void ExtTextOutCore(IntPtr hdc, int x, int y, Win32.RECT clipRect, string text)
		{
			Win32.ExtTextOut(hdc, x, y, etoFlagsForTextOutput, ref clipRect, text, text.Length, null);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected virtual void DrawStringExtTextOutGlyph(IntPtr hdc, string text, Rectangle bounds, IntPtr fontHandle, Win32.RECT clipRect, StringFormat format)
		{
			ExtendedGcpResults extendedGcpResults = CalculateTextHeightAndGlyphs(text, fontHandle);
			ExtTextOut(hdc, bounds, clipRect, extendedGcpResults.Results, format, extendedGcpResults.TextHeight);
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(extendedGcpResults.Results.lpGlyphs);
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(extendedGcpResults.Results.lpDx);
		}

		protected void ExtTextOut(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults, StringFormat format, int textHeight)
		{
			int yOffset = CalculateYOffset(bounds, textHeight, format.LineAlignment);
			switch (format.Alignment)
			{
			case StringAlignment.Near:
				ExtTextOutAlignLeft(hdc, bounds, clipRect, gcpResults, format, yOffset);
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Center:
				ExtTextOutAlignCenter(hdc, bounds, clipRect, gcpResults, format, yOffset);
				break;
			case StringAlignment.Far:
				ExtTextOutAlignRight(hdc, bounds, clipRect, gcpResults, format, yOffset);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ExtTextOutAlignLeft(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults, StringFormat format, int yOffset)
		{
			ExtTextOutCore(hdc, bounds.Left, bounds.Top + yOffset, clipRect, gcpResults);
		}

		private void ExtTextOutAlignCenter(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults, StringFormat format, int yOffset)
		{
			int value = Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, format);
			try
			{
				ExtTextOutCore(hdc, (bounds.Left + bounds.Right) / 2, bounds.Top + yOffset, clipRect, gcpResults);
			}
			finally
			{
				Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, value);
			}
		}

		private void ExtTextOutAlignRight(IntPtr hdc, Rectangle bounds, Win32.RECT clipRect, Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults, StringFormat format, int yOffset)
		{
			int value = Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, format);
			try
			{
				ExtTextOutCore(hdc, bounds.Right, bounds.Top + yOffset, clipRect, gcpResults);
			}
			finally
			{
				Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, value);
			}
		}

		private void ExtTextOutCore(IntPtr hdc, int x, int y, Win32.RECT clipRect, Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults)
		{
			Win32.ExtTextOut(hdc, x, y, UsePdy ? (Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_GLYPH_INDEX | Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_PDY) : Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_GLYPH_INDEX, ref clipRect, gcpResults.lpGlyphs, gcpResults.nGlyphs, gcpResults.lpDx);
		}

		private int CalculateYOffset(Rectangle bounds, int textHeight, StringAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (textHeight <= 0)
			{
				textHeight = bounds.Height;
			}
			return alignment switch
			{
				StringAlignment.Center => (bounds.Height - textHeight) / 2, 
				StringAlignment.Far => bounds.Height - textHeight, 
				_ => 0, 
			};
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private int MeasureWithGetCharacterPlacementSlow(IntPtr hdc, string text, ref Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling((double)text.Length / 2.0));
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num3 < 3)
			{
				gcpResults.lpDx = Marshal.ReAllocCoTaskMem(gcpResults.lpDx, 4 * (text.Length + num2));
				gcpResults.lpGlyphs = Marshal.ReAllocCoTaskMem(gcpResults.lpGlyphs, 2 * (text.Length + num2));
				gcpResults.nGlyphs = text.Length + num2;
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					Marshal.WriteInt16(gcpResults.lpGlyphs, 0);
				}
				int characterPlacement = Win32.GetCharacterPlacement(hdc, text, text.Length, 0, ref gcpResults, Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_USEKERNING | Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_LIGATE);
				if (characterPlacement != 0)
				{
					return characterPlacement;
				}
				num3++;
				num2 += num;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override void ScaleTransform(Graphics gr, float sx, float sy, MatrixOrder order)
		{
			gr.ScaleTransform(sx, sy, order);
			zoomModifier = new HdcZoomModifier(gr, sx);
			zoomFactor = sx;
		}

		public override void DrawImage(Graphics gr, Image image, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			RectangleF correctedBounds = SnapToDevicePixelsHelper.GetCorrectedBounds(gr, image.Size, bounds);
			gr.DrawImage(image, correctedBounds);
		}

		public override void DrawEllipse(Graphics gr, Pen pen, float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			gr.DrawEllipse(pen, x, y, width, height);
		}

		public override void DrawLine(Graphics gr, Pen pen, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			gr.DrawLine(pen, x1, y1, x2, y2);
		}

		public override void DrawLines(Graphics gr, Pen pen, PointF[] points)
		{
			gr.DrawLines(pen, points);
		}

		public override void DrawPath(Graphics gr, Pen pen, GraphicsPath path)
		{
			gr.DrawPath(pen, path);
		}

		public override void DrawRectangle(Graphics gr, Pen pen, RectangleF rect)
		{
			gr.DrawRectangle(pen, rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}
	}
	public class GdiMeasurer : Measurer
	{
		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter;

		public GdiMeasurer(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private int MeasureCharactersWithGetCharacterPlacementSlow(IntPtr hdc, string text, ref Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling((double)text.Length / 2.0));
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num3 < 3)
			{
				gcpResults.lpCaretPos = Marshal.ReAllocCoTaskMem(gcpResults.lpCaretPos, 4 * (text.Length + num2));
				gcpResults.nGlyphs = text.Length + num2;
				int characterPlacement = Win32.GetCharacterPlacement(hdc, text, text.Length, 0, ref gcpResults, Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_USEKERNING | Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_LIGATE);
				if (characterPlacement != 0)
				{
					return characterPlacement;
				}
				num3++;
				num2 += num;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, SizeF size, DXStringFormat dxStringFormat, DXGraphicsUnit pageUnit)
		{
			return MeasureStringCore(text, ((Measurer)this).FontCache.GetFont(font));
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private SizeF MeasureStringCore(string text, Font font)
		{
			lock (((Measurer)this).Graphics)
			{
				IntPtr hdc = ((Measurer)this).Graphics.GetHdc();
				try
				{
					IntPtr intPtr = WindowsPlatformFontInfo.CreateGdiFont(font, unitConverter);
					IntPtr hGdiObj = Win32.SelectObject(hdc, intPtr);
					Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults = new Win32.GCP_RESULTS
					{
						lStructSize = Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(Win32.GCP_RESULTS)),
						lpOutString = IntPtr.Zero,
						lpOrder = IntPtr.Zero,
						lpDx = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(4 * text.Length),
						lpCaretPos = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(4 * text.Length),
						lpClass = IntPtr.Zero,
						lpGlyphs = IntPtr.Zero,
						nGlyphs = text.Length
					};
					int num = Win32.GetCharacterPlacement(hdc, text, text.Length, 0, ref gcpResults, Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_USEKERNING | Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_LIGATE);
					if (num == 0 && text.Length > 0)
					{
						num = MeasureWithGetCharacterPlacementSlow(hdc, text, ref gcpResults);
					}
					int num2 = num & 0xFFFF;
					int num3 = (num & -65536) >>> 16;
					int num4 = Marshal.ReadInt32(gcpResults.lpCaretPos, (text.Length - 1) * 4);
					if (num4 > 65535)
					{
						num2 = num4 + Marshal.ReadInt32(gcpResults.lpDx, (text.Length - 1) * 4);
					}
					Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(gcpResults.lpCaretPos);
					Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(gcpResults.lpDx);
					Win32.SelectObject(hdc, hGdiObj);
					Win32.DeleteObject(intPtr);
					return new SizeF(num2, num3);
				}
				finally
				{
					((Measurer)this).Graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private int MeasureWithGetCharacterPlacementSlow(IntPtr hdc, string text, ref Win32.GCP_RESULTS gcpResults)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling((double)text.Length / 2.0));
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num3 < 3)
			{
				gcpResults.lpDx = Marshal.ReAllocCoTaskMem(gcpResults.lpDx, 4 * (text.Length + num2));
				gcpResults.lpGlyphs = Marshal.ReAllocCoTaskMem(gcpResults.lpGlyphs, 2 * (text.Length + num2));
				gcpResults.nGlyphs = text.Length + num2;
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					Marshal.WriteInt16(gcpResults.lpGlyphs, 0);
				}
				int characterPlacement = Win32.GetCharacterPlacement(hdc, text, text.Length, 0, ref gcpResults, Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_USEKERNING | Win32.GcpFlags.GCP_LIGATE);
				if (characterPlacement != 0)
				{
					return characterPlacement;
				}
				num3++;
				num2 += num;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	public class OfficeBufferedImageGraphicsService : BufferedImageGraphicsService
	{
		private class BufferedGraphicsItem
		{
			private readonly BufferedGraphics bufferedGraphics;

			private readonly Graphics imageGraphics;

			public BufferedGraphics BufferedGraphics => bufferedGraphics;

			public Graphics ImageGraphics => imageGraphics;

			public BufferedGraphicsItem(BufferedGraphics bufferedGraphics, Graphics imageGraphics)
			{
				this.bufferedGraphics = bufferedGraphics;
				this.imageGraphics = imageGraphics;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<Image, BufferedGraphicsItem> imageToGraphics = new Dictionary<Image, BufferedGraphicsItem>();

		public override Graphics CreateGraphics(Image img)
		{
			Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(img);
			BufferedGraphics bufferedGraphics = BufferedGraphicsManager.Current.Allocate(graphics, new Rectangle(0, 0, img.Width, img.Height));
			lock (imageToGraphics)
			{
				imageToGraphics.Add(img, new BufferedGraphicsItem(bufferedGraphics, graphics));
			}
			Graphics graphics2 = bufferedGraphics.Graphics;
			float sx = graphics.DpiX / graphics2.DpiX;
			float sy = graphics.DpiY / graphics2.DpiY;
			graphics2.ScaleTransform(sx, sy);
			return graphics2;
		}

		public override void OnGraphicsDispose(Image img)
		{
			BufferedGraphicsItem value;
			lock (imageToGraphics)
			{
				if (!imageToGraphics.TryGetValue(img, out value))
				{
					return;
				}
				imageToGraphics.Remove(img);
			}
			BufferedGraphics bufferedGraphics = value.BufferedGraphics;
			Graphics imageGraphics = value.ImageGraphics;
			bufferedGraphics.Render();
			bufferedGraphics.Dispose();
			imageGraphics.Dispose();
		}

		public override void Render(Image img)
		{
			BufferedGraphicsItem value;
			lock (imageToGraphics)
			{
				if (!imageToGraphics.TryGetValue(img, out value))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			value.BufferedGraphics.Render();
		}
	}
	[BrickExporter(typeof(TransformationBrickExporter))]
	public class TransformationBrick : PanelBrick
	{
		private bool isHitTestAllowed;

		protected override bool AllowHitTest => isHitTestAllowed;

		public bool IsHitTestAllowed
		{
			get
			{
				return isHitTestAllowed;
			}
			set
			{
				isHitTestAllowed = value;
			}
		}

		public TransformationBrick()
		{
			((VisualBrick)this).BackColor = DXColor.Transparent;
			((VisualBrick)this).BorderWidth = 0f;
			((BrickBase)this).NoClip = true;
			((Brick)this).SeparableHorz = false;
			((Brick)this).SeparableVert = false;
		}
	}
	public class TransformationBrickExporter : PanelBrickExporter
	{
		public override void Draw(IGraphics gr, RectangleF rect)
		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
			{
				((VisualBrickExporter)this).Draw(gr, rect);
				return;
			}
			GdiGraphics val = (GdiGraphics)(object)((gr is GdiGraphics) ? gr : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				((VisualBrickExporter)this).Draw(gr, rect);
				return;
			}
			IServiceProvider printingSystem = (IServiceProvider)((PrintingSystemContext)val).PrintingSystem;
			if (!(printingSystem.GetService(typeof(GraphicsModifier)) is GdiGraphicsModifier gdiGraphicsModifier))
			{
				((VisualBrickExporter)this).Draw(gr, rect);
				return;
			}
			gdiGraphicsModifier.SwitchToLayoutUnits(val.Graphics);
			try
			{
				((VisualBrickExporter)this).Draw(gr, rect);
			}
			finally
			{
				gdiGraphicsModifier.SwitchToDocuments(val.Graphics);
			}
		}
	}

		[Serializable]
		public struct RECT
		{
			public int Left;

			public int Top;

			public int Right;

			public int Bottom;

			public int Width => Right - Left;

			public int Height => Bottom - Top;

			public Size Size => new Size(Width, Height);

			public Point Location => new Point(Left, Top);

			public RECT(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
			{
				Left = left;
				Top = top;
				Right = right;
				Bottom = bottom;
			}

			public Rectangle ToRectangle()
			{
				return Rectangle.FromLTRB(Left, Top, Right, Bottom);
			}

			public static RECT FromRectangle(Rectangle rectangle)
			{
				return new RECT(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return Left ^ ((Top << 13) | (Top >> 19)) ^ ((Width << 26) | (Width >> 6)) ^ ((Height << 7) | (Height >> 25));
			}

			public static implicit operator Rectangle(RECT r)
			{
				return Rectangle.FromLTRB(r.Left, r.Top, r.Right, r.Bottom);
			}

			public static implicit operator RECT(Rectangle r)
			{
				return new RECT(r.Left, r.Top, r.Right, r.Bottom);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static bool IsFontTablePresent(IntPtr hdc, string fontTableName)
		{
			int fontData = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GetFontData(hdc, GetTableIdentifier(fontTableName), 0u, null, 0u);
			return fontData > 0;
		}

		private static uint GetTableIdentifier(string tableName)
		{
			if (tableName.Length != 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return tableName[0] + ((uint)tableName[1] << 8) + ((uint)tableName[2] << 16) + ((uint)tableName[3] << 24);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal static int[] GetCharWidth(IntPtr hdc, uint firstChar, uint lastChar)
		{
			uint num = lastChar - firstChar + 1;
			int[] array = new int[num];
			bool charWidth = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GetCharWidth(hdc, firstChar, lastChar, array);
			return array;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal static int[] GetCharABCWidths(IntPtr hdc, uint firstChar, uint lastChar)
		{
			uint num = lastChar - firstChar + 1;
			int[] array = new int[num];
			ABC[] array2 = new ABC[num];
			bool charABCWidths = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GetCharABCWidths(hdc, firstChar, lastChar, array2);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (charABCWidths)
				{
					array[i] = ((array2[i].abcC < 0) ? (-array2[i].abcC) : 0);
				}
				else
				{
					array[i] = 0;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static int SetTextAlign(IntPtr hdc, StringFormat format)
		{
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment textAlignment = format.Alignment switch
			{
				StringAlignment.Center => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_CENTER, 
				StringAlignment.Far => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_RIGHT, 
				_ => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_NOUPDATECP, 
			};
			int textAlign = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GetTextAlign(hdc);
			if ((textAlign & 6) != (int)textAlignment)
			{
				textAlign &= -7;
				textAlign |= (int)textAlignment;
				return PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.SetTextAlign(hdc, textAlign);
			}
			return textAlign;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static string GetUserName(ExtendedNameFormat nameFormat)
		{
			if (getUserNameFailed)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!SecurityHelper.IsPermissionGranted((IPermission)new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode)))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(1000);
				int userNameSize = stringBuilder.Capacity;
				return (PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GetUserNameEx(nameFormat, stringBuilder, ref userNameSize) != 0) ? stringBuilder.ToString() : string.Empty;
			}
			catch
			{
				getUserNameFailed = true;
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public static void ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptor(string stringSecurityDescriptor, IntPtr ppSecurityDescriptor)
		{
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW(stringSecurityDescriptor, 1, ppSecurityDescriptor, IntPtr.Zero);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static string ConvertSecurityDescriptorToStringSecurityDescriptor(IntPtr securityDescriptor, SECURITY_INFORMATION securityInformation)
		{
			if (PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.ConvertSecurityDescriptorToStringSecurityDescriptorA(securityDescriptor, 1, securityInformation, out var stringSecurityDescriptor, out var stringSecurityDescriptorLen) == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (stringSecurityDescriptorLen <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string result = Marshal.PtrToStringAnsi(stringSecurityDescriptor);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(stringSecurityDescriptor);
			return result;
		}

	[ComImport]
	[InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
	[Guid("965FC360-16FF-11d0-91CB-00AA00BBB723")]
	public interface ISecurityInformation
	{
		void GetObjectInformation(ref Win32.SI_OBJECT_INFO object_info);

		void GetSecurity(int requestInformation, IntPtr securityDescriptor, bool fDefault);

		void SetSecurity(int requestInformation, IntPtr securityDescriptor);

		void GetAccessRight(IntPtr guidObject, int dwFlags, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPArray)] out Win32.SI_ACCESS[] access, ref int accessCount, ref int defaultAccess);

		void MapGeneric(IntPtr guidObjectType, IntPtr aceFlags, IntPtr mask);

		void GetInheritTypes(ref Win32.SI_INHERIT_TYPE inheritType, IntPtr inheritTypesCount);

		void PropertySheetPageCallback(IntPtr hwnd, int uMsg, int uPage);
	}
	public class SimpleSecurityInformation : ISecurityInformation
	{
		private Win32.SI_OBJECT_INFO objectInfo;

		private Win32.SI_ACCESS[] accessList = new Win32.SI_ACCESS[0];

		private Win32.GENERIC_MAPPING mapping;

		public Win32.SI_OBJECT_INFO ObjectInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return objectInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				objectInfo = value;
			}
		}

		public Win32.SI_ACCESS[] AccessList
		{
			get
			{
				return accessList;
			}
			set
			{
				accessList = value;
			}
		}

		public Win32.GENERIC_MAPPING GenericMapping
		{
			get
			{
				return mapping;
			}
			set
			{
				mapping = value;
			}
		}

		public string ObjectName
		{
			get
			{
				return objectInfo.szObjectName;
			}
			set
			{
				objectInfo.szObjectName = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual void GetObjectInformation(ref Win32.SI_OBJECT_INFO objectInfo)
		{
			objectInfo = this.objectInfo;
		}

		public virtual void GetSecurity(int requestInformation, IntPtr ppSecurityDescriptor, bool fDefault)
		{
		}

		public virtual void SetSecurity(int requestInformation, IntPtr securityDescriptor)
		{
		}

		public virtual void GetAccessRight(IntPtr guidObject, int dwFlags, out Win32.SI_ACCESS[] access, ref int accessCount, ref int defaultAccess)
		{
			access = accessList;
			accessCount = accessList.Length;
			defaultAccess = 0;
		}

		public virtual void GetInheritTypes(ref Win32.SI_INHERIT_TYPE inheritType, IntPtr inheritTypesCount)
		{
		}

		public virtual void PropertySheetPageCallback(IntPtr hwnd, int uMsg, int uPage)
		{
		}

		public virtual void MapGeneric(IntPtr guidObjectType, IntPtr aceFlags, IntPtr mask)
		{
			Win32.MapGenericMask(mask, ref mapping);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Office.NumberConverters
{
	public abstract class AlphabetBasedNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override long MinValue => 0L;

		protected internal override long MaxValue => 780L;

		protected internal abstract char[] Alphabet { get; }

		protected internal abstract int AlphabetSize { get; }

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			if (value == 0L)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			value--;
			int count = (int)value / AlphabetSize + 1;
			char c = Alphabet[value % AlphabetSize];
			return new string(c, count);
		}
	}
	public class ArabicAbjadConverter : ArabicAlphabetBasedNumberConverter
	{
		private static char[] arabicAbjad = new char[28]
		{
			'أ', 'ب', 'ج', 'د', 'ه', 'و', 'ز', 'ح', 'ط', 'ي',
			'ك', 'ل', 'م', 'ن', 'س', 'ع', 'ف', 'ص', 'ق', 'ر',
			'ش', 'ت', 'ث', 'خ', 'ذ', 'ض', 'ظ', 'غ'
		};

		private static int alphabetSize = arabicAbjad.Length;

		protected internal override char[] Alphabet => arabicAbjad;

		protected internal override int AlphabetSize => alphabetSize;

		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.ArabicAbjad;
	}
	public abstract class ArabicAlphabetBasedNumberConverter : AlphabetBasedNumberConverter
	{
		private static string RepeatString(string s, int n)
		{
			string text = s;
			for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++)
			{
				text += s;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			if (value == 0L)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			value--;
			int n = (int)value / AlphabetSize + 1;
			char c = Alphabet[value % AlphabetSize];
			return RepeatString(c + "\u200c", n);
		}
	}
	public class ArabicAlphaConverter : ArabicAlphabetBasedNumberConverter
	{
		private static char[] arabicAlpha = new char[28]
		{
			'أ', 'ب', 'ت', 'ث', 'ج', 'ح', 'خ', 'د', 'ذ', 'ر',
			'ز', 'س', 'ش', 'ص', 'ض', 'ط', 'ظ', 'ع', 'غ', 'ف',
			'ق', 'ك', 'ل', 'م', 'ن', 'ه', 'و', 'ي'
		};

		private static int alphabetSize = arabicAlpha.Length;

		protected internal override char[] Alphabet => arabicAlpha;

		protected internal override int AlphabetSize => alphabetSize;

		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.ArabicAlpha;
	}
	public class BulletNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.Bullet;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			return $"•";
		}
	}
	public class ChicagoNumberConverter : AlphabetBasedNumberConverter
	{
		private static readonly char[] symbols = new char[4] { '*', '†', '‡', '§' };

		private static int alphabetSize = symbols.Length;

		protected internal override char[] Alphabet => symbols;

		protected internal override int AlphabetSize => alphabetSize;

		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.Chicago;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			if (value == 0L)
			{
				return "*";
			}
			return base.ConvertNumberCore(value);
		}
	}
	public class DecimalNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.Decimal;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			return value.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class DecimalEnclosedParenthesesNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.DecimalEnclosedParentheses;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			return $"({value})";
		}
	}
	public class DecimalZeroNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.DecimalZero;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			if (value < 10)
			{
				return $"0{value}";
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}
	}

	public enum DigitType
	{
		Zero,
		SingleNumeral,
		Single,
		Teen,
		Tenth,
		Hundred,
		Thousand,
		Million,
		Billion,
		Trillion,
		Quadrillion,
		Quintillion,
		Separator
	}
	public abstract class DigitInfo
	{
		private INumericsProvider provider;

		private long number;

		public abstract DigitType Type { get; }

		public INumericsProvider Provider
		{
			get
			{
				return provider;
			}
			set
			{
				provider = value;
			}
		}

		public long Number => number;

		protected DigitInfo(INumericsProvider provider, long number)
		{
			this.provider = provider;
			this.number = number;
		}

		public string ConvertToString()
		{
			string[] numerics = GetNumerics();
			return numerics[number];
		}

		protected internal abstract string[] GetNumerics();
	}
	public class DigitInfoCollection : List<DigitInfo>
	{
		public DigitInfo Last => base[base.Count - 1];
	}
	public class SingleNumeralDigitInfo : DigitInfo

			: base(provider, number - 1)
		{
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetNumerics()

		}
