	public abstract class DescriptivePortugueseNumberConverterBase : DescriptiveNumberConverterBase
	{
		private bool oneHundredValue;

		private bool fullHundreds;

		protected internal bool OneHundredValue => oneHundredValue;

		protected internal bool FullHundreds => fullHundreds;

		protected internal override void GenerateDigitsInfo(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value / 1000000000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				GenerateQuintillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000000000000L);
				base.FlagQuintillion = false;
			}
			value %= 1000000000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				GenerateQuadrillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000000000L);
				base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
			}
			value %= 1000000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				GenerateTrillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000000L);
				base.FlagTrillion = false;
			}
			value %= 1000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateBillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000);
				base.FlagBillion = false;
			}
			value %= 1000000000;
			if (value / 1000000 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateMillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
				base.FlagMillion = false;
			}
			value %= 1000000;
			if (value / 1000 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateThousandDigits(digits, value / 1000);
				base.FlagThousand = false;
			}
			long num = value % 1000;
			if (num >= 100)
			{
				fullHundreds = num % 100 == 0;
			}
			oneHundredValue = num / 100 == 1 && fullHundreds;
			value %= 1000;
			if (value / 100 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value / 100);
			}
			value %= 100;
			if (value != 0L)
			{
				if (value >= 20)
				{
					GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value);
				}
				else if (value >= 10)
				{
					GenerateTeensDigits(digits, value % 10);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract INumericsProvider GetHundredProvider(INumericsProvider provider);
	}
	public class DescriptiveCardinalPortugueseNumberConverter : DescriptivePortugueseNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.CardinalText;

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateSinglesProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTeensProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTenthsProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateHundredProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateThousandProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateMillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateBillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuadrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuintillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuintillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagQuintillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagTrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagTrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateMillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagMillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagMillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateHundredSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0 && base.FullHundreds)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(provider, 1L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateHundredSeparator(digits, provider);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateHundredDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (base.OneHundredValue)
			{
				GenerateHundredSeparator(digits, GenerateHundredProvider());
				digits.Add(new HundredsDigitInfo(new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider(), 10L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTenthsSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider)
		{
			TeensTenthsSingleSeparator(digits, provider);
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTeensSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider, long value)
		{
			TeensTenthsSingleSeparator(digits, provider);
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider, long value)
		{
			TeensTenthsSingleSeparator(digits, provider);
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if ((!base.FlagThousand && !base.FlagBillion && !base.FlagQuadrillion) || value != 1 || digits.Count != 0)
			{
				base.GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected DigitInfo ChooseCardinalProvider(int number)
		{
			if (base.FlagMillion)
			{
				return new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagTrillion)
			{
				return new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuintillion)
			{
				return new QuintillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuintillionProvider(), number);
			}
			return new ThousandsDigitInfo(GenerateThousandProvider(), number);
		}

		protected void GenerateLastDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			GenerateQuintillionSeparator(digits, GenerateQuintillionProvider(), value);
			if (value > 1)
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(1));
			}
			else
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(0));
			}
		}

		protected void TeensTenthsSingleSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0 && base.IsValueGreaterHundred && IsDigitInfoGreaterThousand(digits.Last))
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(provider, 0L));
			}
			else if (digits.Count != 0)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(provider, 1L));
			}
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GetHundredProvider(INumericsProvider provider)
		{
			return provider;
		}
	}
	public class DescriptiveOrdinalPortugueseNumberConverter : DescriptivePortugueseNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.OrdinalText;

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateSinglesProvider()
		{
			if (base.IsValueGreaterHundred)
			{
				return new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider();
			}
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTeensProvider()
		{
			if (base.IsValueGreaterHundred)
			{
				return new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider();
			}
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTenthsProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateHundredProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateThousandProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateMillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateBillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTrillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuadrillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuintillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuintillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagQuintillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuadrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuadrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagTrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagTrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateBillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagBillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagBillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateMillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagMillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagMillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateThousandDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagThousand = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagThousand = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateHundredSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0 && base.FullHundreds)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider(), 1L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateHundredSeparator(digits, provider);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateHundredDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (base.IsValueGreaterHundred)
			{
				if (digits.Count != 0 && base.FullHundreds)
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider(), 1L));
				}
				else
				{
					base.GenerateHundredSeparator(digits, GenerateHundredProvider());
				}
				long number = (base.OneHundredValue ? 10 : value);
				digits.Add(new HundredsDigitInfo(new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider(), number));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTenthsDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (base.IsValueGreaterHundred)
			{
				GenerateTenthsSeparator(digits, new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider());
				digits.Add(new TenthsDigitInfo(new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider(), value / 10));
				if (value % 10 != 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider(), 1L));
					digits.Add(new SingleNumeralDigitInfo(new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider(), value % 10));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GetHundredProvider(INumericsProvider provider)
		{
			return new OrdinalPortugueseOptionalNumericProvider();
		}

		protected DigitInfo ChooseOrdinalProvider(int number)
		{
			if (base.FlagMillion)
			{
				return new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagBillion)
			{
				return new BillionDigitInfo(GenerateBillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagTrillion)
			{
				return new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuadrillion)
			{
				return new QuadrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuintillion)
			{
				return new QuintillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuintillionProvider(), number);
			}
			return new ThousandsDigitInfo(GenerateThousandProvider(), number);
		}

		protected void GenerateLastDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value == 1)
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseOrdinalProvider(1));
			}
			else if (value % 100 != 1)
			{
				GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				digits.Add(ChooseOrdinalProvider(0));
			}
			else
			{
				long number = ((value / 100 == 1) ? (value % 100) : (value / 100));
				digits.Add(new HundredsDigitInfo(new CardinalPortugueseNumericsProvider(), number));
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalPortugueseNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				digits.Add(ChooseOrdinalProvider(1));
			}
		}
	}
	public class OrdinalPortugueseNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.Ordinal;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			return $"{value}º";
		}
	}
	public abstract class RomanNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal abstract int[] Arabics { get; }

		protected internal abstract string[] Romans { get; }

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (int num = Romans.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				while (value >= Arabics[num])
				{
					value -= Arabics[num];
					text += Romans[num];
				}
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SlavicBase : SomeLanguagesBased
	{
		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuintillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			GenerateQuintillionSeparator(digits, GenerateQuintillionProvider(), value);
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagQuintillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuadrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuadrillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			GenerateQuadrillionSeparator(digits, GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), value);
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagTrillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			GenerateTrillionSeparator(digits, GenerateTrillionProvider(), value);
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagTrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateBillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagBillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			GenerateBillionSeparator(digits, GenerateBillionProvider(), value);
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagBillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateMillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagMillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			GenerateMillionSeparator(digits, GenerateMillionProvider(), value);
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagMillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateThousandDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagThousand = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			GenerateThousandSeparator(digits, GenerateThousandProvider(), value);
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			base.FlagThousand = false;
		}

		protected DigitInfo ChooseCardinalProvider(int number)
		{
			if (base.FlagMillion)
			{
				return new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagBillion)
			{
				return new BillionDigitInfo(GenerateBillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagTrillion)
			{
				return new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuadrillion)
			{
				return new QuadrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuintillion)
			{
				return new QuintillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuintillionProvider(), number);
			}
			return new ThousandsDigitInfo(GenerateThousandProvider(), number);
		}

		protected void GenerateLastDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			long num = value % 100;
			if (num > 9 && num < 21)
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(2));
				return;
			}
			num %= 10;
			if (num == 1)
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(0));
			}
			if (num > 1 && num < 5)
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(1));
			}
			if ((num > 4 && num <= 9) || num == 0L)
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(2));
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SlavicCardinalBase : SlavicBase
	{
		protected internal override void GenerateHundredDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			INumericsProvider provider = GenerateHundredProvider();
			GenerateHundredSeparator(digits, provider);
			digits.Add(new HundredsDigitInfo(provider, value));
		}
	}
	public abstract class SlavicOrdinalBase : SlavicBase
	{
		private delegate bool CheckTypeDelegate(DigitType type);

		protected internal override void GenerateDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.GenerateDigits(digits, value);
			if (base.FlagIntegerThousand)
			{
				GenerateDigitsCore(digits, CheckTypeIntegerThousand);
			}
			else if (base.FlagIntegerMillion)
			{
				GenerateDigitsCore(digits, CheckTypeIntegerMillion);
			}
			else if (base.FlagIntegerBillion)
			{
				GenerateDigitsCore(digits, CheckTypeIntegerBillion);
			}
			else if (base.FlagIntegerTrillion)
			{
				GenerateDigitsCore(digits, CheckTypeIntegerTrillion);
			}
			else if (base.FlagIntegerQuadrillion)
			{
				GenerateDigitsCore(digits, CheckTypeIntegerQuadrillion);
			}
			else if (base.FlagIntegerQuintillion)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i <= digits.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					digits[i].Provider = GetProvider();
				}
			}
			digits.Last.Provider = GetOrdinalSlavicNumericsProvider();
		}

		private void GenerateDigitsCore(DigitInfoCollection digits, CheckTypeDelegate checkType)
		{
			int num = digits.Count - 1;
			for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					digits[num2].Provider = GetProvider();
				}
				else
				{
					DigitType type = digits[num2 - 1].Type;
					if (checkType(type))
					{
						break;
					}
					digits[num2].Provider = GetProvider();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CheckTypeIntegerThousand(DigitType type)
		{
			if (type != DigitType.Million && type != DigitType.Billion && type != DigitType.Trillion && type != DigitType.Quadrillion)
			{
				return type == DigitType.Quintillion;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckTypeIntegerMillion(DigitType type)
		{
			if (type != DigitType.Billion && type != DigitType.Trillion && type != DigitType.Quadrillion)
			{
				return type == DigitType.Quintillion;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckTypeIntegerBillion(DigitType type)
		{
			if (type != DigitType.Trillion && type != DigitType.Quadrillion)
			{
				return type == DigitType.Quintillion;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckTypeIntegerTrillion(DigitType type)
		{
			if (type != DigitType.Quadrillion)
			{
				return type == DigitType.Quintillion;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckTypeIntegerQuadrillion(DigitType type)
		{
			return type == DigitType.Quintillion;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (!base.FlagIntegerQuintillion)
			{
				base.GenerateQuintillionDigits(digits, value);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateIntegerLastDigit(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuadrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (!base.FlagIntegerQuadrillion)
			{
				base.GenerateQuadrillionDigits(digits, value);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateIntegerLastDigit(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (!base.FlagIntegerTrillion)
			{
				base.GenerateTrillionDigits(digits, value);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateIntegerLastDigit(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateBillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (!base.FlagIntegerBillion)
			{
				base.GenerateBillionDigits(digits, value);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateIntegerLastDigit(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateMillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (!base.FlagIntegerMillion)
			{
				base.GenerateMillionDigits(digits, value);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateIntegerLastDigit(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateThousandDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (!base.FlagIntegerThousand)
			{
				base.GenerateThousandDigits(digits, value);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateIntegerLastDigit(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0 || value != 1 || (!base.FlagIntegerThousand && !base.FlagIntegerMillion && !base.FlagIntegerBillion && !base.FlagIntegerTrillion && !base.FlagIntegerQuadrillion && !base.FlagIntegerQuintillion))
			{
				base.GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected void GenerateIntegerLastDigit(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value == 1)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalRussianNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				digits.Add(ChooseOrdinalProvider());
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
				digits.Add(ChooseOrdinalProvider());
			}
		}

		public DigitInfo ChooseOrdinalProvider()
		{
			if (base.FlagIntegerMillion)
			{
				return new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L);
			}
			if (base.FlagIntegerBillion)
			{
				return new BillionDigitInfo(GenerateBillionProvider(), 0L);
			}
			if (base.FlagIntegerTrillion)
			{
				return new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), 0L);
			}
			if (base.FlagIntegerQuadrillion)
			{
				return new QuadrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), 0L);
			}
			if (base.FlagIntegerQuintillion)
			{
				return new QuintillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuintillionProvider(), 0L);
			}
			return new ThousandsDigitInfo(GenerateThousandProvider(), 0L);
		}

		protected internal abstract INumericsProvider GetProvider();

		protected internal abstract INumericsProvider GetOrdinalSlavicNumericsProvider();
	}
	public abstract class SomeLanguagesBased : DescriptiveNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal bool FlagIntegerThousand { get; set; }

		protected internal bool FlagIntegerMillion { get; set; }

		protected internal bool FlagIntegerBillion { get; set; }

		protected internal bool FlagIntegerTrillion { get; set; }

		protected internal bool FlagIntegerQuadrillion { get; set; }

		protected internal bool FlagIntegerQuintillion { get; set; }

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			FlagIntegerThousand = false;
			FlagIntegerMillion = false;
			FlagIntegerBillion = false;
			FlagIntegerTrillion = false;
			FlagIntegerQuadrillion = false;
			FlagIntegerQuintillion = false;
			return base.ConvertNumberCore(value);
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateDigitsInfo(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value / 1000000000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				FlagIntegerQuintillion = value % 1000000000000000000L == 0;
				GenerateQuintillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000000000000L);
			}
			value %= 1000000000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				FlagIntegerQuadrillion = value % 1000000000000000L == 0;
				GenerateQuadrillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000000000L);
			}
			value %= 1000000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				FlagIntegerTrillion = value % 1000000000000L == 0;
				GenerateTrillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000000L);
			}
			value %= 1000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000 != 0L)
			{
				FlagIntegerBillion = value % 1000000000 == 0;
				GenerateBillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000);
				value %= 1000000000;
			}
			if (value / 1000000 != 0L)
			{
				FlagIntegerMillion = value % 1000000 == 0;
				GenerateMillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
			}
			value %= 1000000;
			if (value / 1000 != 0L)
			{
				FlagIntegerThousand = value % 1000 == 0;
				GenerateThousandDigits(digits, value / 1000);
			}
			value %= 1000;
			if (value / 100 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value / 100);
			}
			value %= 100;
			if (value != 0L)
			{
				if (value >= 20)
				{
					GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value);
				}
				else if (value >= 10)
				{
					GenerateTeensDigits(digits, value % 10);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class DescriptiveSpanishNumberConverterBase : DescriptiveNumberConverterBase
	{
		private bool oneHundredValue;

		private bool hundredOneValue;

		protected internal bool OneHundredValue => oneHundredValue;

		protected internal bool HundredOneValue => hundredOneValue;

		protected internal override void GenerateThousandSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider, long value)
		{
			if (value == 1)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(provider, 2L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateThousandSeparator(digits, provider, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateDigitsInfo(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			long num = value % 1000;
			oneHundredValue = num / 100 == 1 && num % 100 == 0;
			hundredOneValue = num / 100 == 1 && num % 100 == 1;
			base.GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
		}
	}
	public class DescriptiveCardinalSpanishNumberConverter : DescriptiveSpanishNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.CardinalText;

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateSinglesProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTeensProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTenthsProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateHundredProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateThousandProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateMillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateBillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuadrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuintillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuintillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigit(digits, value);
			base.FlagQuintillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuadrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuadrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigit(digits, value);
			base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagTrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigit(digits, value);
			base.FlagTrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateBillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagBillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigit(digits, value);
			base.FlagBillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateMillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagMillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigit(digits, value);
			base.FlagMillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateHundredDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value == 1 && base.IsValueGreaterHundred && base.OneHundredValue)
			{
				if (digits.Count != 0)
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				}
				digits.Add(new HundredsDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), 10L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTenthsDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value > 20 && value < 30)
			{
				GenerateTenthsSeparator(digits, GenerateTenthsProvider());
				digits.Add(new TenthsDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider(), value % 10 + 1));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (!base.FlagThousand || value != 1 || digits.Count != 0)
			{
				if (digits.Count != 0 && value == 1 && base.FlagThousand && IsDigitInfoGreaterThousand(digits.Last))
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), 0L));
				}
				else if (digits.Count == 0 && base.IsValueGreaterThousand)
				{
					digits.Add(new SingleNumeralDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), value));
				}
				else
				{
					base.GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void GenerateLastDigit(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.GenerateDigits(digits, value);
			digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L));
			if (value % 100 == 1)
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(0L));
			}
			else
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(1L));
			}
		}

		protected DigitInfo ChooseCardinalProvider(long value)
		{
			if (base.FlagMillion)
			{
				return new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), value);
			}
			if (base.FlagBillion)
			{
				return new BillionDigitInfo(GenerateBillionProvider(), value);
			}
			if (base.FlagTrillion)
			{
				return new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), value);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuadrillion)
			{
				return new QuadrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), value);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuintillion)
			{
				return new QuintillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuintillionProvider(), value);
			}
			return new ThousandsDigitInfo(GenerateThousandProvider(), value);
		}
	}
	public class DescriptiveOrdinalSpanishNumberConverter : DescriptiveSpanishNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.OrdinalText;

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateSinglesProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTeensProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTenthsProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateHundredProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateThousandProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateMillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateBillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTrillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuadrillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuintillionProvider()
		{
			return new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuintillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			digits.Add(new QuintillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuintillionProvider(), 0L));
			base.FlagQuintillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuadrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuadrillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			digits.Add(new QuadrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), 0L));
			base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagTrillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			digits.Add(new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), 0L));
			base.FlagTrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateBillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagBillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			digits.Add(new BillionDigitInfo(GenerateBillionProvider(), 0L));
			base.FlagBillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateMillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagMillion = true;
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			digits.Add(new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L));
			base.FlagMillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateThousandSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider, long value)
		{
			if ((digits.Count != 0 && value < 30) || value > 99)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(provider, 2L));
			}
			else if (value % 10 == 0L && value < 100)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(provider, 0L));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateHundredDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0 && IsDigitInfoGreaterHundred(digits.Last))
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider(), 0L));
			}
			if (base.FlagQuadrillion || base.FlagTrillion || base.FlagBillion || base.FlagMillion || base.FlagThousand)
			{
				if (value == 1)
				{
					int num = ((!base.OneHundredValue) ? 1 : 10);
					digits.Add(new HundredsDigitInfo(new OrdinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider(), num));
				}
				else
				{
					digits.Add(new HundredsDigitInfo(new OrdinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider(), value));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				digits.Add(new HundredsDigitInfo(new OrdinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), value));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTenthsDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0)
			{
				if (base.FlagThousand && IsDigitInfoGreaterThousand(digits.Last))
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				}
				DigitType type = digits.Last.Type;
				if (base.FlagMillion && (type == DigitType.Billion || type == DigitType.Trillion || type == DigitType.Quadrillion || type == DigitType.Quintillion))
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				}
				if (base.FlagBillion && (type == DigitType.Trillion || type == DigitType.Quadrillion || type == DigitType.Quintillion))
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				}
				if (base.FlagTrillion && (type == DigitType.Quadrillion || type == DigitType.Quintillion))
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				}
				if (base.FlagQuadrillion && type == DigitType.Quintillion)
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				}
			}
			if (!base.FlagThousand && !base.FlagMillion && !base.FlagBillion && !base.FlagTrillion && !base.FlagQuadrillion)
			{
				base.GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value);
			}
			else if (value < 30)
			{
				long number = ((value == 20) ? 2 : (value % 10 + 1));
				digits.Add(new TenthsDigitInfo(GetTenthsProvider(value), number));
			}
			else if (base.IsValueGreaterThousand)
			{
				digits.Add(new TenthsDigitInfo(GetTenthsProvider(value), value / 10));
				if (value % 10 != 0L)
				{
					GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value % 10);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				digits.Add(new TenthsDigitInfo(GetTenthsProvider(value), value / 10));
				GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value % 10);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTeensDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (base.IsValueGreaterHundred)
			{
				if (digits.Count != 0)
				{
					GenerateTeensSeparator(digits, GenerateTeensProvider(), value);
				}
				digits.Add(new TeensDigitInfo(new OrdinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider(), value));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateTeensDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTeensSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider, long value)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0 && IsDigitInfoGreaterThousand(digits.Last))
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(GenerateTeensProvider(), 0L));
			}
			else if (digits.Count != 0 && base.IsValueGreaterHundred)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(GenerateTeensProvider(), 2L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateTeensSeparator(digits, provider, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesSeparator(DigitInfoCollection digits, INumericsProvider provider, long value)
		{
			if (base.FlagThousand && digits.Count != 0 && digits.Last.Type == DigitType.Tenth)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider(), 1L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateSinglesSeparator(digits, provider, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0 || value != 1 || !base.IsValueGreaterThousand)
			{
				if (digits.Count == 0 && value > 1 && base.IsValueGreaterThousand)
				{
					digits.Add(new SingleNumeralDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), value));
				}
				else if (digits.Count != 0 && digits.Last.Type == DigitType.Tenth && base.IsValueGreaterThousand)
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider(), 1L));
					digits.Add(new SingleNumeralDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), value));
				}
				else if (digits.Count != 0 && digits.Last.Type == DigitType.Billion && base.IsValueGreaterThousand)
				{
					digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new OrdinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider(), 0L));
					digits.Add(new SingleNumeralDigitInfo(new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider(), value));
				}
				else if (digits.Count != 0 && digits.Last.Type == DigitType.Hundred && base.IsValueGreaterHundred)
				{
					long number = ((value == 1) ? (value * 10) : value);
					digits.Add(new SingleNumeralDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), number));
				}
				else
				{
					base.GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal INumericsProvider GetTenthsProvider(long value)
		{
			if (value > 20 && value < 30)
			{
				return new CardinalSpanishOptionalNumericsProvider();
			}
			return new CardinalSpanishNumericsProvider();
		}
	}
	public class OrdinalSpanishNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.Ordinal;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			return $"{value}°";
		}
	}
	public class CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider : INumericsProvider
	{
		private static string[] separator = new string[3] { "", "", " " };

		private static string[] singlesNumeral = new string[10] { "et", "två", "tre", "fyra", "fem", "sex", "sju", "åtta", "nio", "noll" };

		private static string[] singles = new string[11]
		{
			"ett", "två", "tre", "fyra", "fem", "sex", "sju", "åtta", "nio", "noll",
			"en"
		};

		private static string[] teens = new string[10] { "tio", "elva", "tolv", "tretton", "fjorton", "femton", "sexton", "sjutton", "arton", "nitton" };

		private static string[] tenths = new string[8] { "tjugo", "trettio", "fyrtio", "femtio", "sextio", "sjuttio", "åttio", "nittio" };

		private static string[] hundreds = new string[9] { "etthundra", "tvåhundra", "trehundra", "fyrahundra", "femhundra", "sexhundra", "sjuhundra", "åttahundra", "niohundra" };

		private static string[] thousands = new string[2] { "tusen", "tusen" };

		private static string[] million = new string[2] { "miljon", "miljoner" };

		private static string[] billion = new string[2] { "miljard", "miljarder" };

		private static string[] trillion = new string[2] { "biljon", "biljoner" };

		private static string[] quadrillion = new string[2] { "biljard", "biljarder" };

	public abstract class DescriptiveSwedishNumberConverterBase : SomeLanguagesBased
	{
		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateSinglesProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTeensProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTenthsProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateHundredProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateThousandProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateMillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateBillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuadrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuintillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuintillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerQuintillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagQuintillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuadrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuadrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerQuadrillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagTrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerTrillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagTrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateBillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagBillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerBillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagBillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateMillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagMillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerMillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagMillion = false;
		}

		protected DigitInfo ChooseCardinalProvider(int number)
		{
			if (base.FlagMillion)
			{
				return new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagBillion)
			{
				return new BillionDigitInfo(GenerateBillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagTrillion)
			{
				return new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuadrillion)
			{
				return new QuadrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuintillion)
			{
				return new QuintillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuintillionProvider(), number);
			}
			return new ThousandsDigitInfo(GenerateThousandProvider(), number);
		}

		protected void GenerateLastDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			if (Type == NumberingFormat.OrdinalText && value == 1)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider(), 0L));
			}
			else
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalSwedishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			if (value % 1000000 > 1)
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(1));
			}
			else
			{
				digits.Add(ChooseCardinalProvider(0));
			}
		}
	}
	public class DescriptiveCardinalSwedishNumberConverter : DescriptiveSwedishNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.CardinalText;

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if ((base.FlagMillion || base.FlagBillion || base.FlagTrillion || base.FlagQuadrillion || base.FlagQuintillion) && digits.Count == 0)
			{
				long number = ((value == 1) ? 11 : value);
				digits.Add(new SingleDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), number));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class DescriptiveOrdinalSwedishNumberConverter : DescriptiveSwedishNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.OrdinalText;

		protected internal override void GenerateDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.GenerateDigits(digits, value);
			digits.Last.Provider = new OrdinalSwedishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if ((!base.FlagMillion && !base.FlagBillion && !base.FlagTrillion && !base.FlagQuadrillion && !base.FlagQuintillion) || digits.Count != 0 || value != 1)
			{
				base.GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class OrdinalSwedishNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.Ordinal;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			if (value % 10 == 1 || value % 10 == 2)
			{
				return $"{value}:a";
			}
			return $"{value}:e";
		}
	}

	public class DescriptiveOrdinalThaiNumberConverter : DescriptiveThaiNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.OrdinalText;

		protected internal override string ConvertDigitsToString(DigitInfoCollection digits)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int count = digits.Count;
			stringBuilder.Append("ท\u0e35\u0e48");
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(digits[i].ConvertToString());
			}
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder[0] = char.ToUpper(stringBuilder[0]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public abstract class DescriptiveThaiNumberConverterBase : DescriptiveNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal const long maxThaiValue = 10000000000000000L;

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateSinglesProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTeensProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTenthsProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateHundredProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateThousandProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateMillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateBillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuadrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuintillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalThaiNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateDigitsInfo(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value / 1000000000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				GenerateQuintillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
			}
			value %= 1000000000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				GenerateQuadrillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
			}
			value %= 1000000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000000L != 0L)
			{
				GenerateTrillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
			}
			value %= 1000000000000L;
			if (value / 1000000000 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateBillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
			}
			value %= 1000000000;
			if (value / 1000000 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateMillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
			}
			value %= 1000000;
			if (value / 1000 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateThousandDigits(digits, value / 1000);
			}
			value %= 1000;
			if (value / 100 != 0L)
			{
				GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value / 100);
			}
			value %= 100;
			if (value != 0L)
			{
				if (value >= 20)
				{
					GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value);
				}
				else if (value >= 10)
				{
					GenerateTeensDigits(digits, value % 10);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value % 1000000000000L == 0L)
			{
				base.GenerateQuintillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000000L);
				return;
			}
			GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value / 1000000000000L);
			if (value / 1000000 % 1000 != 0L || value / 1000000000 % 1000 != 0L)
			{
				digits.Add(new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L));
			}
			else if (value % 1000000 != 0L)
			{
				digits.Add(new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), 0L));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuadrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuadrillion = true;
			if (value >= 100000000000L)
			{
				GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value / 100000000000L);
				if (value % 100000000000L == 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), 0L));
				}
				value %= 100000000000L;
			}
			if (value >= 10000000000L && value < 100000000000L)
			{
				GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value / 1000000000);
				if (value % 10000000000L == 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), 0L));
				}
				else if (value % 1000000000 == 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new QuadrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), 0L));
				}
				else if (value / 1000000000 % 10 == 0L)
				{
					if (value / 1000000 % 1000 != 0L)
					{
						base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
						return;
					}
					digits.Add(new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L));
				}
				else if (value / 1000 % 1000000 == 0L || value / 1000000 % 1000 == 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new BillionDigitInfo(GenerateBillionProvider(), 0L));
				}
				else
				{
					digits.Add(new ThousandsDigitInfo(new CardinalThaiOptionalNumericsProvider(), 2L));
				}
			}
			if (value >= 1000000000 && value < 10000000000L)
			{
				if (value % 1000000000 == 0L)
				{
					base.GenerateQuadrillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000000);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value / 1000000000);
					digits.Add(new ThousandsDigitInfo(new CardinalThaiOptionalNumericsProvider(), 2L));
					if (value % 1000000000 != 0L && value % 1000000000 / 1000000 == 0L)
					{
						digits.Add(new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L));
					}
				}
			}
			base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagTrillion = true;
			if (value % 1000000 == 0L)
			{
				base.GenerateTrillionDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
			}
			else
			{
				if (value >= 100000000)
				{
					GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value / 100000000);
					value %= 100000000;
				}
				if (value > 20000000 && value < 100000000)
				{
					GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
				}
				if (value >= 10000000 && value < 20000000)
				{
					digits.Add(new TeensDigitInfo(GenerateTeensProvider(), value % 10000000 / 1000000));
				}
				if (value < 10000000)
				{
					GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value / 1000000);
				}
				digits.Add(new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L));
			}
			base.FlagTrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateBillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagBillion = true;
			if (value >= 100000)
			{
				GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value / 100000);
				if (value % 100000 == 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L));
				}
				value %= 100000;
			}
			if (value >= 10000 && value < 100000)
			{
				GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value / 1000);
				if (value / 1000 % 10 != 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new ThousandsDigitInfo(new CardinalThaiOptionalNumericsProvider(), 2L));
				}
				if (value % 1000 == 0L || value % 10000 == 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), 0L));
				}
			}
			if (value >= 1000 && value < 10000)
			{
				if (value % 1000 == 0L)
				{
					base.GenerateBillionDigits(digits, value / 1000);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value / 1000);
					digits.Add(new ThousandsDigitInfo(new CardinalThaiOptionalNumericsProvider(), 2L));
				}
			}
			base.FlagBillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateThousandDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagThousand = true;
			if (value >= 100 && value % 10 == 0L)
			{
				GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value / 100);
				if (value % 100 != 0L)
				{
					GenerateThousandDigits(digits, value % 100);
				}
			}
			else if (value < 100 && value % 10 == 0L)
			{
				GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value % 100);
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateThousandDigits(digits, value);
			}
			base.FlagThousand = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateHundredDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (base.FlagThousand || base.FlagBillion || base.FlagQuadrillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SingleDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), value));
				digits.Add(new ThousandsDigitInfo(new CardinalThaiOptionalNumericsProvider(), 1L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateHundredDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTenthsDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (base.FlagThousand || base.FlagBillion || base.FlagQuadrillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SingleDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), value / 10));
				digits.Add(new ThousandsDigitInfo(new CardinalThaiOptionalNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				if (value % 10 != 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new SingleDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), value % 10));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateTenthsDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTeensDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (base.FlagThousand || base.FlagBillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SingleDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), 1L));
				digits.Add(new ThousandsDigitInfo(new CardinalThaiOptionalNumericsProvider(), 0L));
				if (value % 10 != 0L)
				{
					digits.Add(new SingleDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), value % 10));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateTeensDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (digits.Count != 0 && value == 1 && !base.FlagThousand)
			{
				digits.Add(new SingleDigitInfo(GenerateSinglesProvider(), 11L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider : INumericsProvider
	{
		private static string[] separator = new string[3] { "", "", " " };

		private static string[] generalSingles = new string[10] { "bir", "iki", "üç", "dört", "beş", "altı", "yedi", "sekiz", "dokuz", "sıfır" };

	public abstract class DescriptiveTurkishNumberConverterBase : SomeLanguagesBased
	{
		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateSinglesProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTeensProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTenthsProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateHundredProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateThousandProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateMillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateBillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateTrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuadrillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override INumericsProvider GenerateQuintillionProvider()
		{
			return new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuintillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuintillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerQuintillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagQuintillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateQuadrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagQuadrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerQuadrillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagQuadrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateTrillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagTrillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerTrillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagTrillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateBillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagBillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerBillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagBillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateMillionDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.FlagMillion = true;
			GenerateLastDigits(digits, value);
			if (!base.FlagIntegerMillion)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			base.FlagMillion = false;
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateThousandDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if (value == 1)
			{
				GenerateThousandSeparator(digits, GenerateThousandProvider(), value);
				digits.Add(new ThousandsDigitInfo(GenerateThousandProvider(), 0L));
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateThousandDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}

		protected DigitInfo GetCardinalProvider(int number)
		{
			if (base.FlagMillion)
			{
				return new MillionDigitInfo(GenerateMillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagBillion)
			{
				return new BillionDigitInfo(GenerateBillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagTrillion)
			{
				return new TrillionDigitInfo(GenerateTrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuadrillion)
			{
				return new QuadrillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuadrillionProvider(), number);
			}
			if (base.FlagQuintillion)
			{
				return new QuintillionDigitInfo(GenerateQuintillionProvider(), number);
			}
			return new ThousandsDigitInfo(GenerateThousandProvider(), number);
		}

		protected void GenerateLastDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			GenerateDigitsInfo(digits, value);
			if (Type == NumberingFormat.OrdinalText && value == 1)
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider(), 0L));
			}
			else
			{
				digits.Add(new SeparatorDigitInfo(new CardinalTurkishNumericsProvider(), 2L));
			}
			if (value % 1000000 > 1)
			{
				digits.Add(GetCardinalProvider(1));
			}
			else
			{
				digits.Add(GetCardinalProvider(0));
			}
		}
	}
	public class DescriptiveCardinalTurkishNumberConverter : DescriptiveTurkishNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.CardinalText;
	}
	public class DescriptiveOrdinalTurkishNumberConverter : DescriptiveTurkishNumberConverterBase
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.OrdinalText;

		protected internal override void GenerateDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			base.GenerateDigits(digits, value);
			digits.Last.Provider = new OrdinalTurkishNumericsProvider();
		}

		protected internal override void GenerateSinglesDigits(DigitInfoCollection digits, long value)
		{
			if ((!base.FlagMillion && !base.FlagBillion && !base.FlagTrillion && !base.FlagQuadrillion && !base.FlagQuintillion) || digits.Count != 0 || value != 1)
			{
				base.GenerateSinglesDigits(digits, value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class OrdinalTurkishNumberConverter : OrdinalBasedNumberConverter
	{
		protected internal override NumberingFormat Type => NumberingFormat.Ordinal;

		public override string ConvertNumberCore(long value)
		{
			return $"{value}.";
		}
	}

		public static XtraLocalizer<OfficeStringId> CreateDefaultLocalizer()
		{
			return (XtraLocalizer<OfficeStringId>)(object)new OfficeResLocalizer();
		}

		public static string GetString(OfficeStringId id)
		{
			return XtraLocalizer<OfficeStringId>.Active.GetLocalizedString(id);
		}

		public override XtraLocalizer<OfficeStringId> CreateResXLocalizer()
		{
			return (XtraLocalizer<OfficeStringId>)(object)new OfficeResLocalizer();
		}
	}
	public class OfficeResLocalizer : XtraResXLocalizer<OfficeStringId>
	{
		public OfficeResLocalizer()
			: base((XtraLocalizer<OfficeStringId>)new OfficeLocalizer())
		{
		}

		protected override ResourceManager CreateResourceManagerCore()
		{
			return XtraLocalizer.CreateResourceManager<OfficeStringId>((XtraResXLocalizer<OfficeStringId>)this, "DevExpress.Office.LocalizationRes", typeof(OfficeResLocalizer));
		}
	}

	}

namespace DevExpress.Office.Services
{
	public class OfficeCharts
	{
		private static OfficeCharts instance;

		public static OfficeCharts Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					instance = new OfficeCharts();
				}
				return instance;
			}
		}
	}
	public class CrossPlatformShapeRenderDependencies : IPlatformShapeRenderDependencies
	{
		private IPlatformImageFactoryService imageFactory;

		private IPlatformShapeRenderService shapeRender;

		private IPlatformPathService path;

		private IPlatformPaintService paint;

		public IPlatformImageFactoryService ImageFactory
		{
			get
			{
				if (imageFactory == null)
				{
					imageFactory = new CrossPlatformImageFactoryService();
				}
				return imageFactory;
			}
		}

		public IPlatformShapeRenderService ShapeRender
		{
			get
			{
				if (shapeRender == null)
				{
					shapeRender = new CrossPlatformShapeRenderService();
				}
				return shapeRender;
			}
		}

		public IPlatformPathService Path
		{
			get
			{
				if (path == null)
				{
					path = new GdiPlusPathService();
				}
				return path;
			}
		}

		public IPlatformPaintService Paint
		{
			get
			{
				if (paint == null)
				{
					paint = new GdiPlusPaintService();
				}
				return paint;
			}
		}

		public IPlatformTextRenderService TextRender => null;
	}
	public class GdiPlusPaintService : IPlatformPaintService
	{
		public IPlatformStroke GetPenInfo(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths)
		{
			return ShapeRenderHelper.GetPenInfo(shapeProperties.Outline, shapeStyle, graphicsPaths, shapeProperties.ShapeType, shapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode);
		}

		public IPlatformStroke GetPenInfo(Outline outline, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, ShapePreset shapeType)
		{
			return ShapeRenderHelper.GetPenInfo(outline, shapeStyle, graphicsPaths, shapeType, blackAndWhitePrintMode: false);
		}

		public IPlatformFill GetBrush(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, DXMatrix shapeTransform, float scaleFactor)
		{
			return ShapeRenderHelper.GetBrush(shapeProperties, shapeStyle, graphicsPaths, shapeTransform, scaleFactor);
		}
	}
	public class GdiPlusPathService : IPlatformPathService
	{
		private static DXFillMode ToGraphicsFillMode(CrossPlatformFillMode fillMode)
		{
			return fillMode switch
			{
				CrossPlatformFillMode.Winding => DXFillMode.Winding, 
				_ => DXFillMode.Alternate, 
			};
		}

		public IPlatformPath CreatePath(CrossPlatformFillMode fillMode)
		{
			return new GdiPlusPath(ToGraphicsFillMode(fillMode));
		}

		public PathInfo CalculatePathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, ModelShapePath path, IPlatformFill defaultBrush, bool hasPermanentFill, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode, float scaleFactor = 1f)
		{
			BrushInfo brushInfo = defaultBrush as BrushInfo;
			try
			{
				DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(Color.White);
				BrushInfo brushInfo2 = null;
				if (!blackAndWhitePrintMode)
				{
					brush = ShapeRenderHelper.GetPathFillBrush(path.FillMode, brushInfo?.Brush);
				}
				brushInfo2 = new BrushInfo(brush);
				return new PathInfo(graphicsPath, brushInfo2, path.Stroke, hasPermanentFill);
			}
			catch
			{
				return new PathInfo(new GdiPlusPath(), null, stroke: false);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CrossPlatformShapeRenderService : IPlatformShapeRenderService
	{
		private DXImage placeHolderImage;

		private static object syncPlaceHolderImage = new object();

		private DXImage PlaceHolderImage
		{
			get
			{
				if (placeHolderImage == null)
				{
					placeHolderImage = CreatePlaceHolderImage();
				}
				return placeHolderImage;
			}
		}

		private static DXImage CreatePlaceHolderImage()
		{
			lock (syncPlaceHolderImage)
			{
				Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(UriBasedOfficeImageBase).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("DevExpress.Office.Images.ImagePlaceHolder.png");
				return DXImage.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
			}
		}

		private DXImage CreateMetafile(Size size)
		{
			return new DXMetafile(size, DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel, DXEmfType.EmfPlusOnly);
		}

		public DXImage DrawShapePaths(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo, Size resultImageSize, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter, bool shoulScale = false)
		{
			DXImage dXImage = CreateMetafile(resultImageSize);
			DXMetafile dXMetafile = dXImage as DXMetafile;
			DXMatrix shapeTransform = shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform.Clone();
			try
			{
				using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = CreateGraphics(dXImage, layoutUnitConverter);
				if (shoulScale && dXMetafile != null)
				{
					DXMetafileHeader header = dXMetafile.Header;
					float num = header.DpiX / iDXGraphics.DpiX;
					float num2 = header.DpiY / iDXGraphics.DpiY;
					shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform.Scale(1f / num, 1f / num2);
					iDXGraphics.ScaleTransform(num, num2);
				}
				Rectangle bounds = shapeLayoutInfo.GetBounds();
				iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-bounds.Left, -bounds.Top);
				DrawPaths(shapeLayoutInfo, iDXGraphics);
			}
			finally
			{
				shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform = shapeTransform;
			}
			if (shoulScale && dXMetafile != null)
			{
				return DXImageHelper.PatchMetafileResolution(dXMetafile, 96);
			}
			return dXImage;
		}

		public DXImage DrawShapeImage(DXImage image, Size resultImageSize, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			return DrawShapeImage(image, resultImageSize, Point.Empty, layoutUnitConverter);
		}

		public DXImage DrawShapeImage(DXImage image, Size resultImageSize, Point location, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXImage dXImage = CreateMetafile(resultImageSize);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = CreateGraphics(dXImage, layoutUnitConverter);
			iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, location.X, location.Y);
			return dXImage;
		}

		public DXImage DrawGroupShape(GroupShapeLayoutInfo groupShapeLayoutInfo, Size resultImageSize, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			DXImage dXImage = CreateMetafile(resultImageSize);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = CreateGraphics(dXImage, layoutUnitConverter);
			Rectangle bounds = groupShapeLayoutInfo.GetBounds();
			iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-bounds.Left, -bounds.Top);
			DrawGroupShape(groupShapeLayoutInfo, iDXGraphics);
			return dXImage;
		}

		private void DrawGroupShape(GroupShapeLayoutInfo groupShapeLayoutInfo, IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			DXSmoothingMode smoothingMode = graphics.SmoothingMode;
			graphics.SmoothingMode = DXSmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
			try
			{
				groupShapeLayoutInfo.Draw(graphics);
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingMode;
			}
		}

		private void DrawPaths(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo, IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			foreach (PathInfoBase path in shapeLayoutInfo.Paths)
			{
				if (!path.SkipDrawing)
				{
					path.Draw(graphics, shapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo, shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform);
				}
			}
		}

		private static IDXGraphics CreateGraphics(DXImage image, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(image, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale);
			iDXGraphics.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.Half;
			return iDXGraphics;
		}

		public DXImage DrawPlaceHolder(int width, int height)
		{
			lock (syncPlaceHolderImage)
			{
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(width, height);
				using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = CreateGraphics(dXBitmap, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter.Create(DocumentLayoutUnit.Pixel, 96f)))
				{
					iDXGraphics.DrawImage(PlaceHolderImage, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, PlaceHolderImage.Size));
					iDXGraphics.DrawRectangle(DXPens.Black, new Rectangle(0, 0, dXBitmap.Width - 1, dXBitmap.Height - 1));
				}
				return dXBitmap;
			}
		}
	}
	public class GdiPlusImageFactoryService : IPlatformImageFactoryService
	{
		public DXImage CreateImage(Stream stream)
		{
			return DXImage.FromStream(stream);
		}

		public DXImage CreateImage(int width, int height, bool tryCreateMetafile = true)
		{
			if (tryCreateMetafile)
			{
				return CreateMetafile(width, height);
			}
			return GdiPlusBitmap.Wrap(new Bitmap(width, height));
		}

		private static DXMetafile CreateMetafile(int width, int height)
		{
			return new DXMetafile(new Size(width, height), DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel, DXEmfType.EmfPlusOnly);
		}

		public OfficeNativeImage CreateImage(MemoryStreamBasedImage streamBasedImage)
		{
			if (!(streamBasedImage.Image.Implementation is GdiPlusImage gdiPlusImage))
			{
				return new OfficeDXImage(streamBasedImage.Image, streamBasedImage.ImageStream, streamBasedImage.Id);
			}
			Image image = gdiPlusImage.Unwrap(cloneImage: false);
			if (image.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Wmf))
			{
				if ((AzureCompatibility.Enable || !PlatformHelpers.IsWindows) && streamBasedImage.ImageStream != null)
				{
					return new OfficeWmfImageWinAzure((Metafile)image, ImageLoaderHelper.GetMemoryStream(streamBasedImage.ImageStream, -1, seekToBegin: true), streamBasedImage.Id);
				}
				return new OfficeWmfImageWin((Metafile)image, streamBasedImage.Id);
			}
			if (image.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Emf))
			{
				if ((AzureCompatibility.Enable || !PlatformHelpers.IsWindows) && streamBasedImage.ImageStream != null)
				{
					return new OfficeEmfImageWinAzure((Metafile)image, ImageLoaderHelper.GetMemoryStream(streamBasedImage.ImageStream, -1, seekToBegin: true), streamBasedImage.Id);
				}
				return new OfficeEmfImageWin((Metafile)image, streamBasedImage.Id);
			}
			return new OfficeImageWin(image, streamBasedImage.Image, streamBasedImage.ImageStream, streamBasedImage.Id);
		}
	}
	public class CrossPlatformImageFactoryService : IPlatformImageFactoryService
	{
		public DXImage CreateImage(Stream stream)
		{
			return DXImage.FromStream(stream);
		}

		public DXImage CreateImage(int width, int height, bool tryCreateMetafile = true)
		{
			if (tryCreateMetafile)
			{
				return CreateMetafile(width, height);
			}
			return CreateBitMap(width, height);
		}

		private static DXMetafile CreateMetafile(int width, int height)
		{
			return new DXMetafile(new Size(width, height), DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel, DXEmfType.EmfPlusOnly);
		}

		private DXImage CreateBitMap(int width, int height)
		{
			return new DXBitmap(width, height);
		}

		public OfficeNativeImage CreateImage(MemoryStreamBasedImage streamBasedImage)
		{
			if (streamBasedImage.Image.Implementation is GdiPlusImage gdiPlusImage)
			{
				return CreateGdiPlusImage(streamBasedImage.Image, gdiPlusImage, streamBasedImage);
			}
			return CreateDXImage(streamBasedImage.Image, streamBasedImage);
		}

		private OfficeNativeImage CreateGdiPlusImage(DXImage dxImage, GdiPlusImage gdiPlusImage, MemoryStreamBasedImage streamBasedImage)
		{
			Image image = gdiPlusImage.Unwrap(cloneImage: false);
			if (image.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Wmf))
			{
				if ((AzureCompatibility.Enable || !PlatformHelpers.IsWindows) && streamBasedImage.ImageStream != null)
				{
					return new OfficeWmfImageWinAzure((Metafile)image, ImageLoaderHelper.GetMemoryStream(streamBasedImage.ImageStream, -1, seekToBegin: true), streamBasedImage.Id);
				}
				return new OfficeWmfImageWin((Metafile)image, streamBasedImage.Id);
			}
			if (image.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Emf))
			{
				if ((AzureCompatibility.Enable || !PlatformHelpers.IsWindows) && streamBasedImage.ImageStream != null)
				{
					return new OfficeEmfImageWinAzure((Metafile)image, ImageLoaderHelper.GetMemoryStream(streamBasedImage.ImageStream, -1, seekToBegin: true), streamBasedImage.Id);
				}
				return new OfficeEmfImageWin((Metafile)image, streamBasedImage.Id);
			}
			return new OfficeImageWin(image, dxImage, streamBasedImage.ImageStream, streamBasedImage.Id);
		}

		private OfficeNativeImage CreateDXImage(DXImage dxImage, MemoryStreamBasedImage streamBasedImage)
		{
			return new OfficeDXImage(dxImage, streamBasedImage.ImageStream, streamBasedImage.Id);
		}
	}

	public class FontCharsetService : IFontCharacterSetService, IDisposable
	{
		private FontCache cache;

		private FontCharacterSet characterSet;

		public void BeginProcessing(string fontName)
		{
			cache = new WindowsPlatformFontCache(FontCacheType.GdiPlus, new DocumentLayoutUnitDocumentConverter(), allowCjkCorrection: false, useSystemFontQuality: true);
			characterSet = cache.GetFontCharacterSet(new FontDescription(fontName, bold: false, italic: false));
		}

		public bool ContainsChar(char ch)
		{
			if (characterSet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return characterSet.ContainsChar(ch);
		}

		public void EndProcessing()
		{
			ClearCache();
		}

		private void ClearCache()
		{
			if (cache != null)
			{
				cache.Dispose();
				cache = null;
			}
			characterSet = null;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				ClearCache();
			}
		}
	}
