	public class OfficeThreadPoolService : IThreadPoolService, IDisposable
	{
		private OfficeThreadPool threadPool;

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && threadPool != null)
			{
				threadPool.Dispose();
				threadPool = null;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		public void QueueJob(WaitCallback job)
		{
			if (threadPool == null)
			{
				threadPool = new OfficeThreadPool();
			}
			threadPool.QueueJob(job);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			if (threadPool != null)
			{
				threadPool.Reset();
			}
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class UriProviderCollection : List<IUriProvider>
	{
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class UriProviderService : IUriProviderService
	{
		private readonly UriProviderCollection providers;

		public UriProviderCollection Providers => providers;

		public UriProviderService(bool registerDefaultProviders = true)
		{
			providers = new UriProviderCollection();
			if (registerDefaultProviders)
			{
				RegisterDefaultProviders();
			}
		}

		public string CreateImageUri(string rootUri, OfficeImage image, string relativeUri)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int count = Providers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				string text = Providers[i].CreateImageUri(rootUri, image, relativeUri);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public string CreateCssUri(string rootUri, string styleText, string relativeUri)
		{
			int count = Providers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				string text = Providers[i].CreateCssUri(rootUri, styleText, relativeUri);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public void RegisterProvider(IUriProvider provider)
		{
			if (provider != null)
			{
				Providers.Insert(0, provider);
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterProvider(IUriProvider provider)
		{
			if (provider != null)
			{
				int num = Providers.IndexOf(provider);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					Providers.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RegisterDefaultProviders()
		{
			RegisterProvider(new FileBasedUriProvider());
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class EmptyUriProvider : IUriProvider
	{
		private int counter;

		public string CreateImageUri(string rootUri, OfficeImage image, string relativeUri)
		{
			counter++;
			return $"img{counter}.img";
		}

		public string CreateCssUri(string rootUri, string styleText, string relativeUri)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(styleText))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			counter++;
			return $"css{counter}.css";
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class DataStringUriProvider : IUriProvider
	{
		private class ImageBytes
		{
			private readonly byte[] bytes;

			private readonly OfficeImageFormat format;

			public byte[] Bytes => bytes;

			public OfficeImageFormat Format => format;

			public ImageBytes(byte[] bytes, OfficeImageFormat format)
			{
				this.bytes = bytes;
				this.format = format;
			}
		}

		public string CreateImageUri(string rootUri, OfficeImage image, string relativeUri)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			try
			{
				ImageBytes imageBytes = GetImageBytes(image);
				string contentType = OfficeImage.GetContentType(imageBytes.Format);
				return $"data:{contentType};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(imageBytes.Bytes)}";
			}
			catch
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private ImageBytes GetImageBytes(OfficeImage image)
		{
			try
			{
				return GetImageBytesCore(image, image.RawFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
				return GetImageBytesCore(image, OfficeImageFormat.Png);
			}
		}

		private ImageBytes GetImageBytesCore(OfficeImage image, OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			byte[] imageBytesSafe = image.GetImageBytesSafe(imageFormat);
			if (imageFormat == OfficeImageFormat.MemoryBmp)
			{
				return new ImageBytes(imageBytesSafe, OfficeImageFormat.Png);
			}
			return new ImageBytes(imageBytesSafe, imageFormat);
		}

		public string CreateCssUri(string rootUri, string styleText, string relativeUri)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class FileBasedUriProvider : IUriProvider
	{
		private const string fileUriPrefix = "file:///";

		private string lastPath;

		private string lastName;

		private string lastExtension;

		private int lastFileIndex;

		public virtual string CreateImageUri(string rootUri, OfficeImage image, string relativeUri)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			rootUri = Path.GetDirectoryName(rootUri);
			if (!EnsureDirectoryExists(rootUri))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = CreateNextFileName(rootUri, "image", GetImageFileExtension(image));
			if (TryToSaveImageInNativeFormat(image.DXImage, text))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(relativeUri))
				{
					return GetRelativeFileName(rootUri, relativeUri, text);
				}
				return "file:///" + text;
			}
			text = CreateNextFileName(rootUri, "image", "png");
			if (TryToSaveImageAsPng(image.DXImage, text))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(relativeUri))
				{
					return GetRelativeFileName(rootUri, relativeUri, text);
				}
				return "file:///" + text;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected internal string GetRelativeFileName(string rootUri, string relativeUri, string fileName)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(fileName);
			try
			{
				if (rootUri.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Remove(0, rootUri.Length + 1);
				}
				stringBuilder.Insert(0, relativeUri);
			}
			catch
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("invalid relativeUri", relativeUri);
				return "file:///" + fileName;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public string CreateCssUri(string rootUri, string styleText, string relativeUri)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(styleText))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			rootUri = Path.GetDirectoryName(rootUri);
			if (!EnsureDirectoryExists(rootUri))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = CreateNextFileName(rootUri, "style", "css");
			SaveCssProperties(text, styleText);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(relativeUri))
			{
				return GetRelativeFileName(rootUri, relativeUri, text);
			}
			return "file:///" + text;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool TryToSaveImageInNativeFormat(DXImage image, string fileName)
		{
			try
			{
				image.Save(fileName, image.ImageFormat);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool TryToSaveImageAsPng(DXImage image, string fileName)
		{
			try
			{
				if (image.Implementation is GdiPlusImage gdiPlusImage)
				{
					ImageCodecInfo imageCodecInfo = OfficeImageWin.GetImageCodecInfo(ImageFormat.Png);
					gdiPlusImage.Unwrap(cloneImage: false).Save(fileName, imageCodecInfo, null);
				}
				else
				{
					image.Save(fileName, DXImageFormat.Png);
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal void SaveCssProperties(string fileName, string styleText)
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.Read);
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream, Encoding.ASCII);
			streamWriter.Write(styleText);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool EnsureDirectoryExists(string path)
		{
			if (!Directory.Exists(path))
			{
				Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
			}
			return Directory.Exists(path);
		}

		protected internal virtual string CreateNextFileName(string path, string name, string extension)
		{
			int num = GetInitialFileIndex(path, name, extension);
			string path2;
			while (true)
			{
				path2 = $"{name}{num}.{extension}";
				path2 = Path.Combine(path, path2);
				if (!File.Exists(path2))
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			lastFileIndex = num;
			return path2;
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetInitialFileIndex(string path, string name, string extension)
		{
			path = Path.GetFullPath(path);
			if (string.Compare(path, lastPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0 && string.Compare(name, lastName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0 && string.Compare(extension, lastExtension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return lastFileIndex + 1;
			}
			lastPath = path;
			lastName = name;
			lastExtension = extension;
			lastFileIndex = 0;
			return lastFileIndex;
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetImageFileExtension(OfficeImage image)
		{
			string extension = OfficeImage.GetExtension(image.RawFormat);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(extension))
			{
				return extension;
			}
			if (image.RawFormat == OfficeImageFormat.MemoryBmp)
			{
				return "png";
			}
			return "img";
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class UriStreamProviderCollection : List<IUriStreamProvider>
	{
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class UriStreamService : IUriStreamService
	{
		private UriStreamProviderCollection providers;

		public UriStreamProviderCollection Providers => providers;

		public UriStreamService()
		{
			providers = new UriStreamProviderCollection();
			RegisterDefaultProviders();
		}

		public Stream GetStream(string uri)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = Providers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				try
				{
					Stream stream = Providers[i].GetStream(uri);
					if (stream != null)
					{
						return stream;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void RegisterProvider(IUriStreamProvider provider)
		{
			if (provider != null)
			{
				Providers.Insert(0, provider);
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterProvider(IUriStreamProvider provider)
		{
			if (provider != null)
			{
				int num = Providers.IndexOf(provider);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					Providers.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RegisterDefaultProviders()
		{
			RegisterProvider(new WebUriStreamProvider());
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class WebUriStreamProvider : IUriStreamProvider
	{
		private sealed class Result
		{
			public readonly Stream Stream;

			public Result(Uri fileUri)
			{
				Stream = new MemoryStream();
				using (Stream stream = File.OpenRead(fileUri.LocalPath))
				{
					stream.CopyTo(Stream);
				}
				Stream.Position = 0L;
			}

			public Result(ExceptionDispatchInfo exception, Stream stream)
			{
				Stream = stream;
			}
		}

		public Stream GetStream(string uri)
		{
			string text = UrlResolverExtensions.MapPath(UrlResolver.Instance, uri, "");
			Uri uri2 = new Uri(text);
			Task<Result> task = (uri2.IsFile ? LoadLocalFile(text) : LoadExternalResource(text));
			return task.GetAwaiter().GetResult().Stream;
		}

		private static Task<Result> LoadLocalFile(string localPathOrUriString)
		{
			FileLoadOptions<Result> val = new FileLoadOptions<Result>((Func<Uri, Result>)((Uri fileUri) => new Result(fileUri)));
			return AsyncDownloader<Result>.LoadAsync(localPathOrUriString, (Func<ExceptionDispatchInfo, Stream, Result>)((ExceptionDispatchInfo e, Stream stream) => new Result(e, stream)), CancellationToken.None, val, AccessSettings.StaticResources);
		}

		private static Task<Result> LoadExternalResource(string localPathOrUriString)
		{
			SendMethodOptions<Result> val = new SendMethodOptions<Result>(HttpMethod.Get, (Action<HttpRequestMessage>)delegate(HttpRequestMessage method)
			{
				SetupHeaders(method);
			}, (Predicate<HttpResponseMessage>)((HttpResponseMessage responce) => true), (LifeTime<Result>)null, AccessSettings.StaticResources);
			return AsyncDownloader<Result>.LoadAsync(localPathOrUriString, (Func<ExceptionDispatchInfo, Stream, Result>)((ExceptionDispatchInfo e, Stream stream) => new Result(e, stream)), CancellationToken.None, val);
		}

		private static void SetupHeaders(HttpRequestMessage requestMessage)
		{
			requestMessage.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Accept", "image/*,*/*");
			requestMessage.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Accept-Encoding", "gzip, deflate");
		}
	}
	[ComVisible(true)]
	public class DataStringUriStreamProvider : IUriStreamProvider
	{
		public bool IsUriSupported(string uri)
		{
			if (StringExtensions.StartsWithInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(uri, "data:"))
			{
				Match match = DataStringUriPattern.regex.Match(uri);
				if (match.Success)
				{
					if (AreEqual(match.Groups["capacity"].Value, "base64"))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					match = DataStringUriPattern.applicationDataStringRegex.Match(uri);
					if (AreEqual(match.Groups["mediaType"].Value, "octet-stream") && AreEqual(match.Groups["capacity"].Value, "base64"))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Stream GetStream(string uri)
		{
			if (StringExtensions.StartsWithInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(uri, "data:"))
			{
				Match match = DataStringUriPattern.regex.Match(uri);
				if (match.Success)
				{
					if (AreEqual(match.Groups["capacity"].Value, "base64"))
					{
						return ConvertToStream(match.Groups["image"].Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					match = DataStringUriPattern.applicationDataStringRegex.Match(uri);
					if (AreEqual(match.Groups["mediaType"].Value, "octet-stream") && AreEqual(match.Groups["capacity"].Value, "base64"))
					{
						return ConvertToStream(match.Groups["content"].Value);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Stream ConvertToStream(string content)
		{
			byte[] buffer;
			try
			{
				buffer = Convert.FromBase64String(content);
			}
			catch
			{
				content = Uri.UnescapeDataString(content);
				buffer = Convert.FromBase64String(content);
			}
			return new MemoryStream(buffer);
		}

		private bool AreEqual(string str1, string str2)
		{
			return StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(str1, str2) == 0;
		}
	}
	public static class DataStringUriPattern
	{
		private const string imageTypePattern = "(?<imageType>\\w*)";

		private const string capacityPattern = "(?<capacity>\\w+)";

		private const string imagePattern = "(?<image>.*)";

		private const string spacePattern = "\\s*";

		private const string slashPattern = "\\/";

		private const string mediaTypePattern = "(?<mediaType>[-\\+\\w]+)";

		private const string contentPattern = "(?<content>.*)";

		private static string imageDataStringPattern = string.Format("{0}?data:{0}?image{0}?{4}?{0}?{1}?{0}?;{0}?{2}{0}?,{0}?{3}{0}?", "\\s*", "(?<imageType>\\w*)", "(?<capacity>\\w+)", "(?<image>.*)", "\\/");

		private static string applicationDataStringPattern = string.Format("{0}?data:{0}?application{0}?{4}?{0}?{1}?{0}?;{0}?{2}{0}?,{0}?{3}{0}?", "\\s*", "(?<mediaType>[-\\+\\w]+)", "(?<capacity>\\w+)", "(?<content>.*)", "\\/");

		public static Regex regex = new Regex(imageDataStringPattern, RegexOptions.Singleline | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

		public static Regex applicationDataStringRegex = new Regex(applicationDataStringPattern, RegexOptions.Singleline | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
	}
}

	public class VmlIntermediateColors : List<OfficeShadeColor>, ISupportsCopyFrom<VmlIntermediateColors>
	{
		public OfficeShadeColor First
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Count != 0)
				{
					return base[0];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public OfficeShadeColor Last
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Count != 0)
				{
					return base[base.Count - 1];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public void CopyFrom(VmlIntermediateColors source)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)source, "source");
			Clear();
			foreach (OfficeShadeColor item in source)
			{
				Add(new OfficeShadeColor(item.ColorRecord.Color, item.Position));
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Join(",", OfficeShadeColorsToStrings());
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> OfficeShadeColorsToStrings()
		{
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				OfficeShadeColor current = enumerator.Current;
				string text = ((current.Position != 0.0 && current.Position != 1.0) ? (((int)Math.Round(current.Position * 65536.0)).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "f") : ((int)current.Position).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				yield return text + " " + DXColor.ToHtml(current.ColorRecord.Color);
			}
		}
	}

	public class VmlShadowEffect : ISupportsCopyFrom<VmlShadowEffect>, ICloneable<VmlShadowEffect>
	{
		private IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private bool isDefault = true;

		public Color Color { get; set; }

		public Color Color2 { get; set; }

		public VmlMatrix Matrix { get; private set; }

		public VmlCoordUnit Offset { get; private set; }

		public VmlCoordUnit Offset2 { get; private set; }

		public float OriginX { get; set; }

		public float OriginY { get; set; }

		public VmlShadowType ShadowType { get; set; }

		public float Opacity { get; set; }

		public bool Obscured { get; set; }

		public bool On { get; set; }

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				return isDefault;
			}
			set
			{
				isDefault = value;
			}
		}

		public VmlShadowEffect(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			Color = DXColor.Gray;
			Color2 = DXColor.LightGray;
			Matrix = new VmlMatrix();
			int num = documentModel.UnitConverter.PointsToModelUnits(2);
			Offset = new VmlCoordUnit(num, num);
			Offset2 = new VmlCoordUnit(-num, -num);
			Obscured = false;
			Opacity = 1f;
			ShadowType = VmlShadowType.Single;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(VmlShadowEffect source)
		{
			Color = source.Color;
			Color2 = source.Color2;
			Matrix.CopyFrom(source.Matrix);
			Obscured = source.Obscured;
			Offset.CopyFrom(source.Offset);
			Offset2.CopyFrom(source.Offset2);
			OriginX = source.OriginX;
			OriginY = source.OriginY;
			ShadowType = source.ShadowType;
			On = source.On;
			Opacity = source.Opacity;
			isDefault = source.isDefault;
		}

		public VmlShadowEffect Clone()
		{
			VmlShadowEffect vmlShadowEffect = new VmlShadowEffect(documentModel);
			vmlShadowEffect.CopyFrom(this);
			return vmlShadowEffect;
		}
	}

	public class VmlShapeType : ISupportsCopyFrom<VmlShapeType>
	{
		public const string DefaultID = "_x0000_t202";

		public const int DefaultCoordSize = 21600;

		private IDocumentModel documentModel;

		public VmlCoordUnit CoordSize { get; private set; }

		public VmlCoordUnit CoordOrigin { get; private set; }

		public string Id { get; set; }

		public float Spt { get; set; }

		public string Path { get; set; }

		public VmlLineStrokeSettings Stroke { get; set; }

		public VmlShapeFillProperties Fill { get; set; }

		public VmlShapePath ShapePath { get; set; }

		public VmlTextPath TextPath { get; set; }

		public VmlSingleFormulasCollection Formulas { get; set; }

		public VmlShapeProtections ShapeProtections { get; set; }

		public VmlShadowEffect ShadowEffect { get; set; }

		public int?[] AdjustValues { get; set; }

		public bool? Filled { get; set; }

		public bool? Stroked { get; set; }

		public bool? PreferRelative { get; set; }

		public VmlBlackAndWhiteMode BlackAndWhiteMode { get; set; }

		public Color FillColor { get; set; }

		public Color StrokeColor { get; set; }

		public int StrokeWeight { get; set; }

		public VmlShapeType(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			Initialize();
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			AdjustValues = new int?[8];
			CoordSize = new VmlCoordUnit(21600, 21600);
			CoordOrigin = new VmlCoordUnit();
		}

		public bool GetFilled()
		{
			return GetFilledCore() ?? true;
		}

		protected bool? GetFilledCore()
		{
			if (ShapePath != null && !ShapePath.FillOk)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Fill != null && Fill.Filled.HasValue)
			{
				return Fill.Filled.Value;
			}
			return Filled;
		}

		public bool GetStroked()
		{
			return GetStrokedCore() ?? true;
		}

		public bool? GetStrokedCore()
		{
			if (ShapePath != null && !ShapePath.StrokeOk)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Stroke != null && Stroke.Stroked.HasValue)
			{
				return Stroke.Stroked.Value;
			}
			return Stroked;
		}

		public string GetPath()
		{
			if (ShapePath != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ShapePath.Path))
			{
				return ShapePath.Path;
			}
			return Path;
		}

		public bool GetShadowed()
		{
			if (ShapePath != null && !ShapePath.ShadowOk)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ShadowEffect != null)
			{
				return ShadowEffect.On;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static VmlShapeType CreateCommentShapeType(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			VmlShapeType vmlShapeType = new VmlShapeType(documentModel);
			vmlShapeType.Id = "_x0000_t202";
			vmlShapeType.CoordSize.X = 21600;
			vmlShapeType.CoordSize.Y = 21600;
			vmlShapeType.Spt = 202f;
			vmlShapeType.Path = "m,l,21600r21600,l21600,xe";
			vmlShapeType.Stroke = new VmlLineStrokeSettings(documentModel);
			vmlShapeType.Stroke.JoinStyle = VmlStrokeJoinStyle.Miter;
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath = new VmlShapePath();
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath.GradientShapeOk = true;
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath.ConnectType = VmlConnectType.Rect;
			return vmlShapeType;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(VmlShapeType source)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)source, "source");
			Array.Copy(source.AdjustValues, AdjustValues, 8);
			Spt = source.Spt;
			BlackAndWhiteMode = source.BlackAndWhiteMode;
			CoordOrigin.CopyFrom(source.CoordOrigin);
			CoordSize.CopyFrom(source.CoordSize);
			CopyFill(source.Fill);
			CopyStroke(source.Stroke);
			StrokeColor = source.StrokeColor;
			Stroked = source.Stroked;
			FillColor = source.FillColor;
			Filled = source.Filled;
			Path = source.Path;
			CopyFormulas(source.Formulas);
			CopyShapeProtections(source.ShapeProtections);
			CopyShadowEffect(source.ShadowEffect);
			CopyShapePath(source.ShapePath);
			CopyTextPath(source.TextPath);
		}

		private void CopyFormulas(VmlSingleFormulasCollection source)
		{
			Formulas = source?.Clone();
		}

		private void CopyShapePath(VmlShapePath source)
		{
			ShapePath = source?.Clone();
		}

		private void CopyTextPath(VmlTextPath source)
		{
			TextPath = source?.Clone();
		}

		private void CopyFill(VmlShapeFillProperties source)
		{
			Fill = source?.Clone();
		}

		private void CopyStroke(VmlLineStrokeSettings source)
		{
			Stroke = source?.Clone();
		}

		private void CopyShapeProtections(VmlShapeProtections source)
		{
			ShapeProtections = source?.Clone();
		}

		private void CopyShadowEffect(VmlShadowEffect source)
		{
			ShadowEffect = source?.Clone();
		}
	}

		{

			});
		}

			VmlSingleFormulasCollection vmlSingleFormulasCollection = new VmlSingleFormulasCollection();
			vmlSingleFormulasCollection.CopyFrom(this);
			return vmlSingleFormulasCollection;
		}
	}

		public static VmlShapeType GetVmlShapeType(string type)
		{
			lock (generatedVmlShapeTypes)
			{
				return GetVmlShapeTypeCore(type);
			}
		}

		public static VmlShapeType GetVmlShapeType(int shapeTypeCode)
		{
			lock (generatedVmlShapeTypes)
			{
				return GetVmlShapeTypeCore($"_x0000_t{shapeTypeCode}");
			}
		}

		private static VmlShapeType GetVmlShapeTypeCore(string type)
		{
			if (generatedVmlShapeTypes.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (!vmlShapeTypeGenerators.TryGetValue(type, out var value2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			VmlShapeType vmlShapeType = value2();
			generatedVmlShapeTypes.Add(type, vmlShapeType);
			return vmlShapeType;
		}

			vmlShapeType.Path = "m,l,21600r21600,l21600,xe";
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath = new VmlShapePath();
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath.ConnectType = VmlConnectType.Rect;
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath.ShadowOk = false;
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath.ExtrusionOk = false;
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath.StrokeOk = false;
			vmlShapeType.ShapePath.FillOk = false;
			vmlShapeType.ShapeProtections = new VmlShapeProtections();
			vmlShapeType.ShapeProtections.Ext = VmlExtensionHandlingBehavior.Edit;
			vmlShapeType.ShapeProtections.ShapeType = true;
			vmlShapeType.Stroke = new VmlLineStrokeSettings(FakeDocumentModel.Instance);
			vmlShapeType.Stroke.JoinStyle = VmlStrokeJoinStyle.Miter;
			return vmlShapeType;
		}

		private static VmlShapeType GenerateTextBox()
		{
			VmlShapeType vmlShapeType = new VmlShapeType(FakeDocumentModel.Instance);
			vmlShapeType.CoordSize.X = 21600;
			vmlShapeType.CoordSize.Y = 21600;

	public class ColorTransformCollection : UndoableClonableCollection<ColorTransformBase>
	{
		private readonly InvalidateProxy innerParent;

		public ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerParent.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				innerParent.Target = value;
			}
		}

		public ColorTransformCollection(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();
		}

		public Color ApplyTransform(Color color)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				color = base.InnerList[i].ApplyTransform(color);
			}
			return color;
		}

		public override ColorTransformBase GetCloneItem(ColorTransformBase item, IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			return item.Clone();
		}

		public override UndoableClonableCollection<ColorTransformBase> GetNewCollection(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			return new ColorTransformCollection(documentModelPart.DocumentModel);
		}

		public override ColorTransformBase DeserializeItem(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			return reader.GetObject(reader.ReadInt32()) as ColorTransformBase;
		}
	}
	public interface IColorTransformVisitor
	{
		void Visit(TintColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(ShadeColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(ComplementColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(InverseColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(GrayscaleColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(AlphaColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(AlphaOffsetColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(AlphaModulationColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(HueColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(HueOffsetColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(HueModulationColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(LuminanceColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(LuminanceOffsetColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(LuminanceModulationColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(SaturationColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(SaturationOffsetColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(SaturationModulationColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(RedColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(RedOffsetColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(RedModulationColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(GreenColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(GreenOffsetColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(GreenModulationColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(BlueColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(BlueOffsetColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(BlueModulationColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(GammaColorTransform transform);

		void Visit(InverseGammaColorTransform transform);
	}
	public abstract class ColorTransformBase
	{
		protected double ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(double normalRgb)
		{
			if (normalRgb < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (normalRgb <= 0.04045)
			{
				return normalRgb / 12.92;
			}
			if (normalRgb < 1.0)
			{
				return Math.Pow((normalRgb + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		protected double ApplyDefaultGamma(double normalRgb)
		{
			if (normalRgb < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (normalRgb <= 0.0031308)
			{
				return normalRgb * 12.92;
			}
			if (normalRgb < 1.0)
			{
				return 1.055 * Math.Pow(normalRgb, 5.0 / 12.0) - 0.055;
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		protected double ToDoubleValue(int value)
		{
			return (double)value / 255.0;
		}

		protected int ToIntValue(double value)
		{
			return GetFixRGBValue((int)Math.Round(255.0 * value, 0));
		}

		protected int GetFixRGBValue(int rgb)
		{
			if (rgb >= 0)
			{
				if (rgb <= 255)
				{
					return rgb;
				}
				return 255;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected Color ApplyDefaultGamma(Color color)
		{
			int num = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.R)));
			int num2 = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.G)));
			int num3 = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.B)));
			return DXColor.FromArgb(num, num2, num3);
		}

		protected Color ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(Color color)
		{
			int num = ToIntValue(ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.R)));
			int num2 = ToIntValue(ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.G)));
			int num3 = ToIntValue(ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.B)));
			return DXColor.FromArgb(num, num2, num3);
		}

		public abstract void Visit(IColorTransformVisitor visitor);

		public abstract ColorTransformBase Clone();

		public abstract Color ApplyTransform(Color color);
	}
	public abstract class ColorTransformValueBase : ColorTransformBase
	{
		private readonly int value;

		public int Value => value;

		protected ColorTransformValueBase(int value)
		{
			this.value = value;
		}

		protected int GetRGBFromValue()
		{
			double normalRgb = (double)Value / 100000.0;
			return ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(normalRgb));
		}

		protected double ApplyRGBOffset(double normalRgb, double offset)
		{
			return GetFixRGBNormalValue(normalRgb + offset);
		}

		protected double ApplyRGBModulation(double normalRgb, double modulation)
		{
			return GetFixRGBNormalValue(normalRgb * modulation);
		}

		protected double GetFixRGBNormalValue(double rgb)
		{
			if (!(rgb < 0.0))
			{
				if (!(rgb > 1.0))
				{
					return rgb;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected int ApplyRGBOffset(int rgb)
		{
			double offset = (double)Value / 100000.0;
			return ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(ApplyRGBOffset(ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(rgb)), offset)));
		}

		protected int ApplyRGBModulation(int rgb)
		{
			double modulation = (double)Value / 100000.0;
			return ApplyRGBModulationCore(rgb, modulation);
		}

		protected int ApplyRGBModulationCore(int rgb, double modulation)
		{
			return ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(ApplyRGBModulation(ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(rgb)), modulation)));
		}
	}
	public class TintColorTransform : ColorTransformValueBase
	{
		public TintColorTransform(int value)
			: base(value)
		{
		}

		public override void Visit(IColorTransformVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override ColorTransformBase Clone()
		{
			return new TintColorTransform(base.Value);
		}

		public override Color ApplyTransform(Color color)
		{
			double normalTint = 1.0 - (double)base.Value / 100000.0;
			int num = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(ApplyTintCore(ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.R)), normalTint)));
			int num2 = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(ApplyTintCore(ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.G)), normalTint)));
			int num3 = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(ApplyTintCore(ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.B)), normalTint)));
			return DXColor.FromArgb(num, num2, num3);
		}

		private double ApplyTintCore(double normalRgb, double normalTint)
		{
			if (!(normalTint > 0.0))
			{
				return normalRgb * (1.0 + normalTint);
			}
			return normalRgb * (1.0 - normalTint) + normalTint;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TintColorTransform tintColorTransform)
			{
				return tintColorTransform.Value == base.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return GetType().GetHashCode() ^ base.Value;
		}
	}
	public class ShadeColorTransform : ColorTransformValueBase
	{
		public ShadeColorTransform(int value)
			: base(value)
		{
		}

		public override void Visit(IColorTransformVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override ColorTransformBase Clone()
		{
			return new ShadeColorTransform(base.Value);
		}

		public override Color ApplyTransform(Color color)
		{
			double modulation = (double)base.Value / 100000.0;
			int num = ApplyRGBModulationCore(color.R, modulation);
			int num2 = ApplyRGBModulationCore(color.G, modulation);
			int num3 = ApplyRGBModulationCore(color.B, modulation);
			return DXColor.FromArgb(num, num2, num3);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ShadeColorTransform shadeColorTransform)
			{
				return shadeColorTransform.Value == base.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return GetType().GetHashCode() ^ base.Value;
		}
	}

	public class InverseColorTransform : ColorTransformBase
	{
		public override void Visit(IColorTransformVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override ColorTransformBase Clone()
		{
			return new InverseColorTransform();
		}

		public override Color ApplyTransform(Color color)
		{
			int num = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(1.0 - ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.R))));
			int num2 = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(1.0 - ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.G))));
			int num3 = ToIntValue(ApplyDefaultGamma(1.0 - ApplyInverseDefaultGamma(ToDoubleValue(color.B))));
			return DXColor.FromArgb(num, num2, num3);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return obj is InverseColorTransform;

		{
			return GetType().GetHashCode();
		}

		public override void Visit(IColorTransformVisitor visitor)

			visitor.Visit(this);

		public override ColorTransformBase Clone()
		{
			return new GrayscaleColorTransform();
		}

		public override Color ApplyTransform(Color color)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Round(0.3 * (double)(int)color.R + 0.59 * (double)(int)color.G + 0.11 * (double)(int)color.B + 0.5, 0);
			return DXColor.FromArgb(num, num, num);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return obj is GrayscaleColorTransform;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return GetType().GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public enum DrawingColorType
	{
		Rgb,
		System,
		Scheme,
		Preset,
		ScRgb,
		Hsl
	}
	public class DrawingColorModelInfo : ICloneable<DrawingColorModelInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingColorModelInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private static Dictionary<SystemColorValues, Color> systemColorTable = CreateSystemColorTable();

		private DrawingColorType colorType;

		private Color rgb;

		private SystemColorValues systemColor;

		private SchemeColorValues schemeColor;

		private string preset;

		private ScRGBColor scRgb;

		private ColorHSL hsl;

		public DrawingColorType ColorType => colorType;

		public Color Rgb
		{
			get
			{
				return rgb;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != DrawingColorType.Rgb)
				{
					SetColorType(DrawingColorType.Rgb);
				}
				if (rgb != value)
				{
					rgb = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public SystemColorValues SystemColor
		{
			get
			{
				return systemColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != DrawingColorType.System)
				{
					SetColorType(DrawingColorType.System);
				}
				if (systemColor != value)
				{
					systemColor = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public SchemeColorValues SchemeColor
		{
			get
			{
				return schemeColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != DrawingColorType.Scheme)
				{
					SetColorType(DrawingColorType.Scheme);
				}
				if (schemeColor != value)
				{
					schemeColor = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ColorHSL Hsl
		{
			get
			{
				return hsl;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != DrawingColorType.Hsl)
				{
					SetColorType(DrawingColorType.Hsl);
				}
				if (!hsl.Equals(value))
				{
					hsl = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public string Preset
		{
			get
			{
				return preset;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != DrawingColorType.Preset)
				{
					SetColorType(DrawingColorType.Preset);
				}
				if (preset != value && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					preset = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ScRGBColor ScRgb
		{
			get
			{
				return scRgb;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != DrawingColorType.ScRgb)
				{
					SetColorType(DrawingColorType.ScRgb);
				}
				if (!scRgb.Equals(value))
				{
					scRgb = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (DXColor.IsTransparentOrEmpty(Rgb))
				{
					return ColorType == DrawingColorType.Rgb;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static DrawingColorModelInfo CreateRGB(Color rgb)
		{
			DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo = new DrawingColorModelInfo();
			drawingColorModelInfo.Rgb = DXColor.FromArgb(255, (int)rgb.R, (int)rgb.G, (int)rgb.B);
			return drawingColorModelInfo;
		}

		public static DrawingColorModelInfo CreateARGB(Color argb)
		{
			DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo = new DrawingColorModelInfo();
			drawingColorModelInfo.Rgb = argb;
			return drawingColorModelInfo;
		}

		public static DrawingColorModelInfo CreateSystem(SystemColorValues systemColor)
		{
			DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo = new DrawingColorModelInfo();
			drawingColorModelInfo.SystemColor = systemColor;
			return drawingColorModelInfo;
		}

		public static DrawingColorModelInfo CreateScheme(SchemeColorValues schemeColor)
		{
			DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo = new DrawingColorModelInfo();
			drawingColorModelInfo.SchemeColor = schemeColor;
			return drawingColorModelInfo;
		}

		public static DrawingColorModelInfo CreatePreset(string preset)
		{
			DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo = new DrawingColorModelInfo();
			drawingColorModelInfo.Preset = preset;
			return drawingColorModelInfo;
		}

		public static DrawingColorModelInfo CreateScRgb(int scR, int scG, int scB)
		{
			DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo = new DrawingColorModelInfo();
			drawingColorModelInfo.ScRgb = new ScRGBColor(scR, scG, scB);
			return drawingColorModelInfo;
		}

		public static DrawingColorModelInfo CreateHSL(int hue, int saturation, int luminance)
		{
			DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo = new DrawingColorModelInfo();
			drawingColorModelInfo.Hsl = new ColorHSL(hue, saturation, luminance);
			return drawingColorModelInfo;
		}

		public static Color SRgbToRgb(string hexColor)
		{
			string s = hexColor.Substring(0, 2);
			string s2 = hexColor.Substring(2, 2);
			string s3 = hexColor.Substring(4, 2);
			int num = int.Parse(s, NumberStyles.HexNumber);
			int num2 = int.Parse(s2, NumberStyles.HexNumber);
			int num3 = int.Parse(s3, NumberStyles.HexNumber);
			return DXColor.FromArgb(num, num2, num3);
		}

		private static Dictionary<SystemColorValues, Color> CreateSystemColorTable()
		{
			Dictionary<SystemColorValues, Color> dictionary = new Dictionary<SystemColorValues, Color>();
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.Sc3dDkShadow, DXSystemColors.ControlDarkDark);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.Sc3dLight, DXSystemColors.ControlLightLight);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScActiveBorder, DXSystemColors.ActiveBorder);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScActiveCaption, DXSystemColors.ActiveCaption);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScAppWorkspace, DXSystemColors.AppWorkspace);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScBackground, DXSystemColors.Desktop);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScBtnFace, DXSystemColors.Control);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScBtnHighlight, DXSystemColors.ControlLight);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScBtnShadow, DXSystemColors.ControlDark);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScBtnText, DXSystemColors.ControlText);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScCaptionText, DXSystemColors.ActiveCaptionText);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScGradientActiveCaption, DXSystemColors.GradientActiveCaption);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScGradientInactiveCaption, DXSystemColors.GradientInactiveCaption);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScGrayText, DXSystemColors.GrayText);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScHighlight, DXSystemColors.Highlight);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScHighlightText, DXSystemColors.HighlightText);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScHotLight, DXSystemColors.HotTrack);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScInactiveBorder, DXSystemColors.InactiveBorder);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScInactiveCaption, DXSystemColors.InactiveCaption);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScInactiveCaptionText, DXSystemColors.InactiveCaptionText);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScInfoBk, DXSystemColors.Info);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScInfoText, DXSystemColors.InfoText);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScMenu, DXSystemColors.Menu);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScMenuBar, DXSystemColors.MenuBar);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScMenuHighlight, DXSystemColors.MenuHighlight);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScMenuText, DXSystemColors.MenuText);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScScrollBar, DXSystemColors.ScrollBar);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScWindow, DXSystemColors.Window);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScWindowFrame, DXSystemColors.WindowFrame);
			dictionary.Add(SystemColorValues.ScWindowText, DXSystemColors.WindowText);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static SystemColorValues GetSystemColorValue(Color color)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<SystemColorValues, Color> item in systemColorTable)
			{
				if (color == item.Value)
				{
					return item.Key;
				}
			}
			return SystemColorValues.Empty;
		}

		public DrawingColorModelInfo()
		{
			RestoreDefaultValues();
		}

		public Color ToRgb(ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors, Color styleColor)
		{
			return colorType switch
			{
				DrawingColorType.System => GetRgbFromSystemColor(), 
				DrawingColorType.Scheme => GetRgbFromSchemeColor(colors, styleColor), 
				DrawingColorType.Hsl => hsl.ToRgb(), 
				DrawingColorType.Preset => GetRgbFromPreset(), 
				DrawingColorType.ScRgb => scRgb.ToRgb(), 
				_ => rgb, 
			};
		}

		public Color ToRgb(ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors)
		{
			return ToRgb(colors, DXColor.Empty);
		}

		private Color GetRgbFromPreset()
		{
			string key = char.ToUpper(preset[0]) + preset.Substring(1);
			if (DXColor.PredefinedColors.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return DXColor.PredefinedColors[key];
			}
			return DXColor.Empty;
		}

		private Color GetRgbFromSystemColor()
		{
			if (SystemColor != SystemColorValues.Empty)
			{
				return systemColorTable[SystemColor];
			}
			return DXColor.Empty;
		}

		private Color GetRgbFromSchemeColor(ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors, Color styleColor)
		{
			if (SchemeColor == SchemeColorValues.Style)
			{
				return styleColor;
			}
			if (SchemeColor != SchemeColorValues.Empty)
			{
				return colors.GetColor(SchemeColor);
			}
			return DXColor.Empty;
		}

		private void SetColorType(DrawingColorType colorType)
		{
			RestoreDefaultValues();
			this.colorType = colorType;
		}

		private void RestoreDefaultValues()
		{
			rgb = DXColor.Empty;
			schemeColor = SchemeColorValues.Empty;
			systemColor = SystemColorValues.Empty;
			preset = string.Empty;
			scRgb = ScRGBColor.DefaultValue;
			hsl = ColorHSL.DefaultValue;
		}

		public DrawingColorModelInfo Clone()
		{
			DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo = new DrawingColorModelInfo();
			drawingColorModelInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingColorModelInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingColorModelInfo value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "DrawingColorInfo");
			colorType = value.colorType;
			rgb = value.rgb;
			schemeColor = value.schemeColor;
			systemColor = value.systemColor;
			preset = value.preset;
			scRgb = value.scRgb;
			hsl = value.hsl;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingColorModelInfo drawingColorModelInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (colorType == drawingColorModelInfo.colorType && rgb == drawingColorModelInfo.Rgb && schemeColor == drawingColorModelInfo.schemeColor && systemColor == drawingColorModelInfo.systemColor && preset == drawingColorModelInfo.preset && scRgb.Equals(drawingColorModelInfo.scRgb))
			{
				return hsl.Equals(drawingColorModelInfo.hsl);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)((uint)colorType ^ (uint)rgb.GetHashCode() ^ (uint)schemeColor.GetHashCode() ^ (uint)systemColor.GetHashCode() ^ (uint)preset.GetHashCode() ^ (uint)scRgb.GetHashCode()) ^ hsl.GetHashCode();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			colorType = (DrawingColorType)reader.ReadInt32();
			rgb = ReadColor(reader);
			schemeColor = (SchemeColorValues)reader.ReadInt32();
			systemColor = (SystemColorValues)reader.ReadInt32();
			preset = reader.ReadString();
			int scR = reader.ReadInt32();
			int scG = reader.ReadInt32();
			int scB = reader.ReadInt32();
			scRgb = new ScRGBColor(scR, scG, scB);
			float hue = reader.ReadSingle();
			float luminance = reader.ReadSingle();
			float saturation = reader.ReadSingle();
			hsl = new ColorHSL(hue, saturation, luminance);
		}

		private Color ReadColor(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			return reader.ReadByte() switch
			{
				0 => DXColor.Empty, 
				1 => Color.FromKnownColor((KnownColor)reader.ReadInt16()), 
				2 => Color.FromName(reader.ReadString()), 
				_ => Color.FromArgb(reader.ReadInt32()), 
			};
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write((int)colorType);
			WriteColor(writer, rgb);
			writer.Write((int)schemeColor);
			writer.Write((int)systemColor);
			writer.Write(preset);
			writer.Write(scRgb.ScR);
			writer.Write(scRgb.ScG);
			writer.Write(scRgb.ScB);
			writer.Write(hsl.FloatHue);
			writer.Write(hsl.FloatLuminance);
			writer.Write(hsl.FloatSaturation);
		}

		private void WriteColor(BinaryWriter writer, Color color)
		{
			if (color.IsEmpty)
			{
				writer.Write((byte)0);
			}
			else if (color.IsKnownColor)
			{
				writer.Write((byte)1);
				writer.Write((short)color.ToKnownColor());
			}
			else if (color.IsNamedColor)
			{
				writer.Write((byte)2);
				writer.Write(color.Name);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write((byte)3);
				writer.Write(color.ToArgb());
			}
		}
	}
	public class DrawingColorModelInfoCache : UniqueItemsCache<DrawingColorModelInfo>
	{
		public const int DefaultItemIndex = 0;

		public DrawingColorModelInfoCache(IDocumentModelUnitConverter converter)
			: base(converter)
		{
		}

		protected override DrawingColorModelInfo CreateDefaultItem(IDocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			return new DrawingColorModelInfo();
		}
	}
	public interface IDrawingOriginalColor
	{
		Color Rgb { get; set; }

		SystemColorValues System { get; set; }

		SchemeColorValues Scheme { get; set; }

		string Preset { get; set; }

		ColorHSL Hsl { get; set; }

		ScRGBColor ScRgb { get; set; }

		ColorTransformCollection Transforms { get; }

		void SetColorFromRGB(Color rgb);
	}
	public interface IDrawingColor : IDrawingOriginalColor
	{
		Color FinalColor { get; }

		DrawingColorType ColorType { get; }

		bool IsEmpty { get; }

		Color ToRgb(Color styleColor);

		DrawingColor CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel);
	}
	public class DrawingColor : DrawingUndoableIndexBasedObjectEx<DrawingColorModelInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingColor>, IDrawingColor, IDrawingOriginalColor, IDrawingBullet
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey RgbPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(0);

		public static readonly PropertyKey SystemPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey SchemePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		public static readonly PropertyKey PresetPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(3);

		public static readonly PropertyKey HslPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(4);

		public static readonly PropertyKey ScRgbPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(5);

		private readonly ColorTransformCollection transforms;

		private bool HasColorTransform => transforms.Count != 0;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasColorTransform)
				{
					return base.Info.IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public Color FinalColor => ToRgb(DXColor.Empty);

		public ColorTransformCollection Transforms => transforms;

		public IDrawingOriginalColor OriginalColor => this;

		Color IDrawingOriginalColor.Rgb
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.Rgb;
			}
			set
			{
				SetARGBColor(value);
			}
		}

		SystemColorValues IDrawingOriginalColor.System
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.SystemColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Info.SystemColor != value || base.Info.ColorType != DrawingColorType.System)
				{
					SetPropertyValue(SetSystemColor, value);
				}
			}
		}

		SchemeColorValues IDrawingOriginalColor.Scheme
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.SchemeColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Info.SchemeColor != value || base.Info.ColorType != DrawingColorType.Scheme)
				{
					SetPropertyValue(SetSchemeColor, value);
				}
			}
		}

		string IDrawingOriginalColor.Preset
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.Preset;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(base.Info.Preset == value) || base.Info.ColorType != DrawingColorType.Preset)
				{
					SetPropertyValue(SetPresetColor, value);
				}
			}
		}

		ColorHSL IDrawingOriginalColor.Hsl
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.Hsl;
			}
			set

		public DrawingColorType ColorType => base.Info.ColorType;

		public DrawingBulletType Type => DrawingBulletType.Color;

		public static DrawingColor Create(IDocumentModel documentModel, DrawingColorModelInfo colorInfo)
		{
			DrawingColor drawingColor = new DrawingColor(documentModel);
			drawingColor.AssignInfo(colorInfo);
			return drawingColor;
		}

		public static DrawingColor Create(IDocumentModel documentModel, Color color)
		{
			DrawingColor drawingColor = new DrawingColor(documentModel);
			drawingColor.AssignColorRGB(color);
			return drawingColor;
		}

		public DrawingColor(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			transforms = new ColorTransformCollection(documentModel);
		}

		void IDrawingOriginalColor.SetColorFromRGB(Color rgb)
		{
			base.DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				int a = rgb.A;
				if (a == 255)
				{
					SetARGBColor(rgb);
					transforms.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					SetARGBColor(DXColor.FromArgb(255, (int)rgb.R, (int)rgb.G, (int)rgb.B));
					transforms.Clear();
					transforms.Add(AlphaColorTransform.CreateFromA(a));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.DocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void SetARGBColor(Color argb)
		{
			if (!(base.Info.Rgb == argb) || base.Info.ColorType != DrawingColorType.Rgb)
			{
				SetPropertyValue(SetARGBColorCore, argb);
			}
		}

		private PropertyKey SetARGBColorCore(DrawingColorModelInfo info, Color value)
		{
			info.Rgb = value;
			return RgbPropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetSystemColor(DrawingColorModelInfo info, SystemColorValues value)
		{
			info.SystemColor = value;
			return SystemPropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetSchemeColor(DrawingColorModelInfo info, SchemeColorValues value)
		{
			info.SchemeColor = value;
			return SchemePropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetPresetColor(DrawingColorModelInfo info, string value)
		{
			info.Preset = value;
			return PresetPropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetHslColor(DrawingColorModelInfo info, ColorHSL value)
		{
			info.Hsl = value;
			return HslPropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetScRgbColor(DrawingColorModelInfo info, ScRGBColor value)
		{
			info.ScRgb = value;
			return ScRgbPropertyKey;
		}

		protected internal override UniqueItemsCache<DrawingColorModelInfo> GetCache(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return base.DrawingCache.DrawingColorModelInfoCache;
		}

		public Color ToRgb(Color styleColor)
		{
			ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors = base.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors;
			Color color = base.Info.ToRgb(colors, styleColor);
			if (HasColorTransform)
			{
				color = transforms.ApplyTransform(color);
			}
			if (color.A == 0 && color.R == 0 && color.G == 0 && color.B == 0)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			return color;
		}

		public DrawingColor CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingColor drawingColor = new DrawingColor(documentModel);
			drawingColor.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingColor;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingColor other)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(other);
			transforms.CopyFrom(other.transforms);
		}

		private void AssignColorRGB(Color color)
		{
			int a = color.A;
			if (a == 255)
			{
				AssignInfo(DrawingColorModelInfo.CreateARGB(color));
				return;
			}
			AssignInfo(DrawingColorModelInfo.CreateRGB(color));
			Transforms.AddInternal(AlphaColorTransform.CreateFromA(a));
		}

		IDrawingBullet IDrawingBullet.CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return CloneTo(documentModel);
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingBulletVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingColor drawingColor))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Index == drawingColor.Index)
			{
				return transforms.Equals(drawingColor.transforms);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.Index ^ transforms.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (base.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				base.Info.CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.DrawingColorModelInfoCache.DefaultItem);
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeIndexCore(0, PropertyKey.Undefined);
			}
			transforms.Clear();
		}
	}
	public interface ISupportsInvalidate
	{
		void Invalidate();
	}
	public interface ISupportsInvalidateNotify
	{
		void InvalidateNotify();
	}
	public class InvalidateProxy : ISupportsInvalidate
	{
		private ISupportsInvalidate target;

		private ISupportsInvalidateNotify notifyTarget;

		public ISupportsInvalidate Target
		{
			get
			{
				return target;
			}
			set
			{
				target = value;
			}
		}

		public ISupportsInvalidateNotify NotifyTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return notifyTarget;
			}
			set
			{
				notifyTarget = value;
			}
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				target.Invalidate();
				if (notifyTarget != null)
				{
					notifyTarget.InvalidateNotify();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static class DrawingValueConverter
	{
		private const double Rad2Deg = 180.0 / Math.PI;

		private const double Deg2Rad = Math.PI / 180.0;

		public static int ToPercentage(double value)
		{
			return (int)(value * 100000.0);
		}

		public static double FromPercentage(int value)
		{
			return (double)value / 100000.0;
		}

		public static int ToPositiveFixedAngle(double value)
		{
			return (int)(value * 60000.0);
		}

		public static double FromPositiveFixedAngle(int value)
		{
			return (double)value / 60000.0;
		}

		public static double FromPositiveFixedAngle(double value)
		{
			return value / 60000.0;
		}

		public static double RadianToDegree(double radian)
		{
			return radian * (180.0 / Math.PI);
		}

		public static double DegreeToRadian(double degree)
		{
			return degree * (Math.PI / 180.0);
		}

		public static Color GetDarkenTransformColor(Color color, double vmod)
		{
			double num = (double)(int)color.R / 255.0;
			double num2 = (double)(int)color.G / 255.0;
			double num3 = (double)(int)color.B / 255.0;
			double num4 = Math.Max(num, Math.Max(num2, num3));
			double num5 = Math.Min(num, Math.Min(num2, num3));
			double num6 = ((num4 == num5) ? 0.0 : ((num4 == num && num2 >= num3) ? (60.0 * (num2 - num3) / (num4 - num5)) : ((num4 == num && num2 < num3) ? (60.0 * (num2 - num3) / (num4 - num5) + 360.0) : ((num4 != num2) ? (60.0 * (num - num2) / (num4 - num5) + 240.0) : (60.0 * (num3 - num) / (num4 - num5) + 120.0)))));
			double num7 = ((num4 == 0.0) ? 0.0 : (1.0 - num5 / num4));
			double num8 = num4;
			num8 = Math.Min(1.0, num8 * vmod);
			int num9 = (int)(num6 / 60.0) % 6;
			double num10 = (1.0 - num7) * num8;
			double num11 = (num8 - num10) * (num6 % 60.0) / 60.0;
			double num12 = num10 + num11;
			double num13 = num8 - num11;
			double num14;
			double num15;
			double num16;
			switch (num9)
			{
			case 0:
				num14 = num8;
				num15 = num12;
				num16 = num10;
				break;
			case 1:
				num14 = num13;
				num15 = num8;
				num16 = num10;
				break;
			case 2:
				num14 = num10;
				num15 = num8;
				num16 = num12;
				break;
			case 3:
				num14 = num10;
				num15 = num13;
				num16 = num8;
				break;
			case 4:
				num14 = num12;
				num15 = num10;
				num16 = num8;
				break;
			default:
				num14 = num8;
				num15 = num10;
				num16 = num13;
				break;
			}
			return Color.FromArgb((int)(num14 * 255.0), (int)(num15 * 255.0), (int)(num16 * 255.0));
		}

		public static Color GetLightenTransformColor(Color color, double tint)
		{
			return ColorHSL.CalculateColorRGB(color, tint);
		}
	}

	public class DrawingEffectCollection : UndoableClonableCollection<IDrawingEffect>
	{
		public DrawingEffectCollection(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
		}

		public void ApplyEffects(IDrawingEffectVisitor visitor)
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				base.InnerList[i].Visit(visitor);
			}
		}

		public override IDrawingEffect GetCloneItem(IDrawingEffect item, IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			return item.CloneTo(documentModelPart.DocumentModel);
		}

		public override UndoableClonableCollection<IDrawingEffect> GetNewCollection(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			return new DrawingEffectCollection(documentModelPart.DocumentModel);
		}

		public override IDrawingEffect DeserializeItem(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			return reader.GetObject(reader.ReadInt32()) as IDrawingEffect;
		}
	}
	public sealed class DrawingEffect : IDrawingEffect
	{
		public static DrawingEffect AlphaCeilingEffect = new DrawingEffect(0);

		public static DrawingEffect AlphaFloorEffect = new DrawingEffect(1);

		public static DrawingEffect GrayScaleEffect = new DrawingEffect(2);

		private const int alphaCeilingEffectIndex = 0;

		private const int alphaFloorEffectIndex = 1;

		private const int grayScaleEffectIndex = 2;

		private readonly int index;

		private DrawingEffect(int index)
		{
			this.index = index;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingEffectVisitor visitor)
		{
			if (index == 0)
			{
				visitor.AlphaCeilingEffectVisit();
			}
			else if (index == 1)
			{
				visitor.AlphaFloorEffectVisit();
			}
			else
			{
				visitor.GrayScaleEffectVisit();
			}
		}

		public IDrawingEffect CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			if (index == 0)
			{
				return AlphaCeilingEffect;
			}
			if (index == 1)
			{
				return AlphaFloorEffect;
			}
			return GrayScaleEffect;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingEffect drawingEffect))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return index == drawingEffect.index;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return index;
		}
	}

	public enum BlendMode
	{
		Overlay,
		Multiply,
		Screen,
		Darken,
		Lighten
	}
	public class BlendEffect : IDrawingEffect
	{
		private readonly BlendMode blendMode;

		private readonly ContainerEffect container;

		public BlendMode BlendMode => blendMode;

		public ContainerEffect Container => container;

		public BlendEffect(ContainerEffect container, BlendMode blendMode)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)container, "DrawingEffectContainer");
			this.container = container;
			this.blendMode = blendMode;
		}

		public BlendEffect(IDocumentModel documentModel, BlendMode blendMode)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			container = new ContainerEffect(documentModel);
			this.blendMode = blendMode;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingEffectVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public IDrawingEffect CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return new BlendEffect((ContainerEffect)container.CloneTo(documentModel), blendMode);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is BlendEffect blendEffect))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (blendMode == blendEffect.blendMode)
			{
				return container.Equals(blendEffect.container);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return GetType().GetHashCode() ^ blendMode.GetHashCode() ^ container.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public enum DrawingEffectContainerType
	{
		Sibling,
		Tree
	}
	public class ContainerEffect : IDrawingEffect, ISupportsCopyFrom<ContainerEffect>, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey EffectsPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(0);

		public static readonly PropertyKey NamePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey TypePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		public static readonly PropertyKey HasEffectsListPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(3);

		public static readonly PropertyKey ApplyEffectsListPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(4);

		private readonly DrawingEffectCollection effects;

		private readonly PropertyChangedNotifier notifier;

		private string name = string.Empty;

		private DrawingEffectContainerType type;

		private bool hasEffectsList = true;

		private bool applyEffectList;

		public DrawingEffectCollection Effects => effects;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				SetName(value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingEffectContainerType Type
		{
			get
			{
				return type;
			}
			set
			{
				SetType(value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasEffectsList
		{
			get
			{
				return hasEffectsList;
			}
			set
			{
				SetHasEffectsList(value);
			}
		}

		public bool ApplyEffectList
		{
			get
			{
				return applyEffectList;
			}
			set
			{
				if (applyEffectList != value)
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new ActionBooleanHistoryItem(DocumentModel.MainPart, applyEffectList, value, SetApplyEffectListCore));
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ApplyEffectList)
				{
					return effects.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private IDocumentModel DocumentModel => effects.DocumentModel;

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
		}

		public ContainerEffect(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
			effects = new DrawingEffectCollection(documentModel);
			effects.Modified += OnEffectsModified;
		}

		protected internal void SetApplyEffectListCore(bool value)
		{
			applyEffectList = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(ApplyEffectsListPropertyKey);
		}

		private void SetName(string value)
		{
			if (name != value)
			{
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingContainerEffectNameChangedHistoryItem(DocumentModel.MainPart, this, name, value));
			}
		}

		internal void SetNameCore(string value)
		{
			name = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(NamePropertyKey);
		}

		private void SetType(DrawingEffectContainerType value)
		{
			if (type != value)
			{
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingContainerEffectTypeChangedHistoryItem(DocumentModel.MainPart, this, type, value));
			}
		}

		internal void SetTypeCore(DrawingEffectContainerType value)
		{
			type = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(TypePropertyKey);
		}

		internal void ApplyEffects(IDrawingEffectVisitor visitor)
		{
			Effects.ApplyEffects(visitor);
		}

		private void SetHasEffectsList(bool value)
		{
			if (hasEffectsList != value)
			{
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingContainerEffectHasEffectsListChangedHistoryItem(DocumentModel.MainPart, this, hasEffectsList, value));
			}
		}

		internal void SetHasEffectsListCore(bool value)
		{
			hasEffectsList = value;
		}

		private void ApplyHistoryItem(HistoryItem item)
		{
			DocumentModel.History.Add(item);
			item.Execute();
		}

		private void OnEffectsModified(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(EffectsPropertyKey);
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingEffectVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public IDrawingEffect CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			ContainerEffect containerEffect = new ContainerEffect(documentModel);
			containerEffect.CopyFrom(this);
			return containerEffect;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ContainerEffect value)
		{
			Effects.Clear();
			foreach (IDrawingEffect effect in value.Effects)
			{
				Effects.Add(effect.CloneTo(DocumentModel));
			}
			Name = value.Name;
			Type = value.Type;
			HasEffectsList = value.HasEffectsList;
			ApplyEffectList = value.ApplyEffectList;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ContainerEffect containerEffect))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(name, containerEffect.name) == 0 && type == containerEffect.type && hasEffectsList == containerEffect.hasEffectsList && applyEffectList == containerEffect.applyEffectList)
			{
				return effects.Equals(containerEffect.effects);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return GetType().GetHashCode() ^ name.GetHashCode() ^ type.GetHashCode() ^ effects.GetHashCode() ^ hasEffectsList.GetHashCode() ^ applyEffectList.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		{

		}

				return coordinateShiftInfo.Equals(transformEffect.coordinateShiftInfo);

			return false;

	public class OuterShadowEffectInfo : ICloneable<OuterShadowEffectInfo>
	{
		private readonly OffsetShadowInfo offsetShadowInfo;

		private readonly ScalingFactorInfo scalingFactorInfo;

		private readonly SkewAnglesInfo skewAnglesInfo;

		private readonly RectangleAlignType shadowAlignment;

		private readonly long blurRadius;

		private readonly bool rotateWithShape;

		public OffsetShadowInfo OffsetShadow => offsetShadowInfo;

		public ScalingFactorInfo ScalingFactor => scalingFactorInfo;

		public SkewAnglesInfo SkewAngles => skewAnglesInfo;

		public RectangleAlignType ShadowAlignment => shadowAlignment;

		public long BlurRadius => blurRadius;

		public bool RotateWithShape => rotateWithShape;

		public static OuterShadowEffectInfo Create(long blurRadius, long dist, int dir, int sx, int sy, int kx, int ky, RectangleAlignType align, bool rotWithShape)
		{
			OffsetShadowInfo offsetShadowInfo = new OffsetShadowInfo(dist, dir);
			ScalingFactorInfo scalingFactorInfo = new ScalingFactorInfo(sx, sy);
			SkewAnglesInfo skewAnglesInfo = new SkewAnglesInfo(kx, ky);
			return new OuterShadowEffectInfo(offsetShadowInfo, scalingFactorInfo, skewAnglesInfo, align, blurRadius, rotWithShape);
		}

		public OuterShadowEffectInfo(OffsetShadowInfo offsetShadowInfo, ScalingFactorInfo scalingFactorInfo, SkewAnglesInfo skewAnglesInfo, RectangleAlignType shadowAlignment, long blurRadius, bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)offsetShadowInfo, "offsetShadowInfo");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)scalingFactorInfo, "scalingFactorInfo");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)skewAnglesInfo, "skewAnglesInfo");
			this.offsetShadowInfo = offsetShadowInfo;
			this.scalingFactorInfo = scalingFactorInfo;
			this.shadowAlignment = shadowAlignment;
			this.skewAnglesInfo = skewAnglesInfo;
			this.blurRadius = blurRadius;
			this.rotateWithShape = rotateWithShape;
		}

		public OuterShadowEffectInfo Clone()
		{
			return new OuterShadowEffectInfo(offsetShadowInfo.Clone(), scalingFactorInfo.Clone(), skewAnglesInfo.Clone(), shadowAlignment, blurRadius, rotateWithShape);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is OuterShadowEffectInfo outerShadowEffectInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (offsetShadowInfo.Equals(outerShadowEffectInfo.offsetShadowInfo) && scalingFactorInfo.Equals(outerShadowEffectInfo.scalingFactorInfo) && skewAnglesInfo.Equals(outerShadowEffectInfo.skewAnglesInfo) && shadowAlignment == outerShadowEffectInfo.shadowAlignment && blurRadius == outerShadowEffectInfo.blurRadius)
			{
				return rotateWithShape == outerShadowEffectInfo.rotateWithShape;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return GetType().GetHashCode() ^ offsetShadowInfo.GetHashCode() ^ scalingFactorInfo.GetHashCode() ^ skewAnglesInfo.GetHashCode() ^ shadowAlignment.GetHashCode() ^ blurRadius.GetHashCode() ^ rotateWithShape.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public class DrawingEffectStyle : ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingEffectStyle>, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey ContainerEffectPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(0);

		public static readonly PropertyKey Scene3DPropertiesPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey Shape3DPropertiesPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		private readonly ContainerEffect containerEffect;

		private readonly Scene3DProperties scene3DProperies;

		private readonly Shape3DProperties shape3DProperties;

		private readonly PropertyChangedNotifier notifier;

		public ContainerEffect ContainerEffect => containerEffect;

		public Scene3DProperties Scene3DProperties => scene3DProperies;

		public Shape3DProperties Shape3DProperties => shape3DProperties;

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (containerEffect.IsEmpty && scene3DProperies.IsDefault)
				{
					return shape3DProperties.IsDefault;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingEffectStyle(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
			containerEffect = new ContainerEffect(documentModel);
			containerEffect.PropertyChanged += OnContainerEffectChanged;
			scene3DProperies = new Scene3DProperties(documentModel);
			scene3DProperies.PropertyChanged += OnScene3DProperiesChanged;
			shape3DProperties = new Shape3DProperties(documentModel);
			shape3DProperties.PropertyChanged += OnShape3DPropertiesChanged;
		}

		private void OnContainerEffectChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(ContainerEffectPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnScene3DProperiesChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(Scene3DPropertiesPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnShape3DPropertiesChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(Shape3DPropertiesPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		public void ApplyEffects(IDrawingEffectVisitor visitor)
		{
			ContainerEffect.ApplyEffects(visitor);
		}

		public DrawingEffectStyle CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingEffectStyle drawingEffectStyle = new DrawingEffectStyle(documentModel);
			drawingEffectStyle.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingEffectStyle;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingEffectStyle value)
		{
			containerEffect.CopyFrom(value.containerEffect);
			scene3DProperies.CopyFrom(value.scene3DProperies);
			shape3DProperties.CopyFrom(value.shape3DProperties);
		}
	}

	public delegate IDrawingEffect[] PresetShadowGeneratorDelegate(PresetShadowEffect presetShadow);
	public static class PresetShadowGenerator
	{
		private static Dictionary<PresetShadowType, PresetShadowGeneratorDelegate> generators;

		private static Dictionary<PresetShadowType, PresetShadowGeneratorDelegate> Generators => generators ?? (generators = CreateGenerators());

		private static Dictionary<PresetShadowType, PresetShadowGeneratorDelegate> CreateGenerators()
		{
			Dictionary<PresetShadowType, PresetShadowGeneratorDelegate> dictionary = new Dictionary<PresetShadowType, PresetShadowGeneratorDelegate>();
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.TopLeftDrop, GenerateTopLeftDrop);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.TopRightDrop, GenerateTopRightDrop);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.BackLeftPerspective, GenerateBackLeftPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.BackRightPerspective, GenerateBackRightPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.BottomLeftDrop, GenerateBottomLeftDrop);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.BottomRightDrop, GenerateBottomRightDrop);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.FrontLeftPerspective, GenerateFrontLeftPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.FrontRightPerspective, GenerateFrontRightPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.TopLeftSmallDrop, GenerateTopLeftSmallDrop);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.TopLeftLargeDrop, GenerateTopLeftLargeDrop);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.BackLeftLongPerspective, GenerateBackLeftLongPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.BackRightLongPerspective, GenerateBackRightLongPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.TopLeftDoubleDrop, GenerateTopLeftDoubleDrop);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.BottomRightSmallDrop, GenerateBottomRightSmallDrop);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.FrontLeftLongPerspective, GenerateFrontLeftLongPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.FrontRightLongPerspective, GenerateFrontRightLongPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.OuterBox3d, GenerateOuterBox3D);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.InnerBox3d, GenerateInnerBox3D);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.BackCenterPerspective, GenerateBackCenterPerspective);
			dictionary.Add(PresetShadowType.FrontBottomShadow, GenerateFrontBottomShadow);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static IDrawingEffect[] GenerateShadowEffect(PresetShadowEffect presetShadow)
		{
			if (!Generators.TryGetValue(presetShadow.Type, out var value))
			{
				return new IDrawingEffect[0];
			}
			return value(presetShadow);
		}

		private static IDrawingEffect[] GenerateTopLeftDrop(PresetShadowEffect presetShadow)
		{
			int num = 0;
			long distance = presetShadow.OffsetShadow.Distance;
			int direction = presetShadow.OffsetShadow.Direction;
			int sx = 100000;
			int sy = 100000;
			int kx = 0;
			int ky = 0;
			RectangleAlignType align = RectangleAlignType.TopLeft;
			OuterShadowEffect outerShadowEffect = new OuterShadowEffect(presetShadow.Color, OuterShadowEffectInfo.Create(num, distance, direction, sx, sy, kx, ky, align, rotWithShape: false));
			return new IDrawingEffect[1] { outerShadowEffect };
		}

		private static IDrawingEffect[] GenerateTopRightDrop(PresetShadowEffect presetShadow)
		{
			int num = 0;
			long distance = presetShadow.OffsetShadow.Distance;

			int sx = 100000;
			int sy = 100000;

		}

		private static Color TransformColor(Color source)
		{
			Color color = DXColor.Blend(source, Color.White);
			int num = (int)Math.Round((float)(102 * source.A) / 255f);
			int red = Math.Min(255, color.R + num);
			int green = Math.Min(255, color.G + num);
			int blue = Math.Min(255, color.B + num);
			return Color.FromArgb(red, green, blue);
		}
	}
