	public class ShapeBevel3DProperties : ISupportsCopyFrom<ShapeBevel3DProperties>, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey HeightPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(0);

		public static readonly PropertyKey WidthPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey PresetTypePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		public const int DefaultCoordinate = 76200;

		public const PresetBevelType DefaultPresetType = PresetBevelType.Circle;

		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly PropertyChangedNotifier notifier;

		private PresetBevelType preset;

		private long width;

		private long height;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		public long Height
		{
			get
			{
				return height;
			}
			set
			{
				if (height != value)
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new ActionLongHistoryItem(documentModel.MainPart, height, value, SetHeightCore));
				}
			}
		}

		public long Width
		{
			get
			{
				return width;
			}
			set
			{
				if (width != value)
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new ActionLongHistoryItem(documentModel.MainPart, width, value, SetWidthCore));
				}
			}
		}

		public PresetBevelType PresetType
		{
			get
			{
				return preset;
			}
			set
			{
				if (preset != value)
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new Shape3DPropertiesPresetTypeHistoryItem(this, preset, value));
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (PresetType == PresetBevelType.Circle && Height == 76200)
				{
					return Width == 76200;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
		}

		public ShapeBevel3DProperties(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
			preset = PresetBevelType.Circle;
			width = 76200L;
			height = 76200L;
		}

		protected internal void SetHeightCore(long value)
		{
			height = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(HeightPropertyKey);
		}

		protected internal void SetWidthCore(long value)
		{
			width = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(WidthPropertyKey);
		}

		protected internal void SetPresetCore(PresetBevelType value)
		{
			preset = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(PresetTypePropertyKey);
		}

		protected void ApplyHistoryItem(HistoryItem item)
		{
			documentModel.History.Add(item);
			item.Execute();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ShapeBevel3DProperties shapeBevel3DProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Height == shapeBevel3DProperties.Height && Width == shapeBevel3DProperties.Width)
			{
				return PresetType == shapeBevel3DProperties.PresetType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalcHashCode32(Height.GetHashCode(), Width.GetHashCode(), PresetType.GetHashCode());
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ShapeBevel3DProperties value)
		{
			preset = value.preset;
			width = value.width;
			height = value.height;
		}
	}
	public class Shape3DProperties : ICloneable<Shape3DProperties>, ISupportsCopyFrom<Shape3DProperties>, IDrawingText3D, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged

		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		public DrawingColor ContourColor => contourColor;

		public DrawingColor ExtrusionColor => extrusionColor;

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (ContourColor.IsEmpty && ExtrusionColor.IsEmpty && TopBevel.IsDefault && BottomBevel.IsDefault && PresetMaterial == PresetMaterialType.WarmMatte && ExtrusionHeight == 0L && ContourWidth == 0L)
				{
					return ShapeDepth == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		DrawingText3DType IDrawingText3D.Type => DrawingText3DType.Shape3D;

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged

			}

		public Shape3DProperties(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			topBevel = new ShapeBevel3DProperties(documentModel);
			topBevel.PropertyChanged += OnTopBevelChanged;
			bottomBevel = new ShapeBevel3DProperties(documentModel);
			bottomBevel.PropertyChanged += OnBottomBevelChanged;
			contourColor = new DrawingColor(documentModel);
			contourColor.PropertyChanged += OnContourColorChanged;
			extrusionColor = new DrawingColor(documentModel);
			extrusionColor.PropertyChanged += OnExtrusionColorChanged;
			preset = PresetMaterialType.WarmMatte;
		}

		protected internal void SetExtrusionHeightCore(long value)
		{
			extrusionHeight = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(ExtrusionHeightPropertyKey);

		protected internal void SetContourWidthCore(long value)
		{
			contourWidth = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(ContourWidthPropertyKey);
		}

		protected internal void SetShapeDepthCore(long value)
		{
			shapeDepth = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(ShapeDepthPropertyKey);
		}

		protected internal void SetPresetCore(PresetMaterialType value)
		{
			preset = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(PresetMaterialPropertyKey);

		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(ContourColorPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnExtrusionColorChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(ExtrusionColorPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnBottomBevelChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(BottomBevelPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnTopBevelChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(TopBevelPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		protected void ApplyHistoryItem(HistoryItem item)
		{
			DocumentModel.History.Add(item);
			item.Execute();
		}

		public Shape3DProperties Clone()
		{
			Shape3DProperties shape3DProperties = new Shape3DProperties(DocumentModel);
			shape3DProperties.CopyFrom(this);
			return shape3DProperties;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is Shape3DProperties shape3DProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (preset == shape3DProperties.preset && topBevel.Equals(shape3DProperties.topBevel) && bottomBevel.Equals(shape3DProperties.bottomBevel) && contourColor.Equals(shape3DProperties.contourColor) && extrusionColor.Equals(shape3DProperties.extrusionColor) && ExtrusionHeight == shape3DProperties.ExtrusionHeight && ContourWidth == shape3DProperties.ContourWidth)
			{
				return ShapeDepth == shape3DProperties.ShapeDepth;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return preset.GetHashCode() ^ extrusionHeight.GetHashCode() ^ contourWidth.GetHashCode() ^ shapeDepth.GetHashCode() ^ topBevel.GetHashCode() ^ bottomBevel.GetHashCode() ^ contourColor.GetHashCode() ^ extrusionColor.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void CopyFrom(Shape3DProperties value)
		{
			extrusionHeight = value.extrusionHeight;
			contourWidth = value.contourWidth;
			shapeDepth = value.shapeDepth;
			preset = value.preset;
			topBevel.CopyFrom(value.topBevel);
			bottomBevel.CopyFrom(value.bottomBevel);
			contourColor.CopyFrom(value.contourColor);
			extrusionColor.CopyFrom(value.extrusionColor);
		}

		IDrawingText3D IDrawingText3D.CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Shape3DProperties shape3DProperties = new Shape3DProperties(documentModel);
			shape3DProperties.CopyFrom(this);
			return shape3DProperties;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingText3DVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}

	public class DrawingBlip : ICloneable<DrawingBlip>, ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingBlip>, IDrawingBullet, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey EmbeddedPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(0);

		public static readonly PropertyKey LinkPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey CompressionStatePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		public static readonly PropertyKey ImagePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(3);

		public static readonly PropertyKey EffectsPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(4);

		private readonly InvalidateProxy innerParent;

		private readonly PropertyChangedNotifier notifier;

		private readonly DrawingEffectCollection effects;

		private bool embedded = true;

		private string link = string.Empty;

		private CompressionState compressionState;

		private OfficeImage image;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => effects.DocumentModel;

		public ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerParent.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				innerParent.Target = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawingEffectCollection Effects => effects;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Embedded && Effects.Count == 0 && CompressionState == CompressionState.None)
				{
					return string.IsNullOrEmpty(Link);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool Embedded
		{
			get
			{
				return embedded;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (embedded != value)
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingBlipEmbeddedChangeHistoryItem(this, embedded, value));
				}
			}
		}

		public string Link
		{
			get
			{
				return link;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (link != value)
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingBlipLinkChangeHistoryItem(this, link, value));
				}
			}
		}

		public CompressionState CompressionState
		{
			get
			{
				return compressionState;
			}
			set
			{
				if (CompressionState != value)
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingBlipCompressionStateHistoryItem(this, compressionState, value));
				}
			}
		}

		public OfficeImage Image
		{
			get
			{
				return image;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(image, value))
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingBlipImageChangeHistoryItem(this, image, value));
				}
			}
		}

		public DrawingBulletType Type => DrawingBulletType.Common;

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingBlip(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
			effects = new DrawingEffectCollection(documentModel);
			effects.Modified += OnEffectsModified;
			compressionState = CompressionState.None;
		}

		public void SetEmbeddedCore(bool value)
		{
			embedded = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(EmbeddedPropertyKey);
		}

		public void SetLinkCore(string value)
		{
			link = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(LinkPropertyKey);
		}

		public void SetCompressionStateCore(CompressionState value)
		{
			compressionState = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(CompressionStatePropertyKey);
		}

		public void SetImageCore(OfficeImage value)
		{
			image = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(ImagePropertyKey);
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public void SetExternal(string link)
		{
			SetExternalCore(embedded: false, link);
		}

		private void SetExternalCore(bool embedded, string link)
		{
			DocumentModel.History.BeginTransaction();
			Embedded = embedded;
			Link = link;
			DocumentModel.History.EndTransaction();
		}

		public void SetEmbedded()
		{
			SetExternalCore(embedded: true, string.Empty);
		}

		private void ApplyHistoryItem(HistoryItem item)
		{
			DocumentModel.History.Add(item);
			item.Execute();
		}

		private void OnEffectsModified(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(EffectsPropertyKey);
		}

		public DrawingBlip Clone()
		{
			DrawingBlip drawingBlip = new DrawingBlip(DocumentModel);
			drawingBlip.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingBlip;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingBlip value)
		{
			link = value.Link;
			embedded = value.Embedded;
			compressionState = value.compressionState;
			effects.CopyFrom(value.effects);
			if (value.Image == null)
			{
				Image = null;
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Image = value.Image.Clone(DocumentModel);
			}
			catch
			{
				Image = null;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingBlip drawingBlip))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (effects.Equals(drawingBlip.effects) && compressionState == drawingBlip.compressionState && embedded == drawingBlip.embedded && StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(link, drawingBlip.link) == 0)
			{
				return object.Equals(image, drawingBlip.image);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return GetType().GetHashCode() ^ effects.GetHashCode() ^ compressionState.GetHashCode() ^ embedded.GetHashCode() ^ link.GetHashCode() ^ image.GetHashCode();
		}

		public IDrawingBullet CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingBlip drawingBlip = new DrawingBlip(documentModel);
			drawingBlip.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingBlip;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingBulletVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}

			drawingBlipTileInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingBlipTileInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingBlipTileInfo value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			packedValues = value.packedValues;
			scaleX = value.scaleX;
			scaleY = value.scaleY;
			offsetX = value.offsetX;
			offsetY = value.offsetY;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingBlipTileInfo drawingBlipTileInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (packedValues == drawingBlipTileInfo.packedValues && scaleX == drawingBlipTileInfo.scaleX && scaleY == drawingBlipTileInfo.scaleY && offsetX == drawingBlipTileInfo.offsetX)
			{
				return offsetY == drawingBlipTileInfo.offsetY;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)(packedValues ^ scaleX ^ scaleY ^ offsetX.GetHashCode() ^ offsetY.GetHashCode());
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			packedValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
			scaleX = reader.ReadInt32();
			scaleY = reader.ReadInt32();
			offsetX = reader.ReadInt64();
			offsetY = reader.ReadInt64();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(packedValues);
			writer.Write(scaleX);
			writer.Write(scaleY);
			writer.Write(offsetX);
			writer.Write(offsetY);
		}
	}

		public static DrawingBlipFill Create(IDocumentModel documentModel, DrawingBlipFillInfo fillInfo, DrawingBlipTileInfo tileInfo)
		{
			DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill = new DrawingBlipFill(documentModel);
			drawingBlipFill.AssignInfoes(fillInfo, tileInfo);
			return drawingBlipFill;
		}

		public static DrawingBlipFill Create(IDocumentModel documentModel, DrawingBlipFillInfo fillInfo)
		{
			return Create(documentModel, fillInfo, new DrawingBlipTileInfo());
		}

		public static DrawingBlipFill Create(IDocumentModel documentModel, OfficeImage image)
		{
			DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill = new DrawingBlipFill(documentModel);
			drawingBlipFill.Blip.Image = image;
			drawingBlipFill.Stretch = true;
			return drawingBlipFill;
		}

		public static DrawingBlipFill Create(IDocumentModel documentModel, string fileName)
		{
			DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill = new DrawingBlipFill(documentModel);
			using (FileStream stream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read))
			{
				drawingBlipFill.Blip.Image = documentModel.CreateImage(stream);
			}
			drawingBlipFill.Stretch = true;
			return drawingBlipFill;
		}

		public DrawingBlipFill(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
			blip = new DrawingBlip(documentModel);
			blip.PropertyChanged += OnBlipPropertyChanged;
			blip.Parent = base.InnerParent;
			sourceRectangle = RectangleOffset.Empty;
			fillRectangle = RectangleOffset.Empty;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetDpiCore(DrawingBlipFillInfo info, int value)
		{
			info.Dpi = value;
			return DpiPropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetRotateWithShapeCore(DrawingBlipFillInfo info, bool value)
		{
			info.RotateWithShape = value;
			return RotateWithShapePropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetStretchCore(DrawingBlipFillInfo info, bool value)
		{
			info.Stretch = value;
			return StretchPropertyKey;
		}

		public void SetSourceRectangleCore(RectangleOffset value)
		{
			sourceRectangle = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(SourceRectanglePropertyKey);
			InvalidateParent();
		}

		private void SetFillRectangle(RectangleOffset value)
		{
			base.DocumentModel.History.BeginTransaction();
			try
			{
				ApplyHistoryItem(new FillRectangleHistoryItem(this, fillRectangle, value));
				if (!object.Equals(value, RectangleOffset.Empty))
				{
					Stretch = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.DocumentModel.History.EndTransaction();
			}
		}

		public void SetFillRectangleCore(RectangleOffset value)
		{
			fillRectangle = value;
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(FillRectanglePropertyKey);
			InvalidateParent();
		}

		private PropertyKey SetTileAlignCore(DrawingBlipTileInfo info, RectangleAlignType value)
		{
			info.TileAlign = value;
			return TileAlignPropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetTileFlipCore(DrawingBlipTileInfo info, TileFlipType value)
		{
			info.TileFlip = value;
			return TileFlipPropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetScaleXCore(DrawingBlipTileInfo info, int value)
		{
			info.ScaleX = value;
			return ScaleXPropertyKey;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetScaleYCore(DrawingBlipTileInfo info, int value)
		{
			info.ScaleY = value;
			return ScaleYPropertyKey;

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingBlipFill value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			blip.CopyFrom(value.blip);
			SourceRectangle = value.SourceRectangle;
			FillRectangle = value.FillRectangle;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (drawingBlipFill.FillType != DrawingFillType.Picture)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill2 = drawingBlipFill;
			if (base.Equals((object)drawingBlipFill2) && blip.Equals(drawingBlipFill2.blip) && sourceRectangle.Equals(drawingBlipFill2.sourceRectangle))
			{
				return fillRectangle.Equals(drawingBlipFill2.fillRectangle);
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			return base.GetHashCode() ^ blip.GetHashCode() ^ sourceRectangle.GetHashCode() ^ fillRectangle.GetHashCode();
		}

	public sealed class DrawingFill : IDrawingFill, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged, IUnderlineFill
	{
		public static DrawingFill Automatic = new DrawingFill(DrawingFillType.Automatic);

		public static DrawingFill None = new DrawingFill(DrawingFillType.None);

		public static DrawingFill Group = new DrawingFill(DrawingFillType.Group);

		private DrawingFillType fillType;

		public DrawingFillType FillType => fillType;

		public ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		DrawingUnderlineFillType IUnderlineFill.Type => DrawingUnderlineFillType.Fill;

		event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
			}
			remove
			{
			}
		}

		public static DrawingColor GetColor(IDocumentModel documentModel, IDrawingFill fill)
		{
			if (fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Solid)
			{
				return ((DrawingSolidFill)fill).Color;
			}
			if (fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Pattern)
			{
				return ((DrawingPatternFill)fill).ForegroundColor;
			}
			if (fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Gradient)
			{
				DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill = (DrawingGradientFill)fill;
				if (drawingGradientFill.GradientStops.Count > 0)
				{
					return drawingGradientFill.GradientStops[0].Color;
				}
			}
			return DrawingColor.Create(documentModel, DrawingColorModelInfo.CreateARGB(Color.FromArgb(0, 255, 255, 255)));
		}

		private DrawingFill(DrawingFillType fillType)
		{
			this.fillType = fillType;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingFill drawingFill))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return fillType == drawingFill.fillType;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)fillType;
		}

		public IDrawingFill CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			if (fillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic)
			{
				return Automatic;
			}
			if (fillType == DrawingFillType.None)
			{
				return None;
			}
			return Group;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingFillVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		IUnderlineFill IUnderlineFill.CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return CloneTo(documentModel) as IUnderlineFill;
		}
	}

	public class DrawingGradientStop : ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingGradientStop>
	{
		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly InvalidateProxy innerParent;

		private DrawingColor color;

		private int position;

		public ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerParent.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				innerParent.Target = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Color => color;

		public int Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				ValueChecker.CheckValue(value, 0, 100000, "Position");
				if (position != value)
				{
					SetPosition(value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static DrawingGradientStop Create(IDocumentModel documentModel, Color color, int position)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = new DrawingGradientStop(documentModel);
			drawingGradientStop.AssignProperties(color, position);
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		public DrawingGradientStop(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			color = new DrawingColor(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = innerParent
			};
			position = 0;
		}

		private void SetPosition(int value)
		{
			GradientStopPositionPropertyChangedHistoryItem gradientStopPositionPropertyChangedHistoryItem = new GradientStopPositionPropertyChangedHistoryItem(documentModel.MainPart, this, position, value);
			documentModel.History.Add(gradientStopPositionPropertyChangedHistoryItem);
			gradientStopPositionPropertyChangedHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		protected internal void SetPositionCore(int value)
		{
			position = value;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		private void AssignProperties(Color color, int position)
		{
			this.color = DrawingColor.Create(documentModel, color);
			SetPositionCore(position);
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingGradientStop value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			Color.CopyFrom(value.Color);
			Position = value.Position;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (position == drawingGradientStop.position)
			{
				return color.Equals(drawingGradientStop.color);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return position ^ color.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class GradientStopCollection : UndoableCollection<DrawingGradientStop>
	{
		private readonly InvalidateProxy innerParent;

		protected internal ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerParent.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				innerParent.Target = value;
			}
		}

		public GradientStopCollection(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();
		}

		public override int AddCore(DrawingGradientStop item)
		{
			int result = base.AddCore(item);
			item.Parent = innerParent;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void InsertCore(int index, DrawingGradientStop item)
		{
			base.InsertCore(index, item);
			item.Parent = innerParent;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void RemoveAtCore(int index)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = base[index];
			drawingGradientStop.Parent = null;
			base.RemoveAtCore(index);
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void ClearCore()
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (IEnumerator<DrawingGradientStop> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DrawingGradientStop current = enumerator.Current;
					current.Parent = null;
				}
			}
			base.ClearCore();
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void AddRangeCore(IEnumerable<DrawingGradientStop> collection)
		{
			foreach (DrawingGradientStop item in collection)
			{
				item.Parent = innerParent;
			}
			base.AddRangeCore(collection);
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		internal void AddStopsFromInfoes(IList<GradientStopInfo> infoes)
		{
			int count = infoes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				base.InnerList.Add(infoes[i].CreateStop(base.DocumentModel));
			}
		}

		public override DrawingGradientStop DeserializeItem(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			return reader.GetObject(reader.ReadInt32()) as DrawingGradientStop;
		}
	}

	public class DrawingGradientFillInfo : ICloneable<DrawingGradientFillInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingGradientFillInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private const int offsetGradientFlip = 2;

		private const uint maskGradientType = 3u;

		private const uint maskGradientFlip = 12u;

		private const uint maskRotateWithShape = 16u;

		private const uint maskScaled = 32u;

		private const uint maskUseGradientType = 64u;

		private const uint maskUseGradientFlip = 128u;

		private const uint maskUseAngle = 256u;

		private const uint maskUseRotateWithShape = 512u;

		private const uint maskUseScaled = 1024u;

		private uint packedValues = 16u;

		private int angle;

		public GradientType GradientType
		{
			get
			{
				return (GradientType)PackedValues.GetIntBitValue(packedValues, 3u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetIntBitValue(ref packedValues, 3u, (int)value);
			}
		}

		public TileFlipType Flip
		{
			get
			{
				return (TileFlipType)PackedValues.GetIntBitValue(packedValues, 12u, 2);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetIntBitValue(ref packedValues, 12u, 2, (int)value);
			}
		}

		public bool RotateWithShape
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, 16u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, 16u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool Scaled
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, 32u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, 32u, value);
			}
		}

		public int Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return angle;
			}
			set
			{
				ValueChecker.CheckValue(value, 0, 21600000, "Angle");
				angle = value;
			}
		}

		public bool UseGradientType
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, 64u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, 64u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool UseAngle
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, 256u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, 256u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool UseFlip
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, 128u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, 128u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool UseRotateWithShape
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, 512u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, 512u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool UseScaled
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, 1024u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, 1024u, value);
			}
		}

		internal static DrawingGradientFillInfo Create(GradientType type)
		{
			DrawingGradientFillInfo drawingGradientFillInfo = new DrawingGradientFillInfo();
			drawingGradientFillInfo.UseGradientType = true;
			drawingGradientFillInfo.GradientType = type;
			return drawingGradientFillInfo;
		}

		public DrawingGradientFillInfo Clone()
		{
			DrawingGradientFillInfo drawingGradientFillInfo = new DrawingGradientFillInfo();
			drawingGradientFillInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingGradientFillInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingGradientFillInfo value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			packedValues = value.packedValues;
			angle = value.angle;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingGradientFillInfo drawingGradientFillInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (packedValues == drawingGradientFillInfo.packedValues)
			{
				return angle == drawingGradientFillInfo.angle;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)(packedValues ^ angle);
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			packedValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
			angle = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(packedValues);
			writer.Write(angle);
		}

				drawingGradientFill.SetFillRectCore(new RectangleOffset(num, num, num, num));

		public void AddGradientStop(DrawingGradientStop stop)
		{
			gradientStops.Add(stop);
		}

		public override PropertyKey GetBatchUpdateChangeActions()
		{
			return PropertyKey.Undefined;
		}

		protected internal override UniqueItemsCache<DrawingGradientFillInfo> GetCache(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return base.DrawingCache.DrawingGradientFillInfoCache;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingGradientFill value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			TileRect = value.TileRect;
			FillRect = value.FillRect;
			gradientStops.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < value.GradientStops.Count; i++)
			{
				DrawingGradientStop value2 = value.GradientStops[i];
				DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = new DrawingGradientStop(base.DocumentModel);
				drawingGradientStop.CopyFrom(value2);
				AddGradientStop(drawingGradientStop);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (drawingGradientFill.FillType != DrawingFillType.Gradient)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill2 = drawingGradientFill;
			if (!base.Info.Equals(drawingGradientFill2.Info))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!FillRect.Equals(drawingGradientFill2.FillRect))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TileRect.Equals(drawingGradientFill2.TileRect))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GradientStops.Count != drawingGradientFill2.GradientStops.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < GradientStops.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!GradientStops[i].Equals(drawingGradientFill2.GradientStops[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.Info.GetHashCode() ^ gradientStops.GetHashCode() ^ tileRect.GetHashCode() ^ fillRect.GetHashCode();
		}

		public virtual IDrawingFill CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill = new DrawingGradientFill(documentModel);
			drawingGradientFill.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingGradientFill;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingFillVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		IUnderlineFill IUnderlineFill.CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return CloneTo(documentModel) as IUnderlineFill;
		}
	}
	public class ModelShapeGradientFill : DrawingGradientFill
	{
		private readonly ShapeStyle shapeStyle;

		public ModelShapeGradientFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
			this.shapeStyle = shapeStyle;
		}

		private DrawingGradientFill GetThemeFill()
		{
			IOfficeTheme officeTheme = base.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme;
			if (officeTheme == null || officeTheme.FormatScheme == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return officeTheme.FormatScheme.GetFill(shapeStyle.FillReferenceIdx) as DrawingGradientFill;
		}

		protected override GradientStopCollection GetGradientStops()
		{
			GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = base.GetGradientStops();
			if (gradientStopCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				DrawingGradientFill themeFill = GetThemeFill();
				if (themeFill != null && themeFill.GradientStops.Count > 0)
				{
					return themeFill.GradientStops;
				}
			}
			return gradientStopCollection;
		}

		protected override GradientType GetDefaultGradientType()
		{
			return GetThemeFill()?.GradientType ?? base.GetDefaultGradientType();
		}

		protected override TileFlipType GetDefaultFlip()
		{
			return GetThemeFill()?.Flip ?? base.GetDefaultFlip();
		}

		protected override bool GetDefaultRotateWithShape()
		{
			return GetThemeFill()?.RotateWithShape ?? base.GetDefaultRotateWithShape();
		}

		protected override bool GetDefaultScaled()
		{
			return GetThemeFill()?.Scaled ?? base.GetDefaultScaled();
		}

		protected override int GetDefaultAngle()
		{
			return GetThemeFill()?.Angle ?? base.GetDefaultAngle();
		}

		protected override RectangleOffset GetTileRect()
		{
			RectangleOffset result = base.GetTileRect();
			if (result.Equals(RectangleOffset.Empty))
			{
				DrawingGradientFill themeFill = GetThemeFill();
				if (themeFill != null)
				{
					return themeFill.TileRect;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override RectangleOffset GetFillRect()
		{
			RectangleOffset result = base.GetFillRect();
			if (result.Equals(RectangleOffset.Empty))
			{
				DrawingGradientFill themeFill = GetThemeFill();
				if (themeFill != null)
				{
					return themeFill.FillRect;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override IDrawingFill CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill = new DrawingGradientFill(documentModel);
			drawingGradientFill.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				drawingGradientFill.GradientType = base.GradientType;
				drawingGradientFill.Flip = base.Flip;
				drawingGradientFill.RotateWithShape = base.RotateWithShape;
				drawingGradientFill.Scaled = base.Scaled;
				drawingGradientFill.Angle = base.Angle;
				drawingGradientFill.TileRect = base.TileRect;
				drawingGradientFill.FillRect = base.FillRect;
				foreach (DrawingGradientStop gradientStop in base.GradientStops)
				{
					DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = new DrawingGradientStop(documentModel);
					drawingGradientStop.CopyFrom(gradientStop);
					drawingGradientFill.AddGradientStop(drawingGradientStop);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				drawingGradientFill.EndUpdate();
			}
			return drawingGradientFill;
		}
	}

	public class AdjustableCoordinate : ICloneable<AdjustableCoordinate>, ISupportsCopyFrom<AdjustableCoordinate>
	{
		public double ValueEMU { get; private set; }

		public string GuideName { get; private set; }

		public bool Constant => string.IsNullOrEmpty(GuideName);

		public static AdjustableCoordinate FromString(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			AdjustableCoordinate adjustableCoordinate = new AdjustableCoordinate();
			if (long.TryParse(value, out var result))
			{
				adjustableCoordinate.ValueEMU = result;
			}
			else
			{
				adjustableCoordinate.GuideName = value;
			}
			return adjustableCoordinate;
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate()
		{
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate(double value)
		{
			ValueEMU = value;
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate(double value, string guideName)
		{
			ValueEMU = value;
			GuideName = guideName;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GuideName))
			{
				return GuideName;
			}
			return ValueEMU.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			AdjustableCoordinate adjustableCoordinate = obj as AdjustableCoordinate;
			if (adjustableCoordinate == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ValueEMU == adjustableCoordinate.ValueEMU)
			{
				return string.Equals(GuideName, adjustableCoordinate.GuideName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = ValueEMU.GetHashCode();
			if (GuideName != null)
			{
				num ^= GuideName.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(AdjustableCoordinate coord1, AdjustableCoordinate coord2)
		{
			if ((object)coord1 == null && (object)coord2 == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)coord1 == null || (object)coord2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return coord1.Equals(coord2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(AdjustableCoordinate coord1, AdjustableCoordinate coord2)
		{
			return !(coord1 == coord2);
		}

		public double Evaluate(IShapeGuideCalculator calculator)
		{
			if (!Constant)
			{
				return calculator.GetGuideValue(GuideName);
			}
			return ValueEMU;
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate Clone()
		{
			AdjustableCoordinate adjustableCoordinate = new AdjustableCoordinate();
			adjustableCoordinate.CopyFrom(this);
			return adjustableCoordinate;

			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formula))

				return modelShapeGuideFormula;
			}
			string[] array = formula.Split(" ".ToCharArray(), StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return modelShapeGuideFormula;
			}
			string value = array[0];
			string value2 = ((array.Length >= 2) ? array[1] : string.Empty);
			string value3 = ((array.Length >= 3) ? array[2] : string.Empty);
			string value4 = ((array.Length >= 4) ? array[3] : string.Empty);
			modelShapeGuideFormula.Type = GetFormulaTypeFromString(value);
			modelShapeGuideFormula.Argument1 = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(value2);
			modelShapeGuideFormula.Argument2 = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(value3);
			modelShapeGuideFormula.Argument3 = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(value4);

		}

		}

	public class AdjustableAngle : ICloneable<AdjustableAngle>, ISupportsCopyFrom<AdjustableAngle>

		public string GuideName { get; private set; }

		public bool Constant => string.IsNullOrEmpty(GuideName);

		public static AdjustableAngle FromString(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			AdjustableAngle adjustableAngle = new AdjustableAngle();
			if (int.TryParse(value, out var result))
			{
				adjustableAngle.Value = result;
			}
			else
			{
				adjustableAngle.GuideName = value;
			}
			return adjustableAngle;
		}

		public AdjustableAngle()
		{
		}

		public AdjustableAngle(double value)
		{
			Value = value;
		}

		public AdjustableAngle(double value, string guideName)
		{
			Value = value;
			GuideName = guideName;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GuideName))
			{
				return GuideName;
			}
			return Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			AdjustableAngle adjustableAngle = obj as AdjustableAngle;
			if (adjustableAngle == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Value == adjustableAngle.Value)
			{
				return string.Equals(GuideName, adjustableAngle.GuideName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = Value.GetHashCode();
			if (GuideName != null)
			{
				num ^= GuideName.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(AdjustableAngle angle1, AdjustableAngle angle2)
		{
			if ((object)angle1 == null && (object)angle2 == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)angle1 == null || (object)angle2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return angle1.Equals(angle2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(AdjustableAngle angle1, AdjustableAngle angle2)
		{
			return !(angle1 == angle2);
		}

		public double Evaluate(IShapeGuideCalculator calculator)
		{
			if (!Constant)
			{
				return calculator.GetGuideValue(GuideName);
			}
			return Value;
		}

		public AdjustableAngle Clone()
		{
			AdjustableAngle adjustableAngle = new AdjustableAngle();
			adjustableAngle.CopyFrom(this);
			return adjustableAngle;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(AdjustableAngle value)
		{
			Value = value.Value;
			GuideName = value.GuideName;
		}

		{

			if (adjustablePoint == null)
			{
				return false;

			if (X == adjustablePoint.X)
			{
				return Y == adjustablePoint.Y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			return GetHashCodeCore();
		}

		{

		public XYAdjustHandle()
		{
		}

		public XYAdjustHandle(string gdRefX, string minX, string maxX, string gdRefY, string minY, string maxY, string x, string y)
		{
			HorizontalGuide = gdRefX;
			VerticalGuide = gdRefY;
			MinX = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(minX);
			MaxX = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(maxX);
			MinY = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(minY);
			MaxY = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(maxY);
			base.X = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(x);
			base.Y = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(y);
		}

		public XYAdjustHandle(string gdRefX, AdjustableCoordinate minX, AdjustableCoordinate maxX, string gdRefY, AdjustableCoordinate minY, AdjustableCoordinate maxY, AdjustableCoordinate x, AdjustableCoordinate y)
		{
			HorizontalGuide = gdRefX;
			VerticalGuide = gdRefY;
			MinX = minX;
			MaxX = maxX;
			MinY = minY;
			MaxY = maxY;
			base.X = x;
			base.Y = y;
		}

		internal override void ExportToXml(XmlWriter documentContentWriter)
		{
			OpenXmlDrawingExportHelper.ExportXYAdjustHandle(documentContentWriter, this);
		}

		protected override AdjustablePoint CreateEmptyClone()
		{
			return new XYAdjustHandle();
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(AdjustablePoint value)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			XYAdjustHandle xYAdjustHandle = value as XYAdjustHandle;
			if (!(xYAdjustHandle == null))
			{
				HorizontalGuide = xYAdjustHandle.HorizontalGuide;
				VerticalGuide = xYAdjustHandle.VerticalGuide;
				MinX = xYAdjustHandle.MinX?.Clone();
				MaxX = xYAdjustHandle.MaxX?.Clone();
				MinY = xYAdjustHandle.MinY?.Clone();
				MaxY = xYAdjustHandle.MaxY?.Clone();
			}
		}

		protected override bool EqualsCore(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.EqualsCore(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			XYAdjustHandle xYAdjustHandle = obj as XYAdjustHandle;
			if (xYAdjustHandle == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (horizontalGuide == xYAdjustHandle.horizontalGuide && verticalGuide == xYAdjustHandle.verticalGuide && minX == xYAdjustHandle.minX && maxX == xYAdjustHandle.maxX && minY == xYAdjustHandle.minY)
			{
				return maxY == xYAdjustHandle.maxY;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override int GetHashCodeCore()
		{
			int hashCodeCore = base.GetHashCodeCore();
			return HashCodeHelper.Calculate(hashCodeCore, HorizontalGuide?.GetHashCode() ?? 0, VerticalGuide?.GetHashCode() ?? 0, MinX?.GetHashCode() ?? 0, MaxX?.GetHashCode() ?? 0, MinY?.GetHashCode() ?? 0, MaxY?.GetHashCode() ?? 0);
		}
	}

	public class ModelShapePath : ICloneable<ModelShapePath>, ISupportsCopyFrom<ModelShapePath>
	{
		private IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart;

		private long width;

		private long height;

		private PathFillMode fillMode;

		private bool stroke;

		private bool extrusionOK;

		public long Width
		{
			get
			{
				return width;
			}
			set
			{
				long num = Width;
				if (num != value)
				{
					ActionLongHistoryItem actionLongHistoryItem = new ActionLongHistoryItem(documentModelPart, num, value, SetWidth);
					documentModelPart.DocumentModel.History.Add(actionLongHistoryItem);
					actionLongHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public long Height
		{
			get
			{
				return height;
			}
			set
			{
				long num = Height;
				if (num != value)
				{
					ActionLongHistoryItem actionLongHistoryItem = new ActionLongHistoryItem(documentModelPart, num, value, SetHeight);
					documentModelPart.DocumentModel.History.Add(actionLongHistoryItem);
					actionLongHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public PathFillMode FillMode
		{
			get
			{
				return fillMode;
			}
			set
			{
				PathFillMode pathFillMode = fillMode;
				if (pathFillMode != value)
				{
					ModelShapePathFillModeHistoryItem modelShapePathFillModeHistoryItem = new ModelShapePathFillModeHistoryItem(this, pathFillMode, value);
					documentModelPart.DocumentModel.History.Add(modelShapePathFillModeHistoryItem);
					modelShapePathFillModeHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Stroke
		{
			get
			{
				return stroke;
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = stroke;
				if (flag != value)
				{
					ActionBooleanHistoryItem actionBooleanHistoryItem = new ActionBooleanHistoryItem(documentModelPart, flag, value, SetStroke);
					documentModelPart.DocumentModel.History.Add(actionBooleanHistoryItem);
					actionBooleanHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ExtrusionOK
		{
			get
			{
				return extrusionOK;
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = ExtrusionOK;
				if (flag != value)
				{
					ActionBooleanHistoryItem actionBooleanHistoryItem = new ActionBooleanHistoryItem(documentModelPart, flag, value, SetExtrusionOK);
					documentModelPart.DocumentModel.History.Add(actionBooleanHistoryItem);
					actionBooleanHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public IDocumentModelPart DocumentModelPart => documentModelPart;

		public ModelPathInstructionList Instructions { get; private set; }

		private void SetWidth(long width)
		{
			this.width = width;
		}

		private void SetHeight(long height)
		{
			this.height = height;
		}

		internal void SetFillMode(PathFillMode fillMode)
		{
			this.fillMode = fillMode;
		}

		private void SetStroke(bool stroke)
		{
			this.stroke = stroke;
		}

		private void SetExtrusionOK(bool extrusionOK)
		{
			this.extrusionOK = extrusionOK;
		}

		public ModelShapePath(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			this.documentModelPart = documentModelPart;
			SetFillMode(PathFillMode.Norm);
			SetStroke(stroke: true);
			SetExtrusionOK(extrusionOK: true);
			Instructions = new ModelPathInstructionList(documentModelPart);
		}

		public ModelShapePath Clone()
		{
			return Clone(copyInstructions: true);
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ModelShapePath value)
		{
			CopyFrom(value, copyInstructions: true);
		}

		public ModelShapePath Clone(bool copyInstructions)
		{
			ModelShapePath modelShapePath = new ModelShapePath(documentModelPart);
			modelShapePath.CopyFrom(this, copyInstructions);
			return modelShapePath;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ModelShapePath value, bool copyInstructions)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "ModelShapePath");
			width = value.Width;
			height = value.Height;
			fillMode = value.FillMode;
			stroke = value.Stroke;
			extrusionOK = value.ExtrusionOK;
			if (copyInstructions)
			{
				Instructions.CopyFrom(value.Instructions);
			}
		}
	}

	public class PathCubicBezier : IDocumentModelObject, IPathInstruction, ICloneable<IPathInstruction>, ISupportsCopyFrom<PathCubicBezier>

			this.documentModelPart = documentModelPart;

		}

		public PathCubicBezier(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart, string x1, string y1, string x2, string y2, string x3, string y3)
			: this(documentModelPart)
		{
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(x1, y1));
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(x2, y2));
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(x3, y3));
		}

		public PathCubicBezier(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart, AdjustableCoordinate x1, AdjustableCoordinate y1, AdjustableCoordinate x2, AdjustableCoordinate y2, AdjustableCoordinate x3, AdjustableCoordinate y3)
			: this(documentModelPart)
		{
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(x1, y1));
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(x2, y2));
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(x3, y3));
		}

		public PathCubicBezier(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2, double x3, double y3)
			: this(documentModelPart)
		{
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(new AdjustableCoordinate(x1), new AdjustableCoordinate(y1)));
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(new AdjustableCoordinate(x2), new AdjustableCoordinate(y2)));
			Points.AddCore(new AdjustablePoint(new AdjustableCoordinate(x3), new AdjustableCoordinate(y3)));
		}

		public void Visit(IPathInstructionWalker visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public IPathInstruction Clone()
		{
			PathCubicBezier pathCubicBezier = new PathCubicBezier(documentModelPart);
			pathCubicBezier.CopyFrom(this);
			return pathCubicBezier;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(PathCubicBezier value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "PathCubicBezier");
			Points.CopyFrom(value.Points);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ModelObjectUndoableCollection<T> : UndoableCollection<T> where T : IDocumentModelObject
	{
		public ModelObjectUndoableCollection(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
			: base(documentModelPart)
		{
		}

		public override int AddCore(T item)
		{
			item.DocumentModelPart = base.DocumentModelPart;
			return base.AddCore(item);
		}

		public override void AddRangeCore(IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			foreach (T item in collection)
			{
				T current = item;
				current.DocumentModelPart = base.DocumentModelPart;
			}
			base.AddRangeCore(collection);
		}

		protected internal override void InsertCore(int index, T item)
		{
			item.DocumentModelPart = base.DocumentModelPart;
			base.InsertCore(index, item);
		}

		public override void RemoveAtCore(int index)
		{
			T val = base[index];
			val.DocumentModelPart = null;
			base.RemoveAtCore(index);
		}

		public override void ClearCore()
		{
			ForEach(delegate(T i)
			{
				i.DocumentModelPart = null;
			});
			base.ClearCore();
		}
	}

	public class ModelShapeGuide : IDocumentModelObject, ICloneable<ModelShapeGuide>, ISupportsCopyFrom<ModelShapeGuide>
	{

		public ModelShapeGuideFormula Formula
		{
			get
			{
				return formula;
			}
			set
			{
				ModelShapeGuideFormula modelShapeGuideFormula = Formula;
				if (modelShapeGuideFormula != value)
				{
					if (DocumentModelPart == null)
					{
						SetFormula(value);
						return;
					}
					ModelShapeGuideFormulaHistoryItem modelShapeGuideFormulaHistoryItem = new ModelShapeGuideFormulaHistoryItem(this, modelShapeGuideFormula, value);
					DocumentModelPart.DocumentModel.History.Add(modelShapeGuideFormulaHistoryItem);
					modelShapeGuideFormulaHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				string text = Name;
				if (!(text == value))
				{
					if (DocumentModelPart == null)
					{
						SetName(value);
						return;
					}
					ActionStringHistoryItem actionStringHistoryItem = new ActionStringHistoryItem(DocumentModelPart, text, value, SetName);
					DocumentModelPart.DocumentModel.History.Add(actionStringHistoryItem);
					actionStringHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public IDocumentModelPart DocumentModelPart { get; set; }

		internal void SetFormula(ModelShapeGuideFormula formula)
		{
			this.formula = formula;
		}

		private void SetName(string name)
		{
			this.name = name;
		}

		public ModelShapeGuide()
		{
		}

		public ModelShapeGuide(string name, string formula)
		{
			Name = name;
			Formula = ModelShapeGuideFormula.FromString(formula);
		}

		public ModelShapeGuide(string name, ModelShapeGuideFormula formula)
		{
			Name = name;
			Formula = formula;
		}

		public ModelShapeGuide Clone()
		{
			ModelShapeGuide modelShapeGuide = new ModelShapeGuide();
			modelShapeGuide.CopyFrom(this);
			return modelShapeGuide;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ModelShapeGuide value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "ModelShapeGuide");
			if (value.Formula == null)
			{
				Formula = null;
			}
			else if (Formula == null)
			{
				Formula = value.Formula.Clone();
			}
			else
			{
				Formula.CopyFrom(value.Formula);
			}
			Name = value.Name;
		}

	public class AdjustableRect : ICloneable<AdjustableRect>, ISupportsCopyFrom<AdjustableRect>, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey LeftPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(0);

		public static readonly PropertyKey TopPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey RightPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		public static readonly PropertyKey BottomPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(3);

		private const int idxLeft = 0;

		private const int idxRight = 1;

		private const int idxTop = 2;

		private const int idxBottom = 3;

		private AdjustableCoordinate[] coordinates = new AdjustableCoordinate[4];

		private readonly PropertyChangedNotifier notifier;

		protected AdjustableCoordinate[] Coordinates => coordinates;

		public AdjustableCoordinate Left
		{
			get
			{
				return coordinates[0];
			}
			set
			{
				SetCoordinate(0, value);
			}
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate Right
		{
			get
			{
				return coordinates[1];
			}
			set
			{
				SetCoordinate(1, value);
			}
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate Top
		{
			get
			{
				return coordinates[2];
			}
			set
			{
				SetCoordinate(2, value);
			}
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return coordinates[3];
			}
			set
			{
				SetCoordinate(3, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
		}

		public AdjustableRect()
		{
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetCoordinate(int index, AdjustableCoordinate value)
		{
			SetCoordinateCore(index, value);
		}

		protected void SetCoordinateCore(int index, AdjustableCoordinate coordinate)
		{
			coordinates[index] = coordinate;
			PropertyKey propertyKey = index switch
			{
				1 => RightPropertyKey, 
				2 => TopPropertyKey, 
				0 => LeftPropertyKey, 
				_ => BottomPropertyKey, 
			};
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(propertyKey);
		}

		public void FromDoubles(double left, double top, double right, double bottom)
		{
			coordinates[0] = new AdjustableCoordinate(left);
			coordinates[1] = new AdjustableCoordinate(right);
			coordinates[2] = new AdjustableCoordinate(top);
			coordinates[3] = new AdjustableCoordinate(bottom);
		}

		public void FromString(string left, string top, string right, string bottom)
		{
			coordinates[0] = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(left);
			coordinates[1] = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(right);
			coordinates[2] = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(top);
			coordinates[3] = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(bottom);
		}

		public bool IsEmpty()
		{
			if (!(Left == null) && !(Right == null) && !(Top == null))
			{
				return Bottom == null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public AdjustableRect Clone()
		{
			AdjustableRect adjustableRect = new AdjustableRect();
			adjustableRect.CopyFrom(this);
			return adjustableRect;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(AdjustableRect value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "AdjustableRect");
			Left = value.Left;
			Right = value.Right;
			Top = value.Top;
			Bottom = value.Bottom;
		}
	}

			if (!(adjustableCoordinate == value))
			{
				base.SetCoordinate(index, value);
				ModelAdjustableRectHistoryItem modelAdjustableRectHistoryItem = new ModelAdjustableRectHistoryItem(this, index, adjustableCoordinate, value);
				DocumentModelPart.DocumentModel.History.Add(modelAdjustableRectHistoryItem);
				modelAdjustableRectHistoryItem.Execute();
			}
		}
	}

	public static class GeometryCalculator
	{
		private class PathWalker : IPathInstructionWalker
		{
			private ModelPathInstructionList result;

			private ShapeGuideCalculator guideCalculator;

			private double lastX;

			private double lastY;

			public PathWalker(ShapeGuideCalculator guideCalculator)
			{
				this.guideCalculator = guideCalculator;
			}

			public void Walk(ModelShapePath path, ModelPathInstructionList result)
			{
				this.result = result;
				foreach (IPathInstruction instruction in path.Instructions)
				{
					instruction.Visit(this);
				}
			}

			private static double[] ArcToBeziers(double centerX, double centerY, double wR, double hR, double startAngle, double swingAngle)
			{
				List<double> list = new List<double>();
				double angle = startAngle + swingAngle;
				startAngle = UnstretchAngle(startAngle, wR, hR);
				angle = UnstretchAngle(angle, wR, hR);
				double num = startAngle;
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					double num2 = Math.PI / 2.0;
					double endAngle;
					if (swingAngle > 0.0)
					{
						if (num >= angle)
						{
							break;
						}
						endAngle = Math.Min(num + num2, angle);
					}
					else
					{
						if (num <= angle)
						{
							break;
						}
						endAngle = Math.Max(num - num2, angle);
					}
					List<double> collection = ArcToBezierCore(centerX, centerY, wR, hR, num, endAngle, i == 0);
					list.AddRange(collection);
					num += num2 * ((swingAngle < 0.0) ? (-1.0) : 1.0);
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}

			private static double UnstretchAngle(double angle, double wR, double hR)
			{
				double num = DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(angle);
				double num2 = Math.Cos(num);
				double num3 = Math.Sin(num);
				if (Math.Abs(num2) < 1E-05 || Math.Abs(num3) < 1E-05)
				{
					return num;
				}
				double num4 = Math.Atan2(num3 / Math.Abs(hR), num2 / Math.Abs(wR));
				double num5 = Math.Round(num / (Math.PI * 2.0) - Math.Round(num4 / (Math.PI * 2.0)));
				return num4 + num5 * 2.0 * Math.PI;
			}

			private static List<double> ArcToBezierCore(double centerX, double centerY, double wR, double hR, double startAngle, double endAngle, bool firstPart)
			{
				List<double> list = new List<double>();
				double num = Math.Cos(startAngle);
				double num2 = Math.Sin(startAngle);
				double num3 = Math.Cos(endAngle);
				double num4 = Math.Sin(endAngle);
				double num5 = (endAngle - startAngle) / 2.0;
				double num6 = 1.3333333333333333 * (1.0 - Math.Cos(num5)) / Math.Sin(num5);
				if (firstPart)
				{
					list.Add(num);
					list.Add(num2);
				}
				list.Add(num - num6 * num2);
				list.Add(num2 + num6 * num);
				list.Add(num3 + num6 * num4);
				list.Add(num4 - num6 * num3);
				list.Add(num3);
				list.Add(num4);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count / 2; i++)
				{
					list[i * 2] = list[i * 2] * wR + centerX;
					list[i * 2 + 1] = list[i * 2 + 1] * hR + centerY;
				}
				return list;
			}

			public void Visit(PathArc pathArc)
			{
				double num = pathArc.HeightRadius.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				double num2 = pathArc.WidthRadius.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				double num3 = DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(pathArc.StartAngle.Evaluate(guideCalculator));
				double swingAngle = DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(pathArc.SwingAngle.Evaluate(guideCalculator));
				double num4 = Math.Cos(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(num3));
				double num5 = Math.Sin(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(num3));
				double num6 = num * num2 / Math.Sqrt(num * num * num4 * num4 + num2 * num2 * num5 * num5);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num6))
				{
					double centerX = lastX - num6 * num4;
					double centerY = lastY - num6 * num5;
					double[] array = ArcToBeziers(centerX, centerY, num2, num, num3, swingAngle);
					int num7 = array.Length;
					for (int i = 0; i + 7 < num7; i += 6)
					{
						result.AddCore(new PathCubicBezier(pathArc.DocumentModelPart, array[i + 2], array[i + 3], array[i + 4], array[i + 5], array[i + 6], array[i + 7]));
					}
					if (num7 > 1)
					{
						lastX = array[num7 - 2];
						lastY = array[num7 - 1];
					}
				}
			}

			public void Visit(PathClose pathClose)
			{
				result.AddCore(new PathClose());
			}

			public void Visit(PathCubicBezier pathCubicBezier)
			{
				double[] array = new double[pathCubicBezier.Points.Count];
				double[] array2 = new double[pathCubicBezier.Points.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < pathCubicBezier.Points.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = pathCubicBezier.Points[i].X.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
					array2[i] = pathCubicBezier.Points[i].Y.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				}
				result.AddCore(new PathCubicBezier(pathCubicBezier.DocumentModelPart, array[0], array2[0], array[1], array2[1], array[2], array2[2]));
				lastX = array[2];
				lastY = array2[2];
			}

			public void Visit(PathLine pathLine)
			{
				double x = pathLine.Point.X.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				double y = pathLine.Point.Y.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				result.AddCore(new PathLine(x, y));
				lastX = x;
				lastY = y;
			}

			public void Visit(PathMove pathMove)
			{
				double x = pathMove.Point.X.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				double y = pathMove.Point.Y.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				result.AddCore(new PathMove(x, y));
				lastX = x;
				lastY = y;
			}

			public void Visit(PathQuadraticBezier pathQuadraticBezier)
			{
				double[] array = new double[3];
				double[] array2 = new double[3];
				double[] array3 = new double[4];
				double[] array4 = new double[4];
				array[0] = lastX;
				array2[0] = lastY;
				for (int i = 1; i < 3; i++)
				{
					array[i] = pathQuadraticBezier.Points[i - 1].X.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
					array2[i] = pathQuadraticBezier.Points[i - 1].Y.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				}
				array3[0] = array[0];
				array4[0] = array2[0];
				array3[1] = array[0] + 2.0 * (array[1] - array[0]) / 3.0;
				array4[1] = array2[0] + 2.0 * (array2[1] - array2[0]) / 3.0;
				array3[2] = array[2] + 2.0 * (array[1] - array[2]) / 3.0;
				array4[2] = array2[2] + 2.0 * (array2[1] - array2[2]) / 3.0;
				array3[3] = array[2];
				array4[3] = array2[2];
				lastX = array3[3];
				lastY = array4[3];
				result.AddCore(new PathCubicBezier(pathQuadraticBezier.DocumentModelPart, array3[1], array4[1], array3[2], array4[2], array3[3], array4[3]));
			}
		}

		public static ModelShapeCustomGeometry Calculate(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, double widthEMU, double heightEMU, ModelShapeGuideList presetAdjustList)
		{
			ShapeGuideCalculator guideCalculator = new ShapeGuideCalculator(geometry, widthEMU, heightEMU, presetAdjustList);
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry modelShapeCustomGeometry = new ModelShapeCustomGeometry(geometry.DocumentModelPart);
			CalculatePaths(geometry.Paths, modelShapeCustomGeometry.Paths, guideCalculator);
			CalculateTextRect(geometry.ShapeTextRectangle, guideCalculator, modelShapeCustomGeometry.ShapeTextRectangle);
			CalculateConnectionSites(geometry.ConnectionSites, guideCalculator, modelShapeCustomGeometry.ConnectionSites);
			return modelShapeCustomGeometry;
		}

		private static void CalculatePaths(ModelShapePathsList etalonPaths, ModelShapePathsList resultPathList, ShapeGuideCalculator guideCalculator)
		{
			PathWalker pathWalker = new PathWalker(guideCalculator);
			foreach (ModelShapePath etalonPath in etalonPaths)
			{
				ModelShapePath modelShapePath = etalonPath.Clone(copyInstructions: false);
				pathWalker.Walk(etalonPath, modelShapePath.Instructions);
				resultPathList.AddCore(modelShapePath);
			}
		}

		private static void CalculateTextRect(AdjustableRect etalonRect, ShapeGuideCalculator guideCalculator, AdjustableRect resultRect)
		{
			if (etalonRect != null && !etalonRect.IsEmpty())
			{
				double left = etalonRect.Left.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				double top = etalonRect.Top.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				double right = etalonRect.Right.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				double bottom = etalonRect.Bottom.Evaluate(guideCalculator);
				resultRect.FromDoubles(left, top, right, bottom);
			}
		}

		private static void CalculateConnectionSites(ModelShapeConnectionList etalonConnections, ShapeGuideCalculator guideCalculator, ModelShapeConnectionList resultList)
		{
			foreach (ModelShapeConnection etalonConnection in etalonConnections)
			{
				ModelShapeConnection modelShapeConnection = new ModelShapeConnection();
				modelShapeConnection.Angle = new AdjustableAngle(etalonConnection.Angle.Evaluate(guideCalculator));
				modelShapeConnection.X = new AdjustableCoordinate(etalonConnection.X.Evaluate(guideCalculator));
				modelShapeConnection.Y = new AdjustableCoordinate(etalonConnection.Y.Evaluate(guideCalculator));
				resultList.AddCore(modelShapeConnection);
			}
		}
	}

		public static ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetCustomGeometryByPreset(ShapePreset shapeType)
		{
			lock (calculatedGeometries)
			{
				return GetCustomGeometryByPresetCore(shapeType);
			}
		}

		private static ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetCustomGeometryByPresetCore(ShapePreset shapeType)
		{
			if (calculatedGeometries.TryGetValue(shapeType, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (!geometrysGenerators.TryGetValue(shapeType, out var value2))
			{
				return GetCustomGeometryByPresetCore(ShapePreset.Rect);
			}
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry modelShapeCustomGeometry = value2();
			calculatedGeometries.Add(shapeType, modelShapeCustomGeometry);
			return modelShapeCustomGeometry;
		}

	public interface IShapeGuideCalculator
	{
		double GetGuideValue(string guideName);
	}
	public class ShapeGuideCalculator : IShapeGuideCalculator
	{
		private static readonly List<ModelShapeGuide> builtinGuides = PopulateBuiltInGuides();

		private readonly Dictionary<string, double> guides;

		private readonly ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry;

		private Dictionary<string, double> Guides => guides;

		private ModelShapeCustomGeometry Geometry => geometry;

		private static List<ModelShapeGuide> PopulateBuiltInGuides()
		{
			List<ModelShapeGuide> list = new List<ModelShapeGuide>();
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("hc", "*/ w 1 2"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("hd2", "*/ h 1 2"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("hd3", "*/ h 1 3"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("hd4", "*/ h 1 4"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("hd5", "*/ h 1 5"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("hd6", "*/ h 1 6"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("hd8", "*/ h 1 8"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("hd10", "*/ h 1 10"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ls", "max w h"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ss", "min w h"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ssd2", "*/ ss 1 2"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ssd4", "*/ ss 1 4"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ssd6", "*/ ss 1 6"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ssd8", "*/ ss 1 8"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ssd16", "*/ ss 1 16"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ssd32", "*/ ss 1 32"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("vc", "*/ h 1 2"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd2", "*/ w 1 2"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd3", "*/ w 1 3"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd4", "*/ w 1 4"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd5", "*/ w 1 5"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd6", "*/ w 1 6"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd8", "*/ w 1 8"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd10", "*/ w 1 10"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd12", "*/ w 1 12"));
			list.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("wd32", "*/ w 1 32"));
			return list;
		}

		public ShapeGuideCalculator(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, double widthEmu, double heightEmu, ModelShapeGuideList presetAdjustList)
			: this(geometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, presetAdjustList, ignoreCase: false)
		{
		}

		public ShapeGuideCalculator(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, double widthEmu, double heightEmu, ModelShapeGuideList presetAdjustList, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			guides = (ignoreCase ? new Dictionary<string, double>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) : new Dictionary<string, double>());
			this.geometry = geometry;
			PopulateConstantGuides();
			Guides.Add("h", heightEmu);
			Guides.Add("w", widthEmu);
			Guides.Add("b", heightEmu);
			Guides.Add("r", widthEmu);
			CalculateGuides(presetAdjustList);
		}

		private void CalculateGuides(ModelShapeGuideList presetAdjustList)
		{
			foreach (ModelShapeGuide builtinGuide in builtinGuides)
			{
				CalculateGuide(builtinGuide);
			}
			foreach (ModelShapeGuide adjustValue in Geometry.AdjustValues)
			{
				CalculateGuide(adjustValue);
			}
			if (presetAdjustList != null)
			{
				foreach (ModelShapeGuide presetAdjust in presetAdjustList)
				{
					CalculateGuide(presetAdjust);
				}
			}
			foreach (ModelShapeGuide guide in Geometry.Guides)
			{
				CalculateGuide(guide);
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateGuide(ModelShapeGuide guide)
		{
			double value = 0.0;
			try
			{
				ModelShapeGuideFormula formula = guide.Formula;
				double num = ((formula.Argument1 != null) ? formula.Argument1.Evaluate(this) : 0.0);
				double num2 = ((formula.Argument2 != null) ? formula.Argument2.Evaluate(this) : 0.0);
				double num3 = ((formula.Argument3 != null) ? formula.Argument3.Evaluate(this) : 0.0);
				switch (formula.Type)
				{
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.MultiplyDivide:
					value = ProcessMultiplyDivide(num, num2, num3);
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.AddSubtract:
					value = num + num2 - num3;
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.AddDivide:
					value = ProcessAddDivide(num, num2, num3);
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.IfElse:
					value = ((num > 0.0) ? num2 : num3);
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Abs:
					value = Math.Abs(num);
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.ArcTan:
				{
					double a = ((num == 0.0) ? Math.Atan(num2) : Math.Atan2(num2, num));
					value = RadianToEMUDegree(a);
					break;
				}
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.CosArcTan:
				{
					double a = ((num2 == 0.0) ? Math.Atan(num3) : Math.Atan2(num3, num2));
					value = num * Math.Cos(a);
					break;
				}
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Cos:
					value = num * Math.Cos(EMUDegreeToRadian(num2));
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Max:
					value = Math.Max(num, num2);
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Min:
					value = Math.Min(num, num2);
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Mod:
					value = Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2 + num3 * num3);
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Pin:
					value = ((num2 < num) ? num : ((num2 > num3) ? num3 : num2));
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.SinArcTan:
				{
					double a = ((num2 == 0.0) ? Math.Atan(num3) : Math.Atan2(num3, num2));
					value = num * Math.Sin(a);
					break;
				}
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Sin:
					value = num * Math.Sin(EMUDegreeToRadian(num2));
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Sqrt:
					value = ProcessSqrt(num);
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Tan:
					value = num * Math.Tan(EMUDegreeToRadian(num2));
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Value:
					value = num;
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Mid:
					value = (num + num2) / 2.0;
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.SumAngle:
					value = num + num2 * 65536.0 - num3 * 65536.0;
					break;
				case ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Ellipse:
					value = num3 * Math.Sqrt(1.0 - Math.Pow((num2 == 0.0) ? num : (num / num2), 2.0));
					break;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				value = 0.0;
			}
			if (Guides.ContainsKey(guide.Name))
			{
				Guides.Remove(guide.Name);
			}
			Guides.Add(guide.Name, value);
		}

		protected virtual double ProcessSqrt(double x)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Abs(x));
		}

		protected virtual double ProcessAddDivide(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			if (z != 0.0)
			{
				return (x + y) / z;
			}
			return x + y;
		}

		protected virtual double ProcessMultiplyDivide(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			if (z != 0.0)
			{
				return x * y / z;
			}
			return x * y;
		}

		private void PopulateConstantGuides()
		{
			Guides.Add("3cd4", 16200000.0);
			Guides.Add("3cd8", 8100000.0);
			Guides.Add("5cd8", 13500000.0);
			Guides.Add("7cd8", 18900000.0);
			Guides.Add("cd2", 10800000.0);
			Guides.Add("cd3", 7200000.0);
			Guides.Add("cd4", 5400000.0);
			Guides.Add("cd8", 2700000.0);
			Guides.Add("l", 0.0);
			Guides.Add("t", 0.0);
		}

		public double GetGuideValue(string guideName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(guideName))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(guideName, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (Guides.TryGetValue(guideName, out result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public static double EMUDegreeToRadian(double degree)
		{
			return degree / 60000.0 / 180.0 * Math.PI;
		}

		public static double RadianToEMUDegree(double radian)
		{
			return radian / Math.PI * 180.0 * 60000.0;
		}
	}
	public class VmlShapeGuideCalculator : ShapeGuideCalculator
	{
		public VmlShapeGuideCalculator(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, double widthEmu, double heightEmu, ModelShapeGuideList presetAdjustList)
			: base(geometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, presetAdjustList)
		{
		}

		protected override double ProcessMultiplyDivide(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			double a = base.ProcessMultiplyDivide(x, y, z);
			return Math.Ceiling(a);
		}

		protected override double ProcessAddDivide(double x, double y, double z)
		{
			double d = base.ProcessAddDivide(x, y, z);
			return Math.Truncate(d);
		}

		protected override double ProcessSqrt(double x)
		{
			double d = base.ProcessSqrt(x);
			return Math.Floor(d);
		}
	}

	public class CommonDrawingLocksInfo : ICloneable<CommonDrawingLocksInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<CommonDrawingLocksInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf, IEquatable<CommonDrawingLocksInfo>, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private const uint MaskNoGroup = 1u;

		private const uint MaskNoSelect = 2u;

		private const uint MaskNoRotate = 4u;

		private const uint MaskNoChangeAspect = 8u;

		private const uint MaskNoMove = 16u;

		private const uint MaskNoResize = 32u;

		private const uint MaskNoEditPoints = 64u;

		private const uint MaskNoAdjustHandles = 128u;

		private const uint MaskNoChangeArrowheads = 256u;

		private const uint MaskNoChangeShapeType = 512u;

		private const uint MaskNoTextEdit = 1024u;

		private const uint MaskNoCrop = 2048u;

		private const uint MaskNoDrillDown = 4096u;

		private const uint MaskNoUngroup = 8192u;

		private uint packedValues;

		public bool NoGroup
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, 1u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, 1u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool NoSelect
		{

			}

		public bool IsEmpty()
		{
			return packedValues == 0;
		}

		public CommonDrawingLocksInfo Clone()
		{
			CommonDrawingLocksInfo commonDrawingLocksInfo = new CommonDrawingLocksInfo();
			commonDrawingLocksInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return commonDrawingLocksInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(CommonDrawingLocksInfo value)
		{
			packedValues = value.packedValues;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj.GetType() != GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((CommonDrawingLocksInfo)obj);
		}

		public bool Equals(CommonDrawingLocksInfo other)
		{
			if (other != null)
			{
				return packedValues == other.packedValues;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)packedValues;
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			packedValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(packedValues);
		}
	}
