	public class OutlineInfo : ICloneable<OutlineInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<OutlineInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private static readonly OutlineInfo defaultInfo = new OutlineInfo();

		private const uint MaskJoinStyle = 3u;

		private const uint MaskDashing = 60u;

		private const uint MaskHeadLength = 192u;

		private const uint MaskHeadWidth = 768u;

		private const uint MaskTailLength = 3072u;

		private const uint MaskTailWidth = 12288u;

		private const uint MaskHeadType = 114688u;

		private const uint MaskTailType = 917504u;

		private const uint MaskStrokeAlignment = 3145728u;

		private const uint MaskEndCapStyle = 12582912u;

		private const uint MaskCompoundType = 117440512u;

		private const uint MaskHasLineJoinStyle = 134217728u;

		private const uint MaskHasCompoundType = 268435456u;

		private const uint MaskHasDashing = 536870912u;

		private const uint MaskHasWidth = 1073741824u;

		private uint packedValues = 8394050u;

		private uint packedValues2;

		private const uint MaskHasHeadLength = 1u;

		private const uint MaskHasHeadWidth = 2u;

		private const uint MaskHasTailLength = 4u;

		private const uint MaskHasTailWidth = 8u;

		private const uint MaskHasHeadType = 16u;

		private const uint MaskHasTailType = 32u;

		private const uint MaskHasStrokeAlignment = 64u;

		private const uint MaskHasEndCapStyle = 128u;

		private const uint MaskHasMiterLimit = 256u;

		private int width;

		private int miterLimit = 800000;

		public static OutlineInfo DefaultInfo => defaultInfo;

		public static OutlineHeadTailSize DefaultHeadTailSize => OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium;

		public static OutlineHeadTailType DefaultHeadTailType => OutlineHeadTailType.None;

		public LineJoinStyle JoinStyle
		{
			get

				return (LineJoinStyle)GetUIntValue(3u, 0);
			}
			set
			{
				SetUIntValue(3u, 0, (uint)value);
			}
		}

		public OutlineDashing Dashing

			{
				return (OutlineDashing)GetUIntValue(60u, 2);

		{
			get

				return miterLimit;
			}
			set
			{
				miterLimit = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefaultHeadEndStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (HeadLength == DefaultInfo.HeadLength && HeadType == DefaultInfo.HeadType)
				{
					return HeadWidth == DefaultInfo.HeadWidth;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefaultTailEndStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (TailLength == DefaultInfo.TailLength && TailType == DefaultInfo.TailType)
				{
					return TailWidth == DefaultInfo.TailWidth;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool HasHeadLength
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 1u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 1u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasHeadWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 2u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 2u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasTailLength
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 4u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 4u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasTailWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 8u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 8u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasHeadType
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 16u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 16u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasTailType
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 32u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 32u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasStrokeAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 64u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 64u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasEndCapStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 128u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 128u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasMiterLimit
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues2, 256u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues2, 256u, value);
			}
		}

		private void SetUIntValue(uint mask, int bits, uint value)
		{
			packedValues &= ~mask;
			packedValues |= (value << bits) & mask;
		}

		private uint GetUIntValue(uint mask, int bits)
		{
			return (packedValues & mask) >> bits;
		}

		private void SetBooleanValue(uint mask, bool bitVal)
		{
			if (bitVal)
			{
				packedValues |= mask;
			}
			else
			{
				packedValues &= ~mask;
			}
		}

		private bool GetBooleanValue(uint mask)
		{
			return (packedValues & mask) != 0;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is OutlineInfo outlineInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (packedValues == outlineInfo.packedValues && packedValues2 == outlineInfo.packedValues2 && width == outlineInfo.width)
			{
				return miterLimit == outlineInfo.miterLimit;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return packedValues.GetHashCode() ^ packedValues2.GetHashCode() ^ width ^ miterLimit;
		}

		public OutlineInfo Clone()
		{
			OutlineInfo outlineInfo = new OutlineInfo();
			outlineInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return outlineInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(OutlineInfo value)
		{
			packedValues = value.packedValues;
			packedValues2 = value.packedValues2;
			width = value.width;
			miterLimit = value.miterLimit;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return ObjectSizeHelper.CalculateApproxObjectSize32(this, ignoreStringSize: true);
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			packedValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
			packedValues2 = reader.ReadUInt32();
			width = reader.ReadInt32();
			miterLimit = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(packedValues);
			writer.Write(packedValues2);
			writer.Write(width);
			writer.Write(miterLimit);
		}
	}

		public IDrawingFill Fill
		{
			get
			{
				return fill;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = DrawingFill.Automatic;
				}
				if (!IsValidOutlineFill(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Wrong outline fill type.");
				}
				if (!fill.Equals(value))
				{
					HistoryItem historyItem = new DrawingFillPropertyChangedHistoryItem(base.DocumentModel.MainPart, this, fill, value);
					base.DocumentModel.History.Add(historyItem);
					historyItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public OutlineType Type
		{
			get
			{
				if (Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Solid)
				{
					return OutlineType.Solid;
				}
				if (Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Pattern)
				{
					return OutlineType.Pattern;
				}
				if (Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Gradient)
				{
					return OutlineType.Gradient;
				}
				return OutlineType.None;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Type == value && Fill.FillType != DrawingFillType.Automatic)
				{
					return;
				}
				base.DocumentModel.History.BeginTransaction();
				try
				{
					switch (value)
					{
					case OutlineType.Solid:
					{
						DrawingSolidFill drawingSolidFill = new DrawingSolidFill(base.DocumentModel);
						drawingSolidFill.Color.OriginalColor.Scheme = SchemeColorValues.Text1;
						Fill = drawingSolidFill;
						break;
					}
					case OutlineType.Pattern:
					{
						DrawingPatternFill drawingPatternFill = new DrawingPatternFill(base.DocumentModel);
						drawingPatternFill.PatternType = DrawingPatternType.Percent5;
						drawingPatternFill.ForegroundColor.OriginalColor.Scheme = SchemeColorValues.Accent1;
						drawingPatternFill.BackgroundColor.OriginalColor.Scheme = SchemeColorValues.Background1;
						Fill = drawingPatternFill;
						break;
					}
					case OutlineType.Gradient:
					{
						DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill = new DrawingGradientFill(base.DocumentModel);
						drawingGradientFill.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(0, SchemeColorValues.Accent1, 66000, 160000));
						drawingGradientFill.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(50000, SchemeColorValues.Accent1, 44500, 160000));
						drawingGradientFill.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(100000, SchemeColorValues.Accent1, 23500, 160000));
						drawingGradientFill.Angle = base.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToAdjAngle(5400000);
						Fill = drawingGradientFill;
						break;
					}
					default:
						Fill = DrawingFill.None;
						break;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					base.DocumentModel.History.EndTransaction();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (fill == DrawingFill.Automatic)
				{
					return base.Index == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Color
		{
			get
			{
				return DrawingFill.GetColor(base.DocumentModel, Fill);
			}
			set
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "OutlineColor");
				if (Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Solid && Color.Equals(value))
				{
					return;
				}
				base.DocumentModel.History.BeginTransaction();
				try
				{
					if (Fill.FillType != DrawingFillType.Solid)
					{
						DrawingSolidFill drawingSolidFill = new DrawingSolidFill(base.DocumentModel);
						Fill = drawingSolidFill;
					}
					((DrawingSolidFill)Fill).Color.CopyFrom(value);
				}
				finally
				{
					base.DocumentModel.History.EndTransaction();
				}
			}
		}

		DrawingStrokeUnderlineType IStrokeUnderline.Type => DrawingStrokeUnderlineType.Outline;

		public event SetFillEventHandler SetFill
		{
			add
			{
				onSetFill = (SetFillEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onSetFill, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onSetFill = (SetFillEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onSetFill, value);
			}
		}

		public Outline(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			fill = DrawingFill.Automatic;
		}

		public void SetDrawingFillCore(IDrawingFill value)
		{
			RaiseSetFill(value);
			fill.Parent = null;
			fill.PropertyChanged -= OnFillChanged;
			fill = value;
			fill.Parent = base.InnerParent;
			fill.PropertyChanged += OnFillChanged;
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(FillPropertyKey);
			InvalidateParent();
		}

		private void OnFillChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(FillPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private bool IsValidOutlineFill(IDrawingFill value)
		{
			if (value.FillType != DrawingFillType.Automatic && value.FillType != DrawingFillType.Gradient && value.FillType != DrawingFillType.None && value.FillType != DrawingFillType.Pattern)
			{
				return value.FillType == DrawingFillType.Solid;
			}
			return true;
		}

			base.CopyFrom(value);

		private DrawingGradientStop CreateGradientStop(int position, SchemeColorValues schemeColor, int tint, int saturationModulation)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = new DrawingGradientStop(base.DocumentModel);
			drawingGradientStop.Position = position;
			drawingGradientStop.Color.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				drawingGradientStop.Color.OriginalColor.Scheme = schemeColor;
				drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.Add(new TintColorTransform(tint));
				drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.Add(new SaturationModulationColorTransform(saturationModulation));
			}
			finally
			{
				drawingGradientStop.Color.EndUpdate();
			}
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		public Outline CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Outline outline = new Outline(documentModel);
			outline.CopyFrom(this);
			return outline;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is Outline outline))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Info.Equals(outline.Info))
			{
				return fill.Equals(outline.fill);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.Info.GetHashCode() ^ fill.GetHashCode();
		}

		IStrokeUnderline IStrokeUnderline.CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Outline outline = new Outline(documentModel);
			outline.CopyFrom(this);
			return outline;
		}

		public void ResetToStyle()
		{
			if (base.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				base.Info.CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.OutlineInfoCache.DefaultItem);
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeIndexCore(0, PropertyKey.Undefined);
			}
			Fill = DrawingFill.Automatic;
		}

		protected internal void RaiseSetFill(IDrawingFill value)
		{
			if (onSetFill != null)
			{
				SetFillEventArgs e = new SetFillEventArgs(value);
				onSetFill(this, e);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class ActualOutlineHelper
	{
		public static OutlineInfo MergeOutline(Outline shapeOutline, Outline themeOutline)
		{
			if (themeOutline == null)
			{
				return shapeOutline.Info;
			}
			if (shapeOutline.IsDefault)
			{
				return themeOutline.Info;
			}
			OutlineInfo outlineInfo = new OutlineInfo();
			outlineInfo.Width = ((shapeOutline.HasWidth && shapeOutline.Width > 0) ? shapeOutline.Width : themeOutline.Width);
			outlineInfo.CompoundType = (shapeOutline.HasCompoundType ? shapeOutline.CompoundType : themeOutline.CompoundType);
			outlineInfo.Dashing = (shapeOutline.HasDashing ? shapeOutline.Dashing : themeOutline.Dashing);
			outlineInfo.JoinStyle = (shapeOutline.HasLineJoinStyle ? shapeOutline.JoinStyle : themeOutline.JoinStyle);
			outlineInfo.MiterLimit = (shapeOutline.HasMiterLimit ? shapeOutline.MiterLimit : themeOutline.MiterLimit);
			outlineInfo.StrokeAlignment = (shapeOutline.HasStrokeAlignment ? shapeOutline.StrokeAlignment : themeOutline.StrokeAlignment);
			outlineInfo.EndCapStyle = (shapeOutline.HasEndCapStyle ? shapeOutline.EndCapStyle : themeOutline.EndCapStyle);
			outlineInfo.HeadType = (shapeOutline.HasHeadType ? shapeOutline.HeadType : themeOutline.HeadType);
			outlineInfo.HeadLength = (shapeOutline.HasHeadLength ? shapeOutline.HeadLength : themeOutline.HeadLength);
			outlineInfo.HeadWidth = (shapeOutline.HasHeadWidth ? shapeOutline.HeadWidth : themeOutline.HeadWidth);
			outlineInfo.TailType = (shapeOutline.HasTailType ? shapeOutline.TailType : themeOutline.TailType);
			outlineInfo.TailLength = (shapeOutline.HasTailLength ? shapeOutline.TailLength : themeOutline.TailLength);
			outlineInfo.TailWidth = (shapeOutline.HasTailWidth ? shapeOutline.TailWidth : themeOutline.TailWidth);
			return outlineInfo;
		}
	}

	public class ShapePropertiesInfo : ICloneable<ShapePropertiesInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<ShapePropertiesInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private const uint maskBlackWhiteMode = 15u;

		private const uint maskShapeType = 4080u;

		private const int offsetShapeType = 4;

		private uint packedValues;

		public OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode BlackAndWhiteMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode)PackedValues.GetIntBitValue(packedValues, 15u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetIntBitValue(ref packedValues, 15u, (int)value);
			}
		}

		public ShapePreset ShapeType
		{
			get
			{
				return (ShapePreset)PackedValues.GetIntBitValue(packedValues, 4080u, 4);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetIntBitValue(ref packedValues, 4080u, 4, (int)value);
			}
		}

		public ShapePropertiesInfo Clone()
		{
			ShapePropertiesInfo shapePropertiesInfo = new ShapePropertiesInfo();
			shapePropertiesInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return shapePropertiesInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ShapePropertiesInfo value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "ShapePropertiesInfo");
			packedValues = value.packedValues;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ShapePropertiesInfo shapePropertiesInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return packedValues == shapePropertiesInfo.packedValues;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)packedValues;
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			packedValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(packedValues);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ShapePropertiesBase : DrawingUndoableIndexBasedObjectEx<ShapePropertiesInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<ShapePropertiesBase>, IFillOwner, ISupportsInvalidateNotify
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey EffectStylePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(0);

		public static readonly PropertyKey FillPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey BlackAndWhiteModePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		public static readonly PropertyKey Transform2DPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(3);

		private readonly DrawingEffectStyle effectStyle;

		private IDrawingFill fill;

		private Transform2D transform2D;

		private bool blackAndWhitePrintMode;

		private SetFillEventHandler onSetFill;

		private EventHandler onFillChanged;

		public bool BlackAndWhitePrintMode
		{
			get
			{
				return blackAndWhitePrintMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (BlackAndWhitePrintMode != value)
				{
					blackAndWhitePrintMode = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public DrawingEffectStyle EffectStyle => effectStyle;

		public IDrawingFill Fill
		{
			get
			{
				return fill;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = GetDefaultFill();
				}
				if (!fill.Equals(value))
				{
					DrawingFillPropertyChangedHistoryItem drawingFillPropertyChangedHistoryItem = new DrawingFillPropertyChangedHistoryItem(base.DocumentModel.MainPart, this, fill, value);
					base.DocumentModel.History.Add(drawingFillPropertyChangedHistoryItem);
					drawingFillPropertyChangedHistoryItem.Execute();
					RaiseFillChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode BlackAndWhiteMode
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.BlackAndWhiteMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (BlackAndWhiteMode != value)
				{
					SetPropertyValue(SetBlackAndWhiteModeCore, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public Transform2D Transform2D => transform2D;

		protected internal event EventHandler Changed;

		public event SetFillEventHandler SetFill
		{
			add
			{
				onSetFill = (SetFillEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onSetFill, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onSetFill = (SetFillEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onSetFill, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler FillChanged
		{
			add
			{
				onFillChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onFillChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onFillChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onFillChanged, value);
			}
		}

		protected ShapePropertiesBase(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: this(documentModel, new Transform2D(documentModel))
		{
		}

		protected ShapePropertiesBase(IDocumentModel documentModel, Transform2D transform2D)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			base.InnerParent.NotifyTarget = this;
			fill = GetDefaultFill();
			fill.PropertyChanged += OnFillChanged;
			effectStyle = new DrawingEffectStyle(base.DocumentModel);
			effectStyle.PropertyChanged += OnEffectStyleChanged;
			this.transform2D = transform2D;
			this.transform2D.PropertyChanged += OnTransform2DChanged;
		}

		protected virtual IDrawingFill GetDefaultFill()
		{
			return DrawingFill.Automatic;
		}

		public void RotateCore(int newValue)
		{
			Transform2D.RotateCore(newValue);
		}

		public void SetDrawingFillCore(IDrawingFill value)
		{
			RaiseSetFill(value);
			fill.Parent = null;
			fill.PropertyChanged -= OnFillChanged;
			fill = value;
			fill.Parent = base.InnerParent;
			fill.PropertyChanged += OnFillChanged;
			base.InnerParent.Invalidate();
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(FillPropertyKey);
		}

		private PropertyKey SetBlackAndWhiteModeCore(ShapePropertiesInfo info, OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode value)
		{
			info.BlackAndWhiteMode = value;
			return BlackAndWhiteModePropertyKey;
		}

		public override PropertyKey GetBatchUpdateChangeActions()
		{
			return PropertyKey.Undefined;
		}

		protected internal override UniqueItemsCache<ShapePropertiesInfo> GetCache(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return base.DocumentModel.DrawingCache.ShapePropertiesInfoCache;
		}

		public void ResetToStyle()
		{
			ResetToStyle(keepOutline: false);
		}

		public void ResetToStyle(bool keepOutline)
		{
			base.DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				ResetToStyleCore(keepOutline);
			}
			finally
			{
				base.DocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public virtual void ResetToStyleCore(bool keepOutline)
		{
			Fill = DrawingFill.Automatic;
		}

		private void RaiseSetFill(IDrawingFill value)
		{
			if (onSetFill != null)
			{
				SetFillEventArgs e = new SetFillEventArgs(value);
				onSetFill(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void RaiseFillChanged()
		{
			onFillChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void InvalidateNotify()
		{
			if (this.Changed != null)
			{
				this.Changed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(ShapePropertiesBase value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "ShapePropertiesBase");
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			Fill = value.Fill.CloneTo(base.DocumentModel);
			effectStyle.CopyFrom(value.effectStyle);
			transform2D.CopyFrom(value.transform2D);
		}

		private void OnTransform2DChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(Transform2DPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnEffectStyleChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(EffectStylePropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnFillChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(FillPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}
	}
	public class GroupShapeProperties : ShapePropertiesBase, ICloneable<GroupShapeProperties>, ISupportsCopyFrom<GroupShapeProperties>

		private readonly Transform2D childTransform2D;

		public Transform2D ChildTransform2D => childTransform2D;

	public class ShapeProperties : ShapePropertiesBase, ICloneable<ShapeProperties>, ISupportsCopyFrom<ShapeProperties>
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey OutlinePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(4);

		public static readonly PropertyKey ShapeTypePropertyKey = new PropertyKey(5);

		public static readonly PropertyKey PresetAdjustListPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(6);

		public static readonly PropertyKey CustomGeometryPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(7);

		private Outline outline;

		private readonly ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry;

		private readonly ModelShapeGuideList presetAdjustList;

		public ModelShapeCustomGeometry CustomGeometry => customGeometry;

		public Outline Outline
		{
			get
			{
				return outline;
			}
			set
			{
				Outline.PropertyChanged -= OnOutlineChanged;
				outline.Parent = null;
				outline = value ?? new Outline(base.DocumentModel);
				outline.Parent = base.InnerParent;
				Outline.PropertyChanged += OnOutlineChanged;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAutomatic
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic && Outline.Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic)
				{
					return base.EffectStyle.IsDefault;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual ShapePreset ShapeType
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.ShapeType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ShapeType != value)
				{
					SetPropertyValue(SetShapeTypeCore, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public OutlineType OutlineType
		{
			get
			{
				return outline.Type;
			}
			set
			{
				outline.Type = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor OutlineColor
		{
			get
			{
				return outline.Color;
			}
			set
			{
				outline.Color = value;
			}
		}

		public ModelShapeGuideList PresetAdjustList => presetAdjustList;

		public ShapeProperties(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: this(documentModel, new Transform2D(documentModel))
		{
		}

		public ShapeProperties(IDocumentModel documentModel, Transform2D transform2D)
			: base(documentModel, transform2D)
		{
			outline = new Outline(documentModel);
			outline.SetDrawingFillCore(GetDefaultFill());
			outline.Parent = base.InnerParent;
			outline.PropertyChanged += OnOutlineChanged;
			customGeometry = new ModelShapeCustomGeometry(base.DocumentModel.MainPart);
			customGeometry.PropertyChanged += OnCustomGeometryChanged;
			presetAdjustList = new ModelShapeGuideList(base.DocumentModel.MainPart);
			presetAdjustList.Modified += OnPresetAdjustListModified;
		}

		private PropertyKey SetShapeTypeCore(ShapePropertiesInfo info, ShapePreset value)
		{
			info.ShapeType = value;
			return ShapeTypePropertyKey;
		}

		public bool IsConnectionShape()
		{
			ShapePreset shapeType = ShapeType;
			if (shapeType == ShapePreset.Line || (uint)(shapeType - 96) <= 8u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ShapeProperties Clone()
		{
			ShapeProperties shapeProperties = new ShapeProperties(base.DocumentModel, new Transform2D(base.DocumentModel));
			shapeProperties.CopyFrom(this);
			return shapeProperties;
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(ShapeProperties value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "ShapeProperties");
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			Outline.CopyFrom(value.Outline);
			customGeometry.CopyFrom(value.CustomGeometry);
			presetAdjustList.CopyFrom(value.presetAdjustList);
		}

		public void SetupShapeAdjustList(int?[] values)
		{
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometryByPreset = ShapesPresetGeometry.GetCustomGeometryByPreset(ShapeType);
			PresetAdjustList.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < customGeometryByPreset.AdjustValues.Count; i++)
			{
				ModelShapeGuide item = ((i >= values.Length || !values[i].HasValue) ? customGeometryByPreset.AdjustValues[i].Clone() : new ModelShapeGuide(customGeometryByPreset.AdjustValues[i].Name, "val " + values[i].Value));
				PresetAdjustList.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public override void ResetToStyleCore(bool keepOutline)
		{
			base.ResetToStyleCore(keepOutline);
			if (!keepOutline)
			{
				Outline.ResetToStyle();
			}
		}

		public ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetShapeGeometry()
		{
			if (ShapeType != ShapePreset.None)
			{
				return ShapesPresetGeometry.GetCustomGeometryByPreset(ShapeType);
			}
			return CustomGeometry;
		}

		private void OnOutlineChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(OutlinePropertyKey, sender, e);
		}

		private void OnPresetAdjustListModified(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(PresetAdjustListPropertyKey);
		}

		private void OnCustomGeometryChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(CustomGeometryPropertyKey, sender, e);
		}
	}
	public class ShapeStyleInfo : ICloneable<ShapeStyleInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<ShapeStyleInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private int effectReferenceIdx;

		private int fillReferenceIdx;

		private byte fontReferenceIdx;

		private int lineReferenceIdx;

		public int EffectReferenceIdx
		{
			get
			{
				return effectReferenceIdx;
			}
			set
			{
				effectReferenceIdx = value;
			}
		}

		public int FillReferenceIdx
		{
			get
			{
				return fillReferenceIdx;
			}
			set
			{
				fillReferenceIdx = value;
			}
		}

		public XlFontSchemeStyles FontReferenceIdx
		{
			get
			{
				return (XlFontSchemeStyles)fontReferenceIdx;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				fontReferenceIdx = (byte)value;
			}
		}

		public int LineReferenceIdx
		{
			get
			{
				return lineReferenceIdx;
			}
			set
			{
				lineReferenceIdx = value;
			}
		}

		public ShapeStyleInfo Clone()
		{
			ShapeStyleInfo shapeStyleInfo = new ShapeStyleInfo();
			shapeStyleInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return shapeStyleInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ShapeStyleInfo value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "ShapeStyleInfo");
			effectReferenceIdx = value.effectReferenceIdx;
			fillReferenceIdx = value.fillReferenceIdx;
			fontReferenceIdx = value.fontReferenceIdx;
			lineReferenceIdx = value.lineReferenceIdx;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ShapeStyleInfo shapeStyleInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (effectReferenceIdx == shapeStyleInfo.effectReferenceIdx && fillReferenceIdx == shapeStyleInfo.fillReferenceIdx && fontReferenceIdx == shapeStyleInfo.fontReferenceIdx)
			{
				return lineReferenceIdx == shapeStyleInfo.lineReferenceIdx;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return effectReferenceIdx ^ fillReferenceIdx ^ fontReferenceIdx ^ lineReferenceIdx;
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			effectReferenceIdx = reader.ReadInt32();
			fillReferenceIdx = reader.ReadInt32();
			fontReferenceIdx = reader.ReadByte();
			lineReferenceIdx = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(effectReferenceIdx);
			writer.Write(fillReferenceIdx);
			writer.Write(fontReferenceIdx);
			writer.Write(lineReferenceIdx);
		}
	}

	public class DrawingLanguageChangedHistoryItem : DrawingHistoryItem<DrawingTextCharacterProperties, CultureInfo>
	{
		private bool alternateLanguage;

		public DrawingLanguageChangedHistoryItem(DrawingTextCharacterProperties owner, bool alternateLanguage, CultureInfo oldValue, CultureInfo newValue)
			: base(owner.DocumentModel.MainPart, owner, oldValue, newValue)
		{
			this.alternateLanguage = alternateLanguage;
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			if (alternateLanguage)
			{
				base.Owner.SetAlternateLanguageCore(base.OldValue);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Owner.SetLanguageCore(base.OldValue);
			}
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			if (alternateLanguage)
			{
				base.Owner.SetAlternateLanguageCore(base.NewValue);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Owner.SetLanguageCore(base.NewValue);
			}
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(alternateLanguage);
			writer.Write((base.OldValue != null) ? base.OldValue.Name : string.Empty);
			writer.Write((base.NewValue != null) ? base.NewValue.Name : string.Empty);
		}
	}

	public abstract class DrawingUndoableIndexBasedObjectEx<T> : UndoableIndexBasedObject<T, PropertyKey>, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged where T : ICloneable<T>, ISupportsCopyFrom<T>, ISupportsSizeOf
	{
		private readonly PropertyChangedNotifier notifier;

		private InvalidateProxy innerParent;

		protected PropertyChangedNotifier Notifier => notifier;

		protected internal IDrawingCache DrawingCache => base.DocumentModel.DrawingCache;

		public ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerParent.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				innerParent.Target = value;
			}
		}

		protected InvalidateProxy InnerParent => innerParent;

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
		}

		protected DrawingUndoableIndexBasedObjectEx(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
			: base(documentModelPart)
		{
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
		}

		protected internal override void ApplyChanges(PropertyKey propertyKey)
		{
			InvalidateParent();
			Notifier.OnPropertyChanged(propertyKey);
		}

		protected override IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<PropertyKey> CreateIndexChangedHistoryItem()
		{
			return base.CreateIndexChangedHistoryItem();
		}

		public override PropertyKey GetBatchUpdateChangeActions()
		{
			return PropertyKey.Undefined;
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(DrawingUndoableIndexBasedObjectEx<T> sourceItem)
		{
			if (sourceItem.DocumentModel == base.DocumentModel)
			{
				base.CopyFrom(sourceItem);
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate();
			sourceItem.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				((ISupportsCopyFrom<T>)base.Info/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).CopyFrom(sourceItem.Info);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
				sourceItem.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected void InvalidateParent()
		{
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public void AssignInfo(T info)
		{
			SetIndexInitial(GetCache(base.DocumentModel).AddItem(info));
		}
	}

	public class ThemeDrawingColorCollection
	{
		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly Dictionary<ThemeColorIndex, DrawingColor> innerCollection;

		private readonly Dictionary<SchemeColorValues, ThemeColorIndex> schemeColorValuesToThemeColorIndexTranslationTable = CreateSchemeColorValuesToThemeColorIndexTranslationTable();

		private string name;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				name = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Light1
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Light1);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Light1, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Light2
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Light2);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Light2, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Dark1
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Dark1);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Dark1, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Dark2
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Dark2);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Dark2, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Accent1
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent1);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent1, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Accent2
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent2);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent2, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Accent3
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent3);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent3, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Accent4
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent4);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent4, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Accent5
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent5);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent5, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Accent6
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent6);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Accent6, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor Hyperlink
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Hyperlink);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.Hyperlink, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingColor FollowedHyperlink
		{
			get
			{
				return TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.FollowedHyperlink);
			}
			set
			{
				SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex.FollowedHyperlink, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsValidate => CheckValidation();

		public Dictionary<SchemeColorValues, ThemeColorIndex> SchemeColorValuesToThemeColorIndexTranslationTable => schemeColorValuesToThemeColorIndexTranslationTable;

		private static Dictionary<SchemeColorValues, ThemeColorIndex> CreateSchemeColorValuesToThemeColorIndexTranslationTable()
		{
			Dictionary<SchemeColorValues, ThemeColorIndex> dictionary = new Dictionary<SchemeColorValues, ThemeColorIndex>();
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Background1, ThemeColorIndex.Light1);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Background2, ThemeColorIndex.Light2);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Text1, ThemeColorIndex.Dark1);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Text2, ThemeColorIndex.Dark2);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Light1, ThemeColorIndex.Light1);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Light2, ThemeColorIndex.Light2);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Dark1, ThemeColorIndex.Dark1);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Dark2, ThemeColorIndex.Dark2);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Accent1, ThemeColorIndex.Accent1);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Accent2, ThemeColorIndex.Accent2);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Accent3, ThemeColorIndex.Accent3);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Accent4, ThemeColorIndex.Accent4);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Accent5, ThemeColorIndex.Accent5);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Accent6, ThemeColorIndex.Accent6);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.Hyperlink, ThemeColorIndex.Hyperlink);
			dictionary.Add(SchemeColorValues.FollowedHyperlink, ThemeColorIndex.FollowedHyperlink);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public ThemeDrawingColorCollection(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			name = string.Empty;
			innerCollection = new Dictionary<ThemeColorIndex, DrawingColor>();
		}

		public Color GetColor(ThemeColorIndex key)
		{
			DrawingColor drawingColor = TryGetDrawingColor(key);
			if (drawingColor == null)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			return drawingColor.FinalColor;
		}

		public Color GetColor(SchemeColorValues value)
		{
			return GetColor(schemeColorValuesToThemeColorIndexTranslationTable[value]);
		}

		internal void CopyFrom(ThemeDrawingColorCollection sourceObj)
		{
			Clear();
			name = sourceObj.name;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ThemeColorIndex, DrawingColor> item in sourceObj.innerCollection)
			{
				innerCollection.Add(item.Key, GetColor(item.Value, sourceObj.documentModel));
			}
		}

		private DrawingColor GetColor(DrawingColor sourceColor, IDocumentModel sourceDocumentModel)
		{
			if (sourceDocumentModel == documentModel)
			{
				return sourceColor;
			}
			return sourceColor.CloneTo(documentModel);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			name = string.Empty;
			innerCollection.Clear();
		}

		private bool CheckValidation()
		{
			if (name != null && innerCollection.Count == 12 && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Dark1) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Light1) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Dark2) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Light2) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Accent1) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Accent2) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Accent3) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Accent4) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Accent5) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Accent6) && innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.Hyperlink))
			{
				return innerCollection.ContainsKey(ThemeColorIndex.FollowedHyperlink);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex index, DrawingColor value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "DrawingColor");
			if (innerCollection.ContainsKey(index))
			{
				innerCollection[index] = value;
			}
			else
			{
				innerCollection.Add(index, value);
			}
		}

		internal void SetColor(ThemeColorIndex index, Color value)
		{
			SetDrawingColor(index, CreateDrawingColor(value));
		}

		internal void SetColor(ThemeColorIndex index, SystemColorValues value)
		{
			SetDrawingColor(index, CreateDrawingColor(value));
		}

		private DrawingColor CreateDrawingColor(SystemColorValues value)
		{
			return DrawingColor.Create(documentModel, DrawingColorModelInfo.CreateSystem(value));
		}

		private DrawingColor CreateDrawingColor(Color value)
		{
			return DrawingColor.Create(documentModel, DrawingColorModelInfo.CreateARGB(value));
		}

		private DrawingColor TryGetDrawingColor(ThemeColorIndex index)
		{
			if (innerCollection.ContainsKey(index))
			{
				return innerCollection[index];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool IsEqualColors(ThemeDrawingColorCollection other)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)other, "other");
			for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++)
			{
				ThemeColorIndex index = new ThemeColorIndex(i);
				DrawingColor drawingColor = TryGetDrawingColor(index);
				DrawingColor drawingColor2 = other.TryGetDrawingColor(index);
				if (drawingColor == null && drawingColor2 != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (drawingColor != null && drawingColor2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (drawingColor != null && drawingColor2 != null && drawingColor.FinalColor != drawingColor2.FinalColor)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class ThemeFontScheme
	{
		private readonly ThemeFontSchemePart minorFont;

		private readonly ThemeFontSchemePart majorFont;

		private string name = string.Empty;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				name = value;
			}
		}

		public ThemeFontSchemePart MinorFont => minorFont;

		public ThemeFontSchemePart MajorFont => majorFont;

		public bool IsValidate
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && minorFont.IsValid)
				{
					return majorFont.IsValid;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public ThemeFontScheme(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			minorFont = new ThemeFontSchemePart(documentModel);
			majorFont = new ThemeFontSchemePart(documentModel);
		}

		public string GetTypeface(XlFontSchemeStyles schemeStyle, CultureInfo currentUICulture)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)schemeStyle == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if ((int)schemeStyle == 1)
			{
				return MinorFont.GetTypeface(currentUICulture);
			}
			return MajorFont.GetTypeface(currentUICulture);
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ThemeFontScheme sourceObj)
		{
			name = sourceObj.Name;
			majorFont.CopyFrom(sourceObj.majorFont);
			minorFont.CopyFrom(sourceObj.minorFont);
		}

		protected internal void Clear()
		{
			name = string.Empty;
			majorFont.Clear();
			minorFont.Clear();
		}
	}

				isValid = value;

		}

		private static Dictionary<string, string> GetCultureNameToScriptTable()
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			dictionary.Add("ar-LY", "Arab");

			dictionary.Add("ar-MA", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("ar-TN", "Arab");

			dictionary.Add("ar-BH", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("ar-QA", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("ar-SA", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("ur-PK", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("fa-IR", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("ps-AF", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("prs-AF", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("ar-IQ", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("ar-EG", "Arab");
			dictionary.Add("hy-AM", "Armn");

		public ThemeFontSchemePart(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			latin = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel);
			eastAsian = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel);
			complexScript = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel);
		}

		public void AddSupplementalFont(string script, string typeface)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(script) && !supplementalFonts.ContainsKey(script))
			{
				supplementalFonts.Add(script, typeface);
			}
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ThemeFontSchemePart value)
		{
			latin.CopyFrom(value.latin);
			eastAsian.CopyFrom(value.eastAsian);
			complexScript.CopyFrom(value.complexScript);
			isValid = value.isValid;
			supplementalFonts.Clear();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> supplementalFont in value.supplementalFonts)
			{
				AddSupplementalFont(supplementalFont.Key, supplementalFont.Value);
			}
		}

		public string GetTypeface(CultureInfo currentUICulture)
		{
			return GetTypeface(currentUICulture, GetDefaultTypeface());
		}

		public string GetTypeface(CultureInfo currentUICulture, string defaultValue)
		{
			string name = currentUICulture.Name;
			if (cultureNameToScriptTable.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				string key = cultureNameToScriptTable[name];
				if (supplementalFonts.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					return supplementalFonts[key];
				}
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		protected internal void Clear()
		{
			Latin.Clear();
			EastAsian.Clear();
			ComplexScript.Clear();
			SupplementalFonts.Clear();
			IsValid = false;
		}

		private string GetDefaultTypeface()
		{
			return latin.Typeface;
		}
	}
	public enum StyleMatrixElementType
	{
		None,
		Subtle,
		Moderate,
		Intense
	}
	public class ThemeFormatScheme
	{
		private readonly List<IDrawingFill> backgroundFillStyleList = new List<IDrawingFill>();

		private readonly List<IDrawingFill> fillStyleList = new List<IDrawingFill>();

		private readonly List<Outline> lineStyleList = new List<Outline>();

		private readonly List<DrawingEffectStyle> effectStyleList = new List<DrawingEffectStyle>();

		private string name = string.Empty;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				name = value;
			}
		}

		public List<IDrawingFill> BackgroundFillStyleList => backgroundFillStyleList;

		public List<IDrawingFill> FillStyleList => fillStyleList;

		public List<Outline> LineStyleList => lineStyleList;

		public List<DrawingEffectStyle> EffectStyleList => effectStyleList;

		public bool IsValidate => CheckValidation();

		public Outline GetOutline(StyleMatrixElementType type)
		{
			return GetElement(type, lineStyleList);
		}

		public Outline GetOutline(int index)
		{
			return GetElement(index, lineStyleList);
		}

		public IDrawingFill GetFill(StyleMatrixElementType type)
		{
			return GetElement(type, fillStyleList);
		}

		public IDrawingFill GetFill(int index)
		{
			if (index < 1000)
			{
				return GetElement(index, fillStyleList);
			}
			return GetElement(index - 1000, backgroundFillStyleList);
		}

		public DrawingEffectStyle GetEffectStyle(StyleMatrixElementType type)
		{
			return GetElement(type, effectStyleList);
		}

		public DrawingEffectStyle GetEffectStyle(int index)
		{
			return GetElement(index, effectStyleList);
		}

		private T GetElement<T>(StyleMatrixElementType type, List<T> items) where T : class
		{
			return type switch
			{
				StyleMatrixElementType.Subtle => items[0], 
				StyleMatrixElementType.Moderate => items[1], 
				StyleMatrixElementType.Intense => items[2], 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private T GetElement<T>(int index, List<T> items) where T : class
		{
			int count = items.Count;
			if (index < 1 || count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return items[Math.Min(index, count) - 1];
		}

		private bool CheckValidation()
		{
			if (backgroundFillStyleList.Count >= 3 && fillStyleList.Count >= 3 && lineStyleList.Count >= 3)
			{
				return effectStyleList.Count >= 3;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal void CopyFrom(IDocumentModel targetModel, IOfficeTheme sourceTheme)
		{
			Clear();
			name = sourceTheme.FormatScheme.name;
			CopyFrom(targetModel, backgroundFillStyleList, sourceTheme.FormatScheme.backgroundFillStyleList);
			CopyFrom(targetModel, fillStyleList, sourceTheme.FormatScheme.fillStyleList);
			CopyFrom(targetModel, lineStyleList, sourceTheme.FormatScheme.lineStyleList);
			CopyFrom(targetModel, effectStyleList, sourceTheme.FormatScheme.effectStyleList);
		}

		private void CopyFrom(IDocumentModel targetModel, List<IDrawingFill> targetList, List<IDrawingFill> sourceList)
		{
			int count = sourceList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				targetList.Add(sourceList[i].CloneTo(targetModel));
			}
		}

		private void CopyFrom(IDocumentModel targetModel, List<Outline> targetList, List<Outline> sourceList)
		{
			int count = sourceList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				targetList.Add(sourceList[i].CloneTo(targetModel));
			}
		}

		private void CopyFrom(IDocumentModel targetModel, List<DrawingEffectStyle> targetList, List<DrawingEffectStyle> sourceList)
		{
			int count = sourceList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				targetList.Add(sourceList[i].CloneTo(targetModel));
			}
		}

		protected internal void Clear()
		{
			name = string.Empty;
			backgroundFillStyleList.Clear();
			fillStyleList.Clear();
			lineStyleList.Clear();
			effectStyleList.Clear();
		}
	}

	public enum OfficeThemePreset
	{
		Office,
		Office2013
	}
	public class OfficeThemeBuilder<TFormat>
	{
		private delegate void CalculateOfficeThemeProperties();

		public const int DefaultOfficeThemeVersion1 = 124226;

		public const int DefaultOfficeThemeVersion2 = 123820;

		public const string DefaultPartOfficeName = "Office";

		public const string DefaultOfficeName = "Office Theme";

		private OfficeThemeBase<TFormat> theme;

		private OfficeThemePreset preset;

		public static OfficeThemeBase<TFormat> CreateTheme(OfficeThemePreset preset)
		{
			OfficeThemeBase<TFormat> result = new OfficeThemeBase<TFormat>();
			OfficeThemeBuilder<TFormat> officeThemeBuilder = new OfficeThemeBuilder<TFormat>(result, preset);
			officeThemeBuilder.Build();
			return result;
		}

		public static bool IsDefaultOfficeThemeVersion(int themeVersion)
		{
			if (themeVersion != 124226)
			{
				return themeVersion == 123820;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private OfficeThemeBuilder(OfficeThemeBase<TFormat> theme, OfficeThemePreset preset)
		{
			this.theme = theme;
			this.preset = preset;
		}

		private void Build()
		{
			theme.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				Dictionary<OfficeThemePreset, CalculateOfficeThemeProperties> delegateCollection = GetDelegateCollection();
				CalculateOfficeThemeProperties calculateOfficeThemeProperties = delegateCollection[preset];
				calculateOfficeThemeProperties();
			}
			finally
			{
				theme.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<OfficeThemePreset, CalculateOfficeThemeProperties> GetDelegateCollection()
		{
			Dictionary<OfficeThemePreset, CalculateOfficeThemeProperties> dictionary = new Dictionary<OfficeThemePreset, CalculateOfficeThemeProperties>();
			dictionary.Add(OfficeThemePreset.Office, CalculateDefaultOfficeThemeProperties);
			dictionary.Add(OfficeThemePreset.Office2013, CalculateOffice2013ThemeProperties);
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void CalculateDefaultOfficeThemeProperties()
		{
			theme.Name = "Office Theme";
			CalculateDefaultOfficeThemeColorProperties();
			CalculateDefaultOfficeThemeFontProperties();
			CalculateDefaultOfficeThemeFormatProperties();
		}

		private void CalculateDefaultOfficeThemeColorProperties()
		{
			ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors = theme.Colors;

		private void CalculateDefaultOfficeEffectStyleList()
		{
			OuterShadowEffect shadowEffect = CreateOuterShadowEffect(20000L, 38000);
			AddOuterShadowEffectToContainer(shadowEffect);
			OuterShadowEffect shadowEffect2 = CreateOuterShadowEffect(23000L, 35000);
			AddOuterShadowEffectToContainer(shadowEffect2);
			DrawingEffectStyle drawingEffectStyle = new DrawingEffectStyle(theme);
			OuterShadowEffect item = CreateOuterShadowEffect(23000L, 35000);
			Scene3DProperties scene3DProperties = new Scene3DProperties(theme);
			scene3DProperties.Camera.Preset = PresetCameraType.OrthographicFront;
			scene3DProperties.LightRig.Preset = LightRigPreset.ThreePt;
			scene3DProperties.LightRig.Direction = LightRigDirection.Top;
			scene3DProperties.Camera.Lat = 0;
			scene3DProperties.LightRig.Rev = 1200000;
			Shape3DProperties shape3DProperties = new Shape3DProperties(theme);
			shape3DProperties.TopBevel.Width = 100L;
			shape3DProperties.TopBevel.Height = 40L;
			drawingEffectStyle.ContainerEffect.Effects.Add(item);
			drawingEffectStyle.ContainerEffect.SetApplyEffectListCore(value: true);
			drawingEffectStyle.Scene3DProperties.CopyFrom(scene3DProperties);
			drawingEffectStyle.Shape3DProperties.CopyFrom(shape3DProperties);
			theme.FormatScheme.EffectStyleList.Add(drawingEffectStyle);
		}

		private DrawingSolidFill CreateSolidFill()
		{
			DrawingSolidFill drawingSolidFill = new DrawingSolidFill(theme);
			drawingSolidFill.Color.OriginalColor.Scheme = SchemeColorValues.Style;
			return drawingSolidFill;
		}

		private DrawingSolidFill CreateSolidFill(int shade, int satMod)
		{
			DrawingSolidFill drawingSolidFill = CreateSolidFill();
			drawingSolidFill.Color.OriginalColor.Scheme = SchemeColorValues.Style;
			drawingSolidFill.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new ShadeColorTransform(shade));
			drawingSolidFill.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new SaturationModulationColorTransform(satMod));
			return drawingSolidFill;
		}

		private DrawingGradientFill CreateGradientFill(bool scaled, GradientType type)
		{
			DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill = new DrawingGradientFill(theme);
			drawingGradientFill.RotateWithShape = true;
			drawingGradientFill.GradientType = type;
			drawingGradientFill.Angle = 16200000;
			drawingGradientFill.Scaled = scaled;
			return drawingGradientFill;
		}

		private DrawingGradientStop CreateGradientStopCore(int position)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = new DrawingGradientStop(theme);
			drawingGradientStop.Position = position;
			drawingGradientStop.Color.OriginalColor.Scheme = SchemeColorValues.Style;
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		private DrawingGradientStop CreateGradientStopWithTint(int position, int tint, int satMod)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = CreateGradientStopCore(position);
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new TintColorTransform(tint));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new SaturationModulationColorTransform(satMod));
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		private DrawingGradientStop CreateGradientStopWithTint(int position, int tint, int satMod, int lumMod)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = CreateGradientStopCore(position);
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new LuminanceModulationColorTransform(lumMod));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new SaturationModulationColorTransform(satMod));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new TintColorTransform(tint));
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		private DrawingGradientStop CreateGradientStopWithTint2(int position, int tint, int satMod, int lumMod)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = CreateGradientStopCore(position);
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new SaturationModulationColorTransform(satMod));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new LuminanceModulationColorTransform(lumMod));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new TintColorTransform(tint));
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		private DrawingGradientStop CreateGradientStopWithShade(int position, int shade, int satMod)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = CreateGradientStopCore(position);
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new ShadeColorTransform(shade));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new SaturationModulationColorTransform(satMod));
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		private DrawingGradientStop CreateGradientStopWithTintShade(int position, int tint, int shade, int satMod)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = CreateGradientStopCore(position);
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new TintColorTransform(tint));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new ShadeColorTransform(shade));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new SaturationModulationColorTransform(satMod));
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		private DrawingGradientStop CreateGradientStopWithTintShade(int position, int tint, int shade, int satMod, int lumMod)
		{
			DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = CreateGradientStopCore(position);
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new TintColorTransform(tint));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new SaturationModulationColorTransform(satMod));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new ShadeColorTransform(shade));
			drawingGradientStop.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new LuminanceModulationColorTransform(lumMod));
			return drawingGradientStop;
		}

		private Outline CreateOutline(int width)
		{
			Outline outline = new Outline(theme);
			outline.Width = width;
			outline.EndCapStyle = OutlineEndCapStyle.Flat;
			outline.CompoundType = OutlineCompoundType.Single;
			outline.StrokeAlignment = OutlineStrokeAlignment.Center;
			outline.Dashing = OutlineDashing.Solid;
			return outline;
		}

		private OuterShadowEffect CreateOuterShadowEffect(long distance, int alpha)
		{
			return CreateOuterShadowEffect(distance, alpha, RectangleAlignType.Bottom, 40000L);
		}

		private OuterShadowEffect CreateOuterShadowEffect(long distance, int alpha, RectangleAlignType align, long blurRadius)
		{
			OffsetShadowInfo offsetShadowInfo = new OffsetShadowInfo(distance, 5400000);
			ScalingFactorInfo scalingFactorInfo = new ScalingFactorInfo(100000, 100000);
			SkewAnglesInfo skewAnglesInfo = new SkewAnglesInfo(0, 0);
			OuterShadowEffectInfo info = new OuterShadowEffectInfo(offsetShadowInfo, scalingFactorInfo, skewAnglesInfo, align, blurRadius, rotateWithShape: false);
			DrawingColor drawingColor = DrawingColor.Create(theme, DrawingColorModelInfo.CreateARGB(DXColor.FromArgb(0, 0, 0)));
			drawingColor.Transforms.AddCore(new AlphaColorTransform(alpha));
			return new OuterShadowEffect(drawingColor, info);
		}

		private void AddOuterShadowEffectToContainer(OuterShadowEffect shadowEffect)
		{
			DrawingEffectStyle drawingEffectStyle = new DrawingEffectStyle(theme);
			drawingEffectStyle.ContainerEffect.SetApplyEffectListCore(value: true);
			drawingEffectStyle.ContainerEffect.Effects.Add(shadowEffect);
			theme.FormatScheme.EffectStyleList.Add(drawingEffectStyle);
		}

		private void AddEmptyEffectStyle()
		{
			DrawingEffectStyle drawingEffectStyle = new DrawingEffectStyle(theme);
			drawingEffectStyle.ContainerEffect.SetApplyEffectListCore(value: true);
			theme.FormatScheme.EffectStyleList.Add(drawingEffectStyle);
		}
	}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextBodyInfo value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			packedValues = value.packedValues;
			packedOptionsValues = value.packedOptionsValues;
			numberOfColumns = value.numberOfColumns;
			rotation = value.rotation;
			spaceBetweenColumns = value.spaceBetweenColumns;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextBodyInfo drawingTextBodyInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (packedValues == drawingTextBodyInfo.packedValues && packedOptionsValues == drawingTextBodyInfo.packedOptionsValues && numberOfColumns == drawingTextBodyInfo.numberOfColumns && rotation == drawingTextBodyInfo.rotation)
			{
				return spaceBetweenColumns == drawingTextBodyInfo.spaceBetweenColumns;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)(packedValues ^ packedOptionsValues ^ (uint)numberOfColumns ^ (uint)rotation) ^ spaceBetweenColumns.GetHashCode();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			packedValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
			packedOptionsValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
			numberOfColumns = reader.ReadInt32();
			rotation = reader.ReadInt32();
			spaceBetweenColumns = reader.ReadSingle();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(packedValues);
			writer.Write(packedOptionsValues);
			writer.Write(numberOfColumns);
			writer.Write(rotation);
			writer.Write(spaceBetweenColumns);
		}

	public interface ITextInset : ITextInsetOptions
	{
		ITextInsetOptions Options { get; }

		float Left { get; set; }

		float Right { get; set; }

		float Top { get; set; }

		float Bottom { get; set; }
	}
	public interface ITextInsetOptions
	{
		bool HasLeft { get; }

		bool HasRight { get; }

		bool HasTop { get; }

		bool HasBottom { get; }
	}
	public class DrawingTextInset : ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingTextInset>, ITextInset, ITextInsetOptions, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private const int length = 4;

		private const int LeftIndex = 0;

		private const int RightIndex = 1;

		private const int TopIndex = 2;

		private const int BottomIndex = 3;

		public const int DefaultTopBottom = 72;

		public const int DefaultLeftRight = 144;

		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly float[] inset;

		private readonly bool[] hasValues;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		public float Left
		{
			get
			{
				return inset[0];
			}
			set
			{
				SetInset(0, value);
			}
		}

		public float Right
		{
			get
			{
				return inset[1];
			}
			set
			{
				SetInset(1, value);
			}
		}

		public float Top
		{
			get
			{
				return inset[2];
			}
			set
			{
				SetInset(2, value);
			}
		}

		public float Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return inset[3];
			}
			set
			{
				SetInset(3, value);
			}
		}

		public ITextInsetOptions Options => this;

		bool ITextInsetOptions.HasLeft => hasValues[0];

		bool ITextInsetOptions.HasRight => hasValues[1];

		bool ITextInsetOptions.HasTop => hasValues[2];

		bool ITextInsetOptions.HasBottom => hasValues[3];

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (!hasValues[0] && !hasValues[1] && !hasValues[2])
				{
					return !hasValues[3];
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextInset(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			inset = new float[4] { 144f, 144f, 72f, 72f };
			hasValues = new bool[4];
		}

		public void SetInsetCore(int index, float value)
		{
			inset[index] = value;
		}

		public void SetInsetHasValuesCore(int index, bool value)
		{
			hasValues[index] = value;
		}

		private void SetInset(int index, float value)
		{
			if (inset[index] != value || !hasValues[index])
			{
				if (inset[index] == value)
				{
					ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingTextInsetHasValuesChangeHistoryItem(this, index, hasValues[index], newValue: true));
					return;
				}
				DrawingValueChecker.CheckCoordinate32F(inset[index], "InsetCoordinate");
				DocumentModel.History.BeginTransaction();
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingTextInsetHasValuesChangeHistoryItem(this, index, hasValues[index], newValue: true));
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingTextInsetChangeHistoryItem(this, index, inset[index], value));
				DocumentModel.History.EndTransaction();
			}
		}

		private void SetInset(int index, float value, bool hasValue)
		{
			if (hasValues[index] != hasValue)
			{
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingTextInsetHasValuesChangeHistoryItem(this, index, hasValues[index], hasValue));
			}
			if (inset[index] != value)
			{
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingTextInsetChangeHistoryItem(this, index, inset[index], value));
			}
		}

		private void ApplyHistoryItem(HistoryItem item)
		{
			DocumentModel.History.Add(item);
			item.Execute();
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextInset value)
		{
			SetInset(0, value.Left, value.Options.HasLeft);
			SetInset(1, value.Right, value.Options.HasRight);
			SetInset(2, value.Top, value.Options.HasTop);
			SetInset(3, value.Bottom, value.Options.HasBottom);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextInset drawingTextInset))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (inset[0] == drawingTextInset.Left && inset[1] == drawingTextInset.Right && inset[2] == drawingTextInset.Top && inset[3] == drawingTextInset.Bottom && hasValues[0] == drawingTextInset.Options.HasLeft && hasValues[1] == drawingTextInset.Options.HasRight && hasValues[2] == drawingTextInset.Options.HasTop)
			{
				return hasValues[3] == drawingTextInset.Options.HasBottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return inset[0].GetHashCode() ^ inset[1].GetHashCode() ^ inset[2].GetHashCode() ^ inset[3].GetHashCode() ^ hasValues[0].GetHashCode() ^ hasValues[1].GetHashCode() ^ hasValues[2].GetHashCode() ^ hasValues[3].GetHashCode();
		}

		public void ResetToStyle()
		{
			SetInset(0, 144f, hasValue: false);
			SetInset(1, 144f, hasValue: false);
			SetInset(2, 72f, hasValue: false);
			SetInset(3, 72f, hasValue: false);
		}

		public void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				inset[i] = reader.ReadSingle();
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
			{
				hasValues[j] = reader.ReadBoolean();
			}
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				writer.Write(inset[i]);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
			{
				writer.Write(hasValues[j]);
			}
		}
	}

	public class DrawingTextBodyProperties : DrawingUndoableIndexBasedObjectEx<DrawingTextBodyInfo>, ICloneable<DrawingTextBodyProperties>, ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingTextBodyProperties>, ITextBodyOptions
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey UprightTextKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey AnchorKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		public static readonly PropertyKey TextWrappingKey = new PropertyKey(3);

		private readonly DrawingTextInset inset;

		private readonly Scene3DProperties scene3d;

		private IDrawingText3D text3D;

		private IDrawingTextAutoFit autoFit;

		private DrawingPresetTextWarp presetTextWarp;

		private ModelShapeGuideList presetAdjustValues;

		public DrawingTextInset Inset => inset;

		public Scene3DProperties Scene3D => scene3d;

		public ITextBodyOptions Options => this;

		public DrawingPresetTextWarp PresetTextWarp
		{
			get
			{
				return presetTextWarp;
			}
			set
			{
				if (presetTextWarp != value)
				{
					ActionIntHistoryItem actionIntHistoryItem = new ActionIntHistoryItem(base.DocumentModelPart, (int)presetTextWarp, (int)value, SetPresetTextWarpCore);
					base.DocumentModel.History.Add(actionIntHistoryItem);
					actionIntHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		public ModelShapeGuideList PresetAdjustValues => presetAdjustValues;

		public IDrawingTextAutoFit AutoFit
		{
			get
			{
				return autoFit;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = DrawingTextAutoFit.Automatic;
				}
				if (!IsValidAutoFit(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Wrong autofit type.");
				}
				if (!autoFit.Equals(value))
				{
					SetAutoFit(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextAnchoringType Anchor
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.Anchor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Anchor != value || !Options.HasAnchor)
				{
					SetPropertyValue(SetAnchorCore, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextHorizontalOverflowType HorizontalOverflow
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Info.HorizontalOverflow;
			}
			set
			{
				if (HorizontalOverflow != value || !Options.HasHorizontalOverflow)

					SetPropertyValue(SetHorizontalOverflowCore, value);

				}
			}
		}

				if (FromWordArt != value || !Options.HasFromWordArt)

		public IDrawingText3D Text3D
		{
			get
			{
				return text3D;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = DrawingText3D.Automatic;
				}
				if (!IsValidText3D(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Wrong text3d type.");
				}
				if (text3D != value)
				{
					DrawingTextBodyPropertiesText3DChangedHistoryItem drawingTextBodyPropertiesText3DChangedHistoryItem = new DrawingTextBodyPropertiesText3DChangedHistoryItem(this, text3D, value);
					base.DocumentModel.History.Add(drawingTextBodyPropertiesText3DChangedHistoryItem);
					drawingTextBodyPropertiesText3DChangedHistoryItem.Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		bool ITextBodyOptions.HasRotation => base.Info.HasRotation;

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Index == 0 && inset.IsDefault && scene3d.IsDefault && text3D.Type == DrawingText3DType.Automatic)
				{
					return autoFit.Type == DrawingTextAutoFitType.Automatic;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextBodyProperties(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			inset = new DrawingTextInset(documentModel);
			scene3d = new Scene3DProperties(documentModel);
			autoFit = DrawingTextAutoFit.Automatic;
			text3D = DrawingText3D.Automatic;
			presetTextWarp = DrawingPresetTextWarp.NoShape;
			presetAdjustValues = new ModelShapeGuideList(base.DocumentModelPart);
		}

		public void SetPresetTextWarpCore(int value)
		{
			presetTextWarp = (DrawingPresetTextWarp)value;
			InvalidateParent();
		}

		private void SetAutoFit(IDrawingTextAutoFit value)
		{
			DrawingTextBodyPropertiesAutoFitChangedHistoryItem drawingTextBodyPropertiesAutoFitChangedHistoryItem = new DrawingTextBodyPropertiesAutoFitChangedHistoryItem(this, autoFit, value);
			base.DocumentModel.History.Add(drawingTextBodyPropertiesAutoFitChangedHistoryItem);
			drawingTextBodyPropertiesAutoFitChangedHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public void SetAutoFitCore(IDrawingTextAutoFit value)
		{
			autoFit = value;
			InvalidateParent();
		}

		private bool IsValidAutoFit(IDrawingTextAutoFit value)
		{
			if (value.Type != DrawingTextAutoFitType.None && value.Type != DrawingTextAutoFitType.Normal && value.Type != DrawingTextAutoFitType.Shape)
			{
				return value.Type == DrawingTextAutoFitType.Automatic;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void SetText3DCore(IDrawingText3D value)
		{
			text3D = value;
			InvalidateParent();
		}

		private bool IsValidText3D(IDrawingText3D value)
		{
			if (value.Type != DrawingText3DType.Automatic && value.Type != DrawingText3DType.Shape3D)
			{
				return value.Type == DrawingText3DType.FlatText;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextBodyProperties value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			inset.CopyFrom(value.inset);
			scene3d.CopyFrom(value.scene3d);
			autoFit = value.autoFit.CloneTo(base.DocumentModel);
			text3D = value.text3D.CloneTo(base.DocumentModel);
			presetTextWarp = value.PresetTextWarp;
			presetAdjustValues = value.PresetAdjustValues.Clone();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextBodyProperties drawingTextBodyProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Info.Equals(drawingTextBodyProperties.Info) && inset.Equals(drawingTextBodyProperties.inset) && scene3d.Equals(drawingTextBodyProperties.scene3d) && autoFit.Equals(drawingTextBodyProperties.autoFit))
			{
				return text3D.Equals(drawingTextBodyProperties.text3D);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.Info.GetHashCode() ^ inset.GetHashCode() ^ scene3d.GetHashCode() ^ autoFit.GetHashCode() ^ text3D.GetHashCode() ^ presetTextWarp.GetHashCode();
		}

		protected internal override UniqueItemsCache<DrawingTextBodyInfo> GetCache(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextBodyInfoCache;
		}

		public DrawingTextBodyProperties Clone()
		{
			DrawingTextBodyProperties drawingTextBodyProperties = new DrawingTextBodyProperties(base.DocumentModel);
			drawingTextBodyProperties.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextBodyProperties;
		}

		public void ResetToStyle()
		{
			if (base.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				base.Info.CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextBodyInfoCache.DefaultItem);
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeIndexCore(0, PropertyKey.Undefined);
			}
			inset.ResetToStyle();
			scene3d.ResetToStyle();
			AutoFit = DrawingTextAutoFit.Automatic;
			Text3D = DrawingText3D.Automatic;
		}
	}

		{
			this.zCoordinate = zCoordinate;
		}

		{
			if (obj is DrawingText3DFlatText drawingText3DFlatText)
			{
				return zCoordinate == drawingText3DFlatText.zCoordinate;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return zCoordinate.GetHashCode();
		}

		public DrawingText3DFlatText Clone()
		{
			return new DrawingText3DFlatText(zCoordinate);
		}

		public IDrawingText3D CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return new DrawingText3DFlatText(zCoordinate);
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingText3DVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedOptionsValues, 2048u);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedOptionsValues, 2048u, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextCharacterInfo Clone()
		{
			DrawingTextCharacterInfo drawingTextCharacterInfo = new DrawingTextCharacterInfo();
			drawingTextCharacterInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextCharacterInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextCharacterInfo value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			packedValues = value.packedValues;
			packedOptionsValues = value.packedOptionsValues;
			fontSize = value.fontSize;
			kerning = value.kerning;
			spacing = value.spacing;
			baseline = value.baseline;
			smartTagId = value.smartTagId;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextCharacterInfo drawingTextCharacterInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (packedValues == drawingTextCharacterInfo.packedValues && packedOptionsValues == drawingTextCharacterInfo.packedOptionsValues && fontSize == drawingTextCharacterInfo.fontSize && kerning == drawingTextCharacterInfo.kerning && spacing == drawingTextCharacterInfo.spacing && baseline == drawingTextCharacterInfo.baseline)
			{
				return smartTagId == drawingTextCharacterInfo.smartTagId;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)(packedValues ^ packedOptionsValues ^ (uint)fontSize ^ (uint)kerning ^ (uint)spacing ^ (uint)baseline ^ smartTagId);
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			packedValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
			packedOptionsValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
			fontSize = reader.ReadInt32();
			kerning = reader.ReadInt32();
			spacing = reader.ReadInt32();
			baseline = reader.ReadInt32();
			smartTagId = reader.ReadUInt32();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(packedValues);
			writer.Write(packedOptionsValues);
			writer.Write(fontSize);
			writer.Write(kerning);
			writer.Write(spacing);
			writer.Write(baseline);
			writer.Write(smartTagId);
		}
	}

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (fill == DrawingFill.Automatic && outline.IsDefault && effects.Effects.Count == 0 && highlight.IsEmpty && underlineFill == DrawingFill.Automatic && strokeUnderline == DrawingStrokeUnderline.Automatic && eastAsian.IsDefault && latin.IsDefault && symbol.IsDefault && complexScript.IsDefault && base.Index == 0 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(bookmark) && language.Equals(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
				{
					return alternateLanguage.Equals(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextCharacterProperties(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			fill = DrawingFill.Automatic;
			outline = new Outline(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = base.InnerParent
			};
			effects = new ContainerEffect(documentModel);
			highlight = new DrawingColor(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = base.InnerParent
			};
			underlineFill = DrawingFill.Automatic;
			strokeUnderline = DrawingStrokeUnderline.Automatic;
			eastAsian = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = base.InnerParent
			};
			latin = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = base.InnerParent
			};
			symbol = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = base.InnerParent
			};
			complexScript = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = base.InnerParent
			};
			language = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
			alternateLanguage = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
		}

		{
			base.DocumentModel.History.Add(item);
			item.Execute();
