		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextCharacterProperties value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			fill = value.fill.CloneTo(base.DocumentModel);
			outline.CopyFrom(value.outline);
			effects.CopyFrom(value.effects);
			highlight.CopyFrom(value.highlight);
			underlineFill = value.underlineFill.CloneTo(base.DocumentModel);
			strokeUnderline = value.strokeUnderline.CloneTo(base.DocumentModel);
			bookmark = value.bookmark;
			complexScript.CopyFrom(value.complexScript);
			eastAsian.CopyFrom(value.eastAsian);
			latin.CopyFrom(value.latin);
			symbol.CopyFrom(value.symbol);
			language = (CultureInfo)value.language.Clone();
			alternateLanguage = (CultureInfo)value.alternateLanguage.Clone();
		}

		protected internal override UniqueItemsCache<DrawingTextCharacterInfo> GetCache(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextCharacterInfoCache;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextCharacterProperties drawingTextCharacterProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Info.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.Info) && fill.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.fill) && outline.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.outline) && effects.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.effects) && highlight.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.highlight) && underlineFill.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.underlineFill) && strokeUnderline.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.strokeUnderline) && bookmark == drawingTextCharacterProperties.bookmark && latin.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.latin) && eastAsian.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.eastAsian) && complexScript.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.complexScript) && symbol.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.symbol) && language.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.language))
			{
				return alternateLanguage.Equals(drawingTextCharacterProperties.alternateLanguage);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.Info.GetHashCode() ^ fill.GetHashCode() ^ outline.GetHashCode() ^ effects.GetHashCode() ^ highlight.GetHashCode() ^ underlineFill.GetHashCode() ^ strokeUnderline.GetHashCode() ^ bookmark.GetHashCode() ^ latin.GetHashCode() ^ eastAsian.GetHashCode() ^ complexScript.GetHashCode() ^ symbol.GetHashCode() ^ language.GetHashCode() ^ alternateLanguage.GetHashCode();
		}

		public DrawingTextCharacterProperties Clone()
		{
			DrawingTextCharacterProperties drawingTextCharacterProperties = new DrawingTextCharacterProperties(base.DocumentModel);
			drawingTextCharacterProperties.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextCharacterProperties;
		}

		public void ResetToStyle()
		{
			if (base.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				base.Info.CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextCharacterInfoCache.DefaultItem);
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeIndexCore(0, DocumentModelChangeActions.None);
			}
			Fill = DrawingFill.Automatic;
			outline.ResetToStyle();
			effects.Effects.Clear();
			highlight.Clear();
			UnderlineFill = DrawingFill.Automatic;
			StrokeUnderline = DrawingStrokeUnderline.Automatic;
			eastAsian.Clear();
			latin.Clear();
			symbol.Clear();
			complexScript.Clear();
			Bookmark = string.Empty;
			Language = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
			AlternateLanguage = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
		}
	}

	{
		public static string GetFontTypeFace(DrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
		{
			return GetFontTypeFace((IDrawingTextCharacterProperties)runProperties, shapeStyle);
		}

		internal static string GetFontTypeFace(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XlFontSchemeStyles val = shapeStyle.FontReferenceIdx;
			if (runProperties == null)
			{
				return shapeStyle.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FontScheme.MinorFont.Latin.Typeface;
			}
			string typeface = runProperties.Latin.Typeface;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeface) || typeface.StartsWith("+mn"))
			{
				if ((int)val == 0)
				{
					val = (XlFontSchemeStyles)1;
				}
				typeface = shapeStyle.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FontScheme.GetTypeface(val, runProperties.Language);
			}
			return typeface;
		}
	}

	public class DrawingTextParagraph : ICloneable<DrawingTextParagraph>, ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingTextParagraph>
	{
		private const int ApplyParagraphPropertiesIndex = 0;

		private const int ApplyEndRunPropertiesIndex = 1;

		private readonly InvalidateProxy innerParent;

		private readonly DrawingTextRunCollection runs;

		private readonly DrawingTextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties;

		private readonly DrawingTextCharacterProperties endRunProperties;

		private bool[] options;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => runs.DocumentModel;

		public ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerParent.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				innerParent.Target = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextRunCollection Runs => runs;

		public DrawingTextParagraphProperties ParagraphProperties => paragraphProperties;

		public DrawingTextCharacterProperties EndRunProperties => endRunProperties;

		public bool ApplyParagraphProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return options[0];
			}
			set
			{
				SetOptions(0, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ApplyEndRunProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return options[1];
			}
			set
			{
				SetOptions(1, value);
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextParagraph(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();
			runs = new DrawingTextRunCollection(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = innerParent
			};
			paragraphProperties = new DrawingTextParagraphProperties(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = innerParent
			};
			endRunProperties = new DrawingTextCharacterProperties(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = innerParent
			};
			options = new bool[2];
		}

		private void SetOptions(int index, bool value)
		{
			if (options[index] != value)
			{
				HistoryItem historyItem = new DrawingTextParagraphOptionsChangedHistoryItem(this, index, options[index], value);
				DocumentModel.History.Add(historyItem);
				historyItem.Execute();
			}
		}

		internal void SetOptionsCore(int index, bool value)
		{
			options[index] = value;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public string GetPlainText()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < runs.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(runs[i].Text);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void SetPlainText(string value)
		{
			runs.Clear();
			DrawingTextRun item = new DrawingTextRun(DocumentModel, value);
			runs.Add(item);
		}

		public DrawingTextParagraph CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingTextParagraph drawingTextParagraph = new DrawingTextParagraph(documentModel);
			drawingTextParagraph.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextParagraph;
		}

		public DrawingTextParagraph Clone()
		{
			DrawingTextParagraph drawingTextParagraph = new DrawingTextParagraph(DocumentModel);
			drawingTextParagraph.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextParagraph;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextParagraph value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
			runs.CopyFrom(value.runs);
			paragraphProperties.CopyFrom(value.paragraphProperties);
			endRunProperties.CopyFrom(value.endRunProperties);
			options[0] = value.ApplyParagraphProperties;
			options[1] = value.ApplyEndRunProperties;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextParagraph drawingTextParagraph))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!runs.Equals(drawingTextParagraph.runs))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!paragraphProperties.Equals(drawingTextParagraph.paragraphProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!endRunProperties.Equals(drawingTextParagraph.endRunProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ApplyParagraphProperties == drawingTextParagraph.ApplyParagraphProperties)
			{
				return ApplyEndRunProperties == drawingTextParagraph.ApplyEndRunProperties;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return runs.GetHashCode() ^ paragraphProperties.GetHashCode() ^ endRunProperties.GetHashCode() ^ ApplyParagraphProperties.GetHashCode() ^ ApplyEndRunProperties.GetHashCode();
		}

		private int CalcSpacingPoints(IDrawingTextSpacing spacing)
		{
			switch (spacing.Type)
			{
			case DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Automatic:
				return 0;
			case DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Points:
				return spacing.Value;
			case DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Percent:
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (IDrawingTextRun run in runs)
				{
					if (run.RunProperties.Options.HasFontSize)
					{
						num = Math.Max(run.RunProperties.FontSize, num);
					}
				}
				if (ApplyEndRunProperties)
				{
					num = Math.Max(endRunProperties.FontSize, num);
				}
				return num * spacing.Value / 100000;
			}
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}

		public int GetLineSpacingPoints()
		{
			return CalcSpacingPoints(ParagraphProperties.Spacings.Line);
		}

		public int GetSpacingBeforePoints()
		{
			return CalcSpacingPoints(ParagraphProperties.Spacings.SpaceBefore);
		}

		public int GetSpacingAfterPoints()
		{
			return CalcSpacingPoints(ParagraphProperties.Spacings.SpaceAfter);
		}

		public void SplitRun(int runIndex, int textPosition)
		{
			DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				if (runs[runIndex] is DrawingTextRun drawingTextRun)
				{
					string text = drawingTextRun.Text.Substring(textPosition);
					DrawingTextRun drawingTextRun2 = new DrawingTextRun(DocumentModel);
					drawingTextRun2.CopyFrom(drawingTextRun);
					drawingTextRun2.Text = text;
					Runs.Insert(runIndex + 1, drawingTextRun2);
					drawingTextRun.Text = drawingTextRun.Text.Substring(0, textPosition);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}
	}

		public DrawingTextParagraphCollection(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();
		}

		public override UndoableClonableCollection<DrawingTextParagraph> GetNewCollection(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			return new DrawingTextParagraphCollection(documentModelPart.DocumentModel);
		}

		public override DrawingTextParagraph GetCloneItem(DrawingTextParagraph item, IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			return item.CloneTo(documentModelPart.DocumentModel);
		}

		public override int AddCore(DrawingTextParagraph item)
		{
			int result = base.AddCore(item);
			item.Parent = innerParent;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void InsertCore(int index, DrawingTextParagraph item)
		{
			base.InsertCore(index, item);
			item.Parent = innerParent;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void RemoveAtCore(int index)
		{
			DrawingTextParagraph drawingTextParagraph = base[index];
			drawingTextParagraph.Parent = null;
			base.RemoveAtCore(index);
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void ClearCore()
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (IEnumerator<DrawingTextParagraph> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DrawingTextParagraph current = enumerator.Current;
					current.Parent = null;
				}
			}
			base.ClearCore();
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void AddRangeCore(IEnumerable<DrawingTextParagraph> collection)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<DrawingTextParagraph> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DrawingTextParagraph current = enumerator.Current;
					current.Parent = innerParent;
				}
			}
			base.AddRangeCore(collection);
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override DrawingTextParagraph DeserializeItem(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			return reader.GetObject(reader.ReadInt32()) as DrawingTextParagraph;
		}
	}

			SetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper, GetInfo(owner));
		}

		public void CopyDeferredInfo(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner, DrawingTextParagraphProperties from)
		{
			SetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper, GetInfo(from));
		}

		public bool ApplyDeferredChanges(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner)
		{
			return owner.ReplaceInfo(this, GetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper), owner.GetBatchUpdateChangeActions());
		}
	}

	public class DrawingTextSpacingInfoIndexAccessor : IIndexAccessor<DrawingTextParagraphProperties, DrawingTextSpacingInfo, DocumentModelChangeActions>, IIndexAccessorBase<DrawingTextParagraphProperties, DocumentModelChangeActions>
	{
		private int index;

		public DrawingTextSpacingInfoIndexAccessor(int index)
		{
			this.index = index;
		}

		public int GetIndex(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner)
		{
			return owner.TextSpacingInfoIndexes[index];
		}

		public int GetDeferredInfoIndex(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner)
		{
			return GetInfoIndex(owner, GetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper));
		}

		public void SetIndex(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner, int value)
		{
			owner.AssignTextSpacingInfoIndex(index, value);
		}

		public int GetInfoIndex(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner, DrawingTextSpacingInfo value)
		{
			return GetInfoCache(owner).GetItemIndex(value);
		}

		public DrawingTextSpacingInfo GetInfo(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner)
		{
			return GetInfoCache(owner)[GetIndex(owner)];
		}

		public bool IsIndexValid(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner, int index)
		{
			return index < GetInfoCache(owner).Count;
		}

		private UniqueItemsCache<DrawingTextSpacingInfo> GetInfoCache(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner)
		{
			return owner.DrawingCache.DrawingTextSpacingInfoCache;
		}

		public IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<DocumentModelChangeActions> CreateHistoryItem(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner)
		{
			return new DrawingTextSpacingInfoIndexChangeHistoryItem(owner, index);
		}

		public DrawingTextSpacingInfo GetDeferredInfo(MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper helper)
		{
			return ((DrawingTextParagraphPropertiesBatchUpdateHelper)helper).TextSpacingInfos[index];
		}

		public void SetDeferredInfo(MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper helper, DrawingTextSpacingInfo info)
		{
			((DrawingTextParagraphPropertiesBatchUpdateHelper)helper).TextSpacingInfos[index] = info.Clone();
		}

		public void InitializeDeferredInfo(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner)
		{
			SetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper, GetInfo(owner));
		}

		public void CopyDeferredInfo(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner, DrawingTextParagraphProperties from)
		{
			SetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper, GetInfo(from));
		}

		public bool ApplyDeferredChanges(DrawingTextParagraphProperties owner)
		{
			return owner.ReplaceInfo(this, GetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper), owner.GetBatchUpdateChangeActions());
		}

	public class DrawingTextParagraphPropertiesBatchUpdateHelper : MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper

		private DrawingTextParagraphInfo textParagraphInfo;

		private int suppressDirectNotificationsCount;

		public DrawingTextParagraphInfo TextParagraphInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return textParagraphInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				textParagraphInfo = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextSpacingInfo[] TextSpacingInfos => textSpacingInfos;

		public bool IsDirectNotificationsEnabled => suppressDirectNotificationsCount == 0;

		public DrawingTextParagraphPropertiesBatchUpdateHelper(IBatchUpdateHandler handler)
			: base(handler)
		{
			textSpacingInfos = new DrawingTextSpacingInfo[3];
		}

		public void SuppressDirectNotifications()
		{
			suppressDirectNotificationsCount++;
		}

		public void ResumeDirectNotifications()
		{
			suppressDirectNotificationsCount--;
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (TextParagraphInfoIndex == 0 && LineSpacingInfoIndex == 0 && SpaceAfterInfoIndex == 0 && SpaceBeforeInfoIndex == 0 && defaultCharacterProperties.IsDefault && CommonBullet.Type == DrawingBulletType.Automatic && ColorBullet.Type == DrawingBulletType.Automatic && TypefaceBullet.Type == DrawingBulletType.Automatic && SizeBullet.Type == DrawingBulletType.Automatic)
				{
					return TabStopList.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static IIndexAccessorBase<DrawingTextParagraphProperties, DocumentModelChangeActions>[] GetIndexAccessors()
		{
			IIndexAccessorBase<DrawingTextParagraphProperties, DocumentModelChangeActions>[] array = new IIndexAccessorBase<DrawingTextParagraphProperties, DocumentModelChangeActions>[4];
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new DrawingTextSpacingInfoIndexAccessor(i);
			}
			array[3] = textParagraphInfoIndexAccessor;
			return array;
		}

		public DrawingTextParagraphProperties(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
			defaultCharacterProperties = new DrawingTextCharacterProperties(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = base.InnerParent
			};
			textSpacingInfoIndexes = new int[3];
			textSpacingsChangeManager = new DrawingTextSpacingPropertyChangeManager(this);
			bullets = new Dictionary<DrawingBulletType, IDrawingBullet>();
			AddDefaultBullets();
			tabStopList = new DrawingTextTabStopCollection(documentModel);
		}

		private void SetBullet(DrawingBulletType type, IDrawingBullet value)
		{
			if (value.Type != DrawingBulletType.Automatic && type != value.Type)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid DrawingBulletType.");
			}
			IDrawingBullet drawingBullet = bullets[type];
			if (!drawingBullet.Equals(value))
			{
				HistoryItem historyItem = new DrawingTextParagraphPropertiesBulletChangedHistoryItem(this, type, drawingBullet, value);
				base.DocumentModel.History.Add(historyItem);
				historyItem.Execute();
			}
		}

		public void SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType type, IDrawingBullet value)
		{
			bullets[type] = value;
		}

		DrawingTextSpacingValueType IDrawingTextSpacingsChanger.GetType(int index)
		{
			return GetTextSpacingInfo(index).Type;
		}

		void IDrawingTextSpacingsChanger.SetType(int index, DrawingTextSpacingValueType value)
		{
			if (GetTextSpacingInfo(index).Type != value)
			{
				SetPropertyValue(GetTextSpacingInfoIndexAccessor(index), SetTypeCore, value);
			}
		}

		private DocumentModelChangeActions SetTypeCore(DrawingTextSpacingInfo info, DrawingTextSpacingValueType value)
		{
			info.Type = value;
			return DocumentModelChangeActions.None;
		}

		int IDrawingTextSpacingsChanger.GetValue(int index)
		{
			return GetTextSpacingInfo(index).Value;
		}

		void IDrawingTextSpacingsChanger.SetValue(int index, int value)
		{
			if (GetTextSpacingInfo(index).Value != value && GetTextSpacingInfo(index).Type != DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Automatic)
			{
				SetPropertyValue(GetTextSpacingInfoIndexAccessor(index), SetValueCore, value);
			}
		}

		private DocumentModelChangeActions SetValueCore(DrawingTextSpacingInfo info, int value)
		{
			info.Value = value;
			return DocumentModelChangeActions.None;
		}

		private void AddDefaultBullets()
		{
			SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType.Common, DrawingBullet.Automatic);
			SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType.Color, DrawingBullet.Automatic);
			SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType.Typeface, DrawingBullet.Automatic);
			SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType.Size, DrawingBullet.Automatic);
		}

		public void AssignTextParagraphInfoIndex(int value)
		{
			textParagraphInfoIndex = value;
		}

		public void AssignTextSpacingInfoIndex(int index, int value)
		{
			if (base.IsUpdateLocked && base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextSpacingInfoCache.Count > value)
			{
				BatchUpdateHelper.TextSpacingInfos[index] = base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextSpacingInfoCache[value];
			}
			else
			{
				textSpacingInfoIndexes[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public override DrawingTextParagraphProperties GetOwner()
		{
			return this;
		}

		protected override MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper CreateBatchUpdateHelper()
		{
			return new DrawingTextParagraphPropertiesBatchUpdateHelper((IBatchUpdateHandler)(object)this);
		}

		protected override MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper CreateBatchInitHelper()
		{
			return new DrawingTextParagraphPropertiesBatchInitHelper(this);
		}

		public override DocumentModelChangeActions GetBatchUpdateChangeActions()
		{
			return DocumentModelChangeActions.None;
		}

		internal DrawingTextSpacingInfo GetTextSpacingInfo(int index)
		{
			if (BatchUpdateHelper != null)
			{
				return BatchUpdateHelper.TextSpacingInfos[index];
			}
			return base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextSpacingInfoCache[TextSpacingInfoIndexes[index]];
		}

		private DrawingTextSpacingInfoIndexAccessor GetTextSpacingInfoIndexAccessor(int index)
		{
			return (DrawingTextSpacingInfoIndexAccessor)TextParagraphPropertiesIndexAccessors[index];
		}

		public DrawingTextParagraphProperties Clone()
		{
			DrawingTextParagraphProperties drawingTextParagraphProperties = new DrawingTextParagraphProperties(base.DocumentModel);
			CloneCore(drawingTextParagraphProperties);
			drawingTextParagraphProperties.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextParagraphProperties;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextParagraphProperties value)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			defaultCharacterProperties.CopyFrom(value.defaultCharacterProperties);
			SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType.Common, value.CommonBullet);
			SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType.Color, value.ColorBullet);
			SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType.Typeface, value.TypefaceBullet);
			SetBulletCore(DrawingBulletType.Size, value.SizeBullet);
			tabStopList.CopyFrom(value.TabStopList);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextParagraphProperties drawingTextParagraphProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Equals((object)drawingTextParagraphProperties) && defaultCharacterProperties.Equals(drawingTextParagraphProperties.defaultCharacterProperties) && CommonBullet.Equals(drawingTextParagraphProperties.CommonBullet) && ColorBullet.Equals(drawingTextParagraphProperties.ColorBullet) && TypefaceBullet.Equals(drawingTextParagraphProperties.TypefaceBullet) && SizeBullet.Equals(drawingTextParagraphProperties.SizeBullet))
			{
				return tabStopList.Equals(drawingTextParagraphProperties.tabStopList);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode() ^ defaultCharacterProperties.GetHashCode() ^ CommonBullet.GetHashCode() ^ ColorBullet.GetHashCode() ^ TypefaceBullet.GetHashCode() ^ SizeBullet.GetHashCode() ^ tabStopList.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void ResetToStyle()
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				TextParagraphInfo.CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextParagraphInfoCache.DefaultItem);
				GetTextSpacingInfo(0).CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextSpacingInfoCache.DefaultItem);
				GetTextSpacingInfo(1).CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextSpacingInfoCache.DefaultItem);
				GetTextSpacingInfo(2).CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.DrawingTextSpacingInfoCache.DefaultItem);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
			defaultCharacterProperties.ResetToStyle();
			SetBullet(DrawingBulletType.Common, DrawingBullet.Automatic);
			SetBullet(DrawingBulletType.Color, DrawingBullet.Automatic);
			SetBullet(DrawingBulletType.Typeface, DrawingBullet.Automatic);
			SetBullet(DrawingBulletType.Size, DrawingBullet.Automatic);
			TabStopList.Clear();
		}
	}

		public static ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetCustomGeometryByPreset(DrawingPresetTextWarp warpType)
		{
			lock (calculatedGeometries)
			{
				return GetCustomGeometryByPresetCore(warpType);
			}
		}

		private static ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetCustomGeometryByPresetCore(DrawingPresetTextWarp warpType)
		{
			if (calculatedGeometries.TryGetValue(warpType, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (!geometrysGenerators.TryGetValue(warpType, out var value2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry modelShapeCustomGeometry = value2();
			calculatedGeometries.Add(warpType, modelShapeCustomGeometry);
			return modelShapeCustomGeometry;
		}

			modelShapePath.Instructions.Add(new PathCubicBezier(FakeDocumentModel.Instance, "x13", "y6", "x14", "y5", "x15", "y4"));
			modelShapeCustomGeometry.Paths.Add(modelShapePath);
			return modelShapeCustomGeometry;
		}
	}
	public interface IDrawingBullet
	{
		DrawingBulletType Type { get; }

		void Visit(IDrawingBulletVisitor visitor);
	}
	public enum DrawingBulletType
	{
		Automatic,
		Color,
		Size,
		Typeface,
		Common
	}
	public interface IDrawingBulletVisitor
	{
		void Visit(DrawingBulletAutoNumbered bullet);

		void Visit(DrawingBulletCharacter bullet);

		void Visit(DrawingBlip bullet);

		void Visit(DrawingColor bullet);

		void Visit(DrawingTextFont bullet);

		void Visit(DrawingBulletSizePercentage bullet);

		void Visit(DrawingBulletSizePoints bullet);

		void VisitNoBullets();

		void VisitBulletColorFollowText();

		void VisitBulletTypefaceFollowText();

		void VisitBulletSizeFollowText();
	}
	public sealed class DrawingBullet : IDrawingBullet
	{
		public static DrawingBullet Automatic = new DrawingBullet(DrawingBulletType.Automatic);

		public static DrawingBullet NoBullets = new DrawingBullet(DrawingBulletType.Common);

		public static DrawingBullet TypefaceFollowText = new DrawingBullet(DrawingBulletType.Typeface);

		public static DrawingBullet ColorFollowText = new DrawingBullet(DrawingBulletType.Color);

		public static DrawingBullet SizeFollowText = new DrawingBullet(DrawingBulletType.Size);

		private DrawingBulletType type;

		public DrawingBulletType Type => type;

		private DrawingBullet(DrawingBulletType type)
		{
			this.type = type;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingBulletVisitor visitor)
		{
			if (type == DrawingBulletType.Common)
			{
				visitor.VisitNoBullets();
			}
			if (type == DrawingBulletType.Typeface)
			{
				visitor.VisitBulletTypefaceFollowText();
			}
			if (type == DrawingBulletType.Color)
			{
				visitor.VisitBulletColorFollowText();
			}
			if (type == DrawingBulletType.Size)
			{
				visitor.VisitBulletSizeFollowText();
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DrawingBullet drawingBullet)
			{
				return type == drawingBullet.type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)type;
		}

		public IDrawingBullet CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			if (type == DrawingBulletType.Common)
			{
				return NoBullets;
			}
			if (type == DrawingBulletType.Typeface)
			{
				return TypefaceFollowText;
			}
			if (type == DrawingBulletType.Color)
			{
				return ColorFollowText;
			}
			if (type == DrawingBulletType.Size)
			{
				return SizeFollowText;
			}
			return Automatic;
		}
	}
	public class DrawingBulletAutoNumbered : IDrawingBullet

		public DrawingBulletType Type => DrawingBulletType.Common;

		public DrawingBulletAutoNumbered(DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType schemeType, short startAt)
		{
			DrawingValueChecker.CheckTextBulletStartAtNumValue(startAt);
			this.schemeType = schemeType;
			this.startAt = startAt;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingBulletVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DrawingBulletAutoNumbered drawingBulletAutoNumbered && schemeType == drawingBulletAutoNumbered.schemeType)
			{
				return startAt == drawingBulletAutoNumbered.startAt;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)((uint)GetType().GetHashCode() ^ (uint)schemeType) ^ (int)startAt;
		}

		public IDrawingBullet CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			return new DrawingBulletAutoNumbered(schemeType, startAt);
		}
	}

	public class DrawingTextFont : ICloneable<DrawingTextFont>, ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingTextFont>, IDrawingBullet
	{
		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly InvalidateProxy innerParent;

		public const byte DefaultCharset = 1;

		public const byte DefaultPitchFamily = 0;

		private const int TypefaceIndex = 0;

		private const int PanoseIndex = 1;

		private const int CharsetIndex = 0;

		private const int PitchFamilyIndex = 1;

		private string[] stringArray;

		private byte[] byteArray;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		protected internal ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerParent.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				innerParent.Target = value;
			}
		}

		public string Typeface
		{
			get
			{
				return stringArray[0];
			}
			set
			{
				SetStringArray(0, value);
			}
		}

		public string Panose
		{
			get
			{
				return stringArray[1];
			}
			set
			{
				SetStringArray(1, value);
			}
		}

		public byte Charset
		{
			get
			{
				return byteArray[0];
			}
			set
			{
				SetByteArray(0, value);
			}
		}

		public byte PitchFamily
		{
			get
			{
				return byteArray[1];
			}
			set
			{
				SetByteArray(1, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(stringArray[0]) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(stringArray[1]) && byteArray[0] == 1)
				{
					return byteArray[1] == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		DrawingBulletType IDrawingBullet.Type => DrawingBulletType.Typeface;

		public DrawingTextFont(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			stringArray = new string[2]
			{
				string.Empty,
				string.Empty
			};
			byteArray = new byte[2] { 1, 0 };
		}

		private void SetStringArray(int index, string value)
		{
			if (stringArray[index] != value)
			{
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingTextFontStringChangedHistoryItem(this, index, stringArray[index], value));
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetStringCore(int index, string value)
		{
			stringArray[index] = value;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		private void SetByteArray(int index, byte value)
		{
			if (byteArray[index] != value)
			{
				ApplyHistoryItem(new DrawingTextFontByteChangedHistoryItem(this, index, byteArray[index], value));
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetByteCore(int index, byte value)
		{
			byteArray[index] = value;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		private void ApplyHistoryItem(HistoryItem item)
		{
			documentModel.History.Add(item);
			item.Execute();
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextFont value)
		{
			stringArray[0] = value.stringArray[0];
			stringArray[1] = value.stringArray[1];
			byteArray[0] = value.byteArray[0];
			byteArray[1] = value.byteArray[1];
		}

		public DrawingTextFont Clone()
		{
			DrawingTextFont drawingTextFont = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel);
			drawingTextFont.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextFont;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextFont drawingTextFont))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (stringArray[0] == drawingTextFont.stringArray[0] && stringArray[1] == drawingTextFont.stringArray[1] && byteArray[0] == drawingTextFont.byteArray[0])
			{
				return byteArray[1] == drawingTextFont.byteArray[1];
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return stringArray[0].GetHashCode() ^ stringArray[1].GetHashCode() ^ byteArray[0] ^ byteArray[1];
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			documentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				Typeface = string.Empty;
				Panose = string.Empty;
				Charset = 1;
				PitchFamily = 0;
			}
			finally
			{
				documentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		IDrawingBullet IDrawingBullet.CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingTextFont drawingTextFont = new DrawingTextFont(documentModel);
			drawingTextFont.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextFont;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingBulletVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}

	public abstract class DrawingTextRunStringBase : DrawingTextRunBase
	{
		private string text = string.Empty;

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					value = string.Empty;
				}
				if (!(text == value))
				{
					SetText(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected DrawingTextRunStringBase(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
		}

		private void SetText(string value)
		{
			DrawingTextRunTextPropertyChangedHistoryItem drawingTextRunTextPropertyChangedHistoryItem = new DrawingTextRunTextPropertyChangedHistoryItem(base.DocumentModel.MainPart, this, text, value);
			base.DocumentModel.History.Add(drawingTextRunTextPropertyChangedHistoryItem);
			drawingTextRunTextPropertyChangedHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public void SetTextCore(string value)
		{
			text = value;
			InvalidateParent();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DrawingTextRunStringBase drawingTextRunStringBase && string.Equals(text, drawingTextRunStringBase.text))
			{
				return base.Equals(obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode() ^ text.GetHashCode();
		}

		protected void CopyFrom(DrawingTextRunStringBase value)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			Text = value.Text;
		}
	}

		public Guid FieldId

			get

				return fieldId;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!fieldId.Equals(value))
				{
					SetFieldId(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public string FieldType
		{
			get
			{
				return fieldType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = string.Empty;
				}
				if (!fieldType.Equals(value))
				{
					SetFieldType(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextParagraphProperties ParagraphProperties => paragraphProperties;

		public bool IsTextLinkField => fieldType == "TxLink";

		public DrawingTextField(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)

			fieldId = Guid.Empty;
			fieldType = string.Empty;
			paragraphProperties = new DrawingTextParagraphProperties(documentModel)
			{
				Parent = base.InnerParent
			};
		}

		private void SetFieldId(Guid value)
		{
			DrawingTextFieldIdPropertyChangedHistoryItem drawingTextFieldIdPropertyChangedHistoryItem = new DrawingTextFieldIdPropertyChangedHistoryItem(base.DocumentModel.MainPart, this, fieldId, value);
			base.DocumentModel.History.Add(drawingTextFieldIdPropertyChangedHistoryItem);
			drawingTextFieldIdPropertyChangedHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public void SetFieldIdCore(Guid value)
		{
			fieldId = value;
		}

		private void SetFieldType(string value)
		{
			DrawingTextFieldTypePropertyChangedHistoryItem drawingTextFieldTypePropertyChangedHistoryItem = new DrawingTextFieldTypePropertyChangedHistoryItem(base.DocumentModel.MainPart, this, fieldType, value);
			base.DocumentModel.History.Add(drawingTextFieldTypePropertyChangedHistoryItem);
			drawingTextFieldTypePropertyChangedHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public void SetFieldTypeCore(string value)
		{
			fieldType = value;
			InvalidateParent();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextField drawingTextField))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Equals((object)drawingTextField) && fieldId.Equals(drawingTextField.fieldId) && fieldType.Equals(drawingTextField.fieldType))
			{
				return paragraphProperties.Equals(drawingTextField.paragraphProperties);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode() ^ fieldId.GetHashCode() ^ fieldType.GetHashCode() ^ paragraphProperties.GetHashCode();
		}

			FieldId = value.FieldId;
			FieldType = value.FieldType;
			paragraphProperties.CopyFrom(value.paragraphProperties);
		}

	public class DrawingTextRunCollection : UndoableClonableCollection<IDrawingTextRun>
	{
		private readonly InvalidateProxy innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();

		protected internal ISupportsInvalidate Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return innerParent.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				innerParent.Target = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextRunCollection(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel.MainPart)
		{
		}

		public override UndoableClonableCollection<IDrawingTextRun> GetNewCollection(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			return new DrawingTextRunCollection(documentModelPart.DocumentModel);
		}

		public override IDrawingTextRun GetCloneItem(IDrawingTextRun item, IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			return item.CloneTo(documentModelPart.DocumentModel);
		}

		public override int AddCore(IDrawingTextRun item)
		{
			int result = base.AddCore(item);
			item.Parent = innerParent;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void InsertCore(int index, IDrawingTextRun item)
		{
			base.InsertCore(index, item);
			item.Parent = innerParent;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void RemoveAtCore(int index)
		{
			IDrawingTextRun drawingTextRun = base[index];
			base.RemoveAtCore(index);
			drawingTextRun.Parent = null;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void ClearCore()
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (IEnumerator<IDrawingTextRun> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					IDrawingTextRun current = enumerator.Current;
					current.Parent = null;
				}
			}
			base.ClearCore();
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override void AddRangeCore(IEnumerable<IDrawingTextRun> collection)
		{
			foreach (IDrawingTextRun item in collection)
			{
				item.Parent = innerParent;
			}
			base.AddRangeCore(collection);
			innerParent.Invalidate();
		}

		public override IDrawingTextRun DeserializeItem(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			return reader.GetObject(reader.ReadInt32()) as IDrawingTextRun;
		}
	}

	public class DrawingTextSpacingInfo : ICloneable<DrawingTextSpacingInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<DrawingTextSpacingInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private DrawingTextSpacingValueType type;

		private int value;

		public DrawingTextSpacingValueType Type
		{
			get
			{
				return type;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Automatic)
				{
					this.value = 0;
				}
				type = value;
			}
		}

		public int Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextSpacingInfo Clone()
		{
			DrawingTextSpacingInfo drawingTextSpacingInfo = new DrawingTextSpacingInfo();
			drawingTextSpacingInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return drawingTextSpacingInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(DrawingTextSpacingInfo value)
		{
			type = value.type;
			this.value = value.value;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return DXMarshal.SizeOf(GetType());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DrawingTextSpacingInfo drawingTextSpacingInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (type == drawingTextSpacingInfo.type)
			{
				return value == drawingTextSpacingInfo.value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)type ^ value;
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			type = (DrawingTextSpacingValueType)reader.ReadInt32();
			value = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write((int)type);
			writer.Write(value);
		}
	}

	public class DrawingTextTabStop : ICloneable<DrawingTextTabStop>
	{
		private DrawingTextTabAlignmentType alignment;

		private float position;

		private bool hasPosition;

		public DrawingTextTabAlignmentType Alignment => alignment;

		public float Position => position;

		public bool HasPosition => hasPosition;

		public DrawingTextTabStop()
		{
		}

		public DrawingTextTabStop(DrawingTextTabAlignmentType alignment)
		{
			this.alignment = alignment;
		}

		public DrawingTextTabStop(DrawingTextTabAlignmentType alignment, float position)
			: this(alignment)
		{
			this.position = position;
			hasPosition = true;
		}

		public DrawingTextTabStop Clone()
		{
			if (!hasPosition)
			{
				return new DrawingTextTabStop(alignment);
			}
			return new DrawingTextTabStop(alignment, position);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj.GetType() != GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((DrawingTextTabStop)obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = (int)alignment;
			num = (num * 397) ^ position.GetHashCode();
			return (num * 397) ^ hasPosition.GetHashCode();
		}

		protected bool Equals(DrawingTextTabStop other)
		{
			if (alignment == other.alignment && position.Equals(other.position))
			{
				return hasPosition == other.hasPosition;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public enum DrawingTextTabAlignmentType
	{
		Automatic,
		Left,
		Center,
		Right,
		Decimal
	}

		public static readonly PropertyKey OffsetYPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(4);

		public static readonly PropertyKey CxPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(5);

		public static readonly PropertyKey CyPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(6);

		private int rotation;

		private bool flipH;

		private bool flipV;

		private float cy;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		public int Rotation
		{
			get

				return rotation;
			}
			set

					ChangeRotationProperty(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool FlipH

				return flipH;

		public bool FlipV

		public float OffsetX

				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Rotation == 0 && !FlipH && !FlipV && OffsetX == 0f && OffsetY == 0f && Cx == 0f)
				{
					return Cy == 0f;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged
		{

				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
			remove

				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);

		public Transform2D(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "DocumentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			innerParent = new InvalidateProxy();

		protected virtual void ChangeRotationProperty(int value)
		{
			ActionIntHistoryItem actionIntHistoryItem = new ActionIntHistoryItem(DocumentModel.MainPart, Rotation, value, SetRotationCore);
			DocumentModel.History.Add(actionIntHistoryItem);
			actionIntHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public void SetRotationCore(int value)
		{
			rotation = value;
			innerParent.Invalidate();
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(RotationPropertyKey);
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeFlipHProperty(bool value)
		{

		public float GetRotationAngleInDegrees()
		{
			return DocumentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToDegreeF(Rotation);
		}

		public void RotateCore(int newValue)
		{
			Rotation = newValue;
		}

		public RectangleF GetRotatedBox()
		{
			float rotationAngleInDegrees = GetRotationAngleInDegrees();
			double angle = (double)rotationAngleInDegrees * Math.PI / 180.0;
			double num = OffsetX + Cx / 2f;
			double num2 = OffsetY + Cy / 2f;
			PointF pointF = RotatePoint(new PointF(OffsetX, OffsetY), num, num2, angle);
			PointF pointF2 = RotatePoint(new PointF(OffsetX, OffsetY + Cy), num, num2, angle);
			PointF pointF3 = RotatePoint(new PointF(OffsetX + Cx, OffsetY), num, num2, angle);
			PointF pointF4 = RotatePoint(new PointF(OffsetX + Cx, OffsetY + Cy), num, num2, angle);
			float left = Math.Min(Math.Min(pointF.X, pointF2.X), Math.Min(pointF3.X, pointF4.X));
			float top = Math.Min(Math.Min(pointF.Y, pointF2.Y), Math.Min(pointF3.Y, pointF4.Y));
			float right = Math.Max(Math.Max(pointF.X, pointF2.X), Math.Max(pointF3.X, pointF4.X));
			float bottom = Math.Max(Math.Max(pointF.Y, pointF2.Y), Math.Max(pointF3.Y, pointF4.Y));
			return RectangleF.FromLTRB(left, top, right, bottom);
		}

		private static PointF RotatePoint(PointF point, double cx, double cy, double angle)
		{
			float x = (float)(Math.Cos(angle) * ((double)point.X - cx) + Math.Sin(angle) * ((double)point.Y - cy) + cx);
			float y = (float)((0.0 - Math.Sin(angle)) * ((double)point.X - cx) + Math.Cos(angle) * ((double)point.Y - cy) + cy);
			return new PointF(x, y);
		}

		public void CheckRotationAndSwapBox()
		{
			if (NeedToSwap())
			{
				float num = Cx;
				float num2 = Cy;
				DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
				int value = (unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(num2) - unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(num)) / 2;
				float num3 = unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(value);
				SetOffsetYCore(OffsetY + num3);
				SetOffsetXCore(OffsetX - num3);
				SetCxCore(num2);
				SetCyCore(num);
			}
		}

		private bool NeedToSwap()
		{
			float num = Rotation % 10800000;
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num += 10800000f;
			}
			if (num >= 2700000f)
			{
				return num < 8100000f;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Transform2D Clone()
		{
			Transform2D transform2D = new Transform2D(DocumentModel);
			transform2D.CopyFrom(this);
			return transform2D;
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(Transform2D value)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "Transform2D");
			Rotation = value.rotation;
			FlipH = value.flipH;
			FlipV = value.flipV;
			OffsetX = value.offsetX;
			OffsetY = value.offsetY;
			Cx = value.cx;
			Cy = value.cy;
		}

		public void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			rotation = reader.ReadInt32();
			flipH = reader.ReadBoolean();
			flipV = reader.ReadBoolean();
			offsetX = reader.ReadSingle();
			offsetY = reader.ReadSingle();
			cx = reader.ReadSingle();
			cy = reader.ReadSingle();
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(rotation);
			writer.Write(flipH);
			writer.Write(flipV);
			writer.Write(offsetX);
			writer.Write(offsetY);
			writer.Write(cx);
			writer.Write(cy);
		}
	}
	public class DXGraphicsPainter : Painter
	{
		private delegate void DrawStringImplementationDelegate(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, DXBrush foreBrush, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options);

		private static DrawStringImplementationDelegate[] drawStringImplementations;

		private readonly IDXGraphics graphics;

		private RectangleF rectangularClipBounds;

		protected override RectangleF RectangularClipBounds => rectangularClipBounds;

		public override int DpiY => (int)graphics.DpiY;

		static DXGraphicsPainter()
		{
			drawStringImplementations = new DrawStringImplementationDelegate[4];
			drawStringImplementations[0] = DrawStringSimple;
			drawStringImplementations[1] = DrawStringWithSpacing;
			drawStringImplementations[2] = DrawStringScaled;
			drawStringImplementations[3] = DrawStringScaledAndSpaced;
		}

		public DXGraphicsPainter(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)graphics, "graphics");
			this.graphics = graphics;
			rectangularClipBounds = graphics.ClipBounds;
		}

		public static Rectangle[] MeasureCharactersBounds(IDXGraphics gr, string text, FontInfo fontInfo, Rectangle bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			return MeasureCharactersBounds(gr, text, fontInfo.DXFont, bounds, stringFormat, options);
		}

		public static Rectangle[] MeasureCharactersBounds(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = gr.Transform.Clone();
			try
			{
				gr.ScaleTransform(100f, 100f);
				return MeasureCharactersBoundsCore(gr, text, font, bounds, stringFormat, options);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.Transform = dXMatrix.Clone();
			}
		}

		private static Rectangle[] MeasureCharactersBoundsCore(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			List<DXRegion> list = MeasureCharactersRegions(gr, text, font, bounds, stringFormat);
			int count = list.Count;
			Rectangle[] array = new Rectangle[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = Rectangle.Round(list[i].GetBounds());
			}
			Painter.TryApplyScale(array, options);
			Painter.TryApplyCharacterSpacing(array, options);
			return array;
		}

		private static List<DXRegion> MeasureCharactersRegions(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			SizeF sizeF = gr.MeasureString(text, font, new SizeF(bounds.Width, bounds.Height), stringFormat);
			return new List<DXRegion>
			{
				new DXRegion(new RectangleF(0f, 0f, sizeF.Width, sizeF.Height))
			};
		}

		protected override void SetClipBounds(RectangleF bounds)
		{
			graphics.SetClip(bounds);
			rectangularClipBounds = graphics.ClipBounds;
		}

		public static void DrawStringDispatch(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, DXBrush brush, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			int num = options.CalcVTableIndex();
			drawStringImplementations[num](gr, text, font, brush, bounds, stringFormat, options);
		}

		public override void DrawString(string text, FontInfo fontInfo, Rectangle bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options, IWordBreakProvider workBreakProvider)
		{
			DXBrush brush = GetBrush(base.TextForeColor);
			DrawStringDispatch(graphics, text, fontInfo.DXFont, brush, bounds, stringFormat, options);
		}

		private static void DrawStringSimple(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, DXBrush foreBrush, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			gr.DrawString(text, font, foreBrush, bounds, stringFormat);
		}

		private static void DrawStringWithSpacing(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, DXBrush foreBrush, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			Rectangle[] array = MeasureCharactersBounds(gr, text, font, bounds, stringFormat, options);
			if (array.Length != text.Length)
			{
				DrawStringSimple(gr, text, font, foreBrush, bounds, stringFormat, options);
				return;
			}
			int num = array.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				DrawStringSimple(gr, new string(text[i], 1), font, foreBrush, array[i], stringFormat, options);
			}
		}

		private static void DrawStringScaled(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, DXBrush foreBrush, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = gr.Transform.Clone();
			try
			{
				gr.TranslateTransform(bounds.X, 0f);
				bounds.X = 0f;
				gr.ScaleTransform((float)options.Scale / 100f, 1f);
				DrawStringSimple(gr, text, font, foreBrush, bounds, stringFormat, options);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.Transform = dXMatrix.Clone();
			}
		}

		private static void DrawStringScaledAndSpaced(IDXGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, DXBrush foreBrush, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat stringFormat, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			Rectangle[] array = MeasureCharactersBounds(gr, text, font, bounds, stringFormat, options);
			if (array.Length != text.Length)
			{
				DrawStringSimple(gr, text, font, foreBrush, bounds, stringFormat, options);
				return;
			}
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = gr.Transform.Clone();
			try
			{
				int num = array.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = array[i];
					gr.Transform = dXMatrix.Clone();
					gr.TranslateTransform(rectangle.X, 0f);
					rectangle.X = 0;
					gr.ScaleTransform((float)options.Scale / 100f, 1f);
					DrawStringSimple(gr, new string(text[i], 1), font, foreBrush, rectangle, stringFormat, options);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.Transform = dXMatrix.Clone();
			}
		}

	public abstract class GdiPlusPainterBase : Painter
	{
		protected virtual Rectangle CorrectTextDrawingBounds(FontInfo fontInfo, Rectangle textBounds)
		{
			Rectangle result = textBounds;
			result.Y += CalculateGdiPlusYCorrection(fontInfo);
			return result;
		}

		public static int CalculateGdiPlusYCorrection(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			int num = fontInfo.Free;
			if (!fontInfo.UseTypoMetrics)
			{
				num -= fontInfo.DrawingOffset;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		public virtual void SnapWidths(float[] widths)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[widths.Length + 1];
			array[0] = new PointF(0f, 0f);
			for (int i = 0; i < widths.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i + 1] = new PointF(widths[i], 0f);
			}
			TransformToPixels(array);
			for (int num = widths.Length; num > 0; num--)
			{
				array[num].X = ((widths[num - 1] != 0f) ? Math.Max((int)((double)(array[num].X - array[0].X) + 0.5), 1) : 0);
			}
			array[0].X = 0f;
			TransformToLayoutUnits(array);
			for (int num2 = widths.Length; num2 > 0; num2--)
			{
				widths[num2 - 1] = array[num2].X - array[0].X;
			}
		}

		public virtual void SnapHeights(float[] heights)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[heights.Length + 1];
			array[0] = new PointF(0f, 0f);
			for (int i = 0; i < heights.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i + 1] = new PointF(0f, heights[i]);
			}
			TransformToPixels(array);
			for (int num = heights.Length; num > 0; num--)
			{
				array[num].Y = ((heights[num - 1] != 0f) ? Math.Max((int)((double)(array[num].Y - array[0].Y) + 0.5), 1) : 0);
			}
			array[0].Y = 0f;
			TransformToLayoutUnits(array);
			for (int num2 = heights.Length; num2 > 0; num2--)
			{
				heights[num2 - 1] = array[num2].Y - array[0].Y;
			}
		}

		public virtual PointF GetSnappedPoint(PointF point)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[1] { point };
			TransformToPixels(array);
			array[0].X = (int)Math.Round(array[0].X);
			array[0].Y = (int)Math.Round(array[0].Y);
			TransformToLayoutUnits(array);
			return array[0];
		}

		protected abstract PointF[] TransformToPixels(PointF[] points);

		protected abstract PointF[] TransformToLayoutUnits(PointF[] points);

		public static void TryApplyScale(Rectangle[] charactersBounds, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			if (options.IsEmpty || options.Scale == 100 || options.Scale <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = charactersBounds.Length;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				int x = charactersBounds[0].X;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = charactersBounds[i];
					rectangle.X = x + options.Scale * (rectangle.X - x) / 100;
					rectangle.Width = options.Scale * rectangle.Width / 100;
					charactersBounds[i] = rectangle;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void TryApplyCharacterSpacing(Rectangle[] charactersBounds, AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions options)
		{
			int spacing = options.Spacing;
			if (options.IsEmpty || spacing == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = charactersBounds.Length;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (spacing >= 0)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = charactersBounds[i];
					rectangle.X += num2;
					rectangle.Width += spacing;
					num2 += spacing;
					charactersBounds[i] = rectangle;
				}
				return;
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle2 = charactersBounds[j];
				rectangle2.X += num3;
				int num4 = rectangle2.Width + spacing;
				if (num4 <= 0)
				{
					num3 += -rectangle2.Width + 1;
					rectangle2.Width = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 += spacing;
					rectangle2.Width = num4;
				}
				charactersBounds[j] = rectangle2;
			}
		}
	}

	public class FontFamilyCharset
	{
		private readonly FontCharacterSet regularCharset;

		private readonly FontCharacterSet boldCharset;

		private readonly FontCharacterSet italicCharset;

		private readonly FontCharacterSet boldItalicCharset;

		public FontFamilyCharset(FontCharacterSet regular)
		{
			regularCharset = regular;
		}

		public FontFamilyCharset(FontCharacterSet regular, FontCharacterSet bold, FontCharacterSet italic, FontCharacterSet boldItalic)
			: this(regular)
		{
			boldCharset = bold ?? regular;
			italicCharset = italic ?? regular;
			boldItalicCharset = boldItalic ?? regular;
		}

		public FontCharacterSet GetCharset(bool bold, bool italic)
		{
			if (bold)
			{
				if (italic)
				{
					return boldItalicCharset;
				}
				return boldCharset;
			}
			if (!italic)
			{
				return regularCharset;
			}
			return italicCharset;
		}
	}
	public struct FontDescription : IEquatable<FontDescription>
	{
		public string Name { get; }

		public bool Bold { get; }

		public bool Italic { get; }

		public FontDescription(string name, bool bold, bool italic)
		{
			Name = name;
			Bold = bold;
			Italic = italic;
		}

		public bool Equals(FontDescription other)
		{
			if (Name == other.Name && Bold == other.Bold)
			{
				return Italic == other.Italic;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is FontDescription))
			{
				return base.Equals(obj);
			}
			return Equals((FontDescription)obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = -1246436871;
			num = num * -1521134295 + EqualityComparer<string>.Default.GetHashCode(Name);
			num = num * -1521134295 + Bold.GetHashCode();
			return num * -1521134295 + Italic.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public abstract class FontCache : IFontRepositoryListener, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly object syncObject = new object();

		private bool isDisposed;

		private FontInfoMeasurer measurer;

		private ConcurrentDictionary<long, int> indexHash;

		private Dictionary<string, int> charsets;

		private List<FontInfo> fontInfoList;

		private readonly Dictionary<Guid, WeakReference<IFontCacheListener>> listeners = new Dictionary<Guid, WeakReference<IFontCacheListener>>();

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, FontFamilyCharset> nameToCharacterSetMap = new Dictionary<string, FontFamilyCharset>();

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, FontCapabilitiesInfo> fontCapabilitiesMap = CreateFontCapabilitiesMap();

		protected static bool nameToCharacterMapPopulated;

		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter;

		private readonly bool allowCjkCorrection;

		internal bool IsDisposed => isDisposed;

		public FontInfo this[int index] => fontInfoList[index];

		internal List<FontInfo> FontInfoList => fontInfoList;

		internal ConcurrentDictionary<long, int> IndexHash => indexHash;

		public FontInfoMeasurer Measurer
		{
			get
			{
				if (measurer == null)
				{
					measurer = CreateFontInfoMeasurer(unitConverter);
				}
				return measurer;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual Dictionary<string, FontFamilyCharset> NameToCharacterSetMap => nameToCharacterSetMap;

		public DocumentLayoutUnitConverter UnitConverter => unitConverter;

		public bool AllowCjkCorrection => allowCjkCorrection;

		public abstract FontCacheType FontCacheType { get; }

		protected FontCache(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, bool allowCjkCorrection)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
			indexHash = new ConcurrentDictionary<long, int>();
			charsets = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringExtensions.ComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			fontInfoList = new List<FontInfo>();
			this.allowCjkCorrection = allowCjkCorrection;
			DXFontRepository.Instance.RegisterListener(this);
		}

		public virtual bool ShouldUseDefaultFontToDrawInvisibleCharacter(FontInfo fontInfo, char character)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal abstract FontInfoMeasurer CreateFontInfoMeasurer(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter);

		protected internal abstract FontInfo CreateFontInfoCore(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int textRotation, FontInfo baselineFontInfo);

		public FontInfo CreateFontInfo(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline)
		{
			return CreateFontInfo(fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, 0);
		}

		public FontInfo CreateFontInfo(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int textRotation)
		{
			return CreateFontInfoCore(fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, textRotation, null);
		}

		public virtual int CalcFontIndex(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, CharacterFormattingScript script, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline)
		{
			return CalcFontIndex(fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, script, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, 0);
		}

		public int CalcFontIndex(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, CharacterFormattingScript script, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int textRotation)
		{
			int num = unitConverter.PointsToFontUnits(doubleFontSize);
			int num2 = CalcNormalFontIndex(fontName, num, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, textRotation);
			int num3;
			switch (script)
			{
			case CharacterFormattingScript.Normal:
				return num2;
			case CharacterFormattingScript.Subscript:
				num3 = CalcSubscriptFontSize(num2);
				break;
			default:
				num3 = CalcSuperscriptFontSize(num2);
				break;
			}
			return CalcFontIndexCore(fontName, num3 * 2, num, fontBold, fontItalic, script, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, textRotation, this[num2]);
		}

		public int CalcNormalFontIndex(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int textRotation)
		{
			return CalcFontIndexCore(fontName, doubleFontSize, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, CharacterFormattingScript.Normal, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, textRotation, null);
		}

		protected internal int CalcSubscriptFontSize(int baseFontIndex)
		{
			FontInfo fontInfo = fontInfoList[baseFontIndex];
			return (int)Math.Round((float)fontInfo.SubscriptSize.Height * unitConverter.FontSizeScale);
		}

		protected internal int CalcSuperscriptFontSize(int baseFontIndex)
		{
			FontInfo fontInfo = fontInfoList[baseFontIndex];
			return (int)Math.Round((float)fontInfo.SuperscriptSize.Height * unitConverter.FontSizeScale);
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalcFontIndexCore(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, int doubleBaselineFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, CharacterFormattingScript script, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int textRotation, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
		{
			long num = CalcHash(fontName, doubleFontSize, doubleBaselineFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, script, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, textRotation);
			if (!indexHash.TryGetValue(num, out var value))
			{
				lock (this)
				{
					if (!indexHash.TryGetValue(num, out value))
					{
						return CreateFontInfo(num, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, textRotation, baselineFontInfo);
					}
					return value;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal virtual long CalcHash(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, int doubleBaselineFontSize, bool bold, bool italic, CharacterFormattingScript script, bool strikeout, bool underline, int textRotation)
		{
			long num = fontName.ToLower().GetHashCode();
			long num2 = doubleFontSize + doubleBaselineFontSize;
			int num3 = (textRotation + 90 << 6) | (underline ? 32 : 0) | (strikeout ? 16 : 0) | (italic ? 8 : 0) | (bold ? 4 : 0) | (int)script;
			return (num << 32) + (num2 << 14) + num3;
		}

		protected internal virtual int CreateFontInfo(long hash, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int textRotation, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
		{
			FontInfo fontInfo = CreateFontInfoCore(fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, textRotation, baselineFontInfo);
			int count = fontInfoList.Count;
			fontInfoList.Add(fontInfo);
			if (!charsets.ContainsKey(fontName))
			{
				charsets.Add(fontName, fontInfo.Charset);
			}
			indexHash.TryAdd(hash, count);
			return count;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				fontInfoList.Clear();
				indexHash.Clear();
				Measurer.EmbeddedFonts.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected abstract List<FontCharacterRange> GetFontCharacterRanges(FontInfo fontInfo);

		protected List<FontCharacterRange> CreateFontCharacterRanges(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			List<FontCharacterRange> fontCharacterRanges = GetFontCharacterRanges(fontInfo);
			if (fontCharacterRanges != null)
			{
				fontCharacterRanges.Add(new FontCharacterRange(0, 31));
				fontCharacterRanges.Add(new FontCharacterRange(127, 159));
				fontCharacterRanges.Add(new FontCharacterRange(61440, 61695));
			}
			return fontCharacterRanges;
		}

		public int GetCharsetByFontName(string fontName)
		{
			if (!charsets.TryGetValue(fontName, out var _))
			{
				CalcFontIndex(fontName, 24, fontBold: false, fontItalic: false, CharacterFormattingScript.Normal, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false, 0);
			}
			return charsets[fontName];
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposeContent();
				if (measurer != null)
				{
					measurer.Dispose();
					measurer = null;
				}
			}
			isDisposed = true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		protected internal virtual void DisposeContent()
		{
			DisposeContentCore();
			fontInfoList = null;
			indexHash = null;
		}

		private void DisposeContentCore()
		{
			if (fontInfoList != null)
			{
				int count = fontInfoList.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					this[i].Dispose();
				}
				fontInfoList.Clear();
			}
			if (indexHash != null)
			{
				indexHash.Clear();
			}
		}

		public virtual string FindSubstituteFont(FontDescription sourceFont, char ch)
		{
			PopulateNameToCharacterSetMap();
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			string result = sourceFont.Name;
			lock (NameToCharacterSetMap)
			{
				FontCharacterSet charset = NameToCharacterSetMap[sourceFont.Name].GetCharset(sourceFont.Bold, sourceFont.Italic);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, FontFamilyCharset> item in NameToCharacterSetMap)
				{
					FontCharacterSet charset2 = item.Value.GetCharset(sourceFont.Bold, sourceFont.Italic);
					if (charset2.ContainsChar(ch))
					{
						int num2 = FontCharacterSet.CalculatePanoseDistance(charset, charset2);
						if (num2 < num)
						{
							num = num2;
							result = item.Key;
						}
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PopulateNameToCharacterSetMap()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				if (nameToCharacterMapPopulated)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (string systemFontFamily in GetSystemFontFamilies())
				{
					GetFontCharacterSet(new FontDescription(systemFontFamily, bold: false, italic: false));
				}
				nameToCharacterMapPopulated = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract IEnumerable<string> GetSystemFontFamilies();

		protected internal abstract FontCharacterSet CreateFontCharacterSet(FontDescription fontDescription);

		public FontData[] GetFontsData()
		{
			List<FontData> list = new List<FontData>();
			for (int i = 0; i < FontInfoList.Count; i++)
			{
				FontInfo fontInfo = FontInfoList[i];
				IEmbeddedFont embeddedFont;
				string name = (Measurer.TryGetEmbeddedFont(fontInfo.NameWin32, out embeddedFont) ? embeddedFont.FontName : fontInfo.NameWin32);
				FontData fontData = new FontData(name, fontInfo.Bold, fontInfo.Italic, embeddedFont, fontInfo.GetFontData());
				if (list.FindIndex((FontData value) => fontData.Data.SequenceEqual(value.Data)) == -1)
				{
					list.Add(fontData);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public IEmbeddedFont[] GetEmbeddedFontsData()
		{
			return Measurer.EmbeddedFonts.Values.ToArray();
		}

		public FontCharacterSet GetFontCharacterSet(FontDescription fontDescription)
		{
			lock (NameToCharacterSetMap)
			{
				if (NameToCharacterSetMap.TryGetValue(fontDescription.Name, out var value))
				{
					return value.GetCharset(fontDescription.Bold, fontDescription.Italic);
				}
				value = CreateFontFamilyCharacterSet(fontDescription.Name);
				if (value != null)
				{
					NameToCharacterSetMap.Add(fontDescription.Name, value);
					return value.GetCharset(fontDescription.Bold, fontDescription.Italic);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual FontFamilyCharset CreateFontFamilyCharacterSet(string fontName)
		{
			FontCharacterSet fontCharacterSet = CreateFontCharacterSet(new FontDescription(fontName, bold: false, italic: false));
			if (fontCharacterSet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FontCharacterSet bold = CreateFontCharacterSet(new FontDescription(fontName, bold: true, italic: false));
			FontCharacterSet italic = CreateFontCharacterSet(new FontDescription(fontName, bold: false, italic: true));
			FontCharacterSet boldItalic = CreateFontCharacterSet(new FontDescription(fontName, bold: true, italic: true));
			return new FontFamilyCharset(fontCharacterSet, bold, italic, boldItalic);
		}

		public bool IsCjkFont(string fontName, bool fallbackValue)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FontCapabilitiesInfo fontCapabilities = GetFontCapabilities(fontName);
			if (fontCapabilities == null || fontCapabilities.IsSubstituted)
			{
				return fallbackValue;
			}
			return fontCapabilities.IsCjk;
		}

		public bool IsComplexScriptFont(string fontName, bool fallbackValue)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FontCapabilitiesInfo fontCapabilities = GetFontCapabilities(fontName);
			if (fontCapabilities == null || fontCapabilities.IsSubstituted)
			{
				return fallbackValue;
			}
			return fontCapabilities.IsComplexScript;
		}

		public FontCapabilitiesInfo GetFontCapabilities(string fontName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (fontCapabilitiesMap.TryGetValue(fontName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = GetFontCapabilitiesCore(fontName);
			fontCapabilitiesMap[fontName] = value;
			return value;
		}

		protected abstract FontCapabilitiesInfo GetFontCapabilitiesCore(string fontName);

		public void OnChanged()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				IList<IFontCacheListener> list = CollectActualListeners();
				foreach (IFontCacheListener item in list)
				{
					item.BeforeFontCacheInvalidated();
				}
				DisposeContentCore();
				foreach (IFontCacheListener item2 in list)
				{
					item2.AfterFontCacheInvalidated();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterListener(IFontCacheListener listener)
		{
			lock (listeners)
			{
				if (!listeners.ContainsKey(listener.Id))
				{
					listeners.Add(listener.Id, new WeakReference<IFontCacheListener>(listener));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UnregisterListener(IFontCacheListener listener)
		{
			lock (listeners)
			{
				if (listeners.ContainsKey(listener.Id))
				{
					listeners.Remove(listener.Id);
				}
			}
		}

		private IList<IFontCacheListener> CollectActualListeners()
		{
			lock (listeners)
			{
				List<IFontCacheListener> list = new List<IFontCacheListener>();
				List<Guid> list2 = new List<Guid>();
				foreach (Guid key in listeners.Keys)
				{
					if (listeners[key].TryGetTarget(out var target))
					{
						list.Add(target);
					}
					else
					{
						list2.Add(key);
					}
				}
				foreach (Guid item in list2)
				{
					listeners.Remove(item);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ScriptFontSizeComparableBase : IComparable<int>
	{
		private readonly string fontName;

		private readonly bool fontBold;

		private readonly bool fontItalic;

		private readonly bool fontStrikeout;

		private readonly bool fontUnderline;

		private readonly FontCache fontCache;

		private readonly int formattingFontSize;

		private readonly int doubleformattingFontSize;

		private readonly int textRotation;

		protected ScriptFontSizeComparableBase(FontCache fontCache, string fontName, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int scriptFontSize, int doublescriptFontSize, int textRotation)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fontCache, "fontCache");
			this.fontCache = fontCache;
			this.fontName = fontName;
			this.fontBold = fontBold;
			this.fontItalic = fontItalic;
			this.fontStrikeout = fontStrikeout;
			this.fontUnderline = fontUnderline;
			formattingFontSize = fontCache.UnitConverter.PointsToFontUnits(scriptFontSize);
			doubleformattingFontSize = fontCache.UnitConverter.PointsToFontUnits(doublescriptFontSize);
			this.textRotation = textRotation;
		}

		public int CompareTo(int doublebaseFontSize)
		{
			return Math.Sign(CalculateDistance(doublebaseFontSize));
		}

		public int CalculateDistance(int doublebaseFontSize)
		{
			int baseFontIndex = fontCache.CalcFontIndex(fontName, doublebaseFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, CharacterFormattingScript.Normal, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, textRotation);
			int num = CalculateScriptFontSize(fontCache, baseFontIndex);
			return num - formattingFontSize;
		}

		protected internal abstract int CalculateScriptFontSize(FontCache fontCache, int baseFontIndex);
	}
	public class SuperscriptFontSizeComparable : ScriptFontSizeComparableBase
	{
		public SuperscriptFontSizeComparable(FontCache fontCache, string fontName, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int scriptFontSize, int doublescriptFontSize, int textRotation)
			: base(fontCache, fontName, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, scriptFontSize, doublescriptFontSize, textRotation)
		{
		}

		protected internal override int CalculateScriptFontSize(FontCache fontCache, int baseFontIndex)
		{
			return fontCache.CalcSuperscriptFontSize(baseFontIndex);
		}
	}
	public class SubscriptFontSizeComparable : ScriptFontSizeComparableBase
	{
		public SubscriptFontSizeComparable(FontCache fontCache, string fontName, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int scriptFontSize, int doublescriptFontSize, int textRotation)
			: base(fontCache, fontName, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, scriptFontSize, doublescriptFontSize, textRotation)
		{
		}

		protected internal override int CalculateScriptFontSize(FontCache fontCache, int baseFontIndex)
		{
			return fontCache.CalcSubscriptFontSize(baseFontIndex);
		}
	}
	public abstract class FontCacheManager
	{
		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter;

		private readonly bool allowCjkCorrection;

		private readonly bool useSystemFontQuality;

		public DocumentLayoutUnitConverter UnitConverter => unitConverter;

		public bool AllowCjkCorrection => allowCjkCorrection;

		public bool UseSystemFontQuality => useSystemFontQuality;

		protected FontCacheManager(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, bool allowCjkCorrection, bool useSystemFontQuality)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
			this.allowCjkCorrection = allowCjkCorrection;
			this.useSystemFontQuality = useSystemFontQuality;
		}

		public abstract FontCache CreateFontCache();

		public virtual void ReleaseFontCache(FontCache cache)
		{
			cache.Dispose();
		}

		public abstract FontCacheManager Clone(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, bool allowCjkCorrection, bool useSystemFontQuality);

		public static FontCacheManager CreateDefault(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, bool allowCjkCorrection, bool useSystemFontQuality)
		{
			return MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyTypeHelper.CalculateType() switch
			{
				MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyType.ServiceBased => PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.TextRender.CreateFontCacheManager(unitConverter, allowCjkCorrection, useSystemFontQuality), 
				MeasurementAndDrawingStrategyType.CrossPlatform => new CrossPlatformFontCacheManager(unitConverter, allowCjkCorrection, useSystemFontQuality), 
				_ => new WindowsPlatformFontCacheManager(unitConverter, allowCjkCorrection, useSystemFontQuality, FontCacheType.GdiPlus), 
			};
		}
	}

		private int hi;

		public int Low => low;

		{
			this.low = low;
			this.hi = hi;
		}

	public class FontCharacterSet
	{
		public const int panoseLength = 10;

		private const int unicodeCharacterCount = 65536;

		private BitArray bitArray;

		private byte[] panose;

		private static int[] panoseWeights = new int[10] { 4, 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1 };

		internal BitArray BitArray => bitArray;

		public FontCharacterSet(List<FontCharacterRange> ranges, byte[] panose)
		{
			if (panose.Length != 10)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("panose", panose);
			}
			this.panose = panose;
			bitArray = new BitArray(65536);
			int count = ranges.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FontCharacterRange fontCharacterRange = ranges[i];
				if (fontCharacterRange.Hi < 65536)
				{
					AddRange(fontCharacterRange);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddRange(FontCharacterRange fontCharacterRange)
		{
			for (int i = fontCharacterRange.Low; i <= fontCharacterRange.Hi; i++)
			{
				bitArray[i] = true;
			}
		}

		public bool ContainsChar(char ch)
		{
			return bitArray[ch];
		}

		public static int CalculatePanoseDistance(FontCharacterSet font1, FontCharacterSet font2)
		{
			byte[] array = font1.panose;
			byte[] array2 = font2.panose;
			int num = array.Length;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				int num3 = (array[i] - array2[i]) * panoseWeights[i];
				num2 += num3 * num3;
			}
			return num2;
		}
	}
