		public DXFont DXFont
		{
			get
			{
				if (dxFont == null)
				{
					dxFont = new Lazy<DXFont>(delegate
					{
						float num = SizeInPoints;
						float size = Size;
						if (size != num)
						{
							num = RoundToQuarter(SizeInPoints);
						}
						return new DXFont(FontFamilyName, num, CreateFontStyle());
					});
				}
				return dxFont.Value;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsTabStop(char ch)
		{
			return ch == TabStopChar;

			return ch == NewLineChar;
		}

		public static bool IsReturn(char ch)
		{
			return ch == ReturnChar;
		}

		public static bool IsSpace(char ch)
		{
			return ch == SpaceChar;
		}

		protected FontInfo(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, bool allowCjkCorrection, bool useSystemFontQuality, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
			: this(measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, allowCjkCorrection, 0, useSystemFontQuality, baselineFontInfo)
		{
		}

		protected FontInfo(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, bool allowCjkCorrection, int textRotation, bool useSystemFontQuality, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
		{
			Initialize(measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, allowCjkCorrection, textRotation, useSystemFontQuality, baselineFontInfo);
		}

		protected FontInfo()
		{
		}

		private static float RoundToQuarter(float value)
		{
			return (float)Math.Round(value * 4f, MidpointRounding.ToEven) / 4f;
		}

		private DXFontStyle CreateFontStyle()
		{
			DXFontStyle dXFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			if (Bold)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (Italic)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if (Underline)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Underline;
			}
			if (Strikeout)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Strikeout;
			}
			return dXFontStyle;
		}

		protected internal abstract void Initialize(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, bool useSystemFontQuality);

		protected internal abstract void CalculateFontVerticalParameters(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, bool allowCjkCorrection);

		protected internal abstract void CalculateUnderlineAndStrikeoutParameters(FontInfoMeasurer measurer);

		protected internal abstract int CalculateFontCharset(FontInfoMeasurer measurer);

		protected internal abstract void CreateFont(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline);

		protected internal abstract float CalculateFontSizeInPoints();

		protected internal abstract byte[] GetFontData();

		protected void Initialize(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, bool allowCjkCorrection, int textRotation, bool useSystemFontQuality, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
		{
			this.textRotation = textRotation;
			this.baselineFontInfo = baselineFontInfo ?? this;
			CreateFont(measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline);
			Initialize(measurer, useSystemFontQuality);
			CalculateFontParameters(measurer, allowCjkCorrection);
		}

		protected internal virtual void CalculateFontParameters(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, bool allowCjkCorrection)
		{
			CalculateFontVerticalParameters(measurer, allowCjkCorrection);
			sizeInPoints = CalculateFontSizeInPoints();
			AdjustFontParameters();
			spaceWidth = (int)Math.Round(measurer.MeasureCharacterWidthF(' ', this));
			pilcrowSignWidth = measurer.MeasureCharacterWidth('¶', this);
			nonBreakingSpaceWidth = measurer.MeasureCharacterWidth('\u00a0', this);
			underscoreWidth = measurer.MeasureCharacterWidth('_', this);
			middleDotWidth = measurer.MeasureCharacterWidth('·', this);
			dotWidth = measurer.MeasureCharacterWidth('.', this);
			dashWidth = measurer.MeasureCharacterWidth('-', this);
			equalSignWidth = measurer.MeasureCharacterWidth('=', this);
			charset = CalculateFontCharset(measurer);
			CalculateUnderlineAndStrikeoutParameters(measurer);
			maxDigitWidth = CalculateMaxDigitWidth(measurer);
		}

		private float CalculateMaxDigitWidth(FontInfoMeasurer measurer)
		{
			return measurer.MeasureMaxDigitWidthF(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual void AdjustFontParameters()
		{
			free = lineSpacing - ascent - descent;
			if (free < 0)
			{
				descent += free;
				if (descent < 0)
				{
					ascent += descent;
					descent = 0;
				}
				free = 0;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				baselineFontInfo = null;
			}
			isDisposed = true;
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}
	}

	public abstract class FontInfoMeasurer : IDisposable
	{
		private bool isDisposed;

		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, IEmbeddedFont> embeddedFonts = new Dictionary<string, IEmbeddedFont>();

		internal bool IsDisposed => isDisposed;

		protected internal DocumentLayoutUnitConverter UnitConverter => unitConverter;

		protected internal Dictionary<string, IEmbeddedFont> EmbeddedFonts => embeddedFonts;

		public int EmbeddedFontsCount => embeddedFonts.Count;

		protected FontInfoMeasurer(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
			Initialize();
		}

		protected abstract void Initialize();

		public virtual int MeasureCharacterWidth(char character, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			return (int)Math.Ceiling(MeasureCharacterWidthF(character, fontInfo));
		}

		public abstract float MeasureCharacterWidthF(char character, FontInfo fontInfo);

		public abstract float MeasureMaxDigitWidthF(FontInfo fontInfo);

		public abstract Size MeasureString(string text, FontInfo fontInfo);

		protected abstract void LoadEmbeddedFont(IEmbeddedFont embeddedFont);

		public void AddEmbeddedFont(IEmbeddedFont embeddedFont)
		{
			if (!embeddedFonts.ContainsKey(embeddedFont.FontName))
			{
				embeddedFonts.Add(embeddedFont.FontName, embeddedFont);
			}
		}

		internal bool TryGetEmbeddedFont(string fontName, out IEmbeddedFont embeddedFont)
		{
			embeddedFont = embeddedFonts.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<string, IEmbeddedFont> x) => x.Value.RealTtfFontName == fontName).Value;
			return embeddedFont != null;
		}

		public virtual Size MeasureMultilineText(string text, FontInfo fontInfo, int availableWidth)
		{
			return Size.Empty;
		}

		public bool IsFontEmbedded(string fontName)
		{
			return embeddedFonts.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<string, IEmbeddedFont> x) => x.Value.FontName == fontName).Value != null;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			isDisposed = true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}
	}

		byte[] GetTtfData();

	public abstract class OfficeDpiService : IDpiService
	{
		private const float fallbackDpi = 96f;

		private Graphics pixelGraphics;

		public float Dpi
		{
			get
			{
				if (pixelGraphics == null)
				{
					return 96f;
				}
				return pixelGraphics.DpiY;
			}
		}

		protected OfficeDpiService()
		{
			try
			{
				pixelGraphics = CreateGraphics();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected abstract Graphics CreateGraphics();
	}

	public class GdiPlusPath : IPlatformPath, IDisposable
	{
		private bool ownPath;

		private DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath;

		public DXGraphicsPath NativeObject => graphicsPath;

		public int PointCount => graphicsPath.PointCount;

		public GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode fillMode = DXFillMode.Alternate)
		{
			graphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(fillMode);
			ownPath = true;
		}

		public GdiPlusPath(DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			this.graphicsPath = graphicsPath;
		}

		public void ClosePath()
		{
			graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
		}

		public void StartPath()
		{
			graphicsPath.StartFigure();
		}

		public void AddCubicBezierPath(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3, float x4, float y4)
		{
			graphicsPath.AddBezier(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4);
		}

		public void AddLinePath(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			graphicsPath.AddLine(x1, y1, x2, y2);
		}

		public void AddLinesPath(PointF[] points)
		{
			graphicsPath.AddLines(points);
		}

		public void AddMovePath(float x1, float y1)
		{
			graphicsPath.StartFigure();
		}

		public void AddPath(IPlatformPath path, bool connect)
		{
			GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = (GdiPlusPath)path;
			graphicsPath.AddPath(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject, connect);
		}

		public void AddRectangle(RectangleF rect)
		{
			graphicsPath.AddRectangle(rect);
		}

		public void AddString(string s, DXFont font, float emSize, PointF origin)
		{
			DXFont font2 = font;
			if (DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.GdiPlus)
			{
				font2 = new DXFont(font.Name, emSize, font.Style, font.Unit);
			}
			graphicsPath.AddString(s, font2, origin, DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic());
		}

		public bool IsClosed()
		{
			if (graphicsPath.PointCount == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (DXPathPointType pathType in graphicsPath.PathTypes)
			{
				if ((pathType & DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath) != DXPathPointType.Start)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Rectangle GetBounds()
		{
			return Rectangle.Round(graphicsPath.GetBounds());
		}

		public RectangleF GetBoundsF()
		{
			return graphicsPath.GetBounds();
		}

		public void Transform(Matrix matrix)
		{
			Transform(SystemDrawingConverter.CreateDXMatrix(matrix));
		}

		public void Transform(DXMatrix matrix)
		{
			graphicsPath.Transform(matrix);
		}

		public IPlatformPath Clone()
		{
			GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = new GdiPlusPath(graphicsPath.Clone());
			gdiPlusPath.ownPath = true;
			return gdiPlusPath;
		}

		public bool Contains(float x, float y)
		{
			return graphicsPath.IsVisible(x, y);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (ownPath)
			{
				graphicsPath.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public static class PlatformPathExtensions
	{
		public static Rectangle GetBoundsExt(this IPlatformPath path)

		}

		public static Rectangle GetBoundsExt(this IPlatformPath path, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			RectangleF boundsExtF = path.GetBoundsExtF(transform);
			return Rectangle.Round(boundsExtF);

		}

		public static RectangleF GetBoundsExtF(this IPlatformPath path, DXMatrix transform, IPlatformStroke stroke)
		{
			if (path is GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath)
			{
				return gdiPlusPath.NativeObject.GetBoundsExtF(transform, stroke as PenInfo);
			}
			return path.GetBoundsF();
		}

		public static RectangleF GetBoundsExtF(this IPlatformPath path, IPlatformStroke stroke)
		{
			if (path is GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath)
			{
				return gdiPlusPath.NativeObject.GetBoundsExtF(null, stroke as PenInfo);
			}
			return path.GetBoundsF();
		}

		public static RectangleF GetBoundsExtF(this IPlatformPath path, DXMatrix transform, IPlatformStroke stroke, bool correctLineJoin)
		{
			if (path is GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath)
			{
				return gdiPlusPath.NativeObject.GetBoundsExtF(transform, stroke as PenInfo, correctLineJoin);
			}
			return path.GetBoundsF();
		}

		internal static IPlatformPath BuildFigure(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, bool addNotClosedPaths)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Path.CreatePath(CrossPlatformFillMode.EvenOdd);
			if (graphicsPaths != null)
			{
				if (graphicsPaths.Count > 0)
				{
					IPlatformPath platformPath2 = graphicsPaths[0];
					if (platformPath2.PointCount > 0)
					{
						platformPath.AddPath(platformPath2, connect: false);
					}
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < graphicsPaths.Count; i++)
				{
					IPlatformPath platformPath3 = graphicsPaths[i];
					if (addNotClosedPaths || platformPath3.IsClosed())
					{
						platformPath.AddPath(platformPath3, connect: false);
					}
				}
			}
			return platformPath;
		}
	}

	public abstract class PatternLinePainter
	{
		private enum LineType
		{
			Horizontal,
			Vertical,
			BottomLeftToTopRightDiagonal,
			TopLeftToBottomRightDiagonal
		}

		private readonly IPatternLinePaintingSupport painter;

		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter;

		private readonly IDpiService dpiContainer;

		public IPatternLinePaintingSupport Painter => painter;

		public DocumentLayoutUnitConverter UnitConverter => unitConverter;

		protected virtual float[] DotPattern => Parameters.DotPattern;

		protected virtual float[] DashPattern => Parameters.DashPattern;

		protected virtual float[] DashSmallGapPattern => Parameters.DashSmallGapPattern;

		protected virtual float[] DashDotPattern => Parameters.DashDotPattern;

		protected virtual float[] DashDotDotPattern => Parameters.DashDotDotPattern;

		protected virtual float[] LongDashPattern => Parameters.LongDashPattern;

		protected virtual float PixelPenWidth => Parameters.PixelPenWidth;

		protected virtual float PixelStep => Parameters.PixelStep;

		public bool UseFixedWidthPattern { get; set; }

		protected abstract PatternLinePainterParameters Parameters { get; }

		protected float Dpi => dpiContainer.Dpi;

		protected virtual float UnitsToPixels(float val, float dpi)
		{
			return UnitConverter.LayoutUnitsToPixelsF(val, dpi);
		}

		protected virtual float PixelsToUnits(float val, float dpi)
		{
			return UnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnitsF(val, dpi);
		}

		protected virtual float RoundToPixels(float val, float dpi)
		{
			float num = UnitsToPixels(val, dpi);
			num = (float)Math.Round(num);
			val = PixelsToUnits(num, dpi);
			return val;
		}

		protected PatternLinePainter(IPatternLinePaintingSupport painter, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, IDpiService dpiContainer)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)painter, "painter");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.painter = painter;
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
			this.dpiContainer = dpiContainer;
			UseFixedWidthPattern = true;
		}

		protected virtual RectangleF RotateBounds(RectangleF bounds)
		{
			return bounds;
		}

		protected virtual PointF RotatePoint(PointF pointF)
		{
			return pointF;
		}

		protected virtual void DrawLine(DXPen pen, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			Painter.DrawLine(pen, bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Right, bounds.Y);
		}

		protected virtual void DrawLine(DXPen pen, PointF from, PointF to)
		{
			Painter.DrawLine(pen, from.X, from.Y, to.X, to.Y);
		}

		protected virtual void FillPath(DXBrush brush, DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Painter.FillPath(brush, path);
		}

		protected void DrawSolidLine(RectangleF bounds, Color color)
		{
			DXPen pen = painter.GetPen(color, Math.Min(bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
			DrawLine(pen, bounds);
		}

		protected void DrawSolidLine(PointF from, PointF to, Color color, float thickness)
		{
			DXPen pen = painter.GetPen(color, thickness);
			DrawLine(pen, from, to);
		}

		public void DrawDoubleSolidLine(RectangleF bounds, Color color)
		{
			bounds = RotateBounds(bounds);
			float num = RoundToPixels(bounds.Height / 4f, Dpi);
			if (num <= PixelsToUnits(1f, Dpi))
			{
				num = PixelsToUnits(1f, Dpi);
			}
			float num2 = num / 2f;
			RectangleF bounds2 = new RectangleF(bounds.X, bounds.Y + num2, bounds.Width, num);
			RectangleF bounds3 = new RectangleF(bounds.X, bounds.Bottom - num2, bounds.Width, num);
			float num3 = RoundToPixels(bounds3.Y - bounds2.Bottom, Dpi);
			if (num3 <= PixelsToUnits(1f, Dpi))
			{
				num3 = PixelsToUnits(1f, Dpi);
			}
			bounds3.Y = bounds2.Bottom + num3;
			DrawSolidLine(RotateBounds(bounds2), color);
			DrawSolidLine(RotateBounds(bounds3), color);
		}

		protected internal void DrawDoubleSolidLine(PointF from, PointF to, Color color, float thickness)
		{
			thickness /= 3f;
			if (thickness <= PixelsToUnits(1f, Dpi))
			{
				thickness = PixelsToUnits(1f, Dpi);
			}
			double num = from.X - to.X;
			double num2 = from.Y - to.Y;
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			if (num3 != 0.0)
			{
				double num4 = num / num3;
				double num5 = num2 / num3;
				PointF pointF = new PointF((float)((double)from.X - (double)thickness * num5), (float)((double)from.Y + (double)thickness * num4));
				PointF to2 = new PointF((float)((double)to.X - (double)thickness * num5), (float)((double)to.Y + (double)thickness * num4));
				DrawSolidLine(pointF, to2, color, thickness);
				PointF pointF2 = new PointF((float)((double)from.X + (double)thickness * num5), (float)((double)from.Y - (double)thickness * num4));
				PointF to3 = new PointF((float)((double)to.X + (double)thickness * num5), (float)((double)to.Y - (double)thickness * num4));
				DrawSolidLine(pointF2, to3, color, thickness);
			}
		}

		public void DrawPatternLine(RectangleF bounds, Color color, float[] pattern)
		{
			bounds = RotateBounds(bounds);
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(color);
			try
			{
				dXPen.Width = bounds.Height;
				dXPen.DashPattern = MakeFixedWidthPattern(pattern, bounds.Height);
				DrawLine(dXPen, RotateBounds(bounds));
			}
			finally
			{
				dXPen.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected internal void DrawPatternLine(PointF from, PointF to, Color color, float thickness, float[] pattern)
		{
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(color, thickness);
			try
			{
				dXPen.DashPattern = MakeFixedWidthPattern(pattern, thickness);
				DrawLine(dXPen, from, to);
			}
			finally
			{
				dXPen.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void DrawSlantPatternLine(RectangleF bounds, Color color, float[] pattern)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = RotateBounds(bounds);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = ((!bounds.Equals(rectangleF)) ? CreateSlantPatternPath(bounds.Width, bounds.Location, new PointF(bounds.X, bounds.Bottom), pattern, LineType.Vertical) : CreateSlantPatternPath(bounds.Height, bounds.Location, new PointF(bounds.Right, bounds.Y), pattern, LineType.Horizontal));
			FillPath(new DXSolidBrush(color), dXGraphicsPath);
			dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
		}

		protected internal void DrawSlantPatternLine(PointF from, PointF to, Color color, float thickness, float[] pattern)
		{
			LineType lineType = CalculateLineType(from, to);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateSlantPatternPath(thickness, from, to, pattern, lineType);
			FillPath(new DXSolidBrush(color), dXGraphicsPath);
			dXGraphicsPath.Dispose();
		}

		private LineType CalculateLineType(PointF from, PointF to)
		{
			bool flag = from.Y == to.Y;
			bool flag2 = from.X == to.X;
			if (flag)
			{
				return LineType.Horizontal;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return LineType.Vertical;
			}
			if (to.Y > from.Y)
			{
				return LineType.TopLeftToBottomRightDiagonal;
			}
			return LineType.BottomLeftToTopRightDiagonal;
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath CreateSlantPatternPath(float thickness, PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint, float[] dashPattern, LineType lineType)
		{
			float lineWidth = CalculateLineWidth(lineType, startPoint, endPoint);
			float[] array = new float[dashPattern.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = UnitsToPixels(dashPattern[i], Dpi);
			}
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateHorizontalSlantPatternPath(lineWidth, array, thickness);
			CorrectLinePath(dXGraphicsPath, lineType, thickness, startPoint, endPoint);
			float dy = ((lineType == LineType.BottomLeftToTopRightDiagonal) ? endPoint.Y : startPoint.Y);
			dXGraphicsPath.Transform(new DXMatrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, startPoint.X, dy));
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private float CalculateLineWidth(LineType lineType, PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			float num = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
			float num2 = endPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;
			switch (lineType)
			{
			case LineType.Horizontal:
				return num;
			case LineType.Vertical:
				return num2;
			case LineType.BottomLeftToTopRightDiagonal:
			case LineType.TopLeftToBottomRightDiagonal:
				return (float)Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			default:
				return 0f;
			}
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath CreateHorizontalSlantPatternPath(float lineWidth, float[] dashPattern, float thickness)
		{
			float num = lineWidth;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix(1f, 0f, -1f, 1f, 0f, 0f);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			while (num > 0f)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < dashPattern.Length; i += 2)
				{
					num2 = dashPattern[i] * (thickness / 2f);
					if (num2 > num)
					{
						num2 = num;
					}
					PointF[] points = new PointF[4]
					{
						new PointF(num4, 0f),
						new PointF(num4 + num2, 0f),
						new PointF(num4 + num2, thickness),
						new PointF(num4, thickness)
					};
					dXMatrix.TransformPoints(points);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPolygon(points);
					if (i + 1 < dashPattern.Length)
					{
						num3 = dashPattern[i + 1] * (thickness / 2f);
					}
					num -= num2 + num3;
					num4 += num2 + num3;
					if (num <= 0f)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			dXGraphicsPath.CloseFigure();
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private void CorrectLinePath(DXGraphicsPath path, LineType lineType, float thickness, PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			switch (lineType)
			{
			case LineType.Horizontal:
				path.Transform(new DXMatrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, thickness / 2f, (0f - thickness) / 2f));
				break;
			case LineType.Vertical:
				path.Transform(new DXMatrix(0f, 1f, -1f, 0f, thickness / 2f, thickness / 2f));
				path.Transform(new DXMatrix(-1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f));
				break;
			case LineType.TopLeftToBottomRightDiagonal:
				path.Transform(CalculateDiagonalLineMatrix(lineType, startPoint, endPoint));
				break;
			case LineType.BottomLeftToTopRightDiagonal:
				path.Transform(CalculateDiagonalLineMatrix(lineType, startPoint, endPoint));
				break;
			}
		}

		private DXMatrix CalculateDiagonalLineMatrix(LineType lineType, PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			float num = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
			float num2 = endPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;
			double num3 = Math.PI / 2.0 - Math.Atan(num / num2);
			float num4 = (float)Math.Cos(num3);
			float num5 = (float)Math.Sin(num3);
			float dx = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
			float dy = endPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;
			return lineType switch
			{
				LineType.TopLeftToBottomRightDiagonal => new DXMatrix(0f - num4, 0f - num5, num5, 0f - num4, dx, dy), 
				LineType.BottomLeftToTopRightDiagonal => new DXMatrix(num4, num5, 0f - num5, num4, dx, 0f), 
				_ => new DXMatrix(), 
			};
		}

		protected void DrawWaveUnderline(RectangleF bounds, Color color, float penWidth)
		{
			DXPen pen = painter.GetPen(color, penWidth);
			DrawWaveUnderline(bounds, pen);
		}

		public void DrawWaveUnderline(RectangleF bounds, DXPen pen, float step)
		{
			bounds = RotateBounds(bounds);
			int num = (int)Math.Ceiling(bounds.Width / step);
			if (num > 1)
			{
				float num2 = bounds.X;
				float num3 = bounds.Top;
				float num4 = num3 + bounds.Bottom;
				PointF[] array = new PointF[num];
				int num5 = 0;
				while (num5 < num)
				{
					array[num5] = RotatePoint(new PointF(num2, num3));
					num3 = num4 - num3;
					num5++;
					num2 += step;
				}
				Painter.DrawLines(pen, array);
			}
		}

		public void DrawWaveUnderline(RectangleF bounds, DXPen pen)
		{
			bounds = RotateBounds(bounds);
			float val = RoundToPixels(bounds.Height, Dpi);
			val = Math.Max(PixelStep, val);
			DrawWaveUnderline(RotateBounds(bounds), pen, val);
		}

		protected virtual float[] MakeFixedWidthPattern(float[] pattern, float thickness)
		{
			if (!UseFixedWidthPattern)
			{
				thickness = PixelPenWidth;
			}
			int num = pattern.Length;
			float[] array = new float[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = pattern[i] / thickness;
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected virtual RectangleF MakeBoundsAtLeast2PixelsHigh(RectangleF bounds)
		{
			float num = RoundToPixels(bounds.Height, Dpi);
			if (num <= PixelsToUnits(2f, Dpi))
			{
				num = PixelsToUnits(2f, Dpi);
				bounds = new RectangleF(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, num);
			}
			return bounds;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PatternLinePainterParameters
	{
		private float[] dotPattern;

		private float[] dashPattern;

		private float[] dashSmallGapPattern;

		private float[] dashDotPattern;

		private float[] dashDotDotPattern;

		private float[] longDashPattern;

		private float pixelPenWidth;

		private float pixelStep;

		public virtual float[] DotPattern => dotPattern;

		public virtual float[] DashPattern => dashPattern;

		public virtual float[] DashSmallGapPattern => dashSmallGapPattern;

		public virtual float[] DashDotPattern => dashDotPattern;

		public virtual float[] DashDotDotPattern => dashDotDotPattern;

		public virtual float[] LongDashPattern => longDashPattern;

		public float PixelPenWidth => pixelPenWidth;

		public float PixelStep => pixelStep;

		public virtual void Initialize(float dpiX)
		{
			dotPattern = CreatePattern(new float[2] { 10f, 10f }, dpiX);
			dashPattern = CreatePattern(new float[2] { 40f, 20f }, dpiX);
			dashSmallGapPattern = CreatePattern(new float[2] { 40f, 10f }, dpiX);
			dashDotPattern = CreatePattern(new float[4] { 40f, 13f, 13f, 13f }, dpiX);
			dashDotDotPattern = CreatePattern(new float[6] { 30f, 10f, 10f, 10f, 10f, 10f }, dpiX);
			longDashPattern = CreatePattern(new float[2] { 80f, 40f }, dpiX);
			pixelPenWidth = PixelsToUnits(1f, dpiX);
			pixelStep = PixelsToUnits(2f, dpiX);
		}

		protected float[] CreatePattern(float[] pattern, float dpiX)
		{
			int num = pattern.Length;
			float[] array = new float[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = PixelsToUnits(pattern[i], dpiX) / 5f;
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected internal abstract float PixelsToUnits(float value, float dpi);
	}
	public class PatternLinePainterParametersTable : Dictionary<Type, PatternLinePainterParameters>
	{
	}
	public class CrossPlatformFontCacheManager : FontCacheManager
	{
		public CrossPlatformFontCacheManager(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, bool allowCjkCorrection, bool useSystemFontQuality)
			: base(unitConverter, allowCjkCorrection, useSystemFontQuality)
		{
		}

		public override FontCacheManager Clone(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, bool allowCjkCorrection, bool useSystemFontQuality)
		{
			return new CrossPlatformFontCacheManager(unitConverter, allowCjkCorrection, useSystemFontQuality);
		}

		public override FontCache CreateFontCache()
		{
			return new CrossPlatformFontCache(base.UnitConverter, base.AllowCjkCorrection);
		}

		public static bool ShouldUse()
		{
			if (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
			{
				return AzureCompatibility.Enable;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class CrossPlatformFontCache : FontCache
	{
		private static readonly ThreadLocal<DXFontEngine> fontEngine;

		public override FontCacheType FontCacheType => FontCacheType.CrossPlatform;

		static CrossPlatformFontCache()
		{
			fontEngine = new ThreadLocal<DXFontEngine>(() => DXDrawingEngine.CreateFontEngine());
		}

		public CrossPlatformFontCache(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, bool allowCjkCorrection)
			: base(unitConverter, allowCjkCorrection)
		{
		}

		protected internal override FontCharacterSet CreateFontCharacterSet(FontDescription fontDescription)
		{
			using CrossPlatformFontInfo crossPlatformFontInfo = (CrossPlatformFontInfo)CreateFontInfoCore(fontDescription.Name, 20, fontDescription.Bold, fontDescription.Italic, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false, 0, null);
			byte[] panose = crossPlatformFontInfo.InternalFont.Panose;
			if (panose == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<FontCharacterRange> list = CreateFontCharacterRanges(crossPlatformFontInfo);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new FontCharacterSet(list, panose);
		}

		protected internal override FontInfo CreateFontInfoCore(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int textRotation, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
		{
			return new CrossPlatformFontInfo(base.Measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, base.AllowCjkCorrection, textRotation, useSystemFontQuality: false, baselineFontInfo);
		}

		protected internal override FontInfoMeasurer CreateFontInfoMeasurer(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			return new CrossPlatformFontInfoMeasurer(unitConverter, fontEngine.Value);
		}

		protected override List<FontCharacterRange> GetFontCharacterRanges(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			return ((CrossPlatformFontInfo)fontInfo).InternalFont.GetFontCharacterRanges()?.Select((DXCharRange r) => new FontCharacterRange(r.Start, r.End)).ToList();
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<string> GetSystemFontFamilies()
		{
			return (from info in fontEngine.Value.GetFontsInfo()
				select info.GdiFamilyName).Distinct();
		}

		protected override FontCapabilitiesInfo GetFontCapabilitiesCore(string fontName)
		{
			try
			{
				FontInfo fontInfo = CreateFontInfo(fontName, 20, fontBold: false, fontItalic: false, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false);
				return (fontInfo is CrossPlatformFontInfo crossPlatformFontInfo) ? crossPlatformFontInfo.CreateFontCapabilitiesInfo(fontName) : null;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class CrossPlatformFontInfo : FontInfo
	{
		private GraphicsUnit fontUnit;

		private bool underline;

		private bool strikeout;

		private Lazy<Font> font;

		private bool bold;

		private const int CffFontHeader = 1330926671;

		public virtual DXFontInternal InternalFont { get; private set; }

		public override Font Font
		{
			get
			{
				if (font == null)
				{
					font = new Lazy<Font>(() => new Font(NameWin32, InternalFont.SizeInPoints, CalculateFontStyle((int)InternalFont.Weight)));
				}
				return font.Value;
			}
		}

		public override bool Bold => bold;

		public override bool Italic
		{
			get
			{
				if (!InternalFont.Slant.HasFlag(DXFontStyleSlant.Italic))
				{
					return InternalFont.Slant.HasFlag(DXFontStyleSlant.Oblique);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override bool Underline => underline;

		public override bool Strikeout => strikeout;

		public override float Size => GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(InternalFont.SizeInPoints, GraphicsUnit.Point, fontUnit);

		public override string Name => InternalFont.FamilyName;

		public override string NameWin32 => InternalFont.GetWin32FamilyName();

		public override string FontFamilyName => InternalFont.FamilyName;

		public GraphicsUnit FontUnit
		{
			get
			{
				return fontUnit;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				fontUnit = value;
			}
		}

		public CrossPlatformFontInfo(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, bool allowCjkCorrection, int textRotation, bool useSystemFontQuality, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
			: base(measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, allowCjkCorrection, textRotation, useSystemFontQuality, baselineFontInfo)
		{
		}

		private FontStyle CalculateFontStyle(int weight)
		{
			FontStyle fontStyle = FontStyle.Regular;
			if (Bold && weight <= 700)
			{
				fontStyle |= FontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (Italic)
			{
				fontStyle |= FontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if (Strikeout)
			{
				fontStyle |= FontStyle.Strikeout;
			}
			if (Underline)
			{
				fontStyle |= FontStyle.Underline;
			}
			return fontStyle;
		}

		protected internal override int CalculateFontCharset(FontInfoMeasurer measurer)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected internal override float CalculateFontSizeInPoints()
		{
			return InternalFont.SizeInPoints;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateFontVerticalParameters(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, bool allowCjkCorrection)
		{
			float num = Size / measurer.UnitConverter.FontSizeScale;
			DXFontMetrics metrics = InternalFont.Metrics;
			float num2 = metrics.UnitsPerEm;
			float num3 = num / num2;
			base.Ascent = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)metrics.EmAscent * num3);
			base.Descent = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)metrics.EmDescent * num3);
			base.LineSpacing = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)metrics.EmLineSpacing * num3);
			base.UseTypoMetrics = metrics.HasTypoMetrics;
			if (!base.UseTypoMetrics && FontIsCff())
			{
				base.LineSpacing = base.Ascent + base.Descent;
			}
			base.CalculatedLineSpacing = base.LineSpacing;
		}

		private bool FontIsCff()
		{
			DXFontFileInfo fontFileInfo = InternalFont.GetFontFileInfo();
			byte[] data = fontFileInfo.Data;
			if (data.Length <= 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = data[0] | (data[1] << 8) | (data[2] << 16) | (data[3] << 24);
			return num == 1330926671;
		}

		protected internal void CalculateSubscriptOffset(FontInfo baseFontInfo)
		{
			int num = baseFontInfo.SubscriptOffset.Y;
			int num2 = baseFontInfo.LineSpacing - base.LineSpacing + base.AscentAndFree - baseFontInfo.AscentAndFree;
			if (num > num2)
			{
				num = num2;
			}
			base.SubscriptOffset = new Point(base.SubscriptOffset.X, num);
			base.CalculatedLineSpacing = base.LineSpacing;
		}

		protected internal void CalculateSuperscriptOffset(FontInfo baseFontInfo)
		{
			int num = baseFontInfo.SuperscriptOffset.Y;
			int num2 = baseFontInfo.AscentAndFree - base.AscentAndFree + num;
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num -= num2;
			}
			base.SuperscriptOffset = new Point(base.SuperscriptOffset.X, num);
			base.CalculatedLineSpacing = base.LineSpacing;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateUnderlineAndStrikeoutParameters(FontInfoMeasurer measurer)
		{
			DXFontMetrics metrics = InternalFont.Metrics;
			float num = Size / measurer.UnitConverter.FontSizeScale;
			float num2 = metrics.UnitsPerEm;
			float num3 = num / num2;
			base.UnderlinePosition = -(int)Math.Ceiling((float)metrics.UnderlinePosition * num3);
			base.UnderlineThickness = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)metrics.UnderlineSize * num3);
			base.StrikeoutPosition = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)metrics.StrikeoutPosition * num3);
			base.StrikeoutThickness = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)metrics.StrikeoutSize * num3);
			base.SubscriptSize = GetSizeWithRatio(metrics.SubscriptSize, num3);
			base.SubscriptOffset = GetOffsetWithRatio(metrics.SubscriptOffset, num3);
			base.SuperscriptSize = GetSizeWithRatio(metrics.SuperscriptSize, num3);
			base.SuperscriptOffset = GetOffsetWithRatio(metrics.SuperscriptOffset, num3);
			if (base.BaselineFontInfo != this)
			{
				CalculateSubscriptOffset(base.BaselineFontInfo);
				CalculateSuperscriptOffset(base.BaselineFontInfo);
			}
		}

		private Size GetSizeWithRatio(Size size, float ratio)
		{
			return new Size((int)Math.Ceiling((float)size.Width * ratio), (int)Math.Ceiling((float)size.Height * ratio));
		}

		private Point GetOffsetWithRatio(Point point, float ratio)
		{
			return new Point((int)Math.Ceiling((float)point.X * ratio), -(int)Math.Ceiling((float)point.Y * ratio));
		}

		protected internal override void CreateFont(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline)
		{
			underline = fontUnderline;
			strikeout = fontStrikeout;
			fontUnit = (GraphicsUnit)measurer.UnitConverter.FontUnit;
			float num = (float)doubleFontSize / 2f;
			if (num == 0f)
			{
				num = measurer.UnitConverter.PointsToFontUnits(10);
			}
			float fontSizeInPoints = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(num, fontUnit, GraphicsUnit.Point);
			DXFontStyle dXFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			if (fontBold)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (fontItalic)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Italic;
			}
			InternalFont = CreateFontCore((CrossPlatformFontInfoMeasurer)measurer, fontName, dXFontStyle, fontSizeInPoints);
			bold = fontBold;
		}

		private DXFontInternal CreateFontCore(CrossPlatformFontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, DXFontStyle style, float fontSizeInPoints)
		{
			return new DXFontInternal(measurer.MatchFontFace(fontName, style), fontSizeInPoints, DXFontDecorations.None, (style & DXFontStyle.Bold) != 0);
		}

		internal FontCapabilitiesInfo CreateFontCapabilitiesInfo(string fontName)
		{
			FontCapabilitiesInfo fontCapabilitiesInfo = new FontCapabilitiesInfo();
			fontCapabilitiesInfo.IsSubstituted = string.Compare(Name, fontName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) != 0;
			fontCapabilitiesInfo.IsComplexScript = InternalFont.IsComplexScript();
			fontCapabilitiesInfo.IsCjk = InternalFont.IsCjk();
			return fontCapabilitiesInfo;
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, bool useSystemFontQuality)
		{
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			InternalFont.Dispose();
			if (font != null && font.IsValueCreated)
			{
				font.Value.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected internal override byte[] GetFontData()
		{
			DXFontFileInfo fontFileInfo = InternalFont.GetFontFileInfo();
			return FontDataExtractor.ReadTtfFromTtc(fontFileInfo.Data, fontFileInfo.Index);
		}
	}
	public class CrossPlatformFontInfoMeasurer : FontInfoMeasurer
	{
		private readonly string DefaultFontName = (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows ? "Arial" : "Liberation Sans");

		private static readonly ThreadLocal<DXFontEngine> fontEngineEmbeddedFonts;

		public DXFontEngine FontEngine { get; }

		static CrossPlatformFontInfoMeasurer()
		{
			fontEngineEmbeddedFonts = new ThreadLocal<DXFontEngine>(() => DXDrawingEngine.CreateFontEngine());
		}

		public CrossPlatformFontInfoMeasurer(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
			: base(unitConverter)
		{
			FontEngine = DXDrawingEngine.CreateFontEngine();
		}

		public CrossPlatformFontInfoMeasurer(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, DXFontEngine fontEngine)
			: base(unitConverter)
		{
			FontEngine = fontEngine;
		}

		public override float MeasureCharacterWidthF(char character, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			CrossPlatformFontInfo crossPlatformFontInfo = (CrossPlatformFontInfo)fontInfo;
			float num = crossPlatformFontInfo.InternalFont.MeasureCharacterWidth(character) / base.UnitConverter.FontSizeScale;
			return GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(num, GraphicsUnit.Point, crossPlatformFontInfo.FontUnit);
		}

		public override float MeasureMaxDigitWidthF(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			float num = float.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, MeasureCharacterWidthF(i.ToString()[0], fontInfo));
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override Size MeasureString(string text, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			SizeF sizeF = ((CrossPlatformFontInfo)fontInfo).InternalFont.MeasureString(text);
			return new Size((int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF.Width / base.UnitConverter.FontSizeScale), (int)Math.Ceiling(sizeF.Height / base.UnitConverter.FontSizeScale));
		}

		public override Size MeasureMultilineText(string text, FontInfo fontInfo, int availableWidth)
		{
			MultilineTextMeasurer multilineTextMeasurer = new MultilineTextMeasurer(this, text, fontInfo, availableWidth);
			return multilineTextMeasurer.Measure();
		}

		protected override void Initialize()
		{
		}

		protected override void LoadEmbeddedFont(IEmbeddedFont embeddedFont)
		{
			string[] array = fontEngineEmbeddedFonts.Value.AddMemoryFont(embeddedFont.GetTtfData());
			if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
			{
				embeddedFont.RealTtfFontName = array[0];
			}
		}

		public DXFontFace MatchFontFace(string familyName, DXFontStyle style)
		{
			DXFontFace dXFontFace = FontEngine.MatchFontFace(familyName, style);
			if (IsDefaultFont(dXFontFace, familyName) && base.EmbeddedFonts.TryGetValue(familyName, out var value))
			{
				if (value.RealTtfFontName == null || value.RealTtfFontName.Equals(string.Empty))
				{
					LoadEmbeddedFont(value);
				}
				if (value.RealTtfFontName == null || value.RealTtfFontName.Equals(string.Empty))
				{
					return dXFontFace;
				}
				dXFontFace = fontEngineEmbeddedFonts.Value.MatchFontFace(value.RealTtfFontName, style);
				if (IsDefaultFont(dXFontFace, familyName))
				{
					LoadEmbeddedFont(value);
				}
				dXFontFace = fontEngineEmbeddedFonts.Value.MatchFontFace(value.RealTtfFontName, style);
			}
			return dXFontFace;
		}

		private bool IsDefaultFont(DXFontFace fontFace, string familyName)
		{
			if (!fontFace.FamilyName.Equals(familyName))
			{
				return fontFace.FamilyName.Equals(DefaultFontName);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class FontInfoUnitConverter
	{
		private LayoutGraphicsUnit graphicsPageUnit;

		private LayoutGraphicsUnit fontUnit;

		private float pageScale;

		public FontInfoUnitConverter(LayoutGraphicsUnit graphicsPageUnit, LayoutGraphicsUnit fontUnit, float pageScale)
		{
			this.graphicsPageUnit = graphicsPageUnit;
			this.fontUnit = fontUnit;
			this.pageScale = pageScale;
		}

		public float Convert(float value)
		{
			return GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(value, (GraphicsUnit)fontUnit, (GraphicsUnit)graphicsPageUnit) / pageScale;
		}
	}
	internal class MultilineTextMeasurer
	{
		private readonly FontInfoMeasurer measurer;

		private readonly FontInfo fontInfo;

		private readonly string text;

		private readonly int availableWidth;

		private int maxLineWidth;

		private int lineCount;

		private int pos;

		private int linepos;

		private int[] widths;

		public MultilineTextMeasurer(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string text, FontInfo fontInfo, int availableWidth)
		{
			this.measurer = measurer;
			this.text = text;
			this.fontInfo = fontInfo;
			this.availableWidth = availableWidth;
		}

		public Size Measure()
		{
			maxLineWidth = 0;
			lineCount = 0;
			PrepareCharactersWidth();
			WrapAndMeasureLines();
			return new Size(maxLineWidth, lineCount * fontInfo.LineSpacing);
		}

		private void PrepareCharactersWidth()
		{
			Dictionary<char, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<char, int>();
			widths = new int[text.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(c, out var value))
				{
					value = ((!FontInfo.IsNewLine(c) && !FontInfo.IsReturn(c)) ? measurer.MeasureCharacterWidth(c, fontInfo) : 0);
					dictionary.Add(c, value);
				}
				widths[i] = value;
			}
		}

		private void WrapAndMeasureLines()
		{
			pos = 0;
			linepos = 0;
			while (pos < text.Length)
			{
				while (pos < text.Length && FontInfo.IsNewLine(text[pos]))
				{
					AddLine();
				}
				if (pos >= text.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				int nextWord = GetNextWord(pos);
				int textWidth = GetTextWidth(linepos, pos - linepos + nextWord);
				if (textWidth > availableWidth)
				{
					if (pos - linepos > 0)
					{
						AddLine();
						continue;
					}
					int num = widths[pos];
					for (int i = 1; i < nextWord; i++)
					{
						if (num + widths[pos + i] > availableWidth)
						{
							pos += i;
							break;
						}
						num += widths[pos + i];
					}
					AddLine();
					if (nextWord == 1)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					pos += nextWord;
				}
			}
			if (pos - linepos > 0)
			{
				AddLine();
			}
		}

		private void AddLine()
		{
			int num = pos - linepos;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				while (num > 0 && CanRemoveSymbol(linepos + num - 1))
				{
					num--;
				}
				while (pos < text.Length && CanRemoveSymbol(pos))
				{
					pos++;
				}
			}
			if (pos < text.Length && FontInfo.IsNewLine(text[pos]))
			{
				pos++;
			}
			maxLineWidth = Math.Max(maxLineWidth, GetTextWidth(linepos, num));
			lineCount++;
			linepos = pos;
		}

		private bool CanRemoveSymbol(int pos)
		{
			if (char.IsWhiteSpace(text[pos]))
			{
				return !FontInfo.IsNewLine(text[pos]);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetNextWord(int startIndex)
		{
			if (IsWordBreakChar(text[startIndex]))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int i;
			for (i = startIndex + 1; i < text.Length && !IsWordBreakChar(text[i]) && !FontInfo.IsNewLine(text[i]); i++)
			{
			}
			return i - startIndex;
		}

		private int GetTextWidth(int startIndex, int length)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				num += widths[startIndex + i];
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool IsWordBreakChar(char ch)
		{
			if (!char.IsWhiteSpace(ch))
			{
				return ch == '-';
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class WindowsPlatformFontCache : FontCache
	{
		private readonly UnicodeRangeInfo unicodeRangeInfo;

		private readonly FontCacheType cacheType;

		private readonly bool useSystemFontQuality;

		protected bool UseSystemFontQuality => useSystemFontQuality;

		public override FontCacheType FontCacheType => cacheType;

		public WindowsPlatformFontCache(FontCacheType cacheType, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter, bool allowCjkCorrection, bool useSystemFontQuality)
			: base(unitConverter, allowCjkCorrection)
		{
			this.cacheType = cacheType;
			unicodeRangeInfo = new UnicodeRangeInfo();
			this.useSystemFontQuality = useSystemFontQuality;
		}

		protected internal override FontInfoMeasurer CreateFontInfoMeasurer(DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			return cacheType switch
			{
				FontCacheType.Gdi => new GdiFontInfoMeasurer(unitConverter), 
				FontCacheType.GdiPlus => new GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer(unitConverter), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		protected internal override FontInfo CreateFontInfoCore(string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, int textRotation, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
		{
			return new WindowsPlatformFontInfo(base.Measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, base.AllowCjkCorrection, textRotation, useSystemFontQuality, baselineFontInfo);
		}

		protected override List<FontCharacterRange> GetFontCharacterRanges(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			WindowsPlatformFontInfo windowsPlatformFontInfo = (WindowsPlatformFontInfo)fontInfo;
			GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer = (GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer)base.Measurer;
			return windowsPlatformFontInfo.GetFontUnicodeRanges(gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer.MeasureGraphics);
		}

		public override bool ShouldUseDefaultFontToDrawInvisibleCharacter(FontInfo fontInfo, char character)
		{
			WindowsPlatformFontInfo windowsPlatformFontInfo = (WindowsPlatformFontInfo)fontInfo;
			GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer = (GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer)base.Measurer;
			return windowsPlatformFontInfo.CanDrawCharacter(unicodeRangeInfo, gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer.MeasureGraphics, character);
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<string> GetSystemFontFamilies()
		{
			FontFamily[] fontFamilies = FontFamily.Families;
			int count = fontFamilies.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FontFamily fontFamily = fontFamilies[i];
				if (fontFamily.IsStyleAvailable(FontStyle.Regular))
				{
					yield return fontFamily.Name;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override FontCharacterSet CreateFontCharacterSet(FontDescription fontDescription)
		{
			using WindowsPlatformFontInfo fontInfo = (WindowsPlatformFontInfo)CreateFontInfoCore(fontDescription.Name, 20, fontDescription.Bold, fontDescription.Italic, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false, 0, null);
			byte[] panose = GetPanose(fontInfo);
			if (panose == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<FontCharacterRange> ranges = CreateFontCharacterRanges(fontInfo);
			return new FontCharacterSet(ranges, panose);
		}

		protected virtual byte[] GetPanose(WindowsPlatformFontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer = (GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer)base.Measurer;
			Win32.FontCharset fontCharsetInfo;
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.OUTLINETEXTMETRIC? outlineTextMetrics = fontInfo.GetOutlineTextMetrics(gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer.MeasureGraphics, out fontCharsetInfo);
			if (!outlineTextMetrics.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return outlineTextMetrics.Value.otmPanoseNumber.ToByteArray();
		}

		protected override FontCapabilitiesInfo GetFontCapabilitiesCore(string fontName)
		{
			try
			{
				FontInfo fontInfo = CreateFontInfo(fontName, 20, fontBold: false, fontItalic: false, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false);
				if (fontInfo is WindowsPlatformFontInfo windowsPlatformFontInfo)
				{
					GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer = (GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer)base.Measurer;
					BitArray bitArray = windowsPlatformFontInfo.CalculateSupportedUnicodeSubrangeBits(gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer.MeasureGraphics);
					bool flag = fontInfo != null && string.Compare(fontInfo.Name, fontName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) != 0;
					FontCapabilitiesInfo fontCapabilitiesInfo = new FontCapabilitiesInfo();
					fontCapabilitiesInfo.IsSubstituted = string.Compare(fontInfo.Name, fontName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) != 0;
					fontCapabilitiesInfo.IsComplexScript = bitArray.Get(11) || bitArray.Get(13);
					fontCapabilitiesInfo.IsCjk = bitArray.Get(54) || bitArray.Get(55) || bitArray.Get(59) || bitArray.Get(61) || bitArray.Get(65);
					return fontCapabilitiesInfo;
				}
				return null;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}

		}

		public WindowsPlatformFontInfo(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, bool allowCjkCorrection, int textRotation, bool useSystemFontQuality, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
			: base(measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, allowCjkCorrection, textRotation, useSystemFontQuality, baselineFontInfo)
		{
		}

		protected WindowsPlatformFontInfo()
		{
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, bool useSystemFontQuality)
		{
			characterDrawingAbilityTable = new Dictionary<char, bool>();
			gdiFontHandle = CreateGdiFontInLayoutUnits(measurer, useSystemFontQuality);
		}

		protected virtual IntPtr CreateGdiFontInLayoutUnits(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, bool useSystemFontQuality)
		{
			return CreateGdiFontInLayoutUnits(Font, measurer, base.TextRotation, useSystemFontQuality);
		}

		protected internal override void CreateFont(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline)
		{
			GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer = (GdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer)measurer;
			font = gdiPlusFontInfoMeasurer.CreateFont(fontName, (float)doubleFontSize / 2f, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, out isEmbedded);
			this.fontName = font.Name;
			fontFamilyName = font.FontFamily.Name;
		}

		protected internal override float CalculateFontSizeInPoints()
		{
			return FontSizeHelper.GetSizeInPoints(font);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (disposing && font != null)
				{
					font.Dispose();
					font = null;
				}
				if (gdiFontHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Win32.DeleteObject(gdiFontHandle);
					gdiFontHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			base.Dispose();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~WindowsPlatformFontInfo()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		protected static uint GetOutlineTextMetrics(IntPtr hdc, uint cbData, IntPtr ptrZero)
		{
			return Win32.GetOutlineTextMetrics(hdc, cbData, ptrZero);
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		protected uint GetOtmfsSelection(Win32.OUTLINETEXTMETRIC otm)
		{
			return otm.otmfsSelection;
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		protected uint GetOtmLineGap(Win32.OUTLINETEXTMETRIC otm)

			return otm.otmLineGap;
		}

		internal PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.OUTLINETEXTMETRIC? GetOutlineTextMetrics(Graphics gr, out Win32.FontCharset fontCharsetInfo)
		{
			lock (gr)
			{
				IntPtr hdc = gr.GetHdc();
				try
				{
					IntPtr hGdiObj = Win32.SelectObject(hdc, gdiFontHandle);
					try
					{
						Win32.FONTSIGNATURE lpSig = default(Win32.FONTSIGNATURE);
						fontCharsetInfo = Win32.GetFontCharsetInfo(hdc, ref lpSig);
						return GetOutlineTextMetrics(hdc);
					}
					finally
					{
						Win32.SelectObject(hdc, hGdiObj);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					gr.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
				}
			}
		}

				finally
