	public class OfficeTextOutDraw : IWordBreakProvider
	{
		private readonly WindowsPlatformFontInfo fontInfo;

		private string text;

		private Rectangle drawBounds;

		private Rectangle rotatedBounds;

		private Rectangle clipedBounds;

		private int[] widths;

		private bool[] hotPrefixes;

		private DXStringFormat format;

		private DXStringAlignment formatAlignment;

		private DXStringFormatFlags formatFlags;

		private TextHighLight highLight;

		private FontCache fontCache;

		private int pos;

		private int drawTop;

		private int linepos;

		private bool isCliped;

		private bool measureTrailingSpaces;

		private bool isNoWrap;

		private bool trimming;

		private TextLines lines;

		private readonly IWordBreakProvider wordBreakProvider;

		private readonly bool textIsRotated;

		internal TextLines TextLines => lines;

		public string Text => text;

		public DXStringAlignment FormatAlignment => formatAlignment;

		public DXStringFormat Format => format;

		public DXStringFormatFlags FormatFlags => formatFlags;

		public Rectangle DrawBounds => drawBounds;

		public Rectangle ClipedBounds => clipedBounds;

		public int Pos
		{
			get
			{
				return pos;
			}
			set
			{
				pos = value;
			}
		}

		public int[] Widths => widths;

		public bool IsCliped => isCliped;

		public bool MeasureTrailingSpaces => measureTrailingSpaces;

		public WindowsPlatformFontInfo FontInfo => fontInfo;

		public FontCache FontCache => fontCache;

		public virtual int FontHeight => FontInfo.FontHeightMetrics.Height;

		public virtual int LineSpacing => FontHeight;

		public virtual int LineOffset => 0;

		public int LineCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (lines == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return lines.Count;
			}
		}

		public bool IsCropped { get; private set; }

		private bool IsNoWrap => isNoWrap;

		protected virtual bool WholeLinesOnly => true;

		private bool IsTrimmingElipsis
		{
			get
			{
				if (trimming)
				{
					if (Format.Trimming != DXStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter && Format.Trimming != DXStringTrimming.EllipsisPath)
					{
						return Format.Trimming == DXStringTrimming.EllipsisWord;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int MaxDrawWidth
		{
			get
			{
				int linesWidth = LinesWidth;
				if (linesWidth >= DrawBounds.Width)
				{
					return DrawBounds.Width;
				}
				return linesWidth;
			}
		}

		public int LinesWidth
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < TextLines.Count; i++)
				{
					int lineWidth = GetLineWidth(TextLines[i]);
					if (num < lineWidth)
					{
						num = lineWidth;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsFontUnderline
		{
			get
			{
				if (FontInfo == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return FontInfo.Underline;
			}
		}

		public OfficeTextOutDraw(WindowsPlatformFontInfo fontInfo, IntPtr hdc, string text, Rectangle drawBounds, Rectangle clipBounds, DXStringFormat format, TextHighLight highLight, IWordBreakProvider provider)
			: this(fontInfo, hdc, text, drawBounds, clipBounds, format, highLight, provider, null)
		{
		}

		public OfficeTextOutDraw(WindowsPlatformFontInfo fontInfo, IntPtr hdc, string text, Rectangle drawBounds, Rectangle clipBounds, DXStringFormat format, TextHighLight highLight, IWordBreakProvider provider, FontCache fontCache)
		{
			this.fontCache = fontCache;
			this.fontInfo = fontInfo;
			this.format = format;
			formatAlignment = CalcAlignment(format.Alignment, (format.FormatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft) != 0);
			formatFlags = format.FormatFlags;
			this.highLight = highLight;
			if (provider == null)
			{
				wordBreakProvider = (IWordBreakProvider)(object)this;
			}
			else
			{
				wordBreakProvider = provider;
			}
			this.text = text;
			textIsRotated = RotatedTextUtils.IsRotated(fontInfo.TextRotation);
			this.drawBounds = ApplyTextUtilsOffsets(drawBounds);
			rotatedBounds = PrepareRotatedBounds(drawBounds, fontInfo.TextRotation);
			if (clipBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				clipedBounds = drawBounds;
			}
			else
			{
				isCliped = true;
				clipedBounds = clipBounds;
				clipedBounds.Intersect(drawBounds);
			}
			widths = GetCharactersWidth(hdc);
			isNoWrap = (formatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap) == DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			trimming = format.Trimming != DXStringTrimming.None;
			isCliped |= (formatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.NoClip) == 0 || (IsNoWrap && !trimming);
			measureTrailingSpaces = (formatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces) == DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces;
			CreateLines();
		}

		private DXStringAlignment CalcAlignment(DXStringAlignment stringAlignment, bool rightToLeft)
		{
			if (!rightToLeft)
			{
				return stringAlignment;
			}
			return GetOppositeAlignment(stringAlignment);
		}

		private Rectangle PrepareRotatedBounds(Rectangle drawBounds, int textRotation)
		{
			if (!RotatedTextUtils.IsRotated(textRotation))
			{
				return drawBounds;
			}
			Rectangle result = drawBounds;
			result.Width = RotatedTextUtils.GetMaxRotatedWidth(FontHeight, drawBounds.Height, textRotation);
			return result;
		}

		public virtual int[] GetCharactersWidth(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			return fontInfo.GetCharactersWidth(hdc, Text, format);
		}

		public void DrawString(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			if (Text.Length != 0)
			{
				DrawStringLines(hdc);
			}
		}

		protected int GetCharABCWidths(char ch)
		{
			if (FontInfo == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return FontInfo.GetCharABCWidths(ch);
		}

		public virtual int GetCharABCWidths(int index)
		{
			return GetCharABCWidths(Text[index]);
		}

		private void CreateLines()
		{
			IsCropped = false;
			lines = new TextLines(null);
			if (IsNoWrap)
			{
				if (Text.IndexOf(DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.NewLineChar) > -1)
				{
					CreateReturnLines();
				}
				else
				{
					CreateNoWrapLines();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CreateWrapLines();
			}
		}

		private bool CanAddOneMoreLine(int lineTop)
		{
			if (!trimming && IsNoWrap)
			{
				return drawTop < DrawBounds.Height;
			}
			if (WholeLinesOnly)
			{
				if (drawTop + LineSpacing > DrawBounds.Height && lines.Count != 0)
				{
					return textIsRotated;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (drawTop >= DrawBounds.Height && lines.Count != 0)
			{
				return textIsRotated;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CreateWrapLines()
		{
			while (Pos < Text.Length && CanAddOneMoreLine(drawTop))
			{
				while (Pos < Text.Length && DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.IsNewLine(Text[Pos]))
				{
					AddNewLineToList();
				}
				if (Pos >= Text.Length || !CanAddOneMoreLine(drawTop) || (!textIsRotated && widths[Pos] > rotatedBounds.Width))
				{
					break;
				}
				int nextWord = GetNextWord(Pos, Text.Length);
				int textWidth = GetTextWidth(linepos, pos - linepos + nextWord);
				if (textWidth > rotatedBounds.Width)
				{
					if (Pos - linepos > 0)
					{
						AddNewLineToList();
						continue;
					}
					int num = widths[Pos];
					for (int i = 1; i < nextWord; i++)
					{
						if (num + widths[Pos + i] + GetCharABCWidths(Pos + i) > rotatedBounds.Width)
						{
							pos += i;
							IsCropped = true;
							break;
						}
						num += widths[Pos + i];
					}
					AddNewLineToList();
					if (nextWord == 1)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					pos += nextWord;
				}
			}
			if (Pos - linepos > 0)
			{
				AddNewLineToList();
			}
			if (Pos < Text.Length - 1)
			{
				if (lines.Count > 0)
				{
					lines[lines.Count - 1].UpdateTrimmingLine(Format.Trimming, rotatedBounds.Width, wordWrap: true, Text);
				}
				IsCropped = true;
			}
			pos = 0;
		}

		private void CreateReturnLines()
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (Pos < Text.Length && CanAddOneMoreLine(drawTop))
			{
				if (DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.IsNewLine(Text[Pos]))
				{
					AddNewLineToList();
					if (lines[lines.Count - 1].Length < num)
					{
						IsCropped = true;
					}
					num = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					if (Text[Pos] != DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.ReturnChar)
					{
						num++;
					}
					pos++;
				}
			}
			if (Pos - linepos > 0)
			{
				AddNewLineToList();
			}
			string text = Text.TrimEnd(DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.ReturnChar, DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.NewLineChar);
			if (Pos < text.Length - 1)
			{
				IsCropped = true;
			}
			pos = 0;
		}

		private void CreateNoWrapLines()
		{
			lines.Add(0, Text.Length);
			lines[0].UpdateTrimmingLine(Format.Trimming, DrawBounds.Width);
			if (lines[0].Length < Text.Length)
			{
				IsCropped = true;
			}
		}

		private void AddNewLineToList()
		{
			int num = Pos - linepos;
			if (num > 0 && trimming)
			{
				int nextWord = GetNextWord(Pos - 1, Text.Length);
				if (nextWord - 1 > 0)
				{
					num += nextWord - 1;
					pos += nextWord - 1;
				}
			}
			if (num > 0 && !MeasureTrailingSpaces)
			{
				while (num > 0 && CanRemoveSymbol(linepos + num - 1))
				{
					num--;
				}
				while (Pos < Text.Length && CanRemoveSymbol(Pos))
				{
					pos++;
				}
			}
			if (Pos < Text.Length && DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.IsNewLine(Text[Pos]))
			{
				pos++;
			}
			lines.Add(linepos, num);
			if (trimming)
			{
				lines[lines.Count - 1].UpdateTrimmingLine(Format.Trimming, rotatedBounds.Width);
			}
			linepos = Pos;
			drawTop += LineSpacing;
		}

		private bool CanRemoveSymbol(int pos)
		{
			if (IsSpace(Text[pos]) && (hotPrefixes == null || !hotPrefixes[pos]))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int GetNextWord(int startIndex, int textLength)
		{
			if (wordBreakProvider.IsWordBreakChar(Text[startIndex]))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int i;
			for (i = startIndex + 1; i < textLength && !wordBreakProvider.IsWordBreakChar(Text[i]) && !DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.IsNewLine(Text[i]); i++)
			{
			}
			return i - startIndex;
		}

		public int GetTextWidth(int startIndex, int length)
		{
			if (length == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				num += widths[startIndex + i];
			}
			return num + GetCharABCWidths(startIndex + length - 1);
		}

		private int[] GetLineWidths(int startIndex, int length)
		{
			if (startIndex == 0 && length == Widths.Length)
			{
				return Widths;
			}
			int[] array = new int[length];
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = Widths[startIndex + i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void DrawStringLines(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			if (textIsRotated)
			{
				DrawRotatedStringLines(hdc);
				return;
			}
			isCliped |= rotatedBounds.Height < LineSpacing * lines.Count;
			rotatedBounds = CorrectRectangleTop(rotatedBounds, LineSpacing * lines.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
			{
				DrawStringLine(bounds: new Rectangle(rotatedBounds.X, rotatedBounds.Y + i * LineSpacing, rotatedBounds.Width, LineSpacing), hdc: hdc, line: lines[i]);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRotatedStringLines(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			if (lines.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int textRotation = FontInfo.TextRotation;
			isCliped |= rotatedBounds.Height < LineSpacing * lines.Count;
			double a = RotatedTextUtils.ConvertDegreesToRadian(textRotation);
			double num = (double)LineSpacing / Math.Sin(a);
			bool flag = Math.Abs(textRotation) == 90;
			bool positiveAngle = textRotation > 0;
			DXStringFormat stringFormat = (flag ? GetStringFormatForVerticalText(positiveAngle) : Format);
			Point point = RotatedTextUtils.GetRotatedTextPosition(nonRotatedSize: new Size(GetMaxLineWidth(), LineSpacing), bounds: DrawBounds, angleRelativeHorizon: textRotation, stringFormat: stringFormat);
			if (flag)
			{
				point.X = CalculateVerticalRotationOffset(positiveAngle, num);
			}
			else
			{
				point.X -= CalculateRotationOffset(positiveAngle, num, stringFormat);
			}
			int value = SetTextAlign(hdc, stringFormat);
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
				{
					DrawRotatedStringLine(bounds: new Rectangle(point.X + (int)(num * (double)i), point.Y, rotatedBounds.Width, LineSpacing), hdc: hdc, line: lines[i]);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SetTextAlign(hdc, value);
			}
		}

		private DXStringFormat GetStringFormatForVerticalText(bool positiveAngle)
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = Format.Clone();
			DXStringAlignment lineAlignment = dXStringFormat.LineAlignment;
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = (positiveAngle ? GetOppositeAlignment(lineAlignment) : lineAlignment);
			return dXStringFormat;
		}

		private DXStringAlignment GetOppositeAlignment(DXStringAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Near => DXStringAlignment.Far, 
				DXStringAlignment.Far => DXStringAlignment.Near, 
				_ => DXStringAlignment.Center, 
			};
		}

		private int CalculateVerticalRotationOffset(bool positiveAngle, double dx)
		{
			int lineOffset = (int)(dx * (double)lines.Count);
			int num = CalculateVerticalRotationOffsetCore(lineOffset, positiveAngle);
			return num + ((Format.LineAlignment == DXStringAlignment.Far) ? ((int)dx) : 0);
		}

		private int CalculateVerticalRotationOffsetCore(int lineOffset, bool positiveAngle)
		{
			return Format.Alignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Near => DrawBounds.Left + ((!positiveAngle) ? (-lineOffset) : 0), 
				DXStringAlignment.Center => (DrawBounds.Left + DrawBounds.Right) / 2 - lineOffset / 2, 
				_ => DrawBounds.Right + (positiveAngle ? (-lineOffset) : 0), 
			};
		}

		private int CalculateRotationOffset(bool positiveAngle, double dx, DXStringFormat format)
		{
			DXStringAlignment alignment = format.Alignment;
			if (alignment == DXStringAlignment.Far)
			{
				positiveAngle = !positiveAngle;
			}
			if (alignment == DXStringAlignment.Center)
			{
				return (int)(dx * (double)(lines.Count - 1)) / 2;
			}
			if (!positiveAngle)
			{
				return (int)(dx * (double)(lines.Count - 1));
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private int GetMaxLineWidth()
		{
			int num = int.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, GetLineWidth(lines[i]));
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int SetTextAlign(IntPtr hdc, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			return SetTextAlign(hdc, (int)(CalculateHorizontalTextAlign(stringFormat) | CalculateVerticalTextAlign(stringFormat)));
		}

		private int SetTextAlign(IntPtr hdc, int value)
		{
			return Win32.SetTextAlign(hdc, value);
		}

		private PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment CalculateHorizontalTextAlign(DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			return stringFormat.Alignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Far => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_RIGHT, 
				DXStringAlignment.Center => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_CENTER, 
				_ => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_NOUPDATECP, 
			};
		}

		private PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment CalculateVerticalTextAlign(DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			return stringFormat.LineAlignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Far => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_BOTTOM, 
				DXStringAlignment.Center => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_NOUPDATECP, 
				_ => PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.TextAlignment.TA_NOUPDATECP, 
			};
		}

		private void DrawStringLine(IntPtr hdc, TextLine line, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			bounds = CorrectRectangleLeft(bounds, line);
			DrawStringLine(hdc, line.Position, line.Length, bounds.X, bounds.Y + LineOffset, highLight);
			if (line.HasElipsis)
			{
				DrawText(hdc, line.ElipsisText, bounds.X + line.TextWidth, bounds.Y + LineOffset, line.ElipsisWidths);
				bounds.X += line.ElipsisWidth;
			}
			if (line.Length2 > 0)
			{
				DrawStringLine(hdc, line.Position2, line.Length2, bounds.X + line.TextWidth, bounds.Y + LineOffset, highLight);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRotatedStringLine(IntPtr hdc, TextLine line, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			DrawStringLine(hdc, line.Position, line.Length, bounds.X, bounds.Y, highLight);
			if (line.HasElipsis)
			{
				DrawText(hdc, line.ElipsisText, bounds.X + line.TextWidth, bounds.Y, line.ElipsisWidths);
				bounds.X += line.ElipsisWidth;
			}
			if (line.Length2 > 0)
			{
				DrawStringLine(hdc, line.Position2, line.Length2, bounds.X + line.TextWidth, bounds.Y, highLight);
			}
		}

		private void DrawStringLine(IntPtr hdc, int startPos, int length, int x, int y, TextHighLight highLight)
		{
			DrawStringLine(hdc, startPos, length, x, y);
		}

		private void DrawStringLine(IntPtr hdc, ref int startPos, ref int length, ref int x, int y, int highLightLen)
		{
			DrawStringLine(hdc, startPos, highLightLen, x, y);
			x += GetTextWidth(startPos, highLightLen);
			startPos += highLightLen;
			length -= highLightLen;
		}

		private void DrawStringLine(IntPtr hdc, int startPos, int length, int x, int y)
		{
			int[] lineWidths = GetLineWidths(startPos, length);
			bool[] array = null;
			if (hotPrefixes != null)
			{
				array = new bool[lineWidths.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = hotPrefixes[startPos + i];
				}
			}
			string lineText = ((startPos == 0 && length == Text.Length) ? Text : Text.Substring(startPos, length));
			DrawStringLine(hdc, lineText, x, y, lineWidths, array);
		}

		private void DrawStringLine(IntPtr hdc, string lineText, int x, int y, int[] lineWidths, bool[] hotkeys)
		{
			DrawStringLine(hdc, lineText, x, y, lineWidths);
		}

		protected void DrawStringLine(IntPtr hdc, string lineText, int x, int y, int[] lineWidths)
		{
			if (lineText.Length != 0)
			{
				lineText = ReplaceTabsWithSpaces(lineText);
				DrawText(hdc, lineText, x, y, lineWidths);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawText(IntPtr hdc, string text, int x, int y, int[] textWidths)
		{
			Win32.EtoFlags options = (isCliped ? Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_CLIPPED : Win32.EtoFlags.ETO_NONE);
			Win32.RECT clip = Win32.RECT.FromRectangle(ClipedBounds);
			Win32.ExtTextOut(hdc, x, y, options, ref clip, text, text.Length, textWidths);
		}

		private void GetHotKeyInfo(string text, int x, int[] lineWidths, bool[] hotkeys, out string newText, out int[] newLineWidths, out int newX)
		{
			newX = x;
			newLineWidths = new int[lineWidths.Length - GetHotKeysCount(hotkeys, text.Length)];
			char[] array = new char[text.Length];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!hotkeys[i])
				{
					array[num] = text[i];
					newLineWidths[num++] = lineWidths[i];
				}
				else if (num == 0)
				{
					newX += lineWidths[i];
				}
				else
				{
					newLineWidths[num - 1] += lineWidths[i];
				}
			}
			newText = new string(array, 0, num);
		}

		private int GetHotKeysCount(bool[] hotkeys, int length)
		{
			if (hotkeys == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				if (hotkeys[i])
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private string ReplaceTabsWithSpaces(string st)
		{
			return st.Replace(DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.TabStopChar, DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.SpaceChar);
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectRectangleLeft(Rectangle bounds, TextLine line)
		{
			if (FormatAlignment != DXStringAlignment.Near)
			{
				int lineWidth = GetLineWidth(line);
				if (FormatAlignment == DXStringAlignment.Far)
				{
					bounds.X += bounds.Width - lineWidth;
				}
				else
				{
					bounds.X += (bounds.Width - lineWidth) / 2;
				}
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private int GetLineWidth(TextLine line)
		{
			return GetTextWidth(line.Position, line.Length) + line.ElipsisWidth + GetTextWidth(line.Position2, line.Length2);
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectRectangleTop(Rectangle bounds, int height)
		{
			if (bounds.Height < height && trimming)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			if (bounds.Height != LineSpacing)
			{
				switch (Format.LineAlignment)
				{
				case DXStringAlignment.Far:
					bounds.Y += bounds.Height - height;
					break;
				case DXStringAlignment.Center:
					bounds.Y += (bounds.Height - height) / 2;
					break;
				}
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private Rectangle CorrectRectangleTopForRotatedText(Rectangle bounds, int height)
		{
			if (bounds.Height < height && trimming)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			if (bounds.Height != LineSpacing)
			{
				switch (Format.LineAlignment)
				{
				case DXStringAlignment.Far:
					bounds.Y += bounds.Height - LineSpacing;
					break;
				case DXStringAlignment.Center:
					bounds.Y += (bounds.Height - height) / 2;
					break;
				}
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private Rectangle ApplyTextUtilsOffsets(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			bounds.X += TextUtils.LeftOffset;
			bounds.Y += TextUtils.TopOffset;
			bounds.Width -= TextUtils.RightOffset + TextUtils.LeftOffset;
			bounds.Height -= TextUtils.BottomOffset + TextUtils.TopOffset;
			return bounds;
		}

		private bool IsSpace(char ch)
		{
			if (wordBreakProvider.IsWordBreakChar(ch) && char.IsWhiteSpace(ch))
			{
				return !DevExpress.Office.Drawing.FontInfo.IsNewLine(ch);
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IWordBreakProvider.IsWordBreakChar(char ch)
		{
			return char.IsWhiteSpace(ch);
		}
	}
	internal class TextLine
	{
		private static readonly int[] emptyWidths = new int[0];

		private TextLines lines;

		private string elipsisText;

		private int elipsisWidth;

		private int[] elipsisWidths;

		private char[] whiteSpaces;

		public int Position { get; private set; }

		public int Length { get; private set; }

		public int Position2 { get; private set; }

		public int Length2 { get; private set; }

		public int TextWidth => GetTextWidth(Position, Length);

		public int Text2Width => GetTextWidth(Position2, Length2);

		public int LineWidth => TextWidth + ElipsisWidth + Text2Width;

		public string ElipsisText => elipsisText;

		public int ElipsisWidth => elipsisWidth;

		public int[] ElipsisWidths => elipsisWidths;

		public bool HasElipsis
		{
			get
			{
				return elipsisText.Length > 0;
			}
			set
			{
				if (HasElipsis == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				elipsisWidth = 0;
				elipsisWidths = emptyWidths;
				if (!value)
				{
					elipsisText = string.Empty;
					return;
				}
				elipsisText = "…";
				elipsisWidths = GetCharactersWidth(elipsisText);
				for (int i = 0; i < elipsisWidths.Length; i++)
				{
					elipsisWidth += elipsisWidths[i];
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsLineFirst => Position == 0;

		private char[] WhiteSpaces
		{
			get
			{
				if (whiteSpaces != null)
				{
					return whiteSpaces;
				}
				List<char> list = new List<char>();
				list.AddRange(Environment.NewLine.ToCharArray());
				list.AddRange(new char[3] { ' ', '\v', '\r' });
				whiteSpaces = list.ToArray();
				return whiteSpaces;
			}
		}

		protected TextLines Lines => lines;

		public TextLine(TextLines lines, int position, int length)
		{
			this.lines = lines;
			Position = position;
			Length = length;
			elipsisText = string.Empty;
			elipsisWidths = emptyWidths;
		}

		public int GetCharWidth(int index)
		{
			return GetCharWidth(index, includeItalic: false);
		}

		public int GetCharWidth(int index, bool includeItalic)
		{
			index += Position;
			return Lines.Widths[index] + Lines.GetCharABCWidths(index);
		}

		public void UpdateTrimmingLine(DXStringTrimming trimming, int drawBoundsWidth)
		{
			UpdateTrimmingLine(trimming, drawBoundsWidth, wordWrap: false, string.Empty);
		}

		public void UpdateTrimmingLine(DXStringTrimming trimming, int drawBoundsWidth, bool wordWrap, string text)
		{
			if (trimming == DXStringTrimming.None || Lines.Draw == null || (TextWidth <= drawBoundsWidth && !wordWrap))
			{
				return;
			}
			HasElipsis = GetIsTrimmingElipsis(trimming);
			int num = drawBoundsWidth - ElipsisWidth;
			int length = Length;
			switch (trimming)
			{
			case DXStringTrimming.Character:
			case DXStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter:
			{
				int usedLineWidth2 = 0;
				int len2 = 0;
				TrimmTextToWord(text, wordWrap, length, num, out len2, out usedLineWidth2);
				while (usedLineWidth2 + GetCharWidth(len2, includeItalic: true) <= num)
				{
					usedLineWidth2 += GetCharWidth(len2++);
					if (wordWrap && ShouldProceed(IsLineLast(text), len2))
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				Length = len2;
				break;
			}
			case DXStringTrimming.Word:
			case DXStringTrimming.EllipsisWord:
			{
				int usedLineWidth = 0;
				int len = 0;
				TrimmTextToWord(text, wordWrap, length, num, out len, out usedLineWidth);
				if (wordWrap)
				{
					if (len == 0)
					{
						len = text.Length - Position;
						break;
					}
					if (string.Equals(Lines.Draw.Text[Position + len - 1].ToString(), " "))
					{
						int num8 = Position + len - 1;
						while (num8 >= Position && string.Equals(Lines.Draw.Text[num8].ToString(), " "))
						{
							num8--;
						}
						if (num8 != Position + len - 1)
						{
							len = num8 - Position + 1;
						}
					}
				}
				Length = len;
				break;
			}
			case DXStringTrimming.EllipsisPath:
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				int num4 = 0;
				int num5 = length - 1;
				int num6 = GetCharWidth(0);
				while (num2 + num6 + num3 < num)
				{
					if (num3 < num2 && num5 > 0)
					{
						num3 += GetCharWidth(num5--);
					}
					else
					{
						num2 += GetCharWidth(num4++);
					}
					if ((Lines.Widths.Length == num4 + Position || num5 < 0) && !IsLineFirst)
					{
						Position2 = Lines.Widths.Length - 1;
						Length2 = 0;
						HasElipsis = false;
						return;
					}
					num6 = ((num3 >= num2 || num5 <= 0) ? GetCharWidth(num4) : GetCharWidth(num5));
				}
				num5 = (Position2 = num5 + 1);
				Length2 = length - num5;
				if (wordWrap && !IsLineFirst)
				{
					Position2 += Position;
				}
				Length = num4;
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void TrimmTextToWord(string text, bool wordWrap, int lineLength, int drawWidth, out int len, out int usedLineWidth)
		{
			len = 0;
			usedLineWidth = 0;
			int num = (wordWrap ? Lines.Draw.Text.Length : lineLength);
			int nextWord = GetNextWord(Position, num);
			for (int textWidth = GetTextWidth(Position, nextWord); textWidth <= drawWidth; textWidth = GetTextWidth(Position, len + nextWord))
			{
				usedLineWidth = textWidth;
				len += nextWord;
				if (wordWrap && ShouldProceed(IsLineLast(text), len))
				{
					break;
				}
				nextWord = GetNextWord(Position + len, Position + num);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldProceed(bool isLineLast, int currentLen)
		{
			if (isLineLast)
			{
				HasElipsis = false;
				return true;
			}
			if (currentLen >= Length)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsLineLast(string text)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return true;
			}
			int lastValuableSymbolIndex = GetLastValuableSymbolIndex(text);
			if (Position + Length - 1 == lastValuableSymbolIndex || lastValuableSymbolIndex < 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetLastValuableSymbolIndex(string text)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			string text2 = text.TrimEnd(WhiteSpaces);
			return text2.Length - 1;
		}

		protected bool GetIsTrimmingElipsis(DXStringTrimming trimming)
		{
			if (trimming != DXStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter && trimming != DXStringTrimming.EllipsisPath)
			{
				return trimming == DXStringTrimming.EllipsisWord;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected int[] GetCharactersWidth(string text)
		{
			return lines.GetCharacterWidths(text);
		}

		protected int GetTextWidth(int pos, int len)
		{
			return Lines.Draw.GetTextWidth(pos, len, false);
		}

		protected int GetNextWord(int startIndex, int textLength)
		{
			return Lines.Draw.GetNextWord(startIndex, textLength);
		}
	}
	internal class TextLines
	{
		private TextOutDraw draw;

		private int count;

		private TextLine[] lines;

		public int Count => count;

		public TextLine this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index >= count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return lines[index];
			}
		}

		public int[] Widths => Draw.Widths;

		public TextOutDraw Draw => draw;

		public TextLines(TextOutDraw draw)
		{
			this.draw = draw;
			lines = new TextLine[1];
		}

		public void Add(int position, int length)
		{
			AddLine(position, length);
		}

		public int[] GetCharacterWidths(string text)
		{
			return Draw.GetCharactersWidth(text);
		}

		public int GetCharABCWidths(int position)
		{
			return Draw.GetCharABCWidths(position);
		}

		protected TextLine AddLine(int position, int length)
		{
			TextLine textLine = new TextLine(this, position, length);
			Add(textLine);
			return textLine;
		}

		protected void Add(TextLine line)
		{
			if (count >= lines.Length)
			{
				TextLine[] destinationArray = new TextLine[lines.Length + 3];
				Array.Copy(lines, destinationArray, lines.Length);
				lines = destinationArray;
			}
			lines[count++] = line;
		}
	}
	public abstract class OfficeSelectionPainter
	{
		protected static readonly Color HotZoneGradientColor = Color.FromArgb(255, 202, 234, 237);

		protected static readonly Color HotZoneRotationGradientColor = Color.FromArgb(255, 136, 228, 58);

		protected static readonly Color HotZoneBorderColor = Color.Gray;

		protected static readonly Color ShapeBorderColor = Color.FromArgb(255, 90, 147, 211);

		protected static readonly int ShapeBorderWidth = 1;

		private readonly IGraphicsCache cache;

		private readonly Stack<Matrix> transformsStack = new Stack<Matrix>();

		public IGraphicsCache Cache => cache;

		public Graphics Graphics => cache.Graphics;

		public virtual SmoothingMode FillSmoothingMode => SmoothingMode.HighQuality;

		public virtual PixelOffsetMode FillPixelOffsetMode => PixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;

		protected OfficeSelectionPainter(IGraphicsCache cache)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)cache, "cache");
			this.cache = cache;
		}

		public bool TryPushFlipTransform(Rectangle bounds, float angleInDegrees, bool flipH, bool flipV)
		{
			if (angleInDegrees % 360f == 0f && !flipH && !flipV)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PushFlipTransform(bounds, angleInDegrees, flipH, flipV);
			return true;
		}

		protected void PushFlipTransform(Rectangle bounds, float angleInDegrees, bool flipH, bool flipV)
		{
			transformsStack.Push(Graphics.Transform);
			using Matrix matrix = TransformMatrixExtensions.CreateFlipTransformUnsafe(bounds, flipH, flipV, angleInDegrees);
			Graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix);
		}

		public bool TryPushRotationTransform(Point center, float angleInDegrees)
		{
			if (angleInDegrees % 360f == 0f)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PushRotationTransform(center, angleInDegrees);
			return true;
		}

		public void PushRotationTransform(Point center, float angleInDegrees)
		{
			using Matrix matrix = Graphics.Transform;
			transformsStack.Push(matrix.Clone());
			matrix.RotateAt(angleInDegrees, center);
			Graphics.Transform = matrix;
		}

		public void PopTransform()
		{
			using Matrix transform = transformsStack.Pop();
			Graphics.Transform = transform;
		}

		protected internal virtual void DrawRectangularHotZone(Rectangle bounds, Color color)
		{
			FillInOptionalQuality(delegate(Graphics graphics)
			{
				graphics.FillRectangle(CreateFillBrush(bounds, color), bounds);
				graphics.DrawRectangle(cache.GetPen(HotZoneBorderColor), bounds);
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual void DrawEllipticHotZone(Rectangle bounds, Color color)
		{
			FillInOptionalQuality(delegate(Graphics graphics)
			{
				graphics.FillEllipse(CreateFillBrush(bounds, color), bounds);
				graphics.DrawEllipse(cache.GetPen(HotZoneBorderColor), bounds);
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual Brush CreateFillBrush(Rectangle bounds, Color color)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(bounds, Color.White, color, LinearGradientMode.Vertical);
			linearGradientBrush.SetSigmaBellShape(0.5f, 1f);
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		protected void DrawInHighQuality(Action<Graphics> draw)
		{
			Graphics graphics = Cache.Graphics;
			SmoothingMode smoothingMode = graphics.SmoothingMode;
			try
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.HighQuality;
				draw(graphics);
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingMode;
			}
		}

		protected void FillInOptionalQuality(Action<Graphics> fill)
		{
			Graphics graphics = Cache.Graphics;
			SmoothingMode smoothingMode = graphics.SmoothingMode;
			PixelOffsetMode pixelOffsetMode = graphics.PixelOffsetMode;
			try
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = FillSmoothingMode;
				graphics.PixelOffsetMode = FillPixelOffsetMode;
				fill(graphics);
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingMode;
				graphics.PixelOffsetMode = pixelOffsetMode;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawActiveRectangle(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			DrawRectangle(bounds);
		}

		protected abstract void FillRectangle(Rectangle bounds);

		protected abstract void DrawRectangle(Rectangle bounds);

		protected abstract void DrawLine(Point from, Point to);
	}
	public class ShapesWordBreakProvider : IWordBreakProvider
	{
		bool IWordBreakProvider.IsWordBreakChar(char ch)
		{
			if (!char.IsWhiteSpace(ch))
			{
				return ch == '-';
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

				return null;
			}
			return CreateBitmapCore(correctedBounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter);
		}

		public static Rectangle GetCorrectedBounds(Size layoutSize, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter, bool isVectorImage)
		{
			if ((float)layoutSize.Width <= 0f || (float)layoutSize.Height <= 0f)
			{
				return default(Rectangle);
			}
			float dpi = (isVectorImage ? DocumentModelBase<int>.Dpi : layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpi);
			int val = layoutUnitConverter.LayoutUnitsToPixels(layoutSize.Width, dpi);
			int val2 = layoutUnitConverter.LayoutUnitsToPixels(layoutSize.Height, dpi);
			return new Rectangle(0, 0, Math.Max(1, val), Math.Max(1, val2));
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateShapeTransform(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, Rectangle bounds, DXMatrix parentTransform)
		{
			return CreateShapeTransform(shapeProperties.Transform2D, bounds, parentTransform);
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateShapeTransform(Transform2D transform2D, Rectangle bounds, DXMatrix parentTransform)
		{
			float angle = transform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees() % 360f;
			bool flipH = transform2D.FlipH;
			bool flipV = transform2D.FlipV;
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = parentTransform?.Clone();
			DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = TransformMatrixExtensions.CreateFlipDXTransformUnsafe(bounds, flipH, flipV, angle);
			if (dXMatrix != null)
			{
				if (dXMatrix2 != null)
				{
					dXMatrix.Multiply(dXMatrix2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dXMatrix = dXMatrix2;
			}
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateShapeDXTransform(Transform2D transform2D, Rectangle bounds, DXMatrix parentTransform)
		{
			float angle = transform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees() % 360f;
			bool flipH = transform2D.FlipH;
			bool flipV = transform2D.FlipV;
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = parentTransform?.Clone();
			DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = TransformMatrixExtensions.CreateFlipDXTransformUnsafe(bounds, flipH, flipV, angle);
			if (dXMatrix != null)
			{
				if (dXMatrix2 != null)
				{
					dXMatrix.Multiply(dXMatrix2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dXMatrix = dXMatrix2;
			}
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		public static void Draw(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo, IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			foreach (PathInfoBase path in shapeLayoutInfo.Paths)
			{
				if (!path.SkipDrawing)
				{
					path.Draw(graphics, shapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo, shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ApplyEffects(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = shapeProperties.DocumentModel;
			DrawingEffectCollection drawingEffectCollection = null;
			ContainerEffect containerEffect = shapeProperties.EffectStyle.ContainerEffect;
			if (containerEffect.ApplyEffectList)
			{
				drawingEffectCollection = containerEffect.Effects;
			}
			else
			{
				DrawingEffectStyle effectStyle = documentModel.OfficeTheme.FormatScheme.GetEffectStyle(shapeStyle.EffectReferenceIdx);
				if (effectStyle != null && effectStyle.ContainerEffect.ApplyEffectList)
				{
					drawingEffectCollection = effectStyle.ContainerEffect.Effects;
				}
			}
			if (drawingEffectCollection != null)
			{
				ShapeEffectRenderingWalker shapeEffectRenderingWalker = new ShapeEffectRenderingWalker(drawingEffectCollection, documentModel, shapeLayoutInfo, shapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode);
				shapeEffectRenderingWalker.ApplyEffects();
			}
		}

		public static bool HasEffects(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = shapeProperties.DocumentModel;
			DrawingEffectCollection drawingEffectCollection = null;
			ContainerEffect containerEffect = shapeProperties.EffectStyle.ContainerEffect;
			if (containerEffect.ApplyEffectList)
			{
				drawingEffectCollection = containerEffect.Effects;
			}
			else
			{
				DrawingEffectStyle effectStyle = documentModel.OfficeTheme.FormatScheme.GetEffectStyle(shapeStyle.EffectReferenceIdx);
				if (effectStyle != null && effectStyle.ContainerEffect.ApplyEffectList)
				{
					drawingEffectCollection = effectStyle.ContainerEffect.Effects;
				}
			}
			if (drawingEffectCollection != null)
			{
				return drawingEffectCollection.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void FillShapeLayoutInfoWithoutEffects(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo, ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, Rectangle bounds, DXMatrix parentTransform, DrawingPathInfo textPathInfo, bool createHitTests = false)
		{
			FillShapeLayoutInfoWithoutEffects(shapeLayoutInfo, shapeProperties, shapeStyle, shapeProperties.Transform2D, geometry, bounds, parentTransform, textPathInfo, createHitTests);
		}

		public static void FillShapeLayoutInfoWithoutEffects(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo, ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, Transform2D actualTransform2D, ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, Rectangle bounds, DXMatrix parentTransform, DrawingPathInfo textPathInfo, bool createHitTests = false)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = shapeProperties.DocumentModel;
			float defaultScale = documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(documentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(1));
			List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths = CalculateGraphicsPaths(geometry, bounds, defaultScale);
			ApplyScene3DProperties(graphicsPaths, shapeProperties.EffectStyle.Scene3DProperties);
			shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform = CreateShapeTransform(actualTransform2D, bounds, parentTransform);
			shapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo = GetPenInfo(shapeProperties, shapeStyle, graphicsPaths);
			if (RenderAsImage(shapeProperties))
			{
				if (!shapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode)
				{
					DrawingBlipFill pictureFill = shapeProperties.Fill as DrawingBlipFill;
					PenInfo penInfo = (PenInfo)shapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo;
					shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Add(CreateMetafilePathInfo(pictureFill, null, geometry, graphicsPaths, penInfo, createHitTests));
					shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.AddRange(CalculatePathsInfo(geometry, graphicsPaths, new BrushInfo(null), hasPermanentFill: false));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IPlatformFill brush = PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Paint.GetBrush(shapeProperties, shapeStyle, graphicsPaths, shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform, shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor);
				if (shapeProperties.IsConnectionShape())
				{
					shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.AddRange(CalculateConnectionShapePathsInfo(geometry, graphicsPaths, shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor));
				}
				else
				{
					shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.AddRange(CalculatePathsInfo(geometry, graphicsPaths, brush, brush.IsPermanent, shapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode, shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor));
				}
			}
			if (textPathInfo != null)
			{
				shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Add(textPathInfo);
			}
		}

		public static bool RenderAsImage(ShapeProperties shapeProperties)
		{
			if (shapeProperties.Fill.FillType != DrawingFillType.Picture)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return RenderAsImage(shapeProperties.Fill as DrawingBlipFill);
		}

		public static bool RenderAsImage(DrawingBlipFill blipFill)
		{
			if (blipFill == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (blipFill.Stretch)
			{
				return blipFill.RotateWithShape;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static RegularPicturePathInfo CreateRegularBitmapPathInfo(DrawingBlipFill fill, ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, bool createHitTests)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = PlatformPathExtensions.BuildFigure(graphicsPaths, addNotClosedPaths: false);
			DXMatrix transform = null;
			RectangleF boundsExtF = platformPath.GetBoundsExtF(transform);
			RegularPicturePathInfo regularPicturePathInfo = new RegularPicturePathInfo(platformPath, fill, Rectangle.Round(boundsExtF));
			if (createHitTests)
			{
				SetupMetafileHitTestCollection(regularPicturePathInfo.HitTestInfos, graphicsPaths, geometry.Paths);
			}
			regularPicturePathInfo.RotateWithShape = true;
			regularPicturePathInfo.Stroke = false;
			return regularPicturePathInfo;
		}

		public static PictureImagePathInfo CreateMetafilePathInfo(DrawingBlipFill pictureFill, IPlatformFill backgroundFill, ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, PenInfo penInfo, bool createHitTests)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = PlatformPathExtensions.BuildFigure(graphicsPaths, addNotClosedPaths: true);
			DXPen dXPen = penInfo?.Pen;
			DXMatrix transform = null;
			RectangleF bounds = platformPath.GetBoundsExtF(transform, penInfo, correctLineJoin: true);
			RectangleF pictureBounds;
			using (IPlatformPath path = PlatformPathExtensions.BuildFigure(graphicsPaths, addNotClosedPaths: false))
			{
				pictureBounds = path.GetBoundsExtF(transform);
			}
			Func<DXImage> bitmapRenderer = delegate
			{
				DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter = pictureFill.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter;
				bool isLibgdiplus = DXDrawingEngine.IsLibgdiplus;
				DXImage dXImage = ((!isLibgdiplus) ? ((DXImage)CreateMetafile(Size.Round(bounds.Size), layoutUnitConverter)) : ((DXImage)CreateBitmap(Size.Round(bounds.Size), layoutUnitConverter)));
				if (dXImage == null)
				{
					return (DXImage)null;
				}
				using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXImage, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale))
				{
					iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(0f - bounds.Left, 0f - bounds.Top, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
					SetupImageGraphicsClip(iDXGraphics, graphicsPaths, geometry.Paths);
					if (!isLibgdiplus || penInfo != null)
					{
						iDXGraphics.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
					}
					if (backgroundFill is ImageFillInfo imageFillInfo)
					{
						RectangleF value = ShapeFillAttributeCalculator.CalculatePictureClipBounds(imageFillInfo.SourceRectangle, pictureBounds);
						DrawImage(iDXGraphics, imageFillInfo.Image, Rectangle.Round(value), imageFillInfo.Effects, imageFillInfo.BlackAndWhitePrintMode);
					}
					else if (backgroundFill is BrushInfo)
					{
						DrawDXImageBackground(iDXGraphics, backgroundFill, geometry, graphicsPaths);
					}
					DXImage dXImage2 = pictureFill.Blip.Image?.DXImage;
					if (dXImage2 != null)
					{
						RectangleF value2 = ShapeFillAttributeCalculator.CalculatePictureClipBounds(pictureFill.SourceRectangle, pictureBounds);
						DrawImage(iDXGraphics, dXImage2, Rectangle.Round(value2), pictureFill.Blip.Effects, pictureFill.BlackAndWhitePrintMode);
					}
				}
				return dXImage;
			};
			PictureImagePathInfo pictureImagePathInfo = new PictureImagePathInfo(platformPath, bitmapRenderer, Rectangle.Round(bounds));
			if (createHitTests)
			{
				SetupMetafileHitTestCollection(pictureImagePathInfo.HitTestInfos, graphicsPaths, geometry.Paths);
			}
			pictureImagePathInfo.RotateWithShape = true;
			pictureImagePathInfo.Stroke = dXPen != null;
			return pictureImagePathInfo;
		}

		private static bool TryDrawGdiPlusMetafile(IDXGraphics graphics, DXImage sourceImage, RectangleF clipBounds, DXColorMatrix colorMatrix)
		{
			if (sourceImage.NativeImage is Metafile metafile && !metafile.GetMetafileHeader().IsEmfPlus() && graphics is GdiPlusGraphics gdiPlusGraphics)
			{
				Metafile metafile2 = GdipExtensions.ConvertToEmfPlus(gdiPlusGraphics.Graphics, metafile);
				if (metafile2 != null)
				{
					ColorMatrix colorMatrix2 = ((colorMatrix != null) ? new ColorMatrix(colorMatrix.Matrix) : null);
					DrawGdiPlusImage(gdiPlusGraphics.Graphics, metafile2, Rectangle.Round(clipBounds), colorMatrix2, null);
					metafile2.Dispose();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void DrawImage(IDXGraphics graphics, DXImage image, Rectangle clipBounds, DrawingEffectCollection effects, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode)
		{
			DrawingBlipEffectWalker drawingBlipEffectWalker = new DrawingBlipEffectWalker();
			drawingBlipEffectWalker.Walk(effects);
			DXColorMap[] dXColorMap = drawingBlipEffectWalker.GetDXColorMap();
			DXColorMatrix dXColorMatrix = ((!blackAndWhitePrintMode) ? (drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMatrix ? new DXColorMatrix(drawingBlipEffectWalker.ColorMatrixElements) : null) : ShapeFillRenderVisitor.GetGrayscaleDXColorMatrix());
			if (TryDrawGdiPlusMetafile(graphics, image, clipBounds, dXColorMatrix))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				RectangleF imageBounds = image.GetImageBounds();
				if (dXColorMatrix != null || dXColorMap != null)
				{
					DXImageAttributes dXImageAttributes = new DXImageAttributes();
					if (dXColorMatrix != null)
					{
						dXImageAttributes.ColorMatrix = dXColorMatrix;
					}
					if (dXColorMap != null)
					{
						dXImageAttributes.RemapTable = dXColorMap;
					}
					graphics.DrawImage(image, clipBounds, imageBounds, DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel, dXImageAttributes);
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(image, clipBounds);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private static void DrawGdiPlusImage(Graphics graphics, Image image, Rectangle clipBounds, ColorMatrix colorMatrix, ColorMap[] colorMap)
		{
			try
			{
				RectangleF imageBounds = image.GetImageBounds();
				if (colorMatrix != null || colorMap != null)
				{
					using (ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes())
					{
						if (colorMatrix != null)
						{
							imageAttributes.SetColorMatrix(colorMatrix, ColorMatrixFlag.Default, ColorAdjustType.Default);
						}
						if (colorMap != null)
						{
							imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(colorMap);
						}
						graphics.DrawImage(image, clipBounds, imageBounds.X, imageBounds.Y, imageBounds.Width, imageBounds.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
						return;
					}
				}
				graphics.DrawImage(image, clipBounds);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private static void DrawDXImageBackground(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformFill fill, ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths)
		{
			if (!(fill is BrushInfo { Brush: not null } brushInfo))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < geometry.Paths.Count; i++)
			{
				if (graphicsPaths[i] is GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath)
				{
					ModelShapePath modelShapePath = geometry.Paths[i];
					DXGraphicsPath nativeObject = gdiPlusPath.NativeObject;
					DXBrush pathFillBrush = GetPathFillBrush(modelShapePath.FillMode, brushInfo.Brush);
					if (pathFillBrush != null)
					{
						graphics.FillPath(pathFillBrush, nativeObject);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void DrawDXImageOutline(IDXGraphics graphics, DXPen pen, ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < geometry.Paths.Count; i++)
			{
				GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = graphicsPaths[i] as GdiPlusPath;
				if (!geometry.Paths[i].Stroke || gdiPlusPath == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				DXGraphicsPath nativeObject = gdiPlusPath.NativeObject;
				if (pen.Alignment == DXPenAlignment.Outset)
				{
					using DXGraphicsPath path = GdipExtensions.TransformGraphicsPathForOutsetPen(nativeObject, pen);
					graphics.DrawPath(pen, path);
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.DrawPath(pen, nativeObject);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SetupImageGraphicsClip(IDXGraphics graphics, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, ModelShapePathsList modelPaths)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < modelPaths.Count; i++)
			{
				GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = graphicsPaths[i] as GdiPlusPath;
				if (modelPaths[i].FillMode != PathFillMode.None && gdiPlusPath != null)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						graphics.SetClip(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject);
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						DXRegion clip = graphics.GetClip();
						clip.Union(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject);
						graphics.SetClip(clip);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SetupMetafileHitTestCollection(HitTestInfoCollection hitTestInfoCollection, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, ModelShapePathsList modelPaths)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < modelPaths.Count; i++)
			{
				hitTestInfoCollection.Add(new HitTestInfo(SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(((GdiPlusPath)graphicsPaths[i]).NativeObject), modelPaths[i].FillMode != PathFillMode.None));
			}
		}

		{
			return CalculateTextRect(shapeTextRectangle, bounds, documentModel, flipH: false, flipV: false);
		}

		private static void SwapTwoFloats(ref float a, ref float b)
		{
			float num = a;
			a = b;
			b = num;
		}

		public static RectangleF CalculateTextRect(AdjustableRect shapeTextRectangle, Rectangle bounds, IDocumentModel documentModel, bool flipH, bool flipV)
		{
			if (shapeTextRectangle == null || shapeTextRectangle.IsEmpty())
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = documentModel.UnitConverter;
			float num = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsL((long)shapeTextRectangle.Top.ValueEMU));
			float a = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsL((long)shapeTextRectangle.Left.ValueEMU));
			float num2 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsL((long)shapeTextRectangle.Bottom.ValueEMU));
			float b = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsL((long)shapeTextRectangle.Right.ValueEMU));
			if ((flipH || flipV) && !(flipH && flipV))
			{
				SwapTwoFloats(ref a, ref b);
				a = (float)bounds.Width - a;
				b = (float)bounds.Width - b;
			}
			float a2 = (float)bounds.Top + num;
			float a3 = (float)bounds.Left + a;
			float b2 = (float)bounds.Top + num2;
			float b3 = (float)bounds.Left + b;
			if (a3 > b3)
			{
				SwapTwoFloats(ref a3, ref b3);
			}
			if (a2 > b2)
			{
				SwapTwoFloats(ref a2, ref b2);
			}
			return RectangleF.FromLTRB(a3, a2, b3, b2);
		}

		public static RectangleF CorrectTextRectangleForUprightText(RectangleF textRectangle, float shapeAngle)
		{
			float num = shapeAngle % 180f;
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num += 180f;
			}
			if (num >= 45f && num < 135f)
			{
				float num2 = (textRectangle.Height - textRectangle.Width) / 2f;
				textRectangle = new RectangleF(textRectangle.X - num2, textRectangle.Y + num2, textRectangle.Height, textRectangle.Width);
			}
			return textRectangle;
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateSpecificTextTransform(DXMatrix shapeTransform, Rectangle bounds, float angle, bool flipH, bool flipV, bool backwardRotation)
		{
			if (shapeTransform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = shapeTransform.Clone();
			if (flipH || flipV)
			{
				DXMatrix matrix = TransformMatrixExtensions.CreateFlipTransformUnsafe(bounds, flipH, flipV);
				dXMatrix.Multiply(matrix);
			}
			if (backwardRotation && angle != 0f)
			{
				dXMatrix.RotateAt(0f - angle, RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(bounds));
			}
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateSpecificTextDXTransform(DXMatrix shapeTransform, Rectangle bounds, float angle, bool flipH, bool flipV, bool backwardRotation)
		{
			if (shapeTransform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = shapeTransform.Clone();
			if (flipH || flipV)
			{
				DXMatrix matrix = TransformMatrixExtensions.CreateFlipDXTransformUnsafe(bounds, flipH, flipV);
				dXMatrix.Multiply(matrix);
			}
			if (backwardRotation && angle != 0f)
			{
				dXMatrix.RotateAt(0f - angle, RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(bounds));
			}
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		public static ConnectionShapePathInfo[] CalculateConnectionShapePathsInfo(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float scaleFactor)
		{
			int count = geometry.Paths.Count;
			ConnectionShapePathInfo[] array = new ConnectionShapePathInfo[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				IPlatformPath graphicsPath = graphicsPaths[i];
				array[i] = new ConnectionShapePathInfo(graphicsPath, scaleFactor);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static PathInfo[] CalculatePathsInfo(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, IPlatformFill defaultBrush, bool hasPermanentFill, float scaleFactor = 1f)
		{
			return CalculatePathsInfo(geometry, graphicsPaths, defaultBrush, hasPermanentFill, blackAndWhitePrintMode: false, scaleFactor);
		}

		public static PathInfo[] CalculatePathsInfo(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, IPlatformFill defaultBrush, bool hasPermanentFill, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode, float scaleFactor = 1f)
		{
			PathInfo[] array = new PathInfo[geometry.Paths.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < geometry.Paths.Count; i++)
			{
				ModelShapePath path = geometry.Paths[i];
				IPlatformPath graphicsPath = graphicsPaths[i];
				array[i] = CalculatePathInfo(graphicsPath, path, defaultBrush, hasPermanentFill, blackAndWhitePrintMode, scaleFactor);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static PathInfo CalculatePathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, ModelShapePath path, IPlatformFill defaultBrush, bool hasPermanentFill, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode, float scaleFactor = 1f)
		{
			return PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Path.CalculatePathInfo(graphicsPath, path, defaultBrush, hasPermanentFill, blackAndWhitePrintMode, scaleFactor);
		}

		public static List<IPlatformPath> CalculateGraphicsPaths(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, Rectangle bounds, float defaultScale)
		{
			List<IPlatformPath> list = new List<IPlatformPath>();
			foreach (ModelShapePath path in geometry.Paths)
			{
				list.Add(CalculateGraphicsPath(path, bounds, defaultScale));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static IPlatformPath CalculateGraphicsPath(ModelShapePath path, Rectangle bounds, float defaultScale)
		{
			try
			{
				GeometryPathToPlatformPathConverter geometryPathToPlatformPathConverter = new GeometryPathToPlatformPathConverter(path, bounds, defaultScale);
				geometryPathToPlatformPathConverter.Walk();
				return geometryPathToPlatformPathConverter.CrossPlatformPath;
			}
			catch
			{
				return PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Path.CreatePath(CrossPlatformFillMode.EvenOdd);
			}
		}

		public static IPlatformFill GetBrush(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, DXMatrix shapeTransform, float scaleFactor)
		{
			if (shapeProperties.Fill == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (shapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode)
			{
				return new BrushInfo(new DXSolidBrush(Color.White));
			}
			DXBrush dXBrush = null;
			if (!shapeStyle.FillColor.IsEmpty && shapeStyle.FillReferenceIdx != 0)
			{
				dXBrush = new DXSolidBrush(shapeStyle.FillColor.FinalColor);
			}
			Color styleColor = shapeStyle.FillColor.FinalColor;
			IDrawingFill fill;
			if (shapeProperties.Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic && shapeStyle.FillReferenceIdx > 0)
			{
				fill = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FormatScheme.GetFill(shapeStyle.FillReferenceIdx);
			}
			else
			{
				fill = shapeProperties.Fill;
				styleColor = Color.Empty;
			}
			ShapeFillRenderVisitor shapeFillRenderVisitor = new ShapeFillRenderVisitor(shapeProperties.ShapeType, styleColor, dXBrush, graphicsPaths, shapeTransform);
			shapeFillRenderVisitor.ScaleFactor = scaleFactor;
			fill.Visit(shapeFillRenderVisitor);
			dXBrush?.Dispose();
			return new BrushInfo(shapeFillRenderVisitor.Result, shapeFillRenderVisitor.HasPermanentFill);
		}

		internal static DXBrush GetPathFillBrush(PathFillMode fillMode, DXBrush defaultBrush)
		{
			switch (fillMode)
			{
			case PathFillMode.None:
				return null;
			case PathFillMode.Norm:
				return defaultBrush;
			default:
				if (defaultBrush is DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush)
				{
					Color pathFillColor = GetPathFillColor(dXSolidBrush.Color, fillMode);
					return new DXSolidBrush(pathFillColor);
				}
				if (defaultBrush is DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush)
				{
					if (!(dXLinearGradientBrush.Clone() is DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush2))
					{
						return defaultBrush;
					}
					if (dXLinearGradientBrush.Blend != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < dXLinearGradientBrush2.LinearColors.Length; i++)
						{
							Color fillColor = dXLinearGradientBrush2.LinearColors[i];
							dXLinearGradientBrush2.LinearColors[i] = GetPathFillColor(fillColor, fillMode);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						DXColorBlend interpolationColors = CorrectDXGradientColors(fillMode, dXLinearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors);
						dXLinearGradientBrush2.InterpolationColors = interpolationColors;
					}
					return dXLinearGradientBrush2;
				}
				if (defaultBrush is DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush)
				{
					DXColorBlend interpolationColors2 = CorrectDXGradientColors(fillMode, dXPathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors);
					if (!(defaultBrush.Clone() is DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush2))
					{
						return defaultBrush;
					}
					dXPathGradientBrush2.InterpolationColors = interpolationColors2;
					return dXPathGradientBrush2;
				}
				if (defaultBrush is DXHatchBrush dXHatchBrush)
				{
					Color pathFillColor2 = GetPathFillColor(dXHatchBrush.BackgroundColor, fillMode);
					return new DXHatchBrush(dXHatchBrush.HatchStyle, dXHatchBrush.ForegroundColor, pathFillColor2);
				}
				return defaultBrush;
			}
		}

		private static DXColorBlend CorrectDXGradientColors(PathFillMode pathFillMode, DXColorBlend interpolationColors)
		{
			DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = new DXColorBlend(interpolationColors.Colors.Length);
			Color[] colors = interpolationColors.Colors;
			for (int i = 0; i < colors.Length; i++)
			{
				dXColorBlend.Colors[i] = GetPathFillColor(colors[i], pathFillMode);
				dXColorBlend.Positions[i] = interpolationColors.Positions[i];
			}
			return dXColorBlend;
		}

		internal static Brush GetPathFillBrush(PathFillMode fillMode, Brush defaultBrush)
		{
			switch (fillMode)
			{
			case PathFillMode.None:
				return null;
			case PathFillMode.Norm:
				return defaultBrush;
			default:
				if (defaultBrush is SolidBrush solidBrush)
				{
					Color pathFillColor = GetPathFillColor(solidBrush.Color, fillMode);
					return new SolidBrush(pathFillColor);
				}
				if (defaultBrush is LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush)
				{
					if (!(linearGradientBrush.Clone() is LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush2))
					{
						return defaultBrush;
					}
					if (linearGradientBrush.Blend != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < linearGradientBrush2.LinearColors.Length; i++)
						{
							Color fillColor = linearGradientBrush2.LinearColors[i];
							linearGradientBrush2.LinearColors[i] = GetPathFillColor(fillColor, fillMode);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ColorBlend interpolationColors = CorrectGradientColors(fillMode, linearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors);
						linearGradientBrush2.InterpolationColors = interpolationColors;
					}
					return linearGradientBrush2;
				}
				if (defaultBrush is PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush)
				{
					ColorBlend interpolationColors2 = CorrectGradientColors(fillMode, pathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors);
					if (!(defaultBrush.Clone() is PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush2))
					{
						return defaultBrush;
					}
					pathGradientBrush2.InterpolationColors = interpolationColors2;
					return pathGradientBrush2;
				}
				if (defaultBrush is HatchBrush hatchBrush)
				{
					Color pathFillColor2 = GetPathFillColor(hatchBrush.BackgroundColor, fillMode);
					return new HatchBrush(hatchBrush.HatchStyle, hatchBrush.ForegroundColor, pathFillColor2);
				}
				return defaultBrush;
			}
		}

		private static ColorBlend CorrectGradientColors(PathFillMode pathFillMode, ColorBlend interpolationColors)
		{
			ColorBlend colorBlend = new ColorBlend(interpolationColors.Colors.Length);
			Color[] colors = interpolationColors.Colors;
			for (int i = 0; i < colors.Length; i++)
			{
				colorBlend.Colors[i] = GetPathFillColor(colors[i], pathFillMode);
				colorBlend.Positions[i] = interpolationColors.Positions[i];
			}
			return colorBlend;
		}

		public static Color GetPathFillColor(Color fillColor, PathFillMode fillMode)
		{
			switch (fillMode)
			{
			case PathFillMode.Norm:
				return fillColor;
			case PathFillMode.None:
				return Color.Empty;
			default:
			{
				Color baseColor = Color.Empty;
				switch (fillMode)
				{
				case PathFillMode.Lighten:
					baseColor = DrawingValueConverter.GetLightenTransformColor(fillColor, 0.4);
					break;
				case PathFillMode.LightenLess:
					baseColor = DrawingValueConverter.GetLightenTransformColor(fillColor, 0.2);
					break;
				case PathFillMode.Darken:
					baseColor = DrawingValueConverter.GetDarkenTransformColor(fillColor, 0.6);
					break;
				case PathFillMode.DarkenLess:
					baseColor = DrawingValueConverter.GetDarkenTransformColor(fillColor, 0.8);
					break;
				}
				return Color.FromArgb(fillColor.A, baseColor);
			}
			}
		}

		internal static DXPen GetPen(IOfficeShape shape)
		{
			if (!(GetPenInfo(shape.ShapeProperties, shape.ShapeStyle, new List<IPlatformPath>()) is PenInfo penInfo))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return penInfo.Pen;
		}

		public static DXPen GetPen(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddRectangle(bounds);
			List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths = new List<IPlatformPath>
			{
				new GdiPlusPath(dXGraphicsPath)
			};
			return (GetPenInfo(shapeProperties.Outline, shapeStyle, graphicsPaths, shapeProperties.ShapeType, shapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode) is PenInfo penInfo) ? penInfo.Pen : null;
		}
