		}

		public static IPlatformStroke GetPenInfo(Outline outline, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, ShapePreset shapeType, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode)
		{
			IDrawingFill fill = outline.Fill;
			Color color = ((fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic) ? shapeStyle.LineColor.FinalColor : Color.Empty);
			IDocumentModel documentModel = shapeStyle.DocumentModel;
			Outline outline2 = documentModel.OfficeTheme.FormatScheme.GetOutline(shapeStyle.LineReferenceIdx);
			if (outline.IsDefault && outline2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			OutlineInfo outlineInfo = ActualOutlineHelper.MergeOutline(outline, outline2);
			if (fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic && outline2 != null)
			{
				fill = outline2.Fill;
			}
			float val = documentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnits(1);
			float penWidth = Math.Max(val, documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits((float)outlineInfo.Width));
			DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
			LineCapInfo startCap = GetLineCap(outlineInfo.HeadType, outlineInfo.HeadWidth, outlineInfo.HeadLength);
			LineCapInfo endCap = GetLineCap(outlineInfo.TailType, outlineInfo.TailWidth, outlineInfo.TailLength);
			Action<DXGraphicsPath> figureTransform = delegate(DXGraphicsPath figure)
			{
				if (penWidth > 0f && GdipExtensions.AllowPathWidening(figure))
				{
					using (DXPen dXPen2 = new DXPen(Color.Empty, penWidth))
					{
						if (startCap != null)
						{
							DXCustomLineCap customStartCap = startCap.CreateCap(1f);
							dXPen2.CustomStartCap = customStartCap;
						}
						if (endCap != null)
						{
							DXCustomLineCap customEndCap = endCap.CreateCap(1f);
							dXPen2.CustomEndCap = customEndCap;
						}
						WidenHelper.Apply(figure, dXPen2);
					}
				}
			};
			bool hasPermanentFill = false;
			DXBrush dXBrush;
			if (blackAndWhitePrintMode)
			{
				dXBrush = new DXSolidBrush(Color.Black);
			}
			else
			{
				ShapeFillRenderVisitor shapeFillRenderVisitor = new ShapeFillRenderVisitor(shapeType, color, dXSolidBrush, graphicsPaths, null);
				shapeFillRenderVisitor.OutlineFill = true;
				shapeFillRenderVisitor.FigureTransform = figureTransform;
				fill.Visit(shapeFillRenderVisitor);
				dXSolidBrush.Dispose();
				dXBrush = shapeFillRenderVisitor.Result;
				hasPermanentFill = shapeFillRenderVisitor.HasPermanentFill;
			}
			if (dXBrush == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(dXBrush, penWidth);
			DXLineCap endCap2 = (dXPen.StartCap = GetLineCap(outlineInfo.EndCapStyle));
			dXPen.EndCap = endCap2;
			SetupOutlineDashing(dXPen, outlineInfo.Dashing);
			SetupOutlineDashCap(dXPen, outlineInfo.EndCapStyle);
			SetupLineJoin(dXPen, shapeType, outlineInfo.JoinStyle, (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(outlineInfo.MiterLimit));
			SetupCompoundType(dXPen, outlineInfo.CompoundType);
			PenInfo penInfo = new PenInfo(dXPen, dXBrush, hasPermanentFill);
			penInfo.StartCap = startCap;
			penInfo.EndCap = endCap;
			penInfo.Converter = (float value) => documentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits(value));
			return penInfo;
		}

		private static DXLineCap GetLineCap(OutlineEndCapStyle capStyle)
		{
			return capStyle switch
			{
				OutlineEndCapStyle.Round => DXLineCap.Round, 
				OutlineEndCapStyle.Square => DXLineCap.Square, 
				_ => DXLineCap.Flat, 
			};
		}

		private static void SetupCompoundType(DXPen pen, OutlineCompoundType compoundType)
		{
			switch (compoundType)
			{
			case OutlineCompoundType.Double:
				pen.CompoundArray = new float[4] { 0f, 0.35f, 0.65f, 1f };
				break;
			case OutlineCompoundType.ThickThin:
				pen.CompoundArray = new float[4] { 0f, 0.6f, 0.8f, 1f };
				break;
			case OutlineCompoundType.ThinThick:
				pen.CompoundArray = new float[4] { 0f, 0.2f, 0.4f, 1f };
				break;
			case OutlineCompoundType.Triple:
				pen.CompoundArray = new float[6] { 0f, 0.2f, 0.35f, 0.65f, 0.8f, 1f };
				break;
			case OutlineCompoundType.Single:
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void SetupOutlineDashing(DXPen pen, OutlineDashing dashing)
		{
			switch (dashing)
			{
			case OutlineDashing.Solid:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Solid;
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.Dash:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = new float[2] { 4f, 3f };
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.LongDash:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = new float[2] { 8f, 3f };
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.SystemDash:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Dash;
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.DashDot:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = new float[4] { 4f, 3f, 1f, 3f };
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.LongDashDot:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = new float[4] { 8f, 3f, 1f, 3f };
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.SystemDashDot:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = new float[4] { 3f, 1f, 1f, 1f };
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.Dot:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = new float[2] { 1f, 3f };
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.SystemDot:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Dot;
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.SystemDashDotDot:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = new float[6] { 3f, 1f, 1f, 1f, 1f, 1f };
				break;
			case OutlineDashing.LongDashDotDot:
				pen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = new float[6] { 8f, 3f, 1f, 3f, 1f, 3f };
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void SetupOutlineDashCap(DXPen pen, OutlineEndCapStyle endCapStyle)
		{
			switch (endCapStyle)
			{
			case OutlineEndCapStyle.Round:
				pen.DashCap = DXDashCap.Round;
				break;
			case OutlineEndCapStyle.Square:
			case OutlineEndCapStyle.Flat:
				pen.DashCap = DXDashCap.Flat;
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void SetupLineJoin(DXPen pen, ShapePreset shapeType, LineJoinStyle joinStyle, float miterLimit)
		{
			if (joinStyle == LineJoinStyle.Round && IsMiteredLineJoinShape(shapeType))
			{
				joinStyle = LineJoinStyle.Miter;
			}
			SetupLineJoinCore(pen, joinStyle, miterLimit);
		}

		private static void SetupLineJoinCore(DXPen pen, LineJoinStyle joinStyle, float miterLimit)
		{
			switch (joinStyle)
			{
			case LineJoinStyle.Bevel:
				pen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Bevel;
				break;
			case LineJoinStyle.Miter:
				pen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Miter;
				pen.MiterLimit = miterLimit;
				break;
			case LineJoinStyle.Round:
				pen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Round;
				break;
			}
		}

		private static LineCapInfo GetLineCap(OutlineHeadTailType type, OutlineHeadTailSize width, OutlineHeadTailSize length)
		{
			if (type == OutlineHeadTailType.None)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return lineCapCreators.Value[type].Create(width, length);
		}

		private static void ApplyScene3DProperties(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, Scene3DProperties scene3D)
		{
			if (scene3D.IsDefault || graphicsPaths == null || graphicsPaths.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IPlatformPath platformPath = PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Path.CreatePath(CrossPlatformFillMode.EvenOdd);
			foreach (IPlatformPath graphicsPath in graphicsPaths)
			{
				platformPath.AddPath(graphicsPath, connect: false);
			}
			Rectangle boundsExt = platformPath.GetBoundsExt();
			platformPath.Dispose();
			DXMatrix matrix = CalculateCameraTransform(scene3D, boundsExt);
			foreach (IPlatformPath graphicsPath2 in graphicsPaths)
			{
				graphicsPath2.Transform(matrix);
			}
		}

		internal static DXMatrix CalculateCameraTransform(Scene3DProperties scene3D, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			IScene3DCamera camera = scene3D.Camera;
			double longitude;
			double latitude;
			double revolution;
			if (camera.HasRotation)
			{
				longitude = DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(camera.Lon) % 360.0;
				latitude = DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(camera.Lat) % 360.0;
				revolution = DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(camera.Rev) % 360.0;
			}
			else
			{
				double[] cameraRotationByPreset = GetCameraRotationByPreset(camera.Preset);
				longitude = cameraRotationByPreset[0];
				latitude = cameraRotationByPreset[1];
				revolution = cameraRotationByPreset[2];
			}
			return CalculateCameraTransformCore(bounds, longitude, latitude, revolution);
		}

		private static DXMatrix CalculateCameraTransformCore(Rectangle bounds, double longitude, double latitude, double revolution)
		{
			PointF pointF = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(bounds);
			double num = (double)bounds.Width / 2.0 * Math.Cos(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(longitude));
			double num2 = (double)bounds.Width / 2.0 * Math.Sin(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(longitude));
			Rectangle bounds2 = new Rectangle(0, bounds.Y, (int)Math.Round(num2 * 2.0), bounds.Height);
			Point point = new Point(bounds2.Left, bounds2.Top);
			Point point2 = new Point(bounds2.Right, bounds2.Top);
			Point point3 = new Point(bounds2.Left, bounds2.Bottom);
			Point point4 = new Point(bounds2.Right, bounds2.Bottom);
			if (latitude != 0.0)
			{
				Matrix matrix = TransformMatrixExtensions.CreateTransformUnsafe((float)latitude, bounds2);
				point = matrix.TransformPoint(point);
				point2 = matrix.TransformPoint(point2);
				point3 = matrix.TransformPoint(point3);
				point4 = matrix.TransformPoint(point4);
				matrix.Dispose();
			}
			PointF[] array = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - num), point.Y),
				new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + num), point2.Y),
				new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X - num), point3.Y),
				new PointF((float)((double)pointF.X + num), point4.Y)
			};
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			if (revolution != 0.0)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Round(RectangleUtils.BoundingRectangle(array));
				Point point5 = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(rectangle);
				dXMatrix.RotateAt((float)(0.0 - revolution), point5);
			}
			DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = DXMatrix.CreateWarpMatrix(bounds, new List<PointF>
			{
				array[0],
				array[1],
				array[2]
			});
			dXMatrix2.Multiply(dXMatrix, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			return dXMatrix2;
		}

		private static double[] GetCameraRotationByPreset(PresetCameraType preset)
		{
			return preset switch
			{
				PresetCameraType.IsometricLeftDown => new double[3] { 45.0, 35.0, 0.0 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricRightUp => new double[3] { 315.0, 35.0, 0.0 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricTopUp => new double[3] { 314.7, 324.6, 60.2 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricBottomDown => new double[3] { 314.7, 35.4, 299.8 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricOffAxis1Left => new double[3] { 64.0, 18.0, 0.0 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricOffAxis1Right => new double[3] { 334.0, 18.0, 0.0 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricOffAxis1Top => new double[3] { 306.5, 301.3, 57.6 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricOffAxis2Left => new double[3] { 26.0, 18.0, 0.0 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricOffAxis2Right => new double[3] { 296.0, 18.0, 0.0 }, 
				PresetCameraType.IsometricOffAxis2Top => new double[3] { 53.5, 301.3, 302.4 }, 
				_ => new double[3], 
			};
		}

		public static bool IsMiteredLineJoinShape(ShapePreset preset)
		{
			switch (preset)
			{
			case ShapePreset.Star4:
			case ShapePreset.Star5:
			case ShapePreset.Star8:
			case ShapePreset.Star10:
			case ShapePreset.Star12:
			case ShapePreset.Star16:
			case ShapePreset.Star24:
			case ShapePreset.Star32:
			case ShapePreset.Chevron:
			case ShapePreset.RightArrow:
			case ShapePreset.UpArrow:
			case ShapePreset.DownArrow:
			case ShapePreset.StripedRightArrow:
			case ShapePreset.NotchedRightArrow:
			case ShapePreset.BentUpArrow:
			case ShapePreset.UpDownArrow:
			case ShapePreset.LeftUpArrow:
			case ShapePreset.LeftArrowCallout:
			case ShapePreset.LeftRightArrowCallout:
			case ShapePreset.UpDownArrowCallout:
			case ShapePreset.QuadArrowCallout:
			case ShapePreset.Cube:
			case ShapePreset.Moon:
			case ShapePreset.EllipseRibbon:
			case ShapePreset.EllipseRibbon2:
			case ShapePreset.Plus:
			case ShapePreset.MathPlus:
			case ShapePreset.MathMinus:
			case ShapePreset.MathMultiply:
			case ShapePreset.MathEqual:
			case ShapePreset.MathNotEqual:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class LineCapInfoCreatorBase
	{
		protected abstract bool Filled { get; }

		protected abstract OutlineHeadTailType Type { get; }

		public LineCapInfo Create(OutlineHeadTailSize width, OutlineHeadTailSize length)
		{
			float inset = GetInset(width, length);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			PreparePath(dXGraphicsPath, width, length, inset);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath2 = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			PrepareBoundingPath(dXGraphicsPath2, width, length);
			return new LineCapInfo(Type, dXGraphicsPath, dXGraphicsPath2, Filled, inset);
		}

		protected abstract float GetInset(OutlineHeadTailSize width, OutlineHeadTailSize length);

		protected abstract void PreparePath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize, float inset);

		protected abstract void PrepareBoundingPath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize);

		protected void AddCirclePath(DXGraphicsPath path, float radius)
		{
			AddEllipsePath(path, radius, radius);
		}

		protected void AddEllipsePath(DXGraphicsPath path, float width, float length)
		{
			path.AddEllipse(0f - width, 0f - length, 2f * width, 2f * length);
			path.CloseFigure();
		}
	}
	internal class DiamondLineCapInfoCreator : LineCapInfoCreatorBase
	{
		private static readonly float[] sizes = new float[3] { 1f, 1.5f, 2.5f };

		protected override bool Filled => true;

		protected override OutlineHeadTailType Type => OutlineHeadTailType.Diamond;

		protected override float GetInset(OutlineHeadTailSize width, OutlineHeadTailSize length)
		{
			return 0f;
		}

		protected override void PreparePath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize, float inset)
		{
			float num = sizes[(int)widthSize];
			float num2 = sizes[(int)lengthSize];
			PointF[] points = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(num, 0f),
				new PointF(0f, num2),
				new PointF(0f - num, 0f),
				new PointF(0f, 0f - num2)
			};
			path.AddLines(points);
			path.CloseFigure();
		}

		protected override void PrepareBoundingPath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize)
		{
			OutlineHeadTailSize biggestSize = GetBiggestSize(widthSize, lengthSize);
			AddCirclePath(path, sizes[(int)biggestSize]);
		}

		private OutlineHeadTailSize GetBiggestSize(OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize)
		{
			if (lengthSize == OutlineHeadTailSize.Large || widthSize == OutlineHeadTailSize.Large)
			{
				return OutlineHeadTailSize.Large;
			}
			if (lengthSize == OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium || widthSize == OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium)
			{
				return OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium;
			}
			return OutlineHeadTailSize.Small;
		}
	}
	internal class OvalLineCapInfoCreator : DiamondLineCapInfoCreator
	{
		private static readonly float[] sizes = new float[3] { 2f, 3f, 5f };

		protected override OutlineHeadTailType Type => OutlineHeadTailType.Oval;

		protected override void PreparePath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize, float inset)
		{
			AddEllipsePath(path, 0.5f * sizes[(int)widthSize], 0.5f * sizes[(int)lengthSize]);
		}
	}
	internal class ArrowLineCapInfoCreator : LineCapInfoCreatorBase
	{
		private static readonly float[] widths = new float[3] { 2.5f, 3.5f, 5f };

		private static readonly float[] lengths = new float[3] { 2f, 3f, 4.5f };

		private static readonly float[] insets = new float[9] { 1f, 0.9f, 0.7f, 1.2f, 1f, 0.8f, 1.8f, 1.4f, 1f };

		private static readonly float[] boundingInsets = new float[9] { 1.8f, 1.4f, 1.3f, 2.2f, 1.5f, 1.1f, 3.1f, 1.7f, 0.9f };

		protected override bool Filled => false;

		protected override OutlineHeadTailType Type => OutlineHeadTailType.Arrow;

		protected override float GetInset(OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize)
		{
			int num = (int)(3 * (int)lengthSize + widthSize);
			return insets[num];
		}

		protected override void PreparePath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize, float inset)
		{
			float num = widths[(int)widthSize];
			float num2 = lengths[(int)lengthSize];
			path.AddLine(new PointF(num / 2f, 0f - num2 - inset), new PointF(0f, 0f - inset));
			path.AddLine(new PointF(0f, 0f - inset), new PointF((0f - num) / 2f, 0f - num2 - inset));
		}

		protected override void PrepareBoundingPath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize)
		{
			int num = (int)(3 * (int)lengthSize + widthSize);
			float radius = lengths[(int)lengthSize] + boundingInsets[num];
			AddCirclePath(path, radius);
		}
	}
	internal class StealthArrowLineCapInfoCreator : LineCapInfoCreatorBase

		private static readonly float[] widths = new float[3] { 1f, 1.5f, 2.5f };

		private static readonly float[] lengths = new float[3] { 2f, 3f, 5f };

		protected override OutlineHeadTailType Type => OutlineHeadTailType.StealthArrow;

			{
				OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium => 2f,

			};

		protected override void PreparePath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize, float inset)
		{
			float num = widths[(int)widthSize];
			float num2 = lengths[(int)lengthSize];

				new PointF(0f, 0f - inset),
				new PointF(num, 0f - num2),
				new PointF(0f, 0f),
				new PointF(0f - num, 0f - num2)
			};
			path.AddLines(points);
			path.CloseFigure();
		}

		protected override void PrepareBoundingPath(DXGraphicsPath path, OutlineHeadTailSize widthSize, OutlineHeadTailSize lengthSize)
		{
			int num = (int)(3 * (int)lengthSize + widthSize);

		}

	{

		protected override OutlineHeadTailType Type => OutlineHeadTailType.TriangleArrow;

		}
	}
	public abstract class BlurEffectRendererBase
	{
		protected const int blueChannel = 0;

		protected const int greenChannel = 1;

		protected const int redChannel = 2;

		protected const int alphaChannel = 3;

		protected const int channelsCount = 4;

		protected bool isNotWindowsSkia = !PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.Skia;

		protected DXBitmap ApplyBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, int width, int height, int blurRadius)
		{
			return ApplyGaussianBlurCore(bitmap, width, height, blurRadius, 1.0);
		}

		protected DXBitmap ApplyBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, int width, int height, int blurRadius, double blurRadiusCoeff)
		{
			return ApplyGaussianBlurCore(bitmap, width, height, blurRadius, blurRadiusCoeff);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private DXBitmap ApplyGaussianBlurCore(DXBitmap bitmap, int width, int height, int blurRadius, double blurRadiusCoeff)
		{
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = bitmap.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite);
			int size = 4 * width * height;
			byte[] content = GetContent(iDXBitmapData, size);
			if (isNotWindowsSkia)
			{
				Unpremultiply(content, width * height);
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[content.Length];
			Array.Copy(content, array, content.Length);
			int rowBytes = iDXBitmapData.RowBytes;
			double radiusFrac = blurRadiusCoeff / (double)(2 * blurRadius + 1);
			BoxBlur(content, array, width, height, rowBytes, blurRadius, radiusFrac);
			if (isNotWindowsSkia)
			{
				Premultiply(content, width * height);
			}
			Marshal.Copy(content, 0, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, content.Length);
			return bitmap;
		}

		protected virtual void BoxBlur(byte[] source, byte[] target, int width, int height, int stride, int radius, double radiusFrac)
		{
			BoxHorizontalBlur(source, target, width, height, stride, radius, radiusFrac);
			BoxVerticalBlur(target, source, width, height, stride, radius, radiusFrac);
		}

		protected abstract void BoxHorizontalBlur(byte[] source, byte[] target, int width, int height, int stride, int radius, double radiusFrac);

		protected abstract void BoxVerticalBlur(byte[] source, byte[] target, int width, int height, int stride, int radius, double radiusFrac);

		protected byte GetColorValue(int colorValue, double coeff)
		{
			double num = Math.Round((double)colorValue * coeff);
			if (num > 255.0)
			{
				return byte.MaxValue;
			}
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return (byte)num;
		}

		protected void Premultiply(byte[] bytes, int size)
		{
			Parallel.For(0, size, delegate(int current)
			{
				int num = current * 4;
				byte b = bytes[num + 3];
				if (b > 0)
				{
					SetColors(bytes, num, (double)(int)b / 255.0);
				}
			});
		}

		protected void Unpremultiply(byte[] bytes, int size)
		{
			Parallel.For(0, size, delegate(int current)
			{
				int num = current * 4;
				byte b = bytes[num + 3];
				if (b > 0)
				{
					SetColors(bytes, num, 255.0 / (double)(int)b);
				}
			});
		}

		protected void SetColors(byte[] bytes, int position, double coeff)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				bytes[position + i] = GetColorValue(bytes[position + i], coeff);
			}
		}

		protected void SetPixelCore(byte[] target, int position, byte red, byte green, byte blue, byte alpha)
		{
			target[position + 2] = red;
			target[position + 1] = green;
			target[position] = blue;
			target[position + 3] = alpha;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected byte[] GetContent(IDXBitmapData data, int size)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[size];
			Marshal.Copy(data.DataPointer, array, 0, array.Length);
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class BlurEffectRenderer : BlurEffectRendererBase
	{
		public static DXBitmap ApplyReflectionBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, int blurRadius, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			BlurEffectRenderer blurEffectRenderer = new BlurEffectRenderer();
			return blurEffectRenderer.EnlargeAndBlurBitmap(bitmap, blurRadius, layoutUnitConverter);
		}

		public static DXBitmap ApplyBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, int blurRadius)
		{
			BlurEffectRenderer blurEffectRenderer = new BlurEffectRenderer();
			bitmap = blurEffectRenderer.ApplyBlur(bitmap, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height, blurRadius);
			return bitmap;
		}

		private DXBitmap EnlargeAndBlurBitmap(DXBitmap bitmap, int blurRadius, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			int width = bitmap.Width;
			int height = bitmap.Height;
			int width2 = width + 2 * blurRadius;
			int height2 = height + 2 * blurRadius;
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmapCore(new Size(width2, height2), layoutUnitConverter, DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp);
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics())
			{
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(bitmap, new Rectangle(blurRadius, blurRadius, width, height));
			}
			bitmap.Dispose();
			return ApplyBlur(dXBitmap, width2, height2, blurRadius);
		}

		protected override void BoxBlur(byte[] source, byte[] target, int width, int height, int stride, int radius, double radiusFrac)
		{
			int size = source.Length / 4;
			if (!isNotWindowsSkia)
			{
				Premultiply(source, size);
			}
			base.BoxBlur(source, target, width, height, stride, radius, radiusFrac);
			if (!isNotWindowsSkia)
			{
				Unpremultiply(source, size);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoxHorizontalBlur(byte[] source, byte[] target, int width, int height, int stride, int radius, double radiusFrac)
		{
			Parallel.For(0, height, delegate(int row)
			{
				int[] array = new int[4];
				int[] array2 = new int[4];
				int[] array3 = new int[4];
				int num = row * stride;
				int num2 = num;
				int num3 = num + radius * 4;
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = source[num + i];
					array3[i] = source[num + (width - 1) * 4 + i];
					array[i] = (radius + 1) * array2[i];
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < radius; j++)
				{
					int num4 = num + j * 4;
					for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
					{
						array[k] += source[num4 + k];
					}
				}
				int num5 = 0;
				while (num5 <= radius)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++)
					{
						array[l] += source[num3 + l] - array2[l];
					}
					SetPixel(target, num, array, radiusFrac);
					num5++;
					num3 += 4;
					num += 4;
				}
				int num6 = radius + 1;
				while (num6 < width - radius)
				{
					for (int m = 0; m < 4; m++)
					{
						array[m] += source[num3 + m] - source[num2 + m];
					}
					SetPixel(target, num, array, radiusFrac);
					num6++;
					num2 += 4;
					num3 += 4;
					num += 4;
				}
				int num7 = width - radius;
				while (num7 < width)
				{
					for (int n = 0; n < 4; n++)
					{
						array[n] += array3[n] - source[num2 + n];
					}
					SetPixel(target, num, array, radiusFrac);
					num7++;
					num2 += 4;
					num += 4;
				}
			});
		}

		protected override void BoxVerticalBlur(byte[] source, byte[] target, int width, int height, int stride, int radius, double radiusFrac)
		{
			Parallel.For(0, width, delegate(int column)
			{
				int[] array = new int[4];
				int[] array2 = new int[4];
				int[] array3 = new int[4];
				int num = column * 4;
				int num2 = num;
				int num3 = num + radius * stride;
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = source[num + i];
					array3[i] = source[num + (height - 1) * stride + i];
					array[i] = (radius + 1) * array2[i];
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < radius; j++)
				{
					int num4 = num + j * stride;
					for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
					{
						array[k] += source[num4 + k];
					}
				}
				int num5 = 0;
				while (num5 <= radius)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++)
					{
						array[l] += source[num3 + l] - array2[l];
					}
					SetPixel(target, num, array, radiusFrac);
					num5++;
					num3 += stride;
					num += stride;
				}
				int num6 = radius + 1;
				while (num6 < height - radius)
				{
					for (int m = 0; m < 4; m++)
					{
						array[m] += source[num3 + m] - source[num2 + m];
					}
					SetPixel(target, num, array, radiusFrac);
					num6++;
					num2 += stride;
					num3 += stride;
					num += stride;
				}
				int num7 = height - radius;
				while (num7 < height)
				{
					for (int n = 0; n < 4; n++)
					{
						array[n] += array3[n] - source[num2 + n];
					}
					SetPixel(target, num, array, radiusFrac);
					num7++;
					num2 += stride;
					num += stride;
				}
			});
		}

		private void SetPixel(byte[] target, int position, int[] sum, double coeff)
		{
			int num = sum[3];
			if (num > 0)
			{
				byte colorValue = GetColorValue(num, coeff);
				byte colorValue2 = GetColorValue(sum[2], coeff);
				byte colorValue3 = GetColorValue(sum[1], coeff);
				byte colorValue4 = GetColorValue(sum[0], coeff);
				SetPixelCore(target, position, colorValue2, colorValue3, colorValue4, colorValue);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AlphaBlurEffectRenderer : BlurEffectRendererBase
	{
		protected Color Color { get; set; }

		public static DXImage ShadowBlur(DXImage bitmap, int blurRadiusInPixels, Color color, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			return new AlphaBlurEffectRenderer().EnlargeAndDrawBlur(bitmap, blurRadiusInPixels, color, 1.0, layoutUnitConverter);
		}

		public static DXBitmap GlowBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, int blurRadiusInPixels, Color color)
		{
			return new AlphaBlurEffectRenderer().DrawBlur(bitmap, (int)((double)blurRadiusInPixels * 0.8), color, 1.4);
		}

		public static DXBitmap InnerShadowBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, Size sourceSizeInPixels, int blurRadiusInPixels, Color color, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			return new AlphaBlurEffectRenderer().DrawInnerShadowBlur(bitmap, sourceSizeInPixels, blurRadiusInPixels, color, layoutUnitConverter);
		}

		private DXImage EnlargeAndDrawBlur(DXImage bitmap, int blurRadius, Color color, double blurRadiusCoeff, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			int width = bitmap.Width + 2 * blurRadius;
			int height = bitmap.Height + 2 * blurRadius;
			DXImage dXImage = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmapCore(new Size(width, height), layoutUnitConverter, DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp);
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXImage.CreateGraphics())
			{
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(bitmap, blurRadius, blurRadius);
			}
			bitmap.Dispose();
			return DrawBlur((DXBitmap)dXImage, blurRadius, color, blurRadiusCoeff);
		}

		private DXBitmap DrawBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, int blurRadius, Color color, double blurRadiusCoeff)
		{
			Color = color;
			bitmap = ApplyBlur(bitmap, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height, blurRadius, blurRadiusCoeff);
			return bitmap;
		}

		private DXBitmap DrawInnerShadowBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, Size sourceSize, int blurRadius, Color color, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			Color = color;
			int width = bitmap.Width;
			int height = bitmap.Height;
			bitmap = ApplyBlur(bitmap, width, height, blurRadius);
			DXImage dXImage = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmapCore(sourceSize, layoutUnitConverter, DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp);
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXImage.CreateGraphics())
			{
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(bitmap, -blurRadius, -blurRadius);
			}
			bitmap.Dispose();
			return (DXBitmap)dXImage;
		}

		protected override void BoxHorizontalBlur(byte[] source, byte[] target, int width, int height, int stride, int radius, double radiusFrac)
		{
			Parallel.For(0, height, delegate(int row)
			{
				int num = row * stride;
				int num2 = num;
				int num3 = num + radius * 4;
				int num4 = source[num + 3];
				int num5 = source[num + (width - 1) * 4 + 3];
				int num6 = (radius + 1) * num4;
				for (int i = 0; i < radius; i++)
				{
					num6 += source[num + i * 4 + 3];
				}
				int num7 = 0;
				while (num7 <= radius)
				{
					num6 += source[num3 + 3] - num4;
					SetPixelHorizontal(target, num, num6, radiusFrac);
					num7++;
					num3 += 4;
					num += 4;
				}
				int num8 = radius + 1;
				while (num8 < width - radius)
				{
					num6 += source[num3 + 3] - source[num2 + 3];
					SetPixelHorizontal(target, num, num6, radiusFrac);
					num8++;
					num2 += 4;
					num3 += 4;
					num += 4;
				}
				int num9 = width - radius;
				while (num9 < width)
				{
					num6 += num5 - source[num2 + 3];
					SetPixelHorizontal(target, num, num6, radiusFrac);
					num9++;
					num2 += 4;
					num += 4;
				}
			});
		}

		protected override void BoxVerticalBlur(byte[] source, byte[] target, int width, int height, int stride, int radius, double radiusFrac)
		{
			Parallel.For(0, width, delegate(int column)
			{
				int num = column * 4;
				int num2 = num;
				int num3 = num + radius * stride;
				int num4 = source[num + 3];
				int num5 = source[num + (height - 1) * stride + 3];
				int num6 = (radius + 1) * num4;
				for (int i = 0; i < radius; i++)
				{
					num6 += source[num + i * stride + 3];
				}
				int num7 = 0;
				while (num7 <= radius)
				{
					num6 += source[num3 + 3] - num4;
					SetPixelVertical(target, num, num6, radiusFrac);
					num7++;
					num3 += stride;
					num += stride;
				}
				int num8 = radius + 1;
				while (num8 < height - radius)
				{
					num6 += source[num3 + 3] - source[num2 + 3];
					SetPixelVertical(target, num, num6, radiusFrac);
					num8++;
					num2 += stride;
					num3 += stride;
					num += stride;
				}
				int num9 = height - radius;
				while (num9 < height)
				{
					num6 += num5 - source[num2 + 3];
					SetPixelVertical(target, num, num6, radiusFrac);
					num9++;
					num2 += stride;
					num += stride;
				}
			});
		}

		protected virtual void SetPixelHorizontal(byte[] target, int position, int alphaSum, double coeff)
		{
			if (alphaSum > 0)
			{
				target[position + 3] = GetColorValue(alphaSum, coeff);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetPixelVertical(byte[] target, int position, int alphaSum, double coeff)
		{
			if (alphaSum > 0)
			{
				byte alpha = Math.Min(GetColorValue(alphaSum, coeff), Color.A);
				SetPixelCore(target, position, Color.R, Color.G, Color.B, alpha);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ShapeEffectRenderingWalker : IDrawingEffectVisitor
	{
		public static Dictionary<Type, int> EffectPriority = CreatePriorities();

		private readonly DrawingEffectCollection effects;

		private readonly IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo;

		private readonly DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter;

		private readonly DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toLayoutUnitConverter;

		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter;

		private bool blackAndWhitePrintMode;

		private readonly float dpiScale = 1f;

		public bool RenderDirectly { get; set; }

		public void Visit(BlurEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			float num = ConvertRadiusToLayoutUnits(drawingEffect.Radius);
			int blurRadius = GetBlurRadius(num * shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor);
			if (blurRadius == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle sourceBounds = shapeLayoutInfo.GetBlurEffectBounds(null, applyTransform: true, EffectAdditionalSize.Default);
			sourceBounds.Inflate(blurRadius, blurRadius);
			if (sourceBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isCropped = !drawingEffect.Grow;
			Rectangle boundsWithoutTransform = (isCropped ? shapeLayoutInfo.GetBlurEffectBounds(null, applyTransform: false, EffectAdditionalSize.Default) : Rectangle.Empty);
			Func<DXImage> effectRenderer = delegate
			{
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(sourceBounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter);
				using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXBitmap, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale))
				{
					iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-sourceBounds.X, -sourceBounds.Y);
					shapeLayoutInfo.DrawBlurEffect(iDXGraphics);
				}
				dXBitmap = BlurEffectRenderer.ApplyBlur(dXBitmap, ConvertToPixels(blurRadius));
				if (isCropped)
				{
					dXBitmap = GetCroppedBitmap(dXBitmap, sourceBounds, boundsWithoutTransform);
				}
				return dXBitmap;
			};
			BlurPathInfo blurPathInfo = new BlurPathInfo(new GdiPlusPath(), PrepareEffectRenderer(effectRenderer), sourceBounds);
			blurPathInfo.BlurRadiusInLayoutUnits = num;
			blurPathInfo.IsCropped = isCropped;
			blurPathInfo.BoundsWithoutTransform = boundsWithoutTransform;
			blurPathInfo.DpiScale = dpiScale;
			shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Insert(0, blurPathInfo);
		}

		private DXBitmap GetCroppedBitmap(DXBitmap figureBitmap, Rectangle bounds, Rectangle boundsWithoutTransform)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(bounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter, DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp);
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXBitmap, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale))
			{
				iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-bounds.X, -bounds.Y);
				DXMatrix transform = iDXGraphics.Transform;
				DXMatrix shapeTransform = shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform;
				if (shapeTransform != null)
				{
					iDXGraphics.MultiplyTransform(shapeTransform);
				}
				iDXGraphics.SetClip(boundsWithoutTransform);
				iDXGraphics.Transform = transform;
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(figureBitmap.Clone(), bounds.Location.X, bounds.Location.Y);
			}
			figureBitmap.Dispose();
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		private static Dictionary<Type, int> CreatePriorities()
		{
			Dictionary<Type, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<Type, int>();
			dictionary.Add(typeof(InnerShadowEffect), 0);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(PresetShadowEffect), 1);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(SoftEdgeEffect), 2);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(BlurEffect), 3);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(GlowEffect), 4);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(OuterShadowEffect), 5);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(ReflectionEffect), 6);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public ShapeEffectRenderingWalker(DrawingEffectCollection effects, IDocumentModel documentModel, IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
			: this(effects, documentModel, shapeLayoutInfo, blackAndWhitePrintMode: false)
		{
		}

		public ShapeEffectRenderingWalker(DrawingEffectCollection effects, IDocumentModel documentModel, IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode, float dpiScale = 1f)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)effects, "effects");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)shapeLayoutInfo, "shapeLayoutInfo");
			this.effects = effects;
			this.shapeLayoutInfo = shapeLayoutInfo;
			unitConverter = documentModel.UnitConverter;
			toLayoutUnitConverter = documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			layoutUnitConverter = documentModel.LayoutUnitConverter;
			this.blackAndWhitePrintMode = blackAndWhitePrintMode;
			this.dpiScale = dpiScale;
		}

		public ShapeEffectRenderingWalker(ShapePropertiesBase shapeProperties, IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)shapeProperties, "shapeProperties");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)shapeLayoutInfo, "shapeLayoutInfo");
			effects = shapeProperties.EffectStyle.ContainerEffect.Effects;
			this.shapeLayoutInfo = shapeLayoutInfo;
			unitConverter = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			toLayoutUnitConverter = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			layoutUnitConverter = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter;
			blackAndWhitePrintMode = shapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode;
		}

		private Func<DXImage> PrepareEffectRenderer(Func<DXImage> effectRenderer)
		{
			if (RenderDirectly)
			{
				DXImage result = effectRenderer();
				return () => result;
			}
			return effectRenderer;
		}

		public void ApplyEffects()
		{
			List<IDrawingEffect> list = new List<IDrawingEffect>(effects.InnerList);
			list.Sort(new ShapeEffectComparer());
			foreach (IDrawingEffect item in list)
			{
				item.Visit(this);
			}
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath CollectFigure(GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags)
		{
			return shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.CollectFigure(flags);
		}

		private float ConvertRadiusToLayoutUnits(long radius)
		{
			return toLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsL(radius));
		}

		private int GetBlurRadius(long radius)
		{
			float radiusInLayoutUnits = ConvertRadiusToLayoutUnits(radius);
			return GetBlurRadius(radiusInLayoutUnits);
		}

		private int GetBlurRadius(float radiusInLayoutUnits)
		{
			if (!(radiusInLayoutUnits > 0f))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return (int)(Math.Round(radiusInLayoutUnits) / 2.0 + 1.0);
		}

		private int ConvertToPixels(int valueInLayoutUnits)
		{
			return layoutUnitConverter.LayoutUnitsToPixels(valueInLayoutUnits);
		}

		public void Visit(OuterShadowEffect shadow)
		{
			OuterShadowEffectInfo info = shadow.Info;
			Rectangle shapeBounds = shapeLayoutInfo.CalculateShadowTransformBounds(info.RotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize.Empty);
			bool rotateWithShape = shadow.Info.RotateWithShape;
			float scaleFactor = ((!rotateWithShape) ? shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor : 1f);
			OuterShadowTransformationInfo transformInfo = CreateOuterShadowTransformationInfo(shapeBounds, info, scaleFactor);
			DXMatrix shadowTransform = CreateEffectTransformCore(transformInfo);
			DXGraphicsPath preparedForShadowFigure = shapeLayoutInfo.GetPreparedForShadowFigure(shadowTransform, rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize.Default);
			if (preparedForShadowFigure == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle boundsExt = preparedForShadowFigure.GetBoundsExt();
			if (boundsExt.Width == 0 || boundsExt.Height == 0)
			{
				preparedForShadowFigure.Dispose();
				return;
			}
			Color shadowColor = (blackAndWhitePrintMode ? Color.FromArgb(shadow.Color.FinalColor.A, 0, 0, 0) : shadow.Color.FinalColor);
			int blurRadius = (int)Math.Round((float)GetBlurRadius(shadow.Info.BlurRadius) * shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor);
			Rectangle shadowBounds = boundsExt;
			if (blurRadius > 0)
			{
				boundsExt.Inflate(blurRadius, blurRadius);
			}
			Func<DXImage> effectRenderer = delegate
			{
				DXMatrix shadowTransform2 = CreateEffectTransformCore(transformInfo);
				DXImage dXImage = CreateShadowPrint(shadowBounds, shadowTransform2, shadowColor, rotateWithShape);
				if (blurRadius > 0)
				{
					dXImage = AlphaBlurEffectRenderer.ShadowBlur(dXImage, ConvertToPixels(blurRadius), shadowColor, layoutUnitConverter);
				}
				return dXImage;
			};
			Func<HitTestInfoCollection> hitTestInfoProvider = delegate
			{
				DXMatrix dxMatrix = CreateEffectTransformCore(transformInfo);
				return shapeLayoutInfo.CreateShadowHitTestInfos(SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMatrix(dxMatrix), rotateWithShape);
			};
			OuterShadowPathInfo outerShadowPathInfo = new OuterShadowPathInfo(new GdiPlusPath(preparedForShadowFigure), PrepareEffectRenderer(effectRenderer), hitTestInfoProvider, boundsExt);
			outerShadowPathInfo.BlurRadius = blurRadius;
			outerShadowPathInfo.RotateWithShape = rotateWithShape;
			outerShadowPathInfo.Stroke = shapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo != null;
			outerShadowPathInfo.DpiScale = dpiScale;
			shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Insert(0, outerShadowPathInfo);
		}

		private DXBitmap CreateShadowPrint(Rectangle figureBounds, DXMatrix shadowTransform, Color shadowColor, bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = CreatePrintBitmapCore(figureBounds, shadowTransform, rotateWithShape, shapeLayoutInfo.DrawShadow);
			ApplyShadow(dXBitmap, shadowColor);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		private DXBitmap CreatePrintBitmapCore(Rectangle figureBounds, DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, Action<IDXGraphics, bool> drawContent)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(figureBounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXBitmap, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale);
			iDXGraphics.Transform = shadowTransform;
			iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-figureBounds.Left, -figureBounds.Top, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			drawContent(iDXGraphics, !rotateWithShape);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		private void ApplyShift(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.Translate(offsetX, offsetY);
			graphicsPath.Transform(dXMatrix);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void ApplyShadow(DXBitmap shadowBitmap, Color color)
		{
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = shadowBitmap.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite);
			int num = iDXBitmapData.RowBytes * shadowBitmap.Height;
			byte[] values = new byte[num];
			Marshal.Copy(iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, values, 0, num);
			GdipExtensions.IterateBitmapBytes(num, delegate(int i)
			{
				byte b = values[i + 3];
				if (b > 0)
				{
					values[i] = color.B;
					values[i + 1] = color.G;
					values[i + 2] = color.R;
					values[i + 3] = Convert.ToByte((float)(int)color.A / 255f * (float)(int)b);
				}
			});
			Marshal.Copy(values, 0, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, num);
		}

		private DXMatrix CreateEffectTransformCore(OuterShadowTransformationInfo info)
		{
			return new DXMatrix(info.ScaleX, info.SkewY, info.SkewX, info.ScaleY, info.OffsetX, info.OffsetY);
		}

		private OuterShadowTransformationInfo CreateOuterShadowTransformationInfo(Rectangle shapeBounds, OuterShadowEffectInfo shadowInfo, float scaleFactor)
		{
			OuterShadowTransformationCalculator outerShadowTransformationCalculator = new OuterShadowTransformationCalculator(unitConverter, toLayoutUnitConverter, scaleFactor);
			return outerShadowTransformationCalculator.Calculate(shapeBounds, shadowInfo);
		}

		public void Visit(ReflectionEffect reflection)
		{
			OuterShadowEffectInfo outerShadowEffectInfo = reflection.OuterShadowEffectInfo;
			Rectangle shapeBounds = shapeLayoutInfo.CalculateReflectionTransformBounds(outerShadowEffectInfo.RotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize.Empty);
			if (shapeBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool rotateWithShape = outerShadowEffectInfo.RotateWithShape;
			float scaleFactor = ((!rotateWithShape) ? shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor : 1f);
			OuterShadowTransformationInfo transformInfo = CreateOuterShadowTransformationInfo(shapeBounds, outerShadowEffectInfo, scaleFactor);
			DXMatrix shadowTransform = CreateEffectTransformCore(transformInfo);
			DXGraphicsPath preparedForReflectionFigure = shapeLayoutInfo.GetPreparedForReflectionFigure(shadowTransform, rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize.Default);
			if (preparedForReflectionFigure == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle boundsExt = preparedForReflectionFigure.GetBoundsExt();
			if (boundsExt.Width == 0 || boundsExt.Height == 0)
			{
				preparedForReflectionFigure.Dispose();
				return;
			}
			int blurRadius = (int)Math.Round((float)GetBlurRadius(outerShadowEffectInfo.BlurRadius) * shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor);
			Rectangle shadowBounds = boundsExt;
			if (blurRadius > 0)
			{
				boundsExt.Inflate(blurRadius, blurRadius);
			}
			Func<DXImage> effectRenderer = delegate
			{
				DXMatrix shadowTransform2 = CreateEffectTransformCore(transformInfo);
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = CreatePrintBitmapCore(shadowBounds, shadowTransform2, rotateWithShape, shapeLayoutInfo.DrawReflection);
				if (blurRadius > 0)
				{
					dXBitmap = BlurEffectRenderer.ApplyReflectionBlur(dXBitmap, ConvertToPixels(blurRadius), layoutUnitConverter);
				}
				ReflectionRenderer.ProcessReflection(dXBitmap, reflection.ReflectionOpacity, layoutUnitConverter);
				return dXBitmap;
			};
			Func<HitTestInfoCollection> hitTestInfoProvider = delegate
			{
				DXMatrix dxMatrix = CreateEffectTransformCore(transformInfo);
				return shapeLayoutInfo.CreateReflectionHitTestInfos(SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMatrix(dxMatrix), rotateWithShape);
			};
			ReflectionPathInfo reflectionPathInfo = new ReflectionPathInfo(new GdiPlusPath(preparedForReflectionFigure), PrepareEffectRenderer(effectRenderer), hitTestInfoProvider, boundsExt);
			reflectionPathInfo.RotateWithShape = rotateWithShape;
			reflectionPathInfo.Stroke = shapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo != null;
			reflectionPathInfo.DpiScale = dpiScale;
			shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Insert(0, reflectionPathInfo);
		}

		public void Visit(PresetShadowEffect presetShadow)
		{
			IDrawingEffect[] array = PresetShadowGenerator.GenerateShadowEffect(presetShadow);
			IDrawingEffect[] array2 = array;
			foreach (IDrawingEffect drawingEffect in array2)
			{
				drawingEffect.Visit(this);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(GlowEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			Color color = (blackAndWhitePrintMode ? Color.White : drawingEffect.Color.FinalColor);
			float num = ConvertRadiusToLayoutUnits(drawingEffect.Radius);
			int blurRadius = GetBlurRadius(num);
			if (blurRadius == 0 || color.A == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool processSoftEdgesSize = shapeLayoutInfo.GetType() == typeof(ShapeLayoutInfo);
			EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize = new EffectAdditionalSize(blurRadius, processSoftEdgesSize);
			Rectangle sourceBounds = shapeLayoutInfo.GetGlowBounds(additionalSize, null);
			if (sourceBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			sourceBounds.Inflate(blurRadius, blurRadius);
			additionalSize.ProcessGlowSize = false;
			Func<DXImage> effectRenderer = delegate
			{
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(sourceBounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter);
				using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXBitmap, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale))
				{
					iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-sourceBounds.Left, -sourceBounds.Top, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
					shapeLayoutInfo.DrawGlow(iDXGraphics, color, additionalSize, null);
				}
				return AlphaBlurEffectRenderer.GlowBlur(dXBitmap, ConvertToPixels(blurRadius), color);
			};
			GlowPathInfo glowPathInfo = new GlowPathInfo(new GdiPlusPath(), PrepareEffectRenderer(effectRenderer), sourceBounds);
			glowPathInfo.BlurRadiusInLayoutUnits = num;
			glowPathInfo.RotateWithShape = true;
			glowPathInfo.DpiScale = dpiScale;
			shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Insert(0, glowPathInfo);
		}

		public void Visit(SoftEdgeEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo = this.shapeLayoutInfo as ShapeLayoutInfo;
			if (shapeLayoutInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			float radius = ConvertRadiusToLayoutUnits(drawingEffect.Radius);
			if (radius == 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle sourceBounds = shapeLayoutInfo.GetSoftEdgeBounds();
			int num = (int)shapeLayoutInfo.PenWidth;
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.Skia)
			{
				num = (int)((float)num * layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale);
			}
			sourceBounds.Inflate(num, num);
			Func<DXImage> effectRenderer = delegate
			{
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(sourceBounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter);
				using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXBitmap, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale))
				{
					iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-sourceBounds.X, -sourceBounds.Y);
					shapeLayoutInfo.DrawBackgroundBitmap(iDXGraphics, GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeSoftEdges | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeBlur);
				}
				SoftEdgesOpacityMaskCreator softEdgesOpacityMaskCreator = new SoftEdgesOpacityMaskCreator(shapeLayoutInfo);
				DXBitmap dXBitmap2 = softEdgesOpacityMaskCreator.Create(dXBitmap, sourceBounds, radius * shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor, layoutUnitConverter);
				return (dXBitmap2 != null) ? SoftEdgesBlurRenderer.ApplyBlur(dXBitmap, dXBitmap2, ConvertToPixels(GetBlurRadius(radius * shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor))) : ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(sourceBounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter);
			};
			SoftEdgePathInfo softEdgePathInfo = new SoftEdgePathInfo(new GdiPlusPath(), PrepareEffectRenderer(effectRenderer), sourceBounds);
			softEdgePathInfo.BlurRadiusInLayoutUnits = radius;
			softEdgePathInfo.DpiScale = dpiScale;
			shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Insert(0, softEdgePathInfo);
		}

		public void Visit(InnerShadowEffect innerShadow)
		{
			ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo = this.shapeLayoutInfo as ShapeLayoutInfo;
			if (shapeLayoutInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXMatrix shapeTransform = shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform;
			IPlatformPath[] innerShadowPaths = GetInnerShadowPaths(GraphicsPathCollectFlags.FigureWithoutEffects | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInvisiblePaths | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeConnectors);
			IPlatformPath platformPath = innerShadowPaths[0];
			IPlatformPath platformPath2 = innerShadowPaths[1];
			Rectangle sourceBounds = Rectangle.Round(platformPath.GetBoundsExtF(shapeTransform));
			platformPath.Dispose();
			if (sourceBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				platformPath2.Dispose();
				return;
			}
			Func<DXImage> effectRenderer = delegate
			{
				PathInfoBase[] pathInfos = shapeLayoutInfo.GetPathInfos();
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = CreateInnerShadowFigureBitmap(pathInfos, sourceBounds, shapeTransform);
				Color color = (blackAndWhitePrintMode ? Color.FromArgb(innerShadow.Color.FinalColor.A, 0, 0, 0) : innerShadow.Color.FinalColor);
				Color color2 = Color.FromArgb(255, color);
				int num = (int)Math.Round((float)GetBlurRadius(innerShadow.BlurRadius) * shapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor);
				List<IPlatformPath> shadowPaths = PrepareInnerShadowPaths(innerShadow.OffsetShadow, pathInfos, shapeTransform);
				DXBitmap dXBitmap2 = CreateInnerShadowOpacityMask(shadowPaths, sourceBounds, color2, num);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					Size sourceSizeInPixels = new Size(ConvertToPixels(sourceBounds.Width), ConvertToPixels(sourceBounds.Height));
					dXBitmap2 = AlphaBlurEffectRenderer.InnerShadowBlur(dXBitmap2, sourceSizeInPixels, ConvertToPixels(num), color2, layoutUnitConverter);
				}
				InnerShadowRenderer.ApplyShadow(dXBitmap, dXBitmap2, color);
				dXBitmap2.Dispose();
				return dXBitmap;
			};
			InnerShadowPathInfo innerShadowPathInfo = new InnerShadowPathInfo(platformPath2, PrepareEffectRenderer(effectRenderer), sourceBounds);
			innerShadowPathInfo.DpiScale = dpiScale;
			shapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Insert(0, innerShadowPathInfo);
		}

		private IPlatformPath[] GetInnerShadowPaths(GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Path.CreatePath(CrossPlatformFillMode.EvenOdd);
			IPlatformPath platformPath2 = PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Path.CreatePath(CrossPlatformFillMode.EvenOdd);
			PathInfoCollection paths = shapeLayoutInfo.Paths;
			foreach (PathInfoBase item in paths)
			{
				IPlatformPath path = item.Path;
				if (path != null && path.PointCount != 0 && !paths.ShouldSkipPathInfo(item, flags))
				{
					platformPath.AddPath(path, connect: false);
					if (item.Stroke)
					{
						platformPath2.AddPath(path, connect: false);
					}
				}
			}
			return new IPlatformPath[2] { platformPath, platformPath2 };
		}

		private List<IPlatformPath> PrepareInnerShadowPaths(OffsetShadowInfo shadowOffset, PathInfoBase[] pathInfos, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			float num = toLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsL(shadowOffset.Distance));
			double num2 = DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(shadowOffset.Direction));
			float num3 = (float)((double)num * Math.Cos(num2));
			float num4 = (float)((double)num * Math.Sin(num2));
			List<IPlatformPath> list = new List<IPlatformPath>();
			foreach (PathInfoBase pathInfoBase in pathInfos)
			{
				IPlatformPath platformPath = pathInfoBase.Path.Clone();
				platformPath.ClosePath();
				ApplyShift(platformPath, 0f - num3, 0f - num4);
				if (shapeTransform != null)
				{
					platformPath.Transform(shapeTransform);
				}
				list.Add(platformPath);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private DXBitmap CreateInnerShadowFigureBitmap(PathInfoBase[] pathInfos, Rectangle sourceBounds, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(sourceBounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXBitmap, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale);
			iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-sourceBounds.Left, -sourceBounds.Top);
			foreach (PathInfoBase pathInfoBase in pathInfos)
			{
				pathInfoBase.SkipDrawing = true;
				pathInfoBase.Draw(iDXGraphics, null, shapeTransform);
			}
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		private DXBitmap CreateInnerShadowOpacityMask(List<IPlatformPath> shadowPaths, Rectangle sourceBounds, Color shadowColor, int blurRadius)
		{
			sourceBounds.Inflate(blurRadius, blurRadius);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(sourceBounds.Size, layoutUnitConverter);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXBitmap, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale);
			iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-sourceBounds.Left, -sourceBounds.Top, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			iDXGraphics.CompositingMode = DXCompositingMode.SourceCopy;
			iDXGraphics.Clear(shadowColor);
			using DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(Color.Empty);
			foreach (IPlatformPath shadowPath in shadowPaths)
			{
				if (shadowPath is GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath)
				{
					iDXGraphics.FillPath(brush, gdiPlusPath.NativeObject);
				}
				shadowPath.Dispose();
			}
			return dXBitmap;
		}
	}
	public class ShapeEffectComparer : IComparer<IDrawingEffect>
	{
		public int Compare(IDrawingEffect x, IDrawingEffect y)
		{
			return GetOrder(x).CompareTo(GetOrder(y));
		}

		private int GetOrder(IDrawingEffect effect)
		{
			Type type = effect.GetType();
			if (ShapeEffectRenderingWalker.EffectPriority.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				return ShapeEffectRenderingWalker.EffectPriority[type];
			}
			return 255;
		}
	}

	public enum GraphicsPathCollectFlags
	{
		None = 0,
		ExcludeInvisiblePaths = 1,
		ExcludeOuterShadow = 4,
		ExcludeInnerShadow = 8,
		ExcludeGlow = 0x10,
		ExcludeReflection = 0x20,
		ExcludeConnectors = 0x40,
		ExcludeTextRectangle = 0x80,
		ExcludeSoftEdges = 0x100,
		ExcludeBlur = 0x200,
		FigureWithoutEffects = 0x3C
	}
	public struct OuterShadowTransformationInfo
	{
		private float offsetX;

		private float offsetY;

		private float scaleX;

		private float scaleY;

		private float skewX;

		private float skewY;

		public float OffsetX => offsetX;

		public float OffsetY => offsetY;

		public float ScaleX => scaleX;

		public float ScaleY => scaleY;

		public float SkewX => skewX;

		public float SkewY => skewY;

		public OuterShadowTransformationInfo(float offsetX, float offsetY, float scaleX, float scaleY, float skewX, float skewY)
		{
			this.offsetX = offsetX;
			this.offsetY = offsetY;
			this.scaleX = scaleX;
			this.scaleY = scaleY;
			this.skewX = skewX;
			this.skewY = skewY;
		}
	}
	public class OuterShadowTransformationCalculator
	{
		private readonly DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter;

		private readonly DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toLayoutUnitConverter;

		private readonly float scaleFactor;

		public OuterShadowTransformationCalculator(DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter, DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toLayoutUnitConverter)
			: this(unitConverter, toLayoutUnitConverter, 1f)
		{
		}

		public OuterShadowTransformationCalculator(DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter, DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toLayoutUnitConverter, float scaleFactor)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)toLayoutUnitConverter, "toLayoutUnitConverter");
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
			this.toLayoutUnitConverter = toLayoutUnitConverter;
			this.scaleFactor = scaleFactor;
		}

		public OuterShadowTransformationInfo Calculate(Rectangle shapeBounds, OuterShadowEffectInfo shadowInfo)
		{
			OffsetShadowInfo offsetShadow = shadowInfo.OffsetShadow;
			float num = toLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsL(offsetShadow.Distance)) * scaleFactor;
			double num2 = DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(offsetShadow.Direction));
			float num3 = (float)((double)num * Math.Cos(num2));
			float num4 = (float)((double)num * Math.Sin(num2));
			ScalingFactorInfo scalingFactor = shadowInfo.ScalingFactor;
			float num5 = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(scalingFactor.Horizontal);
			float num6 = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(scalingFactor.Vertical);
			num3 += (float)shapeBounds.X - (float)shapeBounds.X * num5;
			num4 += (float)shapeBounds.Y - (float)shapeBounds.Y * num6;
			SkewAnglesInfo skewAngles = shadowInfo.SkewAngles;
			float num7 = (float)Math.Tan(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(skewAngles.Horizontal)));
			float skewOffsetX = (float)shapeBounds.Height * num7;
			float num8 = (float)Math.Tan(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(skewAngles.Vertical)));
			float skewOffsetY = (float)shapeBounds.Width * num8;
			if (num7 != 0f)
			{
				num3 -= num7 * (float)shapeBounds.Bottom - num7 * (float)shapeBounds.Height;
			}
			if (num8 != 0f)
			{
				num4 -= num8 * (float)shapeBounds.Right - num8 * (float)shapeBounds.Width;
			}
			float scaledWidth = (float)shapeBounds.Width * num5;
			float scaledHeight = (float)shapeBounds.Height * num6;
			PointF pointF = CalculateAlignmentOffset(shadowInfo.ShadowAlignment, shapeBounds.Width, shapeBounds.Height, scaledWidth, scaledHeight, skewOffsetX, skewOffsetY);
			num3 += pointF.X;
			num4 += pointF.Y;
			return new OuterShadowTransformationInfo(num3, num4, num5, num6, num7, num8);
		}

		private PointF CalculateAlignmentOffset(RectangleAlignType alignment, float shapeWidth, float shapeHeight, float scaledWidth, float scaledHeight, float skewOffsetX, float skewOffsetY)
		{
			PointF result = default(PointF);
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case RectangleAlignType.Top:
				result.X += CalculateCenterOffset(shapeWidth, scaledWidth);
				result.Y -= skewOffsetY / 2f;
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.TopRight:
				result.X += CalculateFarOffset(shapeWidth, scaledWidth);
				result.Y -= skewOffsetY;
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.Left:
				result.X -= skewOffsetX / 2f;
				result.Y += CalculateCenterOffset(shapeHeight, scaledHeight);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.Center:
				result.X += CalculateCenterOffset(shapeWidth, scaledWidth) - skewOffsetX / 2f;
				result.Y += CalculateCenterOffset(shapeHeight, scaledHeight) - skewOffsetY / 2f;
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.Right:
				result.X += CalculateFarOffset(shapeWidth, scaledWidth) - skewOffsetX / 2f;
				result.Y += CalculateCenterOffset(shapeHeight, scaledHeight) - skewOffsetY;
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.BottomLeft:
				result.X -= skewOffsetX;
				result.Y += CalculateFarOffset(shapeHeight, scaledHeight);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.Bottom:
				result.X += CalculateCenterOffset(shapeWidth, scaledWidth) - skewOffsetX;
				result.Y += CalculateFarOffset(shapeHeight, scaledHeight) - skewOffsetY / 2f;
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.BottomRight:
				result.X += CalculateFarOffset(shapeWidth, scaledWidth) - skewOffsetX;
				result.Y += CalculateFarOffset(shapeHeight, scaledHeight) - skewOffsetY;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private float CalculateFarOffset(float figureSize, float shadowSize)
		{
			return figureSize - shadowSize;
		}

		private float CalculateCenterOffset(float figureSize, float shadowSize)
		{
			return figureSize / 2f - shadowSize / 2f;
		}
	}

		public ShapeFillRenderVisitor(ShapePreset shapeType, Color styleColor, DXBrush defaultBrush, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			this.shapeType = shapeType;
			this.styleColor = styleColor;
