		public void Visit(DrawingFill fill)
		{
			Result = ((fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.None || DefaultBrush == null) ? null : DefaultBrush.Clone());
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingSolidFill fill)
		{
			Color colorFromStyle = GetColorFromStyle(fill.Color);
			Result = new DXSolidBrush(colorFromStyle);
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingPatternFill fill)
		{
			DXHatchStyle hatchStyle = (DXHatchStyle)HatchStyleTable[fill.PatternType];
			DXHatchBrush result = new DXHatchBrush(hatchStyle, GetColorFromStyle(fill.ForegroundColor), GetColorFromStyle(fill.BackgroundColor));
			Result = result;
		}

		private Rectangle GetRectOffset(Rectangle original, RectangleOffset offset)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Round((double)original.Left + (double)original.Width * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(offset.LeftOffset));
			int num2 = (int)Math.Round((double)original.Top + (double)original.Height * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(offset.TopOffset));
			int num3 = (int)Math.Round((double)original.Right - (double)original.Width * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(offset.RightOffset));
			int num4 = (int)Math.Round((double)original.Bottom - (double)original.Height * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(offset.BottomOffset));
			return new Rectangle(num, num2, Math.Max(0, num3 - num), Math.Max(0, num4 - num2));
		}

		private DXColorBlend InverseDXBlend(DXColorBlend value)
		{
			int num = value.Colors.Length;
			DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = new DXColorBlend(num);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				dXColorBlend.Colors[i] = value.Colors[num - 1 - i];
				dXColorBlend.Positions[i] = 1f - value.Positions[num - 1 - i];
			}
			return dXColorBlend;
		}

		private Color GetColorFromStyle(DrawingColor drawingColor)
		{
			if (StyleColorEmpty)
			{
				return drawingColor.FinalColor;
			}
			DrawingColor drawingColor2 = DrawingColor.Create(FakeDocumentModel.Instance, styleColor);
			drawingColor2.CopyFrom(drawingColor);
			drawingColor2.Info.SchemeColor = SchemeColorValues.Style;
			return drawingColor2.ToRgb(styleColor);
		}

		private static List<DrawingGradientStop> PrepareGradientStops(DrawingGradientFill fill)
		{
			List<DrawingGradientStop> list = new List<DrawingGradientStop>();
			foreach (DrawingGradientStop gradientStop in fill.GradientStops)
			{
				list.Add(gradientStop);
			}
			list.Sort(new DrawingGradientStopComparer());
			return list;
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingGradientFill fill)
		{
			int count = fill.GradientStops.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<DrawingGradientStop> list = PrepareGradientStops(fill);
			bool flag = list[0].Position > 0;
			bool flag2 = list[count - 1].Position < 100000;
			int num = count;
			if (flag)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				num++;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = new DXColorBlend(num);
			if (flag)
			{
				dXColorBlend.Colors[num2] = GetColorFromStyle(list[0].Color);
				dXColorBlend.Positions[num2] = 0f;
				num2++;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				dXColorBlend.Colors[num2] = GetColorFromStyle(list[i].Color);
				dXColorBlend.Positions[num2] = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(list[i].Position);
				num2++;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				dXColorBlend.Colors[num2] = GetColorFromStyle(list[count - 1].Color);
				dXColorBlend.Positions[num2] = 1f;
			}
			HasPermanentFill = !fill.RotateWithShape;
			IPlatformPath platformPath = PlatformPathExtensions.BuildFigure(graphicsPaths, OutlineFill);
			if (platformPath == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = platformPath as GdiPlusPath;
			if (FigureTransform != null && gdiPlusPath != null)
			{
				FigureTransform(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject);
			}
			Rectangle original = Rectangle.Round(platformPath.GetBoundsExtF(HasPermanentFill ? ShapeTransform : null));
			Rectangle rectOffset = GetRectOffset(original, GetTileRect(fill));
			if (rectOffset.Width == 0 || rectOffset.Height == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectOffset2 = GetRectOffset(original, fill.FillRect);
			Point point = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(rectOffset2);
			switch (CorrectShapeGradientType(fill.GradientType, shapeType, OutlineFill))
			{
			case GradientType.Linear:
				SetupLinearGradientBrush(fill, rectOffset, dXColorBlend);
				break;
			case GradientType.Rectangle:
				SetupRectangularGradientBrush(rectOffset, dXColorBlend, point);
				break;
			case GradientType.Circle:
				SetupRadialGradientBrush(rectOffset, dXColorBlend, point);
				break;
			case GradientType.Shape:
				if (gdiPlusPath != null)
				{
					SetupShapeGradientBrush(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject, dXColorBlend, point);
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			platformPath.Dispose();
		}

		public static GradientType CorrectShapeGradientType(GradientType gradientType, ShapePreset shapeType, bool outlineFill)
		{
			if (gradientType == GradientType.Shape)
			{
				if (outlineFill || UseCircleGradient(shapeType))
				{
					return GradientType.Circle;
				}
				if (UseRectangularGradient(shapeType))
				{
					return GradientType.Rectangle;
				}
			}
			return gradientType;
		}

		protected virtual RectangleOffset GetTileRect(DrawingGradientFill fill)
		{
			return fill.TileRect;
		}

		private void SetupLinearGradientBrush(DrawingGradientFill fill, Rectangle bounds, DXColorBlend colorBlend)
		{
			float num = fill.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToDegreeF(fill.Angle);
			num %= 360f;
			if (fill.Scaled)
			{
				num = ScaleAngle(num, bounds);
			}
			PointF[] array = CalculateGradientPoints(bounds, num);
			PointF pointF = array[0];
			PointF pointF2 = array[1];
			if (CheckSmallestAreaForGdiPlus(pointF, pointF2))
			{
				Color[] colors = colorBlend.Colors;
				int num2 = colors.Length;
				Color color = ((num >= 180f) ? colors[0] : colors[num2 - 1]);
				Color color2 = ((num >= 180f) ? colors[num2 - 1] : colors[0]);
				DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush = new DXLinearGradientBrush(pointF, pointF2, color, color2);
				dXLinearGradientBrush.WrapMode = DXWrapMode.TileFlipXY;
				if (num2 == 2)
				{
					dXLinearGradientBrush.SetSigmaBellShape((num >= 180f) ? 1 : 0);
					dXLinearGradientBrush.GammaCorrection = true;
				}
				else
				{
					dXLinearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = ((num >= 180f) ? InverseDXBlend(colorBlend) : colorBlend);
				}
				TransformLinearGradientBrush(dXLinearGradientBrush);
				Result = dXLinearGradientBrush;
			}
		}

		private bool CheckSmallestAreaForGdiPlus(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			float num = Math.Abs(p2.X - p1.X);
			float num2 = Math.Abs(p2.Y - p1.Y);
			if (num == 0f && num2 == 0f)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num == 0f || num2 == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return num * num2 >= 1.1920929E-07f;
		}

		protected virtual void TransformLinearGradientBrush(DXLinearGradientBrush brush)
		{
		}

		internal static PointF[] CalculateGradientPoints(Rectangle bounds, double gradientAngle)
		{
			PointF pointF = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(bounds);
			double num = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(bounds.Width, 2.0) / 4.0 + Math.Pow(bounds.Height, 2.0) / 4.0);
			double num2 = DrawingValueConverter.RadianToDegree(Math.Atan2(bounds.Height, bounds.Width));
			bool flag = gradientAngle % 180.0 <= 90.0;
			double degree = (flag ? (gradientAngle + 90.0 - num2) : (gradientAngle - 90.0 + num2));
			double num3 = num * Math.Sin(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(degree));
			degree = (flag ? gradientAngle : (180.0 - gradientAngle));
			double num4 = num3 * Math.Cos(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(degree));
			double num5 = num3 * Math.Sin(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(degree));
			double num6 = (double)pointF.X + (flag ? (0.0 - num4) : num4);
			double num7 = (double)pointF.Y - num5;
			double num8 = (double)pointF.X + (flag ? num4 : (0.0 - num4));
			double num9 = (double)pointF.Y + num5;
			return new PointF[2]
			{
				new PointF((float)num6, (float)num7),
				new PointF((float)num8, (float)num9)
			};
		}

		private static float ScaleAngle(float angle, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (angle < 0f)
			{
				angle += 90f;
				num--;
			}
			while (angle > 90f)
			{
				angle -= 90f;
				num++;
			}
			int num2 = Math.Min(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				return angle;
			}
			double num3 = (double)num2 / (double)bounds.Width;
			double num4 = (double)num2 / (double)bounds.Height;
			double num5 = Math.Tan(DrawingValueConverter.DegreeToRadian(angle));
			num5 *= ((num % 2 == 0) ? (num4 / num3) : (num3 / num4));
			double num6 = DrawingValueConverter.RadianToDegree(Math.Atan(num5));
			num6 += (double)(num * 90);
			num6 %= 360.0;
			return (float)num6;
		}

		private void SetupRectangularGradientBrush(RectangleF bounds, DXColorBlend colorBlend, PointF centerPoint)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateRectangularGradientPath(bounds, ref centerPoint);
			DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush = new DXPathGradientBrush(dXGraphicsPath.GetPathData());
			dXPathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = InverseDXBlend(colorBlend);
			dXPathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = centerPoint;
			Result = dXPathGradientBrush;
		}

		protected virtual DXGraphicsPath CreateRectangularGradientPath(RectangleF bounds, ref PointF centerPoint)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddRectangle(bounds);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private void SetupRadialGradientBrush(RectangleF bounds, DXColorBlend colorBlend, PointF centerPoint)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateRadialGradientPath(bounds, ref centerPoint);
			DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush = new DXPathGradientBrush(dXGraphicsPath.GetPathData());
			dXPathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = centerPoint;
			dXPathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = InverseDXBlend(colorBlend);
			Result = dXPathGradientBrush;
		}

		protected virtual DXGraphicsPath CreateRadialGradientPath(RectangleF bounds, ref PointF centerPoint)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			PointF pointF = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(bounds);
			int num = (int)Math.Round(Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(bounds.Width, 2.0) + Math.Pow(bounds.Height, 2.0)) / 2.0);
			RectangleF rect = new RectangleF(pointF.X - (float)num, pointF.Y - (float)num, num * 2, num * 2);
			dXGraphicsPath.AddEllipse(rect);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private void SetupShapeGradientBrush(DXGraphicsPath figure, DXColorBlend colorBlend, PointF centerPoint)
		{
			if (HasPermanentFill)
			{
				if (ShapeTransform != null)
				{
					figure.Transform(ShapeTransform);
				}
				RectangleF bounds = figure.GetBounds();
				centerPoint = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(bounds);
			}
			DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush = new DXPathGradientBrush(figure.GetPathData());
			dXPathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = centerPoint;
			dXPathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = InverseDXBlend(colorBlend);
			Result = dXPathGradientBrush;
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingBlipFill fill)
		{
			if (fill.Blip != null && fill.Blip.Image != null)
			{
				HasPermanentFill = !fill.RotateWithShape;
				DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush = (DXImageHelper.IsEmfMetafile(fill.Blip.Image.DXImage) ? BlipFillFromDXMetafile(fill) : DXBlipFillFromBitmap(fill));
				ApplyTransformForTextureBrush(dXTextureBrush);
				Result = dXTextureBrush;
			}
		}

		private PrepareBlipFillParams PrepareBlipFillFromBitmap(DrawingBlipFill fill)
		{
			RectangleF boundsExtF;
			using (IPlatformPath path = PlatformPathExtensions.BuildFigure(graphicsPaths, addNotClosedPaths: false))
			{
				boundsExtF = path.GetBoundsExtF(HasPermanentFill ? ShapeTransform : null);
			}
			Image image = fill.Blip.Image.NativeImage;
			DXImage dxImage = fill.Blip.Image.DXImage;
			bool isCropped = !fill.SourceRectangle.Equals(RectangleOffset.Empty);
			Func<RectangleF> func = () => (image == null) ? dxImage.GetImageBounds() : image.GetImageBounds();
			RectangleF imageBounds = func();
			int num = (int)Math.Round(imageBounds.Width);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Round(imageBounds.Height);
			return new PrepareBlipFillParams
			{
				imageWidth = num,
				imageHeight = num2,
				isCropped = isCropped,
				image = image,
				dxImage = dxImage,
				imageBounds = imageBounds,
				textureBounds = boundsExtF
			};
		}

		private StretchParams PrepareParamsForStretch(DrawingBlipFill fill, RectangleF textureBounds)
		{
			float width = textureBounds.Width;
			float height = textureBounds.Height;
			RectangleOffset fillRectangle = fill.FillRectangle;
			float num = (float)((double)width * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle.LeftOffset));
			float num2 = (float)((double)height * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle.TopOffset));
			float num3 = (float)((double)width * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle.RightOffset));
			float num4 = (float)((double)height * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle.BottomOffset));
			float stretchedWidth = width - num - num3;
			float stretchedHeight = height - num2 - num4;
			return new StretchParams
			{
				leftOffset = num,
				topOffset = num2,
				stretchedWidth = stretchedWidth,
				stretchedHeight = stretchedHeight
			};
		}

		private DXTextureBrush DXBlipFillFromBitmap(DrawingBlipFill fill)
		{
			DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter = fill.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter;
			PrepareBlipFillParams prepareBlipFillParams = PrepareBlipFillFromBitmap(fill);
			if (prepareBlipFillParams.imageWidth == 0f || prepareBlipFillParams.imageHeight == 0f)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (prepareBlipFillParams.isCropped)
			{
				prepareBlipFillParams.dxImage = CropImage(prepareBlipFillParams.dxImage, prepareBlipFillParams.imageBounds, fill.SourceRectangle, layoutUnitConverter);
			}
			else if (fill.BlackAndWhitePrintMode)
			{
				prepareBlipFillParams.dxImage = prepareBlipFillParams.dxImage.Clone();
			}
			float horizontalResolution = CorrectResolution(prepareBlipFillParams.dxImage.HorizontalResolution);
			float verticalResolution = CorrectResolution(prepareBlipFillParams.dxImage.VerticalResolution);
			DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush;
			try
			{
				dXTextureBrush = new DXTextureBrush(prepareBlipFillParams.dxImage, DXWrapMode.Tile, CreateDXImageAttributes(fill));
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXMatrix transform = dXTextureBrush.Transform;
			transform.Translate(prepareBlipFillParams.textureBounds.X, prepareBlipFillParams.textureBounds.Y);
			float num = layoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnitsF(prepareBlipFillParams.imageWidth) * layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpiX / layoutUnitConverter.Dpi;
			float num2 = layoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnitsF(prepareBlipFillParams.imageHeight) * layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpiY / layoutUnitConverter.Dpi;
			if (fill.Stretch)
			{
				StretchParams stretchParams = PrepareParamsForStretch(fill, prepareBlipFillParams.textureBounds);
				dXTextureBrush.WrapMode = DXWrapMode.Clamp;
				transform.Translate(stretchParams.leftOffset, stretchParams.topOffset);
				transform.Scale(stretchParams.stretchedWidth / num, stretchParams.stretchedHeight / num2);
				dXTextureBrush.Transform = transform;
			}
			else
			{
				SetupTileDXTexture(fill, dXTextureBrush, horizontalResolution, verticalResolution, num, num2, prepareBlipFillParams.textureBounds);
			}
			return dXTextureBrush;
		}

		private DXTextureBrush BlipFillFromDXMetafile(DrawingBlipFill fill)
		{
			Rectangle boundsExt;
			using (IPlatformPath path = PlatformPathExtensions.BuildFigure(graphicsPaths, addNotClosedPaths: false))
			{
				if (HasPermanentFill)
				{
					boundsExt = path.GetBoundsExt(ShapeTransform);
				}
				else
				{
					DXMatrix transform = new DXMatrix(ScaleFactor, 0f, 0f, ScaleFactor, 0f, 0f);
					boundsExt = path.GetBoundsExt(transform);
				}
			}
			IDocumentModel documentModel = fill.DocumentModel;
			DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter = documentModel.LayoutUnitConverter;
			DXImage dXImage = fill.Blip.Image.DXImage;
			bool flag = !fill.SourceRectangle.Equals(RectangleOffset.Empty);
			int width = boundsExt.Width;
			int height = boundsExt.Height;
			RectangleF imageBounds;
			if (fill.Stretch)
			{
				RectangleOffset fillRectangle = fill.FillRectangle;
				float num = (float)((double)width * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle.LeftOffset));
				float num2 = (float)((double)height * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle.TopOffset));
				float num3 = (float)((double)width * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle.RightOffset));
				float num4 = (float)((double)height * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle.BottomOffset));
				float width2 = (float)width - num - num3;
				float height2 = (float)height - num2 - num4;
				imageBounds = new RectangleF(0f, 0f, width2, height2);
			}
			else
			{
				imageBounds = dXImage.GetImageBounds();
				imageBounds.Width *= layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpiX / CorrectResolution(dXImage.HorizontalResolution);
				imageBounds.Height *= layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpiY / CorrectResolution(dXImage.VerticalResolution);
			}
			int num5 = (int)Math.Round(imageBounds.Width);
			int num6 = (int)Math.Round(imageBounds.Height);
			if (num5 == 0 || num6 == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXImageAttributes imageAttributes = CreateDXImageAttributes(fill);
			float horizontalResolution;
			float verticalResolution;
			DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush;
			using (DXImage dXImage2 = (flag ? CropImage(dXImage, imageBounds, fill.SourceRectangle, layoutUnitConverter) : ScaleImage(dXImage, imageBounds, layoutUnitConverter)))
			{
				horizontalResolution = CorrectResolution(dXImage2.HorizontalResolution);
				verticalResolution = CorrectResolution(dXImage2.VerticalResolution);
				dXTextureBrush = new DXTextureBrush(dXImage2, DXWrapMode.Tile, imageAttributes);
			}
			dXTextureBrush.Transform.Translate(boundsExt.X, boundsExt.Y);
			float imageWidthInLayouts = layoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnitsF(num5) * layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpiX / layoutUnitConverter.Dpi;
			float imageHeightInLayouts = layoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnitsF(num6) * layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpiY / layoutUnitConverter.Dpi;
			if (fill.Stretch)
			{
				RectangleOffset fillRectangle2 = fill.FillRectangle;
				float offsetX = (float)((double)width * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle2.LeftOffset));
				float offsetY = (float)((double)height * DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fillRectangle2.TopOffset));
				dXTextureBrush.WrapMode = DXWrapMode.Clamp;
				dXTextureBrush.Transform.Translate(offsetX, offsetY);
			}
			else
			{
				SetupTileDXTexture(fill, dXTextureBrush, horizontalResolution, verticalResolution, imageWidthInLayouts, imageHeightInLayouts, boundsExt);
			}
			if (fill.RotateWithShape && ScaleFactor != 1f)
			{
				dXTextureBrush.Transform.Scale(1f / ScaleFactor, 1f / ScaleFactor, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			}
			return dXTextureBrush;
		}

		private float CorrectResolution(float resolution)
		{
			if (resolution != 0f)
			{
				return resolution;
			}
			return 96f;
		}

		private void SetupTileTexture(DrawingBlipFill fill, TextureBrush textureBrush, float horizontalResolution, float verticalResolution, float imageWidthInLayouts, float imageHeightInLayouts, RectangleF textureBounds)
		{
			SetupWrapMode(textureBrush, fill.TileFlip);
			SetupTileTextureParams setupTileTextureParams = CalculateTileTextureParams(fill, horizontalResolution, verticalResolution, imageWidthInLayouts, imageHeightInLayouts, textureBounds);
			textureBrush.TranslateTransform(setupTileTextureParams.offsetX, setupTileTextureParams.offsetY);
			textureBrush.ScaleTransform(setupTileTextureParams.scaleX, setupTileTextureParams.scaleY);
		}

		private void SetupTileDXTexture(DrawingBlipFill fill, DXTextureBrush textureBrush, float horizontalResolution, float verticalResolution, float imageWidthInLayouts, float imageHeightInLayouts, RectangleF textureBounds)
		{
			SetupWrapMode(textureBrush, fill.TileFlip);
			SetupTileTextureParams setupTileTextureParams = CalculateTileTextureParams(fill, horizontalResolution, verticalResolution, imageWidthInLayouts, imageHeightInLayouts, textureBounds);
			DXMatrix transform = textureBrush.Transform;
			transform.Translate(setupTileTextureParams.offsetX, setupTileTextureParams.offsetY);
			transform.Scale(setupTileTextureParams.scaleX, setupTileTextureParams.scaleY);
			textureBrush.Transform = transform;
		}

		private SetupTileTextureParams CalculateTileTextureParams(DrawingBlipFill fill, float horizontalResolution, float verticalResolution, float imageWidthInLayouts, float imageHeightInLayouts, RectangleF textureBounds)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = fill.DocumentModel;
			DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter = documentModel.LayoutUnitConverter;
			float width = textureBounds.Width;
			float height = textureBounds.Height;
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			float num = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(fill.OffsetX);
			float num2 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(fill.OffsetY);
			float num3 = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fill.ScaleX) * layoutUnitConverter.Dpi / horizontalResolution * ScaleFactor;
			float num4 = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(fill.ScaleY) * layoutUnitConverter.Dpi / verticalResolution * ScaleFactor;
			float imageSize = imageWidthInLayouts * num3;
			float imageSize2 = imageHeightInLayouts * num4;
			switch (fill.TileAlign)
			{
			case RectangleAlignType.Top:
				num += CalculateCenterOffset(width, imageSize);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.TopRight:
				num += CalculateFarOffset(width, imageSize);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.Left:
				num2 += CalculateCenterOffset(height, imageSize2);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.Center:
				num += CalculateCenterOffset(width, imageSize);
				num2 += CalculateCenterOffset(height, imageSize2);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.Right:
				num += CalculateFarOffset(width, imageSize);
				num2 += CalculateCenterOffset(height, imageSize2);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.BottomLeft:
				num2 += CalculateFarOffset(height, imageSize2);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.Bottom:
				num += CalculateCenterOffset(width, imageSize);
				num2 += CalculateFarOffset(height, imageSize2);
				break;
			case RectangleAlignType.BottomRight:
				num += CalculateFarOffset(width, imageSize);
				num2 += CalculateFarOffset(height, imageSize2);
				break;
			}
			return new SetupTileTextureParams
			{
				offsetX = num,
				offsetY = num2,
				scaleX = num3,
				scaleY = num4
			};
		}

		private ImageAttributes CreateImageAttributes(DrawingBlipFill blipFill)
		{
			if (blipFill.BlackAndWhitePrintMode)
			{
				ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
				ColorMatrix grayscaleColorMatrix = GetGrayscaleColorMatrix();
				imageAttributes.SetColorMatrix(grayscaleColorMatrix, ColorMatrixFlag.Default, ColorAdjustType.Bitmap);
				return imageAttributes;
			}
			DrawingBlip blip = blipFill.Blip;
			DrawingBlipEffectWalker drawingBlipEffectWalker = new DrawingBlipEffectWalker();
			drawingBlipEffectWalker.Walk(blip.Effects);
			if (!drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMatrix && !drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMap)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ImageAttributes imageAttributes2 = new ImageAttributes();
			if (drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMatrix)
			{
				ColorMatrix newColorMatrix = new ColorMatrix(drawingBlipEffectWalker.ColorMatrixElements);
				imageAttributes2.SetColorMatrix(newColorMatrix, ColorMatrixFlag.Default, ColorAdjustType.Bitmap);
			}
			if (drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMap)
			{
				imageAttributes2.SetRemapTable(drawingBlipEffectWalker.GetColorMap());
			}
			return imageAttributes2;
		}

		private DXImageAttributes CreateDXImageAttributes(DrawingBlipFill blipFill)
		{
			if (blipFill.BlackAndWhitePrintMode)
			{
				DXImageAttributes dXImageAttributes = new DXImageAttributes();
				dXImageAttributes.ColorMatrix = DXColorMatrix.CreateGrayscaleColorMatrix();
				return dXImageAttributes;
			}
			DrawingBlip blip = blipFill.Blip;
			DrawingBlipEffectWalker drawingBlipEffectWalker = new DrawingBlipEffectWalker();
			drawingBlipEffectWalker.Walk(blip.Effects);
			if (!drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMatrix && !drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMap)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXImageAttributes dXImageAttributes2 = new DXImageAttributes();
			if (drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMatrix)
			{
				dXImageAttributes2.ColorMatrix = new DXColorMatrix(drawingBlipEffectWalker.ColorMatrixElements);
			}
			if (drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMap)
			{
				dXImageAttributes2.RemapTable = drawingBlipEffectWalker.GetDXColorMap();
			}
			return dXImageAttributes2;
		}

		public static ColorMatrix GetGrayscaleColorMatrix()
		{
			return new ColorMatrix(colorMatrix);
		}

		public static DXColorMatrix GetGrayscaleDXColorMatrix()
		{
			return new DXColorMatrix(colorMatrix);
		}

		{
		}

		{
		}

		private void SetupWrapMode(TextureBrush brush, TileFlipType flipType)
		{
			switch (flipType)
			{
			case TileFlipType.Horizontal:
				brush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipX;
				break;
			case TileFlipType.Vertical:
				brush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipY;
				break;
			case TileFlipType.Both:
				brush.WrapMode = WrapMode.TileFlipXY;
				break;
			default:
				brush.WrapMode = WrapMode.Tile;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetupWrapMode(DXTextureBrush brush, TileFlipType flipType)
		{
			switch (flipType)
			{
			case TileFlipType.Horizontal:
				brush.WrapMode = DXWrapMode.TileFlipX;
				break;
			case TileFlipType.Vertical:
				brush.WrapMode = DXWrapMode.TileFlipY;
				break;
			case TileFlipType.Both:
				brush.WrapMode = DXWrapMode.TileFlipXY;
				break;
			default:
				brush.WrapMode = DXWrapMode.Tile;
				break;
			}
		}

		private float CalculateFarOffset(float areaSize, float imageSize)
		{
			return areaSize - imageSize;
		}

		private float CalculateCenterOffset(float areaSize, float imageSize)
		{
			return areaSize / 2f - imageSize / 2f;
		}

		private DXImage CropImage(DXImage image, RectangleF imageBounds, RectangleOffset sourceRectangle, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			int width = (int)Math.Round(imageBounds.Width);
			int height = (int)Math.Round(imageBounds.Height);
			RectangleF rect = ShapeFillAttributeCalculator.CalculatePictureClipBounds(sourceRectangle, imageBounds);
			DXImage dXImage = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmapCore(new Size(width, height), layoutUnitConverter);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXImage);
			iDXGraphics.CompositingQuality = DXCompositingQuality.AssumeLinear;
			iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, rect);
			return dXImage;
		}

		private DXImage ScaleImage(DXImage image, RectangleF imageBounds, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			int width = (int)Math.Round(imageBounds.Width);
			int height = (int)Math.Round(imageBounds.Height);
			DXImage dXImage = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmapCore(new Size(width, height), layoutUnitConverter);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXImage);
			iDXGraphics.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
			iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, new Rectangle(0, 0, width, height));
			return dXImage;
		}
	}
	public class GroupShapeFillRenderVisitor : ShapeFillRenderVisitor
	{
		public GroupShapeFillRenderVisitor(ShapePreset shapeType, Color styleColor, DXBrush defaultBrush, List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
			: base(shapeType, styleColor, defaultBrush, graphicsPaths, shapeTransform)
		{
		}

		protected override void TransformLinearGradientBrush(DXLinearGradientBrush brush)
		{
			if (!base.HasPermanentFill && base.ShapeTransform != null)
			{
				brush.Transform.Multiply(base.ShapeTransform, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			}
		}

		protected override DXGraphicsPath CreateRadialGradientPath(RectangleF bounds, ref PointF centerPoint)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath result = base.CreateRadialGradientPath(bounds, ref centerPoint);
			ApplyGroupTransform(result, ref centerPoint);
			return result;
		}

		protected override DXGraphicsPath CreateRectangularGradientPath(RectangleF bounds, ref PointF centerPoint)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath result = base.CreateRectangularGradientPath(bounds, ref centerPoint);
			ApplyGroupTransform(result, ref centerPoint);
			return result;
		}

		protected override void ApplyTransformForTextureBrush(TextureBrush brush)
		{
			if (!base.HasPermanentFill && base.ShapeTransform != null)
			{
				brush.MultiplyTransform(SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMatrix(base.ShapeTransform), MatrixOrder.Append);
				if (brush.WrapMode != WrapMode.Clamp)
				{
					brush.ScaleTransform(1f / base.ScaleFactor, 1f / base.ScaleFactor);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ApplyTransformForTextureBrush(DXTextureBrush brush)
		{
			if (!base.HasPermanentFill && base.ShapeTransform != null)
			{
				brush.ApplyTransform(base.ShapeTransform, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
				if (brush.WrapMode != DXWrapMode.Clamp)
				{
					brush.Transform.Scale(1f / base.ScaleFactor, 1f / base.ScaleFactor);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ApplyGroupTransform(DXGraphicsPath result, ref PointF centerPoint)
		{
			if (!base.HasPermanentFill && base.ShapeTransform != null)
			{
				result.Transform(base.ShapeTransform);
				centerPoint = base.ShapeTransform.TransformPoint(centerPoint);
			}
		}

		protected override RectangleOffset GetTileRect(DrawingGradientFill fill)
		{
			return RectangleOffset.Empty;
		}
	}
	public class LazyGroupBrush : IDisposable
	{
		public delegate DXBrush Initializer();

		private readonly Initializer initializer;

		private DXBrush brush;

		public bool HasValue => brush != null;

		public DXBrush Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (brush == null)
				{
					brush = ((initializer != null) ? initializer() : null);
				}
				return brush;
			}
		}

		public LazyGroupBrush(Initializer initializer)
		{
			this.initializer = initializer;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (brush != null)
			{
				brush.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public static class ShapeFillAttributeCalculator
	{
		public static float CalculateBlipAlphaValue(DrawingBlip blip)
		{
			foreach (IDrawingEffect effect in blip.Effects)
			{
				if (effect is AlphaModulateFixedEffect alphaModulateFixedEffect)
				{
					return (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(alphaModulateFixedEffect.Amount);
				}
			}
			return 1f;
		}

		public static RectangleF CalculatePictureSourceBounds(RectangleOffset sourceRectangle, int imageWidth, int imageHeight)
		{
			float num = (float)imageWidth * (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(sourceRectangle.LeftOffset);
			float num2 = (float)imageHeight * (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(sourceRectangle.TopOffset);
			float num3 = (float)imageWidth * (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(sourceRectangle.RightOffset);
			float num4 = (float)imageHeight * (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(sourceRectangle.BottomOffset);
			return new RectangleF(num, num2, (float)imageWidth - num - num3, (float)imageHeight - num2 - num4);
		}

		public static RectangleF CalculatePictureClipBounds(RectangleOffset sourceRectangle, RectangleF sourceBounds)
		{
			if (sourceRectangle.Equals(RectangleOffset.Empty))
			{
				return sourceBounds;
			}
			float num = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(sourceRectangle.LeftOffset);
			float num2 = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(sourceRectangle.TopOffset);
			float num3 = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(sourceRectangle.RightOffset);
			float num4 = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(sourceRectangle.BottomOffset);
			float num5 = 1f - num - num3;
			float num6 = 1f - num2 - num4;
			float num7 = ((num5 != 0f) ? (sourceBounds.Width / num5) : sourceBounds.Width);
			float num8 = ((num5 != 0f) ? (sourceBounds.Height / num6) : sourceBounds.Height);
			return new RectangleF(sourceBounds.X - num7 * num, sourceBounds.Y - num8 * num2, num7, num8);
		}
	}

	public class DrawingBlipEffectWalker : IDrawingEffectVisitor
	{
		private float[][] colorMatrixElements;

		private List<DrawingColorMapItem> colorMapItems = new List<DrawingColorMapItem>();

		public float[][] ColorMatrixElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (colorMatrixElements == null)
				{
					InitColorMatrix();
				}
				return colorMatrixElements;
			}
		}

		public bool HasColorMatrix => colorMatrixElements != null;

		public bool HasColorMap => colorMapItems.Count > 0;

		private void InitColorMatrix()
		{
			colorMatrixElements = new float[5][];
			colorMatrixElements[0] = new float[5] { 1f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f };
			colorMatrixElements[1] = new float[5] { 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f, 0f };
			colorMatrixElements[2] = new float[5] { 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f };
			colorMatrixElements[3] = new float[5] { 0f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f };
			colorMatrixElements[4] = new float[5] { 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 1f };
		}

		public void Walk(DrawingEffectCollection effects)
		{
			effects.ForEach(ApplyEffect);
		}

		private void ApplyEffect(IDrawingEffect effect)
		{
			effect.Visit(this);
		}

		public virtual void AlphaCeilingEffectVisit()
		{
		}

		public virtual void AlphaFloorEffectVisit()
		{
		}

		public virtual void GrayScaleEffectVisit()
		{
			ColorMatrixElements[0][0] = 0.3f;
			ColorMatrixElements[0][1] = 0.3f;
			ColorMatrixElements[0][2] = 0.3f;
			ColorMatrixElements[1][0] = 0.59f;
			ColorMatrixElements[1][1] = 0.59f;
			ColorMatrixElements[1][2] = 0.59f;
			ColorMatrixElements[2][0] = 0.11f;
			ColorMatrixElements[2][1] = 0.11f;
			ColorMatrixElements[2][2] = 0.11f;
		}

		{
			float num = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(drawingEffect.Amount);
			if (num != 1f)
			{
				ColorMatrixElements[3][3] = num;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Visit(ColorChangeEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			Color color = drawingEffect.ColorFrom.FinalColor;
			Color to = drawingEffect.ColorTo.FinalColor;
			if (!drawingEffect.UseAlpha)
			{
				color = Color.FromArgb(color.R, color.G, color.B);
				to = Color.FromArgb(to.R, to.G, to.B);
			}
			colorMapItems.Add(new DrawingColorMapItem
			{
				From = color,
				To = to
			});
		}

		public virtual void Visit(ContainerEffect drawingEffect)

		}

		public virtual void Visit(DuotoneEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			Color finalColor = drawingEffect.FirstColor.FinalColor;
			Color finalColor2 = drawingEffect.SecondColor.FinalColor;
			ColorMatrixElements[0][0] = (float)(int)finalColor2.R / 255f - (float)(int)finalColor.R / 255f;
			ColorMatrixElements[0][1] = (float)(int)finalColor2.G / 255f - (float)(int)finalColor.G / 255f;
			ColorMatrixElements[0][2] = (float)(int)finalColor2.B / 255f - (float)(int)finalColor.B / 255f;
			ColorMatrixElements[1][1] = 0f;
			ColorMatrixElements[2][2] = 0f;
			ColorMatrixElements[4][0] = (float)(int)finalColor.R / 255f;
			ColorMatrixElements[4][1] = (float)(int)finalColor.G / 255f;
			ColorMatrixElements[4][2] = (float)(int)finalColor.B / 255f;
		}

		public virtual void Visit(Effect drawingEffect)

		public virtual void Visit(LuminanceEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			double val = (double)drawingEffect.Bright / 100000.0 * 0.5;
			double val2 = (double)drawingEffect.Contrast / 100000.0;
			double num = Math.Min(val2, 0.99999);
			double val3 = 1.0 / (1.0 - num);
			val = Math.Min(Math.Max(val, -0.5), 0.5);
			val3 = Math.Min(Math.Max(val3, 0.0), 100000.0);
			float num2 = (float)val3;
			float num3 = (float)((val - 0.5) * val3 + val + 0.5);
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				ColorMatrixElements[i][i] = num2;
				ColorMatrixElements[4][i] = num3;
			}
		}

		public ColorMap[] GetColorMap()
		{
			if (!HasColorMap)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return colorMapItems.Select((DrawingColorMapItem x) => new ColorMap
			{

	public static class GdipExtensions
	{
		private const int SRCCOPY = 13369376;

		public static bool IsClosed(this GraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			if (graphicsPath.PointCount == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			byte[] types = graphicsPath.PathData.Types;
			foreach (byte b in types)
			{
				if ((b & 0x80) != 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsClosed(this DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			if (graphicsPath.PointCount == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (DXPathPointType pathType in graphicsPath.GetPathData().PathTypes)
			{
				if ((pathType & DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath) != DXPathPointType.Start)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static Rectangle GetBoundsExt(this GraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExt(null);
		}

		public static Rectangle GetBoundsExt(this DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExt(null);
		}

		public static Rectangle GetBoundsExt(this GraphicsPath graphicsPath, Matrix transform)
		{
			RectangleF boundsExtF = graphicsPath.GetBoundsExtF(transform);
			return Rectangle.Round(boundsExtF);
		}

		public static Rectangle GetBoundsExt(this DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			RectangleF boundsExtF = graphicsPath.GetBoundsExtF(transform);
			return Rectangle.Round(boundsExtF);
		}

		public static RectangleF GetBoundsExtF(this GraphicsPath graphicsPath, Matrix transform)
		{
			return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExtF(transform, null);
		}

		public static RectangleF GetBoundsExtF(this DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExtF(transform, null);
		}

		public static RectangleF GetBoundsExtF(this GraphicsPath graphicsPath, Matrix transform, PenInfo penInfo)
		{
			using GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = (GraphicsPath)graphicsPath.Clone();
			if (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
			{
				graphicsPath2.Flatten(null, 0.25f);
			}
			Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(penInfo?.Pen);
			if (pen != null && AllowPathWidening(SystemDrawingConverter.WrapGraphicsPath(graphicsPath2)))
			{
				if (pen.Alignment == PenAlignment.Outset)
				{
					return GetBoundsExtForOutsetPen(SystemDrawingConverter.WrapGraphicsPath(graphicsPath2), penInfo, SystemDrawingConverter.CreateDXMatrix(transform));
				}
				WidenHelper.Apply(SystemDrawingConverter.WrapGraphicsPath(graphicsPath2), penInfo, applyBoundingPath: false, SystemDrawingConverter.CreateDXMatrix(transform));
			}
			else if (transform != null)
			{
				graphicsPath2.Transform(transform);
			}
			return GetBoundsExtCore(graphicsPath2);
		}

		public static RectangleF GetBoundsExtF(this DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath, DXMatrix transform, PenInfo penInfo)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = graphicsPath.Clone();
			dXGraphicsPath.Flatten();
			DXPen dXPen = penInfo?.Pen;
			if (dXPen != null && AllowPathWidening(dXGraphicsPath))
			{
				if (dXPen.Alignment == DXPenAlignment.Outset)
				{
					return GetBoundsExtForOutsetPen(dXGraphicsPath, penInfo, transform);
				}
				WidenHelper.Apply(dXGraphicsPath, penInfo, applyBoundingPath: false, transform);
			}
			else if (transform != null)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Transform(transform);
			}
			return GetBoundsExtCore(dXGraphicsPath);
		}

		private static RectangleF GetBoundsExtForOutsetPen(DXGraphicsPath path, PenInfo penInfo, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = TransformGraphicsPathForOutsetPen(path, penInfo.Pen);
			WidenHelper.Apply(dXGraphicsPath, penInfo, applyBoundingPath: false, transform);
			return GetBoundsExtCore(dXGraphicsPath);
		}

		private static RectangleF GetBoundsExtCore(GraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			return graphicsPath.GetBounds();
		}

		private static RectangleF GetBoundsExtCore(DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			return graphicsPath.GetBounds();
		}

		public static RectangleF GetBoundsExtF(this DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath, DXMatrix transform, PenInfo penInfo, bool correctLineJoin)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = graphicsPath.Clone();
			DXPen dXPen = penInfo?.Pen;
			if (dXPen != null && AllowPathWidening(dXGraphicsPath))
			{
				DXLineJoin lineJoin = DXLineJoin.Miter;
				if (correctLineJoin)
				{
					lineJoin = dXPen.LineJoin;
					dXPen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Round;
				}
				try
				{
					if (dXPen.Alignment == DXPenAlignment.Outset)
					{
						return GetBoundsExtForOutsetPen(dXGraphicsPath, penInfo, transform);
					}
					WidenHelper.Apply(dXGraphicsPath, penInfo, applyBoundingPath: false, transform);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (correctLineJoin)
					{
						dXPen.LineJoin = lineJoin;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (transform != null)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Transform(transform);
			}
			return GetBoundsExtCore(dXGraphicsPath);
		}

		internal static bool AllowPathWidening(DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			int pointCount = graphicsPath.PointCount;
			if (pointCount < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<PointF> pathPoints = graphicsPath.PathPoints;
			PointF pointF = pathPoints[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < pointCount; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF2 = pathPoints[i];
				if (pointF != pointF2)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static GraphicsPath BuildFigure(List<GraphicsPath> graphicsPaths, bool addNotClosedPaths)
		{
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath(FillMode.Alternate);
			if (graphicsPaths != null)
			{
				if (graphicsPaths.Count > 0)
				{
					GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = graphicsPaths[0];
					if (graphicsPath2.PointCount > 0)
					{
						graphicsPath.AddPath(graphicsPath2, connect: false);
					}
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < graphicsPaths.Count; i++)
				{
					GraphicsPath graphicsPath3 = graphicsPaths[i];
					if (addNotClosedPaths || graphicsPath3.IsClosed())
					{
						graphicsPath.AddPath(graphicsPath3, connect: false);
					}
				}
			}
			return graphicsPath;
		}

		public static DXGraphicsPath TransformGraphicsPathForOutsetPen(DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath, DXPen pen)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = graphicsPath.Clone();
			RectangleF rectangleF = dXGraphicsPath.GetBoundsExt();
			if (rectangleF.Width == 0f || rectangleF.Height == 0f)
			{
				return dXGraphicsPath;
			}
			float width = pen.Width;
			float num = rectangleF.Width + width;
			float num2 = rectangleF.Height + width;
			float num3 = num / rectangleF.Width;
			float num4 = num2 / rectangleF.Height;
			float dx = rectangleF.X - rectangleF.X * num3 - (num - rectangleF.Width) / 2f;
			float dy = rectangleF.Y - rectangleF.Y * num4 - (num2 - rectangleF.Height) / 2f;
			DXMatrix matrix = new DXMatrix(num3, 0f, 0f, num4, dx, dy);
			dXGraphicsPath.Transform(matrix);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public static void Translate(this GraphicsPath graphicsPath, float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			using Matrix matrix = new Matrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, offsetX, offsetY);
			graphicsPath.Transform(matrix);
		}

		[DllImport("gdi32.dll")]
		private static extern bool BitBlt(IntPtr hDC, int x, int y, int nWidth, int nHeight, IntPtr hSrcDC, int xSrc, int ySrc, int dwRop);

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static Bitmap GetGraphicsSnapshot(Graphics graphics, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			IntPtr hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
				using (Graphics graphics2 = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap))
				{
					IntPtr hdc2 = graphics2.GetHdc();
					try
					{
						bool flag = BitBlt(hdc2, 0, 0, bounds.Width, bounds.Height, hdc, bounds.X, bounds.Y, 13369376);
					}
					finally
					{
						graphics2.ReleaseHdc(hdc2);
					}
				}
				return bitmap;
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
			}
		}

		internal static DXMatrix ApplyTransform(this DXBrush brush, DXMatrix transform, DXMatrixOrder order)
		{
			if (brush == null || transform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ApplyTransformCore(brush, transform, order);
		}

		private static DXMatrix ApplyTransformCore(DXBrush brush, DXMatrix transform, DXMatrixOrder order)
		{
			DXMatrix result = null;
			if (brush is DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush)
			{
				result = dXLinearGradientBrush.Transform.Clone();
				dXLinearGradientBrush.Transform.Multiply(transform, order);
				return result;
			}
			if (brush is DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush)
			{
				result = dXPathGradientBrush.Transform.Clone();
				dXPathGradientBrush.Transform.Multiply(transform, order);
				return result;
			}
			if (brush is DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush)
			{
				result = dXTextureBrush.Transform.Clone();
				dXTextureBrush.Transform.Multiply(transform, order);
				return result;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void ReplaceTransform(this DXBrush brush, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			if (brush != null && transform != null)
			{
				ReplaceTransformCore(brush, transform);
			}
		}

		private static void ReplaceTransformCore(DXBrush brush, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			if (brush is DXLinearGradientBrush)
			{
				((DXLinearGradientBrush)brush).Transform = transform;
			}
			else if (brush is DXPathGradientBrush)
			{
				((DXPathGradientBrush)brush).Transform = transform;
			}
			else if (brush is DXTextureBrush)
			{
				((DXTextureBrush)brush).Transform = transform;
			}
		}

		internal static DXMatrix ApplyTransform(this DXPen pen, DXMatrix transform, DXMatrixOrder order)
		{
			DXMatrix result = null;
			DXBrush brush = pen.Brush;
			if (brush != null && transform != null)
			{
				result = ApplyTransformCore(brush, transform, order);
				if (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
				{
					pen.Brush = brush;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void ReplaceTransform(this DXPen pen, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			DXBrush brush = pen.Brush;
			if (brush != null && transform != null)
			{
				ReplaceTransformCore(brush, transform);
				if (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
				{
					pen.Brush = brush;
				}
			}
		}

		public static IDXGraphics PrepareGraphicsFromImage(DXImage image, GraphicsUnit pageUnit, float pageScale)

			iDXGraphics.SmoothingMode = DXSmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
			iDXGraphics.CompositingMode = DXCompositingMode.SourceOver;
			iDXGraphics.CompositingQuality = DXCompositingQuality.Default;
			iDXGraphics.InterpolationMode = DXInterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
			return iDXGraphics;
		}
