		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static Metafile ConvertToEmfPlus(Graphics graphics, Metafile metafile)
		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IntPtr nativeGraphics = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				if (!CreateNativeGraphics(graphics, out nativeGraphics))
				{
					return null;
				}
				SetupNativeGraphics(nativeGraphics);
				if (!GetNativeMetafile(metafile, out var nativeMetafile))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ConvertToEmfPlusCore(nativeGraphics, nativeMetafile);
			}
			finally
			{
				DeleteNativeGraphics(nativeGraphics);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Metafile ConvertToEmfPlusCore(IntPtr nativeGraphics, IntPtr nativeMetafile)
		{
			if (!ConvertToEmfPlusWrapper(nativeGraphics, nativeMetafile, out var emfPlus))
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				if (PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GdipGetHemfFromMetafile(emfPlus, out var hEnhMetafile) != 0)
				{
					DevExpress.Office.Utils.MetafileHelper.DeleteMetafileHandle(hEnhMetafile);
					return null;
				}
				return new Metafile(hEnhMetafile, deleteEmf: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				DisposeImage(emfPlus);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static bool ConvertToEmfPlusWrapper(IntPtr nativeGraphics, IntPtr nativeMetafile, out IntPtr emfPlus)
		{
			emfPlus = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				if (PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GdipConvertToEmfPlus(nativeGraphics, nativeMetafile, out var conversionFailureFlag, EmfType.EmfPlusOnly, string.Empty, out emfPlus) != 0 || conversionFailureFlag)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool GetNativeMetafile(Metafile sourceMetafile, out IntPtr nativeMetafile)
		{
			FieldInfo field = typeof(Metafile).GetField("nativeImage", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			nativeMetafile = (IntPtr)(field?.GetValue(sourceMetafile) ?? ((object)IntPtr.Zero));
			if (field != null)
			{
				return nativeMetafile != IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal static bool CreateNativeGraphics(Graphics graphics, out IntPtr nativeGraphics)
		{
			IntPtr hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
			nativeGraphics = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				return PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GdipCreateFromHDC(hdc, out nativeGraphics) == 0;
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void SetupNativeGraphics(IntPtr nativeGraphics)
		{
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GdipSetSmoothingMode(nativeGraphics, SmoothingMode.AntiAlias);
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GdipSetTextRenderingHint(nativeGraphics, TextRenderingHint.AntiAlias);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal static void DeleteNativeGraphics(IntPtr nativeGraphics)
		{
			DisposeNativeCore(nativeGraphics, PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GdipDeleteGraphics);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal static void DisposeImage(IntPtr nativeImage)
		{
			DisposeNativeCore(nativeImage, PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GdipDisposeImage);
		}

		private static void DisposeNativeCore(IntPtr pointer, Func<IntPtr, int> action)
		{
			if (pointer == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				action(pointer);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
	}
	public static class GlowEffectHelper
	{
		private const float epsilon = 1.1920929E-07f;

		public static DXPen CreatePen(Color color, float width, PenInfo penInfo)
		{
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(color, width);
			if (penInfo != null)
			{
				PrepareDashStyle(dXPen, penInfo.Pen, width);
			}
			dXPen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Round;
			dXPen.StartCap = DXLineCap.Round;
			dXPen.EndCap = DXLineCap.Round;
			return dXPen;
		}

		private static void PrepareDashStyle(DXPen resultPen, DXPen originalPen, float width)
		{
			if (originalPen == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXDashStyle dashStyle = originalPen.DashStyle;
			if (dashStyle != DXDashStyle.Solid)
			{
				DXDashCap dashCap = originalPen.DashCap;
				resultPen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				resultPen.DashCap = dashCap;
				float coeff = originalPen.Width / width;
				if (dashCap == DXDashCap.Round)
				{
					PrepareDashStyleForRoundCaps(resultPen, coeff, dashStyle, originalPen.DashPattern);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareDashStyleForSquareCaps(resultPen, coeff, dashStyle, originalPen.DashPattern);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void PrepareDashStyleForRoundCaps(DXPen resultPen, float coeff, DXDashStyle originalDashStyle, float[] originalPattern)
		{
			float num = 1f - coeff;
			float num2;
			float coeff2;
			switch (originalDashStyle)
			{
			case DXDashStyle.Dot:
				num2 = Math.Max(coeff - num, 1.1920929E-07f);
				coeff2 = num2;
				break;
			case DXDashStyle.Dash:
				num2 = Math.Max(coeff - num, 1.1920929E-07f);
				coeff2 = coeff + num / 3f;
				break;
			default:
				num2 = Math.Max(coeff - num / 3f, 1.1920929E-07f);
				coeff2 = coeff + (1f - num2) / (5.3f * originalPattern[0] / 4f);
				break;
			}
			resultPen.DashOffset = num;
			resultPen.DashPattern = CreateDashPattern(originalPattern, coeff2, num2);
		}

		private static void PrepareDashStyleForSquareCaps(DXPen resultPen, float coeff, DXDashStyle originalDashStyle, float[] originalPattern)
		{
			float num = (1f - coeff) / 2f;
			float coeff2;
			float num2;
			float coeff3;
			switch (originalDashStyle)
			{
			case DXDashStyle.Dot:
				coeff2 = coeff + 3f * num / 2f;
				num2 = Math.Max(coeff - 3f * num / 2f, 1.1920929E-07f);
				coeff3 = num2;
				break;
			case DXDashStyle.Dash:
				coeff2 = coeff + 2f * num / 3f;
				num2 = Math.Max(coeff - 2f * num, 1.1920929E-07f);
				coeff3 = num2;
				break;
			default:
				num2 = Math.Max(coeff - num / 3f, 1.1920929E-07f);
				coeff2 = coeff + (1f - num2) / (2f * originalPattern[0]);
				coeff3 = coeff + num;
				break;
			}
			resultPen.DashOffset = num;
			resultPen.DashPattern = CreateDashPattern(originalPattern, coeff2, num2, coeff3);
		}

		private static float[] CreateDashPattern(float[] originalPattern, float coeff1, float coeff2)
		{
			return CreateDashPattern(originalPattern, coeff1, coeff2, coeff2);
		}

		private static float[] CreateDashPattern(float[] originalPattern, float coeff1, float coeff2, float coeff3)
		{
			int num = originalPattern.Length;
			float[] array = new float[num];
			array[0] = originalPattern[0] * coeff1;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i += 2)
			{
				array[i] = originalPattern[i] * coeff2;
			}
			for (int j = 2; j < num; j += 2)
			{
				array[j] = originalPattern[j] * coeff3;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static DXBrush ConvertGradientBrushWithTransparentColors(DXBrush brush, Color glowColor)
		{
			if (brush is DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush)
			{
				DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = ConvertTransparentColors(dXLinearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors, glowColor);
				if (dXColorBlend != null)
				{
					DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush2 = (DXLinearGradientBrush)brush.Clone();
					dXLinearGradientBrush2.InterpolationColors = dXColorBlend;
					return dXLinearGradientBrush2;
				}
			}
			if (brush is DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush)
			{
				DXColorBlend dXColorBlend2 = ConvertTransparentColors(dXPathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors, glowColor);
				if (dXColorBlend2 != null)
				{
					DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush2 = (DXPathGradientBrush)brush.Clone();
					dXPathGradientBrush2.InterpolationColors = dXColorBlend2;
					return dXPathGradientBrush2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static DXColorBlend ConvertTransparentColors(DXColorBlend colorBlend, Color glowColor)
		{
			List<Color> list = new List<Color>();
			List<float> list2 = new List<float>();
			Color[] colors = colorBlend.Colors;
			float[] positions = colorBlend.Positions;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < colors.Length; i++)
			{
				Color color = colors[i];
				float item = positions[i];
				flag2 = color.A == 0;
				if (flag2)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				if (!flag2 && flag)
				{
					list.Add(glowColor);
					list2.Add(positions[i - 1]);
				}
				else if (!flag && flag2 && i != 0)
				{
					list.Add(glowColor);
					list2.Add(item);
				}
				list.Add(flag2 ? color : glowColor);
				list2.Add(item);
				flag = flag2;
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateColorBlend(list, list2);
		}

		private static DXColorBlend CreateColorBlend(List<Color> newColors, List<float> newPositions)
		{
			DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = new DXColorBlend(newColors.Count);
			dXColorBlend.Colors = newColors.ToArray();
			dXColorBlend.Positions = newPositions.ToArray();
			return dXColorBlend;
		}
	}
	public abstract class GroupFillEntriesCalculatorBase<TGroup>
	{
		private readonly Stack<DXMatrix> groupTransforms;

		private readonly Stack<Rectangle> parentBounds;

		private readonly Stack<TGroup> parentGroupShapes;

		protected List<IPlatformPath> Result { get; set; }

		protected DXMatrix CurrentGroupTransform => groupTransforms.Peek();

		protected Rectangle CurrentBounds => parentBounds.Peek();

		protected TGroup CurrentGroup => parentGroupShapes.Peek();

		protected GroupFillEntriesCalculatorBase()
		{
			groupTransforms = new Stack<DXMatrix>();
			parentBounds = new Stack<Rectangle>();
			parentGroupShapes = new Stack<TGroup>();
		}

		public List<IPlatformPath> GetEntries(TGroup groupShape, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Result = new List<IPlatformPath>();
			parentBounds.Push(bounds);
			CalculateBounds(groupShape, null);
			parentBounds.Pop();
			return Result;
		}

		private void CalculateBounds(TGroup groupShape, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			groupTransforms.Push(transform);
			parentGroupShapes.Push(groupShape);
			EnumerateDrawings(groupShape);
			parentGroupShapes.Pop();
			groupTransforms.Pop();
		}

		protected abstract void EnumerateDrawings(TGroup groupShape);

		protected abstract GroupShapeProperties GetGroupShapeProperties(TGroup groupShape);

		protected void VisitGroup(TGroup groupShape)
		{
			Rectangle drawingObjectBoundsInLayoutUnits = GetDrawingObjectBoundsInLayoutUnits(GetGroupShapeProperties(groupShape).Transform2D, CurrentBounds);
			parentBounds.Push(drawingObjectBoundsInLayoutUnits);
			DXMatrix transform = CreateGroupShapeTransform(GetGroupShapeProperties(groupShape), drawingObjectBoundsInLayoutUnits, CurrentGroupTransform);
			CalculateBounds(groupShape, transform);
			parentBounds.Pop();
		}

		protected void VisitCore(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = shapeProperties.DocumentModel;
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			float defaultScale = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(documentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(1));
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateShapeTransform(shapeProperties, bounds, CurrentGroupTransform);
			List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths = ShapeRenderHelper.CalculateGraphicsPaths(geometry, bounds, defaultScale);
			IPlatformPath platformPath = BuildFigure(graphicsPaths);
			if (dXMatrix != null)
			{
				platformPath.Transform(dXMatrix);
			}
			Result.Add(platformPath);
		}

		protected Rectangle GetDrawingObjectBoundsInLayoutUnits(Transform2D innerDrawingTransform2D, Rectangle currentParentBounds)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = innerDrawingTransform2D.DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			int currentParentWidth = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits(currentParentBounds.Width);
			int currentParentHeight = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits(currentParentBounds.Height);
			GroupShapeProperties groupShapeProperties = GetGroupShapeProperties(CurrentGroup);
			float num = CalculateChildScaleX(groupShapeProperties, currentParentWidth);
			float num2 = CalculateChildScaleY(groupShapeProperties, currentParentHeight);
			Transform2D childTransform2D = groupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D;
			RectangleF rectangle = new RectangleF(GetChildX(innerDrawingTransform2D, childTransform2D), GetChildY(innerDrawingTransform2D, childTransform2D), GetChildWidth(innerDrawingTransform2D), GetChildHeight(innerDrawingTransform2D));
			bool flag = NeedToSwap(innerDrawingTransform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees());
			if (flag)
			{
				rectangle = RectangleUtils.SwapWidthAndHeight(rectangle);
			}
			rectangle = new RectangleF(rectangle.X * num, rectangle.Y * num2, rectangle.Width * num, rectangle.Height * num2);
			if (flag)
			{
				rectangle = RectangleUtils.SwapWidthAndHeight(rectangle);
			}
			int x = currentParentBounds.Left + (int)Math.Round(toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(rectangle.X));
			int y = currentParentBounds.Top + (int)Math.Round(toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(rectangle.Y));
			int width = (int)Math.Round(toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(rectangle.Width));
			int height = (int)Math.Round(toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(rectangle.Height));
			return new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
		}

		private float CalculateChildScaleX(GroupShapeProperties groupShapeProperties, int currentParentWidth)
		{
			float num = (float)currentParentWidth / groupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D.Cx;
			if (float.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private float CalculateChildScaleY(GroupShapeProperties groupShapeProperties, int currentParentHeight)
		{
			float num = (float)currentParentHeight / groupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D.Cy;
			if (float.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = 0f;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static float GetChildX(Transform2D innerDrawingTransform2D, Transform2D groupChildTransform2D)
		{
			return innerDrawingTransform2D.OffsetX - groupChildTransform2D.OffsetX;
		}

		private static float GetChildY(Transform2D innerDrawingTransform2D, Transform2D groupChildTransform2D)
		{
			return innerDrawingTransform2D.OffsetY - groupChildTransform2D.OffsetY;
		}

		private static float GetChildWidth(Transform2D innerDrawingTransform2D)
		{
			return innerDrawingTransform2D.Cx;
		}

		private static float GetChildHeight(Transform2D innerDrawingTransform2D)
		{
			return innerDrawingTransform2D.Cy;
		}

		private static bool NeedToSwap(float angleInDegrees)
		{
			float num = angleInDegrees % 180f;
			if (num < 0f)
			{
				num += 180f;
			}
			if (num >= 45f)
			{
				return num < 135f;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static IPlatformPath BuildFigure(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Path.CreatePath(CrossPlatformFillMode.EvenOdd);
			if (graphicsPaths != null)
			{
				if (graphicsPaths.Count > 0)
				{
					IPlatformPath platformPath2 = graphicsPaths[0];
					platformPath.AddPath(platformPath2, connect: false);
					platformPath2.Dispose();
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < graphicsPaths.Count; i++)
				{
					IPlatformPath platformPath3 = graphicsPaths[i];
					if (platformPath3.IsClosed())
					{
						platformPath.AddPath(platformPath3, connect: false);
					}
					platformPath3.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return platformPath;
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateGroupShapeTransform(GroupShapeProperties shapeProperties, Rectangle bounds, DXMatrix parentTransform)
		{
			Transform2D transform2D = shapeProperties.Transform2D;
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = parentTransform?.Clone();
			DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = TransformMatrixExtensions.CreateFlipDXTransformUnsafe(bounds, transform2D.FlipH, transform2D.FlipV, transform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees());
			if (dXMatrix != null)
			{
				if (dXMatrix2 != null)
				{
					dXMatrix.Multiply(dXMatrix2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dXMatrix = dXMatrix2;
			}
			return dXMatrix;
		}
	}
	public class GroupShapeLayoutInfo : ShapeLayoutInfoBase, IDisposable
	{
		private delegate Rectangle GetBoundsStrategy(IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo);

		public Dictionary<int, ShapeLayoutInfo> InnerDrawingsOrder { get; private set; }

		public List<IShapeLayoutInfo> ShapeLayoutInfos { get; private set; }

		public override IPlatformStroke PenInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public bool HasMetafile { get; set; }

		public GroupShapeLayoutInfo(DXMatrix shapeTransform)
			: this()
		{
			base.ShapeTransform = shapeTransform;
		}

		public GroupShapeLayoutInfo()
			: base(useForGroupEffects: false)
		{
			ShapeLayoutInfos = new List<IShapeLayoutInfo>();
			InnerDrawingsOrder = new Dictionary<int, ShapeLayoutInfo>();
		}

		public void AddShapeLayoutInfo(IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
		{
			ShapeLayoutInfos.Add(shapeLayoutInfo);
			base.UseForGroupEffects |= shapeLayoutInfo.UseForGroupEffects;
		}

		public override void Draw(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			base.Draw(graphics);
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				shapeLayoutInfo.Draw(graphics);
			}
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath GetPreparedForShadowFigure(DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			additionalSize.AddSize(this);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				if (shapeLayoutInfo.UseForGroupEffects)
				{
					using DXGraphicsPath path = shapeLayoutInfo.GetPreparedForShadowFigure(shadowTransform, rotateWithShape, additionalSize);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(path, connect: false);
				}
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath GetPreparedForReflectionFigure(DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			additionalSize.AddSize(this);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath();
			AddShadowToReflection(dXGraphicsPath);
			dXGraphicsPath.Transform(shadowTransform);
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				if (shapeLayoutInfo.UseForGroupEffects)
				{
					using DXGraphicsPath path = shapeLayoutInfo.GetPreparedForShadowFigure(shadowTransform, rotateWithShape, additionalSize);
					dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(path, connect: false);
				}
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public override Rectangle CalculateShadowTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			additionalSize.ProcessGlowSize = true;
			GetBoundsStrategy getBounds = delegate(IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
			{
				if (shapeLayoutInfo is GroupShapeLayoutInfo)
				{
					additionalSize.AddSize(shapeLayoutInfo);
				}
				return shapeLayoutInfo.CalculateShadowTransformBounds(rotateWithShape, additionalSize);
			};
			return GetTotalBounds(getBounds);
		}

		public override void DrawShadow(IDXGraphics graphics, bool applyTransform)
		{
			DrawCore(graphics, applyTransform, GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeOuterShadow | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeReflection);
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				if (shapeLayoutInfo.UseForGroupEffects)
				{
					shapeLayoutInfo.DrawShadow(graphics, applyTransform);
				}
			}
		}

		public override Rectangle CalculateReflectionTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			return CalculateShadowTransformBounds(rotateWithShape, additionalSize);
		}

		public override void DrawReflection(IDXGraphics graphics, bool applyTransform)
		{
			DrawGroupPathInfos(graphics, GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeReflection);
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				if (shapeLayoutInfo.UseForGroupEffects)
				{
					shapeLayoutInfo.DrawShadow(graphics, applyTransform);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawGroupPathInfos(IDXGraphics graphics, GraphicsPathCollectFlags excludeFlags)
		{
			foreach (PathInfoBase path in base.Paths)
			{
				if (!base.Paths.ShouldSkipPathInfo(path, excludeFlags) && !path.SkipDrawing)
				{
					bool flag = path is GlowPathInfo;
					path.Draw(graphics, PenInfo, flag ? base.ShapeTransform : null);
				}
			}
		}

		public override Rectangle GetGlowBounds(EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix parentTransform)
		{
			additionalSize.AddSize(this);
			additionalSize.ProcessGlowSize = true;
			GetBoundsStrategy getBounds = delegate(IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
			{
				DXMatrix dXMatrix = parentTransform?.Clone() ?? new DXMatrix();
				DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = CreateGlowChildTransform(base.ShapeTransform, shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform);
				if (dXMatrix2 != null)
				{
					dXMatrix.Multiply(dXMatrix2);
				}
				return shapeLayoutInfo.GetGlowBounds(additionalSize, dXMatrix);
			};
			return GetTotalBounds(getBounds);
		}

		public override void DrawGlow(IDXGraphics graphics, Color color, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			additionalSize.AddSize(this);
			additionalSize.ProcessGlowSize = true;
			DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform;
			using (DXRegion region = graphics.GetClip())
			{
				if (shapeTransform != null)
				{
					graphics.MultiplyTransform(shapeTransform);
				}
				SetGlowClip(graphics, additionalSize.GlowSize);
				foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
				{
					if (shapeLayoutInfo.UseForGroupEffects)
					{
						DXMatrix shapeTransform2 = CreateGlowChildTransform(base.ShapeTransform, shapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform);
						shapeLayoutInfo.DrawGlow(graphics, color, additionalSize, shapeTransform2);
					}
				}
				graphics.SetClip(region);
			}
			graphics.Transform = transform;
		}

		private DXMatrix CreateGlowChildTransform(DXMatrix parentTransform, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = ((shapeTransform != null) ? shapeTransform.Clone() : new DXMatrix());
			if (parentTransform != null && parentTransform.IsInvertible)
			{
				DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = parentTransform.Clone();
				dXMatrix2.Invert();
				dXMatrix.Multiply(dXMatrix2, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			}
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		public override Rectangle GetBlurEffectBounds(DXMatrix parentTransform, bool applyTransform, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			additionalSize.AddSize(this);
			if (!applyTransform)
			{
				parentTransform = GetInverseTransform();
			}
			GetBoundsStrategy getBounds = (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo) => shapeLayoutInfo.GetBlurEffectBounds(parentTransform, applyTransform: true, additionalSize);
			return GetTotalBounds(getBounds);
		}

		private DXMatrix GetInverseTransform()
		{
			if (base.ShapeTransform != null)
			{
				DXMatrix dXMatrix = base.ShapeTransform.Clone();
				if (dXMatrix.IsInvertible)
				{
					dXMatrix.Invert();
					return dXMatrix;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void DrawBlurEffect(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			DrawBackgroundBitmap(graphics, GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeBlur);
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				if (shapeLayoutInfo.UseForGroupEffects)
				{
					shapeLayoutInfo.DrawBlurEffect(graphics);
				}
			}
		}

		private Rectangle GetTotalBounds(GetBoundsStrategy getBounds)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				if (shapeLayoutInfo.UseForGroupEffects)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle2 = getBounds(shapeLayoutInfo);
					rectangle = (rectangle.IsEmpty ? rectangle2 : Rectangle.Union(rectangle, rectangle2));
				}
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		public override void SetupHitTestPen(float extendedWidth)
		{
			base.SetupHitTestPen(extendedWidth);
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				shapeLayoutInfo.SetupHitTestPen(extendedWidth);
			}
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point logicalPoint)
		{
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				if (shapeLayoutInfo.HitTest(logicalPoint))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return base.HitTest(logicalPoint);
		}

		public override HitTestInfoCollection CreateShadowHitTestInfos(Matrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			HitTestInfoCollection hitTestInfoCollection = new HitTestInfoCollection();
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				hitTestInfoCollection.AddRange(shapeLayoutInfo.CreateShadowHitTestInfos(shadowTransform, rotateWithShape));
			}
			return hitTestInfoCollection;
		}

		public override HitTestInfoCollection CreateReflectionHitTestInfos(Matrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			HitTestInfoCollection hitTestInfoCollection = new HitTestInfoCollection();
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				hitTestInfoCollection.AddRange(shapeLayoutInfo.CreateReflectionHitTestInfos(shadowTransform, rotateWithShape));
			}
			PopulateReflectionHitTestInfosFromShadow(hitTestInfoCollection, shadowTransform, rotateWithShape);
			return hitTestInfoCollection;
		}

		protected override void DisposeCore()
		{
			base.DisposeCore();
			if (ShapeLayoutInfos == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				shapeLayoutInfo.Dispose();
			}
			ShapeLayoutInfos = null;
		}

		public override Rectangle GetBounds()
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = base.GetBounds();
			foreach (IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo in ShapeLayoutInfos)
			{
				Rectangle bounds = shapeLayoutInfo.GetBounds();
				if (!bounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					rectangle = ((!rectangle.IsEmpty) ? Rectangle.Union(rectangle, bounds) : bounds);
				}
			}
			return rectangle;
		}
	}
	public class PathInfoCollection : List<PathInfoBase>
	{
		private static Dictionary<Type, GraphicsPathCollectFlags> excludedTypes = CreateExcludedTypes();

		private static Dictionary<Type, GraphicsPathCollectFlags> CreateExcludedTypes()
		{
			Dictionary<Type, GraphicsPathCollectFlags> dictionary = new Dictionary<Type, GraphicsPathCollectFlags>();
			dictionary.Add(typeof(ConnectionShapePathInfo), GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeConnectors);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(InnerShadowPathInfo), GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInnerShadow);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(GlowPathInfo), GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeGlow);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(OuterShadowPathInfo), GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeOuterShadow);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(ReflectionPathInfo), GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeReflection);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(TextRectanglePathInfo), GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeTextRectangle);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(SoftEdgePathInfo), GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeSoftEdges);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(BlurPathInfo), GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeBlur);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public bool ShouldSkipPathInfo(PathInfoBase pathInfo, GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags)
		{
			if (IsExcludedType(flags, GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInvisiblePaths) && !pathInfo.Stroke && !pathInfo.Filled)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Type type = pathInfo.GetType();
			if (excludedTypes.ContainsKey(type) && IsExcludedType(flags, excludedTypes[type]))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsExcludedType(GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags, GraphicsPathCollectFlags excludedType)
		{
			return (flags & excludedType) == excludedType;
		}

		public DXGraphicsPath CollectFigure(GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags)
		{
			GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = new GdiPlusPath();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					PathInfoBase current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.Path != null && current.Path.PointCount != 0 && !ShouldSkipPathInfo(current, flags))
					{
						gdiPlusPath.AddPath(current.Path, connect: false);
					}
				}
			}
			return gdiPlusPath.NativeObject;
		}

		public T GetPathInfo<T>() where T : PathInfoBase
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					PathInfoBase current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.GetType() == typeof(T))
					{
						return (T)current;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public T[] GetPathInfos<T>() where T : PathInfoBase
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					PathInfoBase current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.GetType() == typeof(T))
					{
						list.Add((T)current);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public T[] GetPathInfosAndDerived<T>() where T : PathInfoBase
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					PathInfoBase current = enumerator.Current;
					Type type = current.GetType();
					Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
					if (type == typeFromHandle || type.IsSubclassOf(typeFromHandle))
					{
						list.Add((T)current);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public abstract class BitmapBasedPathInfo : PathInfoBase
	{
		private Lazy<DXImage> print;

		protected Rectangle BoundsInLayoutUnits { get; set; }

		public bool RotateWithShape { get; set; }

		public DXImage Print => print.Value;

		public Point Location => BoundsInLayoutUnits.Location;

		public float DpiScale { get; set; } = 1f;

		protected BitmapBasedPathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, Func<DXImage> bitmapRenderer, Rectangle boundsInLayoutUnits)
			: base(graphicsPath, null, stroke: false, hasPermanentFill: false)
		{
			BoundsInLayoutUnits = boundsInLayoutUnits;
			print = new Lazy<DXImage>(bitmapRenderer);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (print != null)
			{
				if (print.IsValueCreated && print.Value != null)
				{
					print.Value.Dispose();
				}
				print = null;
			}
		}

		public override void Draw(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			if (DpiScale != 1f)
			{
				DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform;
				Point location = Location;
				Rectangle boundsInLayoutUnits = BoundsInLayoutUnits;
				try
				{
					BoundsInLayoutUnits = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, BoundsInLayoutUnits.Size);
					graphics.TranslateTransform(location.X, location.Y);
					graphics.ScaleTransform(DpiScale, DpiScale);
					DrawCore(graphics, penInfo, RotateWithShape ? shapeTransform : null);
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					graphics.Transform = transform;
					BoundsInLayoutUnits = boundsInLayoutUnits;
				}
			}
			DrawCore(graphics, penInfo, RotateWithShape ? shapeTransform : null);
		}

		internal override void DrawCore(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo)
		{
			if (Print == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Print is DXMetafile)
			{
				if (graphics.PageUnit == DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel && PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(Print, BoundsInLayoutUnits, new RectangleF(PointF.Empty, Print.Size), DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel, null);
					return;
				}
				DXPixelOffsetMode pixelOffsetMode = graphics.PixelOffsetMode;
				if (penInfo == null)
				{
					graphics.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
				}
				graphics.DrawImage(Print, BoundsInLayoutUnits);
				graphics.PixelOffsetMode = pixelOffsetMode;
			}
			else
			{
				graphics.DrawImage(Print, Location.X, Location.Y);
			}
		}

		public override RectangleF GetRealBounds(DXMatrix transform, IPlatformStroke penInfo)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = BoundsInLayoutUnits;
			if (RotateWithShape && transform != null)
			{
				rectangleF = RectangleUtils.BoundingRectangle(rectangleF, transform);
			}
			return rectangleF;
		}
	}
	public abstract class HitTestSupportedPathInfo : BitmapBasedPathInfo
	{
		private Lazy<HitTestInfoCollection> hitTestInfos;

		public override bool AllowHitTest => true;

		internal HitTestInfoCollection HitTestInfos => hitTestInfos.Value;

		protected HitTestSupportedPathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, Func<DXImage> bitmapRenderer, Func<HitTestInfoCollection> hitTestInfoProvider, Rectangle boundsInLayoutUnits)
			: base(graphicsPath, bitmapRenderer, boundsInLayoutUnits)
		{
			hitTestInfos = new Lazy<HitTestInfoCollection>(hitTestInfoProvider);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (hitTestInfos != null)
			{
				if (hitTestInfos.IsValueCreated && hitTestInfos.Value != null)
				{
					hitTestInfos.Value.Dispose();
				}
				hitTestInfos = null;
			}
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point logicalPoint, Pen pen, Matrix invertedShapeTransform)
		{
			if (base.RotateWithShape && invertedShapeTransform != null)
			{
				logicalPoint = invertedShapeTransform.TransformPoint(logicalPoint);
			}
			foreach (HitTestInfo hitTestInfo in HitTestInfos)
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = hitTestInfo.GraphicsPath;
				if (hitTestInfo.HasFill && graphicsPath.IsVisible(logicalPoint))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Stroke && pen != null && graphicsPath.IsOutlineVisible(logicalPoint, pen))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class InnerShadowPathInfo : BitmapBasedPathInfo
	{
		private bool drawOutline;

		public InnerShadowPathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, Func<DXImage> bitmapRenderer, Rectangle boundsInLayoutUnits)
			: base(graphicsPath, bitmapRenderer, boundsInLayoutUnits)
		{
		}

		internal override void DrawCore(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke stroke)
		{
			PenInfo penInfo = stroke as PenInfo;
			if (drawOutline)
			{
				DXPen dXPen = penInfo?.Pen;
				GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = base.Path as GdiPlusPath;
				if (dXPen != null && gdiPlusPath != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawPath(dXPen, gdiPlusPath.NativeObject);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.DrawCore(graphics, (IPlatformStroke)penInfo);
			}
		}

		public override void Draw(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			drawOutline = false;
			base.Draw(graphics, penInfo, shapeTransform);
			if (penInfo != null)
			{
				drawOutline = true;
				base.DrawCore(graphics, penInfo, shapeTransform);
				drawOutline = false;
			}
		}
	}

		public override bool AllowHitTest => true;

		public override bool Filled => true;

		public PictureImagePathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, Func<DXImage> bitmapRenderer, Rectangle boundsInLayoutUnits)

				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)

		protected internal override bool ShouldDrawGlowPath()

			return true;
		}

	public class TextRectanglePathInfo : DrawingPathInfo
	{
		private TextLayoutCalculator textLayoutCalculator;

		private readonly Rectangle textBoundsInLayoutUnits;

		public DXMatrix TextTransform { get; set; }

		public override bool AllowHitTest => true;

		internal TextRectanglePathInfo(TextLayoutCalculator textLayoutCalculator, Rectangle boundsInLayoutUnits)
			: base(new GdiPlusPath(), () => CreateTextImage(textLayoutCalculator), boundsInLayoutUnits)
		{
			this.textLayoutCalculator = textLayoutCalculator;
			textBoundsInLayoutUnits = textLayoutCalculator.GetTextBounds();
		}

		public override void Draw(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			if (base.Print != null)
			{
				DrawCore(graphics, penInfo, TextTransform);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (TextTransform != null)
			{
				TextTransform = null;
			}
			if (textLayoutCalculator != null)
			{
				textLayoutCalculator.Dispose();
				textLayoutCalculator = null;
			}
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point logicalPoint, Pen pen, Matrix invertedShapeTransform)
		{
			if (invertedShapeTransform != null)
			{
				logicalPoint = invertedShapeTransform.TransformPoint(logicalPoint);
			}
			return textBoundsInLayoutUnits.Contains(logicalPoint);
		}

		private static DXImage CreateTextImage(TextLayoutCalculator textLayoutCalculator)
		{
			DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter = textLayoutCalculator.LayoutUnitConverter;
			List<PathInfoBase> list;
			using (ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter paragraphLayoutInfoConverter = textLayoutCalculator.GetLayoutInfoConverter())
			{
				list = paragraphLayoutInfoConverter.Convert();
			}
			Size resultBitmapSize = textLayoutCalculator.GetResultBitmapSize();
			DXImage dXImage = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(resultBitmapSize, layoutUnitConverter);
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXImage, (GraphicsUnit)layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, layoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale))
			{
				if (textLayoutCalculator.WarpGeometry == null)
				{
					textLayoutCalculator.ApplyGraphicsTransformation(iDXGraphics);
				}
				iDXGraphics.TextRenderingHint = DXTextRenderingHint.AntiAliasGridFit;
				foreach (PathInfoBase item in list)
				{
					if (!item.SkipDrawing)
					{
						item.Draw(iDXGraphics, null, null);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (PathInfoBase item2 in list)
			{
				item2.Dispose();
			}
			list.Clear();
			return dXImage;
		}

		public override RectangleF GetRealBounds(DXMatrix transform, IPlatformStroke penInfo)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = base.BoundsInLayoutUnits;
			if (TextTransform != null)
			{
				rectangleF = RectangleUtils.BoundingRectangle(rectangleF, TextTransform);
			}
			return rectangleF;
		}
	}

	public class RegularPicturePathInfo : BitmapBasedPathInfo
	{
		private readonly DrawingBlipFill fill;

		internal HitTestInfoCollection HitTestInfos { get; }

		public override bool AllowHitTest => true;

		public override bool Filled => true;

		public RegularPicturePathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, DrawingBlipFill fill, Rectangle boundsInLayoutUnits)
			: base(graphicsPath, () => (DXImage)null, boundsInLayoutUnits)
		{
			this.fill = fill;
			HitTestInfos = new HitTestInfoCollection();
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point logicalPoint, Pen pen, Matrix invertedShapeTransform)
		{
			if (base.RotateWithShape && invertedShapeTransform != null)
			{
				logicalPoint = invertedShapeTransform.TransformPoint(logicalPoint);
			}
			foreach (HitTestInfo hitTestInfo in HitTestInfos)
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = hitTestInfo.GraphicsPath;
				if (hitTestInfo.HasFill && graphicsPath.IsVisible(logicalPoint))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Stroke && pen != null && graphicsPath.IsOutlineVisible(logicalPoint, pen))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			foreach (HitTestInfo hitTestInfo in HitTestInfos)
			{
				hitTestInfo.Dispose();
			}
			HitTestInfos.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldDrawGlowPath()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal override void DrawCore(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo)
		{
			DrawingBlipEffectWalker drawingBlipEffectWalker = new DrawingBlipEffectWalker();
			drawingBlipEffectWalker.Walk(fill.Blip.Effects);
			DXColorMatrix dXColorMatrix = ((!fill.BlackAndWhitePrintMode) ? (drawingBlipEffectWalker.HasColorMatrix ? new DXColorMatrix(drawingBlipEffectWalker.ColorMatrixElements) : null) : DXColorMatrix.CreateGrayscaleColorMatrix());
			DXColorMap[] dXColorMap = drawingBlipEffectWalker.GetDXColorMap();
			DXImage dXImage = fill.Blip.Image.DXImage;
			RectangleF imageBounds = dXImage.GetImageBounds();
			DXInterpolationMode interpolationMode = graphics.InterpolationMode;
			graphics.InterpolationMode = DXInterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
			try
			{
				if (dXColorMatrix != null || dXColorMap != null)
				{
					DXImageAttributes dXImageAttributes = new DXImageAttributes();
					if (dXColorMatrix != null)
					{
						dXImageAttributes.ColorMatrix = dXColorMatrix;
					}
					if (dXColorMap != null)
					{
						dXImageAttributes.RemapTable = dXColorMap;
					}
					graphics.DrawImage(dXImage, base.BoundsInLayoutUnits, imageBounds, DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel, dXImageAttributes);
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(dXImage, base.BoundsInLayoutUnits);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.InterpolationMode = interpolationMode;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class PathInfoBase : IDisposable
	{
		private IPlatformPath path;

		private IPlatformFill fill;

		private readonly float scaleFactor;

		public IPlatformPath Path => path;

		public IPlatformFill Fill => fill;

		public bool HasPermanentFill { get; set; }

		public bool Stroke { get; set; }

		public bool SkipDrawing { get; set; }

		public virtual bool AllowHitTest => false;

		public virtual bool Filled => fill?.Filled ?? false;

		protected PathInfoBase(IPlatformPath path, IPlatformFill fill, bool stroke, float scaleFactor = 1f)
		{
			this.path = path;
			this.fill = fill;
			Stroke = stroke;
			this.scaleFactor = scaleFactor;
		}

		protected PathInfoBase(IPlatformPath path, IPlatformFill fill, bool stroke, bool hasPermanentFill, float scaleFactor = 1f)
			: this(path, fill, stroke, scaleFactor)
		{
			HasPermanentFill = hasPermanentFill;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldDrawGlowPath()
		{
			return Stroke;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (fill != null)
			{
				fill.Dispose();
				fill = null;
			}
			if (path != null)
			{
				path.Dispose();
				path = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Draw(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			if ((fill != null && fill.Filled) || (Stroke && penInfo != null))
			{
				DrawCore(graphics, penInfo, shapeTransform);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawCore(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			if (shapeTransform == null)
			{
				DrawCore(graphics, penInfo);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = penInfo?.HasPermanentFill ?? false;
			bool hasPermanentFill = HasPermanentFill;
			if (hasPermanentFill || flag)
			{
				DrawWithoutGraphicsTransform(graphics, penInfo, shapeTransform, hasPermanentFill, flag);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawWithGraphicsTransform(graphics, penInfo, shapeTransform);
			}
		}

		protected void DrawWithGraphicsTransform(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform.Clone();
			try
			{
				graphics.MultiplyTransform(shapeTransform);
				DrawCore(graphics, penInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.Transform = transform;
			}
		}

		protected void DrawWithoutGraphicsTransform(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke stroke, DXMatrix shapeTransform, bool hasPermanentFill, bool hasPermanentStroke)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = null;
			DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = null;
			PenInfo penInfo = stroke as PenInfo;
			DXPen pen = penInfo?.Pen;
			BrushInfo brushInfo = Fill as BrushInfo;
			try
			{
				Path.Transform(shapeTransform);
				if (!hasPermanentFill && brushInfo != null && brushInfo.Brush != null)
				{
					dXMatrix = brushInfo.Brush.ApplyTransform(shapeTransform, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
				}
				if (!hasPermanentStroke && penInfo != null)
				{
					dXMatrix2 = pen.ApplyTransform(shapeTransform, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
				}
				DrawCore(graphics, penInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (shapeTransform.IsInvertible)
				{
					DXMatrix dXMatrix3 = shapeTransform.Clone();
					dXMatrix3.Invert();
					Path.Transform(dXMatrix3);
				}
				if (dXMatrix != null)
				{
					brushInfo.Brush.ReplaceTransform(dXMatrix);
				}
				if (dXMatrix2 != null)
				{
					pen.ReplaceTransform(dXMatrix2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void DrawCore(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo)
		{
			DXBrush dXBrush = ((fill is BrushInfo brushInfo) ? brushInfo.Brush : null);
			GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = Path as GdiPlusPath;
			if (dXBrush != null && gdiPlusPath != null)
			{
				if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && dXBrush is DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush && (dXTextureBrush.Transform.Elements[0] == 0f || dXTextureBrush.Transform.Elements[3] == 0f))
				{
					dXBrush = new DXTextureBrush(dXTextureBrush.Image, dXTextureBrush.WrapMode);
				}
				graphics.FillPath(dXBrush, gdiPlusPath.NativeObject);
			}
			if (Stroke && penInfo != null)
			{
				DrawPath(graphics, penInfo);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawPath(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke stroke)
		{
			if (!(Path is GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath) || !(stroke is PenInfo penInfo))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (penInfo.HasCaps)
			{
				DrawPathWithCaps(graphics, penInfo);
				return;
			}
			DXPen pen = penInfo.Pen;
			if (pen == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (pen.Alignment == DXPenAlignment.Outset)
			{
				using (DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GdipExtensions.TransformGraphicsPathForOutsetPen(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject, pen))
				{
					graphics.DrawPath(pen, dXGraphicsPath);
					return;
				}
			}
			DXGraphicsPath nativeObject = gdiPlusPath.NativeObject;
			graphics.DrawPath(pen, nativeObject);
		}

		protected internal void DrawPathWithCaps(IDXGraphics graphics, PenInfo penInfo)
		{
			DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform;
			if (penInfo.HasCaps)
			{
				penInfo.ApplyCaps(scaleFactor);
			}
			DXPen pen = penInfo.Pen;
			float width = pen.Width;
			try
			{
				float num = 1f / (float)penInfo.ConvertToEmuSafe(1f);
				DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix(num, 0f, 0f, num, 0f, 0f);
				graphics.MultiplyTransform(dXMatrix);
				pen.Width = penInfo.ConvertPenWidth(width, scaleFactor);
				DXMatrix transform2 = null;
				bool flag = NeedPenBrushScale(pen);
				try
				{
					DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = dXMatrix.Clone();
					dXMatrix2.Invert();
					if (flag)
					{
						transform2 = pen.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix2, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
					}
					if (!(Path.Clone() is GdiPlusPath { NativeObject: var nativeObject }))
					{
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						nativeObject.Transform(dXMatrix2);
						WidenHelper.DrawPath(nativeObject, penInfo, graphics);
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)nativeObject)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						pen.ReplaceTransform(transform2);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.Transform = transform;
				pen.Width = width;
				if (penInfo.HasCaps)
				{
					penInfo.ResetCaps();
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool NeedPenBrushScale(DXPen pen)
		{
			DXBrush brush = pen.Brush;
			if (!(brush is DXTextureBrush) && !(brush is DXPathGradientBrush) && !(brush is DXLinearGradientBrush))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual Rectangle GetBounds()
		{
			return Path.GetBoundsExt();
		}

		public virtual RectangleF GetRealBounds(DXMatrix transform, IPlatformStroke stroke)
		{
			if (!(stroke is PenInfo { HasCaps: not false } penInfo))
			{
				return Path.GetBoundsExtF(transform, Stroke ? stroke : null);
			}
			return GetRealBoundsPathWithCaps(transform, penInfo);
		}

		protected internal RectangleF GetRealBoundsPathWithCaps(DXMatrix transform, PenInfo penInfo)
		{
			if (penInfo.HasCaps)
			{
				penInfo.ApplyCaps(scaleFactor);
			}
			DXPen pen = penInfo.Pen;
			float width = pen.Width;
			try
			{
				using IPlatformPath platformPath = Path.Clone();
				if (transform != null)
				{
					platformPath.Transform(transform);
				}
				pen.Width = penInfo.ConvertPenWidth(width, scaleFactor);
				DXMatrix transform2 = pen.Transform;
				pen.ScaleTransform(scaleFactor, scaleFactor, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
				try
				{
					float num = penInfo.ConvertToEmuSafe(1f);
					DXMatrix matrix = new DXMatrix(num, 0f, 0f, num, 0f, 0f);
					platformPath.Transform(matrix);
					RectangleF boundsExtF = platformPath.GetBoundsExtF(penInfo);
					RectangleF result = new RectangleF(boundsExtF.X / num, boundsExtF.Y / num, boundsExtF.Width / num, boundsExtF.Height / num);
					result.Inflate(1f, 1f);
					return result;
				}
				finally
				{
					pen.Transform = transform2;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				pen.Width = width;
				if (penInfo.HasCaps)
				{
					penInfo.ResetCaps();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual bool HitTest(Point logicalPoint, Pen pen, Matrix invertedShapeTransform)
		{
			GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = Path as GdiPlusPath;
			if (invertedShapeTransform != null)
			{
				logicalPoint = invertedShapeTransform.TransformPoint(logicalPoint);
			}
			if (Fill != null && gdiPlusPath.NativeObject.IsVisible(logicalPoint))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Stroke && pen != null && SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject).IsOutlineVisible(logicalPoint, pen))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		}

		public PathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, IPlatformFill fill, bool stroke, bool hasPermanentFill, float scaleFactor = 1f)
			: base(graphicsPath, fill, stroke, hasPermanentFill, scaleFactor)

		}
	}
	public class ConnectionShapePathInfo : PathInfo
	{
		public override bool AllowHitTest => true;

		public ConnectionShapePathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, float scaleFactor)
			: base(graphicsPath, null, stroke: true, scaleFactor)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawPath(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke stroke)
		{
			if (stroke is PenInfo penInfo)
			{
				DrawPathWithCaps(graphics, penInfo);
			}
		}
	}

	public interface IPlatformStroke : IDisposable
	{
		float PenWidth { get; }

		bool HasPermanentFill { get; }
	}
	public class PenInfo : IPlatformStroke, IDisposable
	{
		public delegate int LayoutUnitsToEmuConverter(float value);

		private delegate DXCustomLineCap CreateCustomCap(LineCapInfo capInfo, float capScaleFactor);

		private readonly float penWidth;

		public DXPen Pen { get; private set; }

		public DXBrush Brush { get; private set; }

		public float PenWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (Pen.Alignment != DXPenAlignment.Outset)
				{
					return penWidth;
				}
				return penWidth * 2f;
			}
		}

		public LayoutUnitsToEmuConverter Converter { get; set; }

		public bool HasPermanentFill { get; private set; }

		public bool HasCaps
		{
			get
			{
				if (StartCap == null)
				{
					return EndCap != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public LineCapInfo StartCap { get; set; }

		public LineCapInfo EndCap { get; set; }

		public PenInfo(DXPen pen, DXBrush brush, bool hasPermanentFill)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)pen, "Pen");
			Pen = pen;
			Brush = brush;
			HasPermanentFill = hasPermanentFill;
			penWidth = CalculatePenWidth();
		}

		private float CalculatePenWidth()
		{
			if (Pen.Brush is DXSolidBrush)
			{
				if (Pen.Color.A != 0)
				{
					return Pen.Width;
				}
				return 0f;
			}
			if (Pen.Brush is DXLinearGradientBrush)
			{
				DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush = (DXLinearGradientBrush)Brush;
				if (dXLinearGradientBrush.Blend != null)
				{
					return GetGradientBrushWidth(dXLinearGradientBrush.LinearColors);
				}
				return GetGradientBrushWidth(dXLinearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors);
			}
			if (Pen.Brush is DXPathGradientBrush)
			{
				return GetGradientBrushWidth(((DXPathGradientBrush)Brush).InterpolationColors);
			}
			return Pen.Width;
		}

		private float GetGradientBrushWidth(DXColorBlend colorBlend)
		{
			return GetGradientBrushWidth(colorBlend.Colors);
		}

		private float GetGradientBrushWidth(Color[] colors)
		{
			foreach (Color color in colors)
			{
				if (color.A > 0)
				{
					return Pen.Width;
				}
			}
			return 0f;
		}

		public void ApplyCaps(float scaleFactor)
		{
			CreateCustomCap createCap = (LineCapInfo capInfo, float capScaleFactor) => capInfo.CreateCap(capScaleFactor);
			ApplyCapsCore(scaleFactor, createCap);
		}

		public void ApplyBoundingCaps(float scaleFactor)
		{
			CreateCustomCap createCap = (LineCapInfo capInfo, float capScaleFactor) => capInfo.CreateBoundingCap(capScaleFactor);
			ApplyCapsCore(scaleFactor, createCap);
		}

		private void ApplyCapsCore(float scaleFactor, CreateCustomCap createCap)
		{
			if (Pen != null)
			{
				float capScaleFactor = CaculateCapScaleFactor(Pen.Width, scaleFactor);
				if (StartCap != null)
				{
					DXCustomLineCap customStartCap = createCap(StartCap, capScaleFactor);
					Pen.CustomStartCap = customStartCap;
				}
				if (EndCap != null)
				{
					DXCustomLineCap customEndCap = createCap(EndCap, capScaleFactor);
					Pen.CustomEndCap = customEndCap;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetCaps()
		{
			if (Pen != null)
			{
				if (Pen.StartCap == DXLineCap.Custom)
				{
					Pen.StartCap = DXLineCap.Flat;
				}
				if (Pen.EndCap == DXLineCap.Custom)
				{
					Pen.EndCap = DXLineCap.Flat;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (Pen != null)
			{
				Pen.Dispose();
				Pen = null;
			}
			if (StartCap != null)
			{
				StartCap.Dispose();
				StartCap = null;
			}
			if (EndCap != null)
			{
				EndCap.Dispose();
				EndCap = null;
			}
			if (Brush != null)
			{
				Brush.Dispose();
				Brush = null;
			}
		}

		internal float CaculateCapScaleFactor(float penWidth, float scaleFactor)
		{
			int num = ConvertPenWidth(penWidth, scaleFactor);
			int num2 = 25400;
			float result = 1f;
			if ((double)num != 0.0 && num2 > num)
			{
				result = (float)num2 / (float)num;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal int ConvertToEmuSafe(float value)
		{
			if (Converter == null)
			{
				return (int)value;
			}
			return Converter(value);
		}

		internal int ConvertPenWidth(float penWidth, float scaleFactor)
		{
			int num = ConvertToEmuSafe(penWidth);
			double num2 = 9525.0;
			double num3 = (double)scaleFactor / num2;
			int num4 = Floor((double)num * num3 + 0.5);
			if (num4 < 1)
			{
				num4 = 1;
			}
			return Normalize((double)num4 / num3);
		}

		private static int Floor(double d)
		{
			return (int)d;
		}

		private static int Normalize(double value)
		{
			double d = ((!(value < 0.0)) ? (value + 0.5) : (value - 0.5));
			return Floor(d);
		}
	}
	public class LineCapInfo : IDisposable
	{
		public OutlineHeadTailType Type { get; private set; }

		public DXGraphicsPath GraphicsPath { get; private set; }

		public DXGraphicsPath BoundingPath { get; private set; }

		public bool Filled { get; private set; }

		public float Inset { get; private set; }

		public LineCapInfo(OutlineHeadTailType type, DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath, DXGraphicsPath boundingPath, bool filled, float inset)
		{
			Type = type;
			GraphicsPath = graphicsPath;
			BoundingPath = boundingPath;
			Filled = filled;
			Inset = inset;
		}

		public DXCustomLineCap CreateCap(float scale)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GraphicsPath.Clone();
			TransformPath(dXGraphicsPath, scale);
			DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap = new DXCustomLineCap();
			dXCustomLineCap.FillPath = (Filled ? dXGraphicsPath.GetPathData() : null);
			dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath = (Filled ? null : dXGraphicsPath.GetPathData());
			dXCustomLineCap.BaseCap = DXLineCap.Round;
			dXCustomLineCap.BaseInset = Inset * scale;
			return dXCustomLineCap;
		}

		public DXCustomLineCap CreateBoundingCap(float scale)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = BoundingPath.Clone();
			TransformPath(dXGraphicsPath, scale);
			DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap = new DXCustomLineCap();
			dXCustomLineCap.FillPath = dXGraphicsPath.GetPathData();
			dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath = null;
			dXCustomLineCap.BaseCap = DXLineCap.Round;
			dXCustomLineCap.BaseInset = Inset * scale;
			return dXCustomLineCap;
		}

		private void TransformPath(DXGraphicsPath path, float scale)
		{
			if (scale != 1f)
			{
				DXMatrix matrix = new DXMatrix(scale, 0f, 0f, scale, 0f, 0f);
				path.Transform(matrix);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (GraphicsPath != null)
			{
				GraphicsPath.Dispose();
				GraphicsPath = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class TextRunPathInfo : PathInfoBase
	{
		public IPlatformStroke PenInfo { get; private set; }

		public TextRunPathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, IPlatformFill fill, IPlatformStroke penInfo)
			: base(graphicsPath, fill, penInfo != null)
		{
			PenInfo = penInfo;
		}

		public override void Draw(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			if (base.Path is PureTextInfo pureTextInfo)
			{
				if (pureTextInfo.FontScale != 1f)
				{
					DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform;
					try
					{
						graphics.TranslateTransform(pureTextInfo.Location.X, pureTextInfo.Location.Y);
						graphics.ScaleTransform(pureTextInfo.FontScale, pureTextInfo.FontScale);
						graphics.DrawString(pureTextInfo.Text, pureTextInfo.Font, pureTextInfo.Brush, PointF.Empty, DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic());
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					graphics.Transform = transform;
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						graphics.DrawString(pureTextInfo.Text, pureTextInfo.Font, pureTextInfo.Brush, pureTextInfo.Location, DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic());
						return;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			base.Draw(graphics, PenInfo, shapeTransform);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && PenInfo != null)
			{
				PenInfo.Dispose();
				PenInfo = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldDrawGlowPath()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class TextLinePathInfo : TextRunPathInfo
	{
		public TextLinePathInfo(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, IPlatformFill fill, IPlatformStroke penInfo)
			: base(graphicsPath, fill, penInfo)

		}

		public override void Draw(IDXGraphics graphics, IPlatformStroke penInfo, DXMatrix shapeTransform)

			graphics.SmoothingMode = DXSmoothingMode.None;
			base.Draw(graphics, penInfo, shapeTransform);
			graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingMode;
		}
	}

			GraphicsPath = graphicsPath;
			HasFill = hasFill;
