	public class HitTestInfoCollection : List<HitTestInfo>, IDisposable
	{
		public void Dispose()
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					HitTestInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					current.Dispose();
				}
			}
			Clear();
		}
	}
	public class ShapeEffectBuildHelper
	{
		private readonly ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo;

		protected ShapeLayoutInfo ShapeLayoutInfo
		{
			[DebuggerStepThrough]
			get
			{
				return shapeLayoutInfo;
			}
		}

		public ShapeEffectBuildHelper(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
		{
			this.shapeLayoutInfo = shapeLayoutInfo;
		}

		public virtual Rectangle CalculateShadowTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags = GraphicsPathCollectFlags.FigureWithoutEffects | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInvisiblePaths;
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.Skia)
			{
				using (DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath = GetTransformedFigure(flags, rotateWithShape, additionalSize))
				{
					return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExt();
				}
			}
			using GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(GetTransformedFigure(flags, rotateWithShape, additionalSize));
			return graphicsPath2.GetBoundsExt();
		}

		public virtual Rectangle CalculateReflectionTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = ShapeLayoutInfo.Paths.CollectFigure(GraphicsPathCollectFlags.FigureWithoutEffects | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInvisiblePaths);
			if (ShapeLayoutInfo.PenWidth > 0f && GdipExtensions.AllowPathWidening(dXGraphicsPath) && ShapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo is PenInfo { Pen: var pen })
			{
				if (pen.Alignment == DXPenAlignment.Outset)
				{
					using DXPen dXPen = pen.Clone();
					dXPen.Width = ShapeLayoutInfo.PenWidth;
					WidenHelper.Apply(dXGraphicsPath, dXPen);
				}
				else
				{
					WidenHelper.Apply(dXGraphicsPath, pen);
				}
			}
			DXMatrix shapeTransform = ShapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform;
			if (!rotateWithShape && shapeTransform != null)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Transform(shapeTransform);
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath.GetBoundsExt();
		}

		public virtual DXGraphicsPath GetPreparedForShadowFigure(DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags = GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeOuterShadow | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInnerShadow | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeReflection;
			DXGraphicsPath transformedFigure = GetTransformedFigure(flags, rotateWithShape, additionalSize);
			transformedFigure.Transform(shadowTransform);
			return transformedFigure;
		}

		public virtual DXGraphicsPath GetPreparedForReflectionFigure(DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags = GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeOuterShadow | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInnerShadow | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeReflection;
			DXGraphicsPath transformedFigure = GetTransformedFigure(flags, rotateWithShape, additionalSize);
			ShapeLayoutInfo.AddShadowToReflection(transformedFigure);
			transformedFigure.Transform(shadowTransform);
			return transformedFigure;
		}

		protected DXGraphicsPath GetTransformedFigure(GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = ShapeLayoutInfo.Paths.CollectFigure(flags);
			WidenFigure(dXGraphicsPath, additionalSize);
			DXMatrix shapeTransform = ShapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform;
			if (!rotateWithShape && shapeTransform != null)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.Transform(shapeTransform);
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		public virtual Rectangle GetGlowBounds(EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix parentTransform)
		{
			GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags = GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInvisiblePaths | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInnerShadow;
			using DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath = GetTransformedFigure(flags, rotateWithShape: true, additionalSize);
			return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExt(parentTransform);
		}

		public virtual void DrawGlow(IDXGraphics graphics, Color color, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			PathInfoBase[] pathInfos = ShapeLayoutInfo.GetPathInfos();
			additionalSize.AddSize(ShapeLayoutInfo);
			float penWidth = ShapeLayoutInfo.PenWidth;
			float width = penWidth + additionalSize.TotalSize;
			using DXSolidBrush glowBrush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
			PenInfo penInfo = ShapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo as PenInfo;
			DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform;
			using (DXPen glowPen = GlowEffectHelper.CreatePen(color, width, penInfo))
			{
				if (shapeTransform != null)
				{
					graphics.MultiplyTransform(shapeTransform);
				}
				DXRegion clip = graphics.GetClip();
				ShapeLayoutInfo.SetGlowClip(graphics, additionalSize.GlowSize);
				PathInfoBase[] array = pathInfos;
				foreach (PathInfoBase pathInfo in array)
				{
					DrawGlow(graphics, pathInfo, glowBrush, glowPen, penWidth);
				}
				graphics.SetClip(clip);
			}
			graphics.Transform = transform;
		}

		private void DrawGlow(IDXGraphics graphics, PathInfoBase pathInfo, DXSolidBrush glowBrush, DXPen glowPen, float penWidth)
		{
			GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = pathInfo.Path as GdiPlusPath;
			BrushInfo brushInfo = pathInfo.Fill as BrushInfo;
			DXGraphicsPath path = gdiPlusPath?.NativeObject;
			DXBrush brush = brushInfo?.Brush;
			if (pathInfo.Filled)
			{
				FillGlowPath(graphics, path, brush, glowBrush);
			}
			if (pathInfo.ShouldDrawGlowPath())
			{
				if (penWidth > 0f)
				{
					DrawGlowPath(graphics, path, glowPen);
				}
				else if (pathInfo.Filled)
				{
					graphics.DrawPath(glowPen, path);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillGlowPath(IDXGraphics graphics, DXGraphicsPath path, DXBrush brush, DXSolidBrush glowBrush)
		{
			if (brush is DXSolidBrush && ((DXSolidBrush)brush).Color.A == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (brush is DXLinearGradientBrush || brush is DXPathGradientBrush)
			{
				using DXBrush dXBrush = GlowEffectHelper.ConvertGradientBrushWithTransparentColors(brush, glowBrush.Color);
				if (dXBrush != null)
				{
					graphics.FillPath(dXBrush, path);
					return;
				}
			}
			graphics.FillPath(glowBrush, path);
		}

		private void DrawGlowPath(IDXGraphics graphics, DXGraphicsPath path, DXPen glowPen)
		{
			if (!(shapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo is PenInfo { Pen: var pen } penInfo))
			{
				return;
			}
			DXBrush brush = pen.Brush;
			if (brush is DXLinearGradientBrush || brush is DXPathGradientBrush)
			{
				using DXBrush gradientBrush = GlowEffectHelper.ConvertGradientBrushWithTransparentColors(penInfo.Brush, glowPen.Color);
				using DXPen dXPen = CreateGradientPen(pen, gradientBrush, glowPen.Width);
				if (dXPen != null)
				{
					graphics.DrawPath(dXPen, path);
					return;
				}
			}
			graphics.DrawPath(glowPen, path);
		}

		private DXPen CreateGradientPen(DXPen pen, DXBrush gradientBrush, float width)
		{
			DXPen dXPen = null;
			if (gradientBrush != null)
			{
				dXPen = pen.Clone();
				dXPen.Width = width;
				dXPen.Brush = gradientBrush;
			}
			return dXPen;
		}

		public virtual Rectangle GetBlurEffectBounds(DXMatrix parentTransform, bool applyTransform, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags = GraphicsPathCollectFlags.FigureWithoutEffects | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInvisiblePaths;
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.Skia)
			{
				using (DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath = GetTransformedFigure(flags, !applyTransform, additionalSize))
				{
					return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExt(parentTransform);
				}
			}
			using GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(GetTransformedFigure(flags, !applyTransform, additionalSize));
			return graphicsPath2.GetBoundsExt(SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMatrix(parentTransform));
		}

		public virtual Rectangle GetSoftEdgeBounds()
		{
			GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags = GraphicsPathCollectFlags.FigureWithoutEffects | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInvisiblePaths;
			using DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath = GetTransformedFigure(flags, rotateWithShape: false, EffectAdditionalSize.Default);
			return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExt();
		}

		protected virtual void WidenFigure(DXGraphicsPath figure, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			additionalSize.AddSize(ShapeLayoutInfo);
			float num = ShapeLayoutInfo.PenWidth + additionalSize.TotalSize;
			if (num > 0f && GdipExtensions.AllowPathWidening(figure))
			{
				using (DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, num))
				{
					dXPen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Round;
					WidenHelper.Apply(figure, dXPen);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ConnectionShapeEffectBuildHelper : ShapeEffectBuildHelper
	{
		public ConnectionShapeEffectBuildHelper(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
			: base(shapeLayoutInfo)
		{
		}

		public override Rectangle CalculateShadowTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GetSourceFigure(!rotateWithShape);
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			WidenFigure(dXGraphicsPath, additionalSize);
			return dXGraphicsPath.GetBoundsExt();
		}

		public override Rectangle CalculateReflectionTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GetSourceFigureWithCapBounds(!rotateWithShape);
			return dXGraphicsPath?.GetBoundsExt() ?? Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath GetPreparedForShadowFigure(DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath sourceFigure = GetSourceFigure(!rotateWithShape);
			if (sourceFigure == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WidenFigure(sourceFigure, additionalSize);
			sourceFigure.Transform(shadowTransform);
			return sourceFigure;
		}

		public override DXGraphicsPath GetPreparedForReflectionFigure(DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath sourceFigureWithCapBounds = GetSourceFigureWithCapBounds(!rotateWithShape);
			if (sourceFigureWithCapBounds == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WidenFigure(sourceFigureWithCapBounds, additionalSize);
			base.ShapeLayoutInfo.AddShadowToReflection(sourceFigureWithCapBounds);
			sourceFigureWithCapBounds.Transform(shadowTransform);
			return sourceFigureWithCapBounds;
		}

		public override Rectangle GetGlowBounds(EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix parentTransform)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GetSourceFigure(applyTransform: false);
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			WidenFigure(dXGraphicsPath, additionalSize);
			return dXGraphicsPath.GetBoundsExt(parentTransform);
		}

		public override void DrawGlow(IDXGraphics graphics, Color color, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix shapeTransform)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GetSourceFigure(applyTransform: false);
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			additionalSize.AddSize(base.ShapeLayoutInfo);
			DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform;
			using (DXRegion region = graphics.GetClip())
			{
				if (shapeTransform != null)
				{
					graphics.MultiplyTransform(shapeTransform);
				}
				base.ShapeLayoutInfo.SetGlowClip(graphics, additionalSize.GlowSize);
				using (DXBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(color))
				{
					using DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(color, additionalSize.TotalSize);
					dXPen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Round;
					graphics.FillPath(brush, dXGraphicsPath);
					graphics.DrawPath(dXPen, dXGraphicsPath);
				}
				graphics.SetClip(region);
			}
			graphics.Transform = transform;
		}

		public override Rectangle GetBlurEffectBounds(DXMatrix parentTransform, bool applyTransform, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GetSourceFigure(applyTransform);
			if (dXGraphicsPath == null)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			WidenFigure(dXGraphicsPath, additionalSize);
			return dXGraphicsPath.GetBoundsExt(parentTransform);
		}

		public override Rectangle GetSoftEdgeBounds()
		{
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GetSourceFigure(applyTransform: false);
			return dXGraphicsPath?.GetBoundsExt() ?? Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		protected override void WidenFigure(DXGraphicsPath figure, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			additionalSize.AddSize(base.ShapeLayoutInfo);
			float totalSize = additionalSize.TotalSize;
			if (totalSize > 0f && GdipExtensions.AllowPathWidening(figure))
			{
				using (DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, totalSize))
				{
					dXPen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Round;
					WidenHelper.Apply(figure, dXPen);
				}
			}
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath GetSourceFigureWithCapBounds(bool applyTransform)
		{
			PenInfo penInfo = base.ShapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo as PenInfo;
			float penWidth = base.ShapeLayoutInfo.PenWidth;
			if (penWidth == 0f || penInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetSourceFigureCore(applyTransform, penInfo.ApplyBoundingCaps, penWidth, applyBoundingCaps: true);
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath GetSourceFigure(bool applyTransform)
		{
			PenInfo penInfo = base.ShapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo as PenInfo;
			float penWidth = base.ShapeLayoutInfo.PenWidth;
			if (penWidth == 0f || penInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetSourceFigureCore(applyTransform, penInfo.ApplyCaps, penWidth, applyBoundingCaps: false);
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath GetSourceFigureCore(bool applyTransform, Action<float> applyCaps, float penWidth, bool applyBoundingCaps)
		{
			if (!(base.ShapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo is PenInfo { Pen: var pen } penInfo))
			{
				return null;
			}
			float scaleFactor = base.ShapeLayoutInfo.ScaleFactor;
			if (penInfo.HasCaps)
			{
				applyCaps(scaleFactor);
			}
			try
			{
				ConnectionShapePathInfo pathInfo = base.ShapeLayoutInfo.Paths.GetPathInfo<ConnectionShapePathInfo>();
				GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = (GdiPlusPath)pathInfo.Path.Clone();
				DXGraphicsPath nativeObject = gdiPlusPath.NativeObject;
				DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix(1f / scaleFactor, 0f, 0f, 1f / scaleFactor, 0f, 0f);
				DXMatrix shapeTransform = base.ShapeLayoutInfo.ShapeTransform;
				if (applyTransform && shapeTransform != null)
				{
					nativeObject.Transform(shapeTransform);
					nativeObject.Transform(dXMatrix);
				}
				dXMatrix.Invert();
				float num = penInfo.ConvertToEmuSafe(1f);
				pen.Width = penInfo.ConvertPenWidth(penWidth, scaleFactor);
				DXMatrix dXMatrix2 = new DXMatrix(num, 0f, 0f, num, 0f, 0f);
				nativeObject.Transform(dXMatrix2);
				if (GdipExtensions.AllowPathWidening(nativeObject))
				{
					WidenHelper.Apply(nativeObject, penInfo, applyBoundingCaps, applyTransform ? dXMatrix : null);
				}
				dXMatrix2.Invert();
				nativeObject.Transform(dXMatrix2);
				return nativeObject;
			}
			finally
			{
				pen.Width = penWidth;
				if (penInfo.HasCaps)
				{
					penInfo.ResetCaps();
				}
			}
		}

		private GraphicsPath GetSourceFigureCoreOld(bool applyTransform, Action<float> applyCaps, float penWidth, bool applyBoundingCaps)
		{
			return SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(GetSourceFigureCore(applyTransform, applyCaps, penWidth, applyBoundingCaps));
		}
	}
	public class SoftEdgesOpacityMaskCreator
	{
		private readonly ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo;

		public SoftEdgesOpacityMaskCreator(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
		{
			this.shapeLayoutInfo = shapeLayoutInfo;
		}

		public DXBitmap Create(DXBitmap figureBitmap, Rectangle bounds, float radius, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter converter)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = null;
			using (DXRegion dXRegion = GetSoftEdgeClipRegion(figureBitmap, bounds, radius, converter))
			{
				if (dXRegion != null)
				{
					dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(bounds.Size, converter);
					using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(dXBitmap, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, 1f);
					iDXGraphics.SetClip(dXRegion);
					iDXGraphics.TranslateTransform(-bounds.Left, -bounds.Top);
					iDXGraphics.DrawImage(figureBitmap, bounds.Location.X, bounds.Location.Y);
				}
			}
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		private DXRegion GetSoftEdgeClipRegion(DXBitmap figureBitmap, Rectangle bounds, float radius, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter converter)
		{
			float num = 2f * radius;
			if (num > (float)bounds.Width || num > (float)bounds.Height)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXRegion dXRegion = null;
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = GetOutlinePath(figureBitmap);
			using DXPen dXPen = GetCropPen(shapeLayoutInfo.PenWidth);
			dXRegion = new DXRegion(dXGraphicsPath);
			dXPen.Width = converter.LayoutUnitsToPixelsF(num);
			if (GdipExtensions.AllowPathWidening(dXGraphicsPath))
			{
				WidenHelper.Apply(dXGraphicsPath, dXPen);
			}
			dXRegion.Exclude(dXGraphicsPath);
			return dXRegion;
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath GetOutlinePath(DXBitmap bitmap)
		{
			BitmapOutlineFinder bitmapOutlineFinder = new BitmapOutlineFinder();
			List<PointF[]> list = bitmapOutlineFinder.Process(bitmap);
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			foreach (PointF[] item in list)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddPolygon(item);
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private DXPen GetCropPen(float penWidth)
		{
			PenInfo penInfo = shapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo as PenInfo;
			if (penWidth > 0f && penInfo != null)
			{
				DXPen dXPen = penInfo.Pen.Clone();
				dXPen.Color = Color.Black;
				return dXPen;
			}
			return new DXPen(Color.Black);
		}
	}
	public class SoftEdgesBlurRenderer : AlphaBlurEffectRenderer
	{
		private byte[] valuesBitmap;

		public static DXBitmap ApplyBlur(DXBitmap bitmap, DXBitmap opacityMask, int blurRadius)
		{
			return new SoftEdgesBlurRenderer().DrawCore(bitmap, opacityMask, blurRadius);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private DXBitmap DrawCore(DXBitmap bitmap, DXBitmap opacityMask, int blurRadius)
		{
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = bitmap.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite);
			int num = iDXBitmapData.RowBytes * bitmap.Height;
			valuesBitmap = new byte[num];
			Marshal.Copy(iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, valuesBitmap, 0, num);
			if (isNotWindowsSkia)
			{
				Unpremultiply(valuesBitmap, valuesBitmap.Length / 4);
			}
			ApplyBlur(opacityMask, opacityMask.Width, opacityMask.Height, blurRadius);
			if (isNotWindowsSkia)
			{
				Premultiply(valuesBitmap, valuesBitmap.Length / 4);
			}
			opacityMask.Dispose();
			Marshal.Copy(valuesBitmap, 0, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, num);
			return bitmap;
		}

		protected override void SetPixelVertical(byte[] target, int position, int alphaSum, double coeff)
		{
			byte b = valuesBitmap[position + 3];
			if (b > 0)
			{
				byte colorValue = GetColorValue(alphaSum, coeff);
				valuesBitmap[position + 3] = (byte)(b * colorValue / 255);
			}
		}
	}
	public class BitmapOutlineFinder
	{
		private enum Direction
		{
			Top,
			TopRight,
			Right,
			BottomRight,
			Bottom,
			BottomLeft,
			Left,
			TopLeft
		}

		private class OutlineData
		{
			private bool[] points;

			private readonly int width;

			private int count;

			public int Count => count;

			public bool this[int x, int y]
			{
				get
				{
					return points[y * width + x];
				}
				set
				{
					int num = y * width + x;
					if (points[num] != value)
					{
						points[num] = value;
						if (value)
						{
							Interlocked.Increment(ref count);
						}
						else
						{
							count--;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public OutlineData(int width, int height)
			{
				this.width = width;
				points = new bool[width * height];
			}

			public Point GetFirstPoint()
			{
				int num = IListExtensions.FindIndex<bool>((IList<bool>)points, (Predicate<bool>)((bool x) => x));
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return new Point(-1, -1);
				}
				return new Point(num % width, num / width);
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<Direction, Point> pointOffsets = CreatePointOffsets();

		private byte[] visited;

		private int width;

		private int height;

		private OutlineData outlineData;

		private readonly Point zeroPoint = new Point(-1, -1);

		private const int directionsCount = 8;

		private static Dictionary<Direction, Point> CreatePointOffsets()
		{
			Dictionary<Direction, Point> dictionary = new Dictionary<Direction, Point>();
			dictionary.Add(Direction.Top, new Point(0, -1));
			dictionary.Add(Direction.TopRight, new Point(1, -1));
			dictionary.Add(Direction.Right, new Point(1, 0));
			dictionary.Add(Direction.BottomRight, new Point(1, 1));
			dictionary.Add(Direction.Bottom, new Point(0, 1));
			dictionary.Add(Direction.BottomLeft, new Point(-1, 1));
			dictionary.Add(Direction.Left, new Point(-1, 0));
			dictionary.Add(Direction.TopLeft, new Point(-1, -1));
			return dictionary;
		}

		public List<PointF[]> Process(DXBitmap bitmap)
		{
			width = bitmap.Width;
			height = bitmap.Height;
			int size = width * height;
			InitializeOutlineData(bitmap, size);
			return FindRegions(size);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void InitializeOutlineData(DXBitmap bitmap, int size)
		{
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = bitmap.GetBitmapData();
			byte[] array = new byte[size * 4];
			Marshal.Copy(iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, array, 0, array.Length);
			outlineData = GetOutlineData(array, iDXBitmapData.RowBytes);
		}

		private List<PointF[]> FindRegions(int size)
		{
			List<PointF[]> list = new List<PointF[]>();
			while (outlineData.Count > 0)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				visited = new byte[size];
				List<PointF> list2 = new List<PointF>();
				Point firstPoint = outlineData.GetFirstPoint();
				list2.Add(firstPoint);
				Point point = firstPoint;
				int num = point.Y * width + point.X;
				do
				{
					Point nextOrBackPoint = GetNextOrBackPoint(point, firstPoint, num);
					if (nextOrBackPoint == zeroPoint)
					{
						flag = false;
						continue;
					}
					point = nextOrBackPoint;
					num = point.Y * width + point.X;
					visited[num]++;
					list2.Add(point);
				}
				while (!point.Equals(firstPoint) && flag);
				foreach (PointF item in list2)
				{
					outlineData[(int)item.X, (int)item.Y] = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(list2.ToArray());
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private Point GetNextOrBackPoint(Point current, Point firstPoint, int position)
		{
			Point point;
			if (visited[position] < 2)
			{
				point = GetNextPoint(current, firstPoint);
				if (point == zeroPoint)
				{
					point = GetNextPointBackwards(current);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				point = GetNextPointBackwards(current);
			}
			return point;
		}

		private Point GetNeighbourPoint(Point point, int direction)
		{
			Point point2 = pointOffsets[(Direction)direction];
			return new Point(point.X + point2.X, point.Y + point2.Y);
		}

		private Point GetNextPoint(Point currentPoint, Point firstPoint)
		{
			Point result = zeroPoint;
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
			{
				Point neighbourPoint = GetNeighbourPoint(currentPoint, i);
				if (!IsNotVisitedOutlinePoint(neighbourPoint))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (neighbourPoint.Equals(firstPoint))
				{
					if (result.Equals(zeroPoint))
					{
						result = firstPoint;
					}
					continue;
				}
				int notVisitedNeigboursCount = GetNotVisitedNeigboursCount(neighbourPoint);
				if (notVisitedNeigboursCount < num)
				{
					num = notVisitedNeigboursCount;
					result = neighbourPoint;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private int GetNotVisitedNeigboursCount(Point point)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
			{
				Point neighbourPoint = GetNeighbourPoint(point, i);
				if (IsNotVisitedOutlinePoint(neighbourPoint))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool IsOutlinePoint(int x, int y)
		{
			if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < width && y < height)
			{
				return outlineData[x, y];
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsNotVisitedOutlinePoint(Point point)
		{
			int x = point.X;
			int y = point.Y;
			if (IsOutlinePoint(x, y))
			{
				return visited[y * width + x] == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Point GetNextPointBackwards(Point position)
		{
			Point point = zeroPoint;
			int num = 0;
			for (int num2 = 7; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				Point neighbourPoint = GetNeighbourPoint(position, num2);
				int x = neighbourPoint.X;
				int y = neighbourPoint.Y;
				if (IsOutlinePoint(x, y))
				{
					int num3 = visited[y * width + x];
					if (num3 == 0)
					{
						return neighbourPoint;
					}
					if (point == zeroPoint || num > num3)
					{
						point = neighbourPoint;
						num = num3;
					}
				}
			}
			return point;
		}

		private OutlineData GetOutlineData(byte[] bytes, int stride)
		{
			OutlineData result = new OutlineData(width, height);
			Parallel.For(0, height, delegate(int y)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < width; i++)
				{
					flag2 = bytes[y * stride + i * 4 + 3] == 0;
					if ((i == 0 || i == width - 1 || flag) && !flag2)
					{
						result[i, y] = true;
					}
					if (!flag && flag2 && i != 0)
					{
						result[i - 1, y] = true;
					}
					flag = flag2;
				}
			});
			Parallel.For(0, width, delegate(int x)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
				{
					flag2 = bytes[i * stride + x * 4 + 3] == 0;
					if ((i == 0 || i == height - 1 || flag) && !flag2)
					{
						result[x, i] = true;
					}
					if (!flag && flag2 && i != 0)
					{
						result[x, i - 1] = true;
					}
					flag = flag2;
				}
			});
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class GeometryPathToPlatformPathConverter : IPathInstructionWalker
	{
		private readonly ModelShapePath path;

		private readonly float scaleX;

		private readonly float scaleY;

		private readonly int left;

		private readonly int top;

		private double lastX;

		private double lastY;

		public IPlatformPath CrossPlatformPath { get; private set; }

		public GeometryPathToPlatformPathConverter(ModelShapePath path, Rectangle bounding, float workbookDefaultScale)
		{
			this.path = path;
			scaleX = ((path.Width == 0L) ? workbookDefaultScale : ((float)bounding.Width / (float)path.Width));
			scaleY = ((path.Height == 0L) ? workbookDefaultScale : ((float)bounding.Height / (float)path.Height));
			left = bounding.Left;
			top = bounding.Top;
		}

		public void Walk()
		{
			CrossPlatformPath = PlatformShapeRenderDependencies.Instance.Path.CreatePath(CrossPlatformFillMode.Winding);
			foreach (IPathInstruction instruction in path.Instructions)
			{
				instruction.Visit(this);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(PathArc pathArc)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(PathClose value)
		{
			CrossPlatformPath.ClosePath();
			CrossPlatformPath.StartPath();
		}

		public void Visit(PathCubicBezier value)
		{
			double[] array = new double[4];
			double[] array2 = new double[4];
			array[0] = lastX;
			array2[0] = lastY;
			for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++)
			{
				array[i] = value.Points[i - 1].X.ValueEMU;
				array2[i] = value.Points[i - 1].Y.ValueEMU;
			}
			CrossPlatformPath.AddCubicBezierPath((float)left + EMUToLayoutUnitsX(array[0]), (float)top + EMUToLayoutUnitsY(array2[0]), (float)left + EMUToLayoutUnitsX(array[1]), (float)top + EMUToLayoutUnitsY(array2[1]), (float)left + EMUToLayoutUnitsX(array[2]), (float)top + EMUToLayoutUnitsY(array2[2]), (float)left + EMUToLayoutUnitsX(array[3]), (float)top + EMUToLayoutUnitsY(array2[3]));
			lastX = array[3];
			lastY = array2[3];
		}

		public void Visit(PathLine pathLine)
		{
			double valueEMU = pathLine.Point.X.ValueEMU;
			double valueEMU2 = pathLine.Point.Y.ValueEMU;
			CrossPlatformPath.AddLinePath((float)left + EMUToLayoutUnitsX(lastX), (float)top + EMUToLayoutUnitsY(lastY), (float)left + EMUToLayoutUnitsX(valueEMU), (float)top + EMUToLayoutUnitsY(valueEMU2));
			lastX = valueEMU;
			lastY = valueEMU2;
		}

		public void Visit(PathMove pathMove)
		{
			double valueEMU = pathMove.Point.X.ValueEMU;
			double valueEMU2 = pathMove.Point.Y.ValueEMU;
			lastX = valueEMU;
			lastY = valueEMU2;
			CrossPlatformPath.AddMovePath((float)left + EMUToLayoutUnitsX(lastX), (float)top + EMUToLayoutUnitsY(lastY));
		}

		public void Visit(PathQuadraticBezier value)
		{
		}

		private static float EMUToLayoutUnits(double emu, float delta)
		{
			return (float)(emu * (double)delta);
		}

		private float EMUToLayoutUnitsX(double emu)
		{
			return EMUToLayoutUnits(emu, scaleX);
		}

		private float EMUToLayoutUnitsY(double emu)
		{
			return EMUToLayoutUnits(emu, scaleY);
		}
	}
	public static class InnerShadowRenderer
	{
		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void ApplyShadow(DXBitmap figure, DXBitmap shadowOpacityMask, Color originalShadowColor)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(0, 0, figure.Width, figure.Height);
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = figure.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite);
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData2 = shadowOpacityMask.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite);
			int num = iDXBitmapData.RowBytes * figure.Height;
			byte[] valuesFigure = new byte[num];
			byte[] valuesShadowOpacityMask = new byte[num];
			Marshal.Copy(iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, valuesFigure, 0, num);
			Marshal.Copy(iDXBitmapData2.DataPointer, valuesShadowOpacityMask, 0, num);
			GdipExtensions.IterateBitmapBytes(num, delegate(int i)
			{
				Color color = GetColor(valuesFigure, i);
				if (color.A > 0)
				{
					Color resultColor = GetResultColor(color, originalShadowColor, valuesShadowOpacityMask[i + 3]);
					if (resultColor.A > 0)
					{
						valuesFigure[i] = resultColor.B;
						valuesFigure[i + 1] = resultColor.G;
						valuesFigure[i + 2] = resultColor.R;
						valuesFigure[i + 3] = resultColor.A;
					}
				}
			});
			Marshal.Copy(valuesFigure, 0, iDXBitmapData.DataPointer, num);
		}

		private static Color GetColor(byte[] array, int i)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(array[i + 3], array[i + 2], array[i + 1], array[i]);
		}

		private static Color GetResultColor(Color fillColor, Color shadowColor, byte opacity)
		{
			Color background = CalculateMixedFillColor(fillColor, shadowColor);
			Color baseColor = CalculateMixedShadowColor(fillColor, shadowColor);
			Color color = ConvertRgbaToRgb(background, Color.FromArgb(opacity, baseColor));
			byte a = fillColor.A;
			if (a > 0 && a < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				color = ConvertRgbToRgba(color, a);
			}
			return color;
		}

		private static Color CalculateMixedFillColor(Color fillColor, Color shadowColor)
		{
			byte a = fillColor.A;
			byte alpha = Convert.ToByte(((float)(int)a - (float)(a * a) / 255f) * ((float)(int)shadowColor.A / 255f));
			Color foreground = MixColors(fillColor, Color.FromArgb(alpha, shadowColor));
			return ConvertRgbaToRgb(Color.White, foreground);
		}

		private static Color CalculateMixedShadowColor(Color fillColor, Color shadowColor)
		{
			byte alpha = Convert.ToByte((float)(fillColor.A * shadowColor.A) / 255f);
			Color foreground = MixColors(fillColor, Color.FromArgb(alpha, shadowColor));
			return ConvertRgbaToRgb(Color.White, foreground);
		}

		private static Color ConvertRgbaToRgb(Color background, Color foreground)
		{
			float num = (float)(int)foreground.A / 255f;
			double r = Math.Round((float)(int)background.R * (1f - num) + (float)(int)foreground.R * num);
			double g = Math.Round((float)(int)background.G * (1f - num) + (float)(int)foreground.G * num);
			double b = Math.Round((float)(int)background.B * (1f - num) + (float)(int)foreground.B * num);
			return CreateColor(1f, r, g, b);
		}

		private static Color ConvertRgbToRgba(Color color, byte fillAlpha)
		{
			int val = 255 - Math.Min(color.R, Math.Min(color.B, color.G));
			float num = (float)Math.Max(fillAlpha, val) / 255f;
			double r = Math.Round(255f - (float)(255 - color.R) / num);
			double g = Math.Round(255f - (float)(255 - color.G) / num);
			double b = Math.Round(255f - (float)(255 - color.B) / num);
			return CreateColor(num, r, g, b);
		}

		private static Color MixColors(Color background, Color foreground)
		{
			float num = (float)(int)background.A / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(int)foreground.A / 255f;
			float num3 = 1f - (1f - num) * (1f - num2);
			if (num3 == 0f)
			{
				return Color.Empty;
			}
			double r = Math.Round(((float)(int)foreground.R * num2 + (float)(int)background.R * num * (1f - num2)) / num3);
			double g = Math.Round(((float)(int)foreground.G * num2 + (float)(int)background.G * num * (1f - num2)) / num3);
			double b = Math.Round(((float)(int)foreground.B * num2 + (float)(int)background.B * num * (1f - num2)) / num3);
			return CreateColor(num3, r, g, b);
		}

		private static Color CreateColor(float a, double r, double g, double b)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(Convert.ToByte(a * 255f), Convert.ToByte(r), Convert.ToByte(g), Convert.ToByte(b));
		}
	}
	public static class ReflectionRenderer
	{
		internal static void ProcessReflection(DXBitmap reflection, ReflectionOpacityInfo opacityInfo, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			double startPosition = DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(opacityInfo.StartPosition);
			double endPosition = DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(opacityInfo.EndPosition);
			byte startAlpha = Convert.ToByte(DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(opacityInfo.StartOpacity) * 255.0);
			byte endAlpha = Convert.ToByte(DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(opacityInfo.EndOpacity) * 255.0);
			float fadeDirection = (float)DrawingValueConverter.FromPositiveFixedAngle(opacityInfo.FadeDirection);
			using DXBitmap gradient = CreateGradientLayer(reflection.Width, reflection.Height, startAlpha, endAlpha, startPosition, endPosition, fadeDirection, layoutUnitConverter);
			ProcessReflectionCore(reflection, gradient);
		}

		private static DXBitmap CreateGradientLayer(int width, int height, byte startAlpha, byte endAlpha, double startPosition, double endPosition, float fadeDirection, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			using DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush = new DXLinearGradientBrush(new Rectangle(0, 0, width, height), Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0), Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0), fadeDirection);
			dXLinearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = CreateColorBlend(startAlpha, endAlpha, startPosition, endPosition);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmapCore(new Size(width, height), layoutUnitConverter);
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics())
			{
				iDXGraphics.FillRectangle(dXLinearGradientBrush, 0f, 0f, width, height);
			}
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		private static DXColorBlend CreateColorBlend(byte startAlpha, byte endAlpha, double startPosition, double endPosition)
		{
			List<float> list = new List<float>();
			List<Color> list2 = new List<Color>();
			list.Add(0f);
			if (startPosition != 0.0)
			{
				list.Add((float)startPosition);
				list2.Add(Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0));
			}
			list2.Add(Color.FromArgb(startAlpha, 0, 0, 0));
			list2.Add(Color.FromArgb(endAlpha, 0, 0, 0));
			if (endPosition != 1.0)
			{
				list.Add((float)endPosition);
				list2.Add(Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0));
			}
			list.Add(1f);
			DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = new DXColorBlend(list.Count);
			dXColorBlend.Colors = list2.ToArray();
			dXColorBlend.Positions = list.ToArray();
			return dXColorBlend;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void ProcessReflectionCore(DXBitmap reflection, DXBitmap gradient)
		{
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData = reflection.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite);
			using IDXBitmapData iDXBitmapData2 = gradient.GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadWrite);
			int rowBytes = iDXBitmapData.RowBytes;
			int height = reflection.Height;
			int num = rowBytes * height;
			byte[] valuesReflection = new byte[num];
			byte[] valuesGradient = new byte[num];
			IntPtr dataPointer = iDXBitmapData.DataPointer;
			IntPtr dataPointer2 = iDXBitmapData2.DataPointer;
			Marshal.Copy(dataPointer, valuesReflection, 0, num);
			Marshal.Copy(dataPointer2, valuesGradient, 0, num);
			GdipExtensions.IterateBitmapBytes(num, delegate(int i)
			{
				byte b = valuesGradient[i + 3];
				byte b2 = valuesReflection[i + 3];
				valuesReflection[i + 3] = Convert.ToByte((float)(int)b2 / 255f * (float)(int)b);
			});
			Marshal.Copy(valuesReflection, 0, dataPointer, num);
		}
	}
	public interface IShapeLayoutInfo

	public abstract class ShapeLayoutInfoBase : IShapeLayoutInfo, IDisposable
	{
		private PathInfoCollection paths;

		private bool useForGroupEffects;

		private float glowSize;

		private float blurSize;

		private DXMatrix invertedShapeTransform;

		private Lazy<Pen> hitTestPen;

		private GraphicsPath selectionPath;

		private int selectionMargin;

		public Rectangle InitialBounds { get; set; }

		public PathInfoCollection Paths
		{
			[DebuggerStepThrough]
			get
			{
				return paths;
			}
			protected set
			{
				paths = value;
			}
		}

		public bool UseForGroupEffects
		{
			[DebuggerStepThrough]
			get
			{
				return useForGroupEffects;
			}
			protected set
			{
				useForGroupEffects = value;
			}
		}

		public DXMatrix ShapeTransform { get; set; }

		public abstract IPlatformStroke PenInfo { get; set; }

		public float PenWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (PenInfo == null)
				{
					return 0f;
				}
				return PenInfo.PenWidth;
			}
		}

		public float ScaleFactor { get; set; }

		public float GlowSize
		{
			get
			{
				UpdateGlowSize();
				return glowSize;
			}
		}

		public float BlurSize
		{
			get
			{
				UpdateBlurSize();
				return blurSize;
			}
		}

		public virtual float SoftEdgesSize => 0f;

		protected Pen HitTestPen => hitTestPen.Value;

		protected GraphicsPath SelectionPath
		{
			get
			{
				if (selectionPath == null)
				{
					selectionPath = new GraphicsPath();
					Rectangle initialBounds = InitialBounds;
					initialBounds.Inflate(selectionMargin, selectionMargin);
					selectionPath.AddRectangle(initialBounds);
				}
				return selectionPath;
			}
		}

		protected ShapeLayoutInfoBase(bool useForGroupEffects)
		{
			paths = new PathInfoCollection();
			this.useForGroupEffects = useForGroupEffects;
			ScaleFactor = 1f;
		}

		public virtual void Draw(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			DrawCore(graphics, applyTransform: true);
		}

		protected void DrawCore(IDXGraphics graphics, bool applyTransform)
		{
			foreach (PathInfoBase path in paths)
			{
				if (!path.SkipDrawing)
				{
					path.Draw(graphics, PenInfo, applyTransform ? ShapeTransform : null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void DrawCore(IDXGraphics graphics, bool applyTransform, GraphicsPathCollectFlags excludeFlags)
		{
			foreach (PathInfoBase path in paths)
			{
				if (!paths.ShouldSkipPathInfo(path, excludeFlags) && !path.SkipDrawing)
				{
					path.Draw(graphics, PenInfo, applyTransform ? ShapeTransform : null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void DrawAndSkip(IDXGraphics graphics, bool applyTransform, GraphicsPathCollectFlags excludeFlags)
		{
			foreach (PathInfoBase path in paths)
			{
				if (!paths.ShouldSkipPathInfo(path, excludeFlags) && !path.SkipDrawing)
				{
					path.SkipDrawing = true;
					path.Draw(graphics, PenInfo, applyTransform ? ShapeTransform : null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGlowSize()
		{
			if (glowSize == 0f)
			{
				GlowPathInfo pathInfo = Paths.GetPathInfo<GlowPathInfo>();
				if (pathInfo != null)
				{
					glowSize = 2f * pathInfo.BlurRadiusInLayoutUnits;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBlurSize()
		{
			if (blurSize == 0f)
			{
				BlurPathInfo pathInfo = Paths.GetPathInfo<BlurPathInfo>();
				if (pathInfo != null)
				{
					blurSize = 1.7f * pathInfo.BlurRadiusInLayoutUnits;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ResetSizes()
		{
			glowSize = 0f;
			blurSize = 0f;
		}

		protected internal void AddShadowToReflection(DXGraphicsPath reflection)
		{
			OuterShadowPathInfo pathInfo = Paths.GetPathInfo<OuterShadowPathInfo>();
			if (pathInfo == null || !(pathInfo.Path is GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath))
			{
				return;
			}
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = gdiPlusPath.NativeObject.Clone();
			int blurRadius = pathInfo.BlurRadius;
			if (blurRadius > 0 && GdipExtensions.AllowPathWidening(dXGraphicsPath))
			{
				using DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(Color.Empty, blurRadius);
				dXPen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Round;
				WidenHelper.Apply(dXGraphicsPath, dXPen);
			}
			reflection.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath, connect: false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			DisposeCore();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeCore()
		{
			if (PenInfo != null)
			{
				PenInfo.Dispose();
				PenInfo = null;
			}
			if (paths != null)
			{
				foreach (PathInfoBase path in paths)
				{
					path.Dispose();
				}
				paths = null;
			}
			if (ShapeTransform != null)
			{
				ShapeTransform = null;
			}
			if (invertedShapeTransform != null)
			{
				invertedShapeTransform = null;
			}
			if (hitTestPen != null)
			{
				if (hitTestPen.IsValueCreated && hitTestPen.Value != null)
				{
					hitTestPen.Value.Dispose();
				}
				hitTestPen = null;
			}
			if (selectionPath != null)
			{
				selectionPath.Dispose();
				selectionPath = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual Rectangle GetBounds()
		{
			if (Paths.Count == 0)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			PenInfo penInfo = PenInfo as PenInfo;
			bool flag = penInfo != null && penInfo.Pen?.Alignment == DXPenAlignment.Outset;
			float num = 0f;
			if (penInfo != null && flag)
			{
				DXPen pen = penInfo.Pen;
				num = pen.Width;
				pen.Width = Math.Max(1f, num * ScaleFactor * 1.5f);
			}
			RectangleF a = Paths[0].GetRealBounds(ShapeTransform, PenInfo);
			for (int i = 1; i < Paths.Count; i++)
			{
				PathInfoBase pathInfoBase = Paths[i];
				RectangleF realBounds = pathInfoBase.GetRealBounds(ShapeTransform, PenInfo);
				a = RectangleF.Union(a, realBounds);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				penInfo.Pen.Width = num;
			}
			return Rectangle.FromLTRB((int)Math.Floor(GetValue(a.X)), (int)Math.Floor(GetValue(a.Y)), (int)Math.Ceiling(GetValue(a.Right)), (int)Math.Ceiling(GetValue(a.Bottom)));
		}

		private double GetValue(float value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		protected internal void DrawBackgroundBitmap(IDXGraphics graphics, GraphicsPathCollectFlags excludeFlags)
		{
			excludeFlags |= GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeOuterShadow | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeGlow | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeReflection | GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeTextRectangle;
			DrawAndSkip(graphics, applyTransform: true, excludeFlags);
		}

		protected internal void SetGlowClip(IDXGraphics graphics, float glowSize)
		{
			BlurPathInfo pathInfo = Paths.GetPathInfo<BlurPathInfo>();
			if (pathInfo != null && pathInfo.IsCropped)
			{
				Rectangle boundsWithoutTransform = pathInfo.BoundsWithoutTransform;
				int num = (int)(glowSize / 2f);
				boundsWithoutTransform.Inflate(num, num);
				graphics.SetClip(boundsWithoutTransform);
			}
		}

		public abstract Rectangle CalculateShadowTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize);

		public abstract Rectangle CalculateReflectionTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize);

		public abstract DXGraphicsPath GetPreparedForReflectionFigure(DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize);

		public abstract void DrawReflection(IDXGraphics graphics, bool applyTransform);

		public abstract DXGraphicsPath GetPreparedForShadowFigure(DXMatrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize);

		public abstract void DrawShadow(IDXGraphics graphics, bool applyTransform);

		public abstract Rectangle GetGlowBounds(EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix parentTransform);

		public abstract void DrawGlow(IDXGraphics graphics, Color color, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix shapeTransform);

		public abstract Rectangle GetBlurEffectBounds(DXMatrix parentTransform, bool applyTransform, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize);

		public abstract void DrawBlurEffect(IDXGraphics graphics);

		protected DXMatrix GetInvertedShapeTransform()
		{
			if (ShapeTransform == null || !ShapeTransform.IsInvertible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (invertedShapeTransform == null)
			{
				invertedShapeTransform = ShapeTransform.Clone();
				invertedShapeTransform.Invert();
			}
			return invertedShapeTransform;
		}

		public virtual bool HitTest(Point logicalPoint)
		{
			foreach (PathInfoBase path in Paths)
			{
				if (path.AllowHitTest && path.HitTest(logicalPoint, HitTestPen, SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMatrix(GetInvertedShapeTransform())))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool SelectionHitTest(PointF logicalPoint)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = GetInvertedShapeTransform();
			if (dXMatrix != null)
			{
				logicalPoint = dXMatrix.TransformPoint(logicalPoint);
			}
			return SelectionPath.IsOutlineVisible(logicalPoint, HitTestPen);
		}

		public virtual void SetupHitTestPen(float extendedWidth)
		{
			Func<Pen> valueFactory = delegate
			{
				DXPen dXPen = ((PenInfo is PenInfo penInfo) ? penInfo.Pen : null);
				Pen pen;
				if (dXPen == null)
				{
					pen = new Pen(Color.Empty, extendedWidth);
				}
				else
				{
					pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(dXPen);
					pen.Width += extendedWidth;
				}
				return pen;
			};
			hitTestPen = new Lazy<Pen>(valueFactory);
		}

		public void SetSelectionMargin(int value)
		{
			selectionMargin = value;
		}

		public abstract HitTestInfoCollection CreateShadowHitTestInfos(Matrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape);

		public abstract HitTestInfoCollection CreateReflectionHitTestInfos(Matrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape);

		protected virtual HitTestInfoCollection CreateHitTestInfosCore(Matrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			HitTestInfoCollection hitTestInfoCollection = new HitTestInfoCollection();
			PathInfo[] pathInfosAndDerived = Paths.GetPathInfosAndDerived<PathInfo>();
			PathInfo[] array = pathInfosAndDerived;
			foreach (PathInfo pathInfo in array)
			{
				if (pathInfo.Path.Clone() is GdiPlusPath { NativeObject: var nativeObject })
				{
					if (!rotateWithShape && ShapeTransform != null)
					{
						nativeObject.Transform(ShapeTransform);
					}
					nativeObject.Transform(SystemDrawingConverter.CreateDXMatrix(shadowTransform));
					hitTestInfoCollection.Add(new HitTestInfo(SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(nativeObject), pathInfo.Fill != null));
				}
			}
			return hitTestInfoCollection;
		}

		protected void PopulateReflectionHitTestInfosFromShadow(HitTestInfoCollection hitTestInfos, Matrix shadowTransform, bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			OuterShadowPathInfo pathInfo = Paths.GetPathInfo<OuterShadowPathInfo>();
			if (pathInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (HitTestInfo hitTestInfo in pathInfo.HitTestInfos)
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = (GraphicsPath)hitTestInfo.GraphicsPath.Clone();
				graphicsPath.Transform(shadowTransform);
				hitTestInfos.Add(new HitTestInfo(graphicsPath, hitTestInfo.HasFill));
			}
		}
	}
	public struct EffectAdditionalSize
	{
		private static byte MaskProcessGlowSize = 1;

		private static byte MaskProcessBlurSize = 2;

		private static byte MaskProcessSoftEdgesSize = 4;

		private const byte DefaultValues = 3;

		public static EffectAdditionalSize Empty = default(EffectAdditionalSize);

		public static EffectAdditionalSize Default = new EffectAdditionalSize(3);

		private float glowSize;

		private float blurSize;

		private byte packedValues;

		public float GlowSize => glowSize;

		public float BlurSize => blurSize;

		public float TotalSize => glowSize + blurSize;

		public bool ProcessGlowSize
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, MaskProcessGlowSize);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, MaskProcessGlowSize, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ProcessBlurSize
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, MaskProcessBlurSize);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, MaskProcessBlurSize, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ProcessSoftEdgesSize
		{
			get
			{
				return PackedValues.GetBoolBitValue(packedValues, MaskProcessSoftEdgesSize);
			}
			set
			{
				PackedValues.SetBoolBitValue(ref packedValues, MaskProcessSoftEdgesSize, value);
			}
		}

		private EffectAdditionalSize(byte packedValues)
		{
			this = default(EffectAdditionalSize);
			this.packedValues = packedValues;
		}

		public EffectAdditionalSize(float glowSize, bool processSoftEdgesSize)
		{
			this = default(EffectAdditionalSize);
			blurSize = 0f;
			this.glowSize = glowSize;
			packedValues = 3;
			ProcessSoftEdgesSize = processSoftEdgesSize;
		}

		public void AddSize(IShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo)
		{
			float num = (ProcessBlurSize ? shapeLayoutInfo.BlurSize : 0f);
			float num2 = (ProcessGlowSize ? shapeLayoutInfo.GlowSize : 0f);
			if (blurSize > 0f && glowSize > 0f)
			{
				num2 *= 0.7f;
			}
			glowSize += num2;
			blurSize += num;
			float num3 = shapeLayoutInfo.SoftEdgesSize;
			if (!ProcessSoftEdgesSize || !(num3 > 0f))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (glowSize > 0f)
			{
				glowSize -= num3;
				if (glowSize < 0f)
				{
					num3 = 0f - glowSize;
					glowSize = 0f;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = 0f;
				}
			}
			if (blurSize > 0f)
			{
				blurSize -= num3;
				if (blurSize < 0f)
				{
					blurSize = 0f;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private float GetSoftEdgesSize()
		{
			if (softEdgesSize == 0f)
			{
				SoftEdgePathInfo pathInfo = base.Paths.GetPathInfo<SoftEdgePathInfo>();
				if (pathInfo != null)
				{
					softEdgesSize = pathInfo.BlurRadiusInLayoutUnits;
				}
			}
			return softEdgesSize;
		}

		}

		{
			HitTestInfoCollection hitTestInfoCollection = CreateHitTestInfosCore(shadowTransform, rotateWithShape);
			PopulateReflectionHitTestInfosFromShadow(hitTestInfoCollection, shadowTransform, rotateWithShape);
			return hitTestInfoCollection;
		}
	}

					{
						graphicsPath.Transform(SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMatrix(base.ShapeTransform));
					}
					graphicsPath.Transform(shadowTransform);
					hitTestInfoCollection.Add(new HitTestInfo(graphicsPath, hitTestInfo.HasFill));
				}
			}
			return hitTestInfoCollection;
		}

	public class GraphicsWarpTransformer
	{
		private struct PointD
		{
			private static readonly PointD emptyPoint;

			public double X { get; set; }

			public double Y { get; set; }

			public static PointD Empty => emptyPoint;

			public PointD(double x, double y)
			{
				this = default(PointD);
				X = x;
				Y = y;
			}
		}

		private class PathInsidePointCalculator : IPathInstructionWalker
		{
			private PointD firstPoint;

			private double p;

			private PointD result;

			public PointD CalcPoint(IPathInstruction instruction, double p, PointD firstPoint)
			{
				result = PointD.Empty;
				this.firstPoint = firstPoint;
				this.p = p;
				instruction.Visit(this);
				return result;
			}

			public void Visit(PathArc pathArc)
			{
			}

			public void Visit(PathClose value)
			{
			}

			public void Visit(PathCubicBezier value)
			{
				double x = firstPoint.X;
				double y = firstPoint.Y;
				double valueEMU = value.Points[0].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU2 = value.Points[0].Y.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU3 = value.Points[1].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU4 = value.Points[1].Y.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU5 = value.Points[2].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU6 = value.Points[2].Y.ValueEMU;
				double num = p;
				double num2 = num * num;
				double num3 = 1.0 - num;
				double num4 = num3 * num3 * num3;
				double num5 = 3.0 * num * num3 * num3;
				double num6 = 3.0 * num2 * num3;
				double num7 = num2 * num;
				double x2 = num4 * x + num5 * valueEMU + num6 * valueEMU3 + num7 * valueEMU5;
				double y2 = num4 * y + num5 * valueEMU2 + num6 * valueEMU4 + num7 * valueEMU6;
				result = new PointD(x2, y2);
			}

			public void Visit(PathLine pathLine)
			{
				double x = firstPoint.X;
				double y = firstPoint.Y;
				double valueEMU = pathLine.Point.X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU2 = pathLine.Point.Y.ValueEMU;
				double x2 = x + (valueEMU - x) * p;
				double y2 = y + (valueEMU2 - y) * p;
				result = new PointD(x2, y2);
			}

			public void Visit(PathMove pathMove)
			{
				result = firstPoint;
			}

			public void Visit(PathQuadraticBezier value)
			{
				double x = firstPoint.X;
				double y = firstPoint.Y;
				double valueEMU = value.Points[0].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU2 = value.Points[0].Y.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU3 = value.Points[1].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU4 = value.Points[1].Y.ValueEMU;
				double num = p;
				double num2 = num * num;
				double num3 = 1.0 - num;
				double num4 = num3 * num3;
				double num5 = 2.0 * num * num3;
				double x2 = num4 * x + num5 * valueEMU + num2 * valueEMU3;
				double y2 = num4 * y + num5 * valueEMU2 + num2 * valueEMU4;
				result = new PointD(x2, y2);
			}
		}

		private class PathLengthCalculator : IPathInstructionWalker
		{
			private double currentInstructionLength;

			private PointD firstPoint;

			public List<PointD> FirstPoints { get; private set; }

			public List<double> InstructionsLength { get; private set; }

			public double Walk(ModelShapePath path)
			{
				FirstPoints = new List<PointD>();
				InstructionsLength = new List<double>();
				double num = 0.0;
				for (int i = 0; i < path.Instructions.Count; i++)
				{
					IPathInstruction pathInstruction = path.Instructions[i];
					currentInstructionLength = 0.0;
					FirstPoints.Add(firstPoint);
					pathInstruction.Visit(this);
					num += currentInstructionLength;
					InstructionsLength.Add(currentInstructionLength);
				}
				return num;
			}

			public void Visit(PathArc pathArc)
			{
			}

			public void Visit(PathClose value)
			{
			}

			public void Visit(PathCubicBezier value)
			{
				double x = firstPoint.X;
				double y = firstPoint.Y;
				double valueEMU = value.Points[0].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU2 = value.Points[0].Y.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU3 = value.Points[1].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU4 = value.Points[1].Y.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU5 = value.Points[2].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU6 = value.Points[2].Y.ValueEMU;
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.001;
				double num3 = x;
				double num4 = y;
				for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
				{
					double num5 = num2 * num2;
					double num6 = 1.0 - num2;
					double num7 = num6 * num6 * num6;
					double num8 = 3.0 * num2 * num6 * num6;
					double num9 = 3.0 * num5 * num6;
					double num10 = num5 * num2;
					double num11 = num7 * x + num8 * valueEMU + num9 * valueEMU3 + num10 * valueEMU5;
					double num12 = num7 * y + num8 * valueEMU2 + num9 * valueEMU4 + num10 * valueEMU6;
					double num13 = num11 - num3;
					double num14 = num12 - num4;
					num += Math.Sqrt(num13 * num13 + num14 * num14);
					num3 = num11;
					num4 = num12;
					num2 += 0.001;
				}
				currentInstructionLength = num;
				firstPoint = new PointD(valueEMU5, valueEMU6);
			}

			public void Visit(PathLine pathLine)
			{
				double x = firstPoint.X;
				double y = firstPoint.Y;
				double valueEMU = pathLine.Point.X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU2 = pathLine.Point.Y.ValueEMU;
				double num = valueEMU - x;
				double num2 = valueEMU2 - y;
				double num3 = Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
				currentInstructionLength = num3;
				firstPoint = new PointD(valueEMU, valueEMU2);
			}

			public void Visit(PathMove pathMove)
			{
				firstPoint = new PointD(pathMove.Point.X.ValueEMU, pathMove.Point.Y.ValueEMU);
			}

			public void Visit(PathQuadraticBezier value)
			{
				double x = firstPoint.X;
				double y = firstPoint.Y;
				double valueEMU = value.Points[0].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU2 = value.Points[0].Y.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU3 = value.Points[1].X.ValueEMU;
				double valueEMU4 = value.Points[1].Y.ValueEMU;
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.001;
				double num3 = x;
				double num4 = y;
				for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
				{
					double num5 = num2 * num2;
					double num6 = 1.0 - num2;
					double num7 = num6 * num6;
					double num8 = 2.0 * num2 * num6;
					double num9 = num7 * x + num8 * valueEMU + num5 * valueEMU3;
					double num10 = num7 * y + num8 * valueEMU2 + num5 * valueEMU4;
					double num11 = num9 - num3;
					double num12 = num10 - num4;
					num += Math.Sqrt(num11 * num11 + num12 * num12);
					num2 += 0.001;
					num3 = num9;
					num4 = num10;
				}
				currentInstructionLength = num;
				firstPoint = new PointD(valueEMU3, valueEMU4);
			}
		}

		private readonly ModelShapeCustomGeometry warpGeometry;

		private readonly double[] pathLength;

		private readonly List<double>[] pathInstructionsLength;

		private readonly List<PointD>[] firstPoints;

		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly PathInsidePointCalculator insidePointCalculator;

		public int PathPairsCount { get; private set; }

		public GraphicsWarpTransformer(IDocumentModel documentModel, ModelShapeCustomGeometry warpGeometry)
		{
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			int count = warpGeometry.Paths.Count;
			PathPairsCount = count / 2;
			this.warpGeometry = warpGeometry;
			pathLength = new double[count];
			pathInstructionsLength = new List<double>[count];
			firstPoints = new List<PointD>[count];
			FillPathInfo();
			insidePointCalculator = new PathInsidePointCalculator();
		}

		private void FillPathInfo()
		{
			PathLengthCalculator pathLengthCalculator = new PathLengthCalculator();
			for (int i = 0; i < warpGeometry.Paths.Count; i++)
			{
				pathLength[i] = pathLengthCalculator.Walk(warpGeometry.Paths[i]);
				pathInstructionsLength[i] = pathLengthCalculator.InstructionsLength;
				firstPoints[i] = pathLengthCalculator.FirstPoints;
			}
		}

		public IPlatformPath TransformGraphics(IPlatformPath sourcePath, RectangleF textBounds, int bucketIndex)
		{
			if (!(sourcePath is GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath))
			{
				return sourcePath;
			}
			DXGraphicsPathData pathData = gdiPlusPath.NativeObject.GetPathData();
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>(pathData.PathPoints);
			double val = double.MaxValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF = list[i];
				double p = (pointF.X - textBounds.X) / textBounds.Width;
				double num = (pointF.Y - textBounds.Y) / textBounds.Height;
				PointD pointD = FindTop(bucketIndex, p);
				PointD pointD2 = FindBottom(bucketIndex, p);
				double value = pointD.X + (pointD2.X - pointD.X) * num;
				double value2 = pointD.Y + (pointD2.Y - pointD.Y) * num;
				value = documentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsD(value);
				value2 = documentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsD(value2);
				value = documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits((float)value);
				value2 = documentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits((float)value2);
				val = Math.Min(val, value2);
				pointF = new PointF((float)value, (float)value2);
				list[i] = pointF;
			}
			DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(list, pathData.PathTypes, gdiPlusPath.NativeObject.FillMode);
			gdiPlusPath.Dispose();
			return new GdiPlusPath(graphicsPath);
		}

		private PointD FindBottom(int bucketIndex, double p)
		{
			int pathIndex = bucketIndex * 2 + 1;
			return FindPointInsidePath(p, pathIndex);
		}

		private PointD FindTop(int bucketIndex, double p)
		{
			int pathIndex = bucketIndex * 2;
			return FindPointInsidePath(p, pathIndex);
		}

		private PointD FindPointInsidePath(double p, int pathIndex)
		{
			ModelShapePath modelShapePath = warpGeometry.Paths[pathIndex];
			int count = modelShapePath.Instructions.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num = pathInstructionsLength[pathIndex][i] / pathLength[pathIndex];
				if (p >= num)
				{
					p -= num;
					continue;
				}
				double p2 = p / num;
				return insidePointCalculator.CalcPoint(modelShapePath.Instructions[i], p2, firstPoints[pathIndex][i]);
			}
			return insidePointCalculator.CalcPoint(modelShapePath.Instructions[modelShapePath.Instructions.Count - 1], 1.0, firstPoints[pathIndex][modelShapePath.Instructions.Count - 1]);
		}
	}
	internal class TextShapeLayoutInfo : ShapeLayoutInfo
	{
		private readonly ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter paragraphLayoutInfoConverter;

		public TextShapeLayoutInfo(ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter paragraphLayoutInfoConverter)
			: base(useForGroupEffects: false)
		{
			this.paragraphLayoutInfoConverter = paragraphLayoutInfoConverter;
		}

		protected override ShapeEffectBuildHelper GetEffectBuilder()
		{
			return new TextEffectBuildHelper(this, paragraphLayoutInfoConverter);
		}

		protected internal void Reset()
		{
			base.Paths.Clear();
			PenInfo = null;
			ResetSizes();
		}

		protected internal override PathInfoBase[] GetPathInfos()
		{
			return base.Paths.GetPathInfosAndDerived<TextRunPathInfo>();
		}
	}
	internal class TextEffectBuildHelper : ShapeEffectBuildHelper
	{
		private readonly ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter paragraphLayoutInfoConverter;

		public TextEffectBuildHelper(ShapeLayoutInfo shapeLayoutInfo, ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter paragraphLayoutInfoConverter)
			: base(shapeLayoutInfo)
		{
			this.paragraphLayoutInfoConverter = paragraphLayoutInfoConverter;
		}

		public override Rectangle CalculateShadowTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape, EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize)
		{
			RectangleF currentRunBounds = paragraphLayoutInfoConverter.GetCurrentRunBounds();
			return Rectangle.Round(currentRunBounds);
		}

		public override Rectangle CalculateReflectionTransformBounds(bool rotateWithShape)
		{
			RectangleF currentRunBounds = paragraphLayoutInfoConverter.GetCurrentRunBounds();
			float currentBaseLine = paragraphLayoutInfoConverter.GetCurrentBaseLine();
			return new Rectangle((int)currentRunBounds.Left, (int)currentRunBounds.Top, (int)currentRunBounds.Width, (int)currentBaseLine);
		}

		public override Rectangle GetGlowBounds(EffectAdditionalSize additionalSize, DXMatrix parentTransform)
		{
			GraphicsPathCollectFlags flags = GraphicsPathCollectFlags.ExcludeInnerShadow;
			using DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath = GetTransformedFigure(flags, rotateWithShape: false, additionalSize);
			return graphicsPath.GetBoundsExt();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter : IDisposable
	{
		protected class BucketElement
		{
			public TextRunPathInfo RunPathInfo { get; private set; }

			public RectangleF Bounds { get; private set; }

			public ContainerEffect Effects { get; private set; }

			public float RunBaseLine { get; private set; }

			public BucketElement(TextRunPathInfo runPathInfo, RectangleF bounds, ContainerEffect effects, float runBaseLine)
			{
				RunPathInfo = runPathInfo;
				Bounds = bounds;
				Effects = effects;
				RunBaseLine = runBaseLine;
			}
		}

		protected class UnderlineInfo
		{
			public float Baseline { get; private set; }

			public RunLayoutInfo RunLayoutInfo { get; private set; }

			public IPlatformFill TextBrush { get; set; }

			public IPlatformStroke PenInfo { get; set; }

			public IPlatformPath GraphicsPath { get; set; }

			public UnderlineInfo(RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo, float baseline, IPlatformPath graphicsPath)
			{
				RunLayoutInfo = runLayoutInfo;
				Baseline = baseline;
				GraphicsPath = graphicsPath;
			}
		}

		private class RunGraphicsInfo
		{
			private readonly IPlatformPath textGraphicsPath;

			private readonly List<IPlatformPath> strikeThroughGraphicsPaths;

			private readonly UnderlineInfo underlineInfo;

			public IPlatformPath TextGraphicsPath => textGraphicsPath;

			public List<IPlatformPath> StrikeThroughGraphicsPaths => strikeThroughGraphicsPaths;

			public UnderlineInfo UnderlineInfo => underlineInfo;

			public RunGraphicsInfo(IPlatformPath textGraphicsPath, List<IPlatformPath> strikeThroughGraphicsPaths, UnderlineInfo underlineInfo)
			{
				this.textGraphicsPath = textGraphicsPath;
				this.strikeThroughGraphicsPaths = strikeThroughGraphicsPaths;
				this.underlineInfo = underlineInfo;
			}
		}

		private readonly List<ParagraphLayoutInfo> paragraphLayouts;

		private readonly PathInfoCollection textPathInfos;

		private readonly PathInfoCollection linesPathInfos;

		private readonly int[] bucketsLast;

		private readonly List<BucketElement> bucketTextPathInfos;

		private bool ShouldApplyEffects { get; set; }

		protected BucketElement CurrentBucketElement { get; private set; }

		protected ShapeStyle ShapeStyle { get; private set; }

		protected IDocumentModel DocumentModel => ShapeStyle.DocumentModel;

		protected TextShapeLayoutInfo TextShapeLayoutInfo { get; }

		protected GraphicsWarpTransformer WarpTransformer { get; }

		protected List<BucketElement> BucketLinesPathInfos { get; private set; }

		private int BucketsCount => WarpTransformer?.PathPairsCount ?? 1;

		private static bool BlackAndWhitePrintMode { get; set; }

		protected abstract float DpiScale { get; }

		protected ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter(List<ParagraphLayoutInfo> paragraphLayouts, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, GraphicsWarpTransformer warpTransformer, bool shouldApplyEffects)
		{
			ShouldApplyEffects = shouldApplyEffects;
			this.paragraphLayouts = paragraphLayouts;
			ShapeStyle = shapeStyle;
			textPathInfos = new PathInfoCollection();
			linesPathInfos = new PathInfoCollection();
			TextShapeLayoutInfo = new TextShapeLayoutInfo(this);
			WarpTransformer = warpTransformer;
			bucketsLast = new int[BucketsCount];
			FillParagraphsBounds();
			bucketTextPathInfos = new List<BucketElement>();
			BucketLinesPathInfos = new List<BucketElement>();
		}

		protected ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter(List<ParagraphLayoutInfo> paragraphLayouts, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, GraphicsWarpTransformer warpTransformer, bool shouldApplyEffects, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode)
			: this(paragraphLayouts, shapeStyle, warpTransformer, shouldApplyEffects)
		{
			BlackAndWhitePrintMode = blackAndWhitePrintMode;
		}

		private void FillParagraphsBounds()
		{
			int num = paragraphLayouts.Count;
			int bucketsCount = BucketsCount;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < bucketsCount; i++)
			{
				int num3 = (num + bucketsCount - 1) / bucketsCount;
				num -= num3;
				bucketsLast[i] = num2 + num3 - 1;
				num2 += num3;
			}
		}

		private static RectangleF CalculateParagraphBounds(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayout)
		{
			if (paragraphLayout.RunLayouts.Count == 0)
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			RectangleF rectangleF = paragraphLayout.RunLayouts[0].Bounds;
			for (int i = 1; i < paragraphLayout.RunLayouts.Count; i++)
			{
				RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = paragraphLayout.RunLayouts[i];
				rectangleF = RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, runLayoutInfo.Bounds);
			}
			if (paragraphLayout.Bullet != null)
			{
				rectangleF = RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, paragraphLayout.Bullet.Bounds);
			}
			return rectangleF;
		}

		public List<PathInfoBase> Convert()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < paragraphLayouts.Count; i++)
			{
				ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo = paragraphLayouts[i];
				RectangleF paragraphBounds = CalculateParagraphBounds(paragraphLayoutInfo);
				ProcessParagraph(paragraphLayoutInfo, paragraphBounds);
				if (i == bucketsLast[num])
				{
					CloseBucket(num);
					num++;
				}
			}
			textPathInfos.AddRange(linesPathInfos);
			TextShapeLayoutInfo.Dispose();
			return textPathInfos;
		}

		private void CloseBucket(int bucketIndex)
		{
			BeforeCloseBucket(bucketTextPathInfos);
			BeforeCloseBucket(BucketLinesPathInfos);
			RectangleF bucketBounds = GetBucketBounds(bucketTextPathInfos);
			RectangleF bucketBounds2 = GetBucketBounds(BucketLinesPathInfos);
			RectangleF bucketBounds3 = (bucketBounds.IsEmpty ? bucketBounds2 : (bucketBounds2.IsEmpty ? bucketBounds : RectangleF.Union(bucketBounds, bucketBounds2)));
			ConvertBucketPathInfos(bucketTextPathInfos, textPathInfos, bucketIndex, bucketBounds3);
			ConvertBucketPathInfos(BucketLinesPathInfos, linesPathInfos, bucketIndex, bucketBounds3);
			bucketTextPathInfos.Clear();
			BucketLinesPathInfos.Clear();
		}

		private RectangleF GetBucketBounds(List<BucketElement> bucket)
		{
			if (bucket.Count == 0)
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			RectangleF rectangleF = bucket[0].RunPathInfo.Path.GetBoundsF();
			for (int i = 1; i < bucket.Count; i++)
			{
				RectangleF boundsF = bucket[i].RunPathInfo.Path.GetBoundsF();
				if (!boundsF.IsEmpty)
				{
					rectangleF = RectangleF.Union(rectangleF, boundsF);
				}
			}
			return rectangleF;
		}

		private void ConvertBucketPathInfos(List<BucketElement> bucketPathInfos, PathInfoCollection pathInfoList, int bucketIndex, RectangleF bucketBounds)
		{
			foreach (BucketElement bucketPathInfo in bucketPathInfos)
			{
				TextRunPathInfo runPathInfo = bucketPathInfo.RunPathInfo;
				IPlatformPath graphicsPath = ApplyWarp(runPathInfo.Path, bucketIndex, bucketBounds);
				IPlatformStroke penInfo = runPathInfo.PenInfo;
				TextRunPathInfo runPathInfo2 = ((runPathInfo is TextLinePathInfo) ? new TextLinePathInfo(graphicsPath, runPathInfo.Fill, penInfo) : new TextRunPathInfo(graphicsPath, runPathInfo.Fill, penInfo));
				ApplyEffects(bucketPathInfo, runPathInfo2, pathInfoList);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessParagraph(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo, RectangleF paragraphBounds)
		{
			float num = CalculateExcelBaseLine(paragraphLayoutInfo);
			List<UnderlineInfo> list = new List<UnderlineInfo>();
			ProcessBullet(paragraphLayoutInfo, paragraphBounds, num);
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in paragraphLayoutInfo.RunLayouts)
			{
				RectangleF brushPenBounds = GetBrushPenBounds(paragraphBounds, runLayout.Bounds);
				IPlatformFill runBrush = GetRunBrush(runLayout.Properties, brushPenBounds, ShapeStyle);
				IPlatformStroke runPen = GetRunPen(runLayout.Properties, brushPenBounds, ShapeStyle);
				RunGraphicsInfo runGraphicsPaths = GetRunGraphicsPaths(runLayout, num, runBrush, runPen);
				bucketTextPathInfos.Add(new BucketElement(new TextRunPathInfo(runGraphicsPaths.TextGraphicsPath, runBrush, runPen), runLayout.Bounds, runLayout.Properties.Effects, num));
				if (runGraphicsPaths.StrikeThroughGraphicsPaths != null)
				{
					foreach (IPlatformPath strikeThroughGraphicsPath in runGraphicsPaths.StrikeThroughGraphicsPaths)
					{
						BucketLinesPathInfos.Add(new BucketElement(new TextLinePathInfo(strikeThroughGraphicsPath, runBrush, runPen), runLayout.Bounds, runLayout.Properties.Effects, num));
					}
				}
				if (runGraphicsPaths.UnderlineInfo == null || (list.Count != 0 && Sign(runLayout.Properties.Baseline) != Sign(list[list.Count - 1].RunLayoutInfo.Properties.Baseline)))
				{
					AddUnderlines(list, paragraphBounds, num);
					list.Clear();
				}
				if (runGraphicsPaths.UnderlineInfo != null)
				{
					runGraphicsPaths.UnderlineInfo.TextBrush = runBrush;
					runGraphicsPaths.UnderlineInfo.PenInfo = runPen;
					list.Add(runGraphicsPaths.UnderlineInfo);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				AddUnderlines(list, paragraphBounds, num);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessBullet(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo, RectangleF paragraphBounds, float excelBaseLine)
		{
			RunLayoutInfo bullet = paragraphLayoutInfo.Bullet;
			if (bullet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IPlatformFill platformFill;
			if (paragraphLayoutInfo.BulletColor != null)
			{
				platformFill = new BrushInfo(new DXSolidBrush(paragraphLayoutInfo.BulletColor.FinalColor));
			}
			else
			{
				IPlatformFill platformFill3;
				if (paragraphLayoutInfo.BulletFill == null)
				{
					IPlatformFill platformFill2 = new BrushInfo(new DXSolidBrush(Color.White));
					platformFill3 = platformFill2;
				}
				else
				{
					platformFill3 = GetBrushByFill(paragraphLayoutInfo.BulletFill, paragraphBounds, ShapeStyle);
				}
				platformFill = platformFill3;
			}
			RunGraphicsInfo runGraphicsPaths = GetRunGraphicsPaths(bullet, excelBaseLine, platformFill, null);
			bucketTextPathInfos.Add(new BucketElement(new TextRunPathInfo(runGraphicsPaths.TextGraphicsPath, platformFill, null), bullet.Bounds, null, excelBaseLine));
		}

		private static int Sign(float value)
		{
			if (!(value < 0f))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected bool AreUnderlinesNotSame(UnderlineInfo a, UnderlineInfo b)
		{
			IDrawingTextCharacterProperties properties = b.RunLayoutInfo.Properties;
			IDrawingTextCharacterProperties properties2 = a.RunLayoutInfo.Properties;
			if (properties2.Underline == properties.Underline && object.Equals(properties2.Effects, properties.Effects) && object.Equals(properties2.Fill, properties.Fill) && object.Equals(properties2.UnderlineFill, properties.UnderlineFill))
			{
				return !object.Equals(properties2.Outline, properties.Outline);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private RunGraphicsInfo GetRunGraphicsPaths(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float excelBaseLine, IPlatformFill textBrush, IPlatformStroke pen)
		{
			float num = CalcRealBaseLine(runLayout, excelBaseLine);
			string text = runLayout.Text;
			IPlatformPath runTextGraphicsPath = GetRunTextGraphicsPath(runLayout, text, runLayout.RunFontInfo, num, textBrush, pen);
			UnderlineInfo underlineInfo = ((runLayout.Properties == null || runLayout.Properties.Underline == DrawingTextUnderlineType.None) ? null : new UnderlineInfo(runLayout, num, runTextGraphicsPath));
			List<IPlatformPath> strikeThroughGraphicsPaths = ((runLayout.Properties == null) ? new List<IPlatformPath>() : GetStrikethroughGraphicsPaths(runLayout, num, runTextGraphicsPath));
			return new RunGraphicsInfo(runTextGraphicsPath, strikeThroughGraphicsPaths, underlineInfo);
		}

		protected void NormalizeHeight(DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath, RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float realBaseLine)
		{
			RectangleF bounds = graphicsPath.GetBounds();
			if (bounds.Width != 0f && bounds.Height != 0f)
			{
				float num = CalcExcelBaseLine(runLayout.BaseFontInfo);
				PointF[] destinationPoints = new PointF[3]
				{
					new PointF(bounds.Left, realBaseLine - num),
					new PointF(bounds.Right, realBaseLine - num),
					new PointF(bounds.Left, realBaseLine)
				};
				graphicsPath.Transform(DXMatrix.CreateWarpMatrix(bounds, destinationPoints));
			}
		}

		private IPlatformPath ApplyWarp(IPlatformPath graphicsPath, int bucketIndex, RectangleF bucketBounds)
		{
			if (WarpTransformer == null)
			{
				return graphicsPath;
			}
			if (graphicsPath.PointCount == 0)
			{
				return graphicsPath;
			}
			return WarpTransformer.TransformGraphics(graphicsPath, bucketBounds, bucketIndex);
		}

		private static IPlatformFill GetRunBrush(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, RectangleF paragraphBounds, ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
		{
			IDrawingFill fill = runProperties.Fill;
			if (fill == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetBrushByFill(fill, paragraphBounds, shapeStyle);
		}

		protected static IPlatformFill GetUnderlineBrush(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, RectangleF bounds, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, IPlatformFill runBrush)
		{
			if (runProperties.UnderlineFill == null || runProperties.UnderlineFill.Type == DrawingUnderlineFillType.FollowsText)
			{
				return runBrush;
			}
			if (!(runProperties.UnderlineFill is IDrawingFill { FillType: not DrawingFillType.Automatic } drawingFill))
			{
				return GetRunBrush(runProperties, bounds, shapeStyle);
			}
			return GetBrushByFill(drawingFill, bounds, shapeStyle);
		}

		private static IPlatformFill GetBrushByFill(IDrawingFill fill, RectangleF paragraphBounds, ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
		{
			if (BlackAndWhitePrintMode)
			{
				return new BrushInfo(new DXSolidBrush(Color.Black));
			}
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			DXMatrix shapeTransform = new DXMatrix();
			dXGraphicsPath.AddRectangle(paragraphBounds);
			BrushInfo brushInfo = null;
			if (!shapeStyle.FontColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				brushInfo = new BrushInfo(new DXSolidBrush(shapeStyle.FontColor.FinalColor));
			}
			if (fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic)
			{
				if (!shapeStyle.FontColor.IsEmpty && shapeStyle.FontColor.FinalColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					brushInfo?.Brush?.Dispose();
					return new BrushInfo(new DXSolidBrush(shapeStyle.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Dark1.FinalColor));
				}
				return brushInfo;
			}
			Color empty = Color.Empty;
			ShapeFillRenderVisitor shapeFillRenderVisitor = new ShapeFillRenderVisitor(ShapePreset.Rect, empty, brushInfo?.Brush, new List<IPlatformPath>
			{
				new GdiPlusPath(dXGraphicsPath)
			}, shapeTransform);
			fill.Visit(shapeFillRenderVisitor);
			brushInfo?.Brush?.Dispose();
			return new BrushInfo(shapeFillRenderVisitor.Result, shapeFillRenderVisitor.HasPermanentFill);
		}

		private static IPlatformStroke GetRunPen(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties properties, RectangleF paragraphBounds, ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
		{
			if (properties.Outline.IsDefault)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			dXGraphicsPath.AddRectangle(paragraphBounds);
			return ShapeRenderHelper.GetPenInfo(properties.Outline, shapeStyle, new List<IPlatformPath>
			{
				new GdiPlusPath(dXGraphicsPath)
			}, ShapePreset.Rect, BlackAndWhitePrintMode);
		}

		private void ApplyEffects(BucketElement bucketElement, TextRunPathInfo runPathInfo, PathInfoCollection pathInfoList)
		{
			ContainerEffect effects = bucketElement.Effects;
			CurrentBucketElement = bucketElement;
			TextShapeLayoutInfo.PenInfo = runPathInfo.PenInfo;
			TextShapeLayoutInfo.Paths.Add(runPathInfo);
			if (ShouldApplyEffects && effects != null)
			{
