				ShapeEffectRenderingWalker shapeEffectRenderingWalker = new ShapeEffectRenderingWalker(effects.Effects, DocumentModel, TextShapeLayoutInfo, BlackAndWhitePrintMode, DpiScale);
				shapeEffectRenderingWalker.RenderDirectly = true;
				shapeEffectRenderingWalker.ApplyEffects();
			}
			pathInfoList.AddRange(TextShapeLayoutInfo.Paths);
			TextShapeLayoutInfo.Reset();
			CurrentBucketElement = null;
		}

		public RectangleF GetCurrentRunBounds()
		{
			return CurrentBucketElement?.Bounds ?? ((RectangleF)Rectangle.Empty);
		}

		protected float CalcGdiBaseLine(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			Font font = fontInfo.Font;
			FontFamily fontFamily = font.FontFamily;
			int lineSpacing = fontFamily.GetLineSpacing(font.Style);
			int cellAscent = fontFamily.GetCellAscent(font.Style);
			return (float)(fontInfo.LineSpacing * cellAscent) / (float)lineSpacing;
		}

		protected float CalcDXBaseLine(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			DXFont dXFont = fontInfo.DXFont;
			float lineSpacing = dXFont.LineSpacing;
			float ascent = dXFont.Ascent;
			return (float)fontInfo.LineSpacing * ascent / lineSpacing;
		}

		protected float CalcExcelBaseLine(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			return fontInfo.CalculatedLineSpacing - fontInfo.Descent;
		}

		protected abstract float CalculateExcelBaseLine(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo);

		protected abstract IPlatformPath GetRunTextGraphicsPath(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, string text, FontInfo fontInfo, float realBaseLine, IPlatformFill textBrush, IPlatformStroke pen);

		protected abstract void AddUnderlines(List<UnderlineInfo> underlines, RectangleF paragraphBounds, float excelBaseLine);

		protected abstract float CalcRealBaseLine(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float excelBaseLine);

		protected abstract List<IPlatformPath> GetStrikethroughGraphicsPaths(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float realBaseLine, IPlatformPath runTextGraphicsPath);

		public abstract float GetCurrentBaseLine();

		protected abstract RectangleF GetBrushPenBounds(RectangleF paragraphBounds, RectangleF runLayoutBounds);

		protected abstract void BeforeCloseBucket(List<BucketElement> bucketLinesPathInfos);

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && TextShapeLayoutInfo != null)
			{
				TextShapeLayoutInfo.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	internal class HorizontalParagraphLayoutInfoConverter : ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter
	{
		private readonly HorizontalTextCalculator layoutCalculator;

		private DXStringFormat StringFormat { get; set; }

		protected override float DpiScale => layoutCalculator.FontScale;

		public HorizontalParagraphLayoutInfoConverter(HorizontalTextCalculator layoutCalculator, List<ParagraphLayoutInfo> paragraphLayouts, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, GraphicsWarpTransformer warpTransformer, bool shouldApplyEffects)
			: base(paragraphLayouts, shapeStyle, warpTransformer, shouldApplyEffects)
		{
			this.layoutCalculator = layoutCalculator;
			StringFormat = new DXStringFormat(DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic());
		}

		public HorizontalParagraphLayoutInfoConverter(HorizontalTextCalculator layoutCalculator, List<ParagraphLayoutInfo> paragraphLayouts, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, GraphicsWarpTransformer warpTransformer, bool shouldApplyEffects, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode)
			: base(paragraphLayouts, shapeStyle, warpTransformer, shouldApplyEffects, blackAndWhitePrintMode)
		{
			this.layoutCalculator = layoutCalculator;
			StringFormat = new DXStringFormat(DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic());
		}

		protected override float CalcRealBaseLine(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float excelBaseLine)
		{
			float num = ((runLayout.Properties != null) ? runLayout.Properties.Baseline : 0);
			return runLayout.Bounds.Top + (excelBaseLine - num * base.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF(runLayout.BaseFontInfo.SizeInPoints) / 100000f);
		}

		protected override List<IPlatformPath> GetStrikethroughGraphicsPaths(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float realBaseLine, IPlatformPath runTextGraphicsPath)
		{
			RectangleF bounds = runLayout.Bounds;
			FontInfo runFontInfo = runLayout.RunFontInfo;
			float num = realBaseLine - (float)runFontInfo.StrikeoutPosition;
			List<IPlatformPath> list = new List<IPlatformPath>();
			int strikeoutThickness = runFontInfo.StrikeoutThickness;
			switch (runLayout.Properties.Strikethrough)
			{
			case DrawingTextStrikeType.Single:
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, bounds.Left, num, bounds.Width, strikeoutThickness);
				break;
			case DrawingTextStrikeType.Double:
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, bounds.Left, num + (float)strikeoutThickness, bounds.Width, strikeoutThickness);
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, bounds.Left, num - (float)strikeoutThickness, bounds.Width, strikeoutThickness);
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			case DrawingTextStrikeType.None:
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override float GetCurrentBaseLine()
		{
			return base.CurrentBucketElement.RunBaseLine;
		}

		protected override RectangleF GetBrushPenBounds(RectangleF paragraphBounds, RectangleF runLayoutBounds)
		{
			if (base.WarpTransformer != null)
			{
				return new RectangleF(PointF.Empty, layoutCalculator.TextRectangle.Size);
			}
			return paragraphBounds;
		}

		protected override void BeforeCloseBucket(List<BucketElement> bucketLinesPathInfos)
		{
		}

		protected override float CalculateExcelBaseLine(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in paragraphLayoutInfo.RunLayouts)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, CalcExcelBaseLine(runLayout.BaseFontInfo));
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void AddUnderlines(List<UnderlineInfo> underlines, RectangleF paragraphBounds, float excelBaseLine)
		{
			if (underlines.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			foreach (UnderlineInfo underline2 in underlines)
			{
				num = Math.Max(underline2.Baseline, num);
				num2 += underline2.RunLayoutInfo.Bounds.Width;
			}
			foreach (UnderlineInfo underline3 in underlines)
			{
				RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = underline3.RunLayoutInfo;
				FontInfo runFontInfo = runLayoutInfo.RunFontInfo;
				int underlineThickness = runFontInfo.UnderlineThickness;
				num3 += runLayoutInfo.Bounds.Width * (float)underlineThickness;
				num4 += runLayoutInfo.Bounds.Width * (float)(underlineThickness + runFontInfo.UnderlinePosition);
			}
			int num5 = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Round(num3 / num2));
			int underlinePosition = (int)Math.Round(num4 / num2) - num5;
			float left = underlines[0].RunLayoutInfo.Bounds.Left;
			for (int i = 0; i < underlines.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0 && AreUnderlinesNotSame(underlines[i - 1], underlines[i]))
				{
					UnderlineInfo underline = underlines[i - 1];
					ProcessUnderline(underline, left, paragraphBounds, excelBaseLine, num, underlinePosition, num5);
					left = underlines[i].RunLayoutInfo.Bounds.Left;
				}
			}
			ProcessUnderline(underlines[underlines.Count - 1], left, paragraphBounds, excelBaseLine, num, underlinePosition, num5);
		}

		protected override IPlatformPath GetRunTextGraphicsPath(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, string text, FontInfo fontInfo, float realBaseLine, IPlatformFill textBrush, IPlatformStroke pen)
		{
			float gdiBaseLine = CalcDXBaseLine(runLayout.RunFontInfo);
			if (AllowConvertRunLayoutToPath(runLayout, textBrush, pen))
			{
				return GetRunTextAsPath(runLayout, text, fontInfo.DXFont, realBaseLine, gdiBaseLine);
			}
			return GetRunTextAsText(runLayout, text, fontInfo.DXFont, realBaseLine, gdiBaseLine, ((BrushInfo)textBrush).Brush);
		}

		private bool AllowConvertRunLayoutToPath(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, IPlatformFill textBrush, IPlatformStroke pen)
		{
			if (base.WarpTransformer != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			IDrawingTextCharacterProperties properties = runLayout.Properties;
			if (properties != null && (properties.Effects.Effects.Count > 0 || properties.NormalizeHeight || properties.Spacing != 0))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (textBrush is BrushInfo)
			{
				return pen != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private IPlatformPath GetRunTextAsPath(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, string text, DXFont font, float realBaseLine, float gdiBaseLine)
		{
			bool flag = !PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.Skia;
			float emSize = base.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF(font.SizeInPoints);
			float num = (flag ? layoutCalculator.Graphics.PageScale : 1f);
			float num2 = runLayout.Bounds.Left * num;
			float y = (realBaseLine - gdiBaseLine) * num;
			IPlatformPath platformPath = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			float num3 = base.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF((runLayout.Properties != null) ? runLayout.Properties.Spacing : 0) / 100f;
			bool flag2 = runLayout.Properties != null && runLayout.Properties.NormalizeHeight;
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				string text2 = text[i].ToString();
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2))
				{
					GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
					gdiPlusPath.AddString(text2, font, emSize, new PointF(num2, y));
					if (flag2)
					{
						NormalizeHeight(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject, runLayout, realBaseLine);
					}
					if (gdiPlusPath.PointCount > 0)
					{
						platformPath.AddPath(gdiPlusPath, connect: false);
					}
					gdiPlusPath.Dispose();
				}
				num2 += (layoutCalculator.GetTextWidth(text2, font) + num3) * num;
			}
			if (flag && num != 1f)
			{
				platformPath.Transform(DXMatrix.CreateScaleMatrix(1f / num, 1f / num));
			}
			return platformPath;
		}

		private IPlatformPath GetRunTextAsText(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, string text, DXFont font, float realBaseLine, float gdiBaseLine, DXBrush brush)
		{
			float y = realBaseLine - gdiBaseLine;
			PointF location = new PointF(runLayout.Bounds.Left, y);
			return new PureTextInfo(text, font, brush, location, layoutCalculator.FontScale);
		}

		private void ProcessUnderline(UnderlineInfo underline, float left, RectangleF paragraphBounds, float excelBaseLine, float baseline, int underlinePosition, int realThickness)
		{
			RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = underline.RunLayoutInfo;
			IPlatformFill underlineBrush = ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter.GetUnderlineBrush(runLayoutInfo.Properties, paragraphBounds, base.ShapeStyle, underline.TextBrush);
			IPlatformStroke penInfo = underline.PenInfo;
			ContainerEffect effects = runLayoutInfo.Properties.Effects;
			RectangleF bounds = runLayoutInfo.Bounds;
			float right = bounds.Right;
			List<IPlatformPath> underlineGraphicsPaths = GetUnderlineGraphicsPaths(runLayoutInfo.Properties.Underline, left, right, baseline, underlinePosition, realThickness);
			foreach (IPlatformPath item in underlineGraphicsPaths)
			{
				TextLinePathInfo runPathInfo = new TextLinePathInfo(item, underlineBrush, penInfo);
				RectangleF bounds2 = new RectangleF(left, bounds.Top, right - left, bounds.Height);
				base.BucketLinesPathInfos.Add(new BucketElement(runPathInfo, bounds2, effects, excelBaseLine));
			}
		}

		private static void AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float left, float top, float width, int height)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			platformPath.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(left, top, width, height));
			graphicsPaths.Add(platformPath);
		}

		private static void AddDashDot(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float left, float right, int top, int dashWidth, int dotWidth, int spaceWidth, int height, int dotsCount)
		{
			float num = left;
			while (num < right)
			{
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(graphicsPaths, num, top, Math.Min(dashWidth, right - num), height);
				num += (float)(dashWidth + spaceWidth);
				for (int i = 0; i < dotsCount; i++)
				{
					if (!(num < right))
					{
						break;
					}
					AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(graphicsPaths, num, top, Math.Min(dotWidth, right - num), height);
					num += (float)(dotWidth + spaceWidth);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AddDash(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float left, float right, int top, int dashWidth, int spaceWidth, int height)
		{
			AddDashDot(graphicsPaths, left, right, top, dashWidth, 0, spaceWidth, height, 0);
		}

		private void AddWave(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float left, float right, float top, int lineLength, int lineWidth)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = new GdiPlusPath();
			AddWave(platformPath, left, right, top, lineLength, lineWidth);
			platformPath.ClosePath();
			graphicsPaths.Add(platformPath);
		}

		private void AddWave(IPlatformPath gp, float left, float right, float top, int lineLength, int lineWidth)
		{
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>();
			list.Add(new PointF(left, top + 1f));
			int num = lineLength - lineWidth + 1;
			while (left < right)
			{
				list.Add(new PointF(left + (float)num - 2f, top + (float)num - 1f));
				list.Add(new PointF(left + (float)num - 2f + (float)num - 1f, top));
				left += (float)(num - 2 + num);
			}
			gp.AddLinesPath(list.ToArray());
			for (int num2 = (list.Count - 1) / 2; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				PointF pointF = list[num2];
				PointF pointF2 = list[list.Count - 1 - num2];
				list[num2] = new PointF(pointF2.X, pointF2.Y + (float)lineWidth);
				list[list.Count - 1 - num2] = new PointF(pointF.X, pointF.Y + (float)lineWidth);
			}
			gp.AddLinesPath(list.ToArray());
		}

		private List<IPlatformPath> GetUnderlineGraphicsPaths(DrawingTextUnderlineType underlineType, float left, float right, float textBaseLine, int underlinePosition, int underlineThickness)
		{
			List<IPlatformPath> list = new List<IPlatformPath>();
			int num = underlineThickness + 1 >> 1;
			int height = underlineThickness + num;
			int num2 = (int)(textBaseLine + (float)underlinePosition);
			int num3 = num2 - underlineThickness;
			int dashWidth = underlineThickness * 3;
			int num4 = underlineThickness * 2;
			int dashWidth2 = underlineThickness * 7;
			int spaceWidth = underlineThickness * 4;
			float width = right - left;
			switch (underlineType)
			{
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Double:
			{
				IPlatformPath platformPath2 = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
				platformPath2.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(left, num3, width, num));
				platformPath2.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(left, num2 + underlineThickness - num, width, num));
				list.Add(platformPath2);
				break;
			}
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Words:
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Single:
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, left, num2, width, underlineThickness);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Heavy:
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, left, num3, width, height);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Dotted:
				AddDash(list, left, right, num2, underlineThickness, underlineThickness, underlineThickness);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyDotted:
				AddDash(list, left, right, num3, underlineThickness, underlineThickness, height);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Dashed:
				AddDash(list, left, right, num2, dashWidth, num4, underlineThickness);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyDashed:
				AddDash(list, left, right, num3, dashWidth, num4, height);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.LongDashed:
				AddDash(list, left, right, num2, dashWidth2, spaceWidth, underlineThickness);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyLongDashed:
				AddDash(list, left, right, num3, dashWidth2, spaceWidth, height);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.DotDash:
				AddDashDot(list, left, right, num2, dashWidth, underlineThickness, num4, underlineThickness, 1);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyDotDash:
				AddDashDot(list, left, right, num3, dashWidth, underlineThickness, num4, height, 1);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.DotDotDash:
				AddDashDot(list, left, right, num2, dashWidth, underlineThickness, num4, underlineThickness, 2);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyDotDotDash:
				AddDashDot(list, left, right, num3, dashWidth, underlineThickness, num4, height, 2);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Wavy:
				AddWave(list, left, right, num2 - num, num4, 1);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyWavy:
				AddWave(list, left, right, num2 - num, num4, num);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.DoubleWavy:
			{
				IPlatformPath platformPath = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
				AddWave(platformPath, left, right, num3, underlineThickness, 1);
				platformPath.ClosePath();
				AddWave(platformPath, left, right, num2, underlineThickness, 1);
				platformPath.ClosePath();
				list.Add(platformPath);
				break;
			}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && StringFormat != null)
			{
				StringFormat = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}
	}
	internal class WordArtVerticalParagraphLayoutInfoConverter : ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter
	{
		private readonly WordArtVerticalTextCalculator layoutCalculator;

		private DXMatrix wrapMatrix;

		private DXStringFormat StringFormat { get; }

		protected override float DpiScale => layoutCalculator.FontScale;

		public WordArtVerticalParagraphLayoutInfoConverter(WordArtVerticalTextCalculator layoutCalculator, List<ParagraphLayoutInfo> paragraphLayouts, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, GraphicsWarpTransformer warpTransformer, bool shouldApplyEffects, float width, float height)
			: base(paragraphLayouts, shapeStyle, warpTransformer, shouldApplyEffects)
		{
			this.layoutCalculator = layoutCalculator;
			StringFormat = DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic();
			wrapMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			wrapMatrix.RotateAt(-90f, new PointF(width / 2f, height / 2f));
		}

		protected override float CalcRealBaseLine(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float excelBaseLine)
		{
			return excelBaseLine;
		}

		protected override List<IPlatformPath> GetStrikethroughGraphicsPaths(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float realBaseLine, IPlatformPath runTextGraphicsPath)
		{
			RectangleF bounds = runLayout.Bounds;
			FontInfo runFontInfo = runLayout.RunFontInfo;
			float num = bounds.Top + CalcDXBaseLine(runLayout.RunFontInfo) - (float)runFontInfo.StrikeoutPosition;
			List<IPlatformPath> list = new List<IPlatformPath>();
			int strikeoutThickness = runFontInfo.StrikeoutThickness;
			float num2 = layoutCalculator.GetRunHeight(runLayout.RunFontInfo) * 1.1655f;
			float num3 = base.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF((runLayout.Properties != null) ? runLayout.Properties.Spacing : 0) / 100f;
			RectangleF boundsF = runTextGraphicsPath.GetBoundsF();
			string text = runLayout.Text;
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				string text2 = text[i].ToString();
				float width = layoutCalculator.Graphics.MeasureString(text2, runLayout.RunFontInfo.DXFont, SizeF.Empty, StringFormat).Width;
				float left = boundsF.Left + boundsF.Width / 2f - width / 2f;
				switch (runLayout.Properties.Strikethrough)
				{
				case DrawingTextStrikeType.Single:
					AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, left, num, width, strikeoutThickness);
					break;
				case DrawingTextStrikeType.Double:
					AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, left, num + (float)strikeoutThickness, width, strikeoutThickness);
					AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, left, num - (float)strikeoutThickness, width, strikeoutThickness);
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				case DrawingTextStrikeType.None:
					break;
				}
				num += num2 + num3;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override float GetCurrentBaseLine()
		{
			return base.CurrentBucketElement.RunBaseLine;
		}

		protected override RectangleF GetBrushPenBounds(RectangleF paragraphBounds, RectangleF runLayoutBounds)
		{
			if (base.WarpTransformer != null)
			{
				return new RectangleF(PointF.Empty, layoutCalculator.TextRectangle.Size);
			}
			return runLayoutBounds;
		}

		protected override void BeforeCloseBucket(List<BucketElement> bucket)
		{
			if (base.WarpTransformer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BucketElement item in bucket)
			{
				item.RunPathInfo.Path.Transform(wrapMatrix);
			}
		}

		protected override float CalculateExcelBaseLine(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in paragraphLayoutInfo.RunLayouts)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, CalcDXBaseLine(runLayout.BaseFontInfo));
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void AddUnderlines(List<UnderlineInfo> underlines, RectangleF paragraphBounds, float excelBaseLine)
		{
			if (underlines.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = float.MaxValue;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			foreach (UnderlineInfo underline2 in underlines)
			{
				RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = underline2.RunLayoutInfo;
				num = Math.Min(num, underline2.GraphicsPath.GetBoundsF().Left);
				num2 += runLayoutInfo.Bounds.Height;
			}
			foreach (UnderlineInfo underline3 in underlines)
			{
				RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo2 = underline3.RunLayoutInfo;
				FontInfo runFontInfo = runLayoutInfo2.RunFontInfo;
				int underlineThickness = runFontInfo.UnderlineThickness;
				num3 += runLayoutInfo2.Bounds.Height * (float)underlineThickness;
				num4 += runLayoutInfo2.Bounds.Height * (float)(underlineThickness + runFontInfo.UnderlinePosition);
			}
			int num5 = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Round(num3 / num2));
			int underlinePosition = (int)Math.Round(num4 / num2) - num5;
			float top = underlines[0].RunLayoutInfo.Bounds.Top;
			for (int i = 0; i < underlines.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0 && AreUnderlinesNotSame(underlines[i - 1], underlines[i]))
				{
					UnderlineInfo underline = underlines[i - 1];
					ProcessUnderline(underline, top, underlines[0].RunLayoutInfo.Bounds, excelBaseLine, num, underlinePosition, num5);
					top = underlines[i].RunLayoutInfo.Bounds.Top;
				}
			}
			ProcessUnderline(underlines[underlines.Count - 1], top, underlines[0].RunLayoutInfo.Bounds, excelBaseLine, num, underlinePosition, num5);
		}

		protected override IPlatformPath GetRunTextGraphicsPath(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, string text, FontInfo fontInfo, float realBaseLine, IPlatformFill textBrush, IPlatformStroke pen)
		{
			bool flag = !PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.Skia;
			float emSize = base.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF(fontInfo.SizeInPoints);
			float num = (flag ? base.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale : 1f);
			float num2 = CalcDXBaseLine(runLayout.RunFontInfo);
			float num3 = runLayout.Bounds.Left * num;
			float num4 = runLayout.Bounds.Top * num;
			IPlatformPath platformPath = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			float num5 = base.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF((runLayout.Properties != null) ? runLayout.Properties.Spacing : 0) / 100f;
			bool flag2 = runLayout.Properties != null && runLayout.Properties.NormalizeHeight;
			float num6 = layoutCalculator.GetRunHeight(fontInfo) * 1.1655f;
			float num7 = ((runLayout.Properties != null) ? runLayout.Properties.Baseline : 0);
			float num8 = num7 * base.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF(runLayout.BaseFontInfo.SizeInPoints) / 100000f;
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				string text2 = text[i].ToString();
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2))
				{
					GdiPlusPath gdiPlusPath = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
					gdiPlusPath.AddString(text2, fontInfo.DXFont, emSize, new PointF(num3, num4));
					if (flag2)
					{
						NormalizeHeight(gdiPlusPath.NativeObject, runLayout, num2 + num4);
					}
					dXMatrix.Reset();
					RectangleF boundsF = gdiPlusPath.GetBoundsF();
					dXMatrix.Translate((realBaseLine - boundsF.Width) / 2f + num8 - boundsF.Left + num3, 0f);
					dXMatrix.Scale(1f / num, 1f / num);
					gdiPlusPath.Transform(dXMatrix);
					if (gdiPlusPath.PointCount > 0)
					{
						platformPath.AddPath(gdiPlusPath, connect: false);
					}
					gdiPlusPath.Dispose();
				}
				num4 += num6 + num5;
			}
			return platformPath;
		}

		private void ProcessUnderline(UnderlineInfo underline, float top, RectangleF paragraphBounds, float excelBaseLine, float baseline, int underlinePosition, int realThickness)
		{
			RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = underline.RunLayoutInfo;
			IPlatformFill underlineBrush = ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter.GetUnderlineBrush(runLayoutInfo.Properties, paragraphBounds, base.ShapeStyle, underline.TextBrush);
			IPlatformStroke penInfo = underline.PenInfo;
			ContainerEffect effects = runLayoutInfo.Properties.Effects;
			RectangleF bounds = runLayoutInfo.Bounds;
			float bottom = bounds.Bottom;
			List<IPlatformPath> underlineGraphicsPaths = GetUnderlineGraphicsPaths(runLayoutInfo.Properties.Underline, top, bottom, baseline, underlinePosition, realThickness);
			foreach (IPlatformPath item in underlineGraphicsPaths)
			{
				TextLinePathInfo runPathInfo = new TextLinePathInfo(item, underlineBrush, penInfo);
				RectangleF bounds2 = new RectangleF(bounds.Left, top, bounds.Width, bottom);
				base.BucketLinesPathInfos.Add(new BucketElement(runPathInfo, bounds2, effects, excelBaseLine));
			}
		}

		private static void AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float left, float top, float width, float height)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			platformPath.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(left, top, width, height));
			graphicsPaths.Add(platformPath);
		}

		private static void AddDashDot(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float top, float bottom, int left, int dashHeight, int dotWidth, int spaceHeight, int width, int dotsCount)
		{
			float num = top;
			while (num < bottom)
			{
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(graphicsPaths, left, num, width, Math.Min(dashHeight, bottom - num));
				num += (float)(dashHeight + spaceHeight);
				for (int i = 0; i < dotsCount; i++)
				{
					if (!(num < bottom))
					{
						break;
					}
					AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(graphicsPaths, left, num, width, Math.Min(dotWidth, bottom - num));
					num += (float)(dotWidth + spaceHeight);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AddDash(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float top, float bottom, int left, int dashHeight, int spaceHeight, int width)
		{
			AddDashDot(graphicsPaths, top, bottom, left, dashHeight, 0, spaceHeight, width, 0);
		}

		private void AddWave(List<IPlatformPath> graphicsPaths, float top, float bottom, float left, int lineLength, int lineWidth)
		{
			IPlatformPath platformPath = new GdiPlusPath();
			AddWave(platformPath, top, bottom, left, lineLength, lineWidth);
			platformPath.ClosePath();
			graphicsPaths.Add(platformPath);
		}

		private void AddWave(IPlatformPath gp, float top, float bottom, float left, int lineLength, int lineWidth)
		{
			int num = lineLength - lineWidth + 1;
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>();
			list.Add(new PointF(left + (float)num - 1f, top));
			while (top < bottom)
			{
				list.Add(new PointF(left, top + (float)num - 2f));
				list.Add(new PointF(left + (float)num - 1f, top + (float)num - 2f + (float)num - 1f));
				top += (float)(num - 2 + num);
			}
			gp.AddLinesPath(list.ToArray());
			for (int num2 = (list.Count - 1) / 2; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				PointF pointF = list[num2];
				PointF pointF2 = list[list.Count - 1 - num2];
				list[num2] = new PointF(pointF2.X + (float)lineWidth, pointF2.Y);
				list[list.Count - 1 - num2] = new PointF(pointF.X + (float)lineWidth, pointF.Y);
			}
			gp.AddLinesPath(list.ToArray());
		}

		private List<IPlatformPath> GetUnderlineGraphicsPaths(DrawingTextUnderlineType underlineType, float top, float bottom, float textBaseLine, int underlinePosition, int underlineThickness)
		{
			List<IPlatformPath> list = new List<IPlatformPath>();
			int num = underlineThickness + 1 >> 1;
			int num2 = underlineThickness + num;
			int num3 = (int)(textBaseLine - (float)underlinePosition - (float)underlineThickness - (float)underlineThickness);
			int num4 = num3 + num;
			int dashHeight = underlineThickness * 3;
			int num5 = underlineThickness * 2;
			int dashHeight2 = underlineThickness * 7;
			int spaceHeight = underlineThickness * 4;
			float height = bottom - top;
			switch (underlineType)
			{
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Double:
			{
				IPlatformPath platformPath2 = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
				platformPath2.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(num3, top, num, height));
				platformPath2.AddRectangle(new RectangleF(num3 + num + underlineThickness, top, num, height));
				list.Add(platformPath2);
				break;
			}
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Words:
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Single:
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, num3, top, underlineThickness, height);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Heavy:
				AddGraphicsPathWithRectangle(list, num4, top, num2, height);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Dotted:
				AddDash(list, top, bottom, num3, underlineThickness, underlineThickness, underlineThickness);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyDotted:
				AddDash(list, top, bottom, num4, underlineThickness, underlineThickness, num2);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Dashed:
				AddDash(list, top, bottom, num3, dashHeight, num5, underlineThickness);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyDashed:
				AddDash(list, top, bottom, num4, dashHeight, num5, num2);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.LongDashed:
				AddDash(list, top, bottom, num3, dashHeight2, spaceHeight, underlineThickness);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyLongDashed:
				AddDash(list, top, bottom, num4, dashHeight2, spaceHeight, num2);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.DotDash:
				AddDashDot(list, top, bottom, num3, dashHeight, underlineThickness, num5, underlineThickness, 1);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyDotDash:
				AddDashDot(list, top, bottom, num4, dashHeight, underlineThickness, num5, num2, 1);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.DotDotDash:
				AddDashDot(list, top, bottom, num3, dashHeight, underlineThickness, num5, underlineThickness, 2);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyDotDotDash:
				AddDashDot(list, top, bottom, num4, dashHeight, underlineThickness, num5, num2, 2);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.Wavy:
				AddWave(list, top, bottom, num3 - num, num5, 1);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.HeavyWavy:
				AddWave(list, top, bottom, num3 - num, num5, num);
				break;
			case DrawingTextUnderlineType.DoubleWavy:
			{
				IPlatformPath platformPath = new GdiPlusPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
				AddWave(platformPath, top, bottom, num3 + underlineThickness, underlineThickness, 1);
				platformPath.ClosePath();
				AddWave(platformPath, top, bottom, num3, underlineThickness, 1);
				platformPath.ClosePath();
				list.Add(platformPath);
				break;
			}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && wrapMatrix != null)
			{
				wrapMatrix = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}
	}
	internal class BulletCalculator : IDrawingBulletVisitor
	{
		public string Typeface { get; set; }

		public string Text { get; set; }

		public DrawingColor Color { get; set; }

		public int SizeValue { get; set; }

		public DrawingTextSpacingValueType SizeType { get; set; }

		private ShapeStyle ShapeStyle { get; set; }

		private List<int> ParagraphsCount { get; set; }

		private List<int> ParagraphsStartAt { get; set; }

		private int Level { get; set; }

		internal bool HasBullet { get; set; }

		public BulletCalculator(ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
		{
			ShapeStyle = shapeStyle;
			ParagraphsCount = new List<int>();
			ParagraphsStartAt = new List<int>();
		}

		public void CalcBulletParams(IDrawingTextBullets bullets, int level)
		{
			Level = level;
			while (ParagraphsCount.Count <= level)
			{
				ParagraphsCount.Add(0);
				ParagraphsStartAt.Add(0);
			}
			HasBullet = false;
			Typeface = string.Empty;
			Text = string.Empty;
			Color = null;
			SizeType = DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Automatic;
			SizeValue = 0;
			bullets.Color.Visit(this);
			bullets.Size.Visit(this);
			bullets.Typeface.Visit(this);
			bullets.Common.Visit(this);
			if (!HasBullet)
			{
				ParagraphsCount.Clear();
				ParagraphsStartAt.Clear();
			}
		}

		private static string RealNumToChars(int realNum, char startChar)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			char value = (char)(startChar + (realNum - 1) % 26);
			for (int i = 0; i <= (realNum - 1) / 26; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private int GetRealParagraphNumber(int startAt)
		{
			if (ParagraphsStartAt[Level] != startAt)
			{
				ParagraphsStartAt[Level] = startAt;
				ParagraphsCount[Level] = 0;
			}
			return ParagraphsStartAt[Level] + ParagraphsCount[Level];
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.Visit(DrawingBulletAutoNumbered bullet)
		{
			HasBullet = true;
			int realParagraphNumber = GetRealParagraphNumber(bullet.StartAt);
			ParagraphsCount[Level]++;
			switch (bullet.SchemeType)
			{
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.AlphaLcParenBoth:
				Text = $"({RealNumToChars(realParagraphNumber, 'a')})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.AlphaUcParenBoth:
				Text = $"({RealNumToChars(realParagraphNumber, 'A')})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.AlphaLcParenR:
				Text = $"{RealNumToChars(realParagraphNumber, 'a')})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.AlphaUcParenR:
				Text = $"{RealNumToChars(realParagraphNumber, 'A')})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.AlphaLcPeriod:
				Text = $"{RealNumToChars(realParagraphNumber, 'a')}.";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.AlphaUcPeriod:
				Text = $"{RealNumToChars(realParagraphNumber, 'A')}.";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.ArabicParenBoth:
				Text = $"({realParagraphNumber.ToString()})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.ArabicParenR:
				Text = $"{realParagraphNumber.ToString()})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.ArabicPeriod:
				Text = $"{realParagraphNumber.ToString()}.";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.ArabicPlain:
				Text = $"{realParagraphNumber.ToString()}";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.RomanLcParenBoth:
				Text = $"({new LowerRomanNumberConverterClassic().ConvertNumber(realParagraphNumber)})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.RomanUcParenBoth:
				Text = $"({new UpperRomanNumberConverterClassic().ConvertNumber(realParagraphNumber)})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.RomanLcParenR:
				Text = $"{new LowerRomanNumberConverterClassic().ConvertNumber(realParagraphNumber)})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.RomanUcParenR:
				Text = $"{new UpperRomanNumberConverterClassic().ConvertNumber(realParagraphNumber)})";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.RomanLcPeriod:
				Text = $"{new LowerRomanNumberConverterClassic().ConvertNumber(realParagraphNumber)}.";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.RomanUcPeriod:
				Text = $"{new UpperRomanNumberConverterClassic().ConvertNumber(realParagraphNumber)}.";
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.CircleNumDbPlain:
				Text = ((realParagraphNumber <= 20) ? new string((char)(9312 + realParagraphNumber - 1), 1) : realParagraphNumber.ToString());
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.CircleNumWdBlackPlain:
				Typeface = "Wingdings";
				Text = new string((char)(139 + ((realParagraphNumber % 10 != 0) ? (realParagraphNumber % 10) : 10)), 1);
				break;
			case DrawingTextAutoNumberSchemeType.CircleNumWdWhitePlain:
				Typeface = "Wingdings";
				Text = new string((char)(128 + ((realParagraphNumber % 10 != 0) ? (realParagraphNumber % 10) : 10)), 1);
				break;
			default:
				Text = $"{realParagraphNumber.ToString()}.";
				break;
			}
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.Visit(DrawingBulletCharacter bullet)
		{
			HasBullet = true;
			Text = bullet.Character;
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.Visit(DrawingBlip bullet)
		{
			HasBullet = true;
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.Visit(DrawingColor bullet)
		{
			HasBullet = true;
			Color = bullet;
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.Visit(DrawingTextFont bullet)
		{
			HasBullet = true;
			Typeface = bullet.Typeface;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Typeface) || Typeface.StartsWith("+mj"))
			{
				Typeface = bullet.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FontScheme.MajorFont.Latin.Typeface;
			}
			else if (Typeface.StartsWith("+mn"))
			{
				Typeface = bullet.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FontScheme.MinorFont.Latin.Typeface;
			}
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.Visit(DrawingBulletSizePercentage bullet)
		{
			HasBullet = true;
			SizeType = DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Percent;
			SizeValue = bullet.Value;
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.Visit(DrawingBulletSizePoints bullet)
		{
			HasBullet = true;
			SizeType = DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Points;
			SizeValue = bullet.Value;
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.VisitNoBullets()
		{
			HasBullet = false;
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.VisitBulletColorFollowText()
		{
			HasBullet = true;
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.VisitBulletTypefaceFollowText()
		{
			HasBullet = true;
		}

		void IDrawingBulletVisitor.VisitBulletSizeFollowText()
		{
			HasBullet = true;
		}
	}
	public struct TextRendererContext
	{
		public DrawingTextParagraphCollection Paragraphs { get; private set; }

		public DrawingTextBodyProperties BodyProperties { get; private set; }

		public RectangleF TextRectangle { get; private set; }

		public ShapeStyle ShapeStyle { get; private set; }

		public DrawingTextListStyles ListStyles { get; private set; }

		public bool BlackAndWhitePrintMode { get; set; }

		public bool ShouldApplyEffects { get; set; }

		public float FontScale { get; set; }

		public TextRendererContext(DrawingTextParagraphCollection paragraphs, DrawingTextBodyProperties bodyProperties, RectangleF textRectangle, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, DrawingTextListStyles listStyles)
		{
			Paragraphs = paragraphs;
			BodyProperties = bodyProperties;
			TextRectangle = textRectangle;
			ShapeStyle = shapeStyle;
			ListStyles = listStyles;
			BlackAndWhitePrintMode = false;
			ShouldApplyEffects = true;
			FontScale = 1f;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class TextLayoutCalculator : IDisposable, IDrawingTextRunVisitor
	{
		private static readonly char[] wordSeparators = new char[3] { ' ', '-', '\t' };

		internal RectangleF TextRectangle { get; set; }

		protected RectangleF TextOnlyRectangle { get; set; }

		protected RectangleF ColumnRectangle => ColumnsBounds[ColumnIndex];

		protected bool StopCalculateLayout { get; set; }

		protected ParagraphLayoutInfo CurrentLine { get; set; }

		public List<ParagraphLayoutInfo> ParagraphLayoutInfos { get; private set; }

		protected DrawingTextParagraphCollection Paragraphs { get; private set; }

		protected IDocumentModel DocumentModel { get; private set; }

		protected DrawingTextBodyProperties BodyProperties { get; private set; }

		protected internal DocumentLayoutUnitConverter LayoutUnitConverter => DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter;

		public RectangleF TextBounds { get; protected set; }

		protected bool IsCurrentLineEmpty => CurrentLine.RunLayouts.Count == 0;

		protected ShapeStyle ShapeStyle { get; private set; }

		protected DXStringFormat StringFormat { get; set; }

		protected float X { get; set; }

		protected float Y { get; set; }

		private float CurrentWordSize { get; set; }

		private List<RunLayoutInfo> CurrentWordRuns { get; set; }

		private List<float> TabList { get; set; }

		private float DefaultTabSize { get; set; }

		private float DefaultParargraphTabSize { get; set; }

		private int LastCustomTabIndex { get; set; }

		private int NextCustomTabIndex { get; set; }

		private RectangleF[] ColumnsBounds { get; set; }

		private int ColumnIndex { get; set; }

		private BulletCalculator BulletCalculator { get; set; }

		protected float BulletIndent { get; set; }

		protected bool ShouldApplyEffects { get; private set; }

		protected internal ModelShapeCustomGeometry WarpGeometry { get; private set; }

		protected bool BlackAndWhitePrintMode { get; set; }

		protected DrawingTextListStyles ListStyles { get; set; }

		protected bool DisallowSpacesOnNewLine { get; set; }

		public float FontScale { get; private set; }

		public IDXGraphics Graphics { get; private set; }

		protected TextLayoutCalculator(TextRendererContext textRendererContext)
			: this(textRendererContext.TextRectangle, textRendererContext.Paragraphs, textRendererContext.BodyProperties, textRendererContext.ShapeStyle, textRendererContext.ShouldApplyEffects, textRendererContext.BlackAndWhitePrintMode, textRendererContext.ListStyles, textRendererContext.FontScale)
		{
		}

		protected TextLayoutCalculator(RectangleF textRectangle, DrawingTextParagraphCollection paragraphs, DrawingTextBodyProperties bodyProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, bool shouldApplyEffects, bool blackAndWhitePrintMode, DrawingTextListStyles listStyles, float fontScale = 1f)
		{
			FontScale = fontScale;
			Paragraphs = paragraphs;
			DocumentModel = paragraphs.DocumentModel;
			BodyProperties = GetBodyProperties(bodyProperties);
			ShapeStyle = shapeStyle;
			StringFormat = DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic();
			StringFormat.FormatFlags = (StringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces);
			TextRectangle = textRectangle;
			NormalizeTextRectangle();
			CalculateOnlyTextRectangle();
			ColumnIndex = 0;
			ColumnsBounds = CalculateColumnsBounds(TextOnlyRectangle, bodyProperties.NumberOfColumns, DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(bodyProperties.SpaceBetweenColumns));
			TabList = new List<float>();
			DefaultTabSize = DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(1440f);
			BulletCalculator = new BulletCalculator(shapeStyle);
			BulletIndent = DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(555f);
			ShouldApplyEffects = shouldApplyEffects;
			WarpGeometry = (shouldApplyEffects ? GetWarpGeometry() : null);
			BlackAndWhitePrintMode = blackAndWhitePrintMode;
			ListStyles = listStyles;
			Graphics = CreateTempGraphics();
		}

		public float GetRunHeight(FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			float height = fontInfo.DXFont.GetHeight(Graphics.DpiX);
			return LayoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnitsF(height);
		}

		private DrawingTextBodyProperties GetBodyProperties(DrawingTextBodyProperties bodyProperties)
		{
			return bodyProperties;
		}

		protected virtual void CalculateOnlyTextRectangle()
		{
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			DrawingTextInset inset = BodyProperties.Inset;
			if (inset != null)
			{
				num = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Left);
				num2 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Top);
				num3 = TextRectangle.Width - toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Right);
				num4 = TextRectangle.Height - toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Bottom);
			}
			if (num > num3)
			{
				float num5 = num;
				num = num3;
				num3 = num5;
			}
			if (num2 > num4)
			{
				float num6 = num2;
				num2 = num4;
				num4 = num6;
			}
			TextOnlyRectangle = RectangleF.FromLTRB(num, num2, num3, num4);
		}

		private void FillTabs(IDrawingTextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties)
		{
			DefaultParargraphTabSize = (paragraphProperties.HasDefaultTabSize ? DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(paragraphProperties.DefaultTabSize) : DefaultTabSize);
			TabList.Clear();
			if (paragraphProperties.TabStopList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DrawingTextTabStop tabStop in paragraphProperties.TabStopList)
			{
				TabList.Add(DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(tabStop.Position));
			}
		}

		public void CalculateTextLayout()
		{
			SetupStartingPosition();
			StopCalculateLayout = false;
			CurrentLine = new ParagraphLayoutInfo();
			ParagraphLayoutInfos = new List<ParagraphLayoutInfo>();
			CurrentWordRuns = new List<RunLayoutInfo>();
			CurrentWordSize = 0f;
			foreach (DrawingTextParagraph paragraph in Paragraphs)
			{
				CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties = GetParagraphProperties(paragraph.ParagraphProperties);
				CalculateParagraphLayout(paragraph);
				if (StopCalculateLayout)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			CalculateTextBounds();
		}

		private void AddIndent()
		{
			if (CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.HasIndent)
			{
				float indent = DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.Indent);
				AddIndent(indent);
			}
		}

		private IDrawingTextParagraphProperties GetParagraphProperties(DrawingTextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties)
		{
			return paragraphProperties;
		}

		private void CalculateParagraphLayout(DrawingTextParagraph paragraph)
		{
			FillTabs(CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties);
			AddIndent();
			StartLine();
			if (paragraph.Runs.Count == 0)
			{
				AddEmptyParagraph(paragraph);
			}
			else
			{
				AddBullet(paragraph);
				foreach (IDrawingTextRun run in paragraph.Runs)
				{
					run.Visit(this);
					if (StopCalculateLayout)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			CloseWord();
			CloseLine();
			AddSpacing();
		}

		void IDrawingTextRunVisitor.Visit(DrawingTextRun item)
		{
			CalculateRunLayoutInfo(item);
		}

		void IDrawingTextRunVisitor.Visit(DrawingTextField item)
		{
			CalculateRunLayoutInfo(item);
		}

		void IDrawingTextRunVisitor.Visit(DrawingTextLineBreak item)
		{
			CloseWord();
			CloseLine();
		}

		private void AddEmptyParagraph(DrawingTextParagraph paragraph)
		{
			IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties = GetRunProperties(paragraph.EndRunProperties);
			if (runProperties != null)
			{
				FontInfo[] fontsByRun = GetFontsByRun(runProperties);
				FontInfo runFontInfo = fontsByRun[0];
				FontInfo baseFontInfo = fontsByRun[1];
				AddWordRun(runProperties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, string.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateRunLayoutInfo(IDrawingTextRun run)
		{
			string text = run.Text;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				CloseWord();
				return;
			}
			IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties = GetRunProperties(run.RunProperties);
			if (runProperties.Caps != DrawingTextCapsType.None)
			{
				text = text.ToUpperInvariant();
			}
			FontInfo[] fontsByRun = GetFontsByRun(runProperties);
			FontInfo runFontInfo = fontsByRun[0];
			FontInfo baseFontInfo = fontsByRun[1];
			ProcessRunByWords(runProperties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text);
		}

		private IDrawingTextCharacterProperties GetRunProperties(DrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties)
		{
			if (runProperties == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IDrawingTextCharacterProperties result = runProperties;
			if (runProperties.Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic && ListStyles != null)
			{
				int textIndentLevel = CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.TextIndentLevel;
				if (!ListStyles[textIndentLevel].IsDefault)
				{
					result = new TextRendererDrawingTextCharacterProperties(runProperties)
					{
						Fill = ListStyles[textIndentLevel].DefaultCharacterProperties.Fill
					};
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CalculateRunLayoutInfoCore(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties properties, FontInfo runFontInfo, FontInfo baseFontInfo, string text)
		{
			int num = 0;
			float num2 = DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF(properties.Spacing) / 100f;
			float num3 = ((text.Length == 0) ? 0f : GetRunGrowthDimension(text[0].ToString(), runFontInfo));
			num3 += num2;
			if (AllowWordWrap() && !IsCurrentLineEmpty && !CanAddSymbolToCurrentLine(num3))
			{
				CloseLine();
				if (StopCalculateLayout)
				{
					return;
				}
				StartLine();
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				string text2 = text[i].ToString();
				float num4 = GetRunGrowthDimension(text2, runFontInfo) + num2;
				if (!AllowWordWrap() || CanAddSymbolToCurrentLine(num3 + num4))
				{
					num3 += num4;
					continue;
				}
				AddRunLayout(properties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text.Substring(num, i - num), num3);
				CloseLine();
				if (StopCalculateLayout)
				{
					return;
				}
				StartLine();
				num = i;
				num3 = num4;
			}
			AddRunLayout(properties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text.Substring(num, text.Length - num), num3);
		}

		private void ProcessRunByWords(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, FontInfo runFontInfo, FontInfo baseFontInfo, string text)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2;
			while ((num2 = text.IndexOfAny(wordSeparators, num)) != -1)
			{
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					AddWordRun(runProperties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text.Substring(num, num2 - num));
				}
				CloseWord();
				string text2 = text[num2].ToString();
				AddWordRun(runProperties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text2);
				if (text2 != "\t")
				{
					CloseWord();
				}
				num = num2 + 1;
				if (StopCalculateLayout)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (num <= text.Length - 1 || num == 0)
			{
				AddWordRun(runProperties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text.Substring(num));
			}
		}

		private void AddWordRun(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties properties, FontInfo runFontInfo, FontInfo baseFontInfo, string text)
		{
			float num = DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF(properties.Spacing) / 100f;
			float num2 = GetRunGrowthDimension(text, runFontInfo) + num * (float)text.Length;
			CurrentWordSize += num2;
			RunLayoutInfo item = new RunLayoutInfo(properties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text);
			CurrentWordRuns.Add(item);
		}

		private void CloseWord()
		{
			if (!StopCalculateLayout)
			{
				CloseWordCore();
				CurrentWordSize = 0f;
				LastCustomTabIndex = NextCustomTabIndex;
				CurrentWordRuns.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void CloseWordCore()
		{
			if (CurrentWordRuns.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (AllowWordWrap() && !CanAddSymbolToCurrentLine(CurrentWordSize) && !IsCurrentLineEmpty)
			{
				if (CurrentWordRuns.Count == 1 && CurrentWordRuns[0].Text == " " && DisallowSpacesOnNewLine)
				{
					return;
				}
				CloseLine();
				if (StopCalculateLayout)
				{
					return;
				}
				StartLine();
			}
			if (CurrentWordRuns.Count == 1 && (!AllowWordWrap() || CanAddSymbolToCurrentLine(CurrentWordSize)) && CurrentWordRuns[0].Text != "\t")
			{
				RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = CurrentWordRuns[0];
				AddRunLayout(runLayoutInfo.Properties, runLayoutInfo.RunFontInfo, runLayoutInfo.BaseFontInfo, runLayoutInfo.Text, CurrentWordSize);
				return;
			}
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo currentWordRun in CurrentWordRuns)
			{
				CalculateRunLayoutInfoCore(currentWordRun.Properties, currentWordRun.RunFontInfo, currentWordRun.BaseFontInfo, currentWordRun.Text);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateTextBounds()
		{
			TextBounds = RectangleF.Empty;
			foreach (ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo in ParagraphLayoutInfos)
			{
				foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in paragraphLayoutInfo.RunLayouts)
				{
					TextBounds = (TextBounds.IsEmpty ? runLayout.Bounds : RectangleF.Union(runLayout.Bounds, TextBounds));
				}
			}
		}

		private FontInfo[] GetFontsByRun(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties)
		{
			FontCache fontCache = DocumentModel.FontCache;
			if (fontCache == null)
			{
				return new FontInfo[2];
			}
			string fontTypeFace = DrawingTextCharacterPropertiesHelper.GetFontTypeFace(runProperties, ShapeStyle);
			float fontSize = GetFontSize(runProperties);
			int num = fontCache.CalcNormalFontIndex(fontTypeFace, (int)(fontSize * 2f), runProperties.Bold, runProperties.Italic, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false, 0);
			int index = num;
			if (runProperties.Baseline != 0)
			{
				index = fontCache.CalcNormalFontIndex(fontTypeFace, (int)(fontSize * 2f * 2f / 3f), runProperties.Bold, runProperties.Italic, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false, 0);
			}
			else if (runProperties.Caps == DrawingTextCapsType.Small)
			{
				index = fontCache.CalcNormalFontIndex(fontTypeFace, (int)(fontSize * 2f * 4f / 5f), runProperties.Bold, runProperties.Italic, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false, 0);
			}
			return new FontInfo[2]
			{
				fontCache[index],
				fontCache[num]
			};
		}

		private float GetFontSize(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties)
		{
			return DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToFontUnitsF((runProperties != null && runProperties.Options.HasFontSize) ? ((float)runProperties.FontSize / 100f) : 11f);
		}

		private void CloseLine()
		{
			LastCustomTabIndex = 0;
			NextCustomTabIndex = 0;
			if (StopCalculateLayout)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CurrentLine.Bullet != null)
			{
				ApplyParagraphAlignment(CurrentLine.Bullet, CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties);
			}
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in CurrentLine.RunLayouts)
			{
				ApplyParagraphAlignment(runLayout, CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties);
			}
			CloseLineCore();
			ParagraphLayoutInfos.Add(CurrentLine);
			CurrentLine = new ParagraphLayoutInfo(CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties);
		}

		protected float GetRunGrowthDimension(string text, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			if (!(text == "\t"))
			{
				return GetRunGrowthDimensionCore(text, fontInfo);
			}
			return AddTab();
		}

		private float AddTab()
		{
			float growthDimension = GetGrowthDimension();
			float result = 0f;
			if (TabList.Count > 0 && LastCustomTabIndex < TabList.Count && TabList[TabList.Count - 1] >= growthDimension)
			{
				for (int i = LastCustomTabIndex; i < TabList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (TabList[i] >= growthDimension)
					{
						result = TabList[i] - growthDimension;
						NextCustomTabIndex = i + 1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = DefaultParargraphTabSize - growthDimension % DefaultParargraphTabSize;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void AddSpacing()
		{
			if (ParagraphLayoutInfos.Count != 0)
			{
				ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo = ParagraphLayoutInfos[ParagraphLayoutInfos.Count - 1];
				if (paragraphLayoutInfo.RunLayouts.Count != 0)
				{
					float normalSpacing = CalcSpacing(paragraphLayoutInfo);
					AddSpacingBefore(paragraphLayoutInfo, normalSpacing);
					AddSpacingAfter(paragraphLayoutInfo, normalSpacing);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddSpacingBefore(ParagraphLayoutInfo lastParagraph, float normalSpacing)
		{
			if (ParagraphLayoutInfos.Count == 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			IDrawingTextSpacing spaceBefore = lastParagraph.ParagraphProperties.SpaceBefore;
			if (spaceBefore.Type == DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Automatic)
			{
				return;
			}
			float spacingValue = GetSpacingValue(normalSpacing, spaceBefore);
			AddSpacing(spacingValue);
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in lastParagraph.RunLayouts)
			{
				OffsetRunLayoutSpacing(runLayout, spacingValue);
			}
		}

		private float GetSpacingValue(float normalSpacing, IDrawingTextSpacing spacing)
		{
			if (spacing.Type != DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Points)
			{
				return normalSpacing * (float)spacing.Value / 100000f;
			}
			return DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF((float)spacing.Value / 100f);
		}

		private void AddSpacingAfter(ParagraphLayoutInfo lastParagraph, float normalSpacing)
		{
			IDrawingTextSpacing spaceAfter = lastParagraph.ParagraphProperties.SpaceAfter;
			if (spaceAfter.Type != DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Automatic)
			{
				float spacingValue = GetSpacingValue(normalSpacing, spaceAfter);
				AddSpacing(spacingValue);
			}
		}

		protected bool TryGotoNextColumn()
		{
			if (ColumnIndex == ColumnsBounds.Length - 1)
			{
				StopCalculateLayout = true;
				return false;
			}
			ColumnIndex++;
			SetupStartingPosition();
			return true;
		}

		private bool AllowWordWrap()
		{
			bool flag = BodyProperties.TextWrapping != DrawingTextWrappingType.None;
			return ColumnIndex < BodyProperties.NumberOfColumns - 1 || flag;
		}

		private void StartLine()
		{
			float marL = (CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.HasLeftMargin ? DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.Margin.Left) : 0f);
			StartLineCore(marL);
		}

		private void AddBullet(DrawingTextParagraph paragraph)
		{
			IDrawingTextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties = paragraph.ParagraphProperties;
			IDrawingTextBullets bullets = paragraphProperties.Bullets;
			BulletCalculator.CalcBulletParams(bullets, paragraphProperties.HasTextIndentLevel ? paragraphProperties.TextIndentLevel : 0);
			if (BulletCalculator.HasBullet)
			{
				IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties = GetRunProperties((paragraph.Runs.Count > 0) ? paragraph.Runs[0].RunProperties : null);
				string fontName = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(BulletCalculator.Typeface)) ? BulletCalculator.Typeface : DrawingTextCharacterPropertiesHelper.GetFontTypeFace(runProperties, ShapeStyle));
				float num = BulletCalculator.SizeType switch
				{
					DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Automatic => GetFontSize(runProperties), 
					DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Percent => GetFontSize(runProperties) * (float)BulletCalculator.SizeValue / 100000f, 
					DrawingTextSpacingValueType.Points => DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToFontUnitsF((float)BulletCalculator.SizeValue / 100f), 
					_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(), 
				};
				FontCache fontCache = DocumentModel.FontCache;
				if (fontCache != null)
				{
					FontInfo bulletFont = fontCache[fontCache.CalcNormalFontIndex(fontName, (int)(num * 2f), fontBold: false, fontItalic: false, fontStrikeout: false, fontUnderline: false, 0)];
					AddBulletCore(bulletFont, BulletCalculator.Text, BulletCalculator.Color, runProperties?.Fill);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void AddBulletCore(FontInfo bulletFont, string text, DrawingColor color, IDrawingFill fill);

		protected abstract void AddSpacing(float spacing);

		protected abstract float CalcSpacing(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo);

		protected abstract void SetupStartingPosition();

		protected abstract void CloseLineCore();

		protected abstract float GetRunGrowthDimensionCore(string text, FontInfo fontInfo);

		protected abstract void ApplyParagraphAlignment(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, IDrawingTextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties);

		protected abstract void AddRunLayout(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, FontInfo runFontInfo, FontInfo baseFontInfo, string text, float growthDimension);

		protected abstract bool CanAddSymbolToCurrentLine(float growthDimension);

		protected abstract void OffsetRunLayoutSpacing(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float spacing);

		protected abstract float GetGrowthDimension();

		protected abstract void AddIndent(float indent);

		protected abstract RectangleF[] CalculateColumnsBounds(RectangleF textOnlyRectangle, int columnsCount, float spaceBetween);

		protected abstract void StartLineCore(float marL);

		protected virtual void NormalizeTextRectangle()
		{
		}

		public virtual Size GetResultBitmapSize()
		{
			return Size.Round(TextRectangle.Size);
		}

		public virtual void ApplyGraphicsTransformation(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			ApplyGraphicsTransformationCore(graphics);
		}

		protected void ApplyGraphicsTransformationCore(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			float horizontalTransform = GetHorizontalTransform();
			float verticalTransform = GetVerticalTransform();
			graphics.TranslateTransform(horizontalTransform, verticalTransform);
		}

		protected virtual float GetHorizontalTransform()
		{
			if (!BodyProperties.AnchorCenter)
			{
				return TextOnlyRectangle.Left;
			}
			return TextOnlyRectangle.Left + (TextOnlyRectangle.Width - TextBounds.Width) / 2f - TextBounds.Left;
		}

		protected virtual float GetVerticalTransform()
		{
			switch (BodyProperties.Anchor)
			{
			case DrawingTextAnchoringType.Center:
				return TextOnlyRectangle.Top + (TextOnlyRectangle.Height - TextBounds.Height) / 2f - TextBounds.Top;
			case DrawingTextAnchoringType.Top:
				return TextOnlyRectangle.Top;
			case DrawingTextAnchoringType.Bottom:
			case DrawingTextAnchoringType.Distributed:
			case DrawingTextAnchoringType.Justified:
				return TextOnlyRectangle.Bottom - TextBounds.Height - TextBounds.Top;
			default:
				return TextOnlyRectangle.Top;
			}
		}

		public abstract ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter GetLayoutInfoConverter();

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (StringFormat != null)
			{
				StringFormat = null;
			}
			if (Graphics != null)
			{
				Graphics.Dispose();
				Graphics = null;
			}
		}

		protected IDXGraphics CreateTempGraphics()
		{
			using DXBitmap image = ShapeRenderHelper.CreateBitmap(new Size(1, 1), LayoutUnitConverter);
			return GdipExtensions.PrepareGraphicsFromImage(image, (GraphicsUnit)LayoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit, LayoutUnitConverter.GraphicsPageScale);
		}

		private ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetWarpGeometry()
		{
			switch (BodyProperties.PresetTextWarp)
			{
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.NoShape:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchDown:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchUp:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Button:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Circle:
				return null;
			default:
			{
				ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometryByPreset = PresetTextWarpGenerators.GetCustomGeometryByPreset(BodyProperties.PresetTextWarp);
				DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
				DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
				double widthEMU = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuD(toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits(TextRectangle.Width));
				double heightEMU = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuD(toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits(TextRectangle.Height));
				return GeometryCalculator.Calculate(customGeometryByPreset, widthEMU, heightEMU, BodyProperties.PresetAdjustValues);
			}
			}
		}

		public Rectangle GetTextBounds()
		{
			if (WarpGeometry != null)
			{
				return Rectangle.Round(TextRectangle);
			}
			RectangleF textBounds = TextBounds;
			float x = GetHorizontalTransform() + TextRectangle.X;
			float y = GetVerticalTransform() + TextRectangle.Y;
			textBounds.Offset(x, y);
			return Rectangle.Round(textBounds);
		}
	}
	internal class HorizontalTextCalculator : TextLayoutCalculator
	{
		public HorizontalTextCalculator(TextRendererContext textRendererContext)
			: base(textRendererContext)
		{
			base.DisallowSpacesOnNewLine = true;
		}

		protected override void AddBulletCore(FontInfo bulletFont, string text, DrawingColor color, IDrawingFill fill)
		{
			RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = new RunLayoutInfo(null, bulletFont, bulletFont, text);
			runLayoutInfo.Bounds = new RectangleF(base.X, base.Y, GetRunGrowthDimensionCore(text, bulletFont), GetRunHeight(bulletFont));
			base.CurrentLine.Bullet = runLayoutInfo;
			base.CurrentLine.BulletColor = color;
			base.CurrentLine.BulletFill = fill;
			base.X = Math.Max(base.X + runLayoutInfo.Bounds.Width, base.CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.HasLeftMargin ? Math.Max(base.BulletIndent, base.DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(base.CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.Margin.Left)) : 0f);
		}

		protected override void AddSpacing(float spacing)
		{
			base.Y += spacing;
		}

		protected override float CalcSpacing(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in paragraphLayoutInfo.RunLayouts)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, runLayout.Bounds.Height);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void SetupStartingPosition()
		{
			base.X = base.ColumnRectangle.Left;
			base.Y = base.ColumnRectangle.Top;
		}

		protected override void CloseLineCore()
		{
			float num = ((base.CurrentLine.Bullet == null) ? 0f : base.CurrentLine.Bullet.Bounds.Height);
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in base.CurrentLine.RunLayouts)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, runLayout.Bounds.Height);
			}
			base.X = base.ColumnRectangle.Left;
			base.Y += num;
		}

		protected override void AddRunLayout(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, FontInfo runFontInfo, FontInfo baseFontInfo, string text, float growthDimension)
		{
			float runHeight = GetRunHeight(baseFontInfo);
			if (!(base.Y + runHeight >= base.ColumnRectangle.Height) || base.ParagraphLayoutInfos.Count <= 0 || TryGotoNextColumn())
			{
				RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = new RunLayoutInfo(runProperties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text);
				runLayoutInfo.Bounds = new RectangleF(base.X, base.Y, growthDimension, runHeight);
				base.CurrentLine.RunLayouts.Add(runLayoutInfo);
				base.X += runLayoutInfo.Bounds.Width;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanAddSymbolToCurrentLine(float growthDimension)
		{
			float num = (base.CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.HasRightMargin ? base.DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(base.CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.Margin.Right) : 0f);
			return base.X + growthDimension <= base.ColumnRectangle.Right - num;
		}

		protected override void OffsetRunLayoutSpacing(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float spacing)
		{
			runLayout.OffsetY(spacing);
		}

		protected override float GetGrowthDimension()
		{
			return base.X;
		}

		protected override void AddIndent(float indent)
		{
			base.X += indent;
		}

		protected override RectangleF[] CalculateColumnsBounds(RectangleF textOnlyRectangle, int columnsCount, float spaceBetween)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = new RectangleF[columnsCount];
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = (textOnlyRectangle.Width - (float)(columnsCount - 1) * spaceBetween) / (float)columnsCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new RectangleF(num, 0f, num2, textOnlyRectangle.Height);
				num += num2 + spaceBetween;
			}
			array[columnsCount - 1] = new RectangleF(num, 0f, textOnlyRectangle.Width - num, textOnlyRectangle.Height);
			return array;
		}

		protected override void StartLineCore(float marL)
		{
			base.X += marL;
			if (base.X < 0f)
			{
				base.X = 0f;
			}
		}

		public override ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter GetLayoutInfoConverter()
		{
			GraphicsWarpTransformer warpTransformer = ((base.WarpGeometry == null) ? null : new GraphicsWarpTransformer(base.DocumentModel, base.WarpGeometry));
			return new HorizontalParagraphLayoutInfoConverter(this, base.ParagraphLayoutInfos, base.ShapeStyle, warpTransformer, base.ShouldApplyEffects, base.BlackAndWhitePrintMode);
		}

		protected override float GetRunGrowthDimensionCore(string text, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			return GetTextWidth(text, fontInfo.DXFont);
		}

		public float GetTextWidth(string text, DXFont font)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (char c in text)
			{
				num += base.Graphics.MeasureString(c.ToString(), font, SizeF.Empty, base.StringFormat).Width;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void ApplyParagraphAlignment(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, IDrawingTextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties)
		{
			float x = 0f;
			switch (paragraphProperties.TextAlignment)
			{
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Center:
				x = base.ColumnRectangle.Width / 2f - base.X / 2f;
				break;
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Right:
				x = base.ColumnRectangle.Width - base.X;
				break;
			}
			runLayout.OffsetX(x);
		}
	}
	internal class Vertical90TextCalculator : HorizontalTextCalculator
	{
		public Vertical90TextCalculator(TextRendererContext textRendererContext)
			: base(textRendererContext)
		{
		}

		protected override void NormalizeTextRectangle()
		{
			RectangleF textRectangle = base.TextRectangle;
			float num = textRectangle.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = textRectangle.Height / 2f;
			float x = textRectangle.Left + num - num2;
			float y = textRectangle.Top + num2 - num;
			base.TextRectangle = new RectangleF(x, y, textRectangle.Height, textRectangle.Width);
		}

		protected override void CalculateOnlyTextRectangle()
		{
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = base.DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			DrawingTextInset inset = base.BodyProperties.Inset;
			if (inset != null)
			{
				num2 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Left);
				num = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Top);
				num4 = base.TextRectangle.Height - toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Right);
				num3 = base.TextRectangle.Width - toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Bottom);
			}
			if (num > num3)
			{
				float num5 = num;
				num = num3;
				num3 = num5;
			}
			if (num2 > num4)
			{
				float num6 = num2;
				num2 = num4;
				num4 = num6;
			}
			base.TextOnlyRectangle = RectangleF.FromLTRB(num, num2, num3, num4);
		}

		public override Size GetResultBitmapSize()
		{
			int width = (int)base.TextRectangle.Height;
			int height = (int)base.TextRectangle.Width;
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		public override void ApplyGraphicsTransformation(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			graphics.TranslateTransform(base.TextRectangle.Height, 0f);
			graphics.RotateTransform(90f);
			ApplyGraphicsTransformationCore(graphics);
		}
	}
	internal class Vertical270TextCalculator : Vertical90TextCalculator
	{
		public Vertical270TextCalculator(TextRendererContext textRendererContext)
			: base(textRendererContext)
		{
		}

		public override void ApplyGraphicsTransformation(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			graphics.TranslateTransform(0f, base.TextRectangle.Width);
			graphics.RotateTransform(-90f);
			ApplyGraphicsTransformationCore(graphics);
		}
	}
	internal class WordArtVerticalTextCalculator : TextLayoutCalculator
	{
		public const float VerticalTextKoef = 1.1655f;

		public WordArtVerticalTextCalculator(TextRendererContext textRendererContext)
			: base(textRendererContext)
		{
		}

		protected override void AddBulletCore(FontInfo bulletFont, string text, DrawingColor color, IDrawingFill fill)
		{
			RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = new RunLayoutInfo(null, bulletFont, bulletFont, text);
			runLayoutInfo.Bounds = new RectangleF(base.X, base.Y, GetRunWidth(bulletFont, text), GetRunGrowthDimensionCore(text, bulletFont));
			base.CurrentLine.Bullet = runLayoutInfo;
			base.CurrentLine.BulletColor = color;
			base.CurrentLine.BulletFill = fill;
			base.Y = Math.Max(base.Y + runLayoutInfo.Bounds.Height, base.CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.HasLeftMargin ? base.DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(base.CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.Margin.Left) : 0f);
		}

		protected override void AddSpacing(float spacing)
		{
			base.X += spacing;
		}

		protected override float CalcSpacing(ParagraphLayoutInfo paragraphLayoutInfo)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in paragraphLayoutInfo.RunLayouts)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, runLayout.Bounds.Width);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void SetupStartingPosition()
		{
			base.X = base.ColumnRectangle.Left;
			base.Y = base.ColumnRectangle.Top;
		}

		protected override void CloseLineCore()
		{
			if (base.StopCalculateLayout)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = 0f;
			List<RunLayoutInfo> list = new List<RunLayoutInfo>();
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout in base.CurrentLine.RunLayouts)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, runLayout.Bounds.Width);
				if (runLayout.Text.Length <= 1)
				{
					list.Add(runLayout);
					continue;
				}
				RectangleF bounds = runLayout.Bounds;
				float num2 = bounds.Height / (float)runLayout.Text.Length;
				float num3 = 0f;
				string text = runLayout.Text;
				foreach (char c in text)
				{
					RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = new RunLayoutInfo(runLayout.Properties, runLayout.RunFontInfo, runLayout.BaseFontInfo, c.ToString());
					runLayoutInfo.Bounds = new RectangleF(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + num3, bounds.Width, num2);
					list.Add(runLayoutInfo);
					num3 += num2;
				}
			}
			foreach (RunLayoutInfo runLayout2 in base.CurrentLine.RunLayouts)
			{
				RectangleF bounds2 = runLayout2.Bounds;
				runLayout2.Bounds = new RectangleF(bounds2.Left, bounds2.Top, num, bounds2.Height);
			}
			base.CurrentLine.RunLayouts.Clear();
			base.CurrentLine.RunLayouts.AddRange(list);
			base.X = GetNextLineLeft(num);
			base.Y = base.ColumnRectangle.Top;
		}

		protected virtual float GetNextLineLeft(float lineWidth)
		{
			return base.X + lineWidth;
		}

		protected override void AddRunLayout(IDrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, FontInfo runFontInfo, FontInfo baseFontInfo, string text, float growthDimension)
		{
			float runWidth = GetRunWidth(baseFontInfo, text);
			if (CanAddLine(runWidth) || TryGotoNextColumn())
			{
				RunLayoutInfo runLayoutInfo = new RunLayoutInfo(runProperties, runFontInfo, baseFontInfo, text);
				runLayoutInfo.Bounds = new RectangleF(base.X, base.Y, runWidth, growthDimension);
				base.CurrentLine.RunLayouts.Add(runLayoutInfo);
				base.Y += runLayoutInfo.Bounds.Height;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanAddLine(float runWidth)
		{
			return base.X + runWidth < base.ColumnRectangle.Width;
		}

		private float GetRunWidth(FontInfo fontInfo, string text)
		{
			float val = 0f;
			foreach (char c in text)
			{
				val = Math.Max(val, base.Graphics.MeasureString(c.ToString(), fontInfo.DXFont, SizeF.Empty, base.StringFormat).Width);
			}
			return Math.Max(val, GetRunHeight(fontInfo) * 1.1655f);
		}

		protected override bool CanAddSymbolToCurrentLine(float growthDimension)
		{
			float num = (base.CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.HasRightMargin ? base.DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(base.CurrentLine.ParagraphProperties.Margin.Right) : 0f);
			return base.Y + growthDimension <= base.ColumnRectangle.Bottom - num;
		}

		protected override void OffsetRunLayoutSpacing(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, float spacing)
		{
			runLayout.OffsetX(spacing);
		}

		protected override float GetGrowthDimension()
		{
			return base.Y;
		}

		protected override void AddIndent(float indent)
		{
			base.Y += indent;
		}

		protected override RectangleF[] CalculateColumnsBounds(RectangleF textOnlyRectangle, int columnsCount, float spaceBetween)
		{
			RectangleF[] array = new RectangleF[columnsCount];
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = (textOnlyRectangle.Height - (float)(columnsCount - 1) * spaceBetween) / (float)columnsCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new RectangleF(0f, num, textOnlyRectangle.Width, num2);
				num += num2 + spaceBetween;
			}
			array[columnsCount - 1] = new RectangleF(0f, num, textOnlyRectangle.Width, textOnlyRectangle.Height - num);
			return array;
		}

		protected override void StartLineCore(float marL)
		{
			base.Y += marL;
			if (base.Y < 0f)
			{
				base.Y = 0f;
			}
		}

		public override ParagraphLayoutInfoConverter GetLayoutInfoConverter()
		{
			GraphicsWarpTransformer warpTransformer = ((base.WarpGeometry == null) ? null : new GraphicsWarpTransformer(base.DocumentModel, base.WarpGeometry));
			return new WordArtVerticalParagraphLayoutInfoConverter(this, base.ParagraphLayoutInfos, base.ShapeStyle, warpTransformer, base.ShouldApplyEffects, base.TextRectangle.Width, base.TextRectangle.Height);
		}

		protected override float GetRunGrowthDimensionCore(string text, FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			return GetRunHeight(fontInfo) * (float)text.Length * 1.1655f;
		}

		protected override void ApplyParagraphAlignment(RunLayoutInfo runLayout, IDrawingTextParagraphProperties paragraphProperties)
		{
			float y = 0f;
			switch (paragraphProperties.TextAlignment)
			{
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Center:
				y = base.ColumnRectangle.Height / 2f - base.Y / 2f;
				break;
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Right:
				y = base.ColumnRectangle.Height - base.Y;
				break;
			}
			runLayout.OffsetY(y);
		}
	}
	internal class WordArtVerticalRTLTextCalculator : WordArtVerticalTextCalculator
	{
		public WordArtVerticalRTLTextCalculator(TextRendererContext textRendererContext)
			: base(textRendererContext)
		{
		}
	}
	public static class TextRenderer
	{
		private static TextLayoutCalculator GetTextLayoutCalculator(TextRendererContext textRendererContext)
		{
			return textRendererContext.BodyProperties.VerticalText switch
			{
				DrawingTextVerticalTextType.EastAsianVertical => new HorizontalTextCalculator(textRendererContext), 
				DrawingTextVerticalTextType.Horizontal => new HorizontalTextCalculator(textRendererContext), 
				DrawingTextVerticalTextType.MongolianVertical => new HorizontalTextCalculator(textRendererContext), 
				DrawingTextVerticalTextType.Vertical => new Vertical90TextCalculator(textRendererContext), 
				DrawingTextVerticalTextType.Vertical270 => new Vertical270TextCalculator(textRendererContext), 
				DrawingTextVerticalTextType.WordArtVertical => new WordArtVerticalTextCalculator(textRendererContext), 
				DrawingTextVerticalTextType.VerticalWordArtRightToLeft => new WordArtVerticalRTLTextCalculator(textRendererContext), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("BodyProperties.VerticalText"), 
			};
		}

		public static TextRectanglePathInfo CalculateTextLayoutInfo(TextRendererContext textRendererContext)
		{
			TextLayoutCalculator textLayoutCalculator = GetTextLayoutCalculator(textRendererContext);
			textLayoutCalculator.CalculateTextLayout();
			if (textLayoutCalculator.ParagraphLayoutInfos.Count == 0)
			{
				textLayoutCalculator.Dispose();
				return null;
			}
			Size resultBitmapSize = textLayoutCalculator.GetResultBitmapSize();
			Rectangle textBounds = textLayoutCalculator.GetTextBounds();
			if (resultBitmapSize.Width == 0 || resultBitmapSize.Height == 0 || textBounds.Width == 0 || textBounds.Height == 0)
			{
				textLayoutCalculator.Dispose();
				return null;
			}
