			return new TextRectanglePathInfo(textLayoutCalculator, Rectangle.Round(textRendererContext.TextRectangle));
		}
	}
	public class WidenHelper
	{
		private delegate void ProcessLineJoin(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, int prev, int next);

		private struct ArrowSegment
		{
			public static ArrowSegment Empty = new ArrowSegment(PointF.Empty, PointF.Empty, PointF.Empty, int.MinValue);

			public PointF StartPoint { get; }

			public PointF EndPoint { get; }

			public PointF InsidePoint { get; }

			public int EndPointIndex { get; }

			public bool IsEmpty
			{
				get
				{
					if (StartPoint.Equals(PointF.Empty) && EndPoint.Equals(PointF.Empty) && InsidePoint.Equals(PointF.Empty))
					{
						return EndPointIndex == int.MinValue;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public ArrowSegment(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint, PointF insidePoint, int endPointIndex)
			{
				StartPoint = startPoint;
				EndPointIndex = endPointIndex;
				EndPoint = endPoint;
				InsidePoint = insidePoint;
			}
		}

		private struct Polygon
		{
			public PointF[] Points { get; }

			public PointF[] Normals { get; }

			public PointF[] ReversedNormals { get; }

			public bool IsClosed { get; }

			public Polygon(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, PointF[] reversedNormals, bool isClosed)
			{
				Points = points;
				Normals = normals;
				ReversedNormals = reversedNormals;
				IsClosed = isClosed;
			}
		}

		private struct SplittedBezierCurve
		{
			public PointF[] FirstHalf { get; }

			public PointF[] SecondHalf { get; }

			public SplittedBezierCurve(PointF[] p, float t)
			{
				this = default(SplittedBezierCurve);
				PointF pointF = p[0];
				PointF bezierPoint = GetBezierPoint(p[0], p[1], t);
				PointF bezierPoint2 = GetBezierPoint(p[1], p[2], t);
				PointF bezierPoint3 = GetBezierPoint(p[2], p[3], t);
				PointF bezierPoint4 = GetBezierPoint(bezierPoint, bezierPoint2, t);
				PointF bezierPoint5 = GetBezierPoint(bezierPoint2, bezierPoint3, t);
				PointF bezierPoint6 = GetBezierPoint(bezierPoint4, bezierPoint5, t);
				PointF pointF2 = p[3];
				FirstHalf = new PointF[4] { pointF, bezierPoint, bezierPoint4, bezierPoint6 };
				SecondHalf = new PointF[4] { bezierPoint6, bezierPoint5, bezierPoint3, pointF2 };
			}

			private PointF GetBezierPoint(PointF start, PointF end, float t)
			{
				return new PointF((end.X - start.X) * t + start.X, (end.Y - start.Y) * t + start.Y);
			}
		}

		private readonly List<Polygon> polygons;

		private readonly DXPen pen;

		private readonly LineCapInfo startCapInfo;

		private readonly LineCapInfo endCapInfo;

		private readonly float miterLimit;

		private readonly float delta;

		private readonly bool applyBoundingPath;

		private const float flatness = 0.1f;

		private DXGraphicsPath currentPath;

		private ProcessLineJoin processLineJoin;

		private DXGraphicsPath startCapPath;

		private DXGraphicsPath endCapPath;

		private DXMatrix scaleTransform;

		public static void Apply(DXGraphicsPath path, DXPen pen)
		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.GdiPlus)
			{
				WidenHelper widenHelper = new WidenHelper(pen);
				widenHelper.ApplyCore(path);
			}
			else
			{
				path.Widen(pen);
			}
		}

		public static void Apply(DXGraphicsPath path, PenInfo penInfo, bool applyBoundingPath, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)penInfo, "penInfo");
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && (DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.GdiPlus || penInfo.HasCaps))
			{
				WidenHelper widenHelper = new WidenHelper(penInfo, applyBoundingPath, transform);
				widenHelper.ApplyCore(path);
				path.Widen(penInfo.Pen);
			}
			else if (transform == null)
			{
				path.Widen(penInfo.Pen);
			}
			else
			{
				path.Widen(penInfo.Pen, transform);
			}
		}

		public static void DrawPath(DXGraphicsPath path, PenInfo penInfo, IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)penInfo, "penInfo");
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.GdiPlus)
			{
				WidenHelper widenHelper = new WidenHelper(penInfo, applyBoundingPath: false, null);
				widenHelper.ApplyCore(path);
				FillWidenPath(path, penInfo, graphics);
			}
			else
			{
				graphics.DrawPath(penInfo.Pen, path);
			}
		}

		private static void FillWidenPath(DXGraphicsPath path, PenInfo penInfo, IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			DXBrush dXBrush = penInfo.Pen?.Brush;
			if (dXBrush != null)
			{
				if (dXBrush is DXSolidBrush)
				{
					FillWidenPathCore(path, dXBrush, graphics);
					return;
				}
				DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
				float num = penInfo.ConvertToEmuSafe(1f);
				dXMatrix.Scale(num, num);
				dXBrush.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
				FillWidenPathCore(path, dXBrush, graphics);
				dXMatrix.Invert();
				dXBrush.ApplyTransform(dXMatrix, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			}
		}

		private static void FillWidenPathCore(DXGraphicsPath path, DXBrush brush, IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			GraphicsPathIterator graphicsPathIterator = new GraphicsPathIterator(SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(path));
			for (int i = 0; i < graphicsPathIterator.SubpathCount; i++)
			{
				bool isClosed = false;
				using GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				graphicsPathIterator.NextSubpath(graphicsPath, out isClosed);
				graphicsPath.FillMode = FillMode.Winding;
				graphics.FillPath(brush, SystemDrawingConverter.WrapGraphicsPath(graphicsPath));
			}
		}

		private WidenHelper(DXPen pen)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)pen, "pen");
			polygons = new List<Polygon>();
			this.pen = pen;
			delta = pen.Width / 2f;
			miterLimit = 2f / (pen.MiterLimit * pen.MiterLimit);
		}

		private WidenHelper(PenInfo penInfo, bool applyBoundingPath, DXMatrix scaleTransform)
			: this(penInfo.Pen)
		{
			startCapInfo = penInfo.StartCap;
			endCapInfo = penInfo.EndCap;
			this.applyBoundingPath = applyBoundingPath;
			this.scaleTransform = scaleTransform;
		}

		private void ApplyCore(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)path, "path");
			PreparePolygons(path);
			path.Reset();
			path.FillMode = DXFillMode.Winding;
			processLineJoin = GetLineJoinStrategy();
			for (int i = 0; i < polygons.Count; i++)
			{
				using DXGraphicsPath path2 = ProcessFigure(polygons[i]);
				path.AddPath(path2, connect: false);
			}
			using DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = CreateLineCapPath();
			if (dXGraphicsPath.PointCount > 0)
			{
				path.AddPath(dXGraphicsPath, connect: false);
			}
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath CreateLineCapPath()
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			if (startCapPath != null)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(startCapPath, connect: false);
				startCapPath.Dispose();
			}
			if (endCapPath != null)
			{
				dXGraphicsPath.AddPath(endCapPath, connect: false);
				endCapPath.Dispose();
			}
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private void PreparePolygons(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			bool isClosed = false;
			System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> pathTypes = path.PathTypes;
			System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<PointF> pathPoints = path.PathPoints;
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>();
			List<PointF> normals = new List<PointF>();
			List<PointF> reversedNormals = new List<PointF>();
			for (int i = 0; i < path.PointCount; i++)
			{
				switch (GetPointType((byte)pathTypes[i]))
				{
				case PathPointType.Start:
					AddPolygon(list, normals, reversedNormals, isClosed);
					list.Add(pathPoints[i]);
					isClosed = false;
					break;
				case PathPointType.Line:
					AddPointAndNormals(list, normals, reversedNormals, pathPoints[i]);
					isClosed = (pathTypes[i] & DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath) != 0;
					break;
				case PathPointType.Bezier:
				{
					PointF[] curve = new PointF[4]
					{
						list.Last(),
						pathPoints[i],
						pathPoints[i + 1],
						pathPoints[i + 2]
					};
					AddFlattenedCurve(curve, list, normals, reversedNormals);
					isClosed = (pathTypes[i + 2] & DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath) != 0;
					i += 2;
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			AddPolygon(list, normals, reversedNormals, isClosed);
		}

		private void AddPointAndNormals(List<PointF> points, List<PointF> normals, List<PointF> reversedNormals, PointF point)
		{
			PointF pointF = points[points.Count - 1];
			if (!pointF.Equals(point))
			{
				points.Add(point);
				normals.Add(GetNormal(pointF, point));
				reversedNormals.Add(GetNormal(point, pointF));
			}
		}

		private void AddFlattenedCurve(PointF[] curve, List<PointF> points, List<PointF> normals, List<PointF> reversedNormals)
		{
			PointF pointF = points.First();
			while (!BezierIsFlat(curve, 0.1f))
			{
				SplittedBezierCurve splittedBezierCurve = FindFlatSegment(curve, 0.5f);
				AddPointAndNormals(points, normals, reversedNormals, splittedBezierCurve.FirstHalf[3]);
				curve = splittedBezierCurve.SecondHalf;
			}
			PointF point = curve[3];
			if (!point.Equals(pointF))
			{
				AddPointAndNormals(points, normals, reversedNormals, point);
			}
		}

		private SplittedBezierCurve FindFlatSegment(PointF[] curve, float t)
		{
			SplittedBezierCurve result = new SplittedBezierCurve(curve, t);
			if (BezierIsFlat(result.FirstHalf, 0.1f))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return FindFlatSegment(curve, t / 2f);
		}

		private void AddPolygon(List<PointF> points, List<PointF> normals, List<PointF> reversedNormals, bool isClosed)
		{
			if (points.Count > 1)
			{
				normals.Add(GetLastNormal(points, normals, isClosed));
				reversedNormals.Insert(0, GetLastNormalReversed(points, reversedNormals, isClosed));
				if (!isClosed)
				{
					ProcessLineCaps(points, normals, reversedNormals);
				}
				if (points.Count > 1)
				{
					polygons.Add(new Polygon(points.ToArray(), normals.ToArray(), reversedNormals.ToArray(), isClosed));
				}
				normals.Clear();
				reversedNormals.Clear();
			}
			points.Clear();
		}

		private PointF GetLastNormal(List<PointF> points, List<PointF> normals, bool isClosed)
		{
			if (isClosed)
			{
				return GetNormal(points.Last(), points.First());
			}
			return normals.Last();
		}

		private PointF GetLastNormalReversed(List<PointF> points, List<PointF> reversedNormals, bool isClosed)
		{
			if (isClosed)
			{
				return GetNormal(points.First(), points.Last());
			}
			return reversedNormals.First();
		}

		private PathPointType GetPointType(byte type)
		{
			byte b = 128;
			if (type > b)
			{
				type -= b;
			}
			return (PathPointType)type;
		}

		private ProcessLineJoin GetLineJoinStrategy()
		{
			switch (pen.LineJoin)
			{
			case DXLineJoin.Miter:
			case DXLineJoin.MiterClipped:
				return ProcessMiterLineJoin;
			case DXLineJoin.Round:
				return ProcessRoundLineJoin;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath ProcessFigure(Polygon polygon)
		{
			if (polygon.IsClosed)
			{
				return ProcessClosedFigure(polygon.Points, polygon.Normals, polygon.ReversedNormals);
			}
			return ProcessOpenFigure(polygon.Points, polygon.Normals, polygon.ReversedNormals);
		}

		private void ProcessLineCaps(List<PointF> points, List<PointF> normals, List<PointF> reversedNormals)
		{
			if (startCapInfo != null || endCapInfo != null)
			{
				ArrowSegment arrowSegment = ArrowSegment.Empty;
				ArrowSegment arrowSegment2 = ArrowSegment.Empty;
				DXMatrix capTransform = CreateCapTransform(pen.Width);
				if (startCapInfo != null)
				{
					DXGraphicsPath path = CreatCapPath(startCapInfo, capTransform);
					float inset = startCapInfo.Inset * pen.Width;
					float arrowLength = GetArrowLength(path, inset, startCapInfo.Type);
					arrowSegment = GetStartCapArrowSegment(points, arrowLength, inset);
					startCapPath = FinalizeCapPath(path, arrowSegment.StartPoint, arrowSegment.EndPoint);
				}
				if (endCapInfo != null)
				{
					DXGraphicsPath path2 = CreatCapPath(endCapInfo, capTransform);
					float inset2 = endCapInfo.Inset * pen.Width;
					float arrowLength2 = GetArrowLength(path2, inset2, endCapInfo.Type);
					arrowSegment2 = GetEndCapArrowSegment(points, arrowLength2, inset2);
					endCapPath = FinalizeCapPath(path2, arrowSegment2.StartPoint, arrowSegment2.EndPoint);
				}
				if (arrowSegment2.IsEmpty)
				{
					UpdatePointsAndNormals_HasStartCap(points, normals, reversedNormals, arrowSegment.EndPointIndex, arrowSegment.InsidePoint);
				}
				else if (arrowSegment.IsEmpty)
				{
					UpdatePointsAndNormals_HasEndCap(points, normals, reversedNormals, arrowSegment2.EndPointIndex, arrowSegment2.InsidePoint);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdatePointsAndNormals(points, normals, reversedNormals, arrowSegment.EndPointIndex, arrowSegment2.EndPointIndex, arrowSegment.InsidePoint, arrowSegment2.InsidePoint);
				}
			}
		}

		private float GetArrowLength(DXGraphicsPath path, float inset, OutlineHeadTailType type)
		{
			if (type == OutlineHeadTailType.Arrow || type == OutlineHeadTailType.StealthArrow)
			{
				return inset;
			}
			int num = 0;
			num = ((!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows) ? path.GetBoundsExt().Height : SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(path).GetBoundsExt().Height);
			if (type == OutlineHeadTailType.TriangleArrow)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return num / 2;
		}

		private void UpdatePointsAndNormals_HasStartCap(List<PointF> points, List<PointF> normals, List<PointF> reversedNormals, int arrowSegmentEndIndex, PointF arrowInsidePoint)
		{
			int num = points.Count - 1;
			if (arrowSegmentEndIndex > num)
			{
				points.Clear();
				return;
			}
			points.RemoveRange(0, arrowSegmentEndIndex);
			points.Insert(0, arrowInsidePoint);
			if (arrowSegmentEndIndex == num)
			{
				UpdateNormalsForArrowWithOneSegmentGeometry(normals, reversedNormals, points.First(), points.Last());
				return;
			}
			normals.RemoveRange(0, arrowSegmentEndIndex - 1);
			reversedNormals.RemoveRange(0, arrowSegmentEndIndex - 1);
		}

		private void UpdatePointsAndNormals_HasEndCap(List<PointF> points, List<PointF> normals, List<PointF> reversedNormals, int arrowSegmentEndIndex, PointF arrowInsidePoint)
		{
			if (arrowSegmentEndIndex == 0)
			{
				points.Clear();
				return;
			}
			int count = points.Count;
			points.RemoveRange(arrowSegmentEndIndex, count - arrowSegmentEndIndex);
			points.Add(arrowInsidePoint);
			if (arrowSegmentEndIndex == 1)
			{
				UpdateNormalsForArrowWithOneSegmentGeometry(normals, reversedNormals, points.First(), points.Last());
				return;
			}
			normals.RemoveRange(arrowSegmentEndIndex - 1, count - arrowSegmentEndIndex + 1);
			reversedNormals.RemoveRange(arrowSegmentEndIndex, count - arrowSegmentEndIndex);
			normals.Add(GetNormal(points[points.Count - 2], points.Last()));
			normals.Add(normals.Last());
			reversedNormals.Add(GetNormal(points.Last(), points[points.Count - 2]));
		}

		private void UpdatePointsAndNormals(List<PointF> points, List<PointF> normals, List<PointF> reversedNormals, int startArrowSegmentEndIndex, int endArrowSegmentEndIndex, PointF startInsidePoint, PointF endInsidePoint)
		{
			if (startArrowSegmentEndIndex < endArrowSegmentEndIndex)
			{
				UpdatePointsAndNormals_HasEndCap(points, normals, reversedNormals, endArrowSegmentEndIndex, endInsidePoint);
				UpdatePointsAndNormals_HasStartCap(points, normals, reversedNormals, startArrowSegmentEndIndex, startInsidePoint);
			}
			else if (startArrowSegmentEndIndex == endArrowSegmentEndIndex)
			{
				points.Clear();
				points.Add(startInsidePoint);
				points.Add(endInsidePoint);
				UpdateNormalsForArrowWithOneSegmentGeometry(normals, reversedNormals, startInsidePoint, endInsidePoint);
			}
			else
			{
				points.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateNormalsForArrowWithOneSegmentGeometry(List<PointF> normals, List<PointF> reversedNormals, PointF start, PointF end)
		{
			PointF normal = GetNormal(start, end);
			PointF normal2 = GetNormal(end, start);
			normals.Clear();
			normals.Add(normal);
			normals.Add(normal);
			reversedNormals.Clear();
			reversedNormals.Add(normal2);
			reversedNormals.Add(normal2);
		}

		private ArrowSegment GetStartCapArrowSegment(List<PointF> points, float arrowLength, float inset)
		{
			PointF pointF = points.First();
			PointF prev = default(PointF);
			PointF pointF2 = pointF;
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			while (num < points.Count - 1 && num2 < (double)arrowLength)
			{
				num++;
				prev = pointF2;
				pointF2 = points[num];
				num2 = GetSegmentLength(pointF, pointF2);
			}
			PointF pointF3 = CalculatePointOnLine(pointF, prev, pointF2, arrowLength, num2);
			PointF insidePoint = PointF.Empty;
			if (num2 >= (double)arrowLength)
			{
				insidePoint = ((inset == 0f) ? pointF : CalculatePointInsideSegment(pointF, pointF3, inset));
			}
			else
			{
				num++;
			}
			return new ArrowSegment(pointF, pointF3, insidePoint, num);
		}

		private ArrowSegment GetEndCapArrowSegment(List<PointF> points, float arrowLength, float inset)
		{
			PointF pointF = points.Last();
			PointF prev = default(PointF);
			PointF pointF2 = pointF;
			int num = points.Count - 1;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			while (num > 0 && num2 < (double)arrowLength)
			{
				num--;
				prev = pointF2;
				pointF2 = points[num];
				num2 = GetSegmentLength(pointF, pointF2);
			}
			PointF pointF3 = CalculatePointOnLine(pointF, prev, pointF2, arrowLength, num2);
			PointF insidePoint = Point.Empty;
			if (num2 >= (double)arrowLength)
			{
				insidePoint = ((inset == 0f) ? pointF : CalculatePointInsideSegment(pointF, pointF3, inset));
				num++;
			}
			return new ArrowSegment(pointF, pointF3, insidePoint, num);
		}

		private PointF CalculatePointOnLine(PointF start, PointF prev, PointF next, double arrowLength, double lengthFromStart)
		{
			bool flag = prev.Equals(start);
			double num = (flag ? lengthFromStart : GetSegmentLength(prev, next));
			double num2 = (double)(next.X - prev.X) / num;
			double num3 = (double)(next.Y - prev.Y) / num;
			if (!flag)
			{
				double num4 = num3 * (double)(start.Y - prev.Y) + num2 * (double)(start.X - prev.X);
				double num5 = num3 * (double)(start.X - prev.X) - num2 * (double)(start.Y - prev.Y);
				num4 += Math.Sqrt(arrowLength * arrowLength - num5 * num5);
				arrowLength = num4;
			}
			double num6 = (double)prev.X + num2 * arrowLength;
			double num7 = (double)prev.Y + num3 * arrowLength;
			return new PointF((float)num6, (float)num7);
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath CreatCapPath(LineCapInfo lineCapInfo, DXMatrix capTransform)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = (applyBoundingPath ? lineCapInfo.BoundingPath.Clone() : lineCapInfo.GraphicsPath.Clone());
			dXGraphicsPath.Transform(capTransform);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath FinalizeCapPath(DXGraphicsPath path, PointF start, PointF end)
		{
			RotatePath(path, start, end);
			path.Translate(start.X, start.Y);
			if (!path.IsClosed())
			{
				WidenCap(path);
			}
			return path;
		}

		private void RotatePath(DXGraphicsPath path, PointF capStart, PointF capEnd)
		{
			float rotationAngle = GetRotationAngle(capStart, capEnd);
			if (rotationAngle != 0f)
			{
				DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
				dXMatrix.Rotate(rotationAngle);
				path.Transform(dXMatrix);
			}
		}

		private void WidenCap(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			using DXPen dXPen = pen.Clone();
			dXPen.LineJoin = DXLineJoin.Miter;
			if (scaleTransform != null)
			{
				dXPen.Width *= scaleTransform.Elements[0];
			}
			WidenHelper widenHelper = new WidenHelper(dXPen);
			widenHelper.ApplyCore(path);
		}

		private DXMatrix CreateCapTransform(float penWidth)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			if (scaleTransform != null)
			{
				dXMatrix.Multiply(scaleTransform);
			}
			dXMatrix.Scale(penWidth, penWidth);
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath ProcessClosedFigure(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, PointF[] reversedNormals)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			currentPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			int prev = 0;
			int num = points.Length;
			OffsetPoints(points, normals, num - 1, 0);
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				OffsetPoints(points, normals, prev, i);
				prev = i;
			}
			AddScaledPath(dXGraphicsPath, currentPath);
			currentPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			prev = num - 1;
			OffsetPoints(points, reversedNormals, 0, num - 1);
			for (int num2 = num - 2; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				OffsetPoints(points, reversedNormals, prev, num2);
				prev = num2;
			}
			AddScaledPath(dXGraphicsPath, currentPath);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private DXGraphicsPath ProcessOpenFigure(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, PointF[] reversedNormals)
		{
			DXGraphicsPath dXGraphicsPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			currentPath = new DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode.Winding);
			OffsetPoints(points, normals, 0, 0, isFirst: true);
			int prev = 0;
			int num = points.Length - 1;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				OffsetPoints(points, normals, prev, i);
				prev = i;
			}
			OffsetPoints(points, normals, num, num, isFirst: false, isLast: true);
			prev = num;
			for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 > 0; num2--)
			{
				OffsetPoints(points, reversedNormals, prev, num2);
				prev = num2;
			}
			AddScaledPath(dXGraphicsPath, currentPath);
			return dXGraphicsPath;
		}

		private void AddScaledPath(DXGraphicsPath parentPath, DXGraphicsPath subPath)
		{
			if (subPath.PointCount > 0)
			{
				subPath.CloseFigure();
				if (scaleTransform != null)
				{
					subPath.Transform(scaleTransform);
				}
				parentPath.AddPath(subPath, connect: false);
				subPath.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void OffsetPoints(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, int prev, int next, bool isFirst = false, bool isLast = false)
		{
			double normalSin = GetNormalSin(normals, prev, next);
			if (processLineJoin == null || isFirst || isLast || normalSin < 0.0)
			{
				PointF startPoint = GetStartPoint(points, normals, prev, next, (!isFirst) ? 1 : (-1));
				PointF endPoint = GetEndPoint(points, normals, prev, next, (!isLast) ? 1 : (-1));
				AddLine(startPoint, endPoint);
			}
			else
			{
				processLineJoin(points, normals, prev, next);
			}
		}

		private void AddLine(PointF start, PointF end)
		{
			currentPath.AddLine(start, end);
		}

		private void ProcessRoundLineJoin(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, int prev, int next)
		{
			PointF startPoint = GetStartPoint(points, normals, prev, next);
			PointF endPoint = GetEndPoint(points, normals, prev, next);
			if (currentPath.PointCount > 0)
			{
				AddLine(currentPath.PathPoints.Last(), startPoint);
			}
			if (!PointsAreEqual(startPoint, endPoint))
			{
				PointF p = default(PointF);
				PointF p2 = default(PointF);
				if (TryCalculateControlPoints(points, normals, prev, next, startPoint, ref p, ref p2, endPoint))
				{
					currentPath.AddBezier(startPoint, p, p2, endPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					AddLine(startPoint, endPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool TryCalculateControlPoints(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, int prev, int next, PointF p0, ref PointF p1, ref PointF p2, PointF p3)
		{
			double normalCos = GetNormalCos(normals, prev, next);
			if (normalCos <= -1.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PointF miterIntersection = GetMiterIntersection(points, normals, prev, next, (double)delta / (1.0 + normalCos));
			if (PointIsNan(miterIntersection) || PointsAreEqual(p0, miterIntersection) || PointsAreEqual(p3, miterIntersection))
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = CalculateLengthToCurveControlPoints(p0, p3, miterIntersection);
			if (num < 1.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			p1 = CalculatePointInsideSegment(p0, miterIntersection, num);
			if (PointIsNan(p1))
			{
				return false;
			}
			p2 = CalculatePointInsideSegment(p3, miterIntersection, num);
			if (PointIsNan(p2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ProcessMiterLineJoin(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, int prev, int next)
		{
			double normalCos = GetNormalCos(normals, prev, next);
			double num = 1.0 + normalCos;
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			PointF miterIntersection = GetMiterIntersection(points, normals, prev, next, (double)delta / num);
			if (num >= (double)miterLimit)
			{
				PointF start = ((currentPath.PointCount > 0) ? currentPath.PathPoints.Last() : miterIntersection);
				AddLine(start, miterIntersection);
				return;
			}
			PointF startPoint = GetStartPoint(points, normals, prev, next);
			PointF endPoint = GetEndPoint(points, normals, prev, next);
			PointF pointF = points[next];
			if (!PointsAreEqual(startPoint, endPoint) && !PointsAreEqual(startPoint, miterIntersection) && !PointsAreEqual(endPoint, miterIntersection) && !PointsAreEqual(pointF, miterIntersection))
			{
				double segmentLength = GetSegmentLength(miterIntersection, pointF);
				double s = Math.Sqrt(segmentLength * segmentLength - (double)(delta * delta)) - (segmentLength - (double)(delta * pen.MiterLimit)) / Math.Cos(Math.Asin((double)delta / segmentLength));
				PointF start2 = CalculatePointInsideSegment(startPoint, miterIntersection, s);
				PointF end = CalculatePointInsideSegment(endPoint, miterIntersection, s);
				AddLine(start2, end);
			}
		}

		private PointF GetNormal(PointF pt1, PointF pt2)
		{
			float num = pt2.X - pt1.X;
			float num2 = pt2.Y - pt1.Y;
			if (num == 0f && num2 == 0f)
			{
				return default(PointF);
			}
			float num3 = 1f / (float)Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			num *= num3;
			num2 *= num3;
			return new PointF(num2, 0f - num);
		}

		private bool BezierIsFlat(PointF[] p, float flatness)
		{
			double segmentLength = GetSegmentLength(p[0], p[1]);
			double segmentLength2 = GetSegmentLength(p[1], p[2]);
			double segmentLength3 = GetSegmentLength(p[2], p[3]);
			double segmentLength4 = GetSegmentLength(p[0], p[3]);
			return segmentLength + segmentLength2 + segmentLength3 - segmentLength4 < (double)flatness;
		}

		private double GetSegmentLength(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(p2.X - p1.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p2.Y - p1.Y, 2.0));
		}

		private bool PointIsNan(PointF p)
		{
			if (!float.IsNaN(p.X))
			{
				return float.IsNaN(p.Y);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool PointsAreEqual(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			if (CoordsAreEqual(p1.X, p2.X))
			{
				return CoordsAreEqual(p1.Y, p2.Y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CoordsAreEqual(float c1, float c2)
		{
			return Math.Abs(c2 - c1) < 1f;
		}

		private PointF GetMiterIntersection(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, int prev, int next, double delta)
		{
			double num = (double)points[next].X + delta * (double)(normals[prev].X + normals[next].X);
			double num2 = (double)points[next].Y + delta * (double)(normals[prev].Y + normals[next].Y);
			return new PointF((float)num, (float)num2);
		}

		private PointF GetStartPoint(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, int prev, int next, int startSign = 1)
		{
			double num = points[next].X + delta * (float)startSign * normals[prev].X;
			double num2 = points[next].Y + delta * (float)startSign * normals[prev].Y;
			return new PointF((float)num, (float)num2);
		}

		private PointF GetEndPoint(PointF[] points, PointF[] normals, int prev, int next, int endSign = 1)
		{
			double num = points[next].X + delta * (float)endSign * normals[next].X;
			double num2 = points[next].Y + delta * (float)endSign * normals[next].Y;
			return new PointF((float)num, (float)num2);
		}

		private double GetNormalCos(PointF[] normals, int prev, int next)
		{
			return normals[prev].X * normals[next].X + normals[prev].Y * normals[next].Y;
		}

		private double GetNormalSin(PointF[] normals, int prev, int next)
		{
			return normals[prev].X * normals[next].Y - normals[next].X * normals[prev].Y;
		}

		private float GetRotationAngle(PointF start, PointF end)
		{
			float num = end.X - start.X;
			float num2 = end.Y - start.Y;
			double val = (double)(0f - num2) / Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			val = Math.Min(1.0, Math.Max(-1.0, val));
			int num3 = ((num > 0f) ? 1 : (-1));
			return (float)((double)num3 * Math.Acos(val) * 180.0 / Math.PI);
		}

		private double CalculateLengthToCurveControlPoints(PointF a, PointF b, PointF c)
		{
			double segmentLength = GetSegmentLength(a, c);
			double segmentLength2 = GetSegmentLength(a, b);
			double num = segmentLength2 / (2.0 * segmentLength);
			if (num >= 1.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num2 = Math.Sin(Math.Acos(num));
			return 2.0 / 3.0 * (1.0 - num) * segmentLength2 / (num2 * num2);
		}

		private PointF CalculatePointInsideSegment(PointF start, PointF end, double s)
		{
			float x = start.X;
			float y = start.Y;
			PointF result;
			PointF result2;
			if (CoordsAreEqual(end.X, x))
			{
				result = new PointF(x, (float)((double)y + s));
				result2 = new PointF(x, (float)((double)y - s));
			}
			else if (CoordsAreEqual(end.Y, y))
			{
				result = new PointF((float)((double)x + s), y);
				result2 = new PointF((float)((double)x - s), y);
			}
			else
			{
				double num = (end.Y - y) / (end.X - x);
				double num2 = (double)end.Y - num * (double)end.X;
				double num3 = 1.0 + num * num;
				double num4 = (double)(0f - x) + num * num2 - (double)y * num;
				double num5 = (double)(x * x) + num2 * num2 - (double)(2f * y) * num2 + (double)(y * y) - s * s;
				double num6 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Abs(num4 * num4 - num3 * num5));
				double num7 = (0.0 - num4 + num6) / num3;
				double num8 = (0.0 - num4 - num6) / num3;
				result = new PointF((float)num7, (float)(num7 * num + num2));
				result2 = new PointF((float)num8, (float)(num8 * num + num2));
			}
			if (!IsBetween(x, end.X, result.X) || !IsBetween(y, end.Y, result.Y))
			{
				return result2;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsBetween(float start, float end, float p)
		{
			if (!(start < end))
			{
				if (p >= end)
				{
					return p <= start;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (p >= start)
			{
				return p <= end;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class SnapToDevicePixelsHelper
	{
		public static RectangleF GetCorrectedBounds(Graphics graphics, Size sizeInPixel, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[2]
			{
				new PointF(bounds.Left, bounds.Top),
				new PointF(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom)
			};
			graphics.TransformPoints(CoordinateSpace.Device, CoordinateSpace.World, array);
			int num = (int)(array[1].X - array[0].X);
			int num2 = (int)(array[1].Y - array[0].Y);
			if (Math.Abs(sizeInPixel.Width - num) <= 5 && Math.Abs(sizeInPixel.Height - num2) <= 5)
			{
				array[0].X = (int)((double)array[0].X + 0.5);
				array[0].Y = (int)((double)array[0].Y + 0.5);
				array[1].X = array[0].X + (float)sizeInPixel.Width;
				array[1].Y = array[0].Y + (float)sizeInPixel.Height;
				graphics.TransformPoints(CoordinateSpace.World, CoordinateSpace.Device, array);
				float width = array[1].X - array[0].X;
				float height = array[1].Y - array[0].Y;
				return new RectangleF(array[0].X, array[0].Y, width, height);
			}
			return bounds;
		}
	}

	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public static class GDIHeightCalculator
	{
		private static class UnderLineAdvancedInfo
		{
			private static int offset { get; set; }

			private static int Width1Line { get; set; }

			private static int Pos1Line { get; set; }

			private static int Width2Lines { get; set; }

			private static void RecalculateManual(int descent)
			{
				Width2Lines = 1;
				if (descent / 4 >= 1)
				{
					Width2Lines = descent / 4;
				}
				Width1Line = Width2Lines;
				Pos1Line = (descent - 3 * Width2Lines + 1) / 2;
				offset = Pos1Line + 2 * Width2Lines;
			}

			private static bool RecalculateFromWinAPI(IntPtr hdc)
			{
				uint outlineTextMetrics = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GetOutlineTextMetrics(hdc, 0u, IntPtr.Zero);
				if (outlineTextMetrics == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal((int)outlineTextMetrics);
				if (PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GetOutlineTextMetrics(hdc, outlineTextMetrics, intPtr) == 0)
				{
					Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
					return false;
				}
				PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.OUTLINETEXTMETRIC oUTLINETEXTMETRIC = (PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.OUTLINETEXTMETRIC)Marshal.PtrToStructure(intPtr, typeof(PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.OUTLINETEXTMETRIC));
				Pos1Line = Math.Abs(oUTLINETEXTMETRIC.otmsUnderscorePosition);
				Width2Lines = Math.Max(oUTLINETEXTMETRIC.otmsUnderscoreSize, 1);
				Width1Line = Width2Lines;
				offset = Pos1Line + 2 * Width2Lines;
				if (3 * Width2Lines < Pos1Line)
				{
					offset = Pos1Line;
					Pos1Line = (Pos1Line - Width2Lines) / 2;
				}
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
				return true;
			}

			public static int CalcMetricsFromUnderlineMode(IntPtr hdc, FontHeightMetrics fontHeightMetrics, XlUnderlineType underlineMode)
			{
				//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				bool flag = true;
				if ((fontHeightMetrics.PitchAndFamily & FontPitchAndFamily.Swiss) != FontPitchAndFamily.DefaultPitch)
				{
					flag = !RecalculateFromWinAPI(hdc);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					RecalculateManual(fontHeightMetrics.Descent);
				}
				int num = underlineMode & 0xF;
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				while (num2 < 10)
				{
					num2++;
					if (Width1Line < 1)
					{
						Width1Line = 1;
					}
					if (Pos1Line < 0)
					{
						Pos1Line = 0;
					}
					num3 = offset;
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						num3 = 0;
					}
					if (Width2Lines < 1)
					{
						Width2Lines = 1;
					}
					if (Pos1Line > 0 && Pos1Line + Width1Line >= num3)
					{
						Pos1Line /= 2;
					}
					int num4 = ((num == 2) ? (Width2Lines + num3) : (Width1Line + Pos1Line));
					if (num4 <= fontHeightMetrics.Descent)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						flag = true;
						RecalculateManual(fontHeightMetrics.Descent);
						continue;
					}
					if (fontHeightMetrics.Descent >= 0 && fontHeightMetrics.Descent <= 2)
					{
						Pos1Line = fontHeightMetrics.Descent - 3;
						num3 = fontHeightMetrics.Descent - 3 + 2;
						Width2Lines = 1;
						break;
					}
					Pos1Line = MulDiv(Pos1Line, fontHeightMetrics.Descent, num4);
					Width1Line = MulDiv(Width1Line, fontHeightMetrics.Descent, num4);
					offset = MulDiv(num3, fontHeightMetrics.Descent, num4);
					Width2Lines = MulDiv(Width2Lines, fontHeightMetrics.Descent, num4);
				}
				int num5 = Width2Lines + num3 - Pos1Line;
				fontHeightMetrics.Descent += num5;
				fontHeightMetrics.Height = fontHeightMetrics.Descent + fontHeightMetrics.Ascent;
				return num5;
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Graphics graphics;

		public static RowHeightInfo GetRowHeightByFont(string fontName, double fontSize, bool italic, bool bold, bool strikeThrough, XlUnderlineType underlineMode, XlScriptType scriptMode, int dpiY)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FontHeightMetrics fontHeightMetrics = GetFontHeightMetrics(fontName, fontSize, italic, bold, strikeThrough, underlineMode, scriptMode, dpiY);
			if (fontHeightMetrics == null)
			{
				return new RowHeightInfo(20);
			}
			return CalcRowHeight(fontHeightMetrics);
		}

		private static RowHeightInfo CalcRowHeight(FontHeightMetrics fontHeightMetrics)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(fontHeightMetrics.ExternalLeading - fontHeightMetrics.ExternalLeading / 2 - 1, 0);
			int val = Math.Max(num + fontHeightMetrics.Descent, fontHeightMetrics.ExternalLeading / 2 + fontHeightMetrics.InternalLeading);
			int val2 = ((fontHeightMetrics.Height < 2) ? 1 : 2);
			int num2 = Math.Max(val, val2);
			int num3 = fontHeightMetrics.Ascent - fontHeightMetrics.InternalLeading + num2;
			int val3 = num3 + num2 + 1;
			return new RowHeightInfo(Math.Min(val3, 2047), Math.Min(num3, 2047));
		}

		public static FontHeightMetrics GetFontHeightMetrics(string fontName, double fontSize, bool italic, bool bold, bool strikeThrough, XlUnderlineType underlineMode, XlScriptType scriptMode, int dpiY)
		{
			//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ab: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (graphics == null)
			{
				graphics = Graphics.FromHwnd(IntPtr.Zero);
			}
			IntPtr hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT logFont = GetLogFont(fontName, fontSize, italic, bold, strikeThrough, dpiY);
				IntPtr intPtr = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.CreateFont(logFont.lfHeight, logFont.lfWidth, logFont.lfEscapement, logFont.lfOrientation, logFont.lfWeight, logFont.lfItalic, logFont.lfUnderline, logFont.lfStrikeOut, (int)logFont.lfCharSet, logFont.lfOutPrecision, logFont.lfClipPrecision, logFont.lfQuality, logFont.lfPitchAndFamily, logFont.lfFaceName);
				if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return null;
				}
				try
				{
					FontHeightMetrics textMetrics = GetTextMetrics(hdc, intPtr, fontName, underlineMode);
					if (textMetrics != null && (int)scriptMode != 0)
					{
						CalMetricsFromScriptMode(fontName, scriptMode, textMetrics, hdc, logFont);
					}
					return textMetrics;
				}
				finally
				{
					PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.DeleteObject(intPtr);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
			}
		}

		private static PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT GetLogFont(string fontName, double fontSize, bool italic, bool bold, bool strikeThrough, int dpiY)
		{
			int num = (int)(fontSize * 20.0);
			SpreadsheetFontWeight lfWeight = (bold ? SpreadsheetFontWeight.Bold : SpreadsheetFontWeight.Normal);
			FontFamilyIndex fontFamily = FontsInfoHelper.GetFontFamily(fontName);
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet fontCharSet = FontsInfoHelper.GetFontCharSet(fontName);
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT lOGFONT = new PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT();
			lOGFONT.lfFaceName = fontName;
			lOGFONT.lfPitchAndFamily = (byte)((uint)fontFamily << 4);
			lOGFONT.lfCharSet = fontCharSet;
			lOGFONT.lfHeight = -Math.Max(1, MulDiv(num, dpiY, 1440));
			if (num < 160 && lOGFONT.lfHeight >= -11 && (fontCharSet == PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet.ANSI || fontCharSet == PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet.RUSSIAN))
			{
				lOGFONT.lfFaceName = "Small Fonts";
			}
			lOGFONT.lfWeight = (int)lfWeight;
			lOGFONT.lfItalic = Convert.ToByte(italic);
			lOGFONT.lfStrikeOut = Convert.ToByte(strikeThrough);
			int lCID = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.LCID;
			if ((lCID == 1042 || lCID == 1028 || lCID == 2052) && fontCharSet != PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet.SHIFTJIS && fontCharSet != PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet.HANGEUL && fontCharSet != PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet.CHINESEBIG5 && fontCharSet != PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet.GB2312)
			{
				lOGFONT.lfClipPrecision |= 40;
			}
			lOGFONT.lfQuality = 5;
			return lOGFONT;
		}

		private static FontHeightMetrics GetTextMetrics(IntPtr hdc, IntPtr logFontPtr, string fontName, XlUnderlineType underlineType)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IntPtr intPtr = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.SelectObject(hdc, logFontPtr);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FontHeightMetrics fontHeightMetrics = WindowsPlatformFontInfo.GetFontHeightMetrics(hdc, fontName);
			if (fontHeightMetrics == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if ((underlineType & 0x20) != 0)
			{
				int num = UnderLineAdvancedInfo.CalcMetricsFromUnderlineMode(hdc, fontHeightMetrics, underlineType);
				fontHeightMetrics.Descent -= num;
				fontHeightMetrics.Height -= num;
			}
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.SelectObject(hdc, intPtr);
			return fontHeightMetrics;
		}

		private static void CalMetricsFromScriptMode(string fontName, XlScriptType scriptType, FontHeightMetrics fontHeightMetrics, IntPtr hDC, PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT logFont)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = CalcMetricsFromScriptModeCore(fontHeightMetrics, (int)scriptType == 1, logFont);
			logFont.lfHeight = -logFont.lfHeight;
			IntPtr intPtr = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.CreateFont(logFont.lfHeight, logFont.lfWidth, logFont.lfEscapement, logFont.lfOrientation, logFont.lfWeight, logFont.lfItalic, logFont.lfUnderline, logFont.lfStrikeOut, (int)logFont.lfCharSet, logFont.lfOutPrecision, logFont.lfClipPrecision, logFont.lfQuality, logFont.lfPitchAndFamily, logFont.lfFaceName);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return;
			}
			IntPtr intPtr2 = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.SelectObject(hDC, intPtr);
			if (intPtr2 == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return;
			}
			FontHeightMetrics fontHeightMetrics2 = WindowsPlatformFontInfo.GetFontHeightMetrics(hDC, fontName);
			if (fontHeightMetrics2 == null)
			{
				PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.SelectObject(hDC, intPtr2);
				return;
			}
			if ((int)scriptType == 1)
			{
				if (fontHeightMetrics.Ascent < fontHeightMetrics2.Ascent + num)
				{
					fontHeightMetrics.Ascent = fontHeightMetrics2.Ascent + num;
				}
			}
			else if (fontHeightMetrics.Descent < fontHeightMetrics2.Descent + num)
			{
				fontHeightMetrics.Descent = fontHeightMetrics2.Descent + num;
			}
			fontHeightMetrics.Height = fontHeightMetrics.Ascent + fontHeightMetrics.Descent;
			PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.DeleteObject(intPtr);
		}

		private static int CalcMetricsFromScriptModeCore(FontHeightMetrics fontHeightMetrics, bool isSuperScript, PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT logfont)
		{
			int num = fontHeightMetrics.Height - fontHeightMetrics.InternalLeading;
			int value = (isSuperScript ? (num / 2) : (num / 5));
			value = Math.Abs(value);
			logfont.lfHeight = Math.Max(MulDiv(num, 2, 3), 1);
			return value;
		}

		private static int MulDiv(int number, int numerator, int denominator)
		{
			return (int)(((long)number * (long)numerator + (denominator >> 1)) / denominator);
		}
	}
	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	internal static class FontsInfoHelper
	{
		[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
		private struct Enumlogfontex
		{
			public PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT elfLogFont;

			[MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 32)]
			public string elfFullName;

			[MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 32)]
			public string elfStyle;

			[MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 32)]
			public string elfScript;
		}

		private delegate int EnumFontExDelegate(ref Enumlogfontex lpelfe, IntPtr lpntme, int fontType, int lParam);

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet> charSets;

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, FontFamilyIndex> fontFamilies;

		public const int FaceSize = 32;

		[DllImport("gdi32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
		private static extern int EnumFontFamiliesEx(IntPtr hdc, [In] IntPtr lpLogfont, EnumFontExDelegate lpEnumFontFamExProc, IntPtr lParam, uint dwFlags);

		static FontsInfoHelper()
		{
			charSets = new Dictionary<string, PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet>();
			fontFamilies = new Dictionary<string, FontFamilyIndex>();
			Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromHwnd(IntPtr.Zero);
			IntPtr hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT structure = new PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LOGFONT
				{
					lfFaceName = "",
					lfCharSet = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet.DEFAULT
				};
				IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(structure));
				Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, intPtr, fDeleteOld: true);
				EnumFontFamiliesEx(hdc, intPtr, EnumFontFamiliesExProc, IntPtr.Zero, 0u);
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
			}
		}

		public static PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet GetFontCharSet(string fontName)
		{
			if (!charSets.TryGetValue(fontName, out var value))
			{
				return PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.LogFontCharSet.DEFAULT;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static FontFamilyIndex GetFontFamily(string fontName)
		{
			if (!fontFamilies.TryGetValue(fontName, out var value))
			{
				return FontFamilyIndex.DontCare;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static int EnumFontFamiliesExProc(ref Enumlogfontex logFontEx, IntPtr lpntme, int fontType, int i)
		{
			if (charSets.ContainsKey(logFontEx.elfLogFont.lfFaceName))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			charSets.Add(logFontEx.elfLogFont.lfFaceName, logFontEx.elfLogFont.lfCharSet);
			fontFamilies.Add(logFontEx.elfLogFont.lfFaceName, (FontFamilyIndex)(logFontEx.elfLogFont.lfPitchAndFamily >> 4));
			return 1;
		}
	}

		public override void PushRotationTransform(Point center, float angleInDegrees)
		{
			transformLevel++;
			transformStack.Push(IGraphics.Transform);
			IGraphics.ResetTransform();
			IGraphics.MultiplyTransform(transformStack.Peek(), DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			IGraphics.TranslateTransform((float)center.X, (float)center.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Prepend);
			IGraphics.RotateTransform(angleInDegrees, DXMatrixOrder.Prepend);
			IGraphics.TranslateTransform((float)(-center.X), (float)(-center.Y), DXMatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public override void PopTransform()
		{
			transformLevel--;
			IGraphics.ResetTransform();
			IGraphics.MultiplyTransform(transformStack.Pop(), DXMatrixOrder.Prepend);
		}

		public override void PushSmoothingMode(bool highQuality)
		{
		}

		public override void PopSmoothingMode()
		{
		}

		public override void PushPixelOffsetMode(bool highQualtity)
		{
		}

		public override void PopPixelOffsetMode()
		{
		}

		public override bool PushTransform(DXMatrix transformMatrix)
		{
			transformLevel++;
			transformStack.Push(IGraphics.Transform);
			IGraphics.ResetTransform();
			IGraphics.MultiplyTransform(transformMatrix, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class GdiGraphicsPainter : IGraphicsPainter
	{
		private readonly Stack<Region> clipRegions;

		public new GdiGraphics IGraphics => (GdiGraphics)base.IGraphics;

		public GdiGraphicsPainter(GdiGraphics graphics)
			: base((IGraphicsBase)(object)graphics)
		{
			clipRegions = new Stack<Region>();
		}

		protected override void SetClipBounds(RectangleF bounds)
		{
			if (clipRegions.Count > 0)
			{
				using (Region region = clipRegions.Peek().Clone())
				{
					region.Intersect(bounds);
					IGraphics.Clip = region;
				}
				SetActualClipBounds(bounds);
			}
			else
			{
				base.SetClipBounds(bounds);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				while (clipRegions.Count > 0)
				{
					clipRegions.Pop().Dispose();
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override void PushRotationTransform(Point center, float angleInDegrees)
		{
			base.PushRotationTransform(center, angleInDegrees);
			clipRegions.Push(IGraphics.Clip);
		}

		public override void PopTransform()
		{
			clipRegions.Pop().Dispose();
			base.PopTransform();
		}
	}

	public abstract class ActionHistoryItem<T> : HistoryItem
	{
		private readonly T oldValue;

		private readonly T newValue;

		private readonly Action<T> setValueAction;

		public T OldValue => oldValue;

		public T NewValue => newValue;

		public Action<T> SetValueAction => setValueAction;

		protected ActionHistoryItem(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart, T oldValue, T newValue, Action<T> setValueAction)
			: base(documentModelPart)
		{
			this.oldValue = oldValue;
			this.newValue = newValue;
			this.setValueAction = setValueAction;
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			setValueAction(OldValue);
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			setValueAction(NewValue);
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return setValueAction.Target;
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(setValueAction.Method.Name);
		}
	}

	public class CompositeHistoryItem : HistoryItem
	{
		private readonly List<HistoryItem> items;

		public override bool ChangeModified
		{
			get
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (items[i].ChangeModified)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public HistoryItem this[int index] => items[index];

		public int Count => items.Count;

		public IList<HistoryItem> Items => items;

		public CompositeHistoryItem(IDocumentModelPart part)
			: base(part)
		{
			items = new List<HistoryItem>();
		}

		public void AddItem(HistoryItem item)
		{
			items.Add(item);
		}

		public void AddRange(CompositeHistoryItem item)
		{
			items.AddRange(item.items);
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			for (int num = items.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				this[num].Undo();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void Clear()
		{
			items.Clear();
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				this[i].Redo();
			}
		}

		public void Rollback()
		{
			Undo();
			Clear();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				int count = items.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					items[i].Dispose();
					items[i] = null;
				}
				items.Clear();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override void Register(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			foreach (HistoryItem item in items)
			{
				item.Register(writer, undone);
			}
		}

		public override void WriteObjects(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			foreach (HistoryItem item in items)
			{
				item.WriteObjects(writer, undone);
			}
		}

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			int count = items.Count;
			writer.Write(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				HistoryItem historyItem = items[i];
				int typeCode = writer.GetTypeCode(historyItem);
				writer.Write(typeCode);
				if (typeCode >= 0)
				{
					historyItem.Write(writer);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Read(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				HistoryItem historyItem = reader.CreateHistoryItem();
				if (historyItem != null)
				{
					historyItem.Read(reader);
					items.Add(historyItem);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DisabledHistory : EmptyHistory
	{
		private int transactionCount;

		public DisabledHistory(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
		}

		public override void Add(HistoryItem item)
		{
			if (base.TransactionLevel > 0)
			{
				transactionCount++;
			}
			Modified = true;
		}

		public override HistoryItem BeginTransaction()
		{
			if (base.TransactionLevel == 0)
			{
				transactionCount = 0;
			}
			return base.BeginTransaction();
		}

		public override HistoryItem EndTransaction()
		{
			if (base.TransactionLevel == 1)
			{
				transactionCount = 0;
			}
			return base.EndTransaction();
		}

		public override bool HasChangesInCurrentTransaction()
		{
			if (base.TransactionLevel <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return transactionCount > 0;
		}
	}
	public class DocumentHistory : IDisposable
	{
		public const int ForceModifiedIndex = -2;

		private bool isDisposed;

		private List<HistoryItem> items;

		private int unmodifiedIndex = -1;

		private int currentIndex = -1;

		private IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private CompositeHistoryItem transaction;

		private NotificationIdGenerator idGenerator;

		private int transactionLevel;

		private int disableCount;

		private bool suppressRaiseOperationComplete;

		private bool previousModifiedValue;

		private EventHandler onOperationCompleted;

		private EventHandler onModifiedChanged;

		public bool IsDisposed => isDisposed;

		public List<HistoryItem> Items => items;

		internal bool IsHistoryDisabled => disableCount > 0;

		public HistoryItem this[int index] => items[index];

		public int Count => items.Count;

		public int CurrentIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return currentIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				currentIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public int UnmodifiedIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return unmodifiedIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				unmodifiedIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public HistoryItem Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (CurrentIndex < 0 || CurrentIndex >= Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return this[CurrentIndex];
			}
		}

		public int TransactionLevel => transactionLevel;

		public bool CanUndo => CurrentIndex >= 0;

		public bool CanRedo
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count > 0)
				{
					return CurrentIndex < Count - 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public CompositeHistoryItem Transaction => transaction;

		public virtual bool Modified
		{
			get
			{
				return IsModified(unmodifiedIndex);
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != Modified)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						unmodifiedIndex = -2;
					}
					else
					{
						unmodifiedIndex = CurrentIndex;
					}
					RaiseModifiedChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool SuppressRaiseOperationComplete
		{
			get
			{
				return suppressRaiseOperationComplete;
			}
			set
			{
				suppressRaiseOperationComplete = value;
			}
		}

		protected IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		public event EventHandler OperationCompleted
		{
			add
			{
				onOperationCompleted = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onOperationCompleted, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onOperationCompleted = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onOperationCompleted, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler ModifiedChanged
		{
			add
			{
				onModifiedChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onModifiedChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onModifiedChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onModifiedChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public DocumentHistory(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			items = new List<HistoryItem>();
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			idGenerator = CreateIdGenerator();
		}

		protected internal void SetTransaction(CompositeHistoryItem value)
		{
			transaction = value;
		}

		protected internal void SetTransactionLevel(int value)
		{
			transactionLevel = value;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetModifiedTextAppended(bool forceRaiseModifiedChanged)
		{
			if (!Modified)
			{
				unmodifiedIndex--;
				RaiseModifiedChanged();
			}
		}

		protected virtual NotificationIdGenerator CreateIdGenerator()
		{
			return new NotificationIdGenerator();
		}

		public int GetNotificationId()
		{
			return idGenerator.GenerateId();
		}

		protected internal virtual void BeginTrackModifiedChanged()
		{
			previousModifiedValue = Modified;
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndTrackModifiedChanged()
		{
			if (previousModifiedValue != Modified)
			{
				RaiseModifiedChanged();
			}
		}

		private void ClearCore(bool disposeOnlyCutOffItems)
		{
			DisposeContent(disposeOnlyCutOffItems);
			if (transactionLevel > 0)
			{
				transaction = CreateCompositeHistoryItem();
			}
			items.Clear();
			BeginTrackModifiedChanged();
			try
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
				unmodifiedIndex = -1;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndTrackModifiedChanged();
			}
		}

		public void SmartClear()
		{
			ClearCore(disposeOnlyCutOffItems: true);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ClearCore(disposeOnlyCutOffItems: false);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposeContent(cutOffItemsOnly: false);
			}
			isDisposed = true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		public virtual void RaiseOperationCompleted()
		{
			if (onOperationCompleted != null)
			{
				onOperationCompleted(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public virtual void RaiseModifiedChanged()
		{
			if (onModifiedChanged != null)
			{
				onModifiedChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void DisposeContent(bool cutOffItemsOnly)
		{
			if (transaction != null)
			{
				transaction.Dispose();
			}
			if (cutOffItemsOnly)
			{
				CutOffHistory();
				return;
			}
			int count = Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				this[i].Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void Undo()
		{
			if (!CanUndo)
			{
				return;
			}
			DisableHistory();
			try
			{
				documentModel.BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					BeginTrackModifiedChanged();
					try
					{
						UndoCore();
					}
					finally
					{
						EndTrackModifiedChanged();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					documentModel.EndUpdate();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EnableHistory();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnEndUndoCore()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void UndoCore()
		{
			BeginUndoCurrent();
			Current.Undo();
			currentIndex--;
			EndUndoCurrent();
			OnEndUndoCore();
			RaiseOperationCompleted();
		}

		protected internal virtual void BeginUndoCurrent()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndUndoCurrent()
		{
		}

		public void Redo()
		{
			if (!CanRedo)
			{
				return;
			}
			DisableHistory();
			try
			{
				documentModel.BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					BeginTrackModifiedChanged();
					try
					{
						RedoCore();
					}
					finally
					{
						EndTrackModifiedChanged();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					documentModel.EndUpdate();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EnableHistory();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RedoCore()
		{
			currentIndex++;
			Current.Redo();
			RaiseOperationCompleted();
		}

		public void DisableHistory()
		{
			disableCount++;
		}

		public void EnableHistory()
		{
			if (disableCount > 0)
			{
				disableCount--;
			}
		}

		public virtual HistoryItem BeginTransaction()
		{
			if (transactionLevel == 0)
			{
				transaction = CreateCompositeHistoryItem();
			}
			transactionLevel++;
			return transaction;
		}

		public virtual HistoryItem EndTransaction()
		{
			if (transactionLevel > 0)
			{
				transactionLevel--;
				if (transactionLevel == 0)
				{
					HistoryItem result = CommitTransaction();
					transaction = null;
					return result;
				}
			}
			return transaction;
		}

		protected internal virtual HistoryItem CommitAsSingleItem()
		{
			return CommitAsSingleItemCore(transaction[0]);
		}

		protected internal virtual HistoryItem CommitAsSingleItemCore(HistoryItem singleItem)
		{
			Add(singleItem);
			return singleItem;
		}

		public virtual HistoryItem CommitTransaction()
		{
			int count = transaction.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				if (count == 1)
				{
					HistoryItem historyItem = CommitAsSingleItem();
					if (historyItem != null)
					{
						return historyItem;
					}
				}
				Add(transaction);
			}
			return transaction;
		}

		private void InternalAdd(HistoryItem item)
		{
			if (!IsHistoryDisabled)
			{
				CutOffHistory();
				items.Add(item);
				BeginTrackModifiedChanged();
				try
				{
					currentIndex++;
				}
				finally
				{
					EndTrackModifiedChanged();
				}
			}
			if (!suppressRaiseOperationComplete)
			{
				RaiseOperationCompleted();
			}
		}

		internal void CutOffHistory()
		{
			int num = currentIndex + 1;
			if (num < Count)
			{
				OnCutOffHistory();
			}
			while (num < Count)
			{
				this[num].Dispose();
				items.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			if (unmodifiedIndex > currentIndex)
			{
				unmodifiedIndex = -2;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCutOffHistory()
		{
		}

		public bool IsModified(int unmodifiedIndex)
		{
			return IsModified(unmodifiedIndex, -1);
		}

		public bool IsModified(int unmodifiedIndex, int unmodifiedTransactionIndex)
		{
			if (CurrentIndex == unmodifiedIndex)
			{
				if (unmodifiedTransactionIndex >= 0 && CheckIsTransactionChangeModifiedBackward(CurrentIndex, unmodifiedTransactionIndex))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (unmodifiedIndex < -1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (unmodifiedIndex < CurrentIndex)
			{
				unmodifiedIndex++;
				if (unmodifiedTransactionIndex >= 0)
				{
					if (CheckIsTransactionChangeModifiedForward(unmodifiedIndex, unmodifiedTransactionIndex + 1))
					{
						return true;
					}
					unmodifiedIndex++;
				}
				for (int i = unmodifiedIndex; i <= CurrentIndex && i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (items[i].ChangeModified)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (unmodifiedTransactionIndex >= 0)
				{
					CheckIsTransactionChangeModifiedBackward(unmodifiedIndex, unmodifiedTransactionIndex);
					unmodifiedIndex--;
				}
				for (int j = CurrentIndex + 1; j <= unmodifiedIndex && j < Count; j++)
				{
					if (items[j].ChangeModified)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckIsTransactionChangeModifiedForward(int index, int startInnerIndex)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(Items[index] is CompositeHistoryItem { Items: var list }))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int i = startInnerIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (list[i].ChangeModified)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckIsTransactionChangeModifiedBackward(int index, int startInnerIndex)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(Items[index] is CompositeHistoryItem { Items: var list }))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int num = startInnerIndex; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (list[num].ChangeModified)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void Add(HistoryItem item)
		{
			if (TransactionLevel != 0)
			{
				Transaction.AddItem(item);
			}
			else
			{
				InternalAdd(item);
			}
		}

		public virtual void AddEmptyOperation()
		{
		}

		public virtual bool HasChangesInCurrentTransaction()
		{
			if (transactionLevel <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return transaction.Count > 0;
		}

		public virtual HistoryItem BeginSyntaxHighlight()
		{
			return transaction;
		}

		public virtual void EndSyntaxHighlight()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual CompositeHistoryItem CreateCompositeHistoryItem()
		{
			return new CompositeHistoryItem(documentModel.MainPart);
		}
	}
	public class NotificationIdGenerator
	{
		public const int EmptyId = 0;

		private int lastId = int.MinValue;

		public virtual int GenerateId()
		{
			lastId++;
			if (lastId == 0)
			{
				lastId++;
			}
			return lastId;
		}
	}

		private TOwner owner;

		private TValue oldValue;

		private TValue newValue;

		protected int Index => index;

		protected TOwner Owner => owner;

		protected TValue OldValue => oldValue;

		protected TValue NewValue => newValue;

		protected DrawingHistoryItem(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart, TOwner owner, TValue oldValue, TValue newValue)

			this.newValue = newValue;

			: this(documentModelPart, owner, oldValue, newValue)
		{
			this.index = index;
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()

			return owner;
		}
	}
	public class EmptyHistory : DocumentHistory
	{
		private int transactionItemCount;

		protected int TransactionItemCount => transactionItemCount;

		public EmptyHistory(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
		}

		public override HistoryItem BeginTransaction()
		{
			if (base.TransactionLevel == 0)
			{
				transactionItemCount = 0;
			}
			return base.BeginTransaction();
		}

		public override void Add(HistoryItem item)
		{
			transactionItemCount++;
		}

		protected override NotificationIdGenerator CreateIdGenerator()
		{
			return new EmptyNotificationIdGenerator();
		}

		public override bool HasChangesInCurrentTransaction()
		{
			if (base.TransactionLevel <= 0)
			{
				return base.HasChangesInCurrentTransaction();
			}
			return transactionItemCount != 0;
		}
	}
	public class EmptyNotificationIdGenerator : NotificationIdGenerator
	{
		public override int GenerateId()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}

	public interface IHistoryItemDecorator
	{
		void Execute();

		void Undo();

		void Redo();
	}
	public interface IHistoryItem
	{
		IDocumentModelPart DocumentModelPart { get; }

		IDocumentModel DocumentModel { get; }

		void Execute();

		void Undo();

		void Redo();

		void ExecuteCore();

		void UndoCore();

		void RedoCore();

		void Decorate(IHistoryItemDecorator decorator);
	}
	public abstract class HistoryItem : IHistoryItem, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart;

		public IDocumentModelPart DocumentModelPart => documentModelPart;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModelPart.DocumentModel;

		public virtual bool ChangeModified => true;

		private IHistoryItemDecorator Decorator { get; set; }

		protected HistoryItem(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModelPart, "documentModelPart");
			this.documentModelPart = documentModelPart;
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			if (Decorator != null)
			{
				Decorator.Execute();
			}
			else
			{
				ExecuteCore();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ExecuteCore()
		{
			RedoCore();
		}

		public void Undo()
		{
			if (Decorator != null)
			{
				Decorator.Undo();
			}
			else
			{
				UndoCore();
			}
		}

		public void Redo()
		{
			if (Decorator != null)
			{
				Decorator.Redo();
			}
			else
			{
				RedoCore();
			}
		}

		protected abstract void UndoCore();

		protected abstract void RedoCore();

		void IHistoryItem.ExecuteCore()
		{
			ExecuteCore();
		}

		void IHistoryItem.UndoCore()
		{
			UndoCore();
		}

		void IHistoryItem.RedoCore()
		{
			RedoCore();
		}

		public void Decorate(IHistoryItemDecorator decorator)
		{
			Decorator = decorator;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		public virtual object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void Register(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
			object targetObject = GetTargetObject();
			if (targetObject != documentModelPart && documentModelPart != documentModelPart.DocumentModel)
			{
				writer.RegisterObject(documentModelPart);
			}
			writer.RegisterObject(targetObject);
		}

		public virtual void WriteObjects(IHistoryWriter writer, bool undone)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(writer.GetObjectId(documentModelPart));
			writer.Write(writer.GetObjectId(GetTargetObject()));
		}

		public virtual void Read(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
		}
	}
	public class HistoryTransaction : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly DocumentHistory history;

		private bool suppressRaiseOperationComplete;

		private bool disposed;

		public bool SuppressRaiseOperationComplete
		{
			get
			{
				return suppressRaiseOperationComplete;
			}
			set
			{
				suppressRaiseOperationComplete = value;
			}
		}

		public HistoryTransaction(DocumentHistory history)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)history, "history");
			this.history = history;
			history.BeginTransaction();
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposed && disposing)
			{
				bool flag = history.TransactionLevel == 1;
				if (flag && SuppressRaiseOperationComplete)
				{
					history.SuppressRaiseOperationComplete = true;
				}
				history.EndTransaction();
				if (flag && SuppressRaiseOperationComplete)
				{
					history.SuppressRaiseOperationComplete = false;
				}
			}
			disposed = true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}
	}
	public abstract class IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<TActions> : HistoryItem where TActions : struct
	{
		private int oldIndex;

		private int newIndex;

		private TActions changeActions;

		public int OldIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return oldIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				oldIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public int NewIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return newIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				newIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public TActions ChangeActions
		{
			get
			{
				return changeActions;
			}
			set
			{
				changeActions = value;
			}
		}

		protected IndexChangedHistoryItemCore(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart)
			: base(documentModelPart)
		{
		}

		protected override void UndoCore()
		{
			IIndexBasedObject<TActions> indexBasedObject = GetObject();
			indexBasedObject.SetIndex(OldIndex, ChangeActions);
		}

		protected override void RedoCore()
		{
			IIndexBasedObject<TActions> indexBasedObject = GetObject();
			indexBasedObject.SetIndex(NewIndex, ChangeActions);
		}

		public abstract IIndexBasedObject<TActions> GetObject();

		public override void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			base.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(OldIndex);
			writer.Write(NewIndex);
			if (ChangeActions is IConvertToInt<TActions>)
			{
				writer.Write(((IConvertToInt<TActions>)(object)ChangeActions).ToInt());
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write(Convert.ToInt32(ChangeActions));
			}
		}

		public override void Read(IHistoryReader reader)
		{
			OldIndex = reader.ReadInt32();
			NewIndex = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (ChangeActions is IConvertToInt<TActions>)
			{
				ChangeActions = ((IConvertToInt<TActions>)(object)ChangeActions).FromInt(reader.ReadInt32());
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeActions = (TActions)Enum.ToObject(typeof(TActions), reader.ReadInt32());
			}
		}
	}
	public class IndexChangedHistoryItem<TActions> : IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<TActions> where TActions : struct
	{
		public const int TypeCode = 2;

		private readonly IIndexBasedObject<TActions> obj;

		public IIndexBasedObject<TActions> Object => obj;

		public IndexChangedHistoryItem(IDocumentModelPart documentModelPart, IIndexBasedObject<TActions> obj)
			: base(documentModelPart)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)obj, "obj");
			this.obj = obj;
		}

		public override IIndexBasedObject<TActions> GetObject()
		{
			return obj;
		}

		public override object GetTargetObject()
		{
			return obj;
		}
	}
}

	public enum DrawingTextAutoFitType
	{
		None,
		Normal,
		Shape,
		Automatic
	}
	public interface IDrawingTextAutoFit
	{
		DrawingTextAutoFitType Type { get; }

		bool Equals(IDrawingTextAutoFit other);

		IDrawingTextAutoFit CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel);

		void Visit(IDrawingTextAutoFitVisitor visitor);
	}
	public interface IDrawingTextAutoFitVisitor
	{
		void VisitAutoFitNone();

		void VisitAutoFitShape();

		void Visit(DrawingTextNormalAutoFit autoFit);
	}
	public class DrawingTextAutoFit : IDrawingTextAutoFit
	{
		public static DrawingTextAutoFit None = new DrawingTextAutoFit(DrawingTextAutoFitType.None);

		public static DrawingTextAutoFit Shape = new DrawingTextAutoFit(DrawingTextAutoFitType.Shape);

		public static DrawingTextAutoFit Automatic = new DrawingTextAutoFit(DrawingTextAutoFitType.Automatic);

		private DrawingTextAutoFitType fitType;

		public DrawingTextAutoFitType Type => fitType;

		public DrawingTextAutoFit(DrawingTextAutoFitType fitType)
		{
			this.fitType = fitType;
		}

		public bool Equals(IDrawingTextAutoFit other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Type == other.Type;
		}

		public IDrawingTextAutoFit CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			if (Type == DrawingTextAutoFitType.Shape)
			{
				return Shape;
			}
			if (Type == DrawingTextAutoFitType.None)
			{
				return None;
			}
			return Automatic;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingTextAutoFitVisitor visitor)
		{
			if (Type == DrawingTextAutoFitType.None)
			{
				visitor.VisitAutoFitNone();
			}
			if (Type == DrawingTextAutoFitType.Shape)
			{
				visitor.VisitAutoFitShape();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DrawingTextNormalAutoFit : IDrawingTextAutoFit
	{
		public const int DefaultFontScale = 100000;

		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private int fontScale;

		private int lineSpaceReduction;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		public int FontScale
		{
			get
			{
				return fontScale;
			}
			set
			{
				if (fontScale != value)
				{
					ValueChecker.CheckValue(value, 1000, 100000, "FontScale");
					SetAutoFitValue(SetFontScale, fontScale, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public int LineSpaceReduction
		{
			get
			{
				return lineSpaceReduction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (lineSpaceReduction != value)
				{
					ValueChecker.CheckValue(value, 0, 13200000, "LineSpaceReduction");
					SetAutoFitValue(SetLineSpaceReduction, lineSpaceReduction, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public DrawingTextAutoFitType Type => DrawingTextAutoFitType.Normal;

		public DrawingTextNormalAutoFit(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			fontScale = 100000;
			lineSpaceReduction = 0;
		}

		public void SetFontScale(int value)
		{
			fontScale = value;
		}

		private void SetAutoFitValue(Action<int> action, int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			ActionIntHistoryItem actionIntHistoryItem = new ActionIntHistoryItem(DocumentModel.MainPart, oldValue, newValue, action);
			documentModel.History.Add(actionIntHistoryItem);
			actionIntHistoryItem.Execute();
		}

		public void SetLineSpaceReduction(int value)
		{
			lineSpaceReduction = value;
		}

		public bool Equals(IDrawingTextAutoFit other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Type != other.Type)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DrawingTextNormalAutoFit drawingTextNormalAutoFit = other as DrawingTextNormalAutoFit;
			if (FontScale == drawingTextNormalAutoFit.FontScale)
			{
				return LineSpaceReduction == drawingTextNormalAutoFit.LineSpaceReduction;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public IDrawingTextAutoFit CloneTo(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingTextNormalAutoFit drawingTextNormalAutoFit = new DrawingTextNormalAutoFit(documentModel);
			drawingTextNormalAutoFit.fontScale = fontScale;
			drawingTextNormalAutoFit.lineSpaceReduction = lineSpaceReduction;
			return drawingTextNormalAutoFit;
		}

		public void Visit(IDrawingTextAutoFitVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}
