	public class Scene3DPropertiesInfo : ICloneable<Scene3DPropertiesInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<Scene3DPropertiesInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf, ISupportsBinaryReadWrite
	{
		private static readonly Scene3DPropertiesInfo defaultInfo = new Scene3DPropertiesInfo();

		private const uint MaskPresetCameraType = 63u;

		private const uint MaskLightRigDirection = 960u;

		private const uint MaskLightRigPreset = 31744u;

		private const uint MaskHasCameraRotation = 32768u;

		private const uint MaskHasLightRigRotation = 65536u;

		private uint packedValues;

		private int fov;

		private int zoom = 100000;

		public static Scene3DPropertiesInfo DefaultInfo => defaultInfo;

		public PresetCameraType CameraType
		{
			get
			{
				return (PresetCameraType)GetUIntValue(63u, 0);
			}
			set
			{
				SetUIntValue(63u, 0, (uint)value);
			}
		}

		public LightRigDirection LightRigDirection
		{
			get
			{
				return (LightRigDirection)GetUIntValue(960u, 6);
			}
			set
			{
				SetUIntValue(960u, 6, (uint)value);
			}
		}

		public LightRigPreset LightRigPreset
		{
			get
			{
				return (LightRigPreset)GetUIntValue(31744u, 10);
			}
			set
			{
				SetUIntValue(31744u, 10, (uint)value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasCameraRotation
		{
			get
			{
				return GetBooleanValue(32768u);
			}
			set
			{
				SetBooleanValue(32768u, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasLightRigRotation
		{
			get
			{
				return GetBooleanValue(65536u);
			}
			set
			{
				SetBooleanValue(65536u, value);
			}
		}

		public int Fov
		{
			get
			{
				return fov;
			}
			set
			{
				fov = value;
			}
		}

		public int Zoom
		{
			get
			{
				return zoom;
			}
			set
			{
				zoom = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefault => Equals(defaultInfo);

		private void SetUIntValue(uint mask, int bits, uint value)
		{
			packedValues &= ~mask;
			packedValues |= (value << bits) & mask;
		}

		private uint GetUIntValue(uint mask, int bits)
		{
			return (packedValues & mask) >> bits;
		}

		private void SetBooleanValue(uint mask, bool bitVal)
		{
			if (bitVal)
			{
				packedValues |= mask;
			}
			else
			{
				packedValues &= ~mask;
			}
		}

		private bool GetBooleanValue(uint mask)
		{
			return (packedValues & mask) != 0;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is Scene3DPropertiesInfo scene3DPropertiesInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (packedValues == scene3DPropertiesInfo.packedValues && fov == scene3DPropertiesInfo.fov)
			{
				return zoom == scene3DPropertiesInfo.zoom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return packedValues.GetHashCode() ^ fov ^ zoom;
		}

		public Scene3DPropertiesInfo Clone()
		{
			Scene3DPropertiesInfo scene3DPropertiesInfo = new Scene3DPropertiesInfo();
			scene3DPropertiesInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return scene3DPropertiesInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(Scene3DPropertiesInfo value)
		{
			packedValues = value.packedValues;
			fov = value.fov;
			zoom = value.zoom;
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return ObjectSizeHelper.CalculateApproxObjectSize32(this, ignoreStringSize: true);
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			packedValues = reader.ReadUInt32();
			fov = reader.ReadInt32();
			zoom = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		void ISupportsBinaryReadWrite.Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(packedValues);
			writer.Write(fov);
			writer.Write(zoom);
		}
	}

			return owner.ReplaceInfo(this, GetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper), owner.GetBatchUpdateChangeActions());
		}
	}
	public class Scene3DLightRigRotationInfoIndexAccessor : IIndexAccessor<Scene3DProperties, Scene3DRotationInfo, PropertyKey>, IIndexAccessorBase<Scene3DProperties, PropertyKey>
	{
		public int GetIndex(Scene3DProperties owner)
		{
			return owner.LightRigRotationInfoIndex;
		}

		public int GetDeferredInfoIndex(Scene3DProperties owner)
		{
			return GetInfoIndex(owner, GetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper));
		}

		public void SetIndex(Scene3DProperties owner, int value)
		{
			owner.AssignLightRigRotationInfoIndex(value);
		}

		public int GetInfoIndex(Scene3DProperties owner, Scene3DRotationInfo value)
		{
			return GetInfoCache(owner).GetItemIndex(value);
		}

		public Scene3DRotationInfo GetInfo(Scene3DProperties owner)
		{
			return GetInfoCache(owner)[GetIndex(owner)];
		}

		public bool IsIndexValid(Scene3DProperties owner, int index)
		{
			return index < GetInfoCache(owner).Count;
		}

		private UniqueItemsCache<Scene3DRotationInfo> GetInfoCache(Scene3DProperties owner)
		{
			return owner.DrawingCache.Scene3DRotationInfoCache;
		}

		public IndexChangedHistoryItemCore<PropertyKey> CreateHistoryItem(Scene3DProperties owner)
		{
			return new Scene3DLightRigRotationInfoIndexChangeHistoryItem(owner);
		}

		public Scene3DRotationInfo GetDeferredInfo(MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper helper)
		{
			return ((Scene3DPropertiesBatchUpdateHelper)helper).LightRigRotationInfo;
		}

		public void SetDeferredInfo(MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper helper, Scene3DRotationInfo info)
		{
			((Scene3DPropertiesBatchUpdateHelper)helper).LightRigRotationInfo = info.Clone();
		}

		public void InitializeDeferredInfo(Scene3DProperties owner)
		{
			SetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper, GetInfo(owner));
		}

		public void CopyDeferredInfo(Scene3DProperties owner, Scene3DProperties from)
		{
			SetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper, GetInfo(from));
		}

		public bool ApplyDeferredChanges(Scene3DProperties owner)
		{
			return owner.ReplaceInfo(this, GetDeferredInfo(owner.BatchUpdateHelper), owner.GetBatchUpdateChangeActions());
		}

	public class Scene3DVector : ISupportsCopyFrom<Scene3DVector>, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private const int Xindex = 0;

		private const int Yindex = 1;

		private const int Zindex = 2;

		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly long[] coordinates;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel => documentModel;

		public long X
		{
			get
			{
				return coordinates[0];
			}
			set
			{
				SetCoordinate(0, value);
			}
		}

		public long Y
		{
			get
			{
				return coordinates[1];
			}
			set
			{
				SetCoordinate(1, value);
			}
		}

		public long Z
		{
			get
			{
				return coordinates[2];
			}
			set
			{
				SetCoordinate(2, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (X == 0L && Y == 0L)
				{
					return Z == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public Scene3DVector(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			coordinates = new long[3];
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		public void SetCoordinateCore(int index, long value)
		{
			coordinates[index] = value;
			OnPropertyChanged(index switch
			{
				1 => "Y", 
				0 => "X", 
				_ => "Z", 
			});
		}

		private void SetCoordinate(int index, long value)
		{
			if (coordinates[index] != value)
			{
				Scene3DVectorCoordinateChangeHistoryItem scene3DVectorCoordinateChangeHistoryItem = new Scene3DVectorCoordinateChangeHistoryItem(this, index, coordinates[index], value);
				documentModel.History.Add(scene3DVectorCoordinateChangeHistoryItem);
				scene3DVectorCoordinateChangeHistoryItem.Execute();
			}
		}

		public void CopyFrom(Scene3DVector value)
		{
			X = value.X;
			Y = value.Y;
			Z = value.Z;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is Scene3DVector scene3DVector))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (coordinates[0] == scene3DVector.X && coordinates[1] == scene3DVector.Y)
			{
				return coordinates[2] == scene3DVector.Z;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return coordinates[0].GetHashCode() ^ coordinates[1].GetHashCode() ^ coordinates[2].GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class BackdropPlane : ISupportsCopyFrom<BackdropPlane>, IOfficeNotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly PropertyKey NormalVectorPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(0);

		public static readonly PropertyKey UpVectorPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(1);

		public static readonly PropertyKey AnchorPointPropertyKey = new PropertyKey(2);

		private Scene3DVector normalVector;

		private Scene3DVector upVector;

		private Scene3DVector anchorPoint;

		private readonly PropertyChangedNotifier notifier;

		public Scene3DVector NormalVector => normalVector;

		public Scene3DVector UpVector => upVector;

		public Scene3DVector AnchorPoint => anchorPoint;

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (anchorPoint.IsDefault && normalVector.IsDefault)
				{
					return upVector.IsDefault;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs> PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChangedNotifier propertyChangedNotifier = notifier;
				propertyChangedNotifier.Handler = (EventHandler<OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(propertyChangedNotifier.Handler, value);
			}
		}

		public BackdropPlane(IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			notifier = new PropertyChangedNotifier(this);
			normalVector = new Scene3DVector(documentModel);
			normalVector.PropertyChanged += OnNormalVectorChanged;
			upVector = new Scene3DVector(documentModel);
			upVector.PropertyChanged += OnUpVectorChanged;
			anchorPoint = new Scene3DVector(documentModel);
			anchorPoint.PropertyChanged += OnAnchorPointChanged;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(BackdropPlane value)
		{
			normalVector.CopyFrom(value.normalVector);
			upVector.CopyFrom(value.upVector);
			anchorPoint.CopyFrom(value.anchorPoint);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is BackdropPlane backdropPlane))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (normalVector.Equals(backdropPlane.normalVector) && anchorPoint.Equals(backdropPlane.anchorPoint))
			{
				return upVector.Equals(backdropPlane.upVector);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return normalVector.GetHashCode() ^ anchorPoint.GetHashCode() ^ upVector.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void ResetToStyle()
		{
			NormalVector.X = 0L;
			NormalVector.Y = 0L;
			NormalVector.Z = 0L;
			UpVector.X = 0L;
			UpVector.Y = 0L;
			UpVector.Z = 0L;
			AnchorPoint.X = 0L;
			AnchorPoint.Y = 0L;
			AnchorPoint.Z = 0L;
		}

		private void OnAnchorPointChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(AnchorPointPropertyKey);
		}

		private void OnUpVectorChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(UpVectorPropertyKey);
		}

		private void OnNormalVectorChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(NormalVectorPropertyKey);
		}
	}

		private void SetRotationPropertyValue(IIndexAccessor<Scene3DProperties, Scene3DRotationInfo, PropertyKey> indexHolder, SetPropertyValueDelegate<Scene3DRotationInfo, int> setter, SetPropertyValueDelegate<Scene3DPropertiesInfo, bool> hasRotationSetter, int newValue)
		{
			base.DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SetPropertyValueCore(indexHolder, setter, newValue);
				SetPropertyValueCore(infoIndexAccessor, hasRotationSetter, newValue: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				base.DocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		{
			base.ApplyChanges(propertyKey);
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(propertyKey);
		}

			return this;
		}

		public void AssignLightRigRotationInfoIndex(int value)
		{
			lightRigRotationInfoIndex = value;
		}

		public override PropertyKey GetBatchUpdateChangeActions()
		{
			return PropertyKey.Undefined;
		}

		protected override MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper CreateBatchUpdateHelper()
		{
			return new Scene3DPropertiesBatchUpdateHelper((IBatchUpdateHandler)(object)this);
		}

		protected override MultiIndexBatchUpdateHelper CreateBatchInitHelper()
		{
			return new Scene3DPropertiesBatchInitHelper(this);
		}

		public Scene3DProperties Clone()
		{
			Scene3DProperties scene3DProperties = new Scene3DProperties(base.DocumentModel);
			scene3DProperties.CopyFrom(this);
			return scene3DProperties;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(Scene3DProperties value)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(value);
			backdropPlane.CopyFrom(value.backdropPlane);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is Scene3DProperties scene3DProperties))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Equals((object)scene3DProperties))
			{
				return backdropPlane.Equals(scene3DProperties.backdropPlane);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode() ^ backdropPlane.GetHashCode();
		}

		public void ResetToStyle()
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				Info.CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.Scene3DPropertiesInfoCache.DefaultItem);
				CameraRotationInfo.CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.Scene3DRotationInfoCache.DefaultItem);
				LightRigRotationInfo.CopyFrom(base.DrawingCache.Scene3DRotationInfoCache.DefaultItem);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
			backdropPlane.ResetToStyle();
		}

		private void OnBackdropPlaneChanged(object sender, OfficePropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			notifier.OnPropertyChanged(BackdropPlanePropertyKey, sender, e);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Office.Model
{
	public class ModelCustomXmlPart<T> : OfficeCustomXmlPart<T>, OfficeCustomXmlPart where T : OfficeCustomXmlPart
	{
		private string guid;

		private XmlDocument document;

		public string CustomXmlGuid
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(guid))
				{
					guid = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
				}
				return guid;
			}
			set
			{
				guid = value;
			}
		}

		public XmlDocument CustomXmlPartDocument
		{
			get
			{
				if (document == null)
				{
					document = new XmlDocument();
				}
				return document;
			}
			set
			{
				document = value;
			}
		}

		public ModelCustomXmlPart()
		{
		}

		public ModelCustomXmlPart(XmlDocument document)
		{
			this.document = document;
		}

		public bool Equals(T item)
		{
			if (guid.Equals(item.CustomXmlGuid))
			{
				string innerXml = document.InnerXml;
				string innerXml2 = item.CustomXmlPartDocument.InnerXml;
				if (innerXml.Length == innerXml2.Length && innerXml.GetHashCode() == innerXml2.GetHashCode())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(string item)
		{
			string innerXml = document.InnerXml;
			if (innerXml.Length == item.Length && innerXml.GetHashCode() == item.GetHashCode())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ModelCustomXmlPartCollection<T> : SimpleCollection<T> where T : OfficeCustomXmlPart
	{
		private CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventHandler<T> onCustomXmlPartAdded;

		private CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventHandler<T> onCustomXmlPartInserted;

		private CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventHandler<T> onCustomXmlPartRemoved;

		private EventHandler onCollectionClear;

		private EventHandler onCollectionChanged;

		public event CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventHandler<T> CustomXmlPartAdded
		{
			add
			{
				onCustomXmlPartAdded = (CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventHandler<T>)Delegate.Combine(onCustomXmlPartAdded, value);
			}

				onCustomXmlPartAdded = (CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventHandler<T>)Delegate.Remove(onCustomXmlPartAdded, value);
			}
		}

		public override int Add(T item)
		{
			int num = base.Add(item);
			RaiseCustomXmlPartAdded(item, num);
			return num;
		}

		public override void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			T newCustomXmlPart = base.InnerList[index];
			RaiseCustomXmlPartRemoved(newCustomXmlPart, index);
			base.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void RemoveAtCore(int index)
		{
			base.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public override void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			base.Insert(index, item);
			RaiseCustomXmlPartInserted(item, index);
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			RaiseCollectionCleared();
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseCustomXmlPartAdded(T newCustomXmlPart, int customXmlPartIndex)
		{
			if (onCustomXmlPartAdded != null)
			{
				CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventArgs<T> args = new CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventArgs<T>(newCustomXmlPart, customXmlPartIndex);
				onCustomXmlPartAdded(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseCustomXmlPartInserted(T newCustomXmlPart, int customXmlPartIndex)
		{
			if (onCustomXmlPartInserted != null)
			{
				CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventArgs<T> args = new CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventArgs<T>(newCustomXmlPart, customXmlPartIndex);
				onCustomXmlPartInserted(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseCustomXmlPartRemoved(T newCustomXmlPart, int customXmlPartIndex)
		{
			if (onCustomXmlPartRemoved != null)
			{
				CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventArgs<T> args = new CustomXmlPartCollectionChangedEventArgs<T>(newCustomXmlPart, customXmlPartIndex);
				onCustomXmlPartRemoved(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseCollectionCleared()
		{
			if (onCollectionClear != null)
			{
				onCollectionClear(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseCollectionChanged()
		{
			if (onCollectionChanged != null)
			{
				onCollectionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}

		private int customXmlPartIndex;

		public T NewCustomXmlPart => newCustomXmlPart;

		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)newCustomXmlPart, "newCustomXmlPart");
			Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(customXmlPartIndex, "customXmlPartIndex");
			this.newCustomXmlPart = newCustomXmlPart;
			this.customXmlPartIndex = customXmlPartIndex;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!isDisposed)
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					DisposeCore();
				}
				isDisposed = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void DisposeCore()
		{
			ClearCore();
			if (serviceManager != null)
			{
				serviceManager.Dispose();
				serviceManager = null;
			}
			if (officeTheme != null)
			{
				officeTheme.Dispose();
				officeTheme = null;
			}
			fontCacheManager = null;
			vbaProjectContent = null;
		}

		public virtual void SwitchToEmptyHistory(bool disposeHistory)

				DisposeHistory();

			history = CreateEmptyHistory();
			SubscribeHistoryEvents();
		}

			return new EmptyHistory(this);
		}

		public virtual void SwitchToNormalHistory(bool disposeHistory)
		{
			if (disposeHistory)
			{
				DisposeHistory();
			}
			history = CreateDocumentHistory();
			ResetMerging();
			SubscribeHistoryEvents();
		}

		public virtual DocumentHistory ReplaceHistory(DocumentHistory newHistory)
		{
			DocumentHistory result = history;
			UnsubscribeHistoryEvents();
			history = newHistory;
			ResetMerging();
			SubscribeHistoryEvents();
			return result;
		}

		protected internal virtual DocumentHistory CreateDocumentHistory()
		{
			return new DocumentHistory(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SubscribeHistoryEvents()
		{
			History.OperationCompleted += OnHistoryOperationCompleted;
			History.ModifiedChanged += OnHistoryModifiedChanged;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnsubscribeHistoryEvents()
		{
			History.OperationCompleted -= OnHistoryOperationCompleted;
			History.ModifiedChanged -= OnHistoryModifiedChanged;
		}

		protected internal virtual void DisposeHistory()
		{
			if (History != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeHistoryEvents();
				History.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public virtual void ResetMerging()
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract void OnHistoryOperationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e);

		protected internal abstract void OnHistoryModifiedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e);

		public virtual void ClearCore()
		{
			ClearFontCache();
			if (history != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeHistoryEvents();
				history.Dispose();
				history = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearFontCache()
		{
			if (fontCache != null)
			{
				fontCache.UnregisterListener(this);
				if (fontCacheManager != null)
				{
					fontCacheManager.ReleaseFontCache(fontCache);
				}
				fontCache = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetFontCacheManager(FontCacheManager fontCacheManager)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fontCacheManager, "fontCacheManager");
			IEmbeddedFont[] array = ((fontCache != null) ? fontCache.GetEmbeddedFontsData() : new IEmbeddedFont[0]);
			ClearFontCache();
			this.fontCacheManager = fontCacheManager;
			fontCache = fontCacheManager.CreateFontCache();
			fontCache.RegisterListener(this);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				fontCache.Measurer.AddEmbeddedFont(array[i]);
			}
		}

		void IFontCacheListener.BeforeFontCacheInvalidated()
		{
			BeforeFontCacheInvalidated();
		}

		void IFontCacheListener.AfterFontCacheInvalidated()
		{
			AfterFontCacheInvalidated();
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeFontCacheInvalidated()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void AfterFontCacheInvalidated()
		{
		}

		protected internal void UpdateLayoutUnitConverter()
		{
			toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = unitConverter.CreateConverterToLayoutUnits(LayoutUnit);
			layoutUnitConverter = DocumentLayoutUnitConverter.Create(LayoutUnit, base.ScreenDpi);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateFontCache()
		{
			if (FontCacheManager != null)
			{
				FontCacheManager = FontCacheManager.Clone(LayoutUnitConverter, AllowCjkCorrection, UseSystemFontQuality);
			}
			else
			{
				FontCacheManager = FontCacheManager.CreateDefault(LayoutUnitConverter, AllowCjkCorrection, UseSystemFontQuality);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnLayoutUnitChanged()
		{
			UpdateLayoutUnitConverter();
			UpdateFontCache();
			RaiseLayoutUnitChanged();
		}

		private void RaiseLayoutUnitChanged()
		{
			if (layoutUnitChanged != null)
			{
				layoutUnitChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		internal bool NeedChangeDpi(float newDpi)
		{
			if (base.ScreenDpi != newDpi || base.ScreenDpiX != newDpi || base.ScreenDpiY != newDpi)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (UnitConverter.ScreenDpi != newDpi || UnitConverter.ScreenDpiX != newDpi || UnitConverter.ScreenDpiY != newDpi)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpi != newDpi || layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpiX != newDpi || layoutUnitConverter.ScreenDpiY != newDpi)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter is DocumentModelTwipsToLayoutPixelsConverter documentModelTwipsToLayoutPixelsConverter && documentModelTwipsToLayoutPixelsConverter.Dpi != newDpi)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void OnDpiChanged(float value)
		{
			base.OnDpiChanged(value);
			UnitConverter.OnDpiChanged(value);
			toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.OnDpiChanged(value);
			layoutUnitConverter.OnDpiChanged(value);
			UpdateFontCache();
		}

		public virtual TFormat AutodetectDocumentFormat(string fileName)
		{
			return AutodetectDocumentFormat(fileName, useFormatFallback: true);
		}

		public virtual TFormat AutodetectDocumentFormat(string fileName, bool useFormatFallback)
		{
			ImportHelper<TFormat, bool> importHelper = CreateDocumentImportHelper();
			IImportManagerService<TFormat, bool> importManagerService = GetImportManagerService();
			if (importManagerService == null)
			{
				return importHelper.UndefinedFormat;
			}
			IImporter<TFormat, bool> importer = importHelper.AutodetectImporter(fileName, importManagerService, useFormatFallback);
			if (importer == null)
			{
				return importHelper.UndefinedFormat;
			}
			return importer.Format;
		}

		public virtual void LoadDocument(Stream stream, TFormat documentFormat, string sourceUri, Encoding encoding, bool leaveOpen)
		{
			ImportHelper<TFormat, bool> importHelper = CreateDocumentImportHelper();
			IImportManagerService<TFormat, bool> importManagerService = GetImportManagerService();
			if (importManagerService == null)
			{
				importHelper.ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			importHelper.Import(stream, documentFormat, sourceUri, importManagerService, encoding, leaveOpen);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SaveDocument(Stream stream, TFormat documentFormat, string targetUri, Encoding encoding)
		{
			SaveDocumentCore(stream, new ExportParameters<TFormat, bool>(documentFormat, targetUri, encoding));
		}

		public virtual void SaveDocument(Stream stream, ExportParameters<TFormat, bool> parameters)
		{
			SaveDocumentCore(stream, parameters);
		}

		private void SaveDocumentCore(Stream stream, ExportParameters<TFormat, bool> parameters)
		{
			using ExportHelper<TFormat, bool> exportHelper = CreateDocumentExportHelper(parameters.DocumentFormat);
			IExportManagerService<TFormat, bool> exportManagerService = GetExportManagerService();
			if (exportManagerService == null)
			{
				exportHelper.ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			parameters.ExportManagerService = exportManagerService;
			exportHelper.Export(stream, parameters);
		}

		public OfficeReferenceImage CreateImage(Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			Crc32Stream val = new Crc32Stream(stream);
			int readCheckSum;
			try
			{
				((Stream)(object)val).ReadToEnd();
				readCheckSum = (int)((CheckSumStream<uint>)(object)val).ReadCheckSum;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			Crc32ImageId id = new Crc32ImageId(readCheckSum);
			OfficeReferenceImage imageById = ImageCache.GetImageById(id);
			if (imageById != null)
			{
				return imageById;
			}
			stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			OfficeNativeImage image = OfficeImage.CreateImage(stream, id);
			return ImageCache.AddImage(image);
		}

		public OfficeReferenceImage CreateImage(MemoryStreamBasedImage image)
		{
			return new OfficeReferenceImage(this, OfficeImage.CreateImage(image));
		}

		public OfficeReferenceImage CreateImage(DXImage image)
		{
			return new OfficeReferenceImage(this, OfficeImage.CreateImage(image));
		}

		public OfficeImage GetImageById(IUniqueImageId id)
		{
			return ImageCache.GetImageById(id)?.NativeRootImage;
		}

		private void ApplyTheme(IOfficeTheme officeTheme)
		{
			if (this.officeTheme != null)
			{
				this.officeTheme.Dispose();
			}
			if (officeTheme == null)
			{
				CreateOfficeTheme();
			}
			else
			{
				this.officeTheme = officeTheme;
			}
			RaiseThemeChanged();
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseThemeChanged()
		{
			if (onThemeChanged != null)
			{
				onThemeChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract IImportManagerService<TFormat, bool> GetImportManagerService();

		protected internal abstract IExportManagerService<TFormat, bool> GetExportManagerService();
	}

	public class NativeImageId : IUniqueImageId
	{
		private readonly int imageHashCode;

		private readonly WeakReference imageRef;

		public NativeImageId(DXImage img)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)img, "img");
			object obj = img.NativeImage ?? img.Implementation;
			imageHashCode = obj.GetHashCode();
			imageRef = new WeakReference(obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return imageHashCode;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			NativeImageId b = obj as NativeImageId;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return EqualsCore(this, b);
		}

		private static bool EqualsCore(NativeImageId a, NativeImageId b)
		{
			if (a == b)
			{
				return true;
			}
			object target = a.imageRef.Target;
			object target2 = b.imageRef.Target;
			if (target == null && target2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return target.Equals(target2);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ImageCacheBase : IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<int, OfficeNativeImage>>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly IDocumentModel owner;

		private int nextImageId = 1;

		protected ImageCacheBase(IDocumentModel owner)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)owner, "owner");
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		protected abstract void AddImage(OfficeNativeImage image, int key);

		protected abstract OfficeNativeImage GetNativeImageByKey(int key);

		protected abstract OfficeNativeImage GetNativeImageById(IUniqueImageId id);

		public void RegisterImage(OfficeNativeImage image)
		{
			if (image.ImageCacheKey <= 0)
			{
				OfficeImage nativeImageById = GetNativeImageById(image.Id);
				if (nativeImageById != null)
				{
					image.SetImageCacheKey(nativeImageById.ImageCacheKey);
					return;
				}
				image.SetImageCacheKey(nextImageId);
				AddImage(image, nextImageId);
				nextImageId++;
			}
		}

		public OfficeReferenceImage GetImageById(IUniqueImageId id)
		{
			OfficeNativeImage nativeImageById = GetNativeImageById(id);
			if (nativeImageById != null)
			{
				return new OfficeReferenceImage(owner, nativeImageById);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public OfficeReferenceImage GetImageByKey(int imageId)
		{
			OfficeNativeImage nativeImageByKey = GetNativeImageByKey(imageId);
			if (nativeImageByKey == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new OfficeReferenceImage(owner, nativeImageByKey);
		}

		public OfficeReferenceImage AddImage(OfficeNativeImage image)
		{
			RegisterImage(image);
			return new OfficeReferenceImage(owner, image);
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			nextImageId = 1;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<int, OfficeNativeImage>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumeratorByIds();
		}

		public abstract IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<int, OfficeNativeImage>> GetEnumeratorByIds();
	}
	public class ImageCache : ImageCacheBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<IUniqueImageId, WeakReference> imagesByIds = new Dictionary<IUniqueImageId, WeakReference>();

		private readonly Dictionary<int, WeakReference> imagesByKeys = new Dictionary<int, WeakReference>();

		public ImageCache(IDocumentModel owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override void AddImage(OfficeNativeImage image, int key)
		{
			CleanDeadItems(imagesByKeys);
			CleanDeadItems(imagesByIds);
			imagesByKeys.Add(key, new WeakReference(image));
			imagesByIds.Add(image.Id, new WeakReference(image));
		}

		protected override OfficeNativeImage GetNativeImageById(IUniqueImageId id)
		{
			return GetNativeImageFromDictionary(imagesByIds, id);
		}

		protected override OfficeNativeImage GetNativeImageByKey(int key)
		{
			return GetNativeImageFromDictionary(imagesByKeys, key);
		}

		protected OfficeNativeImage GetNativeImageFromDictionary<T>(Dictionary<T, WeakReference> dict, T id)
		{
			if (!dict.TryGetValue(id, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			OfficeNativeImage officeNativeImage = (OfficeNativeImage)value.Target;
			if (officeNativeImage == null)
			{
				dict.Remove(id);
				return null;
			}
			CleanDeadItems(dict);
			return officeNativeImage;
		}

		protected internal virtual void CleanDeadItems<T>(Dictionary<T, WeakReference> dictionary)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			foreach (T key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference = dictionary[key];
				OfficeImage officeImage = (OfficeImage)weakReference.Target;
				if (officeImage == null)
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				dictionary.Remove(list[num]);
			}
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (int key in imagesByKeys.Keys)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference = imagesByKeys[key];
				((OfficeImage)weakReference.Target)?.Dispose();
			}
			imagesByKeys.Clear();
			foreach (IUniqueImageId key2 in imagesByIds.Keys)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference2 = imagesByIds[key2];
				((OfficeImage)weakReference2.Target)?.Dispose();
			}
			imagesByIds.Clear();
			base.Clear();
		}

		public override IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<int, OfficeNativeImage>> GetEnumeratorByIds()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, WeakReference> imagesByKey in imagesByKeys)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<int, OfficeNativeImage>(imagesByKey.Key, GetNativeImageByKey(imagesByKey.Key));
			}
		}
	}
	public class PersistentImageCache : ImageCacheBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<IUniqueImageId, OfficeNativeImage> imagesByIds = new Dictionary<IUniqueImageId, OfficeNativeImage>();

		private readonly Dictionary<int, OfficeNativeImage> imagesByKeys = new Dictionary<int, OfficeNativeImage>();

		public PersistentImageCache(IDocumentModel owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override void AddImage(OfficeNativeImage image, int key)
		{
			imagesByKeys.Add(key, image);
			imagesByIds.Add(image.Id, image);
		}

		protected override OfficeNativeImage GetNativeImageById(IUniqueImageId id)
		{
			if (imagesByIds.TryGetValue(id, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override OfficeNativeImage GetNativeImageByKey(int imageId)
		{
			if (imagesByKeys.TryGetValue(imageId, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (IUniqueImageId key in imagesByIds.Keys)
			{
				OfficeNativeImage officeNativeImage = imagesByIds[key];
				officeNativeImage.Dispose();
			}
			imagesByIds.Clear();
			foreach (int key2 in imagesByKeys.Keys)
			{
				OfficeNativeImage officeNativeImage2 = imagesByKeys[key2];
				officeNativeImage2.Dispose();
			}
			imagesByKeys.Clear();
			base.Clear();
		}

		public override IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<int, OfficeNativeImage>> GetEnumeratorByIds()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, OfficeNativeImage> imagesByKey in imagesByKeys)
			{
				yield return imagesByKey;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class PatternLine<T> where T : struct
	{
		public abstract T Id { get; }

		public abstract Rectangle CalcLineBounds(Rectangle r, int thickness);

		public abstract void Draw(IPatternLinePainter<T> painter, RectangleF bounds, Color color);

	public abstract class PatternLineRepository<T, TItem, TCollection> where T : struct where TItem : PatternLine<T> where TCollection : Dictionary<T, TItem>, new()
	{
		private readonly TCollection collection = new TCollection();

		public TCollection Items => collection;

		protected internal abstract TItem Default { get; }

		protected PatternLineRepository()
		{
			PopulateRepository();
		}

		protected internal abstract void PopulateRepository();

		public bool RegisterPatternLine(TItem line)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)line, "line");
			TItem patternLineByType = GetPatternLineByType(line.Id);
			if (patternLineByType != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			collection.Add(line.Id, line);
			return true;
		}

		public bool UnregisterPatternLine(TItem line)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)line, "line");
			return UnregisterPatternLine(line.Id);
		}

		public bool UnregisterPatternLine(T type)
		{
			TItem patternLineByType = GetPatternLineByType(type);
			if (patternLineByType == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			collection.Remove(patternLineByType.Id);
			return true;
		}

		internal TItem GetPatternLineByTypeInternal(T type)
		{
			TItem patternLineByType = GetPatternLineByType(type);
			return GetPatternLineByType(type) ?? Default;
		}

		public TItem GetPatternLineByType(T line)
		{
			collection.TryGetValue(line, out var value);
			return value;
		}
	}
	public struct RectangleOffset : IEquatable<RectangleOffset>
	{
		private int bottomOffset;

		private int leftOffset;

		private int rightOffset;

		private int topOffset;

		public static RectangleOffset Empty;

		public int BottomOffset => bottomOffset;

		public int LeftOffset => leftOffset;

		public int RightOffset => rightOffset;

		public int TopOffset => topOffset;

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals((RectangleOffset)obj);
		}

		public bool Equals(RectangleOffset other)
		{
			if (BottomOffset == other.BottomOffset && LeftOffset == other.LeftOffset && RightOffset == other.RightOffset)
			{
				return TopOffset == other.TopOffset;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode() ^ BottomOffset ^ LeftOffset ^ RightOffset ^ TopOffset;
		}

		public RectangleOffset(int bottomOffset, int leftOffset, int rightOffset, int topOffset)
		{
			this.bottomOffset = bottomOffset;
			this.leftOffset = leftOffset;
			this.rightOffset = rightOffset;
			this.topOffset = topOffset;
		}

		internal void Write(IHistoryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(bottomOffset);
			writer.Write(leftOffset);
			writer.Write(rightOffset);
			writer.Write(topOffset);
		}
	}
	public class PredefinedFontSizeCollection : List<int>
	{
		public const int MinFontSize = 1;

		public const int MaxFontSize = 1500;

		public PredefinedFontSizeCollection()
		{
			CreateDefaultContent();
		}

		public static int ValidateFontSize(int value)
		{
			return Math.Max(Math.Min(value, 1500), 1);
		}

		protected internal virtual void CreateDefaultContent()
		{
			foreach (int predefinedFontSize in FontSizeManager.GetPredefinedFontSizes())
			{
				Add(predefinedFontSize);
			}
		}

		public int CalculateNextFontSize(int fontSize)
		{
			return ValidateFontSize(CalculateNextFontSizeCore(fontSize));
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalculateNextFontSizeCore(int fontSize)
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return fontSize + 1;
			}
			if (fontSize < base[0])
			{
				return fontSize + 1;
			}
			int num = BinarySearch(fontSize);
			num = ((num >= 0) ? (num + 1) : (~num));
			if (num < base.Count)
			{
				return base[num];
			}
			return CalcNextTen(fontSize);
		}

		public int CalculatePreviousFontSize(int fontSize)
		{
			return ValidateFontSize(CalculatePreviousFontSizeCore(fontSize));
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalculatePreviousFontSizeCore(int fontSize)
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return fontSize - 1;
			}
			if (fontSize <= base[0])
			{
				return fontSize - 1;
			}
			int num = BinarySearch(fontSize);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return base[num - 1];
			}
			if (num != ~base.Count)
			{
				return base[~num - 1];
			}
			if (fontSize > CalcNextTen(base[base.Count - 1]))
			{
				return CalcPrevTen(fontSize);
			}
			return base[~num - 1];
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalcNextTen(int value)
		{
			return value + (10 - value % 10);
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalcPrevTen(int value)
		{
			if (value % 10 != 0)
			{
				return value - value % 10;
			}
			return value - 10;
		}
	}

	public class ColorModelInfo : ICloneable<ColorModelInfo>, ISupportsCopyFrom<ColorModelInfo>, ISupportsSizeOf
	{
		public const int DefaultColorIndex = -1;

		private ColorType colorType;

		private Color rgb;

		private ThemeColorIndex theme = ThemeColorIndex.None;

		private ThemeColorValues themeValue = ThemeColorValues.None;

		private int colorIndex = -1;

		private bool auto;

		private double tint;

		public ColorType ColorType => colorType;

		public Color Rgb
		{
			get
			{
				return rgb;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != ColorType.Rgb)
				{
					SetColorType(ColorType.Rgb);
				}
				if (rgb != value)
				{
					rgb = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ThemeColorIndex Theme
		{
			get
			{
				return theme;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != ColorType.Theme)
				{
					SetColorType(ColorType.Theme);
				}
				if (theme != value)
				{
					theme = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ThemeColorValues ThemeValue
		{
			get
			{
				return themeValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != ColorType.Theme)
				{
					SetColorType(ColorType.Theme);
				}
				if (themeValue != value)
				{
					themeValue = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int ColorIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return colorIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != ColorType.Index)
				{
					SetColorType(ColorType.Index);
				}
				if (colorIndex != value)
				{
					colorIndex = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Auto
		{
			get
			{
				return auto;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ColorType != ColorType.Auto)
				{
					SetColorType(ColorType.Auto);
				}
				if (auto != value)
				{
					auto = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public double Tint
		{
			get
			{
				return tint;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Math.Abs(value) > 1.0)
				{
					Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
				}
				tint = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (DXColor.IsTransparentOrEmpty(Rgb))
				{
					return ColorType == ColorType.Rgb;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static ColorModelInfo Create(ThemeColorIndex index)
		{
			return Create(index, 0.0);
		}

		public static ColorModelInfo Create(ThemeColorIndex index, double tint)
		{
			ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo = new ColorModelInfo();
			colorModelInfo.Theme = index;
			colorModelInfo.Tint = tint;
			return colorModelInfo;
		}

		public static ColorModelInfo Create(Color rgb)
		{
			ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo = new ColorModelInfo();
			colorModelInfo.Rgb = rgb;
			return colorModelInfo;
		}

		public static ColorModelInfo Create(int colorIndex)
		{
			ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo = new ColorModelInfo();
			colorModelInfo.ColorIndex = colorIndex;
			return colorModelInfo;
		}

		public static ColorModelInfo CreateAutomatic()
		{
			ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo = new ColorModelInfo();
			colorModelInfo.Auto = true;
			return colorModelInfo;
		}

		public static int ConvertColorIndex(ColorModelInfoCache sourceCache, int sourceColorIndex, ColorModelInfoCache targetCache)
		{
			ColorModelInfo info = sourceCache[sourceColorIndex];
			return GetColorIndex(targetCache, info);
		}

		public static int GetColorIndex(ColorModelInfoCache cache, Color color)
		{
			ColorModelInfo info = Create(color);
			return GetColorIndex(cache, info);
		}

		public static int GetColorIndex(ColorModelInfoCache cache, ColorModelInfo info)
		{
			return cache.GetItemIndex(info);
		}

		public static int GetAutomaticColorIndex(ColorModelInfoCache cache)
		{
			return GetColorIndex(cache, CreateAutomatic());
		}

		public static int GetDefaultForegroundColorIndex(ColorModelInfoCache cache)
		{
			return GetColorIndex(cache, Create(64));
		}

		public static int GetDefaultBackgroundColorIndex(ColorModelInfoCache cache)
		{
			return GetColorIndex(cache, Create(65));
		}

		private void SetColorType(ColorType colorType)
		{
			RestoreDefaultValues();
			this.colorType = colorType;
		}

		private void RestoreDefaultValues()
		{
			theme = ThemeColorIndex.None;
			themeValue = ThemeColorValues.None;
			colorIndex = -1;
			auto = false;
			rgb = DXColor.Empty;
		}

		public Color ToRgb(Palette palette, ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors)
		{
			Color color = DXColor.Empty;
			switch (colorType)
			{
			case ColorType.Index:
				if (ColorIndex != -1)
				{
					color = palette[ColorIndex];
					if (color.A == 0)
					{
						color = DXColor.FromArgb(255, (int)color.R, (int)color.G, (int)color.B);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ColorType.Theme:
				if (Theme != ThemeColorIndex.None)
				{
					color = colors.GetColor(Theme);
				}
				break;
			case ColorType.Rgb:
				color = Rgb;
				break;
			}
			return ColorHSL.CalculateColorRGB(color, tint);
		}

		public ColorModelInfo Clone()
		{
			ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo = new ColorModelInfo();
			colorModelInfo.CopyFrom(this);
			return colorModelInfo;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ColorModelInfo value)
		{
			colorType = value.colorType;
			rgb = value.rgb;
			theme = value.theme;
			themeValue = value.themeValue;
			colorIndex = value.colorIndex;
			auto = value.auto;
			tint = value.Tint;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (colorType == colorModelInfo.colorType && rgb == colorModelInfo.Rgb && theme == colorModelInfo.Theme && colorIndex == colorModelInfo.ColorIndex && auto == colorModelInfo.auto && tint == colorModelInfo.Tint)
			{
				return themeValue == colorModelInfo.themeValue;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.Calculate((int)colorType, rgb.GetHashCode(), theme.GetHashCode(), colorIndex, auto.GetHashCode(), tint.GetHashCode(), (int)themeValue);
		}

		public int SizeOf()
		{
			return ObjectSizeHelper.CalculateApproxObjectSize32(this, ignoreStringSize: true);
		}
	}

	public struct ColorHSL
	{
		private static readonly ColorHSL defaultValue = new ColorHSL(0, 0, 0);

		private const float MaxAngle = 21600000f;

		private const float MaxThousandthOfPercentage = 100000f;

		private float hue;

		private float saturation;

		private float luminance;

		public static ColorHSL DefaultValue => defaultValue;

		public int Hue
		{
			get
			{
				return GetIntValue(hue, 21600000f);
			}
			set
			{
				hue = GetFloatValue(GetValidValue(value), 21600000f);
			}
		}

		public int Saturation
		{
			get
			{
				return GetIntValue(saturation, 100000f);
			}
			set
			{
				saturation = GetFloatValue(GetValidValue(value), 100000f);
			}
		}

		public int Luminance
		{
			get
			{
				return GetIntValue(luminance, 100000f);
			}
			set
			{
				luminance = GetFloatValue(GetValidValue(value), 100000f);
			}
		}

		public float FloatHue
		{
			get
			{
				return hue;
			}
			set
			{
				hue = GetValidValue(value);
			}
		}

		public float FloatSaturation
		{
			get
			{
				return saturation;
			}
			set
			{
				saturation = GetValidValue(value);
			}
		}

		public float FloatLuminance
		{
			get
			{
				return luminance;
			}
			set
			{
				luminance = GetValidValue(value);
			}
		}

		public static ColorHSL FromColorRGB(Color color)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(Math.Max(color.R, color.G), color.B);
			int num2 = Math.Min(Math.Min(color.R, color.G), color.B);
			float num3 = ((num == num2) ? (2f / 3f) : (color.GetHue() / 360f));
			return new ColorHSL(num3, color.GetSaturation(), color.GetBrightness());
		}

		public static Color CalculateColorRGB(Color color, double tint)
		{
			if (color == DXColor.Empty || tint == 0.0)
			{
				return color;
			}
			return FromColorRGB(color).ApplyTint(tint).ToRgb();
		}

		public ColorHSL(float hue, float saturation, float luminance)
		{
			this.hue = hue;
			this.saturation = saturation;
			this.luminance = luminance;
		}

		public ColorHSL(int hue, int saturation, int luminance)
			: this((float)hue / 21600000f, (float)saturation / 100000f, (float)luminance / 100000f)
		{
		}

		private float GetValidValue(float value)
		{
			if (!(value > 1f))
			{
				if (!(value < 0f))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return 0f;
			}
			return 1f;
		}

		private int GetIntValue(float value, float maxValue)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round(value * maxValue);
		}

		private float GetFloatValue(float value, float maxValue)
		{
			return value / maxValue;
		}

		public Color ToRgb()
		{
			float num = (((double)luminance < 0.5) ? (luminance * (1f + saturation)) : (luminance + saturation - luminance * saturation));
			float num2 = 2f * luminance - num;
			float[] array = new float[3]
			{
				hue + 1f / 3f,
				hue,
				hue - 1f / 3f
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] < 0f)
				{
					array[i] += 1f;
				}
				if (array[i] > 1f)
				{
					array[i] -= 1f;
				}
				if (6f * array[i] < 1f)
				{
					array[i] = num2 + (num - num2) * 6f * array[i];
				}
				else if (6f * array[i] >= 1f && 6f * array[i] < 3f)
				{
					array[i] = num;
				}
				else if (6f * array[i] >= 3f && 6f * array[i] < 4f)
				{
					array[i] = num2 + (num - num2) * (4f - 6f * array[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					array[i] = num2;
				}
			}
			return DXColor.FromArgb(ToIntValue(array[0]), ToIntValue(array[1]), ToIntValue(array[2]));
		}

		private int ToIntValue(float value)
		{
			return FixIntValue((int)Math.Round(255f * value, 0));
		}

		private int FixIntValue(int value)
		{
			if (value >= 0)
			{
				if (value <= 255)
				{
					return value;
				}
				return 255;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private ColorHSL ApplyTint(double tint)
		{
			if (tint < 0.0)
			{
				luminance *= 1f + (float)tint;
			}
			if (tint > 0.0)
			{
				luminance = luminance * (1f - (float)tint) + (float)tint;
			}
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL GetComplementColor()
		{
			hue += (((double)hue > 0.5) ? (-0.5f) : 0.5f);
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplyHue(int value)
		{
			FloatHue = (float)value / 21600000f;
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplyHueMod(int value)
		{
			hue = hue * (float)value / 100000f;
			FixHue();
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplyHueOffset(int value)
		{
			hue += (float)value / 21600000f;
			FixHue();
			return this;
		}

		private void FixHue()
		{
			if (hue > 1f)
			{
				hue -= (int)hue;
			}
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplySaturation(int value)
		{
			FloatSaturation = (float)value / 100000f;
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplySaturationMod(int value)
		{
			saturation = saturation * (float)value / 100000f;
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplySaturationOffset(int value)
		{
			saturation += (float)value / 100000f;
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplyLuminance(int value)
		{
			FloatLuminance = (float)value / 100000f;
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplyLuminanceMod(int value)
		{
			luminance = luminance * (float)value / 100000f;
			return this;
		}

		public ColorHSL ApplyLuminanceOffset(int value)
		{
			luminance += (float)value / 100000f;
			return this;
		}
	}

	public struct ScRGBColor
	{
		private static readonly ScRGBColor defaultValue = new ScRGBColor(0, 0, 0);

		private int scR;

		private int scG;

		private int scB;

		public static ScRGBColor DefaultValue => defaultValue;

		public int ScR
		{
			get
			{
				return scR;
			}
			set
			{
				scR = GetValidValue(value);
			}
		}

		public int ScG
		{
			get
			{
				return scG;
			}
			set
			{
				scG = GetValidValue(value);
			}
		}

		public int ScB
		{
			get
			{
				return scB;
			}
			set
			{
				scB = GetValidValue(value);
			}
		}

		public static Color ToRgb(int scR, int scG, int scB)
		{
			return new ScRGBColor(scR, scG, scB).ToRgb();
		}

		public ScRGBColor(int scR, int scG, int scB)
		{
			this.scR = scR;
			this.scG = scG;
			this.scB = scB;
		}

		private int GetValidValue(int value)
		{
			if (value >= 0)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public Color ToRgb()
		{
			double num = (float)scR * 1f / 100000f;
			double num2 = (float)scG * 1f / 100000f;
			double num3 = (float)scB * 1f / 100000f;
			num = ((num <= 0.0031308) ? (12.92 * num) : (1.055 * Math.Pow(num, 5.0 / 12.0) - 0.055));
			num2 = ((num2 <= 0.0031308) ? (12.92 * num2) : (1.055 * Math.Pow(num2, 5.0 / 12.0) - 0.055));
			num3 = ((num3 <= 0.0031308) ? (12.92 * num3) : (1.055 * Math.Pow(num3, 5.0 / 12.0) - 0.055));
			num *= 255.0;
			num2 *= 255.0;
			num3 *= 255.0;
			return DXColor.FromArgb(Convert.ToInt32(num), Convert.ToInt32(num2), Convert.ToInt32(num3));
		}
	}

		{
			public double Distance { get; set; }

			public int ColorIndex { get; set; }

			public int CompareTo(ColorDistanceInfo other)
			{
				if (Distance > other.Distance)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (Distance < other.Distance)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public Palette()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void Reset()
		{
			SynchronizationContext current = SynchronizationContext.Current;
			try
			{
				colorTable = CreateDefaultColorTable();
				isCustomIndexedColorTable = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (current == null && SynchronizationContext.Current != null)
				{
					SynchronizationContext.SetSynchronizationContext(null);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsEqualColors(Palette other)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)other, "other");
			for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] != other[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (this[77] == other[77] && this[78] == other[78] && this[79] == other[79])
			{
				return this[32767] == other[32767];
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Color GetColor(int index)
		{
			if (!colorTable.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void SetColor(int index, Color value)
		{
			if (colorTable.ContainsKey(index))
			{
				if (colorTable[index] != value)
				{
					IsCustomIndexedColorTable = true;
					colorTable[index] = value;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
		}

		public bool IsValidColorIndex(int index)
		{
			return colorTable.ContainsKey(index);
		}

		public int GetColorIndex(ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors, ColorModelInfoCache cache, int index, bool foreground)
		{
			if (!cache.IsIndexValid(index))
			{
				if (!foreground)
				{
					return 65;
				}
				return 64;
			}
			ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo = cache[index];
			ColorModelInfo defaultItem = cache.DefaultItem;
			if (defaultItem == colorModelInfo)
			{
				if (!foreground)
				{
					return 65;
				}
				return 64;
			}
			if (colorModelInfo.ColorType == ColorType.Auto)
			{
				if (!foreground)
				{
					return 65;
				}
				return 64;
			}
			if (colorModelInfo.ColorType == ColorType.Index)
			{
				if (!IsValidColorIndex(colorModelInfo.ColorIndex))
				{
					if (!foreground)
					{
						return 65;
					}
					return 64;
				}
				if (colorModelInfo.ColorIndex <= 65)
				{
					return colorModelInfo.ColorIndex;
				}
			}
			Color color = colorModelInfo.ToRgb(this, colors);
			return GetPaletteNearestColorIndex(color);
		}

		public int GetColorIndex(ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors, ColorModelInfo colorInfo, bool foreground)
		{
			if (colorInfo.ColorType == ColorType.Auto)
			{
				if (!foreground)
				{
					return 65;
				}
				return 64;
			}
			if (colorInfo.ColorType == ColorType.Index)
			{
				if (!IsValidColorIndex(colorInfo.ColorIndex))
				{
					if (!foreground)
					{
						return 65;
					}
					return 64;
				}
				if (colorInfo.ColorIndex >= 8)
				{
					return colorInfo.ColorIndex;
				}
			}
			Color color = colorInfo.ToRgb(this, colors);
			return GetPaletteNearestColorIndex(color);
		}

		public int GetFontColorIndex(ThemeDrawingColorCollection colors, ColorModelInfo colorInfo)
		{
			if (colorInfo.ColorType == ColorType.Auto)
			{
				return 32767;
			}
			if (colorInfo.ColorType == ColorType.Index)
			{
				if (!IsValidColorIndex(colorInfo.ColorIndex))
				{
					return 32767;
				}
				return colorInfo.ColorIndex;
			}
			Color color = colorInfo.ToRgb(this, colors);
			return GetPaletteNearestColorIndex(color);
		}

		public int GetColorIndex(Color color)
		{
			int exactColorIndex = GetExactColorIndex(color, 0, 32767);
			if (exactColorIndex != -1)
			{
				return exactColorIndex;
			}
			if (color.A == byte.MaxValue)
			{
				color = DXColor.FromArgb(0, (int)color.R, (int)color.G, (int)color.B);
				exactColorIndex = GetExactColorIndex(color, 0, 32767);
				if (exactColorIndex != -1)
				{
					return exactColorIndex;
				}
			}
			return 64;
		}

		private int GetExactColorIndex(Color color, int minIndex, int maxIndex)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, Color> item in colorTable)
			{
				if (item.Key >= minIndex && item.Key <= maxIndex && item.Value == color)
				{
					return item.Key;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetNearestColorIndex(Color color)
		{
			int exactColorIndex = GetExactColorIndex(color, 0, 63);
			if (exactColorIndex != -1)
			{
				return exactColorIndex;
			}
			return GetNearestColorIndexCore(color, 0, 63);
		}

		public int GetPaletteNearestColorIndex(Color color)
		{
			int exactColorIndex = GetExactColorIndex(color, 8, 63);
			if (exactColorIndex != -1)
			{
				return exactColorIndex;
			}
			return GetNearestColorIndexCore(color, 8, 63);
		}

		private int GetNearestColorIndexCore(Color color, int minIndex, int maxIndex)
		{
			List<ColorDistanceInfo> list = new List<ColorDistanceInfo>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, Color> item in colorTable)
			{
				if (item.Key >= minIndex && item.Key <= maxIndex && IsCompatibleColors(item.Value, color))
				{
					ColorDistanceInfo colorDistanceInfo = new ColorDistanceInfo();
					colorDistanceInfo.Distance = GetColorDistance(color, item.Value, 3.0);
					colorDistanceInfo.ColorIndex = item.Key;
					list.Add(colorDistanceInfo);
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			if (list.Count > 5)
			{
				list.RemoveRange(5, list.Count - 5);
			}
			int num = -1;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (ColorDistanceInfo item2 in list)
			{
				if (num == -1)
				{
					num = item2.ColorIndex;
					num2 = GetColorDistance(color, colorTable[item2.ColorIndex], 1.5);
					continue;
				}
				double colorDistance = GetColorDistance(color, colorTable[item2.ColorIndex], 1.5);
				if (colorDistance < num2)
				{
					num = item2.ColorIndex;
					num2 = colorDistance;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double GetColorDistance(Color x, Color y, double rgbWeight)
		{
			double num = ColorDifference.HSB(x, y);
			double num2 = ColorDifference.RGB(x, y) * rgbWeight;
			return num + num2;
		}

		private bool IsCompatibleColors(Color x, Color y)
		{
			bool flag = x.R == x.G && x.R == x.B;
			bool flag2 = y.R == y.G && y.R == y.B;
			return flag == flag2;
		}

		public Palette Clone()
		{
			Palette palette = new Palette();
			palette.CopyFrom(this);
			return palette;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(Palette value)
		{
			colorTable = new Dictionary<int, Color>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, Color> item in value.colorTable)
			{
				colorTable.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
			}
			isCustomIndexedColorTable = value.isCustomIndexedColorTable;
		}
	}
	public static class ColorDifference
	{
		public static double RGB(Color x, Color y)
		{
			double num = ((double)(int)x.R - (double)(int)y.R) / 255.0;
			double num2 = ((double)(int)x.G - (double)(int)y.G) / 255.0;
			double num3 = ((double)(int)x.B - (double)(int)y.B) / 255.0;
			return Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2 + num3 * num3);
		}

		public static double HSB(Color x, Color y)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(x.GetHue() - y.GetHue());
			if (num > 180.0)
			{
				num = 360.0 - num;
			}
			num /= 57.3;
			double num2 = (double)Math.Abs(x.GetBrightness() - y.GetBrightness()) * 3.0;
			double num3 = (double)Math.Abs(x.GetSaturation() - y.GetSaturation()) * 1.5;
			return num2 + num + num3;
		}
	}
	public static class CieXYZConverter
	{
		private static double CLinear(double c)
		{
			if (c <= 0.04045)
			{
				return c / 12.92;
			}
			return Math.Pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
		}

		public static double GetX(Color color)
		{
			double num = CLinear((double)(int)color.R / 255.0);
			double num2 = CLinear((double)(int)color.G / 255.0);
			double num3 = CLinear((double)(int)color.B / 255.0);
			return 0.4124 * num + 0.3876 * num2 + 0.1805 * num3;
		}

		public static double GetY(Color color)
		{
			double num = CLinear((double)(int)color.R / 255.0);
			double num2 = CLinear((double)(int)color.G / 255.0);
			double num3 = CLinear((double)(int)color.B / 255.0);
			return 0.2126 * num + 0.7152 * num2 + 0.0722 * num3;
		}

		public static double GetZ(Color color)
		{
			double num = CLinear((double)(int)color.R / 255.0);
			double num2 = CLinear((double)(int)color.G / 255.0);
			double num3 = CLinear((double)(int)color.B / 255.0);
			return 0.0193 * num + 0.1192 * num2 + 0.9505 * num3;
		}
	}
	public static class CieLABConverter
	{
		private static readonly double threshold = Math.Pow(0.20689655172413793, 3.0);

		private static double Func(double t)
		{
			if (t > threshold)
			{
				return Math.Pow(t, 1.0 / 3.0);
			}
			return Math.Pow(4.833333333333333, 2.0) * t / 3.0 + 0.13793103448275862;
		}

		public static double GetL(Color color)
		{
			double y = CieXYZConverter.GetY(color);
			return 116.0 * Func(y / 3.0) - 16.0;
		}

		public static double GetA(Color color)
		{
			double x = CieXYZConverter.GetX(color);
			double y = CieXYZConverter.GetY(color);
			return 500.0 * (Func(x / 3.0) - Func(y / 3.0));
		}

		public static double GetB(Color color)
		{
			double y = CieXYZConverter.GetY(color);
			double z = CieXYZConverter.GetZ(color);
			return 200.0 * (Func(y / 3.0) - Func(z / 3.0));
		}
	}
	public static class CieColorDifference
	{
		public static double Cie76(Color x, Color y)
		{
			double num = CieLABConverter.GetL(x) - CieLABConverter.GetL(y);
			double num2 = CieLABConverter.GetA(x) - CieLABConverter.GetA(y);
			double num3 = CieLABConverter.GetB(x) - CieLABConverter.GetB(y);
			return Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2 + num3 * num3);
		}

		public static double Cie94(Color x, Color y)
		{
			double a = CieLABConverter.GetA(x);
			double b = CieLABConverter.GetB(x);
			double a2 = CieLABConverter.GetA(y);
			double b2 = CieLABConverter.GetB(y);
			double num = CieLABConverter.GetL(x) - CieLABConverter.GetL(y);
			double num2 = a - a2;
			double num3 = b - b2;
			double num4 = Math.Sqrt(a * a + b * b);
			double num5 = Math.Sqrt(a2 * a2 + b2 * b2);
			double num6 = num4 - num5;
			double num7 = Math.Sqrt(num2 * num2 + num3 * num3 - num6 * num6);
			return Math.Sqrt(num * num + Math.Pow(num6 / (1.0 + 0.045 * num4), 2.0) + Math.Pow(num7 / (1.0 + 0.015 * num4), 2.0));
		}
	}

		public const string VbaStorageName = "VBA\\";

		public const string VbaProjectStreamName = "VBA\\_VBA_PROJECT";

		public const string DirStreamName = "VBA\\dir";

		private readonly List<VbaProjectItem> items = new List<VbaProjectItem>();

		public bool IsEmpty => Items.Count == 0;

		public bool HasNoMacros { get; set; }

		public Guid GuidTypeLib { get; set; }

		public IList<VbaProjectItem> SignParts { get; } = new List<VbaProjectItem>();

		{
			Items.Clear();
			HasNoMacros = false;
			GuidTypeLib = Guid.Empty;
			SignParts.Clear();
		}

		public VbaProjectItem FindItem(string path)
		{
			foreach (VbaProjectItem item in Items)
			{
				if (string.Compare(item.StreamName, path, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static class VbaProjectExportHelper
	{
		public const string RelsVbaProjectNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/relationships/vbaProject";

		public const string RelsVbaProjectSignNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/relationships/vbaProjectSignature";

		public const string RelsVbaProjectSignAgileNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2014/relationships/vbaProjectSignatureAgile";

		public const string RelsVbaDataNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/relationships/wordVbaData";

		public const string VbaDataContentType = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2006/wordml";

		public const string VbaProjectContentType = "application/vnd.ms-office.vbaProject";

		public const string VbaProjectSignContentType = "application/vnd.ms-office.vbaProjectSignature";

		public const string VbaProjectSignAgileContentType = "application/vnd.ms-office.vbaProjectSignatureAgile";

		public static void ExportVbaProjectItem(List<VbaProjectEntry> vbaProjectEntries, string name, byte[] data)
		{
			if (!IsPerfomanceCache(name))
			{
				MemoryStream output = new MemoryStream(data.Length);
				VbaProjectEntry vbaProjectEntry = new VbaProjectEntry();
				vbaProjectEntry.StreamName = name;
				vbaProjectEntry.Writer = new BinaryWriter(output);
				vbaProjectEntry.Writer.Write(data);
				vbaProjectEntries.Add(vbaProjectEntry);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsPerfomanceCache(string name)
		{
			return name.Contains("__SRP_");
		}

		public static Stream ExportStandaloneVbaProject(VbaProject vbaProject)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			StructuredStorageWriter val = new StructuredStorageWriter();
			ExportVbaProject(val, vbaProject, string.Empty);
			val.Write((Stream)memoryStream);
			return new MemoryStream(memoryStream.GetBuffer(), 0, (int)memoryStream.Length);
		}

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		public static void ExportVbaProject(StructuredStorageWriter structuredStorageWriter, VbaProject vbaProject, string storageName)
		{
			storageName += "\\";
			List<VbaProjectEntry> list = new List<VbaProjectEntry>();
			foreach (VbaProjectItem item in vbaProject.Items)
			{
				ExportVbaProjectItem(list, item.StreamName, item.Data);
			}
			foreach (VbaProjectEntry item2 in list)
			{
				structuredStorageWriter.AddStreamDirectoryEntry(storageName + item2.StreamName, item2.Writer);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class VbaProjectImportHelper
	{
		public static void ImportVbaProject(IDocumentModel documentModel, PackageFileReader packageFileReader, string storageName)
		{
			int num = 1;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(storageName))
			{
				num += 1 + storageName.Length;
			}
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = packageFileReader.EnumerateFiles(storageName, false);
			foreach (string item in enumerable)
			{
				BinaryReader cachedPackageFileReader = packageFileReader.GetCachedPackageFileReader(item);
				if (cachedPackageFileReader != null)
				{
					string streamName = item.Substring(num);
					byte[] data = cachedPackageFileReader.ReadBytes((int)cachedPackageFileReader.BaseStream.Length);
					documentModel.VbaProjectContent.Items.Add(new VbaProjectItem(streamName, data));
					continue;
				}
				documentModel.VbaProjectContent.Clear();
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	public class AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions
	{
		private static readonly AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions empty = new AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions
		{
			IsEmpty = true,
			UseKerning = true
		};

		public const int MinCondensedBoxWidth = 0;

		public const int MaskNone = 0;

		public const int MaskSpacing = 1;

		public const int MaskScaling = 2;

		public const int VTableSize = 4;

		public static AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions Empty => empty;

		public bool IsEmpty { get; set; }

		public int Spacing { get; set; }

		public int ScaledSpacingInverted
		{
			get
			{
				int num = Scale;
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					num = 100;
				}
				return 100 * Spacing / num;
			}
		}

		public float ScaleFactor => (float)Scale / 100f;

		public int KerningThreshold { get; set; }

		public bool UseKerning { get; set; }

		public int Scale { get; set; }

		public bool UseScale
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsEmpty && Scale > 0)
				{
					return Scale != 100;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Spacing ^ (KerningThreshold << 17) ^ (Scale << 23) ^ ((IsEmpty ? 1 : 0) << 29) ^ ((UseKerning ? 1 : 0) << 30);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions advancedCharacterMeasuringOptions = obj as AdvancedCharacterMeasuringOptions;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (advancedCharacterMeasuringOptions.IsEmpty == IsEmpty && advancedCharacterMeasuringOptions.Spacing == Spacing && advancedCharacterMeasuringOptions.KerningThreshold == KerningThreshold && advancedCharacterMeasuringOptions.Scale == Scale)
			{
				return advancedCharacterMeasuringOptions.UseKerning == UseKerning;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int CalcVTableIndex()
		{
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (Spacing != 0)
			{
				num |= 1;
			}
			if (Scale != 100 && Scale > 0)
			{
				num |= 2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int CalcVTableSize()
		{
			return 4;
		}
	}
}

	public class SimplePageContentAlgorithm : IPageContentAlgorithm
	{
		private RectangleF bounds = RectangleF.Empty;

		private IListWrapper<Brick> bricks;

		public RectangleF ContentBounds => bounds;

		public bool ClipContent => false;

		public IList<Brick> Process(IListWrapper<Brick> bricks, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			if (this.bricks == bricks)
			{
				return (IList<Brick>)(object)new Brick[0];
			}
			this.bricks = bricks;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			return new List<Brick>((IEnumerable<Brick>)bricks);
		}

		public void OnBeforeBuildPages()
		{
			bricks = null;
		}
	}
}
