		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(HSLEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("hsl");
			try
			{
				WriteIntValue("hue", drawingEffect.Hue, 0);
				WriteIntValue("sat", drawingEffect.Saturation, 0);
				WriteIntValue("lum", drawingEffect.Luminance, 0);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void WriteOffsetShadowInfo(OffsetShadowInfo info)
		{
			long distance = info.Distance;
			WriteLongValue("dist", distance, 0);
			WriteIntValue("dir", info.Direction, 0);
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(InnerShadowEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("innerShdw");
			try
			{
				long blurRadius = drawingEffect.BlurRadius;
				WriteLongValue("blurRad", blurRadius, 0);
				WriteOffsetShadowInfo(drawingEffect.OffsetShadow);
				OpemXmlDrawingColorExporter opemXmlDrawingColorExporter = new OpemXmlDrawingColorExporter(DocumentContentWriter);
				opemXmlDrawingColorExporter.GenerateDrawingColorContent(drawingEffect.Color);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(LuminanceEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("lum");
			try
			{
				WriteIntValue("bright", drawingEffect.Bright, 0);
				WriteIntValue("contrast", drawingEffect.Contrast, 0);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void WriteSkewAnglesInfo(SkewAnglesInfo info)
		{
			WriteIntValue("kx", info.Horizontal, 0);
			WriteIntValue("ky", info.Vertical, 0);
		}

		private void WriteScalingFactorInfo(ScalingFactorInfo info)
		{
			WriteIntValue("sx", info.Horizontal, 100000);
			WriteIntValue("sy", info.Vertical, 100000);
		}

		private void WriteOuterShadowEffectInfo(OuterShadowEffectInfo info)
		{
			long blurRadius = info.BlurRadius;
			WriteLongValue("blurRad", blurRadius, 0);
			WriteOffsetShadowInfo(info.OffsetShadow);
			WriteScalingFactorInfo(info.ScalingFactor);
			WriteSkewAnglesInfo(info.SkewAngles);
			WriteEnumValue("algn", info.ShadowAlignment, OpenXmlExporterBase.RectangleAlignTypeTable, RectangleAlignType.Bottom);
			if (!info.RotateWithShape)
			{
				WriteBoolValue("rotWithShape", info.RotateWithShape);
			}
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(OuterShadowEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("outerShdw");
			try
			{
				WriteOuterShadowEffectInfo(drawingEffect.Info);
				OpemXmlDrawingColorExporter opemXmlDrawingColorExporter = new OpemXmlDrawingColorExporter(DocumentContentWriter);
				opemXmlDrawingColorExporter.GenerateDrawingColorContent(drawingEffect.Color);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(PresetShadowEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("prstShdw");
			try
			{
				WriteEnumValue("prst", drawingEffect.Type, OpenXmlExporterBase.PresetShadowTypeTable);
				WriteOffsetShadowInfo(drawingEffect.OffsetShadow);
				OpemXmlDrawingColorExporter opemXmlDrawingColorExporter = new OpemXmlDrawingColorExporter(DocumentContentWriter);
				opemXmlDrawingColorExporter.GenerateDrawingColorContent(drawingEffect.Color);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void WriteReflectionOpacityInfo(ReflectionOpacityInfo info)
		{
			WriteIntValue("stA", info.StartOpacity, 100000);
			WriteIntValue("stPos", info.StartPosition, 0);
			WriteIntValue("endA", info.EndOpacity, 0);
			WriteIntValue("endPos", info.EndPosition, 100000);
			WriteIntValue("fadeDir", info.FadeDirection, 5400000);
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(ReflectionEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("reflection");
			try
			{
				WriteReflectionOpacityInfo(drawingEffect.ReflectionOpacity);
				WriteOuterShadowEffectInfo(drawingEffect.OuterShadowEffectInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(RelativeOffsetEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("relOff");
			try
			{
				WriteIntValue("tx", drawingEffect.OffsetX, 0);
				WriteIntValue("ty", drawingEffect.OffsetY, 0);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(SoftEdgeEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("softEdge");
			try
			{
				long radius = drawingEffect.Radius;
				WriteLongValue("rad", radius);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(SolidColorReplacementEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			GenerateDrawingColorContentFromEffect(drawingEffect.Color, "clrRepl");
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(TintEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("tint");
			try
			{
				WriteIntValue("hue", drawingEffect.Hue, 0);
				WriteIntValue("amt", drawingEffect.Amount, 0);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		void IDrawingEffectVisitor.Visit(TransformEffect drawingEffect)
		{
			WriteStartElement("xfrm");
			try
			{
				WriteScalingFactorInfo(drawingEffect.ScalingFactor);
				WriteSkewAnglesInfo(drawingEffect.SkewAngles);
				long horizontal = drawingEffect.CoordinateShift.Horizontal;
				WriteLongValue("tx", horizontal, 0);
				long vertical = drawingEffect.CoordinateShift.Vertical;
				WriteLongValue("ty", vertical, 0);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DrawingFillExportWalker : IDrawingFillVisitor
	{
		private readonly XmlWriter documentContentWriter;

		private readonly IOpenXmlOfficeImageExporter imageExporter;

		public DrawingFillExportWalker(XmlWriter documentContentWriter, IOpenXmlOfficeImageExporter imageExporter)
		{
			this.documentContentWriter = documentContentWriter;
			this.imageExporter = imageExporter;
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingFill fill)
		{
			if (fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.None)
			{
				OpenXmlDrawingExportHelper.GenerateDrawingFillTag(documentContentWriter, "noFill");
			}
			else if (fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Group)
			{
				OpenXmlDrawingExportHelper.GenerateDrawingFillTag(documentContentWriter, "grpFill");
			}
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingSolidFill fill)
		{
			OpenXmlDrawingExportHelper.GenerateDrawingColorTag(documentContentWriter, "solidFill", fill.Color);
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingPatternFill fill)
		{
			OpenXmlDrawingExportHelper.GenerateDrawingPatternFillContent(documentContentWriter, fill);
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingGradientFill fill)
		{
			OpenXmlDrawingExportHelper.GenerateDrawingGradientFillContent(documentContentWriter, fill);
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingBlipFill fill)
		{
			OpenXmlDrawingExportHelper.GenerateDrawingBlipFillContent(documentContentWriter, fill, imageExporter);
		}
	}
	public interface IThemeOpenXmlExporter
	{
		void GenerateDrawingColorContent(DrawingColor color);

		void GenerateThemeFormatSchemesContent();
	}
	public abstract class ThemesBaseExporter
	{
		private static readonly Lazy<Dictionary<ThemeColorIndex, string>> themeColorIndexTranslationTable = new Lazy<Dictionary<ThemeColorIndex, string>>(CreateThemeColorIndexTranslationTable);

		public const string DrawingMLNamespace = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main";

		private IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private XmlWriter documentContentWriter;

		private IThemeOpenXmlExporter openXmlExporter;

		public IDocumentModel DocumentModel
		{
			get
			{
				return documentModel;
			}
			set
			{
				documentModel = value;
			}
		}

		public IThemeOpenXmlExporter OpenXmlExporter
		{
			get
			{
				return openXmlExporter;
			}
			set
			{
				openXmlExporter = value;
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<ThemeColorIndex, string> CreateThemeColorIndexTranslationTable()
		{
			Dictionary<ThemeColorIndex, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<ThemeColorIndex, string>();
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Dark1, "dk1");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Dark2, "dk2");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Light1, "lt1");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Light2, "lt2");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Accent1, "accent1");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Accent2, "accent2");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Accent3, "accent3");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Accent4, "accent4");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Accent5, "accent5");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Accent6, "accent6");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.Hyperlink, "hlink");
			dictionary.Add(ThemeColorIndex.FollowedHyperlink, "folHlink");
			return dictionary;
		}

		public ThemesBaseExporter(IDocumentModel documentModel, XmlWriter documentContentWriter, IThemeOpenXmlExporter openXmlExporter)
		{
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			this.documentContentWriter = documentContentWriter;
			this.openXmlExporter = openXmlExporter;
		}

		public virtual void WriteStartElement(string tag, string ns)
		{
			documentContentWriter.WriteStartElement(tag, ns);
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteStartElement(string prefix, string tag, string ns)
		{
			documentContentWriter.WriteStartElement(prefix, tag, ns);
		}

		public virtual void WriteEndElement()
		{
			documentContentWriter.WriteEndElement();
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteStringAttr(string prefix, string attr, string ns, string value)
		{
			documentContentWriter.WriteAttributeString(prefix, attr, ns, value);
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteStringValue(string tag, string value)
		{
			WriteStringAttr(null, tag, null, value);
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteStringValue(string attr, string value, bool shouldExport)
		{
			if (shouldExport)
			{
				WriteStringValue(attr, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteString(string text)
		{
			documentContentWriter.WriteString(text);
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteRaw(string data)
		{
			documentContentWriter.WriteRaw(data);
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteIntValue(string attr, int value, int defaultValue)
		{
			WriteIntValue(attr, value, value != defaultValue);
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteIntValue(string attr, int value, bool shouldExport)
		{
			if (shouldExport)
			{
				WriteIntValue(attr, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteIntValue(string tag, int value)
		{
			WriteStringAttr(null, tag, null, value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		public void GenerateDrawingNamespaceAttributes()
		{
			WriteStringAttr("xmlns", "a", null, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
		}

		public virtual void GenerateThemesContent()
		{
			WriteStartElement("a", "theme", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				GenerateDrawingNamespaceAttributes();
				WriteStringValue("name", DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Name);
				GenerateThemeElementsContent();
				GenerateObjectDefaults();
				GenerateExtraClrScheme();
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		protected void GenerateThemeElementsContent()
		{
			WriteStartElement("themeElements", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				GenerateThemeColorSchemesContent();
				GenerateThemeFontSchemesContent();
				GenerateThemeFormatSchemesContent();
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void GenerateThemeColorSchemesContent()
		{
			WriteStartElement("clrScheme", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				WriteStringValue("name", DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Name);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Dark1, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Dark1);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Light1, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Light1);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Dark2, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Dark2);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Light2, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Light2);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Accent1, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Accent1);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Accent2, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Accent2);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Accent3, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Accent3);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Accent4, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Accent4);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Accent5, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Accent5);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Accent6, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Accent6);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.Hyperlink, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.Hyperlink);
				GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex.FollowedHyperlink, DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors.FollowedHyperlink);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void GenerateThemeColorSchemeContent(ThemeColorIndex index, DrawingColor color)
		{
			WriteStartElement(themeColorIndexTranslationTable.Value[index], "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				GenerateDrawingColorContent(color);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		public abstract void GenerateDrawingColorContent(DrawingColor color);

		public void ExportSystemColorAttributes(SystemColorValues color)
		{
			if (SystemColorDestination.systemColorTable.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				WriteStringValue("val", value);
			}
		}

		public void ExportLastComputedColorAttribute(Color color)
		{
			ExportColorAttributes("lastClr", color);
		}

		public void ExportRgbColorAttributes(Color color)
		{
			ExportColorAttributes("val", color);
		}

		private void ExportColorAttributes(string tag, Color color)
		{
			byte r = color.R;
			byte g = color.G;
			byte b = color.B;
			WriteStringValue(tag, $"{r:X2}" + $"{g:X2}" + $"{b:X2}");
		}

		protected internal virtual void GenerateThemeFontSchemesContent()
		{
			WriteStartElement("fontScheme", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				WriteStringValue("name", DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FontScheme.Name);
				GenerateThemeFontSchemePartContent(DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FontScheme.MajorFont, "majorFont");
				GenerateThemeFontSchemePartContent(DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FontScheme.MinorFont, "minorFont");
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void GenerateThemeFontSchemePartContent(ThemeFontSchemePart scheme, string tagName)
		{
			WriteStartElement(tagName, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				GenerateDrawingTextFontContent(scheme.Latin, "latin");
				GenerateDrawingTextFontContent(scheme.EastAsian, "ea");
				GenerateDrawingTextFontContent(scheme.ComplexScript, "cs");
				GenerateSupplementalFontsContent(scheme);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private void GenerateSupplementalFontsContent(ThemeFontSchemePart scheme)
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> supplementalFonts = scheme.SupplementalFonts;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> item in supplementalFonts)
			{
				GenerateThemeSupplementalFontContent(item.Key, item.Value);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateThemeSupplementalFontContent(string script, string typeface)
		{
			WriteStartElement("font", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				WriteStringValue("script", script);
				WriteStringValue("typeface", typeface);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		protected internal void GenerateDrawingTextFontContent(DrawingTextFont textFont, string tagName)
		{
			WriteStartElement(tagName, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				string typeface = textFont.Typeface;
				WriteStringValue("typeface", string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeface) ? string.Empty : typeface);
				string panose = textFont.Panose;
				WriteStringValue("panose", panose, !string.IsNullOrEmpty(panose) && panose.Length == 20);
				byte pitchFamily = textFont.PitchFamily;
				WriteIntValue("pitchFamily", pitchFamily, 0);
				byte charset = textFont.Charset;
				WriteIntValue("charset", (sbyte)charset, 1);
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract void GenerateThemeFormatSchemesContent();

		private void GenerateDrawingListContent<T>(string tagName, List<T> list, Action<T> action)
		{
			WriteStartElement(tagName, "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main");
			try
			{
				int count = list.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					action(list[i]);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void GenerateObjectDefaults()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void GenerateExtraClrScheme()
		{
		}
	}
	public static class OpenXmlExportEncryptionHelper
	{
		public static void ExportEncrypted(Stream outputStream, EncryptionOptions options, Action<Stream> exportAction)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			EncryptionSession val = EncryptionSession.CreateOpenXmlSession(options);
			Stream stream = (Stream)new ChunkedMemoryStream();
			Stream stream2 = (Stream)new ChunkedMemoryStream();
			val.Save(options.Password, stream, stream2, exportAction);
			StructuredStorageWriter val2 = new StructuredStorageWriter();
			val2.AddStreamDirectoryEntry("\\EncryptionInfo", new BinaryWriter(stream));
			val2.AddStreamDirectoryEntry("\\EncryptedPackage", new BinaryWriter(stream2));
			val2.Write(outputStream);
		}
	}

		private static Dictionary<DrawingTextAnchoringType, string> CreateAnchoringTypeTable()
		{
			Dictionary<DrawingTextAnchoringType, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<DrawingTextAnchoringType, string>();
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextAnchoringType.Top, "t");
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextAnchoringType.Center, "ctr");
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextAnchoringType.Bottom, "b");
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextAnchoringType.Justified, "just");
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextAnchoringType.Distributed, "dist");
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static Dictionary<DrawingTextHorizontalOverflowType, string> CreateHorizontalOverflowTypeTable()
		{
			Dictionary<DrawingTextHorizontalOverflowType, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<DrawingTextHorizontalOverflowType, string>();
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextHorizontalOverflowType.Clip, "clip");
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextHorizontalOverflowType.Overflow, "overflow");
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static Dictionary<DrawingTextVerticalOverflowType, string> CreateVerticalOverflowTypeTable()
		{
			Dictionary<DrawingTextVerticalOverflowType, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<DrawingTextVerticalOverflowType, string>();
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextVerticalOverflowType.Clip, "clip");
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextVerticalOverflowType.Overflow, "overflow");
			dictionary.Add(DrawingTextVerticalOverflowType.Ellipsis, "ellipsis");
			return dictionary;
		}

	public abstract class PictureImporterOptions : IImporterOptions, ISupportsCopyFrom<IImporterOptions>
	{
		private string sourceUri;

		public string SourceUri
		{
			get
			{
				return sourceUri;
			}
			set
			{
				sourceUri = value;
			}
		}

		protected PictureImporterOptions()
		{
			sourceUri = string.Empty;
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(IImporterOptions value)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class PictureImporter : IImporter<OfficeImageFormat, OfficeImage>
	{

		public abstract OfficeImageFormat Format { get; }

		public abstract IImporterOptions SetupLoading();

		public virtual OfficeImage LoadDocument(IDocumentModel documentModel, Stream stream, IImporterOptions options)
		{
			return LoadDocument(documentModel, stream, options, leaveOpen: true);
		}

		public virtual OfficeImage LoadDocument(IDocumentModel documentModel, Stream stream, IImporterOptions options, bool leaveOpen)
		{
			return documentModel.CreateImage(stream);
		}
	}

	public interface IDocumentSaveOptions<TFormat>
	{
		string DefaultFileName { get; set; }

		string CurrentFileName { get; set; }

		TFormat DefaultFormat { get; set; }

		TFormat CurrentFormat { get; set; }
	}
	public delegate List<IExporter<TFormat, TResult>> ExportersCalculator<TFormat, TResult>(IExportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> exportManagerService);
	public abstract class ExportHelper<TFormat, TResult> : ImportExportHelper, IDisposable
	{
		protected ExportHelper(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
		}

		public TResult Export(Stream stream, TFormat format, string targetUri, IExportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> exportManagerService)
		{
			return Export(stream, format, targetUri, exportManagerService, null);
		}

		public TResult Export(Stream stream, TFormat format, string targetUri, IExportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> exportManagerService, Encoding encoding)
		{
			ExportParameters<TFormat, TResult> exportParameters = new ExportParameters<TFormat, TResult>(format, targetUri, encoding);
			exportParameters.ExportManagerService = exportManagerService;
			return Export(stream, exportParameters);
		}

		public TResult Export(Stream stream, ExportParameters<TFormat, TResult> parameters)
		{
			IExporter<TFormat, TResult> exporter = parameters.ExportManagerService.GetExporter(parameters.DocumentFormat);
			if (exporter == null)
			{
				ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			IExporterOptions exporterOptions = exporter.SetupSaving();
			IExporterOptions predefinedOptions = GetPredefinedOptions(parameters.DocumentFormat);
			if (predefinedOptions != null)
			{
				((ISupportsCopyFrom<IExporterOptions>)exporterOptions).CopyFrom(predefinedOptions);
			}
			exporterOptions.TargetUri = parameters.TargetUri;
			ApplyParameters(exporterOptions, parameters);
			PreprocessContentBeforeExport(parameters.DocumentFormat);
			return exporter.SaveDocument(base.DocumentModel, stream, exporterOptions);
		}

		public ExportTarget<TFormat, TResult> InvokeExportDialog(object parent, IExportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> exportManagerService)
		{
			return InvokeExportDialog(parent, exportManagerService, null);
		}

		public ExportTarget<TFormat, TResult> InvokeExportDialog(object parent, IExportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> exportManagerService, ExportersCalculator<TFormat, TResult> exportersCollector)
		{
			return InvokeExportDialog(parent, exportManagerService, exportersCollector, null);
		}

		public ExportTarget<TFormat, TResult> InvokeExportDialog(object parent, IExportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> exportManagerService, ExportersCalculator<TFormat, TResult> exportersCollector, IDocumentSaveOptions<TFormat> options)
		{
			if (exportManagerService == null)
			{
				ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			List<IExporter<TFormat, TResult>> list = ((exportersCollector != null) ? exportersCollector(exportManagerService) : exportManagerService.GetExporters());
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			FileDialogFilterCollection filters = CreateExportFilters(list);
			int currentFilterIndex = CalculateCurrentFilterIndex(list, options);
			if (!ShowSaveFileDialog(filters, parent, options, currentFilterIndex))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IExporter<TFormat, TResult> exporter = ChooseExporter(base.FileName, base.FilterIndex, list);
			if (exporter == null)
			{
				ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			return new ExportTarget<TFormat, TResult>(base.FileName, exporter);
		}

		protected virtual bool ShowSaveFileDialog(FileDialogFilterCollection filters, object parent, IDocumentSaveOptions<TFormat> options, int currentFilterIndex)
		{
			ISaveFileDialog val = ((base.DialogProviderService != null) ? base.DialogProviderService.CreateDefaultSaveFileDialog() : PlatformServices.Instance.Factory.CreateSaveFileDialog());
			InitializeSaveFileDialog(val, filters, currentFilterIndex, options);
			bool flag = ShowSaveFileDialog(val, parent);
			if (flag)
			{
				ApplyFileDialogSettings(((IFileDialog)val).FileName, ((IFileDialog)val).FilterIndex - 1);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShowSaveFileDialog(ISaveFileDialog dialog, object parent)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)((ICommonDialog)dialog).ShowDialog(parent) == 1;
		}

		protected internal virtual ISaveFileDialog CreateSaveFileDialog(FileDialogFilterCollection filters, int currentFilterIndex)
		{
			return CreateSaveFileDialog(filters, currentFilterIndex, null);
		}

		internal virtual ISaveFileDialog CreateSaveFileDialog(FileDialogFilterCollection filters, int currentFilterIndex, IDocumentSaveOptions<TFormat> options)
		{
			ISaveFileDialog val = PlatformServices.Instance.Factory.CreateSaveFileDialog();
			InitializeSaveFileDialog(val, filters, currentFilterIndex);
			return val;
		}

		protected internal virtual void InitializeSaveFileDialog(ISaveFileDialog dialog, FileDialogFilterCollection filters, int currentFilterIndex)
		{
			InitializeSaveFileDialog(dialog, filters, currentFilterIndex, null);
		}

		protected internal virtual void InitializeSaveFileDialog(ISaveFileDialog dialog, FileDialogFilterCollection filters, int currentFilterIndex, IDocumentSaveOptions<TFormat> options)
		{
			((IFileDialog)dialog).Filter = CreateFilterString(filters);
			((IFileDialog)dialog).RestoreDirectory = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).CheckFileExists = false;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).CheckPathExists = true;
			dialog.OverwritePrompt = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).DereferenceLinks = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).ValidateNames = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).AddExtension = false;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).FilterIndex = 1;
			if (filters.Count > 0 && currentFilterIndex < filters.Count)
			{
				((IFileDialog)dialog).FilterIndex = 1 + currentFilterIndex;
				if (filters[currentFilterIndex].Extensions.Count > 0)
				{
					((IFileDialog)dialog).DefaultExt = filters[currentFilterIndex].Extensions[0];
					((IFileDialog)dialog).AddExtension = true;
				}
			}
			string fileName = ((options != null) ? GetFileNameForSaving(options) : GetFileNameForSaving());
			string directoryName = GetDirectoryName(fileName);
			fileName = GetFileName(fileName);
			SetFileName(dialog, fileName);
			SetDirectoryName(dialog, directoryName);
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetFileName(string fileName)
		{
			fileName = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(fileName);
			return fileName;
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetDirectoryName(string fileName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string directoryName = Path.GetDirectoryName(fileName);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(directoryName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return Path.GetFullPath(Path.GetDirectoryName(fileName));
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetFileNameForSaving(IDocumentSaveOptions<TFormat> options)
		{
			return GetFileNameForSaving();
		}

		protected internal abstract string GetFileNameForSaving();

		protected IExporter<TFormat, TResult> ChooseExporter(string fileName, int filterIndex, List<IExporter<TFormat, TResult>> exporters)
		{
			IExporter<TFormat, TResult> exporter = ChooseExporterByFileName(fileName, exporters);
			if (exporter == null)
			{
				exporter = ChooseExporterByFilterIndex(filterIndex, exporters);
			}
			return exporter;
		}

		protected IExporter<TFormat, TResult> ChooseExporterByFileName(string fileName, List<IExporter<TFormat, TResult>> exporters)
		{
			string text = Path.GetExtension(fileName).TrimStart('.').ToLower();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = 0;
			IExporter<TFormat, TResult> result = null;
			int count = exporters.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FileExtensionCollection extensions = exporters[i].Filter.Extensions;
				if (extensions.IndexOf(text) >= 0)
				{
					result = exporters[i];
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (num == 1)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected IExporter<TFormat, TResult> ChooseExporterByFilterIndex(int filterIndex, List<IExporter<TFormat, TResult>> exporters)
		{
			if (filterIndex >= 0 && filterIndex < exporters.Count)
			{
				return exporters[filterIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual FileDialogFilterCollection CreateExportFilters(List<IExporter<TFormat, TResult>> exporters)
		{
			FileDialogFilterCollection fileDialogFilterCollection = new FileDialogFilterCollection();
			int count = exporters.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FileDialogFilter filter = exporters[i].Filter;
				if (filter.Extensions.Count > 0)
				{
					fileDialogFilterCollection.Add(filter);
				}
			}
			return fileDialogFilterCollection;
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalculateCurrentFilterIndex(List<IExporter<TFormat, TResult>> exporters)
		{
			return CalculateCurrentFilterIndex(exporters, null);
		}

		internal virtual int CalculateCurrentFilterIndex(List<IExporter<TFormat, TResult>> exporters, IDocumentSaveOptions<TFormat> options)
		{
			TFormat val = ((options != null) ? GetCurrentDocumentFormat(options) : GetCurrentDocumentFormat());
			int count = exporters.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (object.Equals(exporters[i].Format, val))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected internal virtual TFormat GetCurrentDocumentFormat(IDocumentSaveOptions<TFormat> options)
		{
			return GetCurrentDocumentFormat();
		}

		protected internal abstract TFormat GetCurrentDocumentFormat();

		private void SetFileName(ISaveFileDialog dialog, string fileName)
		{
			((IFileDialog)dialog).FileName = fileName;
		}

		private void SetDirectoryName(ISaveFileDialog dialog, string directoryName)
		{
			((IFileDialog)dialog).InitialDirectory = directoryName;
		}

		protected internal abstract IExporterOptions GetPredefinedOptions(TFormat format);

		protected internal abstract void PreprocessContentBeforeExport(TFormat format);

		protected internal abstract void ApplyParameters(IExporterOptions options, ExportParameters<TFormat, TResult> parameters);

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
		}
	}
	public class ExportParameters<TFormat, TResult>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<Type, object> container = new Dictionary<Type, object>();

		public string TargetUri { get; private set; }

		public IExportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> ExportManagerService { get; set; }

		public Encoding Encoding { get; private set; }

		public ExportParameters(TFormat documentFormat, string targetUri, Encoding encoding)
		{
			DocumentFormat = documentFormat;
			TargetUri = targetUri;
			Encoding = encoding;
		}

		public T GetParameter<T>()
		{
			if (!container.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out var value))
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			return (T)value;
		}

		public void AddParameter<T>(T parameter)
		{
			container.Add(parameter.GetType(), parameter);
		}

		public void AddParameter<T>(Type type, T parameter)
		{
			container.Add(type, parameter);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ImportHelper<TFormat, TResult> : ImportExportHelper
	{
		protected internal abstract TFormat UndefinedFormat { get; }

		protected internal abstract TFormat FallbackFormat { get; }

		protected ImportHelper(IDocumentModel documentModel)
			: base(documentModel)
		{
		}

		public TResult Import(Stream stream, TFormat format, string sourceUri, IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService)
		{
			return Import(stream, format, sourceUri, importManagerService, leaveOpen: true);
		}

		public TResult Import(Stream stream, TFormat format, string sourceUri, IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService, bool leaveOpen)
		{
			return Import(stream, format, sourceUri, importManagerService, null, leaveOpen);
		}

		public TResult Import(Stream stream, TFormat format, string sourceUri, IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService, Encoding encoding)
		{
			return Import(stream, format, sourceUri, importManagerService, encoding, leaveOpen: true);
		}

		public TResult Import(Stream stream, TFormat format, string sourceUri, IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService, Encoding encoding, bool leaveOpen)
		{
			IImporter<TFormat, TResult> importer = importManagerService.GetImporter(format);
			return Import(stream, sourceUri, importer, encoding, leaveOpen);
		}

		public TResult Import(Stream stream, string sourceUri, IImporter<TFormat, TResult> importer, Encoding encoding)
		{
			return Import(stream, sourceUri, importer, encoding, leaveOpen: true);
		}

		public TResult Import(Stream stream, string sourceUri, IImporter<TFormat, TResult> importer, Encoding encoding, bool leaveOpen)
		{
			if (importer == null)
			{
				ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			IImporterOptions importerOptions = importer.SetupLoading();
			IImporterOptions predefinedOptions = GetPredefinedOptions(importer.Format);
			if (predefinedOptions != null)
			{
				((ISupportsCopyFrom<IImporterOptions>)importerOptions).CopyFrom(predefinedOptions);
			}
			importerOptions.SourceUri = sourceUri;
			if (encoding != null)
			{
				ApplyEncoding(importerOptions, encoding);
			}
			return importer.LoadDocument(base.DocumentModel, stream, importerOptions, leaveOpen);
		}

		public IImporter<TFormat, TResult> AutodetectImporter(string fileName, IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService)
		{
			return AutodetectImporter(fileName, importManagerService, useFormatFallback: true);
		}

		public IImporter<TFormat, TResult> AutodetectImporter(string fileName, IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService, bool useFormatFallback)
		{
			List<IImporter<TFormat, TResult>> importers = importManagerService.GetImporters();
			if (importers.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ChooseImporter(fileName, -1, importers, useFormatFallback);
		}

		public TResult ImportFromFileAutodetectFormat(string fileName, IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService)
		{
			IImporter<TFormat, TResult> importer = AutodetectImporter(fileName, importManagerService);
			if (importer == null)
			{
				return default(TResult);
			}
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite);
			return Import(stream, importer.Format, fileName, importManagerService);
		}

		public ImportSource<TFormat, TResult> InvokeImportDialog(object parent, IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService)
		{
			if (importManagerService == null)
			{
				ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			List<IImporter<TFormat, TResult>> importers = importManagerService.GetImporters();
			if (importers.Count <= 0)
			{
				ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			FileDialogFilterCollection filters = CreateImportFilters(GetLoadDocumentDialogFileFilters(importManagerService));
			if (!ShowOpenFileDialog(filters, parent))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IImporter<TFormat, TResult> importer = ChooseImporter(base.FileName, base.FilterIndex, importers, useFormatFallback: true);
			if (importer == null)
			{
				ThrowUnsupportedFormatException();
			}
			return new ImportSource<TFormat, TResult>(base.FileName, base.FileName, importer);
		}

		protected virtual bool ShowOpenFileDialog(FileDialogFilterCollection filters, object parent)
		{
			IOpenFileDialog val = ((base.DialogProviderService != null) ? base.DialogProviderService.CreateDefaultOpenFileDialog() : PlatformServices.Instance.Factory.CreateOpenFileDialog());
			InitializeOpenFileDialog(val, filters);
			bool flag = ShowOpenFileDialog(val, parent);
			if (flag)
			{
				ApplyFileDialogSettings(((IFileDialog)val).FileName, ((IFileDialog)val).FilterIndex - 1);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShowOpenFileDialog(IOpenFileDialog dialog, object parent)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)((ICommonDialog)dialog).ShowDialog(parent) == 1;
		}

		protected internal virtual FileDialogFilterCollection GetLoadDocumentDialogFileFilters(IImportManagerService<TFormat, TResult> importManagerService)
		{
			List<IImporter<TFormat, TResult>> importers = importManagerService.GetImporters();
			FileDialogFilterCollection fileDialogFilterCollection = new FileDialogFilterCollection();
			foreach (IImporter<TFormat, TResult> item in importers)
			{
				fileDialogFilterCollection.Add(item.Filter);
			}
			return fileDialogFilterCollection;
		}

		protected internal IImporter<TFormat, TResult> ChooseImporter(string fileName, int filterIndex, List<IImporter<TFormat, TResult>> importers, bool useFormatFallback)
		{
			IImporter<TFormat, TResult> importer = ChooseImporterByFileName(fileName, importers);
			if (importer == null)
			{
				importer = ChooseImporterByFilterIndex(filterIndex, importers);
			}
			if (importer == null)
			{
				TFormat format = (useFormatFallback ? FallbackFormat : UndefinedFormat);
				importer = ChooseImporterByFormat(format, importers);
			}
			return importer;
		}

		protected IImporter<TFormat, TResult> ChooseImporterByFileName(string fileName, List<IImporter<TFormat, TResult>> importers)
		{
			string text = Path.GetExtension(fileName).TrimStart('.').ToLower();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = importers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FileExtensionCollection extensions = importers[i].Filter.Extensions;
				if (extensions.IndexOf(text) >= 0)
				{
					return importers[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected IImporter<TFormat, TResult> ChooseImporterByFormat(TFormat format, List<IImporter<TFormat, TResult>> importers)
		{
			object obj = UndefinedFormat;
			if (format.Equals(obj))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = importers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				object obj2 = importers[i].Format;
				if (format.Equals(obj2))
				{
					return importers[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected IImporter<TFormat, TResult> ChooseImporterByFilterIndex(int filterIndex, List<IImporter<TFormat, TResult>> importers)
		{
			if (filterIndex >= 0 && filterIndex < importers.Count)
			{
				return importers[filterIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual IOpenFileDialog CreateOpenFileDialog(FileDialogFilterCollection filters)
		{
			IOpenFileDialog val = PlatformServices.Instance.Factory.CreateOpenFileDialog();
			InitializeOpenFileDialog(val, filters);
			return val;
		}

		protected internal virtual void InitializeOpenFileDialog(IOpenFileDialog dialog, FileDialogFilterCollection filters)
		{
			((IFileDialog)dialog).Filter = CreateFilterString(filters);
			((IFileDialog)dialog).FilterIndex = 2;
			dialog.Multiselect = false;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).RestoreDirectory = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).CheckFileExists = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).CheckPathExists = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).SupportMultiDottedExtensions = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).AddExtension = false;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).DereferenceLinks = true;
			((IFileDialog)dialog).ValidateNames = true;
		}

		protected internal virtual FileDialogFilterCollection CreateImportFilters(FileDialogFilterCollection filters)
		{
			FileDialogFilter fileDialogFilter = new FileDialogFilter();
			fileDialogFilter.Description = OfficeLocalizer.GetString(OfficeStringId.FileFilterDescription_AllSupportedFiles);
			FileDialogFilterCollection fileDialogFilterCollection = new FileDialogFilterCollection();
			fileDialogFilterCollection.Add(FileDialogFilter.AllFiles);
			fileDialogFilterCollection.Add(fileDialogFilter);
			int count = filters.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FileDialogFilter fileDialogFilter2 = filters[i];
				if (fileDialogFilter2.Extensions.Count > 0)
				{
					fileDialogFilterCollection.Add(fileDialogFilter2);
					fileDialogFilter.Extensions.AddRange(fileDialogFilter2.Extensions);
				}
			}
			return fileDialogFilterCollection;
		}

		protected internal abstract IImporterOptions GetPredefinedOptions(TFormat format);

		protected internal abstract void ApplyEncoding(IImporterOptions options, Encoding encoding);
	}

	public class PreprocessedStream
	{
		private const int maxSignatureLength = 8;

		private static readonly byte[] zipSignature = new byte[2] { 80, 75 };

		private byte[] buffer;

		private InternalZipFileCollection zipFiles;

		private readonly Stream stream;

		public byte[] Buffer => buffer;

		public InternalZipFileCollection ZipFiles => zipFiles;

		public Stream Stream => stream;

		public PreprocessedStream(Stream stream)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
		}

		public void Process()
		{
			PrepareBuffer();
			PrepareZipFiles();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			PrepareZipFiles();
			Stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
		}

		public bool ValidateStream()
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (stream.Length == 0L || !stream.CanSeek)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void PrepareBuffer()
		{
			buffer = GetSignatureBuffer();
		}

		private void PrepareZipFiles()
		{
			if (CheckSignature(zipSignature))
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				zipFiles = InternalZipArchive.Open(Stream);
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
		}

		private byte[] GetSignatureBuffer()
		{
			Stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			StreamHelper.FillBuffer(Stream, array, 0, array.Length);
			Stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return array;
		}

		public bool CheckSignature(byte[] signature)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < signature.Length; i++)
			{
				if (buffer[i] != signature[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public string ReadEntryContent(InternalZipFile entry, Encoding encoding)
		{
			using (entry.CreateDecompressionStream())
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[Math.Min(1024L, entry.UncompressedSize)];
				int num = StreamHelper.FillBuffer(entry.FileDataStream, array, 0, array.Length);
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return encoding.GetString(array, 0, num);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ScrollBarAdapter : IScrollBarAdapter, IBatchUpdateable, IBatchUpdateHandler
	{
		private readonly IOfficeScrollbar scrollBar;

		private readonly BatchUpdateHelper batchUpdateHelper;

		private readonly IPlatformSpecificScrollBarAdapter adapter;

		private double factor = 1.0;

		private long minimum;

		private long maximum;

		private long val;

		private long largeChange;

		private bool enabled;

		private PortableScrollEventHandler onScroll;

		public double Factor
		{
			get
			{
				return factor;
			}
			set
			{
				factor = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract bool DeferredScrollBarUpdate { get; }

		protected internal abstract bool Synchronized { get; set; }

		public long Minimum
		{
			get
			{
				return minimum;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!minimum.Equals(value))
				{
					minimum = value;
					ValidateValues();
				}
			}
		}

		public long Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				return maximum;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!maximum.Equals(value))
				{
					maximum = value;
					ValidateValues();
				}
			}
		}

		public long Value
		{
			get
			{
				return val;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!val.Equals(value))
				{
					val = value;
					ValidateValues();
				}
			}
		}

		public long LargeChange
		{
			get
			{
				return largeChange;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!largeChange.Equals(value))
				{
					largeChange = value;
					ValidateValues();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				enabled = value;
			}
		}

		public IOfficeScrollbar ScrollBar => scrollBar;

		protected internal IPlatformSpecificScrollBarAdapter Adapter => adapter;

		BatchUpdateHelper IBatchUpdateable.BatchUpdateHelper => batchUpdateHelper;

		public bool IsUpdateLocked => batchUpdateHelper.IsUpdateLocked;

		public event PortableScrollEventHandler Scroll
		{
			add
			{
				//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
				onScroll = (PortableScrollEventHandler)Delegate.Combine((Delegate)(object)onScroll, (Delegate)(object)value);
			}
			remove
			{
				//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
				onScroll = (PortableScrollEventHandler)Delegate.Remove((Delegate)(object)onScroll, (Delegate)(object)value);
			}
		}

		protected ScrollBarAdapter(IOfficeScrollbar scrollBar, IPlatformSpecificScrollBarAdapter adapter)
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)scrollBar, "scrollBar");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)adapter, "adapter");
			this.scrollBar = scrollBar;
			this.adapter = adapter;
			batchUpdateHelper = new BatchUpdateHelper((IBatchUpdateHandler)(object)this);
		}

		public virtual void RaiseScroll(PortableScrollEventArgs args)
		{
			if (onScroll != null)
			{
				onScroll.Invoke((object)ScrollBar, args);
			}
		}

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.BeginUpdate();
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.EndUpdate();
		}

		public void CancelUpdate()
		{
			batchUpdateHelper.CancelUpdate();

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnFirstBeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnBeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnEndUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnLastEndUpdate()
		{
			OnLastEndUpdateCore();
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnCancelUpdate()
		{
		}

		void IBatchUpdateHandler.OnLastCancelUpdate()
		{
			OnLastEndUpdateCore();

		public virtual void Activate()
		{
			RefreshValuesFromScrollBar();
			SubscribeScrollbarEvents();
		}

		public virtual void Deactivate()
		{
			UnsubscribeScrollbarEvents();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnLastEndUpdateCore()
		{
			ValidateValues();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ValidateValues()
		{
			if (!IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				ValidateValuesCore();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ValidateValuesCore()
		{
			if (LargeChange < 0)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("LargeChange", LargeChange);
			}
			if (Minimum > Maximum)
			{
				maximum = Minimum;
			}
			largeChange = Math.Min(LargeChange, Maximum - Minimum + 1);
			val = Math.Max(Value, Minimum);
			val = Math.Min(Value, Maximum - LargeChange + 1);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SubscribeScrollbarEvents()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ScrollBar.Scroll += new PortableScrollEventHandler(OnScroll);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnsubscribeScrollbarEvents()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ScrollBar.Scroll -= new PortableScrollEventHandler(OnScroll);
		}

		public virtual bool SynchronizeScrollBarAvoidJump()
		{
			if (ShouldSynchronize())
			{
				double num = (float)Value / Math.Max(1f, Maximum - LargeChange + 1 - Minimum);
				double num2 = (double)ScrollBar.Value / Math.Max(1.0, ScrollBar.Maximum - ScrollBar.LargeChange + 1 - ScrollBar.Minimum);
				if (num <= num2)
				{
					ApplyValuesToScrollBarCore();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool EnsureSynchronizedCore()
		{
			if (ShouldSynchronize())
			{
				ApplyValuesToScrollBarCore();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void EnsureSynchronized()
		{
			EnsureSynchronizedCore();
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldSynchronize()
		{
			if (DeferredScrollBarUpdate)
			{
				return !Synchronized;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnScroll(object sender, PortableScrollEventArgs e)
		{
			Adapter.OnScroll(this, sender, e);
		}

		public virtual void ApplyValuesToScrollBar()
		{
			if (DeferredScrollBarUpdate)
			{
				Synchronized = false;
			}
			else
			{
				ApplyValuesToScrollBarCore();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ApplyValuesToScrollBarCore()
		{
			Adapter.ApplyValuesToScrollBarCore(this);
			Synchronized = true;
		}

		public virtual void RefreshValuesFromScrollBar()
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				Minimum = (long)Math.Round((double)ScrollBar.Minimum / Factor);
				Maximum = (long)Math.Round((double)ScrollBar.Maximum / Factor);
				LargeChange = (long)Math.Round((double)ScrollBar.LargeChange / Factor);
				Value = (long)Math.Round((double)ScrollBar.Value / Factor);
				Enabled = ScrollBar.Enabled;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
			Synchronized = true;
		}

		public virtual PortableScrollEventArgs CreateEmulatedScrollEventArgs(PortableScrollEventType eventType)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			EnsureSynchronized();
			if ((int)eventType <= 1)
			{
				if ((int)eventType == 0)
				{
					return new PortableScrollEventArgs(eventType, ScrollBar.Value - ScrollBar.SmallChange);
				}
				if ((int)eventType == 1)
				{
					return new PortableScrollEventArgs(eventType, ScrollBar.Value + ScrollBar.SmallChange);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if ((int)eventType == 6)
				{
					return new PortableScrollEventArgs(eventType, ScrollBar.Minimum);
				}
				if ((int)eventType == 7)
				{
					return adapter.CreateLastScrollEventArgs(this);
				}
			}
			Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			return null;
		}

		public int GetRawScrollBarValue()
		{
			EnsureSynchronized();
			return Adapter.GetRawScrollBarValue(this);
		}

		public bool SetRawScrollBarValue(int value)
		{
			return Adapter.SetRawScrollBarValue(this, value);
		}

		public virtual int GetPageUpRawScrollBarValue()
		{
			EnsureSynchronized();
			return Adapter.GetPageUpRawScrollBarValue(this);
		}

		public virtual int GetPageDownRawScrollBarValue()
		{
			EnsureSynchronized();
			return Adapter.GetPageDownRawScrollBarValue(this);
		}

	public abstract class OfficeScrollControllerBase
	{
		private IScrollBarAdapter scrollBarAdapter;

		protected internal virtual bool SupportsDeferredUpdate => false;

		public virtual IScrollBarAdapter ScrollBarAdapter => scrollBarAdapter;

		public abstract IOfficeScrollbar ScrollBar { get; }

		protected internal virtual void Initialize()
		{
			scrollBarAdapter = CreateScrollBarAdapter();
			ScrollBarAdapter.RefreshValuesFromScrollBar();
		}

		public virtual void Activate()
		{
			ScrollBarAdapter.Activate();
			SubscribeScrollBarAdapterEvents();
		}

		public virtual void Deactivate()
		{
			ScrollBarAdapter.Deactivate();
			UnsubscribeScrollBarAdapterEvents();
		}

		protected abstract ScrollBarAdapter CreateScrollBarAdapter();

		protected internal virtual void SubscribeScrollBarAdapterEvents()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ScrollBarAdapter.Scroll += new PortableScrollEventHandler(OnScroll);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnsubscribeScrollBarAdapterEvents()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ScrollBarAdapter.Scroll -= new PortableScrollEventHandler(OnScroll);
		}

		protected internal void EmulateScroll(PortableScrollEventType eventType)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PortableScrollEventArgs e = ScrollBarAdapter.CreateEmulatedScrollEventArgs(eventType);
			OnScroll(ScrollBar, e);
		}

		protected abstract void OnScroll(object sender, PortableScrollEventArgs e);

		protected internal virtual void SynchronizeScrollbar()
		{
			UnsubscribeScrollBarAdapterEvents();
			try
			{
				ScrollBarAdapter.ApplyValuesToScrollBar();
			}
			finally
			{
				SubscribeScrollBarAdapterEvents();
			}
		}

		public virtual void UpdateScrollBar()
		{
			if (ScrollBar != null)
			{
				UpdateScrollBarAdapter();
				SynchronizeScrollbar();
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsScrollPossible()
		{
			if (ScrollBarAdapter.Maximum - ScrollBarAdapter.Minimum > ScrollBarAdapter.LargeChange && ScrollBarAdapter.Value >= ScrollBarAdapter.Minimum)
			{
				return ScrollBarAdapter.Value <= ScrollBarAdapter.Maximum - ScrollBarAdapter.LargeChange + 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateScrollBarAdapter();
	}

	public class FileDialogFilter
	{
		internal static readonly FileDialogFilter AllFiles = new FileDialogFilter(OfficeLocalizer.GetString(OfficeStringId.FileFilterDescription_AllFiles), "*");

		internal static readonly FileDialogFilter Empty = new FileDialogFilter(string.Empty, new string[0]);

		private string description = string.Empty;

		private FileExtensionCollection extensions = new FileExtensionCollection();

		public string Description
		{
			get
			{
				return description;
			}
			set
			{
				description = value;
			}
		}

		public FileExtensionCollection Extensions => extensions;

		public FileDialogFilter()
		{
		}

		public FileDialogFilter(string description, string extension)
			: this(description, new string[1] { extension })
		{
		}

		public FileDialogFilter(string description, string[] extensions)
		{
			this.description = description;
			this.extensions.AddRange(extensions);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (extensions.Count <= 0)
			{
				return AllFiles.ToString();
			}
			return CreateFilterString();
		}

		protected internal virtual string CreateFilterString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(Description);
			stringBuilder.Append(" (");
			AppendExtensions(stringBuilder);
			stringBuilder.Append(")|");
			AppendExtensions(stringBuilder);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected internal virtual void AppendExtensions(StringBuilder sb)
		{
			AppendExtension(sb, extensions[0]);
			int count = extensions.Count;
			for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				sb.Append("; ");
				AppendExtension(sb, extensions[i]);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void AppendExtension(StringBuilder sb, string extension)
		{
			sb.Append("*.");
			sb.Append(extension);
		}
	}
	public class FileDialogFilterCollection : List<FileDialogFilter>
	{
		public string CreateFilterString()
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(base[0].ToString());
			for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append('|');
				stringBuilder.Append(base[i].ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public static class OfficeFontSizeEditHelper
	{
		public static bool TryGetValue(object editValue, out int value)
		{
			value = 0;
			if (editValue is int)
			{
				value = (int)editValue;
				return true;
			}
			string text = editValue as string;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && int.TryParse(text, out value))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryGetHalfSizeValue(object editValue, out int value)
		{
			value = 0;
			if (editValue is int)
			{
				value = (int)editValue * 2;
				return true;
			}
			float result = 0f;
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (editValue is float)
			{
				result = (float)editValue;
			}
			else
			{
				text = editValue as string;
			}
			if ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && float.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result)) || result > 0f)
			{
				if (result * 10f % 5f == 0f)
				{
					value = (int)(result * 2f);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsValidFontSize(int fontSize)
		{
			if (fontSize >= 1)
			{
				return fontSize <= 1500;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class ContentTypeTable
	{
		private Dictionary<string, string> contentTypeByExtension = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);

		private Dictionary<string, string> contentTypeByFileName = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);

		internal Dictionary<string, string> ContentTypeByExtension => contentTypeByExtension;

		internal Dictionary<string, string> ContentTypeByFileName => contentTypeByFileName;

		public void AddContentTypeDefault(string fileExtension, string contentType)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileExtension))
			{
				contentTypeByExtension[fileExtension] = contentType;
			}
		}

		public void AddContentTypeOverride(string fileName, string contentType)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				if (fileName[0] != '/')
				{
					fileName = "/" + fileName;
				}
				contentTypeByFileName[fileName] = contentType;
			}
		}

		public string GetContentType(string fileName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (fileName[0] != '/')
			{
				fileName = "/" + fileName;
			}
			if (contentTypeByFileName.TryGetValue(fileName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			string text = Path.GetExtension(fileName);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text[0] == '.')
			{
				text = text.Substring(1);
			}
			if (contentTypeByExtension.TryGetValue(text, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

	public class AdjustableCoordinateCache : Dictionary<string, AdjustableCoordinate>
	{
		public AdjustableCoordinate GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(value);
				if (value2 != null)
				{
					Add(value, value2);
				}
			}
			return value2;
		}
	}
	public class AdjustableAngleCache : Dictionary<string, AdjustableAngle>
	{
		public AdjustableAngle GetCachedAdjustableAngle(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = AdjustableAngle.FromString(value);
				if (value2 != null)
				{
					Add(value, value2);
				}
			}
			return value2;
		}
	}
	public class CustomGeometryDestination : ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>

		private readonly AdjustableAngleCache adjustableAngleCache;

		private static ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> CreateElementHandlerTable()
		{

			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("avLst", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnAdjustValuesList);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("gdLst", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnGuidesList);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("ahLst", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnAdjustHandlesList);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("cxnLst", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnConnectionSitesList);

	public class ModelShapePathDestination : ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<PathFillMode, string> pathFillModeTable = GetPathFillModeTable();

		private static readonly ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> handlerTable = CreateElementHandlerTable();

		private readonly ModelShapePath modelShapePath;

		private readonly AdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache;

		private readonly AdjustableAngleCache adjustableAngleCache;

		protected override ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> ElementHandlerTable => handlerTable;

		private static Dictionary<PathFillMode, string> GetPathFillModeTable()
		{
			Dictionary<PathFillMode, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<PathFillMode, string>();
			dictionary.Add(PathFillMode.None, "none");
			dictionary.Add(PathFillMode.Norm, "norm");
			dictionary.Add(PathFillMode.Lighten, "lighten");
			dictionary.Add(PathFillMode.LightenLess, "lightenLess");
			dictionary.Add(PathFillMode.Darken, "darken");
			dictionary.Add(PathFillMode.DarkenLess, "darkenLess");
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> CreateElementHandlerTable()
		{
			ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> val = new ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>();
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("close", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnClose);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("moveTo", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnMoveTo);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("lnTo", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnLineTo);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("arcTo", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnArcTo);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("quadBezTo", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnQuadraticBezierTo);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("cubicBezTo", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnCubicBezierTo);
			return val;
		}

		public ModelShapePathDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, ModelShapePath modelShapePath, AdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache, AdjustableAngleCache adjustableAngleCache)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.modelShapePath = modelShapePath;
			this.adjustableCoordinateCache = adjustableCoordinateCache;
			this.adjustableAngleCache = adjustableAngleCache;
		}

		private static Destination OnClose(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			PathClose item = new PathClose();
			GetThis(importer).modelShapePath.Instructions.Add(item);
			return (Destination)(object)new EmptyDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>(importer);
		}

		private static Destination OnMoveTo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			PathMove pathMove = new PathMove();
			GetThis(importer).modelShapePath.Instructions.Add(pathMove);
			return (Destination)(object)new PathMoveDestination(importer, pathMove, GetThis(importer).adjustableCoordinateCache);
		}

		private static Destination OnLineTo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			PathLine pathLine = new PathLine();
			GetThis(importer).modelShapePath.Instructions.Add(pathLine);
			return (Destination)(object)new PathLineDestination(importer, pathLine, GetThis(importer).adjustableCoordinateCache);
		}

		private static Destination OnArcTo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			PathArc pathArc = new PathArc();
			GetThis(importer).modelShapePath.Instructions.Add(pathArc);
			return (Destination)(object)new PathArcDestination(importer, pathArc, GetThis(importer).adjustableCoordinateCache, GetThis(importer).adjustableAngleCache);
		}

		private static Destination OnQuadraticBezierTo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			PathQuadraticBezier pathQuadraticBezier = new PathQuadraticBezier(importer.DocumentModel.MainPart);
			GetThis(importer).modelShapePath.Instructions.Add(pathQuadraticBezier);

		private static Destination OnCubicBezierTo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			PathCubicBezier pathCubicBezier = new PathCubicBezier(importer.DocumentModel.MainPart);
			GetThis(importer).modelShapePath.Instructions.Add(pathCubicBezier);
			return (Destination)(object)new PathCubicBezierDestination(importer, pathCubicBezier, GetThis(importer).adjustableCoordinateCache);
		}

		private static ModelShapePathDestination GetThis(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer)
		{
			return (ModelShapePathDestination)(object)importer.PeekDestination();
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			modelShapePath.Width = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetLongValue(reader, "w", 0L);
			if (modelShapePath.Width < 0)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			modelShapePath.Height = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetLongValue(reader, "h", 0L);
			if (modelShapePath.Height < 0)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			modelShapePath.FillMode = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "fill", pathFillModeTable, PathFillMode.Norm);
			modelShapePath.Stroke = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpSTOnOffValue(reader, "stroke", defaultValue: true);
			modelShapePath.ExtrusionOK = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpSTOnOffValue(reader, "extrusionOk", defaultValue: true);
		}
	}

			pathArc.SwingAngle = adjustableAngleCache.GetCachedAdjustableAngle(reader.GetAttribute("swAng"));

			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
		}
	}

	public class ModelShapeGuideDestination : LeafElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private readonly ModelShapeGuide modelShapeGuide;

		private readonly AdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache;

		public ModelShapeGuideDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, ModelShapeGuide modelShapeGuide, AdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.modelShapeGuide = modelShapeGuide;
			this.adjustableCoordinateCache = adjustableCoordinateCache;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			string attribute = reader.GetAttribute("fmla");
			string attribute2 = reader.GetAttribute("name");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute2))
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			modelShapeGuide.Formula = CreateModelShapeGuideFormula(attribute, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			modelShapeGuide.Name = attribute2;
		}

		private static ModelShapeGuideFormula CreateModelShapeGuideFormula(string formula, AdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formula))
			{
				return ModelShapeGuideFormula.Empty;
			}
			string[] array = formula.Split(" ".ToCharArray(), StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return ModelShapeGuideFormula.Empty;
			}
			string value = array[0];
			string value2 = ((array.Length >= 2) ? array[1] : string.Empty);
			string value3 = ((array.Length >= 3) ? array[2] : string.Empty);
			string value4 = ((array.Length >= 4) ? array[3] : string.Empty);
			ModelShapeGuideFormulaType formulaTypeFromString = ModelShapeGuideFormula.GetFormulaTypeFromString(value);
			return new ModelShapeGuideFormula(formulaTypeFromString, adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(value2), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(value3), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(value4));
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{

					}
				}
				return tileAlignTable;
			}
		}

			fill.ScaleY = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "sy", 0);

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			blip.CompressionState = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "cstate", OpenXmlExporterBase.CompressionStateTable, CompressionState.None);
			string attribute = reader.GetAttribute("embed", ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.RelationsNamespace);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute))
			{
				blip.Image = GetEmbededImage(blip.DocumentModel, attribute);
				return;
			}
			string attribute2 = reader.GetAttribute("link", ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.RelationsNamespace);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute2))
			{
				SetExternalOfficeImage(blip, attribute2);
			}
		}

		private OfficeImage GetEmbededImage(IDocumentModel documentModel, string relationId)
		{
			return GetImageCore(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.LookupImageByRelationId(blip.DocumentModel, relationId, ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentRootFolder));
		}

		private OfficeImage GetImageCore(OfficeImage image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return UriBasedOfficeImageBase.CreatePlaceHolder(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentModel, 28, 28);
			}
			return image;
		}

		private void SetExternalOfficeImage(DrawingBlip blip, string relationId)
		{
			OpenXmlRelation val = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.LookupExternalRelationById(relationId);
			if (val != null)
			{
				blip.Image = GetImageCore(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.LookupExternalImageByRelation(val, ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentRootFolder));
				blip.SetExternal(val.UnescapeTarget());
			}
		}
	}

		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (!(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.PeekDestination() is DrawingBlipDestination { Blip: var blip }))
			{
				return;
			}
			string attribute = reader.GetAttribute("embed", ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.RelationsNamespace);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute))
			{
				OfficeImage officeImage = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.LookupImageByRelationId(blip.DocumentModel, attribute, ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentRootFolder);
				if (officeImage != null)
				{
					blip.Image = officeImage;
				}
			}
		}
	}

			this.effects = effects;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementClose(XmlReader reader)
		{
			CheckPropertyValues();
			effects.AddCore(CreateEffect());
		}

		protected virtual void CheckPropertyValues()
		{
			if (!HasColor)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
		}

		protected abstract IDrawingEffect CreateEffect();
	}

		{
			base.ProcessElementOpen(reader);
			IDocumentModel actualDocumentModel = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ActualDocumentModel;
			actualDocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				base.ContainerEffect.Name = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "name");
				base.ContainerEffect.Type = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "type", OpenXmlExporterBase.DrawingEffectContainerTypeTable, DrawingEffectContainerType.Sibling);
				base.ContainerEffect.HasEffectsList = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				actualDocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}
	}
	public static class ImportShadowEffectHelper
	{
		public static ScalingFactorInfo GetScalingFactorInfo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			int integerValue = importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "sx", 100000);
			int integerValue2 = importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "sy", 100000);
			return new ScalingFactorInfo(integerValue, integerValue2);
		}

		public static SkewAnglesInfo GetSkewAnglesInfo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			int integerValue = importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "kx", 0);
			int integerValue2 = importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "ky", 0);
			DrawingValueChecker.CheckFixedAngle(integerValue, "horizontalSkew");
			DrawingValueChecker.CheckFixedAngle(integerValue2, "verticalSkew");
			return new SkewAnglesInfo(integerValue, integerValue2);
		}

		public static OuterShadowEffectInfo GetOuterShadowEffectInfo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			RectangleAlignType wpEnumValue = importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "algn", OpenXmlExporterBase.RectangleAlignTypeTable, RectangleAlignType.Bottom);
			long longValue = importer.GetLongValue(reader, "blurRad", 0L);
			DrawingValueChecker.CheckPositiveCoordinate(longValue, "blurRadius");
			bool onOffValue = importer.GetOnOffValue(reader, "rotWithShape", defaultValue: true);
			return new OuterShadowEffectInfo(GetOffsetShadowInfo(importer, reader), GetScalingFactorInfo(importer, reader), GetSkewAnglesInfo(importer, reader), wpEnumValue, longValue, onOffValue);
		}

		public static OffsetShadowInfo GetOffsetShadowInfo(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			long longValue = importer.GetLongValue(reader, "dist", 0L);
			int integerValue = importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "dir", 0);
			DrawingValueChecker.CheckPositiveCoordinate(longValue, "distance");
			DrawingValueChecker.CheckPositiveFixedAngle(integerValue, "direction");
			return new OffsetShadowInfo(longValue, integerValue);
		}
	}

		}

			: base(importer, effects)
		{
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)

			useAlpha = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetOnOffValue(reader, "useA", defaultValue: true);
		}

		protected override IDrawingEffect CreateEffect()
		{
			if (!HasColor)

	public class DuotoneEffectDestination : DrawingColorEffectDestinationBase
	{
		private readonly DrawingColor secondColor;

		private bool hasSecondColor;

		protected override DrawingColor Color
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsFirstColor)
				{
					return secondColor;
				}
				return base.Color;
			}
		}

		protected override bool HasColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsFirstColor)
				{
					return hasSecondColor;
				}
				return base.HasColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsFirstColor)
				{
					base.HasColor = value;
				}
				else
				{
					hasSecondColor = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsFirstColor => base.Color.Info.IsEmpty;

		public DuotoneEffectDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, DrawingEffectCollection effects)
			: base(importer, effects)
		{
			secondColor = new DrawingColor(effects.DocumentModel);
		}

		protected override IDrawingEffect CreateEffect()
		{
			return new DuotoneEffect(base.Color, secondColor);
		}

		protected override void CheckPropertyValues()
		{
			if (!base.HasColor || !hasSecondColor)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
		}
	}
