	public class DrawingBlipExtensionListDestination : TransparentDestination
	{
		public DrawingBlipExtensionListDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer)
			: base((IDestinationImporter)(object)importer)
		{
		}

		protected override Destination ProcessCurrentElement(XmlReader reader)
		{
			DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer = (DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)((Destination)this).Importer;
			string localName = reader.LocalName;
			if (localName == "ext")
			{
				return (Destination)(object)new DrawingBlipExtensionDestination(importer);
			}
			return ((TransparentDestination)this).ProcessCurrentElement(reader);
		}
	}
	public class DrawingBlipExtensionDestination : TransparentDestination
	{
		private string uri;

		public DrawingBlipExtensionDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer)
			: base((IDestinationImporter)(object)importer)
		{
		}

		protected override Destination ProcessCurrentElement(XmlReader reader)
		{
			DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter destinationAndXmlBasedImporter = (DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)((Destination)this).Importer;
			string localName = reader.LocalName;
			if (uri != null && localName == "svgBlip" && StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(uri, "{96DAC541-7B7A-43D3-8B79-37D633B846F1}") == 0)
			{
				return (Destination)(object)new DrawingSvgBlipDestination(destinationAndXmlBasedImporter);
			}
			return (Destination)(object)new EmptyDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>(destinationAndXmlBasedImporter);
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter destinationAndXmlBasedImporter = (DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter)(object)((Destination)this).Importer;
			uri = reader.GetAttribute("uri");
		}
	}
	public class DrawingGradientFillDestination : ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, TileFlipType> tileFlipTable;

		private static object syncTileFlipTable = new object();

		private static readonly ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> handlerTable = CreateElementHandlerTable();

		private readonly DrawingGradientFill fill;

		private static Dictionary<string, TileFlipType> TileFlipTable
		{
			get
			{
				if (tileFlipTable == null)
				{
					lock (syncTileFlipTable)
					{
						if (tileFlipTable == null)
						{
							tileFlipTable = DictionaryUtils.CreateBackTranslationTable(OpenXmlExporterBase.TileFlipTypeTable);
						}
					}
				}
				return tileFlipTable;
			}
		}

		protected override ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> ElementHandlerTable => handlerTable;

		private static ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> CreateElementHandlerTable()
		{

		{
			DrawingGradientFill fill = GetThis(importer).fill;
			return (Destination)(object)new RelativeRectangleDestination(importer, delegate(RectangleOffset value)
			{
				fill.TileRect = value;
			});
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			fill.BeginUpdate();
			string value = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "flip");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				fill.Flip = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValueCore(value, TileFlipTable, TileFlipType.None);
			}
			value = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "rotWithShape");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				fill.RotateWithShape = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetOnOffValue(value, defaultValue: true);
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessElementClose(XmlReader reader)
		{
			fill.EndUpdate();
		}

	public class DrawingGradientPathDestination : ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>

		private static readonly ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> handlerTable = CreateElementHandlerTable();

		private readonly DrawingGradientFill fill;

		private static Dictionary<string, GradientType> GradientTypeTable
		{
			get
			{
				if (gradientTypeTable == null)
				{
					lock (syncGradientTypeTable)
					{
						if (gradientTypeTable == null)
						{
							gradientTypeTable = DictionaryUtils.CreateBackTranslationTable(OpenXmlExporterBase.GradientTypeTable);
						}
					}
				}
				return gradientTypeTable;
			}
		}

		protected override ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> ElementHandlerTable => handlerTable;

		private static ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> CreateElementHandlerTable()

			string value = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "ang");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				fill.Angle = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.AdjAngleToModelUnits(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetIntegerValue(value, NumberStyles.Integer, 0));
			}
			value = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "scaled");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				fill.Scaled = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetOnOffValue(value, defaultValue: false);
			}
		}

	public class OfficeThemeSupplementalFontSchemeDestination : LeafElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private readonly ThemeFontSchemePart fontPart;

		public OfficeThemeSupplementalFontSchemeDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, ThemeFontSchemePart fontPart)
			: base(importer)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fontPart, "ThemeFontSchemePart");
			this.fontPart = fontPart;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			string text = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "script");
			string text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "typeface");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			fontPart.AddSupplementalFont(text, text2);
		}
	}

			{

			}
			outline.EndUpdate();

			}
		}

	public class RelativeRectangleDestination : LeafElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private Action<RectangleOffset> action;

		public RelativeRectangleDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, Action<RectangleOffset> action)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.action = action;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			int thousandthOfPercentValue = GetThousandthOfPercentValue(reader, "b", 0);
			int thousandthOfPercentValue2 = GetThousandthOfPercentValue(reader, "l", 0);
			int thousandthOfPercentValue3 = GetThousandthOfPercentValue(reader, "r", 0);
			int thousandthOfPercentValue4 = GetThousandthOfPercentValue(reader, "t", 0);
			action(new RectangleOffset(thousandthOfPercentValue, thousandthOfPercentValue2, thousandthOfPercentValue3, thousandthOfPercentValue4));
		}

		private int GetThousandthOfPercentValue(XmlReader reader, string attributeName, int defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = reader.GetAttribute(attributeName, null);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			if (attribute[attribute.Length - 1] == '%')
			{
				return GetPercentValue(attribute, defaultValue);
			}
			return ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetIntegerValue(attribute, NumberStyles.Integer, defaultValue);
		}

		private int GetPercentValue(string value, int defaultValue)
		{
			value = value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1);
			if (double.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return (int)Math.Round(result * 1000.0);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}
	}

	public class Scene3DAnchorPointDestination : LeafElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private readonly Scene3DVector vector;

		public Scene3DAnchorPointDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, Scene3DVector vector)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.vector = vector;
		}

		protected void CreateVector(XmlReader reader, string xName, string yName, string zName)
		{
			vector.DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				vector.X = GetCoordinate(reader, xName);
				vector.Y = GetCoordinate(reader, yName);
				vector.Z = GetCoordinate(reader, zName);
			}
			finally
			{
				vector.DocumentModel.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private long GetCoordinate(XmlReader reader, string coordinateName)
		{
			long num = -27273042329601L;
			long longValue = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetLongValue(reader, coordinateName, num);
			if (longValue == num)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			DrawingValueChecker.CheckCoordinate(longValue, coordinateName);
			return ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsL(longValue);
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			CreateVector(reader, "x", "y", "z");
		}
	}

		{
			int integerValue = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "fov", Scene3DPropertiesInfo.DefaultInfo.Fov);
			DrawingValueChecker.CheckFOVAngle(integerValue, "fovAngle");
			base.Info.Fov = integerValue;
			int integerValue2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "zoom", Scene3DPropertiesInfo.DefaultInfo.Zoom);
			if (integerValue2 < 0)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			base.Info.Zoom = integerValue2;
			PresetCameraType? wpEnumOnOffNullValue = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpEnumOnOffNullValue(reader, "prst", OpenXmlExporterBase.PresetCameraTypeTable);
			if (!wpEnumOnOffNullValue.HasValue)

			}
			base.Info.CameraType = wpEnumOnOffNullValue.Value;
		}

				base.Info.HasCameraRotation = true;
			}

		}

	public class XfrmDestination : ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private static readonly ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> handlerTable = CreateElementHandlerTable();

		private readonly Transform2D xfrm;

		protected override ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> ElementHandlerTable => handlerTable;

		private static ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> CreateElementHandlerTable()
		{
			ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> result = new ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>();
			AddCommonHandlers(result);
			return result;
		}

		protected static void AddCommonHandlers(ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> result)
		{
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)result).Add("ext", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnExtents);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)result).Add("off", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnOffset);
		}

		public XfrmDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, Transform2D xfrm)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.xfrm = xfrm;
		}

		private static XfrmDestination GetThis(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer)
		{
			return (XfrmDestination)(object)importer.PeekDestination();
		}

		private static Destination OnExtents(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			return (Destination)(object)new ExtentsDestination(importer, GetThis(importer).xfrm);
		}

		private static Destination OnOffset(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			return (Destination)(object)new OffsetDestination(importer, GetThis(importer).xfrm);
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			xfrm.Rotation = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.AdjAngleToModelUnits(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpSTIntegerValue(reader, "rot", 0));
			xfrm.FlipH = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpSTOnOffValue(reader, "flipH", defaultValue: false);
			xfrm.FlipV = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpSTOnOffValue(reader, "flipV", defaultValue: false);
		}
	}
	public class ExtentsDestination : LeafElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private readonly Transform2D xfrm;

		public ExtentsDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, Transform2D xfrm)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.xfrm = xfrm;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).ProcessElementOpen(reader);
			long longValue = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetLongValue(reader, "cx", -1L);
			long longValue2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetLongValue(reader, "cy", -1L);
			if (longValue < 0 || longValue2 < 0)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			xfrm.Cx = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsD(longValue);
			xfrm.Cy = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsD(longValue2);
		}
	}
	public class OffsetDestination : LeafElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private readonly Transform2D xfrm;

		public OffsetDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, Transform2D xfrm)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.xfrm = xfrm;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).ProcessElementOpen(reader);
			string s = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "x");
			string s2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "y");
			if (!long.TryParse(s, out var result))
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			if (!long.TryParse(s2, out var result2))
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			xfrm.OffsetX = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsD(result);
			xfrm.OffsetY = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsD(result2);
		}
	}

	public class GroupXfrmDestination : XfrmDestination
	{

	public class ShapeStyleDestination : ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<string, XlFontSchemeStyles> fontCollectionIndexTable = GetFontCollectionIndexTable();

		private static readonly ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> handlerTable = CreateElementHandlerTable();

		private readonly ShapeStyle shapeStyle;

		protected override ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> ElementHandlerTable => handlerTable;

		private static Dictionary<string, XlFontSchemeStyles> GetFontCollectionIndexTable()
		{
			Dictionary<string, XlFontSchemeStyles> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, XlFontSchemeStyles>();
			dictionary.Add("major", (XlFontSchemeStyles)2);
			dictionary.Add("minor", (XlFontSchemeStyles)1);
			dictionary.Add("none", (XlFontSchemeStyles)0);
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> CreateElementHandlerTable()
		{
			ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> val = new ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>();
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("lnRef", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnLineReference);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("fillRef", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnFillReference);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("effectRef", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnEffectReference);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("fontRef", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnFontReference);
			return val;
		}

		}

		{

			return (Destination)(object)new StyleReferenceDestination(importer, delegate(string value)

				style.LineReferenceIdx = integerIdx;
			}, style.LineColor);
		}

		{

		{
			ShapeStyle style = GetThis(importer).shapeStyle;

				style.EffectReferenceIdx = integerIdx;
			}, style.EffectColor);
		}

		private static Destination OnFontReference(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			ShapeStyle style = GetThis(importer).shapeStyle;
			return (Destination)(object)new StyleReferenceDestination(importer, delegate(string value)
			{
				//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!fontCollectionIndexTable.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
				{
					value2 = (XlFontSchemeStyles)0;
				}
				style.FontReferenceIdx = value2;
			}, style.FontColor);
		}

		private static ShapeStyleDestination GetThis(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer)
		{
			return (ShapeStyleDestination)(object)importer.PeekDestination();
		}

		private static int GetIntegerIdx(string value)
		{
			if (!int.TryParse(value, out var result))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return result;
		}

		{
			((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentModel.BeginUpdate();
			string text = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "typeface");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				textFont.Typeface = text;
			}
			string text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "panose");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && text2.Length != 20)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				textFont.Panose = text2;
			}
			int integerValue = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetIntegerValue(reader, "pitchFamily", 0);
			if (Math.Abs(integerValue) > 255)

				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			textFont.PitchFamily = (byte)integerValue;

			if (Math.Abs(integerValue2) > 255)
			{

			}
			textFont.Charset = (byte)integerValue2;

	public static class VmlDrawingImportHelper
	{
		public const string VmlDrawingNamespace = "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml";

		public const string VmlDrawingOfficeNamespace = "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office";

		public static void SetupCustomGeometry(IOfficeShape shape, string path, VmlSingleFormulasCollection formulas, VmlFormulaNamedValues namedValues)
		{
			SetupCustomGeometry(shape.ShapeProperties, shape.DocumentModel, path, formulas, namedValues);
		}

		public static void SetupCustomGeometry(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, IDocumentModel documentModel, string path, VmlSingleFormulasCollection formulas, VmlFormulaNamedValues namedValues)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)namedValues, "namedValues");
				ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry = CreateVmlFakeGeometry(formulas, namedValues);
				ShapeGuideCalculator calculator = new VmlShapeGuideCalculator(geometry, namedValues.EmuWidth, namedValues.EmuHeight, new ModelShapeGuideList(FakeDocumentModel.Instance));
				VmlPathParser vmlPathParser = new VmlPathParser(calculator);
				vmlPathParser.Parse(path);
				vmlPathParser.OffsetPath(namedValues.CoordOriginX, namedValues.CoordOriginY);
				ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry = shapeProperties.CustomGeometry;
				ModelShapePath modelShapePath = new ModelShapePath(documentModel.MainPart);
				modelShapePath.Width = namedValues.Width;
				modelShapePath.Height = namedValues.Height;
				customGeometry.Paths.Add(modelShapePath);
				BinaryDrawingImportHelper.CreateComplexPath(customGeometry, vmlPathParser.MsoPathInfos, vmlPathParser.Vertices, new XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache(), new XlsAdjustableAngleCache());
			}
		}

		internal static ModelShapeCustomGeometry CreateVmlFakeGeometry(VmlSingleFormulasCollection formulas, VmlFormulaNamedValues namedValues)
		{
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry modelShapeCustomGeometry = new ModelShapeCustomGeometry(FakeDocumentModel.Instance);
			if (namedValues != null)
			{
				int?[] adjustValues = namedValues.AdjustValues;
				for (int i = 0; i < adjustValues.Length; i++)
				{
					if (adjustValues[i].HasValue)
					{
						modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("adj" + i.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "val " + adjustValues[i].Value));
					}
				}
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("width", "val " + namedValues.Width.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("height", "val " + namedValues.Height.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("xcenter", "val " + namedValues.CenterX.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ycenter", "val " + namedValues.CenterY.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("xlimo", "val " + namedValues.LimoX.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("ylimo", "val " + namedValues.LimoY.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("lineDrawn", "val " + (namedValues.LineDrawn ? "1" : "0")));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("pixellinewidth", "val " + namedValues.PixelLineWidth.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("pixelwidth", "val " + namedValues.PixelWidth.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("pixelheight", "val " + namedValues.PixelHeight.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("emuwidth", "val " + namedValues.EmuWidth.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("emuheight", "val " + namedValues.EmuHeight.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("emuwidth2", "val " + namedValues.EmuWidth2.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("emuheight2", "val " + namedValues.EmuHeight2.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
			}
			if (formulas != null && formulas.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < formulas.Count; j++)
				{
					modelShapeCustomGeometry.Guides.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("G" + j.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), VmlFormulaParser.Parse(formulas[j].Equation)));
				}
			}
			return modelShapeCustomGeometry;
		}

		public static void SetupDrawingFill(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties, Color fillColor)
		{
			if (fillProperties == null)
			{
				shapeProperties.Fill = CreateDrawingSolidFillCore(shapeProperties.DocumentModel, fillColor, 1f);
			}
			else
			{
				shapeProperties.Fill = SetupDrawingFillCore(shapeProperties.DocumentModel, shapeProperties.ShapeType, fillProperties, fillColor);
			}
		}

		private static IDrawingFill SetupDrawingFillCore(IDocumentModel documentModel, ShapePreset shapeType, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties, Color fillColor)
		{
			switch (fillProperties.Type)
			{
			case VmlFillType.Solid:
				return CreateDrawingSolidFill(documentModel, fillProperties, fillColor);
			case VmlFillType.Gradient:
			case VmlFillType.GradientRadial:
				return CreateGradientFill(documentModel, shapeType, fillProperties, fillColor);
			case VmlFillType.Pattern:
				return CreatePatternFill(documentModel, fillProperties, fillColor);
			case VmlFillType.Tile:
				return CreateTileFill(documentModel, fillProperties);
			case VmlFillType.Frame:
				return CreateFrameFill(documentModel, fillProperties);
			default:
				return DrawingFill.None;
			}
		}

		private static DrawingSolidFill CreateDrawingSolidFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties, Color fillColor)
		{
			Color color = ((fillProperties.Color != DXColor.White) ? fillProperties.Color : fillColor);
			float opacity = fillProperties.Opacity;
			return CreateDrawingSolidFillCore(documentModel, color, opacity);
		}

		private static DrawingSolidFill CreateDrawingSolidFillCore(IDocumentModel documentModel, Color color, float opacity)
		{
			DrawingSolidFill drawingSolidFill = DrawingSolidFill.Create(documentModel, color);
			BinaryDrawingImportHelper.SetupFillOpacity(drawingSolidFill.Color, opacity);
			return drawingSolidFill;
		}

		private static DrawingGradientFill CreateGradientFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, ShapePreset shapeType, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties, Color fillColor)
		{
			DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill = new DrawingGradientFill(documentModel);
			drawingGradientFill.RotateWithShape = fillProperties.Rotate;
			drawingGradientFill.GradientType = ((fillProperties.Type == VmlFillType.GradientRadial) ? ((shapeType == ShapePreset.Rect) ? GradientType.Rectangle : GradientType.Shape) : GradientType.Linear);
			SetupFillRectangle(drawingGradientFill, fillProperties);
			SetupGradientAngle(drawingGradientFill, fillProperties);
			SetupGradientStops(documentModel, drawingGradientFill, fillProperties, fillColor);
			drawingGradientFill.Scaled = true;
			return drawingGradientFill;
		}

		private static void SetupFillRectangle(DrawingGradientFill fill, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties)
		{
			if (fill.GradientType != GradientType.Linear)
			{
				int leftOffset = (int)Math.Round(fillProperties.FocusPosition.Left * 100000f);
				int topOffset = (int)Math.Round(fillProperties.FocusPosition.Top * 100000f);
				int rightOffset = (int)Math.Round((1.0 - (double)(fillProperties.FocusPosition.Left + fillProperties.FocusSize.Width)) * 100000.0);
				int bottomOffset = (int)Math.Round((1.0 - (double)(fillProperties.FocusPosition.Top + fillProperties.FocusSize.Height)) * 100000.0);
				fill.FillRect = new RectangleOffset(bottomOffset, leftOffset, rightOffset, topOffset);
			}
		}

		private static void SetupGradientAngle(DrawingGradientFill fill, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties)
		{
			if (fill.GradientType == GradientType.Linear)
			{
				fill.Angle = BinaryDrawingImportHelper.SetupGradientAngleCore(fillProperties.Angle);
			}
		}

		private static void SetupGradientStops(IDocumentModel documentModel, DrawingGradientFill fill, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties, Color fillColor)
		{
			Color first = ((fillProperties.Color != DXColor.White) ? fillProperties.Color : fillColor);
			Color color = fillProperties.Color2;
			float opacity = fillProperties.Opacity;
			float opacity2 = fillProperties.Opacity2;
			VmlIntermediateColors vmlIntermediateColors = ((fillProperties.Colors.Count > 0) ? fillProperties.Colors : CreateIntermediateColors(first, color));
			List<double> list = CalculateOpacities(vmlIntermediateColors, opacity, opacity2);
			List<Tuple<OfficeShadeColor, double>> list2 = new List<Tuple<OfficeShadeColor, double>>();
			float num = fillProperties.Focus;
			if (num <= -1f)
			{
				num = 1f;
			}
			if (num > 0f)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, 1f);
				for (int i = 0; i < vmlIntermediateColors.Count; i++)
				{
					OfficeShadeColor officeShadeColor = vmlIntermediateColors[i];
					list2.Add(new Tuple<OfficeShadeColor, double>(new OfficeShadeColor(officeShadeColor.ColorRecord.Color, officeShadeColor.Position * (double)num), list[i]));
				}
				if (num < 1f)
				{
					for (int num2 = vmlIntermediateColors.Count - 2; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						OfficeShadeColor officeShadeColor2 = vmlIntermediateColors[num2];
						double position = 1.0 - officeShadeColor2.Position * (double)(1f - num);
						list2.Add(new Tuple<OfficeShadeColor, double>(new OfficeShadeColor(officeShadeColor2.ColorRecord.Color, position), list[num2]));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num3 = vmlIntermediateColors.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					OfficeShadeColor officeShadeColor3 = vmlIntermediateColors[num3];
					double position2 = (1.0 - officeShadeColor3.Position) * (double)(num + 1f);
					list2.Add(new Tuple<OfficeShadeColor, double>(new OfficeShadeColor(officeShadeColor3.ColorRecord.Color, position2), list[num3]));
				}
				if (num < 0f)
				{
					for (int j = 1; j < vmlIntermediateColors.Count; j++)
					{
						OfficeShadeColor officeShadeColor4 = vmlIntermediateColors[j];
						double position3 = (1.0 - officeShadeColor4.Position) * (double)num + 1.0;
						list2.Add(new Tuple<OfficeShadeColor, double>(new OfficeShadeColor(officeShadeColor4.ColorRecord.Color, position3), list[j]));
					}
				}
			}
			GradientStopCollection gradientStops = fill.GradientStops;
			for (int k = 0; k < list2.Count; k++)
			{
				Tuple<OfficeShadeColor, double> tuple = list2[k];
				DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = new DrawingGradientStop(documentModel);
				OfficeShadeColor item = tuple.Item1;
				SetupFillColor(drawingGradientStop.Color, item.ColorRecord.Color);
				BinaryDrawingImportHelper.SetupFillOpacity(drawingGradientStop.Color, tuple.Item2);
				drawingGradientStop.Position = (int)Math.Round(item.Position * 100000.0);
				gradientStops.Add(drawingGradientStop);
			}
		}

		private static VmlIntermediateColors CreateIntermediateColors(Color first, Color last)
		{
			VmlIntermediateColors vmlIntermediateColors = new VmlIntermediateColors();
			vmlIntermediateColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
			{
				ColorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord
				{
					Color = first
				},
				Position = 0.0
			});
			vmlIntermediateColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
			{
				ColorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord
				{
					Color = last
				},
				Position = 1.0
			});
			return vmlIntermediateColors;
		}

		private static List<double> CalculateOpacities(VmlIntermediateColors intermediateColors, double firstOpacity, double lastOpacity)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			double position = intermediateColors.First.Position;
			double position2 = intermediateColors.Last.Position;
			double num = ((position2 == position) ? 0.0 : ((lastOpacity - firstOpacity) / (position2 - position)));
			foreach (OfficeShadeColor intermediateColor in intermediateColors)
			{
				double item = lastOpacity - num * (intermediateColor.Position - position);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void SetupFillColor(IDrawingColor drawingColor, Color color)
		{
			drawingColor.Rgb = color;
		}

		private static DrawingPatternFill CreatePatternFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties, Color fillColor)
		{
			Color foregroundColor = ((fillProperties.Color != DXColor.White) ? fillProperties.Color : fillColor);
			Color color = fillProperties.Color2;
			OfficeImage embeddedImage = fillProperties.EmbeddedImage;
			return CreateDrawingPatternFillCore(documentModel, foregroundColor, color, embeddedImage);
		}

		internal static DrawingPatternFill CreateDrawingPatternFillCore(IDocumentModel documentModel, Color foregroundColor, Color backgroundColor, OfficeImage image)
		{
			DrawingPatternFill drawingPatternFill = new DrawingPatternFill(documentModel);
			SetupFillColor(drawingPatternFill.ForegroundColor, foregroundColor);
			SetupFillColor(drawingPatternFill.BackgroundColor, backgroundColor);
			drawingPatternFill.PatternType = SetupPatternType(image, DrawingPatternType.Percent50);
			return drawingPatternFill;
		}

		private static DrawingPatternType SetupPatternType(OfficeImage image, DrawingPatternType defaultPatternType)
		{
			return defaultPatternType;
		}

		private static IDrawingFill CreateFrameFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties)
		{
			IDrawingFill drawingFill = CreateBlipFillCore(documentModel, fillProperties);
			return drawingFill ?? DrawingFill.None;
		}

		private static IDrawingFill CreateTileFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties)
		{
			DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill = CreateBlipFillCore(documentModel, fillProperties);
			if (drawingBlipFill == null)
			{
				return DrawingFill.None;
			}
			drawingBlipFill.ScaleX = 100000;
			drawingBlipFill.ScaleY = 100000;
			return drawingBlipFill;
		}

		private static DrawingBlipFill CreateBlipFillCore(IDocumentModel documentModel, VmlShapeFillProperties fillProperties)
		{
			if (fillProperties.EmbeddedImage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill = DrawingBlipFill.Create(documentModel, fillProperties.EmbeddedImage.RootImage);
			drawingBlipFill.RotateWithShape = fillProperties.Rotate;
			int amount = (int)Math.Round(fillProperties.Opacity * 100000f);
			drawingBlipFill.Blip.Effects.Add(new AlphaModulateFixedEffect(amount));
			return drawingBlipFill;
		}

		public static void SetupImageData(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, VmlShapeImageData imageData)
		{
			DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill = DrawingBlipFill.Create(shapeProperties.DocumentModel, imageData.Image);
			drawingBlipFill.SetSourceRectangleCore(new RectangleOffset(CalculateCropUnit(imageData.CropBottom), CalculateCropUnit(imageData.CropLeft), CalculateCropUnit(imageData.CropRight), CalculateCropUnit(imageData.CropTop)));
			float floatOrVulgarFractionValue = GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(imageData.Gain, 1f, 65536f);
			float floatOrVulgarFractionValue2 = GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(imageData.BlackLevel, 0f, 65536f);
			if (floatOrVulgarFractionValue != 1f && floatOrVulgarFractionValue2 != 0f)
			{
				drawingBlipFill.Blip.Effects.Add(new LuminanceEffect(ConvertBlacklevelToBrightness(floatOrVulgarFractionValue2), ConvertGainToContrast(floatOrVulgarFractionValue)));
			}
			shapeProperties.Fill = drawingBlipFill;
		}

		public static int CalculateCropUnit(string crop)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(crop))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			float num = ((!crop.EndsWith("%")) ? GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(crop, 0f, 65536f) : GetPercentageValue(crop));
			return (int)Math.Round(num * 100000f);
		}

		private static int ConvertBlacklevelToBrightness(float blacklevel)
		{
			float num = (((double)blacklevel >= -0.5 && (double)blacklevel <= 0.5) ? (blacklevel + 0.5f) : 0.5f);
			return (int)Math.Round(num * 100000f);
		}

		public static int ConvertGainToContrast(float gain)
		{
			float num = 1f;
			if (gain <= 1f)
			{
				num = gain / 2f;
			}
			else if (gain > 1f && gain <= 100f)
			{
				num = 1f - 1f / (2f * gain);
			}
			return (int)Math.Round(num * 100000f);
		}

		public static void SetupOutlineProperties(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, VmlLineStrokeSettings strokeSettings, Color strokeColor, int strokeWeight)
		{
			SetupOutlineProperties(shapeProperties, strokeSettings, strokeColor, strokeWeight, hasArrows: true);
		}

		public static void SetupOutlineProperties(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, VmlLineStrokeSettings strokeSettings, Color strokeColor, int strokeWeight, bool hasArrows)
		{
			Outline outline = shapeProperties.Outline;
			outline.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				outline.Dashing = ((strokeSettings != null) ? GetOutlineDashing(strokeSettings.DashStyle) : OutlineDashing.Solid);
				int num = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.PointsToModelUnits(1);
				outline.Width = ((strokeSettings != null && strokeSettings.StrokeWeight != num) ? strokeSettings.StrokeWeight : strokeWeight);
				outline.CompoundType = ((strokeSettings != null) ? GetOutlineCompoundType(strokeSettings.LineStyle) : OutlineCompoundType.Single);
				if (hasArrows)
				{
					outline.HeadType = ((strokeSettings != null) ? GetOutlineHeadTailType(strokeSettings.StartArrowType) : OutlineHeadTailType.None);
					outline.HeadLength = ((strokeSettings == null) ? OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium : GetOutlineHeadTailSize(strokeSettings.StartArrowLength));
					outline.HeadWidth = ((strokeSettings == null) ? OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium : GetOutlineHeadTailSize(strokeSettings.StartArrowWidth));
					outline.TailType = ((strokeSettings != null) ? GetOutlineHeadTailType(strokeSettings.EndArrowType) : OutlineHeadTailType.None);
					outline.TailLength = ((strokeSettings == null) ? OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium : GetOutlineHeadTailSize(strokeSettings.EndArrowLength));
					outline.TailWidth = ((strokeSettings == null) ? OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium : GetOutlineHeadTailSize(strokeSettings.EndArrowWidth));
				}
				SetFill(outline, strokeSettings, strokeColor);
			}
			finally
			{
				outline.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private static void SetFill(Outline outline, VmlLineStrokeSettings strokeSettings, Color strokeColor)
		{
			VmlFillType vmlFillType = strokeSettings?.FillType ?? VmlFillType.Solid;
			Color color = ((strokeSettings != null && strokeSettings.Color != DXColor.Black) ? strokeSettings.Color : strokeColor);
			switch (vmlFillType)
			{
			case VmlFillType.Solid:
				outline.Fill = CreateDrawingSolidFillCore(outline.DocumentModel, color, strokeSettings?.Opacity ?? 1f);
				break;
			case VmlFillType.Pattern:
				if (strokeSettings != null)
				{
					Color color2 = strokeSettings.Color2;
					outline.Fill = CreateDrawingPatternFillCore(outline.DocumentModel, color, color2, strokeSettings.EmbeddedImage);
				}
				break;
			case VmlFillType.Gradient:
			case VmlFillType.GradientRadial:
			case VmlFillType.Tile:
			case VmlFillType.Frame:
				break;
			}
		}

		private static OutlineDashing GetOutlineDashing(VmlDashStyle vmlDashStyle)
		{
			return vmlDashStyle switch
			{
				VmlDashStyle.Solid => OutlineDashing.Solid, 
				VmlDashStyle.ShortDash => OutlineDashing.SystemDash, 
				VmlDashStyle.ShortDot => OutlineDashing.SystemDot, 
				VmlDashStyle.ShortDashDot => OutlineDashing.SystemDashDot, 
				VmlDashStyle.ShortDashDotDot => OutlineDashing.SystemDashDotDot, 
				VmlDashStyle.Dot => OutlineDashing.Dot, 
				VmlDashStyle.Dash => OutlineDashing.Dash, 
				VmlDashStyle.LongDash => OutlineDashing.LongDash, 
				VmlDashStyle.DashDot => OutlineDashing.DashDot, 
				VmlDashStyle.LongDashDot => OutlineDashing.LongDashDot, 
				VmlDashStyle.LongDashDotDot => OutlineDashing.LongDashDotDot, 
				_ => OutlineDashing.Solid, 
			};
		}

		private static OutlineCompoundType GetOutlineCompoundType(VmlLineStyle vmlLineStyle)
		{
			return vmlLineStyle switch
			{
				VmlLineStyle.Single => OutlineCompoundType.Single, 
				VmlLineStyle.ThinThin => OutlineCompoundType.Double, 
				VmlLineStyle.ThinThick => OutlineCompoundType.ThinThick, 
				VmlLineStyle.ThickThin => OutlineCompoundType.ThickThin, 
				VmlLineStyle.ThickBetweenThin => OutlineCompoundType.Triple, 
				_ => OutlineCompoundType.Single, 
			};
		}

		private static OutlineHeadTailType GetOutlineHeadTailType(VMLStrokeArrowType strokeArrowType)
		{
			return strokeArrowType switch
			{
				VMLStrokeArrowType.None => OutlineHeadTailType.None, 
				VMLStrokeArrowType.Block => OutlineHeadTailType.TriangleArrow, 
				VMLStrokeArrowType.Classic => OutlineHeadTailType.StealthArrow, 
				VMLStrokeArrowType.Diamond => OutlineHeadTailType.Diamond, 
				VMLStrokeArrowType.Open => OutlineHeadTailType.Arrow, 
				VMLStrokeArrowType.Oval => OutlineHeadTailType.Oval, 
				_ => OutlineHeadTailType.None, 
			};
		}

		private static OutlineHeadTailSize GetOutlineHeadTailSize(VMLStrokeArrowLength strokeArrowLength)
		{
			return strokeArrowLength switch
			{
				VMLStrokeArrowLength.Short => OutlineHeadTailSize.Small, 
				VMLStrokeArrowLength.Medium => OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium, 
				VMLStrokeArrowLength.Long => OutlineHeadTailSize.Large, 
				_ => OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium, 
			};
		}

		private static OutlineHeadTailSize GetOutlineHeadTailSize(VMLStrokeArrowWidth strokeArrowWidth)
		{
			return strokeArrowWidth switch
			{
				VMLStrokeArrowWidth.Narrow => OutlineHeadTailSize.Small, 
				VMLStrokeArrowWidth.Medium => OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium, 
				VMLStrokeArrowWidth.Wide => OutlineHeadTailSize.Large, 
				_ => OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium, 
			};
		}

		public static void SetupShadowProperties(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, VmlShadowEffect shadow)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			long num = BinaryDrawingImportHelper.CalculateDistance(unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(shadow.Offset.X), unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(shadow.Offset.Y));
			int num2 = BinaryDrawingImportHelper.CalculateDirection(shadow.Offset.X, shadow.Offset.Y);
			DrawingColor drawingColor = DrawingColor.Create(shapeProperties.DocumentModel, shadow.Color);
			if (shadow.Opacity != 0f)
			{
				drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new AlphaColorTransform((int)Math.Round(shadow.Opacity * 100000f)));
			}
			if (shadow.ShadowType == VmlShadowType.Double)
			{
				AddEffect(shapeProperties, new PresetShadowEffect(drawingColor, PresetShadowType.TopLeftDoubleDrop, new OffsetShadowInfo(num, num2)));
				return;
			}
			if (shadow.ShadowType == VmlShadowType.Emboss)
			{
				AddEffect(shapeProperties, new PresetShadowEffect(drawingColor, PresetShadowType.OuterBox3d, new OffsetShadowInfo(num, num2)));
				return;
			}
			VmlMatrix matrix = shadow.Matrix;
			bool flag = IsShadowPerspective(shadow);
			int sx = (flag ? ((int)Math.Round(matrix.Sxx * 100000f)) : 100000);
			int sy = (flag ? ((int)Math.Round(matrix.Syy * 100000f)) : 100000);
			int kx = (flag ? ((int)Math.Round(Math.Atan((matrix.Sxx != 0f) ? (matrix.Sxy / matrix.Sxx) : matrix.Sxy) * 180.0 / Math.PI * 60000.0)) : 0);
			int ky = (flag ? ((int)Math.Round(Math.Atan((matrix.Syy != 0f) ? (matrix.Syx / matrix.Syy) : matrix.Syx) * 180.0 / Math.PI * 60000.0)) : 0);
			RectangleAlignType shadowAlignCore = BinaryDrawingImportHelper.GetShadowAlignCore(shadow.OriginX, shadow.OriginY);
			OuterShadowEffectInfo info = OuterShadowEffectInfo.Create(0L, num, num2, sx, sy, kx, ky, shadowAlignCore, rotWithShape: false);
			AddEffect(shapeProperties, new OuterShadowEffect(drawingColor, info));
		}

		private static void AddEffect(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, IDrawingEffect effect)
		{
			ContainerEffect containerEffect = shapeProperties.EffectStyle.ContainerEffect;
			containerEffect.SetApplyEffectListCore(value: true);
			containerEffect.Effects.Add(effect);
		}

		private static bool IsShadowPerspective(VmlShadowEffect shadow)
		{
			VmlShadowType shadowType = shadow.ShadowType;
			if ((uint)(shadowType - 2) <= 2u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static Color GetVmlSTColorValue(XmlReader reader, string attributeName, Color defaultValue)
		{
			string attribute = reader.GetAttribute(attributeName);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute))
			{
				return ParseColor(attribute, defaultValue);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static Color ParseColor(string value, Color defaultValue)
		{
			if (value == "auto")
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			int num = value.IndexOf(" [");
			if (num != -1)
			{
				value = value.Remove(num);
			}
			if (value[0] == '#')
			{
				value = value.Substring(1, value.Length - 1);
				Color result = DXColor.FromName(value);
				if (result.IsKnownColor)
				{
					return result;
				}
				value = ((value.Length != 3) ? (new string('0', 6 - value.Length) + value) : string.Format("{0}{0}{1}{1}{2}{2}", value[0], value[1], value[2]));
				if ((value.Length == 8 || value.Length == 6) && uint.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result2))
				{
					if (value.Length == 6)
					{
						result2 += 4278190080u;
					}
					return DXColor.FromArgb((int)result2);
				}
			}
			Color color = DXColor.FromName(value);
			if (color != DXColor.Empty)
			{
				return color;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static float GetWpSTFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(XmlReader reader, string attributeName, float defaultValue, float denominator)
		{
			string attribute = reader.GetAttribute(attributeName);
			return GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(attribute, defaultValue, denominator);
		}

		public static float GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(string value, float defaultValue, float denominator)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			value = value.ToLower();
			if (value.EndsWith("f"))
			{
				return GetWpSTFloatValue(value.Replace("f", ""), NumberStyles.Float, defaultValue) / denominator;
			}
			return GetWpSTFloatValue(value, NumberStyles.Float, defaultValue);
		}

		public static float ReadPercentageAttribute(XmlReader reader, string attributeName)
		{
			string attribute = reader.GetAttribute(attributeName);
			return GetPercentageValue(attribute);
		}

		private static float GetPercentageValue(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			value = value.Replace("%", "");
			return GetWpSTFloatValue(value, NumberStyles.Float, 0f) / 100f;
		}

		public static float GetFloatOrPercentageValue(string value)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (value.EndsWith("%"))
			{
				flag = true;
				value = value.Replace("%", string.Empty);
			}
			float num = GetWpSTFloatValue(value, NumberStyles.Float, 0f);
			if (flag)
			{
				num /= 100f;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static float GetWpSTFloatValue(string value, NumberStyles numberStyles, float defaultValue)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && double.TryParse(value, numberStyles, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return (float)result;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static float GetModelUnitValue(string value, DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			DXVmlUnit unit = new DXVmlUnit(value);
			VmlUnitConverter vmlUnitConverter = new VmlUnitConverter(unitConverter);
			return vmlUnitConverter.ToModelUnitsF(unit);
		}

		public static void PrepareAdjustValues(int?[] adjustValues, string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array = value.Split(new string[1] { "," }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(array.Length, adjustValues.Length); i++)
			{
				string s = array[i];
				if (int.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
				{
					adjustValues[i] = result;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void PrepareCoordSize(string coodsize, VmlCoordUnit coord)
		{
			PrepareCoordValueCore(coodsize, coord);
		}

		public static void PrepareCoordOrigin(string coodorigin, VmlCoordUnit coord)
		{
			PrepareCoordValueCore(coodorigin, coord);
		}

		private static void PrepareCoordValueCore(string value, VmlCoordUnit coord)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array = value.Split(',');
			int num = array.Length;
			if (num > 2 || num == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (int.TryParse(array[0], NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				coord.X = result;
			}
			else
			{
				coord.X = 0;
			}
			if (num != 1)
			{
				if (int.TryParse(array[1], NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result))
				{
					coord.Y = result;
				}
				else
				{
					coord.Y = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void PrepareShapeStyleProperties(VmlShapeStyleProperties styleProperties, string style)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(style))
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array = style.Split(new char[1] { ';' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				string[] array3 = text.Split(new char[1] { ':' }, StringSplitOptions.None);
				if (array3.Length >= 2 && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(array3[0]))
				{
					string key = array3[0].Trim();
					string value = array3[1].Trim();
					if (styleProperties.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						styleProperties[key] = value;
					}
					else
					{
						styleProperties.Add(key, value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SetupShapeTransform(Transform2D transform2D, VmlShapeStyleProperties styleProperties)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = transform2D.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			float modelUnitValue = GetModelUnitValue(styleProperties.GetProperty("left"), unitConverter);
			float modelUnitValue2 = GetModelUnitValue(styleProperties.GetProperty("top"), unitConverter);
			float modelUnitValue3 = GetModelUnitValue(styleProperties.GetProperty("width"), unitConverter);
			float modelUnitValue4 = GetModelUnitValue(styleProperties.GetProperty("height"), unitConverter);
			SetupShapeTransform(transform2D, styleProperties, modelUnitValue, modelUnitValue2, modelUnitValue3, modelUnitValue4);
		}

		public static void SetupShapeTransform(Transform2D transform2D, VmlShapeStyleProperties styleProperties, float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			string property = styleProperties.GetProperty("flip");
			transform2D.SetFlipHCore(property.Contains("x"));
			transform2D.SetFlipVCore(property.Contains("y"));
			int num = GetRotation(styleProperties.GetProperty("rotation"));
			if (num != 0)
			{
				if (transform2D.FlipH)
				{
					num = 21600000 - num;
				}
				if (transform2D.FlipV)
				{
					num = 21600000 - num;
				}
				transform2D.SetRotationCore(num);
			}
			transform2D.SetCxCore(width);
			transform2D.SetCyCore(height);
			transform2D.SetOffsetXCore(x);
			transform2D.SetOffsetYCore(y);
		}

		public static int GetRotation(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			DXRotationUnit dXRotationUnit = new DXRotationUnit(value);
			DXUnitType type = dXRotationUnit.Type;
			if (type == DXUnitType.Fd)
			{
				return (int)Math.Round(dXRotationUnit.Value / 65536f * 60000f);
			}
			return (int)Math.Round(dXRotationUnit.Value * 60000f);
		}

		public static Color CreateDarkenColor(string value, Color color)
		{
			double colorTransform = GetColorTransform(value);
			return DrawingValueConverter.GetDarkenTransformColor(color, colorTransform);
		}

		public static Color CreateLightenColor(string value, Color color)
		{
			double colorTransform = GetColorTransform(value);
			return DrawingValueConverter.GetLightenTransformColor(color, 1.0 - colorTransform);
		}

		private static double GetColorTransform(string value)
		{
			int num = value.IndexOf("(");
			int num2 = value.IndexOf(")");
			if (num == -1 || num2 == -1 || num > num2)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			int.TryParse(value.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1), out var result);
			return (double)result / 255.0;
		}

			locks.NoMove = vmlShapeProtections.Position == true;
		}

		public static void SetupBlackAndWhiteMode(ShapePropertiesBase shapeProperties, VmlBlackAndWhiteMode mode)
		{
			shapeProperties.BlackAndWhiteMode = ConvertBlackWhiteMode(mode);
		}

		private static OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode ConvertBlackWhiteMode(VmlBlackAndWhiteMode mode)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.Color => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Clr, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.GrayScale => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Gray, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.LightGrayscale => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.LtGray, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.InverseGray => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.InvGray, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.GrayOutline => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.GrayWhite, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.BlackTextAndLines => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.BlackGray, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.HighContrast => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.BlackWhite, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.Black => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Black, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.White => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.White, 
				VmlBlackAndWhiteMode.Undrawn => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Hidden, 
				_ => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Auto, 
			};
		}

	public static class VmlPathCommands
	{
		public const string MoveTo = "m";

		public const string LineTo = "l";

		public const string CurveTo = "c";

		public const string Close = "x";

		public const string End = "e";

		public const string RMoveTo = "t";

		public const string RLineTo = "r";

		public const string RCurveTo = "v";

		public const string NoFill = "nf";

		public const string NoStroke = "ns";

		public const string AngleEllipseTo = "ae";

		public const string AngleEllipse = "al";

		public const string ArcTo = "at";

		public const string Arc = "ar";

		public const string ClockwiseArcTo = "wa";

		public const string ClockwiseArc = "wr";

		public const string EllipticalQuadrantX = "qx";

		public const string EllipticalQuadrantY = "qy";

		public const string QuadraticBezier = "qb";
	}
	internal class VmlPathParser
	{
		private class CommandInfo
		{
			public static readonly CommandInfo Empty = new CommandInfo(null, -1);

			public string Command { get; private set; }

			public int Position { get; private set; }

			public CommandInfo(string command, int position)
			{
				Command = command;
				Position = position;
			}
		}

		public const string DefaultGuideName = "G";

		private static readonly string[] Commands = new string[19]
		{
			"m", "l", "c", "x", "e", "t", "r", "v", "nf", "ns",
			"ae", "al", "at", "ar", "wa", "wr", "qx", "qy", "qb"
		};

		private readonly Dictionary<string, Action<string>> parsers;

		private readonly IShapeGuideCalculator calculator;

		private readonly List<MsoPathInfo> msoPathInfos;

		private readonly List<Point> vertices;

		private int lastX;

		private int lastY;

		public MsoPathInfo[] MsoPathInfos => msoPathInfos.ToArray();

		public Point[] Vertices => vertices.ToArray();

		private Dictionary<string, Action<string>> CreateParserTable()
		{
			Dictionary<string, Action<string>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Action<string>>();
			dictionary.Add("m", ParseMoveTo);
			dictionary.Add("l", ParseLineTo);
			dictionary.Add("c", ParseCurveTo);
			dictionary.Add("x", ParseClose);
			dictionary.Add("e", ParseEnd);
			dictionary.Add("t", ParseRMoveTo);
			dictionary.Add("r", ParseRLineTo);
			dictionary.Add("v", ParseRCurveTo);
			dictionary.Add("nf", ParseNoFill);
			dictionary.Add("ns", ParseNoStroke);
			dictionary.Add("ae", ParseAngleEllipseTo);
			dictionary.Add("al", ParseAngleEllipse);
			dictionary.Add("at", ParseArcTo);
			dictionary.Add("ar", ParseArc);
			dictionary.Add("wa", ParseClockwiseArcTo);
			dictionary.Add("wr", ParseClockwiseArc);
			dictionary.Add("qx", ParseEllipticalQuadrantX);
			dictionary.Add("qy", ParseEllipticalQuadrantY);
			dictionary.Add("qb", ParseQuadraticBezier);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public VmlPathParser(IShapeGuideCalculator calculator)
		{
			this.calculator = calculator;
			parsers = CreateParserTable();
			msoPathInfos = new List<MsoPathInfo>();
			vertices = new List<Point>();
		}

		public void OffsetPath(int dX, int dY)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Count; i++)
			{
				vertices[i] = new Point(vertices[i].X - dX, vertices[i].Y - dY);
			}
		}

		public void Parse(string path)
		{
			msoPathInfos.Clear();
			vertices.Clear();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
			{
				int num = 0;
				CommandInfo commandInfo = GetNextCommand(path, num);
				while (num < path.Length && commandInfo != CommandInfo.Empty)
				{
					num += commandInfo.Command.Length;
					CommandInfo nextCommand = GetNextCommand(path, num);
					string content = ((nextCommand == CommandInfo.Empty) ? path.Substring(num) : path.Substring(num, nextCommand.Position - num));
					ParseCommand(commandInfo.Command, content);
					num = nextCommand.Position;
					commandInfo = nextCommand;
				}
				if (msoPathInfos.Count > 0 && msoPathInfos[msoPathInfos.Count - 1].PathType != MsoPathType.End)
				{
					msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.End, -65536));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParseCommand(string command, string content)
		{
			if (parsers.TryGetValue(command, out var value))
			{
				value(content);
			}
		}

		private CommandInfo GetNextCommand(string path, int startIndex)
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i < path.Length; i++)
			{
				string[] commands = Commands;
				foreach (string text in commands)
				{
					if (CheckLength(path.Length, i, text.Length) && CheckCommand(path, text, i))
					{
						return new CommandInfo(text, i);
					}
				}
			}
			return CommandInfo.Empty;
		}

		private bool CheckLength(int pathLength, int startIndex, int commandLength)
		{
			return startIndex + commandLength <= pathLength;
		}

		private bool CheckCommand(string path, string command, int startIndex)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < command.Length; i++)
			{
				if (path[startIndex + i] != command[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int ParseParameter(string value)
		{
			if (value.StartsWith("G"))
			{
				return (int)Math.Round(calculator.GetGuideValue(value));
			}
			if (int.TryParse(value, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal List<int> PrepareParameters(string content)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(content))
			{
				return list;
			}
			content = content.Trim();
			int i = 0;
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (; i < content.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (content[i])
				{
				case '@':
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text != "G")
					{
						list.Add(ParseParameter(text));
					}
					text = "G";
					break;
				case ' ':
					for (; content[i + 1] == ' '; i++)
					{
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text != "G")
					{
						list.Add(ParseParameter(text));
						text = string.Empty;
					}
					break;
				case ',':
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text != "G")
					{
						list.Add(ParseParameter(text));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(0);
					}
					text = string.Empty;
					break;
				default:
					text += content[i];
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text != "G")
			{
				list.Add(ParseParameter(text));
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(0);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void AddMsoPathInfo(MsoPathType type, int segments)
		{
			if (msoPathInfos.Count == 0 || msoPathInfos[msoPathInfos.Count - 1].PathType != type)
			{
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(type, segments));
			}
			else
			{
				msoPathInfos[msoPathInfos.Count - 1].Segments += segments;
			}
		}

		private void AddMsoPathInfo(MsoPathEscape escape, int segments)
		{
			if (msoPathInfos.Count == 0 || msoPathInfos[msoPathInfos.Count - 1].PathEscape != escape)
			{
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(escape, segments));
			}
			else
			{
				msoPathInfos[msoPathInfos.Count - 1].Segments += segments;
			}
		}

		private void ParseMoveTo(string content)
		{
			List<int> list = PrepareParameters(content);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i += 2)
			{
				lastX = list[i];
				lastY = ((i + 1 < list.Count) ? list[i + 1] : 0);
				vertices.Add(new Point(lastX, lastY));
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.MoveTo, 0));
			}
		}

		private void ParseLineTo(string content)
		{
			List<int> list = PrepareParameters(content);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i += 2)
			{
				lastX = list[i];
				lastY = ((i + 1 < list.Count) ? list[i + 1] : 0);
				vertices.Add(new Point(lastX, lastY));
				num++;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				AddMsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.LineTo, num);
			}
		}

		private void ParseCurveTo(string content)
		{
			List<int> list = PrepareParameters(content);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i += 6)
			{
				vertices.Add(new Point(list[i], (i + 1 < list.Count) ? list[i + 1] : 0));
				vertices.Add(new Point((i + 2 < list.Count) ? list[i + 2] : 0, (i + 3 < list.Count) ? list[i + 3] : 0));
				lastX = ((i + 4 < list.Count) ? list[i + 4] : 0);
				lastY = ((i + 5 < list.Count) ? list[i + 5] : 0);
				vertices.Add(new Point(lastX, lastY));
				num++;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				AddMsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.CurveTo, num);
			}
		}

		{

				lastX += ((i + 4 < list.Count) ? list[i + 4] : 0);

		private void ParseAngleEllipseCore(string content, MsoPathEscape command)
		{
			List<int> list = PrepareParameters(content);

			{
				int x = list[i];
				int y = ((i + 1 < list.Count) ? list[i + 1] : 0);
				vertices.Add(new Point(x, y));
				int x2 = ((i + 2 < list.Count) ? list[i + 2] : 0);
				int y2 = ((i + 3 < list.Count) ? list[i + 3] : 0);
				vertices.Add(new Point(x2, y2));
				int num2 = ((i + 4 < list.Count) ? list[i + 4] : 0);
				int num3 = ((i + 5 < list.Count) ? list[i + 5] : 0);
				lastX = num2;
				lastY = num3;
				vertices.Add(new Point(lastX, lastY));
				num += 3;
			}
			if (num > 0)

	internal static class VmlFormulaParser
	{
		private static object syncFormulaTypeTable = new object();

		private static Dictionary<string, ModelShapeGuideFormulaType> formulaTypeTable;

		private static Dictionary<string, ModelShapeGuideFormulaType> FormulaTypeTable
		{
			get
			{
				if (formulaTypeTable == null)
				{
					lock (syncFormulaTypeTable)
					{
						if (formulaTypeTable == null)
						{
							formulaTypeTable = CreateFormulaTypeTable();
						}
					}
				}
				return formulaTypeTable;
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, ModelShapeGuideFormulaType> CreateFormulaTypeTable()
		{
			Dictionary<string, ModelShapeGuideFormulaType> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, ModelShapeGuideFormulaType>();
			dictionary.Add("val", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Value);
			dictionary.Add("sum", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.AddSubtract);
			dictionary.Add("prod", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.MultiplyDivide);
			dictionary.Add("mid", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Mid);
			dictionary.Add("abs", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Abs);
			dictionary.Add("min", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Min);
			dictionary.Add("max", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Max);
			dictionary.Add("if", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.IfElse);
			dictionary.Add("mod", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Mod);
			dictionary.Add("atan2", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.ArcTan);
			dictionary.Add("sin", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Sin);
			dictionary.Add("cos", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Cos);
			dictionary.Add("cosatan2", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.CosArcTan);
			dictionary.Add("sinatan2", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.SinArcTan);
			dictionary.Add("sqrt", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Sqrt);
			dictionary.Add("tan", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Tan);
			dictionary.Add("sumangle", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.SumAngle);
			dictionary.Add("ellipse", ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Ellipse);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static ModelShapeGuideFormula Parse(string formula)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formula))
			{
				return ModelShapeGuideFormula.Empty;
			}
			string[] array = formula.Split(new char[1] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return ModelShapeGuideFormula.Empty;
			}
			string value = array[0];
			string value2 = ((array.Length >= 2) ? UpdateArgument(array[1]) : string.Empty);
			string value3 = ((array.Length >= 3) ? UpdateArgument(array[2]) : string.Empty);
			string value4 = ((array.Length >= 4) ? UpdateArgument(array[3]) : string.Empty);
			ModelShapeGuideFormulaType formulaType = GetFormulaType(value);
			AdjustableCoordinate arg = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(value2);
			AdjustableCoordinate arg2 = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(value3);
			AdjustableCoordinate arg3 = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(value4);
			return new ModelShapeGuideFormula(formulaType, arg, arg2, arg3);
		}

		private static string UpdateArgument(string arg)
		{
			if (arg.StartsWith("#"))
			{
				arg = "adj" + arg.Substring(1);
				return arg;
			}
			if (arg.StartsWith("@"))
			{
				arg = "G" + arg.Substring(1);
				return arg;
			}
			return arg;
		}

		private static ModelShapeGuideFormulaType GetFormulaType(string value)
		{
			if (!FormulaTypeTable.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				return ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Undefined;
			}
			return value2;
		}
	}

	public class VmlShapeStyleProperties : Dictionary<string, string>
	{
		public string GetProperty(string propertyName)
		{

				return string.Empty;

			return value;
		}
	}
	public abstract class VmlDrawingDestinationBase : ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private static readonly ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> handlerTable = CreateElementHandlerTable();

		private VmlShapeProtections shapeProtections;

		protected IOfficeShape CanvasShape;

		protected VmlShapeTypeTable ShapeTypeTable;

		protected override ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> ElementHandlerTable => handlerTable;

		protected string Id { get; private set; }

		protected VmlGroupEditAs EditAs { get; private set; }

		protected VmlShapeStyleProperties StyleProperties { get; private set; }

		public GroupShapeProperties GroupShapeProperties { get; private set; }

		public GroupShapeLocks GroupShapeLocks { get; private set; }

		private static ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> CreateElementHandlerTable()
		{
			ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter> val = new ElementHandlerTable<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>();
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("shapetype", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnShapeType);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("lock", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnShapeProtections);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("shape", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnShape);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("rect", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnRect);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("roundrect", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnRoundRect);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("oval", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnOval);
			((Dictionary<string, ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>>)(object)val).Add("group", (ElementHandler<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)OnGroup);
			return val;
		}

		protected VmlDrawingDestinationBase(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, VmlShapeTypeTable shapeTypeTable)
			: base(importer)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)shapeTypeTable, "shapeTypeTable");
			ShapeTypeTable = shapeTypeTable;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (!(reader.LocalName != "group"))
			{
				EditAs = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "editas", OpenXmlExporterBase.VmlGroupEditAsTable, VmlGroupEditAs.None);
				CreateAndProcessGroupInstance(EditAs);
				Id = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "id");
				VmlCoordUnit vmlCoordUnit = new VmlCoordUnit(21600, 21600);
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.PrepareCoordSize(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "coordsize"), vmlCoordUnit);
				VmlCoordUnit vmlCoordUnit2 = new VmlCoordUnit();
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.PrepareCoordOrigin(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "coordorigin"), vmlCoordUnit2);
				StyleProperties = new VmlShapeStyleProperties();
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.PrepareShapeStyleProperties(StyleProperties, ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "style"));
				GroupShapeProperties = new GroupShapeProperties(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentModel);
				DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
				GroupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D.SetCxCore(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(vmlCoordUnit.X));
				GroupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D.SetCyCore(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(vmlCoordUnit.Y));
				GroupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D.SetOffsetXCore(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(vmlCoordUnit2.X));
				GroupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D.SetOffsetYCore(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(vmlCoordUnit2.Y));
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupShapeTransform(GroupShapeProperties.Transform2D, StyleProperties);
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessElementClose(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (!(reader.LocalName != "group"))
			{
				SetupGroupShapeLocks();
				OnGroupHandled();
			}
		}

		private void SetupGroupShapeLocks()
		{
			if (shapeProtections != null)
			{
				GroupShapeLocks = new GroupShapeLocks(new CommonDrawingLocks(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentModel.MainPart));
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupGroupShapeProtections(GroupShapeLocks, shapeProtections);
			}
		}

		protected abstract IOfficeShape CreateShapeInstance();

		protected abstract VmlDrawingDestinationBase CreateVmlGroupDestination();

		protected abstract void ProcessShapeOpen(IOfficeShape shape);

		protected abstract void ProcessShapeClose(IOfficeShape shape, OfficeVmlShape vmlShape);

		protected abstract void CreateAndProcessGroupInstance(VmlGroupEditAs editAs);

		protected abstract void OnGroupHandled();

		protected abstract Destination CreateTextBoxContentDestination();

		private static VmlDrawingDestinationBase GetThis(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer)
		{
			return (VmlDrawingDestinationBase)(object)importer.PeekDestination();
		}

		private IOfficeShape PrepareShape()
		{
			IOfficeShape officeShape = CreateShapeInstance();
			if (EditAs == VmlGroupEditAs.Canvas && CanvasShape == null)
			{
				CanvasShape = officeShape;
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessShapeOpen(officeShape);
			}
			return officeShape;
		}

		private static Destination OnShapeType(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			return (Destination)(object)new VmlDrawingShapeTypeDestination(importer, GetThis(importer).ShapeTypeTable);
		}

		private static Destination OnShape(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			IOfficeShape shape = GetThis(importer).PrepareShape();
			return (Destination)(object)new VmlShapeDestination(importer, shape, GetThis(importer).ShapeTypeTable, GetThis(importer).CreateTextBoxContentDestination(), GetThis(importer).ProcessShapeClose);
		}

		private static Destination OnRect(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			IOfficeShape shape = GetThis(importer).PrepareShape();
			return (Destination)(object)new VmlRectDestination(importer, shape, GetThis(importer).ShapeTypeTable, GetThis(importer).CreateTextBoxContentDestination(), GetThis(importer).ProcessShapeClose);
		}

		private static Destination OnRoundRect(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			IOfficeShape shape = GetThis(importer).PrepareShape();
			return (Destination)(object)new VmlRoundRectDestination(importer, shape, GetThis(importer).ShapeTypeTable, GetThis(importer).CreateTextBoxContentDestination(), GetThis(importer).ProcessShapeClose);
		}

		private static Destination OnOval(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, XmlReader reader)
		{
			IOfficeShape shape = GetThis(importer).PrepareShape();

		}

		private void PrepareLimo(string s)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s))
			{
				string[] array = s.Split(',');
				if (array.Length != 2)
				{
					((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
				}
				if (int.TryParse(array[0], NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
				{
					shapePath.LimoX = result;
				}
				if (int.TryParse(array[1], NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result))
				{
					shapePath.LimoX = result;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public VmlShapeDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, IOfficeShape shape, VmlShapeTypeTable shapeTypeTable, Destination textBoxContentDestination, Action<IOfficeShape, OfficeVmlShape> processClose)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.shape = shape;
			this.shapeTypeTable = shapeTypeTable;
			this.textBoxContentDestination = textBoxContentDestination;
			VmlShape = new OfficeVmlShape(shape.DocumentModel);
			this.processClose = processClose;
