		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			VmlShape.Id = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "id");
			VmlShape.SpId = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "spid", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office");
			string text = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "type");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = text.TrimStart('#');
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				LookUpVmlShapeType(text);
			}
			string text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "path");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				VmlShape.Path = text2;
			}
			PrepareAdjustValues(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "adj"));
			VmlDrawingImportHelper.PrepareCoordSize(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "coordsize"), VmlShape.CoordSize);
			VmlDrawingImportHelper.PrepareCoordOrigin(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "coordorigin"), VmlShape.CoordOrigin);
			VmlDrawingImportHelper.PrepareShapeStyleProperties(VmlShape.ShapeStyleProperties, ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "style"));
			bool? onOffNullValue = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetOnOffNullValue(reader, "filled");
			if (onOffNullValue.HasValue)
			{
				VmlShape.Filled = onOffNullValue;
			}
			VmlShape.FillColor = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetVmlSTColorValue(reader, "fillcolor", VmlShape.FillColor);
			VmlShape.InsetMode = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "insetmode", OpenXmlExporterBase.VmlInsetModeTable, VmlInsetMode.Custom, "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office");
			VmlShape.AltText = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "alt");
			VmlShape.StrokeColor = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetVmlSTColorValue(reader, "strokecolor", VmlShape.StrokeColor);
			VmlShape.StrokeWeight = VmlLineStrokeSettingsDestination.ConvertStrokeWeight(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "strokeweight"), ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter, VmlShape.StrokeWeight);
			onOffNullValue = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetOnOffNullValue(reader, "stroked");
			if (onOffNullValue.HasValue)
			{
				VmlShape.Stroked = onOffNullValue;
			}
			VmlShape.BlackAndWhiteMode = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "bwmode", OpenXmlExporterBase.VmlBlackAndWhiteModeTable, VmlShape.BlackAndWhiteMode, "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office");
		}

		private void LookUpVmlShapeType(string value)
		{
			if (!shapeTypeTable.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = TryGetPresetShapeType(value);
			}
			if (value2 != null)
			{
				VmlShape.CopyFrom(value2);
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessElementClose(XmlReader reader)
		{
			SetupShapeProperies();
			processClose(Shape, VmlShape);
		}

		private void PrepareAdjustValues(string value)
		{
			VmlDrawingImportHelper.PrepareAdjustValues(VmlShape.AdjustValues, value);
		}

		private void SetupShapeProperies()
		{
			SetupShapePreset();
			SetupSize();
			SetupTransform();
			SetupShapeGeometry();
			SetupFillProperties();
			SetupOutlineProperties();
			SetupShadowProperties();
			SetupBlackAndWhiteMode();
			SetupShapeProtections();
		}

		protected virtual void SetupShapePreset()
		{
			Shape.ShapeProperties.ShapeType = BinaryDrawingImportHelper.GetShapeType((int)VmlShape.Spt, ShapePreset.None);
		}

		private void SetupSize()
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)this).Importer.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			ShapeWidth = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetModelUnitValue(VmlShape.ShapeStyleProperties.GetProperty("width"), unitConverter);
			ShapeHeight = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetModelUnitValue(VmlShape.ShapeStyleProperties.GetProperty("height"), unitConverter);
		}

		private void SetupShapeGeometry()
		{
			if (Shape.ShapeProperties.ShapeType != ShapePreset.None)
			{
				SetupAdjustValues();
			}
			else
			{
				SetupCustomGeometry();
			}
		}

		private void SetupTransform()
		{
			VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupShapeTransform(Shape.ShapeProperties.Transform2D, VmlShape.ShapeStyleProperties);
		}

		private void SetupFillProperties()
		{
			if (VmlShape.ImageData != null && VmlShape.ImageData.Image != null)
			{
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupImageData(shape.ShapeProperties, VmlShape.ImageData);
			}
			else if (VmlShape.GetFilled())
			{
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupDrawingFill(Shape.ShapeProperties, VmlShape.Fill, VmlShape.FillColor);
			}
			else
			{
				Shape.ShapeProperties.Fill = DrawingFill.None;
			}
		}

		private void SetupOutlineProperties()
		{
			if (VmlShape.GetStroked())
			{
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupOutlineProperties(Shape.ShapeProperties, VmlShape.Stroke, VmlShape.StrokeColor, VmlShape.StrokeWeight);
			}
			else
			{
				Shape.ShapeProperties.OutlineType = OutlineType.None;
			}
		}

		private void SetupShadowProperties()
		{
			if (VmlShape.GetShadowed())
			{
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupShadowProperties(shape.ShapeProperties, VmlShape.ShadowEffect);
			}
		}

		private void SetupBlackAndWhiteMode()
		{
			VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupBlackAndWhiteMode(shape.ShapeProperties, VmlShape.BlackAndWhiteMode);
		}

		private void SetupCustomGeometry()
		{
			string path = VmlShape.GetPath();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
			{
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupCustomGeometry(shape, path, VmlShape.Formulas, CreateNamedValues());
			}
		}

		private void SetupShapeProtections()
		{
			if (VmlShape.ShapeProtections != null)
			{
				VmlDrawingImportHelper.SetupShapeProtections(shape.Locks, VmlShape.ShapeProtections);
			}
		}

		private VmlShapeType TryGetPresetShapeType(string shapeType)
		{
			return VmlShapeTypePresets.GetVmlShapeType(shapeType);
		}

		protected virtual void SetupAdjustValues()
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = Shape.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			int shapeWidth = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(ShapeWidth);
			int shapeHeight = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(ShapeHeight);
			int?[] adjustValues = VmlShape.AdjustValues;
			AdjustValuesConverterFromBinaryFormat.Convert(shapeWidth, shapeHeight, Shape.ShapeProperties.ShapeType, adjustValues);
			Shape.ShapeProperties.SetupShapeAdjustList(adjustValues);
		}

		private VmlFormulaNamedValues CreateNamedValues()
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = shape.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			VmlFormulaNamedValues vmlFormulaNamedValues = new VmlFormulaNamedValues();
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.Width = VmlShape.CoordSize.X;
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.Height = VmlShape.CoordSize.Y;
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.CenterX = (VmlShape.CoordSize.X + VmlShape.CoordOrigin.X) / 2;
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.CenterY = (VmlShape.CoordSize.Y + VmlShape.CoordOrigin.Y) / 2;
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.PixelLineWidth = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToPixels(VmlShape.StrokeWeight);
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.EmuWidth = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(ShapeWidth);
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.EmuHeight = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(ShapeHeight);
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.EmuWidth2 = vmlFormulaNamedValues.EmuWidth / 2;
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.EmuHeight2 = vmlFormulaNamedValues.EmuHeight / 2;
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.LineDrawn = VmlShape.GetStroked();
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.PixelWidth = (int)Math.Round(unitConverter.ModelUnitsToPixelsF(ShapeWidth));
			vmlFormulaNamedValues.PixelHeight = (int)Math.Round(unitConverter.ModelUnitsToPixelsF(ShapeHeight));
			if (VmlShape.ShapePath != null)
			{
				vmlFormulaNamedValues.LimoX = VmlShape.ShapePath.LimoX;
				vmlFormulaNamedValues.LimoY = VmlShape.ShapePath.LimoY;
			}
			Array.Copy(VmlShape.AdjustValues, vmlFormulaNamedValues.AdjustValues, 8);
			return vmlFormulaNamedValues;
		}

	public class VmlShapeFillPropertiesDestination : LeafElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private readonly float[] vector2DDefaultValue = new float[2];

		private readonly VmlShapeFillProperties shapeFillProperties;

		public VmlShapeFillPropertiesDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, VmlShapeFillProperties shapeFillProperties)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.shapeFillProperties = shapeFillProperties;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			shapeFillProperties.Color = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetVmlSTColorValue(reader, "color", shapeFillProperties.Color);
			string text = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "color2");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				if (text.StartsWith("fill darken"))
				{
					shapeFillProperties.Color2 = VmlDrawingImportHelper.CreateDarkenColor(text, shapeFillProperties.Color);
				}
				else if (text.StartsWith("fill lighten"))
				{
					shapeFillProperties.Color2 = VmlDrawingImportHelper.CreateLightenColor(text, shapeFillProperties.Color);
				}
				else
				{
					shapeFillProperties.Color2 = VmlDrawingImportHelper.ParseColor(text, DXColor.White);
				}
			}
			shapeFillProperties.Filled = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetOnOffNullValue(reader, "on");
			shapeFillProperties.Opacity = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetWpSTFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(reader, "opacity", shapeFillProperties.Opacity, 65536f);
			string value = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "opacity2", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				shapeFillProperties.Opacity2 = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(value, shapeFillProperties.Opacity2, 65536f);
			}
			shapeFillProperties.Focus = VmlDrawingImportHelper.ReadPercentageAttribute(reader, "focus");
			shapeFillProperties.Method = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "method", OpenXmlExporterBase.VmlFillMethodTable, VmlFillMethod.Sigma);
			shapeFillProperties.Type = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "type", OpenXmlExporterBase.VmlFillTypeTable, VmlFillType.Solid);
			shapeFillProperties.Aspect = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "aspect", OpenXmlExporterBase.VmlImageAspectTable, VmlImageAspect.Ignore);
			shapeFillProperties.Recolor = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetOnOffValue(reader, "recolor", defaultValue: false);
			shapeFillProperties.Rotate = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetOnOffValue(reader, "rotate", defaultValue: false);
			shapeFillProperties.Title = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "title", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office");
			shapeFillProperties.Angle = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetWpSTFloatValue(reader, "angle", NumberStyles.Float, 0f);
			string text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "size");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				string[] array = SplitCoordinates(text2);
				shapeFillProperties.SizeX = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(array[0], 0f, 65536f);
				shapeFillProperties.SizeY = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(array[1], 0f, 65536f);
			}
			text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "origin");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				string[] array2 = SplitCoordinates(text2);
				shapeFillProperties.OriginX = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(array2[0], 0f, 65536f);
				shapeFillProperties.OriginY = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(array2[1], 0f, 65536f);
			}
			text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "position");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				string[] array3 = SplitCoordinates(text2);
				shapeFillProperties.PositionX = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(array3[0], 0f, 65536f);
				shapeFillProperties.PositionY = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(array3[1], 0f, 65536f);
			}
			text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "focusposition");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				float[] array4 = SplitVector2D(text2, vector2DDefaultValue);
				shapeFillProperties.FocusPosition.Left = array4[0];
				shapeFillProperties.FocusPosition.Top = array4[1];
			}
			text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "focussize");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				float[] array5 = SplitVector2D(text2, vector2DDefaultValue);
				shapeFillProperties.FocusSize.Width = array5[0];
				shapeFillProperties.FocusSize.Height = array5[1];
			}
			text2 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "colors");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				string[] array6 = text2.Split(new char[1] { ';' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				string[] array7 = array6;
				foreach (string text3 in array7)
				{
					string[] array8 = text3.Split(new char[1] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
					float floatOrVulgarFractionValue = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(array8[0], 0f, 65536f);
					Color color = VmlDrawingImportHelper.ParseColor(array8[1], DXColor.White);
					OfficeShadeColor item = new OfficeShadeColor(color, floatOrVulgarFractionValue);
					shapeFillProperties.Colors.Add(item);
				}
			}
			string text4 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "relid", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
			{
				text4 = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "id", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships");
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
			{
				shapeFillProperties.EmbeddedImage = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.LookupImageByRelationId(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentModel, text4, ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.DocumentRootFolder);
			}
		}

		private string[] SplitCoordinates(string temp)
		{
			string[] array = temp.Split(',');
			if (array.Length != 2)
			{
				((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ThrowInvalidFile();
			}
			return array;
		}

		private float[] SplitVector2D(string value, float[] defaultValue)
		{
			string[] array = value.Split(',');
			int num = Math.Min(2, array.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				defaultValue[i] = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrPercentageValue(array[i]);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}
	}
	public class VmlShadowEffectDestination : LeafElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>
	{
		private readonly VmlShadowEffect shadowEffect;

		public VmlShadowEffectDestination(DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter importer, VmlShadowEffect shadowEffect)
			: base(importer)
		{
			this.shadowEffect = shadowEffect;
		}

		public override void ProcessElementOpen(XmlReader reader)
		{
			shadowEffect.Color = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetVmlSTColorValue(reader, "color", shadowEffect.Color);
			shadowEffect.Color2 = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetVmlSTColorValue(reader, "color2", shadowEffect.Color2);
			shadowEffect.Obscured = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetOnOffValue(reader, "obscured", defaultValue: false);
			string text = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "on");
			if (text != null)
			{
				shadowEffect.On = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetOnOffValue(text, defaultValue: true);
			}
			shadowEffect.Opacity = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "opacity"), shadowEffect.Opacity, 65536f);
			shadowEffect.ShadowType = ((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.GetWpEnumValue(reader, "type", OpenXmlExporterBase.VmlShadowTypeTable, shadowEffect.ShadowType);
			PrepareMatrix(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "matrix"), shadowEffect.Matrix);
			PrepareOffset(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "offset"), shadowEffect.Offset);
			PrepareOffset(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "offset2"), shadowEffect.Offset2);
			PrepareOrigin(((ElementDestination<DestinationAndXmlBasedImporter>)(object)this).Importer.ReadAttribute(reader, "origin"));
		}

		private void PrepareOrigin(string value)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				string[] array = value.Split(new char[1] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.None);
				string value2 = ((array.Length != 0) ? array[0] : string.Empty);
				string value3 = ((array.Length > 1) ? array[1] : string.Empty);
				shadowEffect.OriginX = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrPercentageValue(value2);
				shadowEffect.OriginY = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrPercentageValue(value3);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareMatrix(string value, VmlMatrix matrix)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				string[] array = value.Split(new char[1] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.None);
				string value2 = ((array.Length != 0) ? array[0] : string.Empty);
				string value3 = ((array.Length > 1) ? array[1] : string.Empty);
				string value4 = ((array.Length > 2) ? array[2] : string.Empty);
				string value5 = ((array.Length > 3) ? array[3] : string.Empty);
				string value6 = ((array.Length > 4) ? array[4] : string.Empty);
				string value7 = ((array.Length > 5) ? array[5] : string.Empty);
				matrix.Sxx = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(value2, matrix.Sxx, 65536f);
				matrix.Sxy = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(value3, matrix.Sxy, 65536f);
				matrix.Syx = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(value4, matrix.Syx, 65536f);
				matrix.Syy = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(value5, matrix.Syy, 65536f);
				matrix.Px = VmlDrawingImportHelper.GetFloatOrVulgarFractionValue(value6, matrix.Px, 65536f);

	public class VmlUnitConverter
	{
		private readonly DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter;

		public VmlUnitConverter(DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
		}

		public int ToModelUnits(DXVmlUnit unit)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round(ToModelUnitsF(unit));
		}

		public float ToModelUnitsF(DXVmlUnit unit)
		{
			return unit.Type switch
			{
				DXUnitType.Cm => unitConverter.CentimetersToModelUnitsF(unit.Value), 
				DXUnitType.Mm => unitConverter.MillimetersToModelUnitsF(unit.Value), 
				DXUnitType.Inch => unitConverter.InchesToModelUnitsF(unit.Value), 
				DXUnitType.Point => unitConverter.PointsToModelUnitsF(unit.Value), 
				DXUnitType.Pica => unitConverter.PicasToModelUnitsF(unit.Value), 
				DXUnitType.Pixel => unitConverter.PointsToModelUnitsF(unit.Value), 
				_ => unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF((int)Math.Round(unit.Value)), 
			};
		}
	}

		private string RaiseStoredPasswordRequested()
		{
			using OpenXmlEncryptedFilePasswordRequestedEventArgs e = new OpenXmlEncryptedFilePasswordRequestedEventArgs();
			this.StoredPasswordRequested?.Invoke(this, e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return e.Password;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool RaisePasswordRequired()
		{
			using OpenXmlEncryptedFilePasswordRequestedEventArgs e = new OpenXmlEncryptedFilePasswordRequestedEventArgs();
			this.PasswordRequested?.Invoke(this, e);
			TempPassword = null;
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			cancelImport = e.Cancel;
			TempPassword = e.Password;
			return true;
		}

		private bool RaisePasswordCheckFailed(EncryptionSessionError decryptionError)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			{
				return false;
			}
			OpenXmlEncryptedFilePasswordCheckFailedEventArgs e = new OpenXmlEncryptedFilePasswordCheckFailedEventArgs(decryptionError);
			this.PasswordCheckFailed?.Invoke(this, e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			cancelImport = !e.TryAgain;
			return e.TryAgain;
		}

		private bool RaiseIntegrityCheckFailed()
		{
			OpenXmlEncryptedFileIntegrityCheckFailedEventArgs e = new OpenXmlEncryptedFileIntegrityCheckFailedEventArgs();
			this.IntegrityCheckFailed?.Invoke(this, e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			cancelImport = e.Cancel;
			return true;
		}

		public void EndSetMainDocumentContent(EncryptionOptions options)
		{
			EncryptionSession obj = session;
			EncryptionPassword obj2 = encryptionPassword;
			options.PreserveSession((IEncryptionSession)(object)obj, (obj2 != null) ? obj2.Password : null);
			InvalidatePassword();
		}

		private void InvalidatePassword()
		{
			EncryptionPassword obj = encryptionPassword;
			if (obj != null)
			{
				obj.Dispose();
			}
			encryptionPassword = null;
			EncryptionPassword obj2 = tempPassword;
			if (obj2 != null)
			{
				obj2.Dispose();
			}
			tempPassword = null;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~OpenXmlEncryptionManager()
		{

		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{

			{
				InvalidatePassword();
			}
		}
	}

			CalculateConnectorCore(adjustValues, 10800, adjCount);
		}

		private static void CalculateCurvedConnectorCore(int?[] adjustValues, int adjCount)
		{
			CalculateConnectorCore(adjustValues, 0, adjCount);
		}

		private static void CalculateConnectorCore(int?[] adjustValues, int odrawAdj, int adjCount)
		{
			double num = 4.62962962962963;
			for (int i = 0; i < adjCount; i++)
			{
				int value = (int)Math.Round((double)(adjustValues[i] ?? odrawAdj) * num);
				adjustValues[i] = value;
			}
		}

		private static void CalculateProportionalValues(int?[] adjustValues, double value)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < adjustValues.Length && adjustValues[i].HasValue; i++)
			{
				adjustValues[i] = (int)((double?)adjustValues[i] * value).Value;
			}
		}

		private static int Pin(int x, int y, int z)
		{
			if (y >= x)
			{
				if (y <= z)
				{
					return y;
				}
				return z;
			}
			return x;
		}

		public static List<long> GetWordArtAdjustValues(DrawingPresetTextWarp presetTextWarp, float shapeWidth, float shapeHeight, int?[] adjs)
		{
			int? value = adjs[0];
			int? value2 = adjs[1];
			List<long> list = new List<long>();
			switch (presetTextWarp)
			{
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchDown:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj5(value, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, 0L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchDownPour:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj5(value, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, 0L));
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj1(value2, 50000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchUp:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj5(value, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, 10800000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchUpPour:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj5(value, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, 10800000L));
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj1(value2, 50000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Button:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj5(value, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, 10800000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ButtonPour:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj5(value, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, 10800000L));
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj1(value2, 50000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CanDown:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 14287L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CanUp:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 85713L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CascadeDown:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 44444L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CascadeUp:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 44444L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Chevron:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 25000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ChevronInverted:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 75000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Circle:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj5(value, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, 10810281L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CirclePour:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj5(value, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, 10810281L));
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj1(value2, 50000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CurveDown:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 43477L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CurveUp:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 45977L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Deflate:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 18750L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.DeflateBottom:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 53125L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.DeflateInflate:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 28028L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateDeflate:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 28028L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.DeflateTop:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 46875L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.DoubleWave1:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 6500L));
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj2(value2, 0L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeDown:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 33333L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeLeft:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeRight:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeUp:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 33333L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Inflate:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 13634L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateBottom:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 68083L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateTop:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 31917L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Plain:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 50000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.RingInside:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.RingOutside:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 62500L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.SlantDown:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 44444L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.SlantUp:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 55556L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Stop:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 22222L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Triangle:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.TriangleInverted:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 50000L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave1:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave2:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 13005L));
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj2(value2, 0L));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave4:
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj3(value, 6500L));
				list.Add(ConvertWordArtAdj2(value2, 0L));
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.NoShape:
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static long ConvertWordArtAdj1(int? value, long defaultValue)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return (long)((double?)value * 9.259).Value;
		}

		private static long ConvertWordArtAdj2(int? value, long defaultValue)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return (long)((double?)(value - 10800) / 0.216).Value;
		}

		private static long ConvertWordArtAdj3(int? value, long defaultValue)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return (long)((double?)value * 4.63).Value;
		}

		private static long ConvertWordArtAdj5(int? value, double width, double height, long defaultValue)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			double num = (double)value.Value / 65536.0;
			num %= 360.0;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num += 360.0;
			}
			double a = num / 180.0 * Math.PI;
			double num2 = Math.Atan(Math.Tan(a) * height / width) / Math.PI * 180.0;
			if (90.0 < num && num <= 270.0)
			{
				return (long)((180.0 + num2) % 360.0 * 60000.0);
			}
			return (long)((360.0 + num2) % 360.0 * 60000.0);
		}
	}
	internal class XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<int, AdjustableCoordinate> intValues;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, AdjustableCoordinate> stringValues;

		public XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache()
		{
			intValues = new Dictionary<int, AdjustableCoordinate>();
			stringValues = new Dictionary<string, AdjustableCoordinate>();
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(int value)
		{
			if (!intValues.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = new AdjustableCoordinate(value);
				intValues.Add(value, value2);
			}
			return value2;
		}

		public AdjustableCoordinate GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(0);
			}
			if (!stringValues.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = AdjustableCoordinate.FromString(value);
				if (value2 != null)
				{
					stringValues.Add(value, value2);
				}
			}
			return value2;
		}
	}
	internal class XlsAdjustableAngleCache : Dictionary<int, AdjustableAngle>
	{
		public AdjustableAngle GetCachedAdjustableAngle(int value)
		{
			if (!TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = new AdjustableAngle(value);
				Add(value, value2);
			}
			return value2;
		}
	}

		private static Dictionary<int, string> ShapeGuideCalculatedParamDescriptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (shapeGuideCalculatedParamDescriptions == null)
				{
					lock (syncShapeGuideCalculatedParamDescriptions)
					{
						if (shapeGuideCalculatedParamDescriptions == null)
						{
							shapeGuideCalculatedParamDescriptions = CreateShapeGuideCalculatedParamDescriptions();
						}
					}
				}
				return shapeGuideCalculatedParamDescriptions;
			}
		}

		public static void SetupShapeCustomGeometry(IOfficeShape shape, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = shape.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			int widthEmu = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(shape.Width);
			int heightEmu = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(shape.Height);
			SetupShapeCustomGeometry(shape.ShapeProperties.CustomGeometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, artProperties);
		}

		public static void SetupShapeCustomGeometry(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (artProperties != null)
			{
				SetupShapeCustomGeometry(customGeometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, artProperties.Properties);
			}
		}

		public static void SetupShapeCustomGeometry(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, IEnumerable<object> properties)
		{
			Rectangle shapeGeometrySpace = GetShapeGeometrySpace(properties);
			int width = shapeGeometrySpace.Width;
			int height = shapeGeometrySpace.Height;
			ModelShapePath modelShapePath = new ModelShapePath(customGeometry.DocumentModelPart);
			modelShapePath.Width = width;
			modelShapePath.Height = height;
			customGeometry.Paths.Add(modelShapePath);
			XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache = new XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache();
			XlsAdjustableAngleCache adjustableAngleCache = new XlsAdjustableAngleCache();
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry = CreateFakeCustomGeometry(properties, widthEmu, heightEmu, customGeometry.DocumentModelPart.DocumentModel.UnitConverter, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			ShapeGuideCalculator calculator = new ShapeGuideCalculator(geometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, new ModelShapeGuideList(FakeDocumentModel.Instance));
			Point[] array = CalculatePoints(GetDrawingGeometryVertices(properties), calculator);
			if (array != null)
			{
				MsoPathInfo[] drawingGeometrySegmentInfos = GetDrawingGeometrySegmentInfos(properties);
				switch ((drawingGeometrySegmentInfos != null && drawingGeometrySegmentInfos.Length != 0) ? ShapePathType.Complex : GetShapePathType(properties))
				{
				case ShapePathType.Lines:
					CreateLinesPath(array, closed: false, modelShapePath, adjustableCoordinateCache);
					break;
				case ShapePathType.LinesClosed:
					CreateLinesPath(array, closed: true, modelShapePath, adjustableCoordinateCache);
					break;
				case ShapePathType.Curves:
					CreateCurvesPath(array, closed: false, modelShapePath, adjustableCoordinateCache);
					break;
				case ShapePathType.CurvesClosed:
					CreateCurvesPath(array, closed: true, modelShapePath, adjustableCoordinateCache);
					break;
				case ShapePathType.Complex:
					CreateComplexPath(customGeometry, drawingGeometrySegmentInfos, array, adjustableCoordinateCache, adjustableAngleCache);
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				Point[] connectionSitesPoints = CalculatePoints(GetConnectionSites(properties), calculator);
				CreateConnectionSites(connectionSitesPoints, GetConnectionSitesDirections(properties), customGeometry, adjustableCoordinateCache, adjustableAngleCache);
			}
		}

		private static Point[] CalculatePoints(DrawingGeometryPoint[] points, ShapeGuideCalculator calculator)
		{
			if (points == null || points.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Point[] array = new Point[points.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				DrawingGeometryPoint drawingGeometryPoint = points[i];
				int x = (int)Math.Round(drawingGeometryPoint.X.IsConstant ? ((double)drawingGeometryPoint.X.Value) : calculator.GetGuideValue("G" + drawingGeometryPoint.X.GuideIndex));
				int y = (int)Math.Round(drawingGeometryPoint.Y.IsConstant ? ((double)drawingGeometryPoint.Y.Value) : calculator.GetGuideValue("G" + drawingGeometryPoint.Y.GuideIndex));
				Point point = new Point(x, y);
				array[i] = point;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static ModelShapeCustomGeometry CreateFakeCustomGeometry(IEnumerable<object> properties, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry modelShapeCustomGeometry = new ModelShapeCustomGeometry(FakeDocumentModel.Instance);
			SetupCustomAdjustValues(modelShapeCustomGeometry, properties, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			SetupCalculatedValues(modelShapeCustomGeometry, properties, widthEmu, heightEmu, unitConverter, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			SetupShapeGuides(modelShapeCustomGeometry, properties, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			return modelShapeCustomGeometry;
		}

		private static void SetupCalculatedValues(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, IEnumerable<object> properties, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			Rectangle shapeGeometrySpace = GetShapeGeometrySpace(properties);
			Point point = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(shapeGeometrySpace);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "xcenter", point.X, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "ycenter", point.Y, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "width", shapeGeometrySpace.Width, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "height", shapeGeometrySpace.Height, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "xlimo", GetLimoX(properties), adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "ylimo", GetLimoY(properties), adjustableCoordinateCache);
			DrawingLineStyleBooleanProperties drawingLineBooleanProperties = GetDrawingLineBooleanProperties(properties);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "lineDrawn", (drawingLineBooleanProperties != null && drawingLineBooleanProperties.UseLine && drawingLineBooleanProperties.Line) ? 1 : 0, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "pixellinewidth", unitConverter.ModelUnitsToPixels(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnits(GetLineWidthInEMUs(properties))), adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "pixelwidth", unitConverter.ModelUnitsToPixels(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnits(widthEmu)), adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "pixelheight", unitConverter.ModelUnitsToPixels(unitConverter.EmuToModelUnits(heightEmu)), adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "emuwidth", widthEmu, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "emuheight", heightEmu, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "emuwidth2", widthEmu / 2, adjustableCoordinateCache);
			AddGuide(customGeometry, "emuheight2", heightEmu / 2, adjustableCoordinateCache);
		}

		private static void AddGuide(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, string name, int value, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			ModelShapeGuideFormula formula = new ModelShapeGuideFormula(ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Value, adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(value), null, null);
			ModelShapeGuide item = new ModelShapeGuide(name, formula);
			customGeometry.Guides.Add(item);
		}

		private static void SetupCustomAdjustValues(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, IEnumerable<object> properties, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			int?[] adjustValues = GetAdjustValues(properties);
			for (int i = 0; i < adjustValues.Length; i++)
			{
				if (adjustValues[i].HasValue)
				{
					ModelShapeGuideFormula formula = new ModelShapeGuideFormula(ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Value, adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(adjustValues[i].Value), null, null);
					customGeometry.AdjustValues.Add(new ModelShapeGuide("adj" + (i + 1), formula));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SetupShapeGuides(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, IEnumerable<object> properties, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			ShapeGuide[] shapeGuides = GetShapeGuides(properties);
			if (shapeGuides != null && shapeGuides.Length != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < shapeGuides.Length; i++)
				{
					ModelShapeGuideFormula formula = CreateModelShapeGuideFormula(shapeGuides[i], adjustableCoordinateCache);
					ModelShapeGuide item = new ModelShapeGuide("G" + i, formula);
					customGeometry.Guides.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private static ModelShapeGuideFormula CreateModelShapeGuideFormula(ShapeGuide guide, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			ModelShapeGuideFormulaType type = ConvertFormulaType(guide.Formula);
			AdjustableCoordinate arg = (guide.CalculatedParam1 ? CalculateShapeGuideParam(guide.Param1, adjustableCoordinateCache) : adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(guide.Param1));
			AdjustableCoordinate arg2 = (guide.CalculatedParam2 ? CalculateShapeGuideParam(guide.Param2, adjustableCoordinateCache) : adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(guide.Param2));
			AdjustableCoordinate arg3 = (guide.CalculatedParam3 ? CalculateShapeGuideParam(guide.Param3, adjustableCoordinateCache) : adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(guide.Param3));
			return new ModelShapeGuideFormula(type, arg, arg2, arg3);
		}

		private static AdjustableCoordinate CalculateShapeGuideParam(int value, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			if (value >= 1024 && value <= 1151)
			{
				return adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate("G" + (value - 1024));
			}
			if (ShapeGuideCalculatedParamDescriptions.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
			{
				return adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(value2);
			}
			return adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(0);
		}

		private static ModelShapeGuideFormulaType ConvertFormulaType(ShapeGuideFormula formula)
		{
			return formula switch
			{
				ShapeGuideFormula.Sum => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.AddSubtract, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Product => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.MultiplyDivide, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Mid => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Mid, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Absolute => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Abs, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Min => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Min, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Max => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Max, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.If => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.IfElse, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Mod => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Mod, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.ATan2 => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.ArcTan, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Sin => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Sin, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Cos => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Cos, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.CosATan2 => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.CosArcTan, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.SinATan2 => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.SinArcTan, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Sqrt => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Sqrt, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.SumAngle => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.SumAngle, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Ellipse => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Ellipse, 
				ShapeGuideFormula.Tan => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Tan, 
				_ => ModelShapeGuideFormulaType.Undefined, 
			};
		}

		private static void CreateConnectionSites(Point[] connectionSitesPoints, FixedPoint[] connectionSitesDirPoints, ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache, XlsAdjustableAngleCache adjustableAngleCache)
		{
			if (connectionSitesPoints != null && connectionSitesDirPoints != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(connectionSitesPoints.Length, connectionSitesDirPoints.Length); i++)
				{
					Point point = connectionSitesPoints[i];
					FixedPoint fixedPoint = connectionSitesDirPoints[i];
					int value = (int)Math.Round(fixedPoint.Value * 60000.0);
					ModelShapeConnection item = new ModelShapeConnection(adjustableAngleCache.GetCachedAdjustableAngle(value), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(point.X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(point.Y));
					geometry.ConnectionSites.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Rectangle GetShapeGeometrySpace(IEnumerable<object> properties)
		{
			int left = 0;
			int right = 21600;
			int top = 0;
			int bottom = 21600;
			foreach (object property in properties)
			{
				if (property is OfficeDrawingIntPropertyBase officeDrawingIntPropertyBase)
				{
					if (property is DrawingGeometryLeft)
					{
						left = officeDrawingIntPropertyBase.Value;
					}
					else if (property is DrawingGeometryRight)
					{
						right = officeDrawingIntPropertyBase.Value;
					}
					else if (property is DrawingGeometryTop)
					{
						top = officeDrawingIntPropertyBase.Value;
					}
					else if (property is DrawingGeometryBottom)
					{
						bottom = officeDrawingIntPropertyBase.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			return Rectangle.FromLTRB(left, top, right, bottom);
		}

		internal static void CreateComplexPath(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, MsoPathInfo[] msoPathInfos, Point[] points, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache, XlsAdjustableAngleCache adjustableAngleCache)
		{
			if (points != null && points.Length != 0 && msoPathInfos != null && msoPathInfos.Length != 0)
			{
				CustomGeometryPathBuilder customGeometryPathBuilder = new CustomGeometryPathBuilder(customGeometry, points, msoPathInfos, adjustableCoordinateCache, adjustableAngleCache);
				customGeometryPathBuilder.CreateComplexPath();
			}
		}

		private static void CreateLinesPath(Point[] points, bool closed, ModelShapePath path, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			if (points != null && points.Length != 0)
			{
				path.Instructions.Add(new PathMove(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[0].X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[0].Y)));
				for (int i = 1; i < points.Length; i++)
				{
					path.Instructions.Add(new PathLine(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[i].X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[i].Y)));
				}
				if (closed)
				{
					path.Instructions.Add(new PathClose());
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CreateCurvesPath(Point[] points, bool closed, ModelShapePath path, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache)
		{
			if (points != null && points.Length != 0)
			{
				path.Instructions.Add(new PathMove(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[0].X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[0].Y)));
				for (int i = 1; i + 2 < points.Length; i += 3)
				{
					path.Instructions.Add(new PathCubicBezier(path.DocumentModelPart, adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[i].X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[i].Y), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[i + 1].X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[i + 1].Y), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[i + 2].X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[i + 2].Y)));
				}
				if (closed)
				{
					path.Instructions.Add(new PathClose());
				}
			}
		}

		public static IDrawingFill CreateDrawingFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer blipContainer, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtTertiaryProperties tertiaryArtProperties)
		{
			OfficeFillType fillType = GetFillType(artProperties);
			switch (fillType)
			{
			case OfficeFillType.Solid:
				return CreateShapeSolidFill(documentModel, palette, artProperties);
			case OfficeFillType.Pattern:
				return CreateShapePatternFill(documentModel, palette, artProperties, blipContainer);
			case OfficeFillType.Texture:
				return CreateShapeTextureFill(documentModel, artProperties, blipContainer);
			case OfficeFillType.Picture:
				return CreateShapePictureFill(documentModel, artProperties, blipContainer);
			case OfficeFillType.Shade:
			case OfficeFillType.ShadeCenter:
			case OfficeFillType.ShadeShape:
			case OfficeFillType.ShadeScale:
			case OfficeFillType.ShadeTile:
				return CreateShapeGradientFill(documentModel, palette, fillType, artProperties, tertiaryArtProperties);
			case OfficeFillType.Background:
				return DrawingFill.Group;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static IDrawingFill CreateShapeSolidFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			DrawingSolidFill drawingSolidFill = new DrawingSolidFill(documentModel);
			SetupFillColor(drawingSolidFill.Color, documentModel, palette, artProperties);
			double fillOpacity = GetFillOpacity<DrawingFillOpacity>(artProperties);
			SetupFillOpacity(drawingSolidFill.Color, fillOpacity);
			return drawingSolidFill;
		}

		private static IDrawingFill CreateShapePatternFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer blipContainer)
		{
			DrawingPatternFill drawingPatternFill = new DrawingPatternFill(documentModel);
			SetupColor(drawingPatternFill.ForegroundColor, GetColorRecord<DrawingFillColor>(artProperties), documentModel, palette, artProperties);
			SetupColor(drawingPatternFill.BackgroundColor, GetColorRecord<DrawingFillBackColor>(artProperties), documentModel, palette, artProperties);
			SetupFillOpacity(drawingPatternFill.ForegroundColor, GetFillOpacity<DrawingFillOpacity>(artProperties));
			SetupFillOpacity(drawingPatternFill.BackgroundColor, GetFillOpacity<DrawingFillBackOpacity>(artProperties));
			drawingPatternFill.PatternType = GetDrawingPatternType(artProperties, blipContainer);
			return drawingPatternFill;
		}

		private static DrawingPatternType GetDrawingPatternType(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer blipContainer)
		{
			DrawingPatternType result = DrawingPatternType.Percent50;
			int drawingFillBlipIdentifier = GetDrawingFillBlipIdentifier(artProperties);
			if (drawingFillBlipIdentifier == 0 || blipContainer == null || blipContainer.Blips.Count < drawingFillBlipIdentifier)
			{
				return result;
			}
			BlipBase blipBase = blipContainer.Blips[drawingFillBlipIdentifier - 1];
			if (!patternsByTag.Value.TryGetValue(blipBase.TagValue, out var value))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static DrawingPatternType GetDrawingPatternType(int tagIndex)
		{
			if (!patternsByTag.Value.TryGetValue(tagIndex, out var value))
			{
				return DrawingPatternType.Percent50;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static int GetBlipTagIndex(DrawingPatternType patternType)
		{
			Dictionary<int, DrawingPatternType> value = patternsByTag.Value;
			foreach (int key in value.Keys)
			{
				if (value[key] == patternType)
				{
					return key;
				}
			}
			return 33;
		}

		private static int GetDrawingFillBlipIdentifier(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingFillBlipIdentifier>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 0;
		}

		private static IDrawingFill CreateShapeTextureFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer blipContainer)
		{
			OfficeImage image = GetImage(artProperties, blipContainer);
			if (image == null)

				return null;

		}

		private static IDrawingFill CreateShapePictureFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer blipContainer)
		{
			OfficeImage image = GetImage(artProperties, blipContainer);
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DrawingBlipFill.Create(documentModel, image);
		}

		public static IDrawingFill CreateTextureBlipFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, OfficeImage image)
		{
			DrawingBlipFill drawingBlipFill = new DrawingBlipFill(documentModel);
			drawingBlipFill.Blip.Image = image;
			drawingBlipFill.Stretch = false;
			drawingBlipFill.TileAlign = RectangleAlignType.TopLeft;
			drawingBlipFill.TileFlip = TileFlipType.None;
			drawingBlipFill.ScaleX = 100000;
			drawingBlipFill.ScaleY = 100000;
			drawingBlipFill.OffsetX = 0L;
			drawingBlipFill.OffsetY = 0L;
			return drawingBlipFill;
		}

		private static OfficeImage GetImage(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer blipContainer)
		{
			int drawingFillBlipIdentifier = GetDrawingFillBlipIdentifier(artProperties);
			if (drawingFillBlipIdentifier == 0 || blipContainer == null || blipContainer.Blips.Count < drawingFillBlipIdentifier)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return blipContainer.Blips[drawingFillBlipIdentifier - 1].Image;
		}

		private static IDrawingFill CreateShapeGradientFill(IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeFillType fillType, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtTertiaryProperties tertiaryArtProperties)
		{
			DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill = new DrawingGradientFill(documentModel);
			switch (fillType)
			{
			case OfficeFillType.ShadeShape:
				drawingGradientFill.GradientType = GradientType.Shape;
				drawingGradientFill.FillRect = new RectangleOffset(50000, 50000, 50000, 50000);
				break;
			case OfficeFillType.ShadeCenter:
				drawingGradientFill.GradientType = GradientType.Rectangle;
				SetupFillRect(drawingGradientFill, artProperties);
				break;
			default:
				drawingGradientFill.GradientType = GradientType.Linear;
				break;
			}
			SetupGradientStops(drawingGradientFill, documentModel, palette, artProperties);
			SetupGradientAngle(drawingGradientFill, artProperties);
			SetupRotateWithShape(drawingGradientFill, artProperties, tertiaryArtProperties);
			return drawingGradientFill;
		}

		private static void SetupRotateWithShape(DrawingGradientFill fill, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtTertiaryProperties tertiaryArtProperties)
		{
			fill.RotateWithShape = GetRotateWithShape(artProperties, tertiaryArtProperties);
		}

		private static void SetupFillRect(DrawingGradientFill fill, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			double relativePosition = GetRelativePosition<DrawingFillToLeft>(artProperties);
			double relativePosition2 = GetRelativePosition<DrawingFillToTop>(artProperties);
			double num = 1.0 - GetRelativePosition<DrawingFillToRight>(artProperties);
			double num2 = 1.0 - GetRelativePosition<DrawingFillToBottom>(artProperties);
			int leftOffset = (int)(relativePosition * 100000.0);
			int topOffset = (int)(relativePosition2 * 100000.0);
			int rightOffset = (int)(num * 100000.0);
			int bottomOffset = (int)(num2 * 100000.0);
			fill.FillRect = new RectangleOffset(bottomOffset, leftOffset, rightOffset, topOffset);
		}

		private static void SetupGradientStops(DrawingGradientFill gradientFill, IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			OfficeShadeColor[] arrayOfElements = OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.GetArrayOfElements<OfficeShadeColor, DrawingFillShadeColors>(artProperties);
			List<OfficeShadeColor> list = new List<OfficeShadeColor>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			if (arrayOfElements != null && arrayOfElements.Length != 0)
			{
				GetShadeColors(list, list2, arrayOfElements, artProperties);
			}
			else
			{
				GetShadeColors(list, list2, artProperties);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				DrawingGradientStop drawingGradientStop = new DrawingGradientStop(documentModel);
				SetupColor(drawingGradientStop.Color, list[i].ColorRecord, documentModel, palette, artProperties);
				drawingGradientStop.Position = (int)(list[i].Position * 100000.0);
				SetupFillOpacity(drawingGradientStop.Color, list2[i]);
				gradientFill.AddGradientStop(drawingGradientStop);
			}
		}

		private static void GetShadeColors(List<OfficeShadeColor> shadeColors, List<double> shadeOpacities, OfficeShadeColor[] officeShadeColors, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			int num = officeShadeColors.Length;
			shadeColors.AddRange(officeShadeColors);
			double fillOpacity = GetFillOpacity<DrawingFillOpacity>(artProperties);
			double fillOpacity2 = GetFillOpacity<DrawingFillBackOpacity>(artProperties);
			double position = shadeColors[0].Position;
			double position2 = shadeColors[num - 1].Position;
			double num2 = ((position2 == position) ? 0.0 : ((fillOpacity2 - fillOpacity) / (position2 - position)));
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				double item = fillOpacity + num2 * (shadeColors[i].Position - position);
				shadeOpacities.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private static void GetShadeColors(List<OfficeShadeColor> shadeColors, List<double> shadeOpacities, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			int drawingFillFocus = GetDrawingFillFocus(artProperties);
			double fillOpacity = GetFillOpacity<DrawingFillOpacity>(artProperties);
			double fillOpacity2 = GetFillOpacity<DrawingFillBackOpacity>(artProperties);
			OfficeColorRecord colorRecord = GetColorRecord<DrawingFillColor>(artProperties);
			OfficeColorRecord colorRecord2 = GetColorRecord<DrawingFillBackColor>(artProperties);
			GetShadeColorsCore(shadeColors, shadeOpacities, (float)drawingFillFocus / 100f, fillOpacity, fillOpacity2, colorRecord, colorRecord2);
		}

		private static int GetDrawingFillFocus(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (!(OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.GetPropertyByType(artProperties, typeof(DrawingFillFocus)) is DrawingFillFocus drawingFillFocus))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return drawingFillFocus.Value;
		}

		public static void GetShadeColorsCore(List<OfficeShadeColor> shadeColors, List<double> shadeOpacities, float focus, double fillOpacity, double fillBackOpacity, OfficeColorRecord fillColor, OfficeColorRecord fillBackColor)
		{
			if ((double)focus <= -1.0 || (double)focus >= 1.0)
			{
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillColor,
					Position = 0.0
				});
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillBackColor,
					Position = 1.0
				});
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillOpacity);
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillBackOpacity);
			}
			else if (focus > 0f)
			{
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillColor,
					Position = 0.0
				});
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillBackColor,
					Position = focus
				});
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillColor,
					Position = 1.0
				});
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillOpacity);
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillBackOpacity);
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillOpacity);
			}
			else if (focus < 0f)
			{
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillBackColor,
					Position = 0.0
				});
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillColor,
					Position = 0f - focus
				});
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillBackColor,
					Position = 1.0
				});
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillBackOpacity);
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillOpacity);
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillBackOpacity);
			}
			else
			{
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillBackColor,
					Position = 0.0
				});
				shadeColors.Add(new OfficeShadeColor
				{
					ColorRecord = fillColor,
					Position = 1.0
				});
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillBackOpacity);
				shadeOpacities.Add(fillOpacity);
			}
		}

		private static void SetupGradientAngle(DrawingGradientFill gradientFill, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			double angle = 0.0;
			if (OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.GetPropertyByType(artProperties, typeof(DrawingFillAngle)) is DrawingFillAngle drawingFillAngle)
			{
				angle = drawingFillAngle.Value;
			}
			gradientFill.Angle = SetupGradientAngleCore(angle);
		}

		public static int SetupGradientAngleCore(double angle)
		{
			angle = ((!(angle >= 0.0)) ? (0.0 - (angle + 90.0)) : (90.0 - angle));
			if (angle < 0.0)
			{
				angle += 360.0;
			}
			if (angle > 360.0)
			{
				angle -= 360.0;
			}
			return (int)(angle * 60000.0);
		}

		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<OfficeDrawingFillType>(artProperties)?.FillType ?? OfficeFillType.Solid;
		}

		private static bool GetRotateWithShape(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtTertiaryProperties tertiaryArtProperties)
		{
			DrawingFillStyleBooleanProperties officeArtProperty = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingFillStyleBooleanProperties>(artProperties);
			DrawingFillStyleBooleanProperties drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties = null;
			if (tertiaryArtProperties != null)
			{
				drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingFillStyleBooleanProperties>(tertiaryArtProperties);
			}
			if (officeArtProperty == null || !officeArtProperty.UseShapeAnchor || !officeArtProperty.ShapeAnchor)
			{
				if (drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties != null && drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties.UseShapeAnchor)
				{
					return drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties.ShapeAnchor;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static double GetRelativePosition<TPos>(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties) where TPos : OfficeDrawingFixedPointPropertyBase
		{
			return (OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.GetPropertyByType(artProperties, typeof(TPos)) as TPos)?.Value ?? 0.0;
		}

		public static void SetupColor(IDrawingColor drawingColor, OfficeColorRecord officeColor, IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (officeColor == null || officeColor.IsDefault)
			{
				drawingColor.Rgb = DXColor.FromArgb(255, 255, 255);
			}
			else if (officeColor.SystemColorUsed)
			{
				SetupSystemColor(drawingColor, officeColor, documentModel, palette, artProperties);
			}
			else if (officeColor.ColorSchemeUsed)
			{
				drawingColor.Rgb = ColorModelInfo.Create(officeColor.ColorSchemeIndex).ToRgb(palette, documentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors);
			}
			else
			{
				drawingColor.Rgb = officeColor.Color;
			}
		}

		private static void SetupSystemColor(IDrawingColor drawingColor, OfficeColorRecord officeColor, IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (officeColor.ColorUse == OfficeColorUse.None)
			{
				SystemColorValues system = SystemColorValues.Empty;
				if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SystemColorValues), officeColor.SystemColorIndex))
				{
					system = (SystemColorValues)officeColor.SystemColorIndex;
				}
				drawingColor.System = system;
			}
			else
			{
				SetupSpecialColor(drawingColor, officeColor, documentModel, palette, artProperties);
			}
		}

		private static void SetupSpecialColor(IDrawingColor drawingColor, OfficeColorRecord officeColor, IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			switch (officeColor.ColorUse)
			{
			case OfficeColorUse.UseFillColor:
				SetupRgbColor(drawingColor, GetColorRecord<DrawingFillColor>(artProperties), documentModel, palette);
				break;
			case OfficeColorUse.UseFillBackColor:
				SetupRgbColor(drawingColor, GetColorRecord<DrawingFillBackColor>(artProperties), documentModel, palette);
				break;
			case OfficeColorUse.UseFillOrLineColor:
			{
				OfficeColorRecord colorRecord2 = GetColorRecord<DrawingFillColor>(artProperties);
				SetupRgbColor(drawingColor, colorRecord2 ?? GetColorRecord<DrawingLineColor>(artProperties), documentModel, palette);
				break;
			}
			case OfficeColorUse.UseLineOrFillColor:
			{
				OfficeColorRecord colorRecord = GetColorRecord<DrawingLineColor>(artProperties);
				SetupRgbColor(drawingColor, colorRecord ?? GetColorRecord<DrawingFillColor>(artProperties), documentModel, palette);
				break;
			}
			case OfficeColorUse.UseLineColor:
				SetupRgbColor(drawingColor, GetColorRecord<DrawingLineColor>(artProperties), documentModel, palette);
				break;
			default:
				SetupRgbColor(drawingColor, null, documentModel, palette);
				break;
			}
			if (officeColor.Transform == OfficeColorTransform.Darken && officeColor.TransformValue < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new GammaColorTransform());
				drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new ShadeColorTransform(officeColor.TransformValue * 100000 / 255));
				drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new InverseGammaColorTransform());
			}
			if (officeColor.Transform == OfficeColorTransform.Lighten && officeColor.TransformValue < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new GammaColorTransform());
				drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new TintColorTransform(officeColor.TransformValue * 100000 / 255));
				drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new InverseGammaColorTransform());
			}
		}

		private static void SetupRgbColor(IDrawingColor drawingColor, OfficeColorRecord officeColor, IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette)
		{
			if (officeColor == null || officeColor.IsDefault || officeColor.SystemColorUsed)
			{
				drawingColor.Rgb = DXColor.FromArgb(255, 255, 255);
			}
			else if (officeColor.ColorSchemeUsed)
			{
				drawingColor.Rgb = ColorModelInfo.Create(officeColor.ColorSchemeIndex).ToRgb(palette, documentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors);
			}
			else
			{
				drawingColor.Rgb = officeColor.Color;
			}
		}

		private static void SetupFillColor(IDrawingColor drawingColor, IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			OfficeColorRecord colorRecord = GetColorRecord<DrawingFillColor>(artProperties);
			SetupColor(drawingColor, colorRecord, documentModel, palette, artProperties);
		}

		private static OfficeColorRecord GetColorRecord<TColor>(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties) where TColor : OfficeDrawingColorPropertyBase
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<TColor>(artProperties)?.ColorRecord;
		}

		public static void SetupFillOpacity(IDrawingColor drawingColor, double opacity)
		{
			if (!(opacity >= 1.0))
			{
				if (opacity < 0.0)
				{
					opacity = 0.0;
				}
				drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new AlphaColorTransform((int)Math.Round(opacity * 100000.0)));
			}
		}

		private static double GetFillOpacity<TOpacity>(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties) where TOpacity : OfficeDrawingFixedPointPropertyBase
		{
			if (!(OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.GetPropertyByType(artProperties, typeof(TOpacity)) is OfficeDrawingFixedPointPropertyBase officeDrawingFixedPointPropertyBase))
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return officeDrawingFixedPointPropertyBase.Value;
		}

		public static void SetupTransformProperties(Transform2D transform2D, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtShapeRecord shapeRecord)
		{
			if (shapeRecord != null)
			{
				transform2D.FlipH = shapeRecord.FlipH;
				transform2D.FlipV = shapeRecord.FlipV;
			}
			if (OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.GetPropertyByType(artProperties, typeof(DrawingShapeBooleanProperties)) is DrawingShapeBooleanProperties drawingShapeBooleanProperties)
			{
				if (drawingShapeBooleanProperties.UseFlipHOverride)
				{
					transform2D.FlipH = drawingShapeBooleanProperties.FlipHOverride;
				}
				if (drawingShapeBooleanProperties.UseFlipVOverride)
				{
					transform2D.FlipV = drawingShapeBooleanProperties.FlipVOverride;
				}
			}
			float num = GetRotation(artProperties);
			if ((double)num != 0.0)
			{
				if (transform2D.FlipH)
				{
					num = 360f - num;
				}
				if (transform2D.FlipV)
				{
					num = 360f - num;
				}
				transform2D.RotateCore(transform2D.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.DegreeToModelUnits(num));
			}
		}

		private static float GetRotation(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			DrawingRotation officeArtProperty = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingRotation>(artProperties);
			if (officeArtProperty == null)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			return (float)officeArtProperty.Value;
		}

		public static void SetupCommonProtectionProperties(ICommonDrawingLocks drawingLocks, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (drawingLocks == null || artProperties == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties officeArtProperty = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties>(artProperties);
			if (officeArtProperty != null)
			{
				if (officeArtProperty.UseLockGroup)
				{
					drawingLocks.NoGroup = officeArtProperty.LockGroup;
				}
				if (officeArtProperty.UseLockSelect)
				{
					drawingLocks.NoSelect = officeArtProperty.LockSelect;
				}
				if (officeArtProperty.UseLockPosition)
				{
					drawingLocks.NoMove = officeArtProperty.LockPosition;
				}
				if (officeArtProperty.UseLockAspectRatio)
				{
					drawingLocks.NoChangeAspect = officeArtProperty.LockAspectRatio;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SetupDrawingProtectionProperties(IDrawingLocks drawingLocks, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (drawingLocks == null || artProperties == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DrawingShapeBooleanProperties officeArtProperty = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShapeBooleanProperties>(artProperties);
			if (officeArtProperty != null && officeArtProperty.UseLockShapeType)
			{
				drawingLocks.NoChangeShapeType = officeArtProperty.LockShapeType;
			}
			DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties officeArtProperty2 = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties>(artProperties);
			if (officeArtProperty2 != null)
			{
				SetupCommonProtectionProperties(drawingLocks, artProperties);
				if (officeArtProperty2.UseLockRotation)
				{
					drawingLocks.NoRotate = officeArtProperty2.LockRotation;
				}
				if (officeArtProperty2.UseLockAdjustHandles)
				{
					drawingLocks.NoAdjustHandles = officeArtProperty2.LockAdjustHandles;
				}
				if (officeArtProperty2.UseLockVertices)
				{
					drawingLocks.NoEditPoints = officeArtProperty2.LockVertices;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SetupShapeProtectionProperties(IDrawingLocks locks, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (locks != null)
			{
				SetupDrawingProtectionProperties(locks, artProperties);
				DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties officeArtProperty = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties>(artProperties);
				if (officeArtProperty != null && locks is IShapeLocks shapeLocks && officeArtProperty.UseLockText)
				{
					shapeLocks.NoTextEdit = officeArtProperty.LockText;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SetupConnectionShapeProperties(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (artProperties != null)
			{
				shapeProperties.Outline.HeadType = OutlineHeadTailTypeConverter.GetOutlineHeadTailType(GetLineStartArrowhead(artProperties));
				shapeProperties.Outline.HeadLength = GetLineStartArrowheadLength(artProperties);
				shapeProperties.Outline.HeadWidth = GetLineStartArrowheadWidth(artProperties);
				shapeProperties.Outline.TailType = OutlineHeadTailTypeConverter.GetOutlineHeadTailType(GetLineEndArrowhead(artProperties));
				shapeProperties.Outline.TailLength = GetLineEndArrowheadLength(artProperties);
				shapeProperties.Outline.TailWidth = GetLineEndArrowheadWidth(artProperties);
			}
		}

		public static void SetupAdjustValues(IOfficeShape shape, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = shape.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			int widthEmu = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(shape.Width);
			int heightEmu = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(shape.Height);
			SetupAdjustValues(shape.ShapeProperties, widthEmu, heightEmu, artProperties);
		}

		public static void SetupAdjustValues(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			SetupAdjustValues(shapeProperties, widthEmu, heightEmu, artProperties?.Properties);
		}

		public static void SetupAdjustValues(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, IEnumerable<object> artProperties)
		{
			if (artProperties != null)
			{
				int?[] adjustValues = GetAdjustValues(artProperties);
				AdjustValuesConverterFromBinaryFormat.Convert(widthEmu, heightEmu, shapeProperties.ShapeType, adjustValues);
				shapeProperties.SetupShapeAdjustList(adjustValues);
			}
		}

		public static int?[] GetAdjustValues(IEnumerable<object> properties)
		{
			int?[] array = new int?[8];
			foreach (object property in properties)
			{
				OfficeDrawingIntPropertyBase officeDrawingIntPropertyBase = property as OfficeDrawingIntPropertyBase;
				if (officeDrawingIntPropertyBase is IDrawingGeometryAdjustValue drawingGeometryAdjustValue)
				{
					array[drawingGeometryAdjustValue.Index] = officeDrawingIntPropertyBase.Value;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static int?[] GetAdjustValues(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (artProperties == null)
			{
				return new int?[8];
			}
			return GetAdjustValues(artProperties.Properties);
		}

		public static void SetupWordArtAdjustValues(ModelShapeGuideList adjustValues, DrawingPresetTextWarp presetTextWarp, float shapeWidth, float shapeHeight, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			List<long> wordArtAdjustValues = GetWordArtAdjustValues(artProperties, presetTextWarp, shapeWidth, shapeHeight);
			SetupWordArtAdjustValues(adjustValues, wordArtAdjustValues);
		}

		public static void SetupWordArtAdjustValues(ModelShapeGuideList adjustValues, List<long> adj)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < adj.Count; i++)
			{
				string name = ((adj.Count == 1) ? "adj" : $"adj{i + 1}");
				string formula = $"val {adj[i]}";
				ModelShapeGuide item = new ModelShapeGuide(name, formula);
				adjustValues.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private static List<long> GetWordArtAdjustValues(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, DrawingPresetTextWarp presetTextWarp, float shapeWidth, float shapeHeight)
		{
			int?[] adjustValues = GetAdjustValues(artProperties);
			return AdjustValuesConverterFromBinaryFormat.GetWordArtAdjustValues(presetTextWarp, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, adjustValues);
		}

		public static void SetupGroupCoordinateSystem(Transform2D childTransform2D, OfficeArtShapeGroupCoordinateSystem coordinateSystem)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = childTransform2D.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			childTransform2D.OffsetX = unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(coordinateSystem.Left);
			childTransform2D.OffsetY = unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(coordinateSystem.Top);
			childTransform2D.Cx = unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(coordinateSystem.Right - coordinateSystem.Left);
			childTransform2D.Cy = unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(coordinateSystem.Bottom - coordinateSystem.Top);
		}

		public static OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode GetBlackAndWhiteMode(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return ConvertBlackWhiteMode(GetDrawingBlackWhiteMode(artProperties));
		}

		public static void SetupBlackAndWhiteMode(ShapePropertiesBase shapeProperties, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)

		}

		private static BlackWhiteMode GetDrawingBlackWhiteMode(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingBlackWhiteMode>(artProperties)?.Mode ?? BlackWhiteMode.Automatic;
		}

		private static OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode ConvertBlackWhiteMode(BlackWhiteMode mode)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				BlackWhiteMode.Normal => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Clr, 
				BlackWhiteMode.GrayScale => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Gray, 
				BlackWhiteMode.LightGrayScale => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.LtGray, 
				BlackWhiteMode.InverseGray => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.InvGray, 
				BlackWhiteMode.GrayOutline => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.GrayWhite, 
				BlackWhiteMode.BlackTextLine => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.BlackGray, 
				BlackWhiteMode.HighContrast => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.BlackWhite, 
				BlackWhiteMode.Black => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Black, 
				BlackWhiteMode.White => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.White, 
				BlackWhiteMode.DontShow => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Hidden, 
				_ => OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Auto, 
			};
		}

		public static void SetupChildAnchor(Transform2D transform2D, OfficeArtChildAnchor childAnchor)

			transform2D.Cx = unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(childAnchor.Right - childAnchor.Left);
			transform2D.Cy = unitConverter.EmuToModelUnitsF(childAnchor.Bottom - childAnchor.Top);
		}

		public static string GetHyperlinkTargetUri(BinaryHyperlinkObject hyperlink)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (hyperlink.HasMoniker)
			{
				if (hyperlink.IsMonkerSavedAsString)
				{
					if (Uri.TryCreate(hyperlink.Moniker, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute, out var _))
					{
						return hyperlink.Moniker;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (hyperlink.OleMoniker.ClassId == BinaryHyperlinkMonikerFactory.CLSID_URLMoniker)
					{
						BinaryHyperlinkURLMoniker val = (BinaryHyperlinkURLMoniker)hyperlink.OleMoniker;
						return val.Url;
					}
					if (hyperlink.OleMoniker.ClassId == BinaryHyperlinkMonikerFactory.CLSID_FileMoniker)
					{
						BinaryHyperlinkFileMoniker val2 = (BinaryHyperlinkFileMoniker)hyperlink.OleMoniker;
						return val2.Path;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (hyperlink.HasLocationString)
			{
				string text = hyperlink.Location;
				if (!text.StartsWith("#"))
				{
					text = "#" + text;
				}
				return text;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static DrawingPresetTextWarp GetWordArtPreset(int value)
		{
			switch (value)
			{
			case 136:

			case 175:
				return DrawingPresetTextWarp.CanDown;

				return DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave1;

				return DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave2;

			case 161:

			case 162:
				return DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateBottom;

			case 164:

			case 24:

				return DrawingPresetTextWarp.NoShape;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Unknown wordart preset type:" + value);
