		}

		public static bool IsWordArtShape(int value)
		{
			if ((uint)(value - 24) <= 7u || (uint)(value - 136) <= 39u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void SetupOutlineProperties(Outline outline, IDocumentModel documentModel, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, bool isPictureFrame)
		{
			if (artProperties == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			outline.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				if (UseLine(GetDrawingLineBooleanProperties(artProperties.Properties), isPictureFrame))
				{
					outline.Type = OutlineType.Solid;
					outline.CompoundType = GetLineCompoundType(artProperties);
					outline.EndCapStyle = GetLineCapStyle(artProperties);
					outline.Dashing = GetLineDashing(artProperties);
					int lineOpacity = GetLineOpacity(artProperties);
					if (lineOpacity != 65536)
					{
						outline.Color.Transforms.AddCore(new AlphaColorTransform(GetAlphaColorTransform(lineOpacity)));
					}
					OfficeColorRecord colorRecord = GetColorRecord<DrawingLineColor>(artProperties);
					if (colorRecord != null)
					{
						if (colorRecord.SystemColorUsed)
						{
							SystemColorValues system = SystemColorValues.Empty;
							if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SystemColorValues), colorRecord.SystemColorIndex))
							{
								system = (SystemColorValues)colorRecord.SystemColorIndex;
							}
							outline.Color.OriginalColor.System = system;
						}
						else
						{
							Color rgb = colorRecord.Color;
							if (colorRecord.ColorSchemeUsed)
							{
								rgb = ColorModelInfo.Create(colorRecord.ColorSchemeIndex).ToRgb(palette, documentModel.OfficeTheme.Colors);
							}
							outline.Color.OriginalColor.Rgb = rgb;
						}
					}
					outline.Width = documentModel.UnitConverter.EmuToModelUnits(GetLineWidthInEMUs(artProperties.Properties));
				}
				else
				{
					outline.Type = OutlineType.None;
					outline.CompoundType = OutlineCompoundType.Single;
				}
				outline.JoinStyle = GetLineJoinStyle(artProperties);
				outline.MiterLimit = DrawingValueConverter.ToPercentage(GetLineMiterLimit(artProperties));
			}
			finally
			{
				outline.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private static bool UseLine(DrawingLineStyleBooleanProperties bpLine, bool isPictureFrame)
		{
			if (bpLine == null)
			{
				return !isPictureFrame;
			}
			if (bpLine.UseLine)
			{
				return bpLine.Line;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static int GetAlphaColorTransform(int lineOpacity)
		{
			int num = 65536;
			return (int)Math.Round((double)lineOpacity / (double)num * 100000.0);
		}

		private static DrawingLineStyleBooleanProperties GetDrawingLineBooleanProperties(IEnumerable<object> properties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingLineStyleBooleanProperties>(properties);
		}

		private static OutlineCompoundType GetLineCompoundType(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingLineCompoundType>(artProperties)?.CompoundType ?? OutlineCompoundType.Single;
		}

		private static OutlineEndCapStyle GetLineCapStyle(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingLineCapStyle>(artProperties)?.Style ?? OutlineEndCapStyle.Flat;
		}

		private static LineJoinStyle GetLineJoinStyle(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingLineJoinStyle>(artProperties)?.Style ?? LineJoinStyle.Miter;
		}

		private static double GetLineMiterLimit(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingLineMiterLimit>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 8.0;
		}

		private static OutlineDashing GetLineDashing(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingLineDashing>(artProperties)?.Dashing ?? OutlineDashing.Solid;
		}

		private static int GetLineOpacity(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingLineOpacity>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 65536;
		}

		private static int GetLineWidthInEMUs(IEnumerable<object> properties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingLineWidth>(properties)?.Value ?? 9525;
		}

		public static void SetupOuterShadowProperties(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, Palette palette, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtTertiaryProperties tertiaryArtProperties)
		{
			DrawingShadowStyleBooleanProperties officeArtProperty = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowStyleBooleanProperties>(artProperties);
			if (officeArtProperty != null && officeArtProperty.UseShadow && officeArtProperty.Shadow)
			{
				MsoShadowType shadowType = GetShadowType(artProperties);
				OfficeColorRecord shadowColor = GetShadowColor(artProperties);
				double shadowOpacity = GetShadowOpacity(artProperties);
				int shadowOffsetX = GetShadowOffsetX(artProperties);
				int shadowOffsetY = GetShadowOffsetY(artProperties);
				long dist = CalculateDistance(shadowOffsetX, shadowOffsetY);
				int dir = CalculateDirection(shadowOffsetX, shadowOffsetY);
				int shadowSoftness = GetShadowSoftness(tertiaryArtProperties);
				int sx = ((shadowType != MsoShadowType.MsoShadowOffset) ? CalculateHorizontalFactor(artProperties) : 100000);
				int sy = ((shadowType != MsoShadowType.MsoShadowOffset) ? CalculateVerticalFactor(artProperties) : 100000);
				int kx = CalculateHorizontalSkewAngle(artProperties);
				int ky = CalculateVerticalSkewAngle(artProperties);
				RectangleAlignType shadowAlign = GetShadowAlign(artProperties);
				OuterShadowEffectInfo info = OuterShadowEffectInfo.Create(shadowSoftness, dist, dir, sx, sy, kx, ky, shadowAlign, rotWithShape: false);
				DrawingColor drawingColor = new DrawingColor(shapeProperties.DocumentModel);
				SetupColor(drawingColor, shadowColor, shapeProperties.DocumentModel, palette, artProperties);
				if (shadowOpacity != 0.0)
				{
					drawingColor.Transforms.Add(new AlphaColorTransform((int)(Math.Round(shadowOpacity, 5) * 100000.0)));
				}
				ContainerEffect containerEffect = shapeProperties.EffectStyle.ContainerEffect;
				containerEffect.SetApplyEffectListCore(value: true);
				containerEffect.Effects.Add(new OuterShadowEffect(drawingColor, info));
			}
		}

		private static RectangleAlignType GetShadowAlign(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			double shadowOriginX = GetShadowOriginX(artProperties);
			double shadowOriginY = GetShadowOriginY(artProperties);
			return GetShadowAlignCore(shadowOriginX, shadowOriginY);
		}

		public static RectangleAlignType GetShadowAlignCore(double shadowOriginX, double shadowOriginY)
		{
			if (shadowOriginX == 0.0 && shadowOriginY == 0.0)
			{
				return RectangleAlignType.Center;
			}
			if (shadowOriginX == 0.0 && shadowOriginY == 0.5)
			{
				return RectangleAlignType.Bottom;
			}
			if (shadowOriginX == -0.5 && shadowOriginY == 0.5)
			{
				return RectangleAlignType.BottomLeft;
			}
			if (shadowOriginX == 0.5 && shadowOriginY == 0.5)
			{
				return RectangleAlignType.BottomRight;
			}
			if (shadowOriginX == -0.5 && shadowOriginY == 0.0)
			{
				return RectangleAlignType.Left;
			}
			if (shadowOriginX == 0.5 && shadowOriginY == 0.0)
			{
				return RectangleAlignType.Right;
			}
			if (shadowOriginX == 0.0 && shadowOriginY == -0.5)
			{
				return RectangleAlignType.Top;
			}
			if (shadowOriginX == 0.5 && shadowOriginY == -0.5)
			{
				return RectangleAlignType.TopRight;
			}
			return RectangleAlignType.TopLeft;
		}

		public static long CalculateDistance(double shadowOffsetX, double shadowOffsetY)
		{
			double num = Math.Pow(shadowOffsetX, 2.0);
			double num2 = Math.Pow(shadowOffsetY, 2.0);
			return (long)Math.Round(Math.Sqrt(num + num2));
		}

		public static int CalculateDirection(double shadowOffsetX, double shadowOffsetY)
		{
			double radian = Math.Atan2(shadowOffsetY, shadowOffsetX);
			int num = (int)Math.Round(ShapeGuideCalculator.RadianToEMUDegree(radian));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num += 21600000;
			}
			return num % 21600000;
		}

		private static int CalculateHorizontalFactor(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			int shadowHorizontalScalingFactor = GetShadowHorizontalScalingFactor(artProperties);
			return CalculateScalingFactorCore(shadowHorizontalScalingFactor);
		}

		private static int CalculateVerticalFactor(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			int shadowVerticalScalingFactor = GetShadowVerticalScalingFactor(artProperties);
			return CalculateScalingFactorCore(shadowVerticalScalingFactor);
		}

		private static int CalculateScalingFactorCore(int value)
		{
			double num = 1.52587890625;
			return (int)Math.Round((double)value * num);
		}

		private static int CalculateHorizontalSkewAngle(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			int shadowHorizontalSkewAngle = GetShadowHorizontalSkewAngle(artProperties);
			int shadowHorizontalScalingFactor = GetShadowHorizontalScalingFactor(artProperties);
			return CalculateSkewAngleCore(shadowHorizontalSkewAngle, shadowHorizontalScalingFactor);
		}

		private static int CalculateVerticalSkewAngle(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			int shadowVerticalSkewAngle = GetShadowVerticalSkewAngle(artProperties);
			int shadowVerticalScalingFactor = GetShadowVerticalScalingFactor(artProperties);
			return CalculateSkewAngleCore(shadowVerticalSkewAngle, shadowVerticalScalingFactor);
		}

		public static int CalculateSkewAngleCore(int value, int scalingFactor)
		{
			if (scalingFactor == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return (int)Math.Round(Math.Atan((double)value / (double)scalingFactor) * 180.0 / Math.PI, 2) * 60000;
		}

		private static MsoShadowType GetShadowType(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowType>(artProperties)?.ShadowType ?? MsoShadowType.MsoShadowOffset;
		}

		private static OfficeColorRecord GetShadowColor(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			DrawingShadowColor officeArtProperty = GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowColor>(artProperties);
			return (officeArtProperty != null) ? officeArtProperty.ColorRecord : new OfficeColorRecord(DXColor.Gray);
		}

		private static double GetShadowOpacity(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowOpacity>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 1.0;
		}

		private static int GetShadowOffsetX(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowOffsetX>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 25400;
		}

		private static int GetShadowOffsetY(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowOffsetY>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 25400;
		}

		private static double GetShadowOriginX(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowOriginX>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 0.0;
		}

		private static double GetShadowOriginY(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowOriginY>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 0.0;
		}

		private static int GetShadowSoftness(OfficeArtTertiaryProperties tertiaryArtProperties)
		{
			if (tertiaryArtProperties == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowSoftness>(tertiaryArtProperties)?.Value ?? 0;
		}

		private static int GetShadowHorizontalScalingFactor(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowHorizontalScalingFactor>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 65536;
		}

		private static int GetShadowVerticalScalingFactor(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowVerticalScalingFactor>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 65536;
		}

		private static int GetShadowHorizontalSkewAngle(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowHorizontalSkewAngle>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 0;
		}

		private static int GetShadowVerticalSkewAngle(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			return GetOfficeArtProperty<DrawingShadowVerticalSkewAngle>(artProperties)?.Value ?? 0;
		}
	}
	internal class CustomGeometryPathBuilder
	{
		private readonly ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry;

		private readonly Point[] points;

		private readonly MsoPathInfo[] msoPathInfos;

		private readonly XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache;

		private readonly XlsAdjustableAngleCache adjustableAngleCache;

		private int lastX;

		private int lastY;

		private int pointsIndex;

		private ModelShapePath Path => customGeometry.Paths.Last;

		public CustomGeometryPathBuilder(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, Point[] points, MsoPathInfo[] msoPathInfos, XlsAdjustableCoordinateCache adjustableCoordinateCache, XlsAdjustableAngleCache adjustableAngleCache)
		{
			this.customGeometry = customGeometry;
			this.points = points;
			this.msoPathInfos = msoPathInfos;
			this.adjustableCoordinateCache = adjustableCoordinateCache;
			this.adjustableAngleCache = adjustableAngleCache;
			lastX = -1;
			lastY = -1;
		}

		internal void CreateComplexPath()
		{
			pointsIndex = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < msoPathInfos.Length; i++)
			{
				MsoPathInfo msoPathInfo = msoPathInfos[i];
				switch (msoPathInfo.PathType)
				{
				case MsoPathType.LineTo:
					AddLineToSegments(msoPathInfo);
					break;
				case MsoPathType.CurveTo:
					AddCurveToSegments(msoPathInfo);
					break;
				case MsoPathType.MoveTo:
					if (pointsIndex < points.Length)
					{
						lastX = points[pointsIndex].X;
						lastY = points[pointsIndex].Y;
						Path.Instructions.Add(new PathMove(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastX), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastY)));
						pointsIndex++;
					}
					break;
				case MsoPathType.Close:
					Path.Instructions.Add(new PathClose());
					break;
				case MsoPathType.End:
					if (i != msoPathInfos.Length - 1)
					{
						AddNewPath();
					}
					break;
				case MsoPathType.Escape:
				case MsoPathType.ClientEscape:
					ProcessEscapeSegments(msoPathInfo);
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddCurveToSegments(MsoPathInfo pathInfo)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pathInfo.Segments; i++)
			{
				if (pointsIndex + 2 >= points.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				lastX = points[pointsIndex + 2].X;
				lastY = points[pointsIndex + 2].Y;
				Path.Instructions.Add(new PathCubicBezier(Path.DocumentModelPart, adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[pointsIndex].X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[pointsIndex].Y), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[pointsIndex + 1].X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(points[pointsIndex + 1].Y), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastX), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastY)));
				pointsIndex += 3;
			}
		}

		private void AddLineToSegments(MsoPathInfo pathInfo)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pathInfo.Segments; i++)
			{
				if (pointsIndex >= points.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				lastX = points[pointsIndex].X;
				lastY = points[pointsIndex].Y;
				Path.Instructions.Add(new PathLine(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastX), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastY)));
				pointsIndex++;
			}
		}

		private void AddNewPath()
		{
			ModelShapePath modelShapePath = new ModelShapePath(Path.DocumentModelPart);
			modelShapePath.Width = Path.Width;
			modelShapePath.Height = Path.Height;
			customGeometry.Paths.Add(modelShapePath);
		}

		private void ProcessEscapeSegments(MsoPathInfo pathInfo)
		{
			switch (pathInfo.PathEscape)
			{
			case MsoPathEscape.AngleEllipseTo:
				AddAngleEllipse(pathInfo, moveToStart: false);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.AngleEllipse:
				AddAngleEllipse(pathInfo, moveToStart: true);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.ArcTo:
				AddArcTo(pathInfo, clockWise: false);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.Arc:
				AddArc(pathInfo, clockWise: false);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.ClockwiseArcTo:
				AddArcTo(pathInfo, clockWise: true);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.ClockwiseArc:
				AddArc(pathInfo, clockWise: true);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.EllipticalQuadrantX:
				AddEllipticalQuadrantX(pathInfo);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.EllipticalQuadrantY:
				AddEllipticalQuadrantY(pathInfo);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.QuadraticBezier:
				AddQuadraticBezier(pathInfo);
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.NoFill:
				Path.FillMode = PathFillMode.None;
				break;
			case MsoPathEscape.NoLine:
				Path.Stroke = false;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			case MsoPathEscape.Extension:
			case MsoPathEscape.AutoLine:
			case MsoPathEscape.AutoCurve:
			case MsoPathEscape.CornerLine:
			case MsoPathEscape.CornerCurve:
			case MsoPathEscape.SmoothLine:
			case MsoPathEscape.SmoothCurve:
			case MsoPathEscape.SymmetricLine:
			case MsoPathEscape.SymmetricCurve:
			case MsoPathEscape.Freeform:
			case MsoPathEscape.FillColor:
			case MsoPathEscape.LineColor:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void AddQuadraticBezier(MsoPathInfo pathInfo)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pathInfo.Segments; i++)
			{
				if (pointsIndex + 1 >= points.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				Point point = points[pointsIndex++];
				Point point2 = points[pointsIndex];
				lastX = point2.X;
				lastY = point2.Y;
				Path.Instructions.Add(new PathQuadraticBezier(Path.DocumentModelPart, adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(point.X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(point.Y), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastX), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastY)));
			}
		}

		private void AddArcTo(MsoPathInfo pathInfo, bool clockWise)
		{
			AddArcCore(pathInfo, clockWise, moveToStart: false);
		}

		private void AddArc(MsoPathInfo pathInfo, bool clockWise)
		{
			AddArcCore(pathInfo, clockWise, moveToStart: true);
		}

		private void AddArcCore(MsoPathInfo pathInfo, bool clockWise, bool moveToStart)
		{
			bool flag = moveToStart;
			for (int i = 0; i < pathInfo.Segments / 4; i++)
			{
				if (pointsIndex + 3 >= points.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				Point point = points[pointsIndex++];
				Point point2 = points[pointsIndex++];
				int num = point2.X - point.X;
				int num2 = point2.Y - point.Y;
				Point point3 = points[pointsIndex++];
				Point point4 = points[pointsIndex++];
				if (num == 0 || num2 == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num3 = point.X + num / 2;
				int num4 = point.Y + num2 / 2;
				int value = AngleByVector(point3.X - num3, point3.Y - num4);
				int num5 = AngleBetweenVectors(point3.X - num3, point3.Y - num4, point4.X - num3, point4.Y - num4);
				num5 = ((!clockWise) ? (num5 - 21600000) : (num5 + 21600000));
				num5 %= 21600000;
				if (num5 == 0)
				{
					num5 = 21600000;
				}
				int value2 = Math.Abs(num / 2);
				int value3 = Math.Abs(num2 / 2);
				if (point3.X != lastX || point3.Y != lastY)
				{
					lastX = point3.X;
					lastY = point3.Y;
					if (flag)
					{
						Path.Instructions.Add(new PathMove(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastX), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastY)));
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						Path.Instructions.Add(new PathLine(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastX), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastY)));
					}
				}
				Path.Instructions.Add(new PathArc(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(value2), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(value3), adjustableAngleCache.GetCachedAdjustableAngle(value), adjustableAngleCache.GetCachedAdjustableAngle(num5)));
				lastX = point4.X;
				lastY = point4.Y;
			}
		}

		private static int AngleByVector(int x, int y)
		{
			double num = Math.Atan2(y, x);
			double num2 = num * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 += 360.0;
			}
			return (int)(num2 * 60000.0);
		}

		private static int AngleBetweenVectors(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)
		{
			double num = (double)x1 * (double)x2 + (double)y1 * (double)y2;
			double num2 = (double)x1 * (double)y2 - (double)x2 * (double)y1;
			double num3 = Math.Atan(num2 / num);
			double num4 = num3 * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			if (num == 0.0 && num2 > 0.0)
			{
				num4 = 90.0;
			}
			if (num == 0.0 && num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num4 = -90.0;
			}
			if (num < 0.0 && num2 >= 0.0)
			{
				num4 += 180.0;
			}
			if (num < 0.0 && num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num4 += 180.0;
			}
			return (int)(num4 * 60000.0);
		}

		private void AddEllipticalQuadrantX(MsoPathInfo pathInfo)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pathInfo.Segments; i++)
			{
				if (pointsIndex >= points.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				Point startPoint = new Point(lastX, lastY);
				Point endPoint = points[pointsIndex++];
				lastX = endPoint.X;
				lastY = endPoint.Y;
				if (i % 2 == 0)
				{
					AddEllipticalQuadrantXCore(startPoint, endPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					AddEllipticalQuadrantYCore(startPoint, endPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddEllipticalQuadrantXCore(Point startPoint, Point endPoint)
		{
			AddEllipticalQuadrantCore(startPoint, endPoint, tangentialX: true);
		}

		private void AddEllipticalQuadrantCore(Point startPoint, Point endPoint, bool tangentialX)
		{
			int num = Math.Abs(endPoint.X - startPoint.X);
			int num2 = Math.Abs(endPoint.Y - startPoint.Y);
			int num3 = (tangentialX ? startPoint.X : ((startPoint.X > endPoint.X) ? (startPoint.X - num) : (startPoint.X + num)));
			int num4 = ((!tangentialX) ? startPoint.Y : ((startPoint.Y > endPoint.Y) ? (startPoint.Y - num2) : (startPoint.Y + num2)));
			int value = AngleByVector(startPoint.X - num3, startPoint.Y - num4);
			int value2 = AngleBetweenVectors(startPoint.X - num3, startPoint.Y - num4, endPoint.X - num3, endPoint.Y - num4);
			Path.Instructions.Add(new PathArc(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(num), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(num2), adjustableAngleCache.GetCachedAdjustableAngle(value), adjustableAngleCache.GetCachedAdjustableAngle(value2)));
		}

		private void AddEllipticalQuadrantY(MsoPathInfo pathInfo)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pathInfo.Segments; i++)
			{
				if (pointsIndex >= points.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				Point startPoint = new Point(lastX, lastY);
				Point endPoint = points[pointsIndex++];
				lastX = endPoint.X;
				lastY = endPoint.Y;
				if (i % 2 == 0)
				{
					AddEllipticalQuadrantYCore(startPoint, endPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					AddEllipticalQuadrantXCore(startPoint, endPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddEllipticalQuadrantYCore(Point startPoint, Point endPoint)
		{
			AddEllipticalQuadrantCore(startPoint, endPoint, tangentialX: false);
		}

		private static Point GetIntersectionPoint(int centerX, int centerY, double wR, double hR, double angle)
		{
			double num = angle / 180.0 * Math.PI;
			double num2 = Math.Atan2(wR * Math.Sin(num), hR * Math.Cos(num));
			double a = wR * Math.Cos(num2) + (double)centerX;
			double a2 = hR * Math.Sin(num2) + (double)centerY;
			return new Point((int)Math.Round(a), (int)Math.Round(a2));
		}

		private void AddAngleEllipse(MsoPathInfo pathInfo, bool moveToStart)
		{
			bool flag = moveToStart;
			for (int i = 0; i < pathInfo.Segments; i++)
			{
				if (pointsIndex + 2 >= points.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
				Point point = points[pointsIndex];
				Point point2 = points[pointsIndex + 1];
				Point point3 = points[pointsIndex + 2];
				double num = (float)(-point3.X) / 65536f % 360f;
				double num2 = (float)(-point3.Y) / 65536f % 360f;
				try
				{
					Point intersectionPoint = GetIntersectionPoint(point.X, point.Y, point2.X, point2.Y, num);
					Point intersectionPoint2 = GetIntersectionPoint(point.X, point.Y, point2.X, point2.Y, num + num2);
					if (intersectionPoint.X != lastX || intersectionPoint.Y != lastY)
					{
						lastX = intersectionPoint.X;
						lastY = intersectionPoint.Y;
						if (flag)
						{
							Path.Instructions.Add(new PathMove(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastX), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastY)));
							flag = false;
						}
						else
						{
							Path.Instructions.Add(new PathLine(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastX), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(lastY)));
						}
					}
					num *= 60000.0;
					num2 *= 60000.0;
					Path.Instructions.Add(new PathArc(adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(point2.X), adjustableCoordinateCache.GetCachedAdjustableCoordinate(point2.Y), adjustableAngleCache.GetCachedAdjustableAngle((int)Math.Round(num)), adjustableAngleCache.GetCachedAdjustableAngle((int)Math.Round(num2))));
					lastX = intersectionPoint2.X;
					lastY = intersectionPoint2.Y;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				pointsIndex += 3;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class ModelShapePathImportHelper
	{
		public static void SetupShapeGeometry(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, float width, float height, int shapeTypeCode)
		{
			SetupShapeGeometry(shapeProperties, artProperties?.Properties, width, height, shapeTypeCode);
		}

		public static void SetupShapeGeometry(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, IEnumerable<object> artProperties, float width, float height, int shapeTypeCode)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			int widthEmu = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(width);
			int heightEmu = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(height);
			if (shapeProperties.ShapeType == ShapePreset.None)
			{
				ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry = shapeProperties.CustomGeometry;
				if (shapeTypeCode == 0 || shapeTypeCode == 100)
				{
					BinaryDrawingImportHelper.SetupShapeCustomGeometry(customGeometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, artProperties);
				}
				else
				{
					SetupShapeCustomGeometry(customGeometry, artProperties, shapeTypeCode);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetupPresetGeometry(shapeProperties, widthEmu, heightEmu, artProperties);
			}
		}

		private static void SetupShapeCustomGeometry(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, IEnumerable<object> artProperties, int shapeTypeCode)
		{
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometryByShapeTypeCode = BinaryCustomGeometryGenerator.GetCustomGeometryByShapeTypeCode(shapeTypeCode);
			customGeometry.CopyFrom(customGeometryByShapeTypeCode);
			if (artProperties != null)
			{
				SetupCustomPathsSize(customGeometry, artProperties);
				int?[] adjustValues = BinaryDrawingImportHelper.GetAdjustValues(artProperties);
				SetupCustomXlsAdjustValues(customGeometry, adjustValues);
			}
		}

		private static void SetupCustomPathsSize(ModelShapeCustomGeometry customGeometry, IEnumerable<object> artProperties)
		{
			DrawingGeometryRight drawingGeometryRight = OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.GetPropertyByType(artProperties, typeof(DrawingGeometryRight)) as DrawingGeometryRight;
			DrawingGeometryBottom drawingGeometryBottom = OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.GetPropertyByType(artProperties, typeof(DrawingGeometryBottom)) as DrawingGeometryBottom;
			int num = drawingGeometryRight?.Value ?? 21600;
			int num2 = drawingGeometryBottom?.Value ?? 21600;
			foreach (ModelShapePath path in customGeometry.Paths)
			{
				path.Width = num;
				path.Height = num2;
			}
		}

		private static void SetupCustomXlsAdjustValues(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, int?[] adjustValues)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < geometry.AdjustValues.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i < adjustValues.Length && adjustValues[i].HasValue)
				{
					ModelShapeGuide modelShapeGuide = geometry.AdjustValues[i];
					modelShapeGuide.Formula = ModelShapeGuideFormula.FromString("val " + adjustValues[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SetupPresetGeometry(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, IEnumerable<object> artProperties)
		{
			BinaryDrawingImportHelper.SetupAdjustValues(shapeProperties, widthEmu, heightEmu, artProperties);
		}
	}
	public static class BinaryCustomGeometryGenerator
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<int, ModelShapeCustomGeometry> calculatedGeometries = new Dictionary<int, ModelShapeCustomGeometry>();

		private static readonly Lazy<Dictionary<int, Func<ModelShapeCustomGeometry>>> customGeometrysGenerators = new Lazy<Dictionary<int, Func<ModelShapeCustomGeometry>>>(InitializeGenerators);

		private static Dictionary<int, Func<ModelShapeCustomGeometry>> InitializeGenerators()
		{
			Dictionary<int, Func<ModelShapeCustomGeometry>> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, Func<ModelShapeCustomGeometry>>();
			dictionary.Add(1, GenerateRectangle);
			dictionary.Add(8, GenerateTrapezoid);
			dictionary.Add(23, GenerateDonut);
			dictionary.Add(57, GenerateNoSmoking);
			dictionary.Add(95, GenerateBlockArc);
			dictionary.Add(74, GenerateHeart);
			dictionary.Add(19, GenerateArc);
			dictionary.Add(76, GenerateQuadArrow);
			dictionary.Add(182, GenerateLeftRightUpArrow);
			dictionary.Add(91, GenerateBentArrow);
			dictionary.Add(101, GenerateUturnArrow);
			dictionary.Add(89, GenerateLeftUpArrow);
			dictionary.Add(90, GenerateBentUpArrow);
			dictionary.Add(93, GenerateStripedRightArrow);
			dictionary.Add(83, GenerateQuadArrowCallout);
			dictionary.Add(99, GenerateCircularArrow);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetCustomGeometryByShapeTypeCode(int shapeTypeCode)
		{
			lock (calculatedGeometries)
			{
				return GetCustomGeometryByShapeTypeCodeCore(shapeTypeCode);
			}
		}

		public static bool ContainsCustomGeometryGenerator(int shapeTypeCode)
		{
			if (shapeTypeCode == 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return customGeometrysGenerators.Value.ContainsKey(shapeTypeCode);
		}

		private static ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetCustomGeometryByShapeTypeCodeCore(int shapeTypeCode)
		{
			if (calculatedGeometries.TryGetValue(shapeTypeCode, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (!customGeometrysGenerators.Value.TryGetValue(shapeTypeCode, out var value2))
			{
				return GetCustomGeometryByShapeTypeCodeCore(1);
			}
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry modelShapeCustomGeometry = value2();
			calculatedGeometries.Add(shapeTypeCode, modelShapeCustomGeometry);
			return modelShapeCustomGeometry;
		}

		private static ModelShapeCustomGeometry GenerateRectangle()
		{

		public static readonly string AssociatedFontAscii = "\\loch";

		public static readonly string RunShadingPattern = "\\chshdng";

		public static readonly string RunBackgroundColor = "\\chcbpat";

		public static readonly string RunHighlightColor = "\\highlight";

	public abstract class RtfBuilderBase
	{
		private static readonly Lazy<Dictionary<char, string>> specialMarks;

		private static readonly Lazy<Dictionary<char, string>> specialPCDataMarks;

		private static readonly string[] byteToHexString;

		private bool hexMode;

		private readonly ChunkedStringBuilder rtfContent;

		private bool isPreviousWriteCommand;

		private readonly StringBuilder unicodeTextBuilder;

		private int rowLength;

		private Encoding encoding;

		public ChunkedStringBuilder RtfContent => rtfContent;

		public Encoding Encoding
		{
			get
			{
				return encoding;
			}
			set
			{
				encoding = value;
			}
		}

		protected StringBuilder UnicodeTextBuilder => unicodeTextBuilder;

		protected bool IsPreviousWriteCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return isPreviousWriteCommand;
			}
			set
			{
				isPreviousWriteCommand = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract int RowLengthBound { get; }

		public bool AppendCharCodeToUnicodeChar { get; set; } = true;

		static RtfBuilderBase()
		{
			specialMarks = new Lazy<Dictionary<char, string>>(CreateSpecialMarksTable);
			specialPCDataMarks = new Lazy<Dictionary<char, string>>(CreateSpecialPCDataMarksTable);
			int num = 255;
			num++;
			byteToHexString = new string[256];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				byteToHexString[i] = $"{i:x2}";
			}
		}

		public static string ConvertByteToHexString(byte ch)
		{
			return byteToHexString[ch];
		}

		public static bool IsSpecialSymbol(char ch)
		{
			if (ch != '{' && ch != '}')
			{
				return ch == '\\';
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TextHasNonASCIISymbol(string text)
		{
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				int code = text[i];
				if (!IsASCII(code))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsASCII(int code)
		{
			if (code >= 0)
			{
				return code <= 127;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsANSI(int code)
		{
			if (code >= 0)
			{
				return code <= 255;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Dictionary<char, string> CreateSpecialMarksTable()
		{
			Dictionary<char, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<char, string>();
			dictionary.Add('\u2003', "\\u8195\\'3f");
			dictionary.Add('\u2002', "\\u8194\\'3f");
			dictionary.Add('\u001f', string.Empty);
			dictionary.Add('\v', "\\line ");
			dictionary.Add('\f', "\\page ");
			dictionary.Add('\u000e', "\\column ");
			dictionary.Add('\u00a0', "\\~");
			dictionary.Add('\u2005', "\\u8197\\'3f");
			dictionary.Add('\t', "\\tab ");
			dictionary.Add('\u00ad', "\\-");
			dictionary.Add('‑', "\\_");
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static Dictionary<char, string> CreateSpecialPCDataMarksTable()
		{
			Dictionary<char, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<char, string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++)
			{
				AddHexToMarkTable(dictionary, (char)i);
			}
			AddHexToMarkTable(dictionary, '\\');
			AddHexToMarkTable(dictionary, '{');
			AddHexToMarkTable(dictionary, '}');
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static void AddHexToMarkTable(Dictionary<char, string> table, char ch)
		{
			table.Add(ch, $"\\'{byteToHexString[(uint)ch]}");
		}

		public RtfBuilderBase(Encoding encoding)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)encoding, "encoding");
			this.encoding = encoding;
			rtfContent = new ChunkedStringBuilder();
			isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			unicodeTextBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			rowLength = 0;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			rtfContent.Clear();
		}

		protected void IncreaseRowLength(int delta)
		{
			rowLength += delta;
			if (rowLength >= RowLengthBound && hexMode)
			{
				rtfContent.Append(RtfExportSRBase.CLRF);
				isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
				rowLength = 0;
			}
		}

		public void WriteCommand(string command)
		{
			rtfContent.Append(command);
			isPreviousWriteCommand = true;
			IncreaseRowLength(command.Length);
		}

		public void WriteCommand(string command, bool param)
		{
			rtfContent.Append(command);
			rtfContent.Append(param ? "1" : "0");
			isPreviousWriteCommand = true;
			IncreaseRowLength(command.Length);
		}

		public void WriteCommand(string command, int param)
		{
			rtfContent.Append(command);
			rtfContent.Append(param);
			isPreviousWriteCommand = true;
			IncreaseRowLength(command.Length);
		}

		public void WriteCommand(string command, string param)
		{
			rtfContent.Append(command);
			rtfContent.Append(param);
			isPreviousWriteCommand = true;
			IncreaseRowLength(command.Length);
		}

		public string CreateKeyword(string propertyName)
		{
			return "\\" + propertyName;
		}

		public string CreateOptionalKeyword(string propertyName)
		{
			return "\\*" + CreateKeyword(propertyName);
		}

		public void WriteAnsiText(string text)
		{
			int length = text.Length;
			if (isPreviousWriteCommand)
			{
				rtfContent.Append(RtfExportSRBase.Space);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char ch = text[i];
				string value = CorrectAnsiString(ch);
				rtfContent.Append(value);
			}
			isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			IncreaseRowLength(text.Length);
		}

		public void WriteText(string text)
		{
			WriteTextCore(text, specialMarks.Value);
		}

		public void WritePCData(string text)
		{
			WriteTextCore(text, specialPCDataMarks.Value);
		}

		protected void WriteTextCore(string text, Dictionary<char, string> specialMarks)
		{
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (specialMarks.TryGetValue(c, out var value))
				{
					WriteTextDirect(value);
				}
				else
				{
					WriteChar(c);
				}
			}
		}

		public void WriteTextDirect(string text, bool makeStringUnicodeCompatible)
		{
			if (isPreviousWriteCommand)
			{
				rtfContent.Append(RtfExportSRBase.Space);
			}
			if (makeStringUnicodeCompatible)
			{
				rtfContent.Append(GetUnicodeCompatibleStringDirect(text));
			}
			else
			{
				rtfContent.Append(text);
			}
			isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			IncreaseRowLength(text.Length);
		}

		public void WriteTextDirect(string text)
		{
			WriteTextDirect(text, makeStringUnicodeCompatible: false);
		}

		public void WriteTextWithEncoding(string text, Encoding encoding)
		{
			WriteTextDirect(ConvertToHexString(text, encoding));
		}

		private string ConvertToHexString(string text, Encoding encoding)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			byte[] bytes = encoding.GetBytes(text);
			int num = bytes.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("\\'");
				stringBuilder.Append(ConvertByteToHexString((byte)(bytes[i] % 256)));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void WriteTextDirectUnsafe(ChunkedStringBuilder text)
		{
			if (isPreviousWriteCommand)
			{
				rtfContent.Append(RtfExportSRBase.Space);
			}
			int length = text.Length;
			rtfContent.AppendExistingBuffersUnsafe(text);
			isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			IncreaseRowLength(length);
		}

		public void WriteChar(char ch)
		{
			if (isPreviousWriteCommand)
			{
				rtfContent.Append(RtfExportSRBase.Space);
			}
			string unicodeCompatibleString = GetUnicodeCompatibleString(ch);
			rtfContent.Append(unicodeCompatibleString);
			isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			IncreaseRowLength(unicodeCompatibleString.Length);
		}

		public void OpenGroup()
		{
			rtfContent.Append(RtfExportSRBase.OpenGroup);
			isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			IncreaseRowLength(RtfExportSRBase.OpenGroup.Length);
		}

		public void CloseGroup()
		{
			rtfContent.Append(RtfExportSRBase.CloseGroup);
			isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			IncreaseRowLength(RtfExportSRBase.CloseGroup.Length);
		}

		protected virtual string CorrectAnsiString(char ch)
		{
			unicodeTextBuilder.Length = 0;
			int code = (short)ch;
			if (IsANSI(code))
			{
				if (IsSpecialSymbol(ch))
				{
					unicodeTextBuilder.Append("\\");
				}
				unicodeTextBuilder.Append(ch);
			}
			else
			{
				unicodeTextBuilder.Append('?');
			}
			return unicodeTextBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetUnicodeCompatibleString(char ch)
		{
			unicodeTextBuilder.Length = 0;
			int code = (short)ch;
			if (IsASCII(code))
			{
				if (IsSpecialSymbol(ch))
				{
					unicodeTextBuilder.Append("\\");
				}
				unicodeTextBuilder.Append(ch);
			}
			else
			{
				AppendUnicodeCompatibleCharCore(code, ch);
			}
			return unicodeTextBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetUnicodeCompatibleStringDirect(string text)
		{
			unicodeTextBuilder.Length = 0;
			int length = text.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				int code = (short)c;
				if (IsASCII(code))
				{
					unicodeTextBuilder.Append(c);
				}
				else
				{
					AppendUnicodeCompatibleCharCore(code, c);
				}
			}
			return unicodeTextBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual void AppendUnicodeCompatibleCharCore(int code, char ch)
		{
			if (AppendCharCodeToUnicodeChar)
			{
				AppendCode(code);
			}
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.GetBytes(new char[1] { ch });
			AppendHexString(bytes);
		}

		private void AppendCode(int code)
		{
			unicodeTextBuilder.AppendFormat("\\u{0}", code);
		}

		private void AppendHexString(byte[] bytes)
		{
			unicodeTextBuilder.AppendFormat("\\'{0}", ConvertByteToHexString(bytes[0]));
		}

		public void WriteHex(byte val)
		{
			if (!hexMode)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			rtfContent.Append(byteToHexString[val]);
		}

		public void WriteHex(int val)
		{
			if (!hexMode)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			rtfContent.Append(byteToHexString[val & 0xFF]);
			rtfContent.Append(byteToHexString[(val >> 8) & 0xFF]);
			rtfContent.Append(byteToHexString[(val >> 16) & 0xFF]);
			rtfContent.Append(byteToHexString[val >> 24]);
		}

		public void WriteStreamAsHex(Stream stream)
		{
			ChunkedMemoryStream val = (ChunkedMemoryStream)(object)((stream is ChunkedMemoryStream) ? stream : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				WriteChunkedMemoryStreamAsHex(val);
			}
			else if (stream is MemoryStream stream2)
			{
				WriteMemoryStreamAsHex(stream2);
			}
			else
			{
				WriteStreamAsHexCore(stream);
			}
		}

		protected void WriteChunkedMemoryStreamAsHex(ChunkedMemoryStream stream)
		{
			IList<byte[]> buffers = stream.GetBuffers();
			int maxBufferSize = stream.MaxBufferSize;
			int num = buffers.Count - 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				WriteByteArrayAsHex(buffers[i], 0, maxBufferSize);
				isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			}
			int num2 = (int)(((Stream)(object)stream).Length % maxBufferSize);
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				WriteByteArrayAsHex(buffers[num], 0, num2);
			}
		}

		protected void WriteMemoryStreamAsHex(MemoryStream stream)
		{
			byte[] array = TryGetMemoryStreamBuffer(stream);
			if (array != null)
			{
				WriteByteArrayAsHex(array, 0, (int)stream.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				WriteStreamAsHexCore(stream);
			}
		}

		protected byte[] TryGetMemoryStreamBuffer(MemoryStream stream)
		{
			try
			{
				return stream.GetBuffer();
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public void WriteByteArrayAsHex(byte[] array)
		{
			WriteByteArrayAsHex(array, 0, array.Length);
		}

		public void WriteByteArrayAsHex(byte[] array, int offset, int length)
		{
			if (isPreviousWriteCommand)
			{
				rtfContent.Append(RtfExportSRBase.Space);
			}
			hexMode = true;
			int num = offset + length;
			for (int i = offset; i < num; i++)
			{
				byte b = array[i];
				IncreaseRowLength(2);
				rtfContent.Append(byteToHexString[b]);
			}
			isPreviousWriteCommand = true;
			hexMode = false;
		}

		protected void WriteStreamAsHexCore(Stream stream)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[4096];
			int num = array.Length;
			long num2 = stream.Length - stream.Position;
			while (num2 >= num)
			{
				stream.Read(array, 0, num);
				num2 -= num;
				WriteByteArrayAsHex(array);
				isPreviousWriteCommand = false;
			}
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				stream.Read(array, 0, (int)num2);
				WriteByteArrayAsHex(array, 0, (int)num2);
			}
			isPreviousWriteCommand = true;
		}

		public string EscapeSpecialCharacters(string fontName)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			bool flag = false;
			int length = fontName.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = fontName[i];
				if (c != ';' && c != '\\' && c != '{' && c != '}')
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (i > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(fontName.Substring(0, i));
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("\\'");
				stringBuilder.Append(ConvertByteToHexString((byte)(c % 256)));
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return fontName;
		}
	}
	public abstract class RtfFontNameEncodingCalculatorBase
	{
		public RtfFontNameEncodingCalculatorBase()
		{
		}

		public Encoding CalculateFontNameEncoding(string fontName, int fontIndex, Encoding actualEncoding)
		{
			if (CanBeLosslesslyEncoded(fontName, DXEncoding.ASCII))
			{
				return DXEncoding.ASCII;
			}
			if (TryToUseFontCharset(fontName, fontIndex, out var encoding))
			{
				return encoding;
			}
			if (CanBeLosslesslyEncoded(fontName, actualEncoding))
			{
				return actualEncoding;
			}
			if (TryToUseOtherEncodings(fontName, out encoding))
			{
				return encoding;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected abstract bool TryToUseFontCharset(string fontName, int fontIndex, out Encoding encoding);

		public bool CanBeLosslesslyEncoded(string value, Encoding encoding)
		{
			byte[] bytes = encoding.GetBytes(value);
			string strB = encoding.GetString(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
			return string.Compare(value, strB) == 0;
		}

		private bool TryToUseOtherEncodings(string fontName, out Encoding encoding)
		{
			encoding = null;
			EncodingInfo[] encodings = DXEncoding.GetEncodings();
			int num = encodings.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				try
				{
					Encoding encoding2 = encodings[i].GetEncoding();
					if (encoding2.CodePage != 65000 && encoding2.CodePage != 65001 && encoding2.CodePage != 1200 && encoding2.CodePage != 1201 && CanBeLosslesslyEncoded(fontName, encoding2))
					{
						encoding = encoding2;
						return true;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		}

			EndFragment = GetPosition(writer);

		}

		protected void Initialize(string targetUri, bool useAbsolutePath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetUri))
			{
				FilesPath = "_files/";
			}
			else
			{
				FilesPath = Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(targetUri), Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(targetUri) + "_files/");
			}

			IScriptContainer val = (IScriptContainer)((service is IScriptContainer) ? service : null);
			if (val != null)
			{

			}
			return (IScriptContainer)(object)StyleControl;
		}

		public string Export()
		{
			ChunkedStringBuilder chunkedStringBuilder = new ChunkedStringBuilder();
			if (ExportToClipboard)
			{
				using ChunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter chunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter = new ChunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter(chunkedStringBuilder);
				chunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter.WriteLine("Version:0.9\r\nStartHTML:>>>>>>>>>1\r\nEndHTML:>>>>>>>>>2\r\nStartFragment:>>>>>>>>>3\r\nEndFragment:>>>>>>>>>4");
				Export(chunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter);
				CalculationClipboardHeaderValue(chunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter);
			}
			else
			{
				using ChunkedStringBuilderWriter writer = new ChunkedStringBuilderWriter(chunkedStringBuilder);
				Export(writer);
			}
			return chunkedStringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public virtual void Export(TextWriter writer)
		{
			if (EmbedImages)
			{
				IUriProvider provider = new DataStringUriProvider();
				IUriProviderService uriProviderService = ServiceProvider.GetService(typeof(IUriProviderService)) as IUriProviderService;
				uriProviderService?.RegisterProvider(provider);
				try
				{
					ExportCore(writer);
				}
				finally
				{
					uriProviderService?.UnregisterProvider(provider);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ExportCore(writer);
			}
			writer.Flush();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ExportCore(TextWriter writer)
		{
			DXHtmlTextWriter val = CreateHtmlTextWriter(writer);
			try
			{
				DXWebControlBase val2 = ExportBodyControl();
				if (ExportToBodyTag)
				{
					val2.RenderControl(val);
				}
				else
				{
					CreateHtmlDocument(val, val2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new DXHtmlTextWriter(writer);
		}

		protected internal virtual void CreateHtmlDocument(DXHtmlTextWriter writer, DXWebControlBase body)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DXHtmlGenericControl val = new DXHtmlGenericControl((DXHtmlTextWriterTag)43);
			if (!UseHtml5)
			{
				((DXHtmlControl)val).Attributes.Add("xmlns", "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml");
			}
			DXHtmlGenericControl val2 = new DXHtmlGenericControl((DXHtmlTextWriterTag)41);
			((DXWebControlBase)val).Controls.Add((DXWebControlBase)(object)val2);
			DXHtmlGenericControl val3 = new DXHtmlGenericControl((DXHtmlTextWriterTag)58);
			((DXHtmlControl)val3).Attributes.Add("http-equiv", "Content-Type");
			((DXHtmlControl)val3).Attributes.Add("content", $"text/html; charset={Encoding.WebName}");
			((DXWebControlBase)val2).Controls.Add((DXWebControlBase)(object)val3);
			DXWebControlBase val4 = CreateTitle();
			((DXWebControlBase)val2).Controls.Add(val4);
			if (ShouldWriteStyles())
			{
				WriteStyles((DXWebControlBase)(object)val2);
			}
			((DXWebControlBase)val).Controls.Add(body);
			WriteHtmlDocumentPreamble(writer);
			((TextWriter)(object)writer).WriteLine();
			((DXWebControlBase)val).RenderControl(writer);
		}

		protected virtual DXWebControlBase CreateTitle()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (DXWebControlBase)new DXHtmlGenericControl((DXHtmlTextWriterTag)89);
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteHtmlDocumentPreamble(DXHtmlTextWriter writer)
		{
			if (UseHtml5)
			{
				((TextWriter)(object)writer).Write("<!DOCTYPE html>");
			}
			else
			{
				((TextWriter)(object)writer).Write("<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC \"-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN\" \"http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd\">");
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldWriteStyles()
		{
			if (StyleControl.Styles.Count <= 0 && StyleControl.TagStyles.Count <= 0)
			{
				return (object)ScriptContainer != StyleControl;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal void WriteStyles(DXWebControlBase control)
		{
			if (ExportStylesAsStyleTag)
			{
				control.Controls.Add((DXWebControlBase)(object)StyleControl);
			}
			if (ExportStylesAsLink)
			{
				WriteStyleLink(control);
			}
		}

		private void WriteStyleLink(DXWebControlBase control)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string text = ExportCssProperiesToSeparateFile(StyleControl);
			DXHtmlGenericControl val = new DXHtmlGenericControl((DXHtmlTextWriterTag)54);
			((DXHtmlControl)val).Attributes.Add("rel", "stylesheet");
			((DXHtmlControl)val).Attributes.Add("type", "text/css");
			((DXHtmlControl)val).Attributes.Add("href", text);
			control.Controls.Add((DXWebControlBase)(object)val);
		}

		protected internal string ExportCssProperiesToSeparateFile(StyleWebControl style)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			using (StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter(stringBuilder))
			{
				style.RenderStyles(stringWriter);
				stringWriter.Flush();
			}
			string styleText = stringBuilder.ToString();
			if (ServiceProvider.GetService(typeof(IUriProviderService)) is IUriProviderService uriProviderService)
			{
				return uriProviderService.CreateCssUri(FilesPath, styleText, RelativeUri);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected virtual DXWebControlBase ExportBodyControl()
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			EmptyWebControl emptyWebControl = new EmptyWebControl();
			ExportBodyContent((DXWebControlBase)(object)emptyWebControl);
			DXWebControlBase val = (DXWebControlBase)new DXHtmlGenericControl((DXHtmlTextWriterTag)12);
			SetupBodyTag(val);
			if (ExportToBodyTag && ShouldWriteStyles())
			{
				WriteStyles(val);
			}
			if (ExportToClipboard)
			{
				Fragment = new DXHtmlClipboardFragment();
				((DXWebControlBase)Fragment).Controls.Add((DXWebControlBase)(object)emptyWebControl);
				val.Controls.Add((DXWebControlBase)(object)Fragment);
			}
			else
			{
				val.Controls.Add((DXWebControlBase)(object)emptyWebControl);
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected virtual void SetupBodyTag(DXWebControlBase body)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void ExportBodyContent(DXWebControlBase root);

		protected virtual void CalculationClipboardHeaderValue(ChunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter writer)
		{
			int length = "Version:0.9\r\nStartHTML:>>>>>>>>>1\r\nEndHTML:>>>>>>>>>2\r\nStartFragment:>>>>>>>>>3\r\nEndFragment:>>>>>>>>>4".Length;
			ChunkedStringBuilder stringBuilder = writer.GetStringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Buffers[0].Replace(">>>>>>>>>1", length.ToString("D10"), 0, length);
			stringBuilder.Buffers[0].Replace(">>>>>>>>>2", writer.ByteCount.ToString("D10"), 0, length);
			stringBuilder.Buffers[0].Replace(">>>>>>>>>3", Fragment.StartFragment.ToString("D10"), 0, length);
			stringBuilder.Buffers[0].Replace(">>>>>>>>>4", Fragment.EndFragment.ToString("D10"), 0, length);
		}
	}
	public class OfficeHtmlImageHelper
	{
		private readonly IDocumentModel documentModel;

		private readonly DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter;

		public float HorizontalResolution { get; set; }

		public float VerticalResolution { get; set; }

		public bool SuppressAdditionalMetafileConversion { get; set; }

		public OfficeHtmlImageHelper(IDocumentModel documentModel, DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
			CalculateDefaultImageResolution();
		}

		private bool ShouldConvertImage(OfficeImage image)
		{
			switch (image.RawFormat)
			{
			default:
				return false;
			case OfficeImageFormat.None:
			case OfficeImageFormat.Emf:
			case OfficeImageFormat.Exif:
			case OfficeImageFormat.Icon:
			case OfficeImageFormat.MemoryBmp:
			case OfficeImageFormat.Wmf:
				return true;
			}
		}

		public void ApplyImageProperties(WebImageControl imageControl, OfficeImage image, Size actualSize, IOfficeImageRepository imageRepository, bool disposeConvertedImagesImmediately)
		{
			ApplyImageProperties(imageControl, image, actualSize, imageRepository, disposeConvertedImagesImmediately, alwaysWriteImageSize: false);
		}

		public void ApplyImageProperties(WebImageControl imageControl, OfficeImage image, Size actualSize, IOfficeImageRepository imageRepository, bool disposeConvertedImagesImmediately, bool alwaysWriteImageSize)
		{
			ApplyImageProperties(imageControl, image, actualSize, imageRepository, disposeConvertedImagesImmediately, alwaysWriteImageSize, keepImageSize: false);
		}

		public void ApplyImageProperties(WebImageControl imageControl, OfficeImage image, Size actualSize, IOfficeImageRepository imageRepository, bool disposeConvertedImagesImmediately, bool alwaysWriteImageSize, bool keepImageSize)
		{
			UriBasedOfficeImageBase uriBasedOfficeImageBase = image as UriBasedOfficeImageBase;
			bool flag = false;
			int? num = uriBasedOfficeImageBase?.PixelTargetWidth;
			int? num2 = uriBasedOfficeImageBase?.PixelTargetHeight;
			if (ShouldConvertImage(image))
			{
				if (keepImageSize)
				{
					Action<IDXGraphics> customization = delegate(IDXGraphics gr)
					{
						gr.CompositingMode = DXCompositingMode.SourceCopy;
						gr.CompositingQuality = DXCompositingQuality.HighQuality;
						gr.SmoothingMode = DXSmoothingMode.HighQuality;
						gr.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.HighQuality;
						gr.InterpolationMode = DXInterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
					};
					OfficeReferenceImage img = documentModel.CreateImage(new DXBitmap(image.DXImage, customization));
					imageControl.ImageUrl = imageRepository.GetImageSource(img, disposeConvertedImagesImmediately);
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					imageControl.ImageUrl = imageRepository.GetImageSource(GetHtmlImage(image, actualSize), disposeConvertedImagesImmediately);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				imageControl.ImageUrl = imageRepository.GetImageSource(image, autoDisposeImage: false);
				if (uriBasedOfficeImageBase == null || (num.HasValue && num2.HasValue))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (alwaysWriteImageSize || flag)
			{
				((DXHtmlControl)imageControl).Attributes.Add("width", (num == 0) ? "0" : unitConverter.RoundModelUnitsToPixels(actualSize.Width, HorizontalResolution).ToString());
				((DXHtmlControl)imageControl).Attributes.Add("height", (num2 == 0) ? "0" : unitConverter.RoundModelUnitsToPixels(actualSize.Height, VerticalResolution).ToString());
			}
			else if (uriBasedOfficeImageBase != null)
			{
				if (num > 0)
				{
					((DXHtmlControl)imageControl).Attributes.Add("width", unitConverter.RoundModelUnitsToPixels(actualSize.Width, HorizontalResolution).ToString());
				}
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					((DXHtmlControl)imageControl).Attributes.Add("height", unitConverter.RoundModelUnitsToPixels(actualSize.Height, VerticalResolution).ToString());
				}
			}
		}

		internal OfficeImage GetHtmlImage(OfficeImage image, Size actualSize)
		{
			int width = Math.Max(1, unitConverter.RoundModelUnitsToPixels(actualSize.Width, HorizontalResolution));
			int height = Math.Max(1, unitConverter.RoundModelUnitsToPixels(actualSize.Height, VerticalResolution));
			OfficeImage officeImage = CreateBitmapFromSourceImage(image, width, height);
			officeImage.Uri = image.Uri;
			return officeImage;
		}

		private OfficeImage CreateBitmapFromSourceImage(OfficeImage image, int width, int height)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(Math.Max(1, width), Math.Max(1, height));
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics())
			{
				DXImage dXImage = image.DXImage;
				if (!SuppressAdditionalMetafileConversion && dXImage is DXMetafile metafile)
				{
					dXImage = DXBitmapCreator.CreateFromMetafile(metafile, Color.Empty, 300f);
					iDXGraphics.InterpolationMode = DXInterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
				}
				iDXGraphics.Clear(DXColor.Transparent);
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(dXImage, new RectangleF(0f, 0f, width, height));
			}
			return documentModel.CreateImage(dXBitmap);
		}

		private void CalculateDefaultImageResolution()
		{
			using DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(1, 1);
			HorizontalResolution = ((dXBitmap.HorizontalResolution > 0f) ? dXBitmap.HorizontalResolution : 96f);
			VerticalResolution = ((dXBitmap.VerticalResolution > 0f) ? dXBitmap.VerticalResolution : 96f);
		}
	}
	public interface IOfficeImageRepository : IDisposable
	{
		string GetImageSource(OfficeImage img, bool autoDisposeImage);
	}
	public class ServiceBasedImageRepository : IOfficeImageRepository, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IServiceProvider serviceProvider;

		private readonly string rootUri;

		private readonly string relativeUri;

		public ServiceBasedImageRepository(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, string rootUri, string relativeUri)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)serviceProvider, "serviceProvider");
			this.serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
			this.rootUri = rootUri;
			this.relativeUri = relativeUri;
		}

		public string GetImageSource(OfficeImage image, bool autoDisposeImage)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			IUriProviderService uriProviderService = (IUriProviderService)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IUriProviderService));
			if (uriProviderService != null)
			{
				result = uriProviderService.CreateImageUri(rootUri, image, relativeUri);
			}
			if (autoDisposeImage)
			{
				image.Dispose();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class StyleWebControl : DXHtmlGenericControl, IScriptContainer
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, string> styles;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, string> tagStyles;

		public Dictionary<string, string> Styles => styles;

		public Dictionary<string, string> TagStyles => tagStyles;

		public StyleWebControl()
			: base((DXHtmlTextWriterTag)79)
		{
			styles = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringExtensions.ComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			tagStyles = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringExtensions.ComparerInvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			((DXHtmlControl)this).Attributes.Add("type", "text/css");
		}

		protected override void Render(DXHtmlTextWriter writer)
		{
			((DXHtmlControl)this).RenderBeginTag(writer);
			RenderTagStyles((TextWriter)(object)writer);
			RenderStyles((TextWriter)(object)writer);
			((DXHtmlContainerControl)this).RenderEndTag(writer);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderStyles(TextWriter writer)
		{
			foreach (string key in styles.Keys)
			{
				string arg = styles[key];
				writer.WriteLine($".{arg}{{{key}}}");
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RenderTagStyles(TextWriter writer)
		{
			foreach (string key in tagStyles.Keys)
			{
				string arg = tagStyles[key];
				writer.WriteLine($"{arg} {{{key}}}");
			}
		}

		public bool IsClientScriptBlockRegistered(string key)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public void RegisterClientScriptBlock(string key, string script)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public string RegisterCssClass(string style)
		{
			AddStyle(style, GetClassName(style));
			return styles[style];
		}

		public void RegisterCommonCssStyle(string style, string tagName)
		{
			AddTagStyle(style, tagName);
		}

		private void AddStyle(string style, string name)
		{
			if (!styles.ContainsKey(style))
			{
				styles.Add(style, name);
			}
		}

		private void AddTagStyle(string style, string name)
		{
			if (!tagStyles.ContainsKey(style))
			{
				tagStyles.Add(style, name);
			}
		}

		protected internal string GetClassName(string style)
		{
			return $"cs{style.GetHashCode():X}";
		}
	}

					return (DXWebImageAlign)obj;

				//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

		protected override void AddAttributesToRender(DXHtmlTextWriter writer)

			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((DXHtmlContainerControl)this).AddAttributesToRender(writer);
			string text = ImageUrl;
			if (!UrlResolved)
			{
				text = ((DXWebControlBase)this).ResolveClientUrl(text);
			}
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				if (StringExtensions.StartsWithInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(text, "file://"))
				{
					writer.AddAttribute("src", text, false);
				}
				else
				{
					writer.AddAttribute((DXHtmlTextWriterAttribute)30, text);
				}
			}
			text = DescriptionUrl;
			if (text.Length != 0)
			{
				writer.AddAttribute((DXHtmlTextWriterAttribute)48, ((DXWebControlBase)this).ResolveClientUrl(text));
			}
			text = AlternateText;
			if (text.Length > 0 || GenerateEmptyAlternateText)
			{
				writer.AddAttribute((DXHtmlTextWriterAttribute)2, text);
			}
			string alignValueString = GetAlignValueString();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(alignValueString))
			{
				writer.AddAttribute((DXHtmlTextWriterAttribute)1, alignValueString);
			}
			DXWebUnit borderWidth = ((DXHtmlControl)this).BorderWidth;
			if (((DXWebUnit)(ref borderWidth)).IsEmpty)
			{
				writer.AddStyleAttribute((DXHtmlTextWriterStyle)5, "0px");
			}
		}

		protected internal string GetAlignValueString()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			DXWebImageAlign imageAlign = ImageAlign;
			return (int)imageAlign switch
			{
				1 => "left", 
				2 => "right", 
				3 => "baseline", 
				4 => "top", 
				5 => "middle", 
				6 => "bottom", 
				7 => "absbottom", 
				8 => "absmiddle", 
				0 => string.Empty, 
				_ => "texttop", 
			};
		}
	}

	public class AdjustValuesConverterToBinaryFormat
	{
		public static void Convert(int shapeWidth, int shapeHeight, ShapePreset shapeType, int?[] adjustValues)
		{
			if (shapeHeight != 0 && shapeWidth != 0)
			{
				int minSide = Math.Min(shapeWidth, shapeHeight);
				switch (shapeType)
				{
				case ShapePreset.LeftArrow:
					CalculateLeftArrow(adjustValues, shapeWidth, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.RightArrow:
					CalculateRightArrow(adjustValues, shapeWidth, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.UpArrow:
					CalculateUpArrow(adjustValues, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.DownArrow:
					CalculateDownArrow(adjustValues, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.LeftRightArrow:
					CalculateLeftRightArrow(adjustValues, shapeWidth, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.UpDownArrow:
					CalculateUpDownArrow(adjustValues, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.NotchedRightArrow:
					CalculateNotchedRightArrow(adjustValues, shapeWidth, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.HomePlate:
				case ShapePreset.Chevron:
					CalculateHomePlate(adjustValues, shapeWidth, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.RightArrowCallout:
					CalculateRightArrowCallout(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.LeftArrowCallout:
					CalculateLeftArrowCallout(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.LeftRightArrowCallout:
					CalculateLeftRightArrowCallout(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.UpArrowCallout:
					CalculateUpArrowCallout(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.DownArrowCallout:
					CalculateDownArrowCallout(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.UpDownArrowCallout:
					CalculateUpDownArrowCallout(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.SmileyFace:
					CalculateSmileyFace(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Star4:
					CalculateStar4(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Star8:
					CalculateStar8(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Star16:
					CalculateStar16(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Star24:
					CalculateStar24(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Star32:
					CalculateStar32(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Wave:
					CalculateWave(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.DoubleWave:
					CalculateDoubleWave(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Ribbon2:
					CalculateUpRibbon(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Ribbon:
					CalculateDownRibbon(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.EllipseRibbon2:
					CalculateCurvedUpRibbon(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.EllipseRibbon:
					CalculateCurvedDownRibbon(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.CurvedRightArrow:
					CalculateCurvedRightArrow(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.CurvedLeftArrow:
					CalculateCurvedLeftArrow(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.CurvedUpArrow:
					CalculateCurvedUpArrow(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.CurvedDownArrow:
					CalculateCurvedDownArrow(adjustValues, shapeWidth, shapeHeight, minSide);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.WedgeRectCallout:
				case ShapePreset.WedgeRoundRectCallout:
				case ShapePreset.WedgeEllipseCallout:
				case ShapePreset.CloudCallout:
					CalculateCallout(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Callout1:
				case ShapePreset.AccentCallout1:
				case ShapePreset.BorderCallout1:
				case ShapePreset.AccentBorderCallout1:
					CalculateLineCallout1(adjustValues);
					break;
				case ShapePreset.Callout2:
				case ShapePreset.AccentCallout2:

			}

			int num9 = (int)Math.Round(100000.0 * num8 / (double)minSide);
			int num10 = (int)Math.Round(21600.0 * num8 / (double)(vertical ? shapeHeight : shapeWidth));
			int num11 = (reverseAdj ? 21600 : num10);
			int num12 = (reverseAdj ? (21600 - num10) : 0);
			int num13 = num11 - num12;
			if (num9 != 0)
			{
				int num14 = (int)Math.Round((double)openXmlAdj3 / (double)num9 * (double)num13);
				if (reverseAdj)
				{
					num14 = num11 - num14;
				}
				adjustValues[2] = ((num14 != odrawAdjDefault) ? new int?(num14) : ((int?)null));
			}
		}

				int num3 = (int)Math.Round((double)adjustValues[1].Value / num) + 10800;
				adjustValues[0] = ((num2 != odrawAdj1) ? new int?(num2) : ((int?)null));
				adjustValues[1] = ((num3 != odrawAdj2) ? new int?(num3) : ((int?)null));
				adjustValues[2] = null;
			}
		}

		private static void CalculateLineCalloutCore(int?[] adjustValues, params int[] odrawValues)
		{
			double num = 4.62962962962963;
			if (odrawValues.Length <= adjustValues.Length)
			{
				int num2 = odrawValues.Length - 1;
				int?[] array = new int?[8];
				for (int i = 0; i < adjustValues.Length && adjustValues[i].HasValue; i++)
				{
					int num3 = (int)Math.Round((double)adjustValues[i].Value / num);
					array[num2] = ((num3 != odrawValues[num2]) ? new int?(num3) : ((int?)null));
					num2--;
				}
				array.CopyTo(adjustValues, 0);
			}
		}

			{

		{
