		private static int Pin(int x, int y, int z)
		{
			if (y >= x)
			{
				if (y <= z)
				{
					return y;
				}
				return z;
			}
			return x;
		}

		public static void ConvertWordArt(int widthEmu, int heightEmu, DrawingPresetTextWarp presetTextWarp, int?[] adjustValues)
		{
			switch (presetTextWarp)
			{
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchDown:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj5(adjustValues[0], widthEmu, heightEmu);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchDownPour:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj5(adjustValues[0], widthEmu, heightEmu);
				adjustValues[1] = ConvertWordArtAdj1(adjustValues[1]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchUp:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj5(adjustValues[0], widthEmu, heightEmu);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ArchUpPour:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj5(adjustValues[0], widthEmu, heightEmu);
				adjustValues[1] = ConvertWordArtAdj1(adjustValues[1]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Button:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj5(adjustValues[0], widthEmu, heightEmu);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ButtonPour:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj5(adjustValues[0], widthEmu, heightEmu);
				adjustValues[1] = ConvertWordArtAdj1(adjustValues[1]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CanDown:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CanUp:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CascadeDown:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CascadeUp:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Chevron:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.ChevronInverted:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Circle:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj5(adjustValues[0], widthEmu, heightEmu);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CirclePour:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj5(adjustValues[0], widthEmu, heightEmu);
				adjustValues[1] = ConvertWordArtAdj1(adjustValues[1]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CurveDown:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.CurveUp:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Deflate:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.DeflateBottom:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.DeflateInflate:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateDeflate:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.DeflateTop:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.DoubleWave1:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				adjustValues[1] = ConvertWordArtAdj2(adjustValues[1]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeDown:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeLeft:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeRight:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeUp:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Inflate:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateBottom:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateTop:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Plain:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.RingInside:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.RingOutside:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.SlantDown:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.SlantUp:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Stop:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Triangle:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.TriangleInverted:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave1:
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave2:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				adjustValues[1] = ConvertWordArtAdj2(adjustValues[1]);
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave4:
				adjustValues[0] = ConvertWordArtAdj3(adjustValues[0]);
				adjustValues[1] = ConvertWordArtAdj2(adjustValues[1]);
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("presetTextWarp", presetTextWarp, null);
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.NoShape:
				break;
			}
		}

		private static int ConvertWordArtAdj1(int? value)
		{
			return (int)((double?)value / 9.259).Value;
		}

		private static int ConvertWordArtAdj2(int? value)
		{
			return (int)((double?)value * 0.216 + 10800.0).Value;
		}

		private static int ConvertWordArtAdj3(int? value)
		{
			return (int)((double?)value / 4.63).Value;
		}

		private static int ConvertWordArtAdj5(int? value, double width, double height)
		{
			double num = (double)value.Value / 60000.0;
			num %= 360.0;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num += 360.0;
			}
			double a = num / 180.0 * Math.PI;
			double num2 = Math.Atan(Math.Tan(a) * width / height) / Math.PI * 180.0;
			if (90.0 < num && num <= 270.0)
			{
				return (int)((180.0 + num2) % 360.0 * 65536.0);
			}
			return (int)((360.0 + num2) % 360.0 * 65536.0);
		}
	}
	public static class BinaryDrawingExportHelper
	{
		private delegate bool IsSomeModelPathType(IPathInstruction instruction);

		private class PathInstructionExportWalker : IPathInstructionWalker
		{
			private readonly List<DrawingGeometryPoint> points;

			private readonly List<MsoPathInfo> msoPathInfos;

			private readonly ModelShapePathsList paths;

			private readonly IShapeGuideCalculator calculator;

			private int lastX;

			private int lastY;

			private int geometrySpaceBottom;

			private int geometrySpaceRight;

			public DrawingGeometryPoint[] Points => points.ToArray();

			public MsoPathInfo[] MsoPathInfos => msoPathInfos.ToArray();

			public int GeometrySpaceBottom => geometrySpaceBottom;

			public int GeometrySpaceRight => geometrySpaceRight;

			public PathInstructionExportWalker(ModelShapePathsList paths, IShapeGuideCalculator calculator)
			{
				this.paths = paths;
				this.calculator = calculator;
				points = new List<DrawingGeometryPoint>();
				msoPathInfos = new List<MsoPathInfo>();
			}

			public void Walk()
			{
				foreach (ModelShapePath path in paths)
				{
					foreach (IPathInstruction instruction in path.Instructions)
					{
						instruction.Visit(this);
						if (instruction is PathMove)
						{
							if (path.FillMode == PathFillMode.None)
							{
								msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathEscape.NoFill, 0));
							}
							if (!path.Stroke)
							{
								msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathEscape.NoLine, 0));
							}
						}
					}
					msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.End, -65536));
					if (path.Width > geometrySpaceRight)
					{
						geometrySpaceRight = (int)path.Width;
					}
					if (path.Height > geometrySpaceBottom)
					{
						geometrySpaceBottom = (int)path.Height;
					}
				}
			}

			public void Visit(PathArc pathArc)
			{
				int num = Round(pathArc.HeightRadius.Evaluate(calculator));
				int num2 = Round(pathArc.WidthRadius.Evaluate(calculator));
				double value = pathArc.StartAngle.Evaluate(calculator);
				double num3 = pathArc.SwingAngle.Evaluate(calculator);
				bool flag = num3 > 0.0;
				double num4 = NormalizeAngle(EmuAngleToDegree(value));
				double angle = (num4 + EmuAngleToDegree(num3)) % 360.0;
				DrawingGeometryPoint item = new DrawingGeometryPoint(lastX, lastY);
				DrawingGeometryPoint drawingGeometryPoint = new DrawingGeometryPoint(GetTopLeftPoint(num2, num, num4));
				DrawingGeometryPoint item2 = new DrawingGeometryPoint(drawingGeometryPoint.X.Value + num2 * 2, drawingGeometryPoint.Y.Value + num * 2);
				DrawingGeometryPoint drawingGeometryPoint2 = new DrawingGeometryPoint(GetIntersectionPoint(drawingGeometryPoint.X.Value, drawingGeometryPoint.Y.Value, num2, num, angle));
				points.Add(drawingGeometryPoint);
				points.Add(item2);
				points.Add(item);
				points.Add(drawingGeometryPoint2);
				lastX = drawingGeometryPoint2.X.Value;
				lastY = drawingGeometryPoint2.Y.Value;
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(flag ? MsoPathEscape.ClockwiseArcTo : MsoPathEscape.ArcTo, 4));
			}

			private Point GetTopLeftPoint(double wR, double hR, double angle)
			{
				double num = DegreeToRadian(angle);
				double num2 = Math.Cos(num);
				double num3 = Math.Sin(num);
				double num4 = hR * wR / Math.Sqrt(hR * hR * num2 * num2 + wR * wR * num3 * num3);
				if (double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					return new Point(Round((double)lastX - wR), Round((double)lastY - hR));
				}
				double num5 = (double)lastX - num4 * num2;
				double num6 = (double)lastY - num4 * num3;
				return new Point(Round(num5 - wR), Round(num6 - hR));
			}

			private static Point GetIntersectionPoint(int left, int top, double wR, double hR, double angle)
			{
				double num = DegreeToRadian(angle);
				double num2 = Math.Atan2(wR * Math.Sin(num), hR * Math.Cos(num));
				double value = wR * Math.Cos(num2) + wR + (double)left;
				double value2 = hR * Math.Sin(num2) + hR + (double)top;
				return new Point(Round(value), Round(value2));
			}

			public void Visit(PathClose value)
			{
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.Close, 1));
			}

			public void Visit(PathCubicBezier pathCubicBezier)
			{
				foreach (AdjustablePoint point in pathCubicBezier.Points)
				{
					int x = Round(point.X.Evaluate(calculator));
					int y = Round(point.Y.Evaluate(calculator));
					points.Add(new DrawingGeometryPoint(x, y));
				}
				AdjustablePoint last = pathCubicBezier.Points.Last;
				if (last != null)
				{
					lastX = Round(last.X.Evaluate(calculator));
					lastY = Round(last.Y.Evaluate(calculator));
				}
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.CurveTo, pathCubicBezier.Points.Count / 3));
			}

			public void Visit(PathLine pathLine)
			{
				int x = Round(pathLine.Point.X.Evaluate(calculator));
				int y = Round(pathLine.Point.Y.Evaluate(calculator));
				points.Add(new DrawingGeometryPoint(x, y));
				lastX = x;
				lastY = y;
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.LineTo, 1));
			}

			public void Visit(PathMove pathMove)
			{
				int x = Round(pathMove.Point.X.Evaluate(calculator));
				int y = Round(pathMove.Point.Y.Evaluate(calculator));
				points.Add(new DrawingGeometryPoint(x, y));
				lastX = x;
				lastY = y;
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.MoveTo, 0));
			}

			public void Visit(PathQuadraticBezier pathQuadraticBezier)
			{
				double[] array = new double[3];
				double[] array2 = new double[3];
				int[] array3 = new int[3];
				int[] array4 = new int[3];
				array[0] = lastX;
				array2[0] = lastY;
				for (int i = 1; i < 3; i++)
				{
					array[i] = pathQuadraticBezier.Points[i - 1].X.Evaluate(calculator);
					array2[i] = pathQuadraticBezier.Points[i - 1].Y.Evaluate(calculator);
				}
				array3[0] = Round(array[0] + 2.0 * (array[1] - array[0]) / 3.0);
				array4[0] = Round(array2[0] + 2.0 * (array2[1] - array2[0]) / 3.0);
				array3[1] = Round(array[2] + 2.0 * (array[1] - array[2]) / 3.0);
				array4[1] = Round(array2[2] + 2.0 * (array2[1] - array2[2]) / 3.0);
				array3[2] = Round(array[2]);
				array4[2] = Round(array2[2]);
				for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
				{
					points.Add(new DrawingGeometryPoint(array3[j], array4[j]));
				}
				lastX = array3[2];
				lastY = array4[2];
				msoPathInfos.Add(new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.CurveTo, 1));
			}

			private static double EmuAngleToDegree(double value)
			{
				return value / 60000.0;
			}

			private static double DegreeToRadian(double degree)
			{
				return degree / 180.0 * Math.PI;
			}

			private static int Round(double value)
			{
				return (int)Math.Round(value);
			}

			private static double NormalizeAngle(double angle)
			{
				if (angle < 0.0)
				{
					return 360.0 - Math.Abs(angle);
				}
				return angle;
			}
		}

		public const int DefaultLineOpacity = 65536;

		public static void CreateCustomGeometryProperties(IOfficeShape shape, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			CreateCustomGeometryProperties(shape.ShapeProperties, shape.Height, shape.Width, artProperties.Properties);
		}

		public static void CreateCustomGeometryProperties(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, float height, float width, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			CreateShapePath(shapeProperties, height, width, properties);
			CreateConnectionSites(shapeProperties, height, width, properties);
		}

		private static void CreateConnectionSites(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, float height, float width, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			int heightEmu = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(height);
			int widthEmu = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(width);
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry shapeGeometry = shapeProperties.GetShapeGeometry();
			ModelShapeGuideList presetAdjustList = shapeProperties.PresetAdjustList;
			CreateConnectionSitesCore(shapeGeometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, presetAdjustList, properties);
		}

		private static void CreateConnectionSitesCore(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, ModelShapeGuideList adjustValues, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			List<DrawingGeometryPoint> list = new List<DrawingGeometryPoint>();
			List<FixedPoint> list2 = new List<FixedPoint>();
			ShapeGuideCalculator calculator = new ShapeGuideCalculator(geometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, adjustValues);
			ModelShapeConnectionList connectionSites = geometry.ConnectionSites;
			if (connectionSites.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ModelShapeConnection item2 in connectionSites)
			{
				double value = item2.Angle.Evaluate(calculator) / 60000.0;
				int x = (int)Math.Round(item2.X.Evaluate(calculator));
				int y = (int)Math.Round(item2.Y.Evaluate(calculator));
				list.Add(new DrawingGeometryPoint(x, y));
				list2.Add(new FixedPoint
				{
					Value = value
				});
			}
			DrawingGeometryConnectionSites drawingGeometryConnectionSites = new DrawingGeometryConnectionSites();
			drawingGeometryConnectionSites.SetElements(list.ToArray());
			DrawingGeometryConnectionSitesDir drawingGeometryConnectionSitesDir = new DrawingGeometryConnectionSitesDir();
			drawingGeometryConnectionSitesDir.SetElements(list2.ToArray());
			properties.Add(drawingGeometryConnectionSites);
			properties.Add(drawingGeometryConnectionSitesDir);
			DrawingConnectionPointsType item = new DrawingConnectionPointsType(ConnectionPointsType.Custom);
			properties.Add(item);
		}

		private static void CreateShapePath(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, float height, float width, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry shapeGeometry = shapeProperties.GetShapeGeometry();
			int heightEmu = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(height);
			int widthEmu = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(width);
			CreateShapePathCore(shapeGeometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, shapeProperties.PresetAdjustList, properties);
		}

		private static void CreateGeometrySpaceProperties(List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties, int geometrySpaceRight, int geometrySpaceBottom)
		{
			int value = 0;
			int value2 = 0;
			properties.Add(new DrawingGeometryLeft
			{
				Value = value
			});
			properties.Add(new DrawingGeometryTop
			{
				Value = value2
			});
			properties.Add(new DrawingGeometryRight
			{
				Value = geometrySpaceRight
			});
			properties.Add(new DrawingGeometryBottom
			{
				Value = geometrySpaceBottom
			});
		}

		private static void CreateShapePathCore(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, int widthEmu, int heightEmu, ModelShapeGuideList adjustValues, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			ShapePathType shapePathType = GetShapePathType(geometry);
			ShapeGuideCalculator calculator = new ShapeGuideCalculator(geometry, widthEmu, heightEmu, adjustValues);
			PathInstructionExportWalker pathInstructionExportWalker = new PathInstructionExportWalker(geometry.Paths, calculator);
			pathInstructionExportWalker.Walk();
			int num = pathInstructionExportWalker.GeometrySpaceRight;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = widthEmu;
			}
			int num2 = pathInstructionExportWalker.GeometrySpaceBottom;
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				num2 = heightEmu;
			}
			CreateGeometrySpaceProperties(properties, num, num2);
			DrawingGeometryShapePath item = new DrawingGeometryShapePath
			{
				ShapePath = shapePathType
			};
			properties.Add(item);
			DrawingGeometryVertices drawingGeometryVertices = new DrawingGeometryVertices();
			drawingGeometryVertices.SetElements(pathInstructionExportWalker.Points);
			properties.Add(drawingGeometryVertices);
			DrawingGeometrySegmentInfo drawingGeometrySegmentInfo = new DrawingGeometrySegmentInfo();
			drawingGeometrySegmentInfo.SetElements(pathInstructionExportWalker.MsoPathInfos);
			properties.Add(drawingGeometrySegmentInfo);
		}

		private static ShapePathType GetShapePathType(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry)
		{
			ModelShapePathsList paths = geometry.Paths;
			if (paths.Count == 1)
			{
				ModelShapePath modelShapePath = paths[0];
				if (modelShapePath.Instructions.Count > 1 && modelShapePath.Instructions[0] is PathMove)
				{
					ModelPathInstructionList instructions = modelShapePath.Instructions;
					bool flag = instructions[instructions.Count - 1] is PathClose;
					IPathInstruction instruction = instructions[1];
					if (IsPathLine(instruction) && InstructionsIdentical(instructions, flag, IsPathLine))
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							return ShapePathType.Lines;
						}
						return ShapePathType.LinesClosed;
					}
					if (IsPathCubicBezier(instruction) && InstructionsIdentical(instructions, flag, IsPathCubicBezier))
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							return ShapePathType.Curves;
						}
						return ShapePathType.CurvesClosed;
					}
				}
			}
			return ShapePathType.Complex;
		}

		private static bool IsPathLine(IPathInstruction instruction)
		{
			return instruction is PathLine;
		}

		private static bool IsPathCubicBezier(IPathInstruction instruction)
		{
			return instruction is PathCubicBezier;
		}

		private static bool InstructionsIdentical(ModelPathInstructionList instructions, bool closed, IsSomeModelPathType condition)
		{
			int num = (closed ? (instructions.Count - 1) : instructions.Count);
			if (num == 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!condition(instructions[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void CreateTransformProperties(Transform2D transform2D, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtShapeRecord shapeRecord)
		{
			shapeRecord.FlipH = transform2D.FlipH;
			shapeRecord.FlipV = transform2D.FlipV;
			if (transform2D.Rotation != 0)
			{
				float num = transform2D.DocumentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToDegreeF(transform2D.Rotation);
				if (transform2D.FlipH)
				{
					num = 360f - num;
				}
				if (transform2D.FlipV)
				{
					num = 360f - num;
				}
				DrawingRotation drawingRotation = new DrawingRotation();
				drawingRotation.Value = num;
				artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingRotation);
			}
		}

		public static void CreateShapeProtectionProperties(IDrawingLocks locks, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (locks != null && !locks.IsEmpty)
			{
				DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties drawingBooleanProtectionProperties = new DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties();
				if (locks is IShapeLocks shapeLocks)
				{
					drawingBooleanProtectionProperties.LockText = shapeLocks.NoTextEdit;
				}
				drawingBooleanProtectionProperties.UseLockText = true;
				CreateDrawingProtectionProperties(locks, drawingBooleanProtectionProperties);
				artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingBooleanProtectionProperties);
			}
		}

		public static void CreateGroupShapeProtectionProperties(IGroupLocks locks, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties drawingBooleanProtectionProperties = new DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties();
			drawingBooleanProtectionProperties.LockText = true;
			drawingBooleanProtectionProperties.UseLockText = true;
			artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingBooleanProtectionProperties);
			if (locks != null && !locks.IsEmpty)
			{
				CreateCommonDrawingProtectionProperties(locks, drawingBooleanProtectionProperties);
				drawingBooleanProtectionProperties.LockUngroup = locks.NoUngroup;
				drawingBooleanProtectionProperties.LockRotation = locks.NoRotate;
				drawingBooleanProtectionProperties.UseLockUngroup = true;
				drawingBooleanProtectionProperties.UseLockRotation = true;
			}
		}

		public static void CreateDrawingProtectionProperties(IDrawingLocks locks, DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties protectionProperties)
		{
			CreateCommonDrawingProtectionProperties(locks, protectionProperties);
			protectionProperties.LockAdjustHandles = locks.NoAdjustHandles;
			protectionProperties.LockVertices = locks.NoEditPoints;
			protectionProperties.LockRotation = locks.NoRotate;
			protectionProperties.UseLockAdjustHandles = true;
			protectionProperties.UseLockVertices = true;
			protectionProperties.UseLockCropping = true;
			protectionProperties.UseLockRotation = true;
		}

		private static void CreateCommonDrawingProtectionProperties(ICommonDrawingLocks locks, DrawingBooleanProtectionProperties protectionProperties)
		{
			protectionProperties.LockGroup = locks.NoGroup;
			protectionProperties.LockSelect = locks.NoSelect;
			protectionProperties.LockAspectRatio = locks.NoChangeAspect;
			protectionProperties.LockPosition = locks.NoMove;
			protectionProperties.UseLockGroup = true;
			protectionProperties.UseLockSelect = true;
			protectionProperties.UseLockAspectRatio = true;
			protectionProperties.UseLockPosition = true;
		}

		public static void CreateAdjustValues(IOfficeShape shape, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			CreateAdjustValues(shape.ShapeProperties, shape.Width, shape.Height, artProperties);
		}

		public static void CreateAdjustValues(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, float width, float height, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			int num = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(height);
			int num2 = unitConverter.CeilingModelUnitsToEmu(width);
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry shapeGeometry = shapeProperties.GetShapeGeometry();
			ShapeGuideCalculator calculator = new ShapeGuideCalculator(shapeGeometry, num2, num, shapeProperties.PresetAdjustList);
			int?[] adjustValues = GetAdjustValues(shapeGeometry, calculator);
			AdjustValuesConverterToBinaryFormat.Convert(num2, num, shapeProperties.ShapeType, adjustValues);
			AddAdjustValuesToProperties(artProperties, adjustValues);
		}

		private static void AddAdjustValuesToProperties(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, int?[] adjustValues)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < adjustValues.Length; i++)
			{
				if (adjustValues[i].HasValue)
				{
					DrawingGeometryAdjustValue drawingGeometryAdjustValue = DrawingGeometryAdjustValueFactory.CreateAdjustValue(i);
					if (drawingGeometryAdjustValue != null)
					{
						drawingGeometryAdjustValue.Value = adjustValues[i].Value;
						artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingGeometryAdjustValue);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static int?[] GetAdjustValues(ModelShapeCustomGeometry geometry, ShapeGuideCalculator calculator)
		{
			int?[] array = new int?[8];
			ModelShapeGuideList adjustValues = geometry.AdjustValues;
			for (int i = 0; i < adjustValues.Count; i++)
			{
				ModelShapeGuide modelShapeGuide = adjustValues[i];
				array[i] = (int)Math.Round(calculator.GetGuideValue(modelShapeGuide.Name));
			}
			return array;
		}

		}

		private static void CreateWordArtAdjustValuesCore(float height, float width, IDocumentModel documentModel, DrawingPresetTextWarp presetTextWarp, ModelShapeGuideList wordArtAdjustValues, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			int num = documentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(height);
			int num2 = documentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(width);
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry wordArtFakeGeometry = GetWordArtFakeGeometry(presetTextWarp, documentModel);
			ShapeGuideCalculator calculator = new ShapeGuideCalculator(wordArtFakeGeometry, num2, num, wordArtAdjustValues);
			int?[] adjustValues = GetAdjustValues(wordArtFakeGeometry, calculator);
			AdjustValuesConverterToBinaryFormat.ConvertWordArt(num2, num, presetTextWarp, adjustValues);
			AddAdjustValuesToProperties(artProperties, adjustValues);
		}

				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj1", "val 6250"));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj2", "val 0"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeDown:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 33333"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeLeft:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 33333"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeRight:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 33333"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.FadeUp:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 33333"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Inflate:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 18750"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateBottom:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 60000"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.InflateTop:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 40000"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Plain:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 50000"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.RingInside:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 60000"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.RingOutside:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 60000"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.SlantDown:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 44445"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.SlantUp:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 55555"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Stop:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 25000"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Triangle:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 50000"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.TriangleInverted:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj", "val 50000"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave1:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj1", "val 12500"));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj2", "val 0"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave2:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj1", "val 12500"));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj2", "val 0"));
				break;
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.Wave4:
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj1", "val 6250"));
				modelShapeCustomGeometry.AdjustValues.AddInternal(new ModelShapeGuide("adj2", "val 0"));
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("presetTextWarp", presetTextWarp, null);
			case DrawingPresetTextWarp.NoShape:
				break;
			}
			return modelShapeCustomGeometry;
		}

		public static void CreateConnectionStyleProperty(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			MsoCxStyle connectionStyle = GetConnectionStyle(shapeProperties.ShapeType);
			if (connectionStyle != MsoCxStyle.None)
			{
				artProperties.Properties.Add(new DrawingCxStyle
				{
					Style = connectionStyle
				});
			}
		}

		private static MsoCxStyle GetConnectionStyle(ShapePreset shapeType)
		{
			switch (shapeType)
			{
			case ShapePreset.StraightConnector1:
				return MsoCxStyle.Straight;
			case ShapePreset.BentConnector2:
			case ShapePreset.BentConnector3:
			case ShapePreset.BentConnector4:
			case ShapePreset.BentConnector5:
				return MsoCxStyle.Bent;
			case ShapePreset.CurvedConnector2:
			case ShapePreset.CurvedConnector3:
			case ShapePreset.CurvedConnector4:
			case ShapePreset.CurvedConnector5:
				return MsoCxStyle.Curved;
			default:
				return MsoCxStyle.None;
			}
		}

		public static void FillCoordinateSystem(Transform2D childTransform2D, OfficeArtShapeGroupCoordinateSystem coordinateSystem)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = childTransform2D.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
			coordinateSystem.Left = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(childTransform2D.OffsetX);
			coordinateSystem.Top = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(childTransform2D.OffsetY);
			coordinateSystem.Right = coordinateSystem.Left + unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(childTransform2D.Cx);
			coordinateSystem.Bottom = coordinateSystem.Top + unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(childTransform2D.Cy);
		}

		public static void CreateBlackAndWhiteMode(ShapePropertiesBase shapeProperties, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (shapeProperties.BlackAndWhiteMode != OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Auto)
			{
				DrawingBlackWhiteMode drawingBlackWhiteMode = new DrawingBlackWhiteMode();
				drawingBlackWhiteMode.Mode = ConvertBlackWhiteMode(shapeProperties.BlackAndWhiteMode);
				artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingBlackWhiteMode);
			}
		}

		private static BlackWhiteMode ConvertBlackWhiteMode(OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode mode)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Clr => BlackWhiteMode.Normal, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Gray => BlackWhiteMode.GrayScale, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.LtGray => BlackWhiteMode.LightGrayScale, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.InvGray => BlackWhiteMode.InverseGray, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.GrayWhite => BlackWhiteMode.GrayOutline, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.BlackGray => BlackWhiteMode.BlackTextLine, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.BlackWhite => BlackWhiteMode.HighContrast, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Black => BlackWhiteMode.Black, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.White => BlackWhiteMode.White, 
				OpenXmlBlackWhiteMode.Hidden => BlackWhiteMode.DontShow, 
				_ => BlackWhiteMode.Automatic, 
			};
		}

		public static OfficeArtChildAnchor CreateChildAnchor(Transform2D transform2D)
		{
			OfficeArtChildAnchor officeArtChildAnchor = new OfficeArtChildAnchor();
			SetupChildAnchor(transform2D, officeArtChildAnchor);
			return officeArtChildAnchor;
		}

		public static void SetupChildAnchor(Transform2D transform2D, OfficeArtChildAnchor anchor)
		{
			if (anchor != null && transform2D != null)
			{
				DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter = transform2D.DocumentModel.UnitConverter;
				anchor.Left = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(transform2D.OffsetX);
				anchor.Top = unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(transform2D.OffsetY);
				anchor.Right = anchor.Left + unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(transform2D.Cx);
				anchor.Bottom = anchor.Top + unitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmuF(transform2D.Cy);
			}
		}

		public static void SetFillColor(OfficeDrawingColorPropertyBase colorProperty, IDrawingColor color)
		{
			if (color == null || color.IsEmpty)
			{
				colorProperty.ColorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord(DXColor.FromArgb(255, 255, 255));
			}
			else if (color.ColorType == DrawingColorType.System)
			{
				SetSystemColor(colorProperty, color);
			}
			else
			{
				colorProperty.ColorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord(color.FinalColor);
			}
		}

		private static void SetSystemColor(OfficeDrawingColorPropertyBase colorProperty, IDrawingColor color)
		{
			OfficeColorRecord colorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord
			{
				SystemColorIndex = (int)color.System
			};
			colorProperty.ColorRecord = colorRecord;
		}

		public static bool IsConnector(ShapePreset shapeType)
		{
			if (shapeType == ShapePreset.Line || (uint)(shapeType - 96) <= 8u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void CreateFillProperties(IOfficeShape shape, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, DrawingTableInfo> patternBlipTable)
		{
			CreateFillProperties(shape.ShapeProperties.Fill, shape.ShapeProperties.ShapeType, shape.ShapeStyle, artProperties, patternBlipTable);
		}

		public static void CreateFillProperties(IDrawingFill fill, ShapePreset shapeType, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, DrawingTableInfo> patternBlipTable)
		{
			CreateFillProperties(fill, shapeType, shapeStyle, artProperties.Properties, patternBlipTable);
		}

		public static void CreateFillProperties(IDrawingFill fill, ShapePreset shapeType, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties, Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, DrawingTableInfo> patternBlipTable)
		{
			DrawingColor defaultColor = null;
			DrawingFillType fillType = fill.FillType;
			bool filled = fillType != DrawingFillType.None;
			if (fillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic)
			{
				if (shapeStyle != null && shapeStyle.FillReferenceIdx > 0)
				{
					defaultColor = shapeStyle.FillColor;
				}
				else
				{
					filled = false;
				}
			}
			if (!IsConnector(shapeType))
			{
				CreateFillProperties(fill, properties, defaultColor, patternBlipTable);
			}
			CreateFillStyleBooleanProperties(fill, properties, filled);
		}

		public static void CreateFillProperties(IDrawingFill fill, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, IDrawingColor defaultColor, Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, DrawingTableInfo> patternBlipTable)
		{
			CreateFillProperties(fill, artProperties.Properties, defaultColor, patternBlipTable);
		}

		public static void CreateFillProperties(IDrawingFill fill, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties, IDrawingColor defaultColor, Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, DrawingTableInfo> patternBlipTable)
		{
			switch (fill.FillType)
			{
			case DrawingFillType.Automatic:
				CreateAutomaticFillProperties(defaultColor, properties);
				break;
			case DrawingFillType.None:
				break;
			case DrawingFillType.Solid:
				CreateSolidFillProperties((DrawingSolidFill)fill, properties);
				break;
			case DrawingFillType.Gradient:
				CreateGradientFillProperties((DrawingGradientFill)fill, properties);
				break;
			case DrawingFillType.Group:
				CreateGroupFillProperties(properties);
				break;
			case DrawingFillType.Pattern:
				CreatePatternFillProperties((DrawingPatternFill)fill, properties, patternBlipTable);
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			case DrawingFillType.Picture:
				break;
			}
		}

		public static void CreateFillStyleBooleanProperties(IDrawingFill fill, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, bool filled)
		{
			CreateFillStyleBooleanProperties(fill, artProperties.Properties, filled);
		}

		public static void CreateFillStyleBooleanProperties(IDrawingFill fill, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties, bool filled)
		{
			DrawingFillStyleBooleanProperties drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties = new DrawingFillStyleBooleanProperties();
			drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties.UseFilled = true;
			drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties.Filled = filled;
			if (fill is DrawingGradientFill { RotateWithShape: not false })
			{
				drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties.UseShapeAnchor = true;
				drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties.ShapeAnchor = true;
			}
			properties.Add(drawingFillStyleBooleanProperties);
		}

		private static void CreateAutomaticFillProperties(IDrawingColor defaultColor, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			if (defaultColor != null)
			{
				CreateFillColor(defaultColor, properties);
			}
		}

		private static void CreateSolidFillProperties(DrawingSolidFill drawingSolidFill, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			CreateFillColor(drawingSolidFill.Color, properties);
			CreateFillOpacity(drawingSolidFill.Color, properties);
		}

		private static void CreateGradientFillProperties(DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			GradientStopCollection gradientStops = drawingGradientFill.GradientStops;
			if (gradientStops != null && gradientStops.Count != 0)
			{
				CreateFillType(drawingGradientFill, properties);
				bool useFocus = GradientWithFocus(gradientStops);
				CreateColors(gradientStops, properties, useFocus);
				CreateFillAngle(drawingGradientFill, properties);
				CreateFillFocus(gradientStops, properties, useFocus);
				CreateFillRect(drawingGradientFill.FillRect, properties);
				CreateShadeColors(gradientStops, properties, useFocus);
			}
		}

		private static void CreateFillType(DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			OfficeFillType officeFillType = GetOfficeFillType(drawingGradientFill);
			if (officeFillType != OfficeFillType.Solid)
			{
				properties.Add(new OfficeDrawingFillType
				{
					FillType = officeFillType
				});
			}
		}

		private static OfficeFillType GetOfficeFillType(DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill)
		{
			switch (drawingGradientFill.GradientType)
			{
			case GradientType.Linear:
				return OfficeFillType.ShadeScale;
			case GradientType.Rectangle:
				return OfficeFillType.ShadeCenter;
			case GradientType.Circle:
			case GradientType.Shape:
				return OfficeFillType.ShadeShape;
			default:
				return OfficeFillType.Solid;
			}
		}

		public static bool GradientWithFocus(GradientStopCollection gradientStops)
		{
			if (gradientStops.Count == 3)
			{
				DrawingColor color = gradientStops.First.Color;
				DrawingColor color2 = gradientStops.Last.Color;
				return color.Equals(color2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void CreateColors(GradientStopCollection gradientStops, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties, bool useFocus)
		{
			DrawingFillColor drawingFillColor = new DrawingFillColor();
			DrawingFillBackColor drawingFillBackColor = new DrawingFillBackColor();
			SetFillColor(drawingFillColor, gradientStops.First.Color);
			CreateFillOpacity(gradientStops.First.Color, properties);
			DrawingColor color = (useFocus ? gradientStops[1].Color : gradientStops.Last.Color);
			SetFillColor(drawingFillBackColor, color);
			CreateFillBackOpacity(color, properties);
			properties.Add(drawingFillColor);
			properties.Add(drawingFillBackColor);
		}

		private static void CreateFillAngle(DrawingGradientFill drawingGradientFill, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			if (drawingGradientFill.GradientType == GradientType.Linear)
			{
				double gradientAngle = GetGradientAngle(drawingGradientFill.Angle);
				if (gradientAngle != 0.0)
				{
					properties.Add(new DrawingFillAngle(gradientAngle));
				}
			}
		}

		public static double GetGradientAngle(int gradientAngleEmu)
		{
			double num = (double)gradientAngleEmu / 60000.0;
			num = ((!(num >= 0.0)) ? (0.0 - (num + 90.0)) : (90.0 - num));
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num += 360.0;
			}
			if (num > 360.0)
			{
				num -= 360.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void CreateFillFocus(GradientStopCollection gradientStops, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties, bool useFocus)
		{
			int num = (useFocus ? GetFillFocus(gradientStops[1]) : 100);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				properties.Add(new DrawingFillFocus(num));
			}
		}

		private static int GetFillFocus(DrawingGradientStop gradientStop)
		{
			return Math.Min((int)Math.Round((double)gradientStop.Position / 100000.0 * 100.0), 100);
		}

		private static void CreateFillRect(RectangleOffset rect, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			double num = (double)rect.LeftOffset / 100000.0;
			double num2 = (double)rect.TopOffset / 100000.0;
			double num3 = 1.0 - (double)rect.RightOffset / 100000.0;
			double num4 = 1.0 - (double)rect.BottomOffset / 100000.0;
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				properties.Add(new DrawingFillToLeft(num));
			}
			if (num2 != 0.0)
			{
				properties.Add(new DrawingFillToTop(num2));
			}
			if (num3 != 0.0)

		public static void RegisterPatternFillBlip(ShapeProperties shapeProperties, Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, DrawingTableInfo> patternBlipTable)
		{
			if (shapeProperties.Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Pattern && patternBlipTable != null && shapeProperties.Fill is DrawingPatternFill { PatternType: var patternType })
			{
				if (patternBlipTable.TryGetValue(patternType, out var value))
				{
					value.RefCount++;
					return;

				value = new DrawingTableInfo(0, 1);
				patternBlipTable.Add(patternType, value);
			}
		}

		public static void FillPatternBlips(OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer blipContainer, Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, DrawingTableInfo> patternBlipTable)
		{
			if (patternBlipTable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DrawingPatternType, DrawingTableInfo> item in patternBlipTable)
			{
				byte[] bytesByPattern = GetBytesByPattern(item.Key);
				PatternBlip patternBlip = new PatternBlip(null);
				byte tagByPattern = GetTagByPattern(item.Key);
				patternBlip.SetData(bytesByPattern, tagByPattern);
				FileBlipStoreEntry fileBlipStoreEntry = new FileBlipStoreEntry(patternBlip, hasDelayedStream: false);
				fileBlipStoreEntry.ReferenceCount = item.Value.RefCount;
				blipContainer.Blips.Add(fileBlipStoreEntry);
				item.Value.Index = blipContainer.Blips.Count;
			}
		}

		private static byte[] GetBytesByPattern(DrawingPatternType pattern)
		{
			Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, byte[]> value = patternsData.Value;
			if (value.TryGetValue(pattern, out var value2))
			{
				return value2;
			}
			return pattern switch
			{
				DrawingPatternType.Cross => value[DrawingPatternType.SmallGrid], 
				DrawingPatternType.DiagonalCross => value[DrawingPatternType.OpenDiamond], 
				DrawingPatternType.DownwardDiagonal => value[DrawingPatternType.LightDownwardDiagonal], 
				DrawingPatternType.Horizontal => value[DrawingPatternType.LightHorizontal], 
				DrawingPatternType.UpwardDiagonal => value[DrawingPatternType.LightUpwardDiagonal], 
				DrawingPatternType.Vertical => value[DrawingPatternType.LightVertical], 
				_ => value[DrawingPatternType.Percent5], 
			};
		}

		private static byte GetTagByPattern(DrawingPatternType pattern)
		{
			Dictionary<DrawingPatternType, byte> value = tagsByPatterns.Value;
			if (value.TryGetValue(pattern, out var value2))
			{
				return value2;
			}
			return pattern switch
			{
				DrawingPatternType.Cross => value[DrawingPatternType.SmallGrid], 
				DrawingPatternType.DiagonalCross => value[DrawingPatternType.OpenDiamond], 
				DrawingPatternType.DownwardDiagonal => value[DrawingPatternType.LightDownwardDiagonal], 
				DrawingPatternType.Horizontal => value[DrawingPatternType.LightHorizontal], 
				DrawingPatternType.UpwardDiagonal => value[DrawingPatternType.LightUpwardDiagonal], 
				DrawingPatternType.Vertical => value[DrawingPatternType.LightVertical], 
				_ => value[DrawingPatternType.Percent5], 
			};
		}

		{

			{
				if (transform is AlphaColorTransform alphaColorTransform)
				{
					double val = (double)alphaColorTransform.Value / 100000.0;
					return Math.Min(val, 1.0);

			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		public static void CreateOutlineProperties(IOfficeShape shape, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			IDocumentModel documentModel = shape.DocumentModel;
			ShapeProperties shapeProperties = shape.ShapeProperties;
			ShapeStyle shapeStyle = shape.ShapeStyle;
			Outline outline = shapeProperties.Outline;
			Outline outline2 = documentModel.OfficeTheme.FormatScheme.GetOutline(shapeStyle.LineReferenceIdx);
			OutlineInfo outline3 = ActualOutlineHelper.MergeOutline(outline, outline2);
			DrawingFillType fillType = outline.Fill.FillType;
			DrawingColor outlineColor = ((fillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic) ? shapeStyle.LineColor : shapeProperties.OutlineColor);
			if (fillType != DrawingFillType.None)
			{
				CreateLineColorProperties(outlineColor, artProperties);
				FillOutlineProperties(outline3, artProperties, documentModel);
			}
			CreateLineStyleBooleanProperties(artProperties, useLine: true, fillType != DrawingFillType.None);
		}

		public static void CreateOutlineProperties(Outline outline, OutlineType outlineType, DrawingColor color, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, DrawingColor defaultColor)
		{
			bool flag = outline.Fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic;
			bool flag2 = outlineType == OutlineType.Solid;
			bool flag3 = flag2 || flag;
			if (flag3)
			{
				DrawingColor outlineColor = (flag ? defaultColor : color);
				CreateLineColorProperties(outlineColor, artProperties);
				FillOutlineProperties(outline.Info, artProperties, outline.DocumentModel);
			}
			CreateLineStyleBooleanProperties(artProperties, useLine: true, flag3);
		}

		public static void CreateLineStyleBooleanProperties(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, bool useLine, bool line)
		{

		public static void CreateLineColorProperties(DrawingColor outlineColor, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			if (!outlineColor.Info.IsEmpty)
			{
				DrawingLineColor drawingLineColor = new DrawingLineColor();
				if (outlineColor.ColorType == DrawingColorType.System)
				{
					int systemColor = (int)outlineColor.Info.SystemColor;
					if (systemColor >= 0)
					{
						drawingLineColor.ColorRecord.SystemColorIndex = systemColor;
					}
					else
					{
						drawingLineColor.ColorRecord.Color = outlineColor.FinalColor;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					drawingLineColor.ColorRecord.Color = outlineColor.FinalColor;
				}
				artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingLineColor);
			}
			foreach (ColorTransformBase transform in outlineColor.Transforms)
			{
				if (transform is AlphaColorTransform alphaColorTransform)
				{
					int lineOpacity = GetLineOpacity(alphaColorTransform.Value);
					if (lineOpacity != 65536)
					{
						DrawingLineOpacity item = new DrawingLineOpacity(lineOpacity);
						artProperties.Properties.Add(item);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void FillOutlineProperties(OutlineInfo outline, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, IDocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			DrawingLineWidth drawingLineWidth = new DrawingLineWidth();
			drawingLineWidth.Value = documentModel.UnitConverter.ModelUnitsToEmu(outline.Width);
			artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingLineWidth);
			if (outline.MiterLimit != OutlineInfo.DefaultInfo.MiterLimit)
			{
				DrawingLineMiterLimit drawingLineMiterLimit = new DrawingLineMiterLimit();
				drawingLineMiterLimit.Value = DrawingValueConverter.FromPercentage(outline.MiterLimit);
				artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingLineMiterLimit);
			}
			if (outline.CompoundType != OutlineCompoundType.Single)
			{
				DrawingLineCompoundType drawingLineCompoundType = new DrawingLineCompoundType();
				drawingLineCompoundType.CompoundType = outline.CompoundType;
				artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingLineCompoundType);
			}
			if (outline.Dashing != OutlineDashing.Solid)
			{
				DrawingLineDashing drawingLineDashing = new DrawingLineDashing();
				drawingLineDashing.Dashing = outline.Dashing;
				artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingLineDashing);
			}
			CreateLineArrowheadProperties(outline, artProperties);
			DrawingLineJoinStyle drawingLineJoinStyle = new DrawingLineJoinStyle();
			drawingLineJoinStyle.Style = outline.JoinStyle;
			artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingLineJoinStyle);
			if (outline.EndCapStyle != OutlineEndCapStyle.Flat)
			{
				DrawingLineCapStyle drawingLineCapStyle = new DrawingLineCapStyle();
				drawingLineCapStyle.Style = outline.EndCapStyle;
				artProperties.Properties.Add(drawingLineCapStyle);
			}
		}

		private static int GetLineOpacity(int alphaTrasfromValue)
		{
			int num = 65536;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Round((double)alphaTrasfromValue * (double)num / 100000.0);
			int num3 = num2 % 257;
			num2 /= 257;
			num2 *= 257;
			if (num3 > 128)
			{
				num2 += 257;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private static void CreateLineArrowheadProperties(OutlineInfo outline, OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties)
		{
			MsoLineEnd msoLineEnd = OutlineHeadTailTypeConverter.GetMsoLineEnd(outline.HeadType);
			if (msoLineEnd != MsoLineEnd.NoEnd)
			{
				artProperties.Properties.Add(new DrawingLineStartArrowhead
				{
					Arrowhead = msoLineEnd
				});
			}
			MsoLineEnd msoLineEnd2 = OutlineHeadTailTypeConverter.GetMsoLineEnd(outline.TailType);
			if (msoLineEnd2 != MsoLineEnd.NoEnd)
			{
				artProperties.Properties.Add(new DrawingLineEndArrowhead
				{
					Arrowhead = msoLineEnd2
				});
			}
			if (outline.HeadWidth != OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium)
			{
				artProperties.Properties.Add(new DrawingLineStartArrowWidth
				{
					HeadTailSize = outline.HeadWidth
				});
			}
			if (outline.HeadLength != OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium)
			{
				artProperties.Properties.Add(new DrawingLineStartArrowLength
				{
					HeadTailSize = outline.HeadLength
				});
			}
			if (outline.TailWidth != OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium)
			{
				artProperties.Properties.Add(new DrawingLineEndArrowWidth
				{
					HeadTailSize = outline.TailWidth
				});
			}
			if (outline.TailLength != OutlineHeadTailSize.Medium)
			{
				artProperties.Properties.Add(new DrawingLineEndArrowLength
				{
					HeadTailSize = outline.TailLength
				});
			}
		}

		public static void CreateShadowProperties(DrawingEffectCollection drawingEffects, CompositeOfficeDrawingPartBase shapeContainer)
		{
			if (!(OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.FindPart(shapeContainer, 61451) is OfficeArtPropertiesBase officeArtPropertiesBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IDrawingEffect drawingEffect in drawingEffects)
			{
				if (drawingEffect is OuterShadowEffect shadowEffect)
				{
					OfficeArtTertiaryProperties officeArtTertiaryProperties = (OfficeArtPropertiesHelper.FindPart(shapeContainer, 61730) as OfficeArtTertiaryProperties) ?? CreateOfficeArtTertiaryProperties(shapeContainer);
					CreateShadowProperties(shadowEffect, officeArtTertiaryProperties.Properties, officeArtPropertiesBase.Properties);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CreateShadowTypeProperty(OuterShadowEffectInfo shadowEffectInfo, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)

			properties.Add(drawingShadowColor);

		private static void CreateShadowOpacityProperty(DrawingColor shadowColor, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			AlphaColorTransform alphaColorTransform = null;
			foreach (ColorTransformBase transform in shadowColor.Transforms)
			{
				alphaColorTransform = transform as AlphaColorTransform;
				if (alphaColorTransform != null)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (alphaColorTransform != null)
			{
				double num = (double)alphaColorTransform.Value / 100000.0;
				if (num != 1.0)
				{
					DrawingShadowOpacity item = new DrawingShadowOpacity(num);
					properties.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CreateShadowOffsetProperties(OffsetShadowInfo offsetShadowInfo, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			double num = ShapeGuideCalculator.EMUDegreeToRadian(offsetShadowInfo.Direction);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Round((double)offsetShadowInfo.Distance * Math.Cos(num));
			int num3 = (int)Math.Round((double)offsetShadowInfo.Distance * Math.Sin(num));
			if (num2 != 25400)
			{
				DrawingShadowOffsetX item = new DrawingShadowOffsetX(num2);
				properties.Add(item);
			}
			if (num3 != 25400)
			{
				DrawingShadowOffsetY item2 = new DrawingShadowOffsetY(num3);
				properties.Add(item2);
			}
		}

		private static void CreateShadowScalingFactorAndSkewAnglesProperties(OuterShadowEffectInfo shadowEffectInfo, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			ScalingFactorInfo scalingFactor = shadowEffectInfo.ScalingFactor;
			int num = CalculateScalingFactor(scalingFactor.Horizontal);
			int num2 = CalculateScalingFactor(scalingFactor.Vertical);
			if (num != 65536)
			{
				DrawingShadowHorizontalScalingFactor item = new DrawingShadowHorizontalScalingFactor(num);
				properties.Add(item);
			}
			if (num2 != 65536)
			{
				DrawingShadowVerticalScalingFactor item2 = new DrawingShadowVerticalScalingFactor(num2);
				properties.Add(item2);
			}
			CreateShadowSkewAnglesProperties(shadowEffectInfo.SkewAngles, properties, num, num2);
		}

		private static int CalculateScalingFactor(int factor)
		{
			double num = 0.65536;
			return (int)Math.Round((double)factor * num);
		}

		private static void CreateShadowSkewAnglesProperties(SkewAnglesInfo skewAnglesInfo, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties, int horizontalScalingFactor, int verticalScalingFactor)
		{
			int num = CalculateSkewAngle(skewAnglesInfo.Horizontal, horizontalScalingFactor);
			int num2 = CalculateSkewAngle(skewAnglesInfo.Vertical, verticalScalingFactor);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				DrawingShadowHorizontalSkewAngle item = new DrawingShadowHorizontalSkewAngle(num);
				properties.Add(item);
			}
			if (num2 != 0)
			{
				DrawingShadowVerticalSkewAngle item2 = new DrawingShadowVerticalSkewAngle(num2);
				properties.Add(item2);
			}
		}

		private static int CalculateSkewAngle(int angle, int scalingFactor)
		{
			double a = Math.Tan((double)angle / 60000.0 * Math.PI / 180.0) * (double)scalingFactor;
			return (int)Math.Round(a);
		}

		private static void CreateShadowOriginProperties(RectangleAlignType alignment, List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			double shadowOriginXByAlignment = GetShadowOriginXByAlignment(alignment);
			double shadowOriginYByAlignment = GetShadowOriginYByAlignment(alignment);
			if (shadowOriginXByAlignment != 0.0)
			{
				DrawingShadowOriginX item = new DrawingShadowOriginX(shadowOriginXByAlignment);
				properties.Add(item);
			}
			if (shadowOriginYByAlignment != 0.0)
			{
				DrawingShadowOriginY item2 = new DrawingShadowOriginY(shadowOriginYByAlignment);
				properties.Add(item2);
			}
		}

		private static void CreateShadowBooleanProperties(List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties)
		{
			DrawingShadowStyleBooleanProperties drawingShadowStyleBooleanProperties = new DrawingShadowStyleBooleanProperties();
			drawingShadowStyleBooleanProperties.UseShadow = true;
			drawingShadowStyleBooleanProperties.Shadow = true;
			properties.Add(drawingShadowStyleBooleanProperties);
		}

		private static double GetShadowOriginXByAlignment(RectangleAlignType alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case RectangleAlignType.TopLeft:
			case RectangleAlignType.Left:
			case RectangleAlignType.BottomLeft:
				return -0.5;
			case RectangleAlignType.Top:
			case RectangleAlignType.Center:
			case RectangleAlignType.Bottom:
				return 0.0;
			case RectangleAlignType.TopRight:
			case RectangleAlignType.Right:
			case RectangleAlignType.BottomRight:
				return 0.5;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}

		private static double GetShadowOriginYByAlignment(RectangleAlignType alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case RectangleAlignType.TopLeft:
			case RectangleAlignType.Top:
			case RectangleAlignType.TopRight:
				return -0.5;
			case RectangleAlignType.Left:
			case RectangleAlignType.Center:
			case RectangleAlignType.Right:
				return 0.0;
			case RectangleAlignType.BottomLeft:
			case RectangleAlignType.Bottom:
			case RectangleAlignType.BottomRight:
				return 0.5;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}

		private static MsoShadowType GetShadowType(OuterShadowEffectInfo shadowEffectInfo)
		{
			if (shadowEffectInfo.ScalingFactor.Horizontal != 100000 || shadowEffectInfo.ScalingFactor.Vertical != 100000 || shadowEffectInfo.SkewAngles.Horizontal != 0 || shadowEffectInfo.SkewAngles.Vertical != 0)
			{
				return MsoShadowType.MsoShadowRich;
			}
			return MsoShadowType.MsoShadowOffset;
		}
	}
	internal class PatternBlip : BlipDib
	{
		private class PatternArtRecordHeader : OfficeArtRecordHeader
		{
			public PatternArtRecordHeader(int version, int instanceInfo, int typeCode, int length)
			{
				base.Version = version;
				base.InstanceInfo = instanceInfo;
				base.TypeCode = typeCode;
				base.Length = length;
			}
		}

		private byte[] patternData;

		private byte[] PatternData => patternData ?? base.Image.GetImageBytes(OfficeImageFormat.Bmp);

		public PatternBlip(OfficeImage image)
			: base(image)
		{
		}

		public PatternBlip(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
			: base(reader, header)
		{
		}

		public void SetData(byte[] patternData, byte tag)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(patternData);
			BinaryReader reader = new BinaryReader(memoryStream);
			DibHeader dibHeader = DibHeader.FromStream(reader);
			int num = dibHeader.BitCount * dibHeader.Width;
			if (num % 32 == 0)
			{
				num /= 8;
			}
			else
			{
				num /= 32;
				num++;
				num *= 4;
			}
			memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			base.Image = OfficeImage.CreateImage(DibHelper.CreateDib(memoryStream, dibHeader.Width, dibHeader.Height, num));
			this.patternData = patternData;
			base.TagValue = tag;
		}

		protected override Stream CreateImageBytesStream()
		{
			return new MemoryStream(PatternData);
		}

		public override OfficeArtRecordHeader CreateRecordHeader()
		{
			return new PatternArtRecordHeader(0, 1960, 61471, 17 + base.ImageBytesLength);
		}
	}

	public enum OfficeCursorType
	{
		IBeamItalic,
		IBeamHorizontal,
		BeginRotate,
		Rotate,
		SelectColumn,
		ResizeColumn,
		ResizeRow
	}
	public class CachedCursorInfo<T> : IEquatable<CachedCursorInfo<T>> where T : struct
	{
		public T CursorType { get; }

		public int DeviceDpi { get; }

		public CachedCursorInfo(T cursorType, int deviceDpi)
		{
			CursorType = cursorType;
			DeviceDpi = deviceDpi;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CachedCursorInfo<T>))
			{
				return false;
			}
			CachedCursorInfo<T> other = (CachedCursorInfo<T>)obj;
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public bool Equals(CachedCursorInfo<T> other)
		{
			if (CursorType.Equals(other.CursorType))
			{
				return DeviceDpi == other.DeviceDpi;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<T, int>(CursorType, DeviceDpi);
		}
	}
	public static class OfficeCursors
	{
		private class CachedOfficeCursorInfo : CachedCursorInfo<OfficeCursorType>
		{
			public CachedOfficeCursorInfo(OfficeCursorType cursorType, int deviceDpi)
				: base(cursorType, deviceDpi)
			{
			}
		}

		private static float defaultHighDpiFactor = DocumentModelDpi.Dpi / (float)DefaultDeviceDpi;

		private static readonly Lazy<Dictionary<OfficeCursorType, string>> cursorNameTable = new Lazy<Dictionary<OfficeCursorType, string>>(() => new Dictionary<OfficeCursorType, string>
		{
			{
				OfficeCursorType.IBeamItalic,
				"IBeamItalic.cur"
			},
			{
				OfficeCursorType.BeginRotate,
				"BeginRotate.cur"
			},
			{
				OfficeCursorType.Rotate,
				"Rotate.cur"
			},
			{
				OfficeCursorType.SelectColumn,
				"SelectColumn.cur"
			},
			{
				OfficeCursorType.ResizeColumn,
				"ResizeColumn.cur"
			},
			{
				OfficeCursorType.ResizeRow,
				"ResizeRow.cur"
			},
			{
				OfficeCursorType.IBeamHorizontal,
				"IBeamHorizontal.cur"
			}
		});

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<CachedOfficeCursorInfo, IPortableCursor> cursorsTable = new ConcurrentDictionary<CachedOfficeCursorInfo, IPortableCursor>();

		private const string cursorsPath = "DevExpress.Office.Cursors.";

		private const string pathCursorSize32 = "Cursors32.";

		private const string pathCursorSize48 = "Cursors48.";

		private const string pathCursorSize64 = "Cursors64.";

		private const string pathCursorSize96 = "Cursors96.";

		private const string pathCursorSize128 = "Cursors128.";

		public static int DefaultDeviceDpi { get; } = 96;

		public static IPortableCursor LoadCursor(OfficeCursorType cursorType, int systemDpi, int deviceDpi)
		{
			CachedOfficeCursorInfo key = new CachedOfficeCursorInfo(cursorType, deviceDpi);
			if (cursorsTable.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			string resourceName = cursorNameTable.Value[cursorType];
			value = LoadCursor(resourceName, systemDpi, deviceDpi);
			cursorsTable.TryAdd(key, value);
			return value;
		}

		public static IPortableCursor LoadCursor(OfficeCursorType cursorType)
		{
			return LoadCursor(cursorType, DefaultDeviceDpi, DefaultDeviceDpi);
		}

		private static IPortableCursor LoadCursor(string resourceName, int systemDpi, int deviceDpi)
		{
			return PlatformServices.Instance.Cursors.FromResources("DevExpress.Office.Cursors." + GetPathByHighDpiFactor(systemDpi, deviceDpi) + resourceName, Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
		}

		public static string GetPathByHighDpiFactor()
		{
			return GetPathByHighDpiFactorCore(defaultHighDpiFactor);
		}

		public static string GetPathByHighDpiFactor(int systemDpi, int deviceDpi)
		{
			return GetPathByHighDpiFactorCore((float)systemDpi / (float)deviceDpi);
		}

		private static string GetPathByHighDpiFactorCore(float highDpiFactor)
		{
			if ((double)highDpiFactor < 1.5)
			{
				return "Cursors32.";
			}
			if ((double)highDpiFactor >= 1.5 && highDpiFactor < 2f)
			{
				return "Cursors48.";
			}
			if (highDpiFactor >= 2f && highDpiFactor < 3f)
			{
				return "Cursors64.";
			}
			if (highDpiFactor >= 3f && highDpiFactor < 4f)
			{
				return "Cursors96.";
			}
			return "Cursors128.";
		}
	}
	public class UnicodeSubrange
	{
		private readonly char lowValue;

		private readonly char hiValue;

		private readonly int bit;

		public char LowValue => lowValue;

		public char HiValue => hiValue;

		public int Bit => bit;

		public UnicodeSubrange(char low, char hi, int bit)
		{
			lowValue = low;
			hiValue = hi;
			this.bit = bit;
		}

		public bool ContainsChar(char ch)
		{
			if (ch >= LowValue)
			{
				return ch <= HiValue;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		protected internal virtual void AddSubrange(char low, char hi, int bit)
		{
			UnicodeSubrange item = new UnicodeSubrange(low, hi, bit);
			ranges.Add(item);
		}

		public UnicodeSubrange LookupSubrange(char ch)
		{
			int num = Algorithms.BinarySearchReverseOrder<UnicodeSubrange, UnicodeSubrangeAndCharComparer>((IList<UnicodeSubrange>)ranges, new UnicodeSubrangeAndCharComparer(ch));
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ranges[num];
		}

		public List<UnicodeSubrange> GetSubranges(BitArray bitArray)
		{
			List<UnicodeSubrange> list = new List<UnicodeSubrange>();
			int length = bitArray.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				if (bitArray[i] && bitToSubrangeMap.TryGetValue(i, out var value))
				{
					list.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class UnicodeSubrangeAndCharComparer : IComparable<UnicodeSubrange>
	{
		private readonly char ch;

		public UnicodeSubrangeAndCharComparer(char ch)
		{
			this.ch = ch;
		}

		public int CompareTo(UnicodeSubrange other)
		{
			if (ch < other.LowValue)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (ch > other.HiValue)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	internal class CharWidthArrayChunk
	{
		private int[] charWidths;

		private int[] abcWidths;

		public char FirstChar { get; private set; }

		public char LastChar { get; private set; }

		public bool Dirty { get; private set; }

		public CharWidthArrayChunk(char first, char last)
		{
			FirstChar = first;
			LastChar = last;
			Dirty = true;
		}

		public int GetCharWidth(char ch)
		{
			return charWidths[ch - FirstChar];
		}

		public int GetCharABCWidth(char ch)
		{
			return abcWidths[ch - FirstChar];
		}

		public void Update(Func<char, char, int[]> widthUpdater, Func<char, char, int[]> abcUpdater)
		{
			charWidths = widthUpdater(FirstChar, LastChar);
			abcWidths = abcUpdater(FirstChar, LastChar);
			Dirty = false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CharWidthArrayLevelBase
	{
		public char FirstChar { get; private set; }

		public abstract bool Dirty { get; }

		protected CharWidthArrayLevelBase(char firstChar)
		{
			FirstChar = firstChar;
		}

		public abstract void Check(char ch);

		public abstract void Update(Func<char, char, int[]> widthUpdater, Func<char, char, int[]> abcUpdater);

		public abstract CharWidthArrayChunk GetChunk(char ch);
	}
	internal class CharWidthArrayLevel : CharWidthArrayLevelBase
	{
		private const int ChunkSize = 64;

		private readonly List<CharWidthArrayChunk> chunks = new List<CharWidthArrayChunk>();

		public override bool Dirty => chunks.Any((CharWidthArrayChunk x) => x?.Dirty ?? false);

		public CharWidthArrayLevel(char firstChar)
			: base(firstChar)
		{
		}

		public override void Check(char ch)
		{
			int num = (ch - base.FirstChar) / 64;
			while (chunks.Count <= num)
			{
				chunks.Add(null);
			}
			if (chunks[num] == null)
			{
				chunks[num] = new CharWidthArrayChunk((char)(base.FirstChar + num * 64), (char)(base.FirstChar + num * 64 + 64 - 1));
			}
		}

		public override void Update(Func<char, char, int[]> widthUpdater, Func<char, char, int[]> abcUpdater)
		{
			foreach (CharWidthArrayChunk chunk in chunks)
			{
				if (chunk != null && chunk.Dirty)
				{
					chunk.Update(widthUpdater, abcUpdater);
				}
			}
		}

		public override CharWidthArrayChunk GetChunk(char ch)
		{
			int index = (ch - base.FirstChar) / 64;
			return chunks[index];
		}
	}
	internal class CharWidthArrayPrimaryLevel : CharWidthArrayLevelBase
	{
		private CharWidthArrayChunk chunk;

		public override bool Dirty => chunk.Dirty;

		public CharWidthArrayPrimaryLevel(char firstChar)
			: base(firstChar)
		{
		}

		public override void Check(char ch)
		{
			if (chunk == null)
			{
				chunk = new CharWidthArrayChunk(base.FirstChar, 'Ͽ');
			}
		}

		public override void Update(Func<char, char, int[]> widthUpdater, Func<char, char, int[]> abcUpdater)
		{
			if (chunk != null && chunk.Dirty)
			{
				chunk.Update(widthUpdater, abcUpdater);
			}
		}

		public override CharWidthArrayChunk GetChunk(char ch)
		{
			return chunk;
		}
	}
	public class CharWidthArray
	{
		public const int LevelSize = 1024;

		private readonly List<CharWidthArrayLevelBase> levels = new List<CharWidthArrayLevelBase>();

		public char FirstChar { get; private set; }

		public bool Dirty => levels.Any((CharWidthArrayLevelBase x) => x?.Dirty ?? false);

		public CharWidthArray(char firstChar)
		{
			FirstChar = firstChar;
		}

		public void Check(char ch)
		{
			int num = ch / 1024;
			while (levels.Count <= num)
			{
				levels.Add(null);
			}
			if (levels[num] == null)
			{
				if (num == 0)
				{
					levels[num] = new CharWidthArrayPrimaryLevel(FirstChar);
				}
				else
				{
					levels[num] = new CharWidthArrayLevel((char)(num * 1024));
				}
			}
			levels[num].Check(ch);
		}

		public void Update(Func<char, char, int[]> widthUpdater, Func<char, char, int[]> abcUpdater)
		{
			foreach (CharWidthArrayLevelBase level in levels)
			{
				if (level != null && level.Dirty)
				{
					level.Update(widthUpdater, abcUpdater);
				}
			}
		}

		public int GetCharWidth(char ch)
		{
			int index = ch / 1024;
			return levels[index].GetChunk(ch).GetCharWidth(ch);
		}

		public int GetCharABCWidth(char ch)
		{
			int index = ch / 1024;
			return levels[index].GetChunk(ch).GetCharABCWidth(ch);
		}
	}
	public static class GraphicsPathExtensions
	{
		public static void Translate(this DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath, float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			DXMatrix matrix = new DXMatrix(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, offsetX, offsetY);
			graphicsPath.Transform(matrix);
		}
	}
	public class HdcOriginModifier : IDisposable
	{
		public enum Mode
		{
			Replace,
			Combine
		}

		private Graphics gr;

		private Win32.POINT oldOrigin;

		public HdcOriginModifier(Graphics gr, Point newOrigin, float zoomFactor)
			: this(gr, newOrigin, zoomFactor, Mode.Replace)
		{
		}

		public HdcOriginModifier(Graphics gr, Point newOrigin, float zoomFactor, Mode mode)
		{
			this.gr = gr;
			SetHDCOrigin(newOrigin, zoomFactor, mode);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetHDCOrigin(Point newOrigin, float zoomFactor, Mode mode)
		{
			IntPtr hdc = gr.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				Win32.POINT lpPoint = default(Win32.POINT);
				Win32.GetWindowOrgEx(hdc, out oldOrigin);
				int num = -(int)Math.Round((float)newOrigin.X / zoomFactor);
				int num2 = -(int)Math.Round((float)newOrigin.Y / zoomFactor);
				if (mode == Mode.Combine)
				{
					num += (int)Math.Round((float)oldOrigin.X / zoomFactor);
					num2 += (int)Math.Round((float)oldOrigin.Y / zoomFactor);
				}
				Win32.SetWindowOrgEx(hdc, num, num2, ref lpPoint);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.ReleaseHdc();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RestoreHDC()
		{
			IntPtr hdc = gr.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				Win32.POINT lpPoint = default(Win32.POINT);
				Win32.SetWindowOrgEx(hdc, oldOrigin.X, oldOrigin.Y, ref lpPoint);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.ReleaseHdc();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			RestoreHDC();
		}
	}
	public class HdcZoomModifier : IDisposable
	{
		private Graphics gr;

		private Win32.SIZE oldWindowExtent;

		public HdcZoomModifier(Graphics gr, float zoomFactor)
		{
			this.gr = gr;
			ZoomHDC(zoomFactor);
		}

		protected internal virtual void ZoomHDC(float zoomFactor)
		{
			IntPtr hdc = gr.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				Win32.SIZE lpSize = new Win32.SIZE(0, 0);
				Win32.GetWindowExtEx(hdc, out oldWindowExtent);
				Win32.SetWindowExtEx(hdc, (int)Math.Round((float)oldWindowExtent.Width / zoomFactor), (int)Math.Round((float)oldWindowExtent.Height / zoomFactor), ref lpSize);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.ReleaseHdc();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RestoreHDC()
		{
			IntPtr hdc = gr.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				Win32.SIZE lpSize = new Win32.SIZE(0, 0);
				Win32.SetWindowExtEx(hdc, oldWindowExtent.Width, oldWindowExtent.Height, ref lpSize);
			}
			finally
			{
				gr.ReleaseHdc();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			RestoreHDC();
		}
	}
	public class HdcScaleModifier : IDisposable
	{
		private bool modifyOrigin;

		private IntPtr hdc;

		private Win32.POINT oldOrigin;

		private Win32.SIZE oldWindowExtent;

		public HdcScaleModifier(IntPtr hdc, float scaleX, float scaleY, bool modifyOrigin)
		{
			this.hdc = hdc;
			this.modifyOrigin = modifyOrigin;
			ScaleOrigin(hdc, scaleX, scaleY);
			ScaleWindow(hdc, scaleX, scaleY);
		}

		private void ScaleOrigin(IntPtr hdc, float scaleX, float scaleY)
		{
			if (modifyOrigin)
			{
				Win32.GetWindowOrgEx(hdc, out oldOrigin);
				Win32.POINT pOINT = oldOrigin;
				int x = (int)Math.Round((float)pOINT.X / scaleX);
				int y = (int)Math.Round((float)pOINT.Y / scaleY);
				Win32.SetWindowOrgEx(hdc, x, y, ref oldOrigin);
			}
		}

		private void ScaleWindow(IntPtr hdc, float scaleX, float scaleY)
		{
			Win32.SIZE lpSize = new Win32.SIZE(0, 0);
			Win32.GetWindowExtEx(hdc, out oldWindowExtent);
			Win32.SetWindowExtEx(hdc, (int)Math.Round((float)oldWindowExtent.Width / scaleX), (int)Math.Round((float)oldWindowExtent.Height / scaleY), ref lpSize);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RestoreWindow(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			Win32.SIZE lpSize = new Win32.SIZE(0, 0);
			Win32.SetWindowExtEx(hdc, oldWindowExtent.Width, oldWindowExtent.Height, ref lpSize);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RestoreOrigin(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			if (modifyOrigin)
			{
				Win32.POINT lpPoint = default(Win32.POINT);
				Win32.SetWindowOrgEx(hdc, oldOrigin.X, oldOrigin.Y, ref lpPoint);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			RestoreWindow(hdc);
			RestoreOrigin(hdc);
		}
	}
	public class MetafilePhysicalDimensionCalculator
	{
		private Win32.MapMode mapMode;

		private Size windowExtent;

		public Size Calculate(Metafile metafile, byte[] bytes)
		{
			windowExtent = Size.Empty;
			mapMode = Win32.MapMode.HighMetric;
			IntPtr intPtr = Win32.SetMetaFileBitsEx(bytes.Length, bytes);
			Size result;
			if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				result = CalculateWmfPhysicalDimension(intPtr, metafile);
				Win32.DeleteMetaFile(intPtr);
			}
			else
			{
				Win32.METAFILEPICT mfp = new Win32.METAFILEPICT(Win32.MapMode.Anisotropic, -1, -1);
				IntPtr intPtr2 = Win32.SetWinMetaFileBits(bytes.Length, bytes, IntPtr.Zero, ref mfp);
				if (intPtr2 == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					intPtr2 = Win32.SetEnhMetaFileBits(bytes.Length, bytes);
				}
				if (intPtr2 != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					result = CalculateEmfPhysicalDimension(intPtr2, metafile);
					MetafileHelper.DeleteMetafileHandle(intPtr2);
				}
				else
				{
					result = Size.Round(metafile.PhysicalDimension);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Size CalculateWmfPhysicalDimension(IntPtr hmf, Metafile metafile)
		{
			Win32.EnumMetaFile(IntPtr.Zero, hmf, EnumMetafileCallback, IntPtr.Zero);
			Size size = windowExtent;
			if (size == Size.Empty)
			{
				size = metafile.Size;
			}
			if (mapMode == Win32.MapMode.HighMetric)
			{
				return size;
			}
			return ConvertLogicalUnitsToHundredthsOfMillimeter(size);
		}

		private Size CalculateEmfPhysicalDimension(IntPtr hEmf, Metafile metafile)
		{
			Win32.RECT lpRect = default(Win32.RECT);
			Win32.EnumEnhMetaFile(IntPtr.Zero, hEmf, EnumEnhMetafileCallback, IntPtr.Zero, ref lpRect);
			Size size = windowExtent;
			if (size == Size.Empty)
			{
				size = metafile.Size;
			}
			return ConvertLogicalUnitsToHundredthsOfMillimeter(size);
		}

		private Size ConvertLogicalUnitsToHundredthsOfMillimeter(Size size)
		{
			size.Width = (int)Math.Round(2540f * (float)Math.Abs(size.Width) / 96f);
			size.Height = (int)Math.Round(2540f * (float)Math.Abs(size.Height) / 96f);
			return size;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private int EnumMetafileCallback(IntPtr hdc, IntPtr handleTable, IntPtr metafileRecord, int objectCount, IntPtr clientData)
		{
			int num = Marshal.ReadInt16(metafileRecord, 4);
			switch ((System.Drawing.Imaging.EmfPlusRecordType)(65536 + num))
			{
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.EmfPlusRecordType.WmfSetWindowExt:
			{
				int height = Marshal.ReadInt16(metafileRecord, 6);
				int width = Marshal.ReadInt16(metafileRecord, 8);
				windowExtent = new Size(width, height);
				break;
			}
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.EmfPlusRecordType.WmfSetMapMode:
				mapMode = (Win32.MapMode)Marshal.ReadInt16(metafileRecord, 6);
				break;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private int EnumEnhMetafileCallback(IntPtr hdc, IntPtr handleTable, IntPtr metafileRecord, int objectCount, IntPtr clientData)
		{
			switch ((System.Drawing.Imaging.EmfPlusRecordType)Marshal.ReadInt32(metafileRecord))
			{
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.EmfPlusRecordType.EmfSetWindowExtEx:
			{
				int width = Marshal.ReadInt32(metafileRecord, 8);
				int height = Marshal.ReadInt32(metafileRecord, 12);
				windowExtent = new Size(width, height);
				break;
			}
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.EmfPlusRecordType.WmfSetMapMode:
				mapMode = (Win32.MapMode)Marshal.ReadInt32(metafileRecord, 8);
				break;
			}
			return 1;
		}
	}

		public static OfficeNativeImage CreateImage(DXImage image)

			return CreateImage(new MemoryStreamBasedImage(image, null));
		}

		{

		}

		}

		public static OfficeNativeImage CreateImage(Stream stream, IUniqueImageId id)
		{
			return CreateImage(stream, -1, id);
		}

		private static OfficeNativeImage CreateImage(Stream stream, int length, IUniqueImageId id)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = ImageLoaderHelper.GetMemoryStream(stream, length);
			MemoryStreamBasedImage memoryStreamBasedImage;
			try
			{
				memoryStreamBasedImage = ImageLoaderHelper.ImageFromStream(memoryStream);
			}
			catch
			{
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				if (memoryStream.Length < 2 || memoryStream.ReadByte() != 31 || memoryStream.ReadByte() != 139)
				{
					return null;
				}
				memoryStreamBasedImage = GetArchivedImage(memoryStream);
				if (memoryStreamBasedImage == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			memoryStreamBasedImage = new MemoryStreamBasedImage(memoryStreamBasedImage.Image, memoryStreamBasedImage.ImageStream, id ?? new NativeImageId(memoryStreamBasedImage.Image));
			return CreateImage(memoryStreamBasedImage);
		}

		private static MemoryStreamBasedImage GetArchivedImage(MemoryStream ms)
		{
			try
			{
				ms.Position = 0L;
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				using (GZipStream stream = new GZipStream(ms, CompressionMode.Decompress, leaveOpen: false))
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[4096];
					while (true)
					{
						int num = StreamHelper.FillBuffer(stream, array, 0, array.Length);
						if (num > 0)
						{
							memoryStream.Write(array, 0, num);
							continue;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				return ImageLoaderHelper.ImageFromStream(memoryStream);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
