	public class OfficeImageWin : OfficeNativeImage
	{
		private static Dictionary<Guid, ImageCodecInfo> imageEncodersInfo = CreateImageEncodersInfo();

		private Image nativeImage;

		private MemoryStream imageStream;

		public override Image NativeImage => nativeImage;

		public override OfficeImageFormat RawFormat => OfficeImageHelper.GetRtfImageFormat(NativeImage.RawFormat);

		public override int PaletteLength => NativeImage.Palette.Entries.Length;

		public override Size SizeInOriginalUnits => NativeImage.Size;

		public override OfficePixelFormat PixelFormat => (OfficePixelFormat)NativeImage.PixelFormat;

		public override float HorizontalResolution => GetResolution(NativeImage.HorizontalResolution);

		public override float VerticalResolution => GetResolution(NativeImage.VerticalResolution);

		public MemoryStream ImageStream => imageStream;

		public override bool IsMetafile => NativeImage is Metafile;

		public override DXImage DXImage { get; }

		private static Dictionary<Guid, ImageCodecInfo> CreateImageEncodersInfo()
		{
			Dictionary<Guid, ImageCodecInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<Guid, ImageCodecInfo>();
			ImageCodecInfo[] imageEncoders = ImageCodecInfo.GetImageEncoders();
			int num = imageEncoders.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				ImageCodecInfo imageCodecInfo = imageEncoders[i];
				Guid formatID = imageCodecInfo.FormatID;
				dictionary.Add(formatID, imageCodecInfo);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public OfficeImageWin(Image image, IUniqueImageId id)
			: this(image, null, id)
		{
		}

		public OfficeImageWin(Image image, MemoryStream imageStream, IUniqueImageId id)
			: this(image, ImageHelper.ToDXImage(image), imageStream, id)
		{
		}

		public OfficeImageWin(Image image, DXImage dxImage, MemoryStream imageStream, IUniqueImageId id)
			: base(id)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)image, "image");
			SetNativeImage(image, imageStream);
			DXImage = dxImage;
		}

		private float GetResolution(float resolution)
		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && resolution == 0f)
			{
				return 96f;
			}
			return resolution;
		}

		private void SetNativeImage(Image value, MemoryStream imageStream)
		{
			if (NativeImage != value)
			{
				RaiseNativeImageChanging();
				SetNativeImageCore(value, imageStream);
				OnNativeImageChanged(value.Size);
			}
		}

		private void SetNativeImageCore(Image value, MemoryStream imageStream)
		{
			nativeImage = value;
			this.imageStream = imageStream;
		}

		protected internal Size EnsureNonZeroSize(Size size)
		{
			return new Size(Math.Max(1, size.Width), Math.Max(1, size.Height));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToDocuments(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(Units.PixelsToDocuments(sizeInUnits, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateImageSizeInModelUnits(DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(unitConverter.PixelsToModelUnits(SizeInOriginalUnits, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToHundredthsOfMillimeter(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(Units.PixelsToHundredthsOfMillimeter(sizeInUnits, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToTwips(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(Units.PixelsToTwips(sizeInUnits, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToPixels(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return sizeInUnits;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnNativeImageChanged(Size desiredSize)
		{
			RaiseNativeImageChanged(desiredSize);
		}

		protected override OfficeImage CreateClone(IDocumentModel target)
		{
			OfficeImage imageById = target.GetImageById(base.Id);
			if (imageById != null)
			{
				return imageById;
			}
			return new OfficeImageWin(CloneNativeImage(), imageStream, base.Id);
		}

		protected Image CloneNativeImage()
		{
			if (NativeImage.RawFormat.Guid == ImageFormat.Gif.Guid)
			{
				MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
				NativeImage.Save(stream, GetImageCodecInfo(ImageFormat.Gif), null);
				return Image.FromStream(stream);
			}
			return (Image)NativeImage.Clone();
		}

		protected internal static ImageCodecInfo GetImageCodecInfo(ImageFormat format)
		{
			imageEncodersInfo.TryGetValue(format.Guid, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public override bool CanGetImageBytes(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override byte[] GetImageBytes(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			if (imageFormat.Equals(OfficeImageFormat.Wmf))
			{
				return GetWmfImageBytes();
			}
			if (imageFormat.Equals(OfficeImageFormat.Emf))
			{
				return GetEmfImageBytes();
			}
			return GetBitmapImageBytes(NativeImage, imageFormat);
		}

		protected internal override Stream GetImageBytesStream(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			if (imageFormat.Equals(OfficeImageFormat.Wmf))
			{
				return GetWmfImageBytesStream();
			}
			if (imageFormat.Equals(OfficeImageFormat.Emf))
			{
				return GetEmfImageBytesStream();
			}
			return (Stream)(object)GetBitmapImageBytesStream(NativeImage, imageFormat);
		}

		private static ChunkedMemoryStream GetBitmapImageBytesStream(Image nativeImage, OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ChunkedMemoryStream val = new ChunkedMemoryStream();
			ImageCodecInfo imageCodecInfo = GetImageCodecInfo(OfficeImageHelper.GetImageFormat(imageFormat));
			nativeImage.Save((Stream)(object)val, imageCodecInfo, null);
			((Stream)(object)val).Flush();
			((Stream)(object)val).Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return val;
		}

		private static byte[] GetBitmapImageBytes(Image nativeImage, OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			ChunkedMemoryStream bitmapImageBytesStream = GetBitmapImageBytesStream(nativeImage, imageFormat);
			try
			{
				return bitmapImageBytesStream.ToArray();
			}
			finally
			{
				((Stream)(object)bitmapImageBytesStream).Close();
				((IDisposable)bitmapImageBytesStream).Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override byte[] GetImageBytesSafe(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			try
			{
				return GetImageBytesSafeCore(imageFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (TryRepairImage())
			{
				try
				{
					return GetImageBytesSafeCore(imageFormat);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			ReplaceInvalidImage();
			return GetImageBytesSafeCore(imageFormat);
		}

		protected virtual bool TryRepairImage()
		{
			try
			{
				if (imageStream == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Image value = Image.FromStream(imageStream);
				SetNativeImage(value, imageStream);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ReplaceInvalidImage()
		{
			Image value = new Bitmap(nativeImage.Width, nativeImage.Height);
			SetNativeImage(value, null);
		}

		protected byte[] GetImageBytesSafeCore(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			try
			{
				return base.GetImageBytesSafe(imageFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return GetImageCopyPngBytes();
		}

		private byte[] GetImageCopyPngBytes()
		{
			using Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(NativeImage);
			return GetBitmapImageBytes(bitmap, OfficeImageFormat.Png);
		}

		public override Stream GetImageBytesStreamSafe(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			try
			{
				return GetImageBytesStreamSafeCore(imageFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (TryRepairImage())
			{
				try
				{
					return GetImageBytesStreamSafeCore(imageFormat);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			ReplaceInvalidImage();
			return GetImageBytesStreamSafeCore(imageFormat);
		}

		protected Stream GetImageBytesStreamSafeCore(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			try
			{
				return base.GetImageBytesStreamSafe(imageFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return GetImageCopyPngBytesStream();
		}

		private Stream GetImageCopyPngBytesStream()
		{
			using Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(NativeImage);
			return (Stream)(object)GetBitmapImageBytesStream(bitmap, OfficeImageFormat.Png);
		}

		public virtual byte[] GetWmfImageBytes()
		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
			{
				if (ImageStream != null && RawFormat == OfficeImageFormat.Wmf)
				{
					return ImageStream.ToArray();
				}
				return new byte[0];
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using Metafile metafile = MetafileCreator.CreateInstance((Stream)memoryStream, base.SizeInPixels.Width + 1, base.SizeInPixels.Height + 1, MetafileFrameUnit.Pixel);
			try
			{
				using (Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(metafile))
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(NativeImage, new Rectangle(0, 0, base.SizeInPixels.Width, base.SizeInPixels.Height));
				}
				intPtr = metafile.GetHenhmetafile();
				return Win32.GdipEmfToWmfBits(intPtr, Win32.MapMode.Anisotropic, Win32.EmfToWmfBitsFlags.EmfToWmfBitsFlagsDefault);
			}
			finally
			{
				MetafileHelper.DeleteMetafileHandle(intPtr);
				memoryStream.Close();
			}
		}

		public virtual Stream GetWmfImageBytesStream()
		{
			byte[] wmfImageBytes = GetWmfImageBytes();
			return new MemoryStream(wmfImageBytes, 0, wmfImageBytes.Length, writable: false, publiclyVisible: true);
		}

		public virtual byte[] GetEmfImageBytes()
		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows || !IsMetafile)
			{
				if (ImageStream != null && RawFormat == OfficeImageFormat.Emf)
				{
					return ImageStream.ToArray();
				}
				return new byte[0];
			}
			using Metafile metafile = (Metafile)NativeImage.Clone();
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = metafile.GetHenhmetafile();
				return Win32.GetEnhMetafileBits(intPtr);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					MetafileHelper.DeleteMetafileHandle(intPtr);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual Stream GetEmfImageBytesStream()
		{
			byte[] emfImageBytes = GetEmfImageBytes();
			return new MemoryStream(emfImageBytes, 0, emfImageBytes.Length, writable: false, publiclyVisible: true);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (disposing && NativeImage != null)
				{
					NativeImage.Dispose();
					SetNativeImageCore(null, null);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override void DiscardCachedData()
		{
			if (imageStream != null)
			{
				imageStream.Close();
				imageStream = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class OfficeDXImage : OfficeNativeImage
	{
		private DXImage dxImage;

		private DXBitmap dxSvgBitmap;

		private MemoryStream imageStream;

		public override Image NativeImage => TryGetNativeImage();

		public override DXImage DXImage => dxImage;

		public override bool IsMetafile => dxImage is DXMetafile;

		public override OfficeImageFormat RawFormat => OfficeImageHelper.GetRtfImageFormat(dxImage.ImageFormat);

		public override OfficePixelFormat PixelFormat => GetPixelFormat();

		public override int PaletteLength => GetPaletteLength();

		public override float HorizontalResolution => dxImage.HorizontalResolution;

		public override float VerticalResolution => dxImage.VerticalResolution;

		public override Size SizeInOriginalUnits => dxImage.Size;

		public MemoryStream ImageStream => imageStream;

		private bool IsGdiImage => dxImage.Implementation is GdiPlusImage;

		public OfficeDXImage(DXImage image, IUniqueImageId id)
			: this(image, null, id)
		{
		}

		public OfficeDXImage(DXImage image, MemoryStream imageStream, IUniqueImageId id)
			: base(id)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)image, "image");
			SetDXImageCore(image, imageStream);
		}

		private Image TryGetNativeImage()
		{
			GdiPlusImage gdiPlusImage;
			if (RawFormat == OfficeImageFormat.Svg)
			{
				if (dxSvgBitmap == null)
				{
					dxSvgBitmap = DXBitmapCreator.Create(dxImage, Color.Transparent);
				}
				gdiPlusImage = dxSvgBitmap.Implementation as GdiPlusImage;
			}
			else
			{
				gdiPlusImage = dxImage.Implementation as GdiPlusImage;
			}
			return gdiPlusImage?.Unwrap(cloneImage: false);
		}

		private int GetPaletteLength()
		{
			return ((!(dxImage is DXBitmap dXBitmap)) ? ((int?)null) : dXBitmap.Palette?.Colors?.Length).GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		private OfficePixelFormat GetPixelFormat()
		{
			if (!(dxImage is DXBitmap dXBitmap))
			{
				return OfficePixelFormat.DontCare;
			}
			return (OfficePixelFormat)OfficeImageHelper.ConvertPixelFormat(dXBitmap.PixelFormat);
		}

		private void SetDXImage(DXImage value, MemoryStream imageStream)
		{
			if (DXImage != value)
			{
				bool isGdiImage = IsGdiImage;
				if (IsGdiImage)
				{
					RaiseNativeImageChanging();
				}
				SetDXImageCore(value, imageStream);
				if (IsGdiImage)
				{
					RaiseNativeImageChanged(value.Size);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetDXImageCore(DXImage value, MemoryStream imageStream)
		{
			dxImage = value;
			this.imageStream = imageStream;
		}

		private Size EnsureNonZeroSize(Size size)
		{
			return new Size(Math.Max(1, size.Width), Math.Max(1, size.Height));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToDocuments(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(Units.PixelsToDocuments(sizeInUnits, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size CalculateImageSizeInModelUnits(DocumentModelUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(unitConverter.PixelsToModelUnits(SizeInOriginalUnits, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToHundredthsOfMillimeter(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(Units.PixelsToHundredthsOfMillimeter(sizeInUnits, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToTwips(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(Units.PixelsToTwips(sizeInUnits, HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToPixels(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return sizeInUnits;
		}

		protected override OfficeImage CreateClone(IDocumentModel target)
		{
			OfficeImage imageById = target.GetImageById(base.Id);
			if (imageById != null)
			{
				return imageById;
			}
			return new OfficeDXImage(DXImage.Clone(), imageStream, base.Id);
		}

		public override bool CanGetImageBytes(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override byte[] GetImageBytes(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			if (imageFormat.Equals(OfficeImageFormat.Wmf))
			{
				return GetWmfImageBytes();
			}
			if (imageFormat.Equals(OfficeImageFormat.Emf))
			{
				return GetEmfImageBytes();
			}
			return GetBitmapImageBytes(DXImage, imageFormat);
		}

		protected internal override Stream GetImageBytesStream(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			if (imageFormat.Equals(OfficeImageFormat.Wmf))
			{
				return GetWmfImageBytesStream();
			}
			if (imageFormat.Equals(OfficeImageFormat.Emf))
			{
				return GetEmfImageBytesStream();
			}
			return (Stream)(object)GetBitmapImageBytesStream(DXImage, imageFormat);
		}

		private static ChunkedMemoryStream GetBitmapImageBytesStream(DXImage dxImage, OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ChunkedMemoryStream val = new ChunkedMemoryStream();
			dxImage.Save((Stream)(object)val, OfficeImageHelper.GetDXImageFormat(imageFormat));
			((Stream)(object)val).Flush();
			((Stream)(object)val).Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return val;
		}

		private static byte[] GetBitmapImageBytes(DXImage dxImage, OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			ChunkedMemoryStream bitmapImageBytesStream = GetBitmapImageBytesStream(dxImage, imageFormat);
			try
			{
				return bitmapImageBytesStream.ToArray();
			}
			finally
			{
				((Stream)(object)bitmapImageBytesStream).Close();
				((IDisposable)bitmapImageBytesStream).Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override byte[] GetImageBytesSafe(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			try
			{
				return GetImageBytesSafeCore(imageFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (TryRepairImage())
			{
				try
				{
					return GetImageBytesSafeCore(imageFormat);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			ReplaceInvalidImage();
			return GetImageBytesSafeCore(imageFormat);
		}

		private bool TryRepairImage()
		{
			try
			{
				if (imageStream == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DXImage value = DXImage.FromStream(imageStream);
				SetDXImage(value, imageStream);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceInvalidImage()
		{
			DXImage value = new DXBitmap(DXImage.Width, DXImage.Height);
			SetDXImage(value, null);
		}

		private byte[] GetImageBytesSafeCore(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			try
			{
				return base.GetImageBytesSafe(imageFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return GetImageCopyPngBytes();
		}

		private byte[] GetImageCopyPngBytes()
		{
			using DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(DXImage);
			return GetBitmapImageBytes(dXBitmap, OfficeImageFormat.Png);
		}

		public override Stream GetImageBytesStreamSafe(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			try
			{
				return GetImageBytesStreamSafeCore(imageFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (TryRepairImage())
			{
				try
				{
					return GetImageBytesStreamSafeCore(imageFormat);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			ReplaceInvalidImage();
			return GetImageBytesStreamSafeCore(imageFormat);
		}

		private Stream GetImageBytesStreamSafeCore(OfficeImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			try
			{
				return base.GetImageBytesStreamSafe(imageFormat);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return GetImageCopyPngBytesStream();
		}

		private Stream GetImageCopyPngBytesStream()
		{
			using DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(DXImage);
			return (Stream)(object)GetBitmapImageBytesStream(dXBitmap, OfficeImageFormat.Png);
		}

		public byte[] GetWmfImageBytes()
		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows || !IsGdiImage)
			{
				if (ImageStream != null && RawFormat == OfficeImageFormat.Wmf)
				{
					return ImageStream.ToArray();
				}
				return new byte[0];
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using Metafile metafile = MetafileCreator.CreateInstance((Stream)memoryStream, base.SizeInPixels.Width + 1, base.SizeInPixels.Height + 1, MetafileFrameUnit.Pixel);
			try
			{
				using (Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(metafile))
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(NativeImage, new Rectangle(0, 0, base.SizeInPixels.Width, base.SizeInPixels.Height));
				}
				intPtr = metafile.GetHenhmetafile();
				return Win32.GdipEmfToWmfBits(intPtr, Win32.MapMode.Anisotropic, Win32.EmfToWmfBitsFlags.EmfToWmfBitsFlagsDefault);
			}
			finally
			{
				MetafileHelper.DeleteMetafileHandle(intPtr);
				memoryStream.Close();
			}
		}

		public Stream GetWmfImageBytesStream()
		{
			byte[] wmfImageBytes = GetWmfImageBytes();
			return new MemoryStream(wmfImageBytes, 0, wmfImageBytes.Length, writable: false, publiclyVisible: true);
		}

		public byte[] GetEmfImageBytes()
		{
			if (DXImageHelper.IsEmfMetafile(DXImage))
			{
				using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
				{
					DXImage.Save(memoryStream, DXImageFormat.Emf);
					return memoryStream.ToArray();
				}
			}
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows || !IsMetafile)
			{
				if (ImageStream != null && RawFormat == OfficeImageFormat.Emf)
				{
					return ImageStream.ToArray();
				}
				return new byte[0];
			}
			using Metafile metafile = (Metafile)NativeImage.Clone();
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = metafile.GetHenhmetafile();
				return Win32.GetEnhMetafileBits(intPtr);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					MetafileHelper.DeleteMetafileHandle(intPtr);
				}
			}
		}

		public Stream GetEmfImageBytesStream()
		{
			byte[] emfImageBytes = GetEmfImageBytes();
			return new MemoryStream(emfImageBytes, 0, emfImageBytes.Length, writable: false, publiclyVisible: true);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (disposing && DXImage != null)
				{
					DXImage.Dispose();
					SetDXImageCore(null, null);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override void DiscardCachedData()
		{
			if (imageStream != null)
			{
				imageStream.Close();
				imageStream = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class OfficeMetafileImageWin : OfficeImageWin
	{

		{

			{

			set
			{
				metafileSizeInHundredthsOfMillimeter = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract bool OverrideResolution { get; }

		public override float HorizontalResolution => 96f;

		public override float VerticalResolution => 96f;

		public override Size SizeInOriginalUnits => MetafileSizeInHundredthsOfMillimeter;

		protected OfficeMetafileImageWin(Metafile image, IUniqueImageId id)

			: base(image, imageStream, id)

			metafileSizeInHundredthsOfMillimeter = EnsureNonZeroSize(Size.Round(image.PhysicalDimension));
		}

		{
			return sizeInUnits;
		}

		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToPixels(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(Units.HundredthsOfMillimeterToPixels(sizeInUnits, VerticalResolution, HorizontalResolution));
		}

		protected internal override Size UnitsToTwips(Size sizeInUnits)
		{
			return EnsureNonZeroSize(Units.HundredthsOfMillimeterToTwips(sizeInUnits));
		}

		protected internal override void OnNativeImageChanged(Size desiredSize)
		{
			metafileSizeInHundredthsOfMillimeter = Size.Empty;
			base.OnNativeImageChanged(desiredSize);
		}

		public override byte[] GetWmfImageBytes()
		{
			using Metafile metafile = (Metafile)NativeImage.Clone();
			IntPtr henhmetafile = metafile.GetHenhmetafile();
			try
			{
				return Win32.GdipEmfToWmfBits(henhmetafile, Win32.MapMode.Anisotropic, Win32.EmfToWmfBitsFlags.EmfToWmfBitsFlagsDefault);
			}
			finally
			{
				MetafileHelper.DeleteMetafileHandle(henhmetafile);
			}
		}

		protected override bool TryRepairImage()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceInvalidImage()
		{
		}
	}

	public static class MetafileHelper
	{
		private delegate byte[] GetMetafileBytesDelegate(IntPtr handle);

		public const int MetafileResolution = 96;

		private const int CF_ENHMETAFILE = 14;

		private const int CF_METAFILEPICT = 3;

		private static Metafile TryCreateMetafile(IntPtr handle)
		{
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				return TryCreateMetafileCore(handle);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Assert, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode)]
		private static Metafile TryCreateMetafileCore(IntPtr handle)
		{
			return new Metafile(handle, deleteEmf: true);
		}

		private static Image CreateMetafileWin(MemoryStream stream, Win32.MapMode mapMode, int pictureWidth, int pictureHeight)
		{
			byte[] buffer = stream.GetBuffer();
			Win32.METAFILEPICT mfp = new Win32.METAFILEPICT(mapMode, pictureWidth, pictureHeight);
			IntPtr handle = Win32.SetWinMetaFileBits((uint)buffer.Length, buffer, IntPtr.Zero, ref mfp);
			Metafile metafile = TryCreateMetafile(handle);
			if (metafile != null)
			{
				return metafile;
			}
			DeleteMetafileHandle(handle);
			handle = Win32.SetMetaFileBitsEx(buffer.Length, buffer);
			metafile = TryCreateMetafile(handle);
			if (metafile != null)
			{
				return metafile;
			}
			DeleteMetafileHandle(handle);
			handle = Win32.SetEnhMetaFileBits(buffer.Length, buffer);
			metafile = TryCreateMetafile(handle);
			if (metafile != null)
			{
				return metafile;
			}
			DeleteMetafileHandle(handle);
			return GetMetafile(stream);
		}

		private static IDXMetafile CreateEmfMetafile(MemoryStream stream, Win32.MapMode mapMode, int pictureWidth, int pictureHeight)
		{
			if (stream.CanSeek)
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
			if (EmfMetafile.TryCreateEmfMetafile(stream, out var emfMetafile))
			{
				return emfMetafile;
			}
			return new EmfMetafile(new EmfMetafileModel(new Size(pictureWidth, pictureHeight), DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel));
		}

		public static DXImage CreateDXMetafile(MemoryStream stream, Win32.MapMode mapMode, int pictureWidth, int pictureHeight)
		{
			if (DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.GdiPlus)
			{
				return GetDXMetafileGdiPlus(stream, mapMode, pictureWidth, pictureHeight);
			}
			IDXMetafile implementation = CreateEmfMetafile(stream, mapMode, pictureWidth, pictureHeight);
			return new DXMetafile(implementation);
		}

		private static DXImage GetDXMetafileGdiPlus(MemoryStream stream, Win32.MapMode mapMode, int pictureWidth, int pictureHeight)
		{
			if (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
			{
				return GdiPlusImage.Wrap(CreateMetafileWin(stream, mapMode, pictureWidth, pictureHeight));
			}
			return GdiPlusImage.Wrap(GetMetafileNonWin(stream));
		}

		public static void DeleteMetafileHandle(IntPtr handle)
		{
			if (!Win32.DeleteEnhMetaFile(handle))
			{
				Win32.DeleteMetaFile(handle);
			}
		}

		private static Image GetMetafileNonWin(MemoryStream stream)
		{
			try
			{
				if (stream.CanSeek)
				{
					stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
				return new Metafile(stream);
			}
			catch
			{
				if (stream.CanSeek)
				{
					stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
				return GetMetafile(stream);
			}
		}

		private static Image GetMetafile(MemoryStream stream)
		{
			byte[] buffer = stream.GetBuffer();
			MemoryStream stream2 = new MemoryStream(buffer, 0, (int)stream.Length);
			try
			{
				MemoryStreamBasedImage memoryStreamBasedImage = ImageLoaderHelper.ImageFromStream(stream2);
				return ((GdiPlusImage)memoryStreamBasedImage.Image.Implementation).Unwrap(cloneImage: false);
			}
			catch
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid metafile.");
			}
		}

			IntPtr intPtr = PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.SetWinMetaFileBits((uint)metaFileBits.Length, metaFileBits, IntPtr.Zero, ref mfp);
			try

				byte[] array = new byte[enhMetaFileBits];
				PInvokeSafeNativeMethods.GetEnhMetaFileBits(intPtr, enhMetaFileBits, array);

		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows || !OpenClipboard(IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				if (IsClipboardFormatAvailable(uFormat) == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				intPtr = GetClipboardData(uFormat);
				using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(getter(intPtr));
				return new Metafile(stream);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					DeleteMetafileHandle(intPtr);
				}
				CloseClipboard();
			}

		private static bool CompareParameterTypes(ParameterInfo[] ciParameters, Type[] parameters)
		{
			if (ciParameters.Length != parameters.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = ciParameters.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (ciParameters[i].ParameterType != parameters[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static List<BlipBase> ReadAllBlips(BinaryReader reader, BinaryReader embeddedReader, long endPosition)
		{
			List<BlipBase> list = new List<BlipBase>();
			while (reader.BaseStream.Position < endPosition)
			{
				OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = OfficeArtRecordHeader.FromStream(reader);
				long val = reader.BaseStream.Position + officeArtRecordHeader.Length;
				BlipBase blipBase = CreateBlipFromStream(reader, embeddedReader, officeArtRecordHeader);
				if (blipBase != null)
				{
					list.Add(blipBase);
				}
				reader.BaseStream.Position = Math.Max(val, reader.BaseStream.Position);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static BlipBase CreateBlipFromStreamCore(BinaryReader reader, BinaryReader embeddedReader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			int typeCode = header.TypeCode;
			if (typeCode == 61447)
			{
				return new FileBlipStoreEntry(reader, embeddedReader, header);
			}
			if (typeCodeTranslationTable.TryGetValue(typeCode, out var value))
			{
				return value.Invoke(new object[2] { reader, header }) as BlipBase;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static BlipBase CreateBlipFromImage(OfficeImage image)
		{
			if (imageFormatTranslationTable.TryGetValue(image.RawFormat, out var value))
			{
				return value.Invoke(new object[1] { image }) as BlipBase;
			}
			return new BlipDib(image);
		}

	public abstract class BlipBase : IDisposable
	{
		public const int MD4MessageSize = 16;

		public const int TagSize = 1;

		internal const int MetafileHeaderSize = 34;

		internal const byte DefaultTagValue = byte.MaxValue;

		private OfficeImage image;

		private Stream imageBytesStream;

		private DocMetafileHeader metafileHeader;

		public abstract int SingleMD4Message { get; }

		public abstract int DoubleMD4Message { get; }

		public byte TagValue { get; protected set; }

		public DocMetafileHeader MetafileHeader => metafileHeader;

		public OfficeImage Image
		{

			{
				return image;
			}
			set
			{
				SetImage(value);
			}
		}

		{

					imageBytesStream = CreateImageBytesStream();
				}

			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (imageBytesStream == null)
				{
					imageBytesStream = CreateImageBytesStream();
				}

				{
					return 0;
				}

			}
		}

		protected internal virtual OfficeImageFormat Format
		{
			get
			{
				if (image != null)
				{
					return image.RawFormat;
				}
				return OfficeImageFormat.None;
			}
		}

		protected BlipBase()
		{
			TagValue = byte.MaxValue;
		}

		protected BlipBase(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)reader, "reader");
			TagValue = byte.MaxValue;
			Read(reader, header);
		}

		protected BlipBase(OfficeImage image)
		{
			TagValue = byte.MaxValue;
			SetImage(image);
		}

		private void SetImage(OfficeImage image)
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				this.image = image;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetImage(BlipBase blip)
		{
			SetImage(blip.Image);
			metafileHeader = blip.metafileHeader;
			TagValue = blip.TagValue;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetImage(DocMetafileReader reader)
		{
			SetImage(reader.Image);
			metafileHeader = reader.MetafileHeader;
		}

		protected virtual void Read(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			int num = CalcMD4MessageOffset(header.InstanceInfo);
			reader.BaseStream.Seek(num, SeekOrigin.Current);
			int count = header.Length - num;
			byte[] buffer = reader.ReadBytes(count);
			MemoryStream imageStream = new MemoryStream(buffer);
			LoadImageFromStream(imageStream);
		}

		public virtual MD4MessageDigest Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = CreateRecordHeader();
			officeArtRecordHeader.Write(writer);
			long position = writer.BaseStream.Position;
			writer.Seek(16, SeekOrigin.Current);
			writer.Write(TagValue);
			MD4MessageDigest result = SaveImageToStream(writer);
			long position2 = writer.BaseStream.Position;
			writer.Seek((int)position, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			writer.Write(result.ToArray());
			writer.Seek((int)position2, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void LoadImageFromStream(MemoryStream imageStream)
		{
			Image = OfficeImage.CreateImage(imageStream);
		}

		protected virtual MD4MessageDigest SaveImageToStream(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Stream stream = ImageBytesStream;
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return default(MD4MessageDigest);
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[4096];
			int num = array.Length;
			long num2 = ImageBytesLength;
			MD4HashCalculator val = new MD4HashCalculator();
			uint[] array2 = val.InitialCheckSumValue;
			while (num2 >= num)
			{
				StreamHelper.FillBuffer(stream, array, 0, num);
				num2 -= num;
				writer.Write(array);
				array2 = val.UpdateCheckSum(array2, array, 0, num);
			}
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				StreamHelper.FillBuffer(stream, array, 0, (int)num2);
				writer.Write(array, 0, (int)num2);
				array2 = val.UpdateCheckSum(array2, array, 0, (int)num2);
			}
			return new MD4MessageDigest(val.GetFinalCheckSum(array2));
		}

		public virtual int GetSize()
		{
			return 25 + ImageBytesLength;
		}

		protected virtual DocMetafileHeader CreateMetafileHeader()
		{
			DocMetafileHeader docMetafileHeader = new DocMetafileHeader();
			int imageBytesLength = ImageBytesLength;
			int width = Image.SizeInPixels.Width;
			int height = Image.SizeInPixels.Height;
			docMetafileHeader.Compressed = false;
			docMetafileHeader.CompressedSize = imageBytesLength;
			docMetafileHeader.UncompressedSize = imageBytesLength;
			docMetafileHeader.Right = 0;
			docMetafileHeader.Left = width;
			docMetafileHeader.Top = 0;
			docMetafileHeader.Bottom = height;
			docMetafileHeader.HeightInEmus = height;
			docMetafileHeader.WidthInEmus = width;
			return docMetafileHeader;
		}

		protected internal virtual int CalcMD4MessageOffset(int uidInfo)
		{
			if (uidInfo == SingleMD4Message)
			{
				return 17;
			}
			if (uidInfo == DoubleMD4Message)
			{
				return 33;
			}
			OfficeArtExceptions.ThrowInvalidContent();
			return 0;
		}

		public abstract OfficeArtRecordHeader CreateRecordHeader();

		protected virtual Stream CreateImageBytesStream()
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				return image.GetImageBytesStreamSafe(Format);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && imageBytesStream != null)
			{
				imageBytesStream.Dispose();
				imageBytesStream = null;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~BlipBase()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}
	}
	public abstract class BlipMetaFile : BlipBase
	{
		private const int bufferSize = 16384;

		private const int maxUncompressedSize = 32768;

		private int uncompressedSize;

		private MD4MessageDigest md4Digest;

		protected BlipMetaFile(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)

		}

			}

		}

		{

			{

		protected internal override int CalcMD4MessageOffset(int uidInfo)
		{

		}

		{
			DocMetafileHeader docMetafileHeader = new DocMetafileHeader();
			int imageBytesLength = base.ImageBytesLength;
			int width = base.Image.SizeInPixels.Width;
			int height = base.Image.SizeInPixels.Height;
			docMetafileHeader.Compressed = imageBytesLength != uncompressedSize;
			docMetafileHeader.CompressedSize = imageBytesLength;
			docMetafileHeader.UncompressedSize = uncompressedSize;
			docMetafileHeader.Left = 0;
			docMetafileHeader.Right = width;
			docMetafileHeader.Top = 0;
			docMetafileHeader.Bottom = height;
			docMetafileHeader.HeightInEmus = PixelsToEmu(height);
			docMetafileHeader.WidthInEmus = PixelsToEmu(width);
			return docMetafileHeader;
		}

		{
			return pixels * 9525;
		}

		protected override Stream CreateImageBytesStream()
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Stream stream = base.CreateImageBytesStream();
			uncompressedSize = (int)stream.Length;
			if (uncompressedSize <= 32768)
			{
				CalcMD4Digest(stream);
				return stream;
			}

			((Stream)(object)val).WriteByte((byte)120);
			((Stream)(object)val).WriteByte((byte)1);
			Adler32CheckSumCalculator val2 = new Adler32CheckSumCalculator();
			uint num = val2.InitialCheckSumValue;
			MD4HashCalculator val3 = new MD4HashCalculator();
			uint[] array = val3.InitialCheckSumValue;
			using (DeflateStream deflateStream = new DeflateStream((Stream)(object)val, CompressionMode.Compress, leaveOpen: true))

					StreamHelper.FillBuffer(stream, array2, 0, num3);
					deflateStream.Write(array2, 0, num3);
					num = val2.UpdateCheckSum(num, array2, 0, num3);
					array = val3.UpdateCheckSum(array, array2, 0, num3);
					num2 -= num3;
				}
			}
			md4Digest = new MD4MessageDigest(val3.GetFinalCheckSum(array));
			num = val2.GetFinalCheckSum(num);
			byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes(num);
			((Stream)(object)val).Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
			((Stream)(object)val).Flush();

		}

		private void CalcMD4Digest(Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			byte[] array = new byte[16384];

		public override int SingleMD4Message => embeddedBlip.SingleMD4Message;

		public override int DoubleMD4Message => embeddedBlip.DoubleMD4Message;

		public FileBlipStoreEntry(BinaryReader reader, BinaryReader embeddedReader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			this.embeddedReader = embeddedReader;
			Read(reader, header);
		}

		public FileBlipStoreEntry(OfficeImage image, bool hasDelayedStream)
		{
			embeddedBlip = BlipFactory.CreateBlipFromImage(image);
			SetImage(embeddedBlip);
			blipType = GetBlipType(image.RawFormat);
			embeddedBlipSize = embeddedBlip.GetSize();
			this.hasDelayedStream = hasDelayedStream;
		}

		public FileBlipStoreEntry(BlipBase blip, bool hasDelayedStream)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)blip, "blip");
			embeddedBlip = blip;
			SetImage(embeddedBlip);
			blipType = 7;
			embeddedBlipSize = embeddedBlip.GetSize();
			this.hasDelayedStream = hasDelayedStream;
		}

		protected override void Read(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			reader.BaseStream.Seek(24L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			ReadCore(reader);
			ReadName(reader);
			ReadEmbeddedBlip(reader);
		}

		private void ReadCore(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			refCount = reader.ReadInt32();
			embeddedBlipOffset = reader.ReadUInt32();
			reader.BaseStream.Seek(1L, SeekOrigin.Current);
		}

		private void ReadName(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			byte b = reader.ReadByte();
			reader.BaseStream.Seek(2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			if (b != 0)
			{
				byte[] array = reader.ReadBytes(b - 2);
				name = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(array, 0, array.Length);
				reader.BaseStream.Seek(2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			}
		}

		private void ReadEmbeddedBlip(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			if (embeddedBlipOffset != uint.MaxValue && ReferenceCount != 0)
			{
				if (EmbeddedReader != reader)
				{
					EmbeddedReader.BaseStream.Seek(embeddedBlipOffset, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
				OfficeArtRecordHeader header = OfficeArtRecordHeader.FromStream(embeddedReader);
				try
				{
					embeddedBlip = BlipFactory.CreateBlipFromStream(embeddedReader, header);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				if (embeddedBlip != null && embeddedBlip.Image != null)
				{
					SetImage(embeddedBlip);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Image = UriBasedOfficeImageBase.CreatePlaceHolder(null, 0, 0);
				}
			}
		}

		public override MD4MessageDigest Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)writer, "writer");
			long num = WriteCore(writer);
			writer.Write(68);
			WriteName(writer);
			MD4MessageDigest result = embeddedBlip.Write(writer);
			long position = writer.BaseStream.Position;
			writer.Seek((int)num, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			writer.Write(result.ToArray());
			writer.Seek((int)position, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return result;
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer, BinaryWriter embeddedWriter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)writer, "writer");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)embeddedWriter, "embeddedWriter");
			long num = WriteCore(writer);
			if (HasDelayedStream)
			{
				writer.Write((int)embeddedWriter.BaseStream.Position);
			}
			else
			{
				writer.Write(0);
			}
			WriteName(writer);
			MD4MessageDigest mD4MessageDigest = embeddedBlip.Write(embeddedWriter);
			long position = writer.BaseStream.Position;
			writer.Seek((int)num, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			writer.Write(mD4MessageDigest.ToArray());
			writer.Seek((int)position, SeekOrigin.Begin);
		}

		private long WriteCore(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = CreateRecordHeader();
			officeArtRecordHeader.Write(writer);
			writer.Write(blipType);
			writer.Write(blipType);
			long position = writer.BaseStream.Position;
			writer.Seek(16, SeekOrigin.Current);
			writer.Write((short)255);
			writer.Write(EmbeddedBlipSize);
			writer.Write(ReferenceCount);
			return position;
		}

		private void WriteName(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.BaseStream.Seek(1L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			writer.Write((byte)0);
			writer.BaseStream.Seek(2L, SeekOrigin.Current);
		}

		public override OfficeArtRecordHeader CreateRecordHeader()
		{
			OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = new OfficeArtRecordHeader();
			officeArtRecordHeader.Version = 2;
			officeArtRecordHeader.InstanceInfo = blipType;
			officeArtRecordHeader.TypeCode = 61447;
			officeArtRecordHeader.Length = (HasDelayedStream ? 36 : (36 + EmbeddedBlipSize));
			return officeArtRecordHeader;
		}

		protected virtual byte GetBlipType(OfficeImageFormat format)
		{
			return format switch
			{
				OfficeImageFormat.Bmp => 6, 
				OfficeImageFormat.MemoryBmp => 6, 
				OfficeImageFormat.Gif => 6, 
				OfficeImageFormat.Emf => 2, 
				OfficeImageFormat.Jpeg => 5, 
				OfficeImageFormat.None => 1, 
				OfficeImageFormat.Png => 6, 
				OfficeImageFormat.Tiff => 17, 
				OfficeImageFormat.Wmf => 3, 
				OfficeImageFormat.Svg => 6, 
				_ => 1, 
			};
		}

		public override int GetSize()
		{
			if (!HasDelayedStream)
			{
				return 44 + EmbeddedBlipSize;
			}
			return 44;
		}
	}

	public class BlipDib : BlipBase
	{
		private const int dwordSize = 32;

		public override int SingleMD4Message => 1960;

		public override int DoubleMD4Message => 1961;

		protected internal override OfficeImageFormat Format => OfficeImageFormat.Png;

		public BlipDib(OfficeImage image)
			: base(image)
		{
		}

		public BlipDib(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
			: base(reader, header)
		{
		}

		protected override void Read(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			int num = CalcMD4MessageOffset(header.InstanceInfo);
			reader.BaseStream.Seek(16L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			base.TagValue = reader.ReadByte();
			if (header.InstanceInfo == DoubleMD4Message)
			{
				reader.BaseStream.Seek(16L, SeekOrigin.Current);
			}
			int count = header.Length - num;
			byte[] buffer = reader.ReadBytes(count);
			MemoryStream imageStream = new MemoryStream(buffer);
			LoadImageFromStream(imageStream);
		}

		protected override void LoadImageFromStream(MemoryStream imageStream)
		{
			BinaryReader reader = new BinaryReader(imageStream);
			DibHeader dibHeader = DibHeader.FromStream(reader);
			int num = dibHeader.BitCount * dibHeader.Width;
			if (num % 32 == 0)
			{
				num /= 8;
			}
			else
			{
				num /= 32;
				num++;
				num *= 4;
			}
			imageStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			base.Image = OfficeImage.CreateImage(DibHelper.CreateDib(imageStream, dibHeader.Width, dibHeader.Height, num));
		}

		public override int GetSize()
		{
			return 25 + base.ImageBytesLength;
		}

		public override OfficeArtRecordHeader CreateRecordHeader()
		{
			OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = new OfficeArtRecordHeader();
			officeArtRecordHeader.Version = 0;
			officeArtRecordHeader.InstanceInfo = 1760;
			officeArtRecordHeader.TypeCode = 61470;
			officeArtRecordHeader.Length = 17 + base.ImageBytesLength;
			return officeArtRecordHeader;
		}
	}

	public class DocMetafileHeader

		private const byte filterCode = 254;

		private int uncompressedSize;

		private int left;

		private int top;

		private int right;

		private int bottom;

		private int widthInEmus;

		private int heightInEmus;

		private int compressedSize;

		private bool compressed;

		public int UncompressedSize

			}
			protected internal set

				heightInEmus = value * 360;
			}
		}

		public int CompressedSize
		{
			get
			{
				return compressedSize;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				compressedSize = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Compressed
		{
			get
			{
				return compressed;
			}
			protected internal set

				compressed = value;
			}
		}

		public static DocMetafileHeader FromStream(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			DocMetafileHeader docMetafileHeader = new DocMetafileHeader();
			docMetafileHeader.Read(reader);
			return docMetafileHeader;
		}

		protected void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			uncompressedSize = reader.ReadInt32();
			left = reader.ReadInt32();
			top = reader.ReadInt32();
			right = reader.ReadInt32();
			bottom = reader.ReadInt32();
			widthInEmus = reader.ReadInt32();
			heightInEmus = reader.ReadInt32();
			compressedSize = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (reader.ReadByte() == 0)
			{
				compressed = true;
			}
			if (reader.ReadByte() != 254)
			{
				OfficeArtExceptions.ThrowInvalidContent();
			}
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(uncompressedSize);
			writer.Write(left);
			writer.Write(top);
			writer.Write(right);
			writer.Write(bottom);
			writer.Write(widthInEmus);
			writer.Write(heightInEmus);
			writer.Write(compressedSize);
			writer.Write((byte)((!compressed) ? 254 : 0));
			writer.Write((byte)254);
		}
	}

	public class DocMetafileReader
	{
		private const uint EmrHeaderType = 1u;

		private const uint WmgPlaceableHeaderKey = 2596720087u;

		private DocMetafileHeader metafileHeader;

		private OfficeImage image;

		public DocMetafileHeader MetafileHeader => metafileHeader;

		public OfficeImage Image => image;

		public void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			metafileHeader = DocMetafileHeader.FromStream(reader);
			if (!metafileHeader.Compressed)
			{
				byte[] buffer = reader.ReadBytes(metafileHeader.UncompressedSize);
				using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(buffer);
				image = OfficeImage.CreateImage(stream);
				return;
			}
			CheckCompressedData(reader);
			byte[] buffer2 = reader.ReadBytes(metafileHeader.CompressedSize - 2);
			using MemoryStream stream2 = new MemoryStream(buffer2);
			DeflateStream stream3 = new DeflateStream(stream2, CompressionMode.Decompress);
			buffer2 = new byte[metafileHeader.UncompressedSize];
			StreamHelper.FillBuffer(stream3, buffer2, 0, metafileHeader.UncompressedSize);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			memoryStream.Write(buffer2, 0, buffer2.Length);
			int pictureWidth;
			int pictureHeight;
			if (DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend == DXDrawingBackend.GdiPlus && (MetafileHeader.HeightInEmus != 0 || MetafileHeader.WidthInEmus != 0))
			{
				pictureWidth = MetafileHeader.WidthInHundredthsOfMillimeter;
				pictureHeight = MetafileHeader.HeightInHundredthsOfMillimeter;
			}
			else
			{
				pictureWidth = MetafileHeader.Right - MetafileHeader.Left;
				pictureHeight = MetafileHeader.Bottom - MetafileHeader.Top;
			}
			try
			{
				DXImage dXImage = MetafileHelper.CreateDXMetafile(memoryStream, Win32.MapMode.Anisotropic, pictureWidth, pictureHeight);
				image = OfficeImage.CreateImage(new MemoryStreamBasedImage(dXImage, memoryStream));
				if (image is OfficeMetafileImageWin officeMetafileImageWin)
				{
					Size metafileSizeInHundredthsOfMillimeter = new Size(MetafileHeader.WidthInHundredthsOfMillimeter, MetafileHeader.HeightInHundredthsOfMillimeter);
					officeMetafileImageWin.MetafileSizeInHundredthsOfMillimeter = metafileSizeInHundredthsOfMillimeter;
				}
			}
			catch (ArgumentException ex)
			{
				if (ex.Message == "Invalid metafile.")
				{
					image = null;
					if (AzureCompatibility.Enable && !HasEmrHeader(buffer2) && !HasWmfPlaceableHeader(buffer2))
					{
						MemoryStream memoryStream2 = new MemoryStream(buffer2.Length + 22);
						WriteWmfPlaceableHeader(memoryStream2, metafileHeader);
						memoryStream2.Write(buffer2, 0, buffer2.Length);
						memoryStream2.Position = 0L;
						image = OfficeImage.CreateImage(memoryStream2);
					}
					return;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private bool HasEmrHeader(byte[] buffer)
		{
			if (buffer == null && buffer.Length < 4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return BitConverter.ToUInt32(buffer, 0) == 1;
		}

		private bool HasWmfPlaceableHeader(byte[] buffer)
		{
			if (buffer == null && buffer.Length < 4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return BitConverter.ToUInt32(buffer, 0) == 2596720087u;
		}

		private void WriteWmfPlaceableHeader(MemoryStream ms, DocMetafileHeader metafileHeader)
		{
			using BinaryWriter binaryWriter = new BinaryWriter(ms, DXEncoding.Default, leaveOpen: true);
			binaryWriter.Write(2596720087u);
			binaryWriter.Write((short)0);
			binaryWriter.Write((short)metafileHeader.Left);
			binaryWriter.Write((short)metafileHeader.Top);
			binaryWriter.Write((short)metafileHeader.Right);
			binaryWriter.Write((short)metafileHeader.Bottom);
			binaryWriter.Write((short)1000);
			binaryWriter.Write(0);
			ushort num = 0;
			byte[] value = ms.ToArray();
			for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
			{
				ushort num2 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(value, i * 2);
				num ^= num2;
			}
			binaryWriter.Write(num);
		}

		private void CheckCompressedData(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			byte b = reader.ReadByte();
			byte b2 = (byte)(b & 0xF);
			b = reader.ReadByte();
			byte b3 = (byte)(b & 0x20);
			if (b2 != 8 || b3 != 0)
			{
				OfficeArtExceptions.ThrowInvalidContent();
			}
		}
	}
	public struct MD4MessageDigest
	{
		private uint[] digest;

		public const int Size = 16;

		internal MD4MessageDigest(uint[] digest)
		{
			this.digest = digest;
		}

		public byte[] ToArray()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[16];
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				Pack(array, i * 4, digest[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void Pack(byte[] destination, int offset, uint value)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				destination[offset + i] = (byte)((value >> 8 * i) & 0xFF);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CancellationHelper : IDisposable
	{
		private IOfficeServiceContainer serviceContainer;

		private ICancellationTokenProvider savedCancellationTokenProvider;

		public CancellationHelper(IOfficeServiceContainer serviceContainer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)serviceContainer, "serviceContainer");
			this.serviceContainer = serviceContainer;
			savedCancellationTokenProvider = this.serviceContainer.ReplaceService((ICancellationTokenProvider)new CancellationTokenProvider(cancellationToken));
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (serviceContainer != null)
			{
				serviceContainer.ReplaceService(savedCancellationTokenProvider);
			}
			serviceContainer = null;
		}
	}
	public class CancellationProvider
	{
		public const int DefaultCheckInterval = 1000;

		private readonly IOfficeServiceContainer serviceContainer;

		private int checkInterval;

		private int checkCount;

		public int CheckInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return checkInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				Guard.ArgumentPositive(value, "CheckInterval");
				checkInterval = value;
				checkCount = 0;
			}
		}

		public CancellationProvider(IOfficeServiceContainer serviceContainer)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)serviceContainer, "serviceContainer");
			this.serviceContainer = serviceContainer;
			checkInterval = 1000;
			checkCount = 0;
		}

		public void ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
		{
			checkCount++;
			if (checkCount >= checkInterval)
			{
				serviceContainer.GetService<ICancellationTokenProvider>()?.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				checkCount = 0;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChunkedList<T> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, ICollection
	{
		private class Chunk : List<T>
		{
			public int StartIndex { get; set; }

			public Chunk()
			{
				StartIndex = 0;
			}

			public Chunk(int capacity)
				: base(capacity)
			{
				StartIndex = 0;
			}

			public bool ContainsItemIndex(int itemIndex)
			{
				if (itemIndex >= StartIndex)
				{
					return itemIndex < StartIndex + base.Count;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class ChunkComparable : IComparable<Chunk>
		{
			private int index;

			public ChunkComparable(int index)
			{
				this.index = index;
			}

			public int CompareTo(Chunk other)
			{
				if (index < other.StartIndex)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (index >= other.StartIndex + other.Count)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private enum ChunkMergeType
		{
			None,
			Prev,
			Next
		}

		private const int minChunkSize = 64;

		private const int defaultChunkSize = 4096;

		private readonly List<Chunk> chunks = new List<Chunk>();

		private readonly int normalChunkSize;

		private readonly int doubleChunkSize;

		private readonly int halfChunkSize;

		private int totalItemCount;

		private int mruChunkIndex;

		public int Count => totalItemCount;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index >= 0 && index < totalItemCount)
				{
					Chunk chunk = GetChunk(index);
					if (chunk != null)
					{
						return chunk[index - chunk.StartIndex];
					}
				}
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			set
			{
				if (index >= 0 && index < totalItemCount)
				{
					Chunk chunk = GetChunk(index);
					if (chunk != null)
					{
						chunk[index - chunk.StartIndex] = value;
						return;
					}
				}
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}

		protected internal int ChunkCount => chunks.Count;

		int ICollection.Count => totalItemCount;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized
		{
			get
			{
				ICollection collection = chunks;
				return collection.IsSynchronized;
			}
		}

		object ICollection.SyncRoot
		{
			get
			{
				ICollection collection = chunks;
				return collection.SyncRoot;
			}
		}

		public ChunkedList()
			: this(4096)
		{
		}

		public ChunkedList(int chunkSize)
		{
			if (chunkSize < 64)
			{
				chunkSize = 64;
			}
			normalChunkSize = chunkSize;
			doubleChunkSize = normalChunkSize * 2;
			halfChunkSize = normalChunkSize / 2;
			Initialize();
		}

		public void Add(T value)
		{
			Chunk chunk = chunks[chunks.Count - 1];
			if (chunk.Count >= normalChunkSize)
			{
				chunk = new Chunk
				{
					StartIndex = totalItemCount
				};
				chunks.Add(chunk);
			}
			chunk.Add(value);
			totalItemCount++;
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<T> items)
		{
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			chunks.Clear();
			Initialize();
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			foreach (Chunk chunk in chunks)
			{
				if (chunk.Contains(item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			foreach (Chunk chunk in chunks)
			{
				chunk.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex + chunk.StartIndex);
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			foreach (Chunk chunk in chunks)
			{
				int num = chunk.IndexOf(item);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num + chunk.StartIndex;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > totalItemCount)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			if (index == totalItemCount)
			{
				Add(item);
				return;
			}
			int chunkIndex = GetChunkIndex(index);
			Chunk chunk = chunks[chunkIndex];
			chunk.Insert(index - chunk.StartIndex, item);
			for (int i = chunkIndex + 1; i < chunks.Count; i++)
			{
				chunks[i].StartIndex++;
			}
			totalItemCount++;
			if (chunk.Count >= doubleChunkSize)
			{
				SplitChunk(chunkIndex);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			int num = GetChunkIndex(index);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				Chunk chunk = chunks[num];
				chunk.RemoveAt(index - chunk.StartIndex);
				bool flag = false;
				if (chunk.Count == 0 && chunks.Count > 1)
				{
					chunks.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
					flag = true;
				}
				for (int i = num; i < chunks.Count; i++)
				{
					chunks[i].StartIndex--;
				}
				totalItemCount--;
				if (flag)
				{
					TryMergeChunk(num - 1);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			chunks.Add(new Chunk());
			totalItemCount = 0;
			mruChunkIndex = 0;
		}

		private int GetChunkIndex(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (mruChunkIndex >= 0 && mruChunkIndex < chunks.Count)
			{
				Chunk chunk = chunks[mruChunkIndex];
				if (chunk.ContainsItemIndex(itemIndex))
				{
					return mruChunkIndex;
				}
			}
			mruChunkIndex = Algorithms.BinarySearchReverseOrder<Chunk>((IList<Chunk>)chunks, (IComparable<Chunk>)new ChunkComparable(itemIndex));
			return mruChunkIndex;
		}

		private Chunk GetChunk(int itemIndex)
		{
			int chunkIndex = GetChunkIndex(itemIndex);
			if (chunkIndex >= 0)
			{
				return chunks[chunkIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SplitChunk(int chunkIndex)
		{
			Chunk chunk = chunks[chunkIndex];
			Chunk chunk2 = new Chunk(normalChunkSize);
			chunk2.StartIndex = chunk.StartIndex + normalChunkSize;
			for (int i = normalChunkSize; i < chunk.Count; i++)
			{
				chunk2.Add(chunk[i]);
			}
			chunk.RemoveRange(normalChunkSize, chunk.Count - normalChunkSize);
			chunk.TrimExcess();
			chunks.Insert(chunkIndex + 1, chunk2);
		}

		private void TryMergeChunk(int chunkIndex)
		{
			Chunk chunk = chunks[chunkIndex];
			int count = chunk.Count;
			if (count > halfChunkSize)
			{
				return;
			}
			Chunk chunk2 = ((chunkIndex == 0) ? null : chunks[chunkIndex - 1]);
			Chunk chunk3 = ((chunkIndex == chunks.Count - 1) ? null : chunks[chunkIndex + 1]);
			switch (CalcMergeType(count, chunk2, chunk3))
			{
			case ChunkMergeType.Next:
				chunk.AddRange(chunk3);
				chunks.RemoveAt(chunkIndex + 1);
				break;
			case ChunkMergeType.Prev:
				chunk2.AddRange(chunk);
				chunks.RemoveAt(chunkIndex);
				if (mruChunkIndex == chunkIndex)
				{
					mruChunkIndex--;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private ChunkMergeType CalcMergeType(int count, Chunk prevChunk, Chunk nextChunk)
		{
			if (prevChunk == null)
			{
				if (nextChunk != null && count + nextChunk.Count < doubleChunkSize)
				{
					return ChunkMergeType.Next;
				}
			}
			else if (nextChunk == null)
			{
				if (count + prevChunk.Count < doubleChunkSize)
				{
					return ChunkMergeType.Prev;
				}
			}
			else if (count + prevChunk.Count > count + nextChunk.Count)
			{
				if (count + nextChunk.Count < doubleChunkSize)
				{
					return ChunkMergeType.Next;
				}
			}
			else if (count + prevChunk.Count < doubleChunkSize)
			{
				return ChunkMergeType.Prev;
			}
			return ChunkMergeType.None;
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (Chunk chunk in chunks)
			{
				foreach (T item in chunk)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<T>)this).GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			foreach (Chunk chunk in chunks)
			{
				Array.Copy(chunk.ToArray(), 0, array, index + chunk.StartIndex, chunk.Count);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChunkedStringBuilder : IStringBuilder
	{
		public const int DefaultMaxBufferSize = 8192;

		private int maxBufferSize = 8192;

		private List<StringBuilder> buffers = new List<StringBuilder>();

		private int totalLength;

		protected internal int MaxBufferSize
		{
			get
			{
				return maxBufferSize;
			}
			set
			{
				maxBufferSize = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal List<StringBuilder> Buffers => buffers;

		public int Length => totalLength;

		public char this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				int index2 = index / MaxBufferSize;
				int index3 = index % MaxBufferSize;
				return buffers[index2][index3];
			}
			set
			{
				int index2 = index / MaxBufferSize;
				int index3 = index % MaxBufferSize;
				buffers[index2][index3] = value;
			}
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder()
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder(string value)
		{
			Initialize();
			Append(value);
		}

		protected internal void Initialize()
		{
			int count = buffers.Count;
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				buffers.Add(new StringBuilder());
			}
			else
			{
				if (count > 1)
				{
					buffers.RemoveRange(1, count - 1);
				}
				buffers[0].Length = 0;
			}
			totalLength = 0;
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return this;
			}
			return Append(value, 0, value.Length);
		}

		private ChunkedStringBuilder AppendCore(string value, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return this;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = buffers[buffers.Count - 1];
			int num = MaxBufferSize - stringBuilder.Length;
			if (num >= count)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value, startIndex, count);
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = startIndex;
				stringBuilder.Append(value, startIndex, num);
				num2 += num;
				int num4;
				for (int num3 = startIndex + count; num2 < num3; num2 += num4)
				{
					num4 = Math.Min(num3 - num2, MaxBufferSize);
					stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(MaxBufferSize);
					stringBuilder.Append(value, num2, num4);
					buffers.Add(stringBuilder);
				}
			}
			totalLength += count;
			return this;
		}

		private ChunkedStringBuilder AppendCore(char[] value, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return this;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = buffers[buffers.Count - 1];
			int num = MaxBufferSize - stringBuilder.Length;
			if (num >= count)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value, startIndex, count);
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = startIndex;
				stringBuilder.Append(value, startIndex, num);
				num2 += num;
				int num4;
				for (int num3 = startIndex + count; num2 < num3; num2 += num4)
				{
					num4 = Math.Min(num3 - num2, MaxBufferSize);
					stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(MaxBufferSize);
					stringBuilder.Append(value, num2, num4);
					buffers.Add(stringBuilder);
				}
			}
			totalLength += count;
			return this;
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(string value, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			return AppendCore(value, startIndex, count);
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(char[] value, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			return AppendCore(value, startIndex, count);
		}

		public IStringBuilder Append(char value)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = buffers[buffers.Count - 1];
			int num = MaxBufferSize - stringBuilder.Length;
			if (num >= 1)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(MaxBufferSize);
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
				buffers.Add(stringBuilder);
			}
			totalLength++;
			return this;
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(bool value)
		{
			return Append(value.ToString());
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(byte value)
		{
			return Append(value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(decimal value)
		{
			return Append(value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(double value)
		{
			return Append(value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(short value)
		{
			return Append(value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(int value)
		{
			return Append(value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(long value)
		{
			return Append(value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return Append(value.ToString());
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder Append(float value)
		{
			return Append(value.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder AppendLine()
		{
			return Append(Environment.NewLine);
		}

		public ChunkedStringBuilder AppendLine(string value)
		{
			Append(value);
			return Append(Environment.NewLine);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(Length);
			int count = buffers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(buffers[i].ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public string ToString(int startIndex, int length)
		{
			int num = startIndex / MaxBufferSize;
			int num2 = startIndex % MaxBufferSize;
			int num3 = (startIndex + length - 1) / MaxBufferSize;
			if (num == num3)
			{
				return buffers[num].ToString(num2, length);
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(length);
			stringBuilder.Append(buffers[num].ToString(num2, MaxBufferSize - num2));
			for (int i = num + 1; i < num3; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(buffers[i].ToString());
			}
			int num4 = startIndex + length;
			stringBuilder.Append(buffers[num3].ToString(0, num4 - num3 * MaxBufferSize));
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		public void AppendExistingBuffersUnsafe(ChunkedStringBuilder stringBuilder)
		{
			if (stringBuilder != null && stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				if (MaxBufferSize != stringBuilder.MaxBufferSize)
				{
					Exceptions.ThrowArgumentException("stringBuilder.MaxBufferSize", stringBuilder.MaxBufferSize);
				}
				Buffers.AddRange(stringBuilder.Buffers);
				totalLength += stringBuilder.totalLength;
				stringBuilder.Buffers.Clear();
				stringBuilder.Initialize();
			}
		}
	}
	public static class ChunkedStringBuilderExtensions
	{
		public static void Write(this Stream stream, ChunkedStringBuilder value, Encoding encoding)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[value.MaxBufferSize * 4];
			List<StringBuilder> buffers = value.Buffers;
			int count = buffers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				string text = buffers[i].ToString();
				int bytes = encoding.GetBytes(text, 0, text.Length, array, 0);
				stream.Write(array, 0, bytes);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChunkedStringBuilderWriter : TextWriter
	{
		private static readonly Encoding unicodeEncoding = new UnicodeEncoding(bigEndian: false, byteOrderMark: false);

		private readonly ChunkedStringBuilder stringBuilder;

		private Encoding encoding = unicodeEncoding;

		private bool isOpen = true;

		public override Encoding Encoding => encoding;

		public ChunkedStringBuilderWriter(ChunkedStringBuilder stringBuilder)
		{
			this.stringBuilder = stringBuilder;
		}

		public void SetEncoding(Encoding encoding)
		{
			this.encoding = encoding;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			isOpen = false;
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		public virtual ChunkedStringBuilder GetStringBuilder()
		{
			return stringBuilder;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override void Write(char value)
		{
			if (isOpen)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
			}
			else
			{
				ThrowWriterClosedException();
			}
		}

		public override void Write(string value)
		{
			if (isOpen)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
			}
			else
			{
				ThrowWriterClosedException();
			}
		}

		public override void Write(char[] buffer, int index, int count)
		{
			if (isOpen)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(buffer, index, count);
			}
			else
			{
				ThrowWriterClosedException();
			}
		}

		private void ThrowWriterClosedException()
		{
			Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException("writer is closed");
		}
	}
	public class ChunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter : ChunkedStringBuilderWriter
	{
		private int byteCount;

		private char[] singleChar = new char[1];

		public int ByteCount => byteCount;

		public ChunkedStringBuilderClipboardWriter(ChunkedStringBuilder stringBuilder)
			: base(stringBuilder)
		{
		}

		public override void Write(char value)
		{
			base.Write(value);
			singleChar[0] = value;
			byteCount += Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(singleChar);
		}

		public override void Write(string value)
		{
			base.Write(value);
			byteCount += Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(value);
		}

		public override void Write(char[] buffer, int index, int count)
		{
			base.Write(buffer, index, count);
			byteCount += Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(buffer, index, count);
		}
	}
	public static class DictionaryUtils
	{
		public static Dictionary<string, T> CreateBackTranslationTable<T>(Dictionary<T, string> table)
		{
			Dictionary<string, T> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, T>();
			foreach (T key in table.Keys)
			{
				dictionary.Add(table[key], key);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static Dictionary<string, T> CreateBackTranslationTable<T>(Dictionary<T, string> table, IEqualityComparer<string> comparer)
		{
			Dictionary<string, T> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, T>(comparer);
			foreach (T key in table.Keys)
			{
				dictionary.Add(table[key], key);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}
	}
	public static class HashCodeCalculator
	{
		public static int CalcHashCode32(IEnumerable enumerable)
		{
			CombinedHashCode combinedHashCode = new CombinedHashCode(5381L);
			IEnumerator enumerator = enumerable.GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator != null)
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current != null)
					{
						combinedHashCode.AddObject(current);
					}
				}
			}
			return combinedHashCode.CombinedHash32;
		}

		public static int CalcHashCode32(int h1, int h2)
		{
			return ((h1 << 5) + h1) ^ h2;
		}

		public static int CalcHashCode32(int h1, int h2, int h3)
		{
			return CalcHashCode32(CalcHashCode32(h1, h2), h3);
		}

		public static int CalcHashCode32(int h1, int h2, int h3, int h4)
		{
			return CalcHashCode32(CalcHashCode32(h1, h2), CalcHashCode32(h3, h4));
		}

		public static int CalcHashCode32(int h1, int h2, int h3, int h4, int h5)
		{
			return CalcHashCode32(CalcHashCode32(h1, h2, h3, h4), h5);
		}

		public static int CalcHashCode32(int h1, int h2, int h3, int h4, int h5, int h6)
		{
			return CalcHashCode32(CalcHashCode32(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5), h6);
		}

		public static int CalcHashCode32(int h1, int h2, int h3, int h4, int h5, int h6, int h7)
		{
			return CalcHashCode32(CalcHashCode32(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6), h7);
		}
	}
	public class OfficeArtSolverContainer : CompositeOfficeDrawingPartBase
	{
		public override int HeaderVersion => 15;

		public override int HeaderInstanceInfo => base.Items.Count;

		public override int HeaderTypeCode => 61445;

		public static OfficeArtSolverContainer FromStream(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			OfficeArtSolverContainer officeArtSolverContainer = new OfficeArtSolverContainer();
			officeArtSolverContainer.Read(reader, header);
			return officeArtSolverContainer;
		}

		protected internal void Read(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < header.InstanceInfo; i++)
			{
				OfficeArtRecordHeader header2 = OfficeArtRecordHeader.FromStream(reader);
				OfficeArtSolverContainerFileBlock officeArtSolverContainerFileBlock = ReadRule(reader, header2);
				if (officeArtSolverContainerFileBlock != null)
				{
					base.Items.Add(officeArtSolverContainerFileBlock);
				}
			}
		}

		private OfficeArtSolverContainerFileBlock ReadRule(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			OfficeArtSolverContainerFileBlock officeArtSolverContainerFileBlock = OfficeArtSolverContainerFileBlockFactory.CreateInstance(header.TypeCode);
			if (officeArtSolverContainerFileBlock == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			officeArtSolverContainerFileBlock.Read(reader);
			return officeArtSolverContainerFileBlock;
		}

		public OfficeArtFConnectionRule GetConnectionRule(int connectionShapeId)
		{
			foreach (OfficeDrawingPartBase item in base.Items)
			{
				if (item is OfficeArtFConnectionRule officeArtFConnectionRule && officeArtFConnectionRule.ConnectionShapeId == connectionShapeId)
				{
					return officeArtFConnectionRule;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldWrite()
		{
			return base.Items.Count > 0;
		}
	}
	internal static class OfficeArtSolverContainerFileBlockFactory
	{
		public static OfficeArtSolverContainerFileBlock CreateInstance(int typeCode)
		{
			return typeCode switch
			{
				61458 => new OfficeArtFConnectionRule(), 
				61460 => new OfficeArtFArcRule(), 
				61463 => new OfficeArtFCalloutRule(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}

		protected internal abstract void Read(BinaryReader reader);
