	internal static class PackedValues
	{
		public static bool GetBoolBitValue(uint packedValues, uint mask)
		{
			return (packedValues & mask) != 0;
		}

		public static void SetBoolBitValue(ref uint packedValues, uint mask, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				packedValues |= mask;
			}
			else
			{
				packedValues &= ~mask;
			}
		}

		public static void SetBoolBitValue(ref byte packedValues, byte mask, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				packedValues |= mask;
			}
			else
			{
				packedValues &= (byte)(~mask);
			}
		}

		public static int GetIntBitValue(uint packedValues, uint mask)
		{
			return (int)(packedValues & mask);
		}

		public static int GetIntBitValue(uint packedValues, uint mask, int offset)
		{
			return (int)((packedValues & mask) >> offset);
		}

		public static void SetIntBitValue(ref uint packedValues, uint mask, int value)
		{
			packedValues &= ~mask;
			packedValues |= (uint)value & mask;
		}

		public static void SetIntBitValue(ref uint packedValues, uint mask, int offset, int value)
		{
			packedValues &= ~mask;
			packedValues |= (uint)(value << offset) & mask;
		}

		public static void SetIntBitValue(ref byte packedValues, byte mask, byte offset, byte value)
		{
			packedValues &= (byte)(~mask);
			packedValues |= (byte)((value << (int)offset) & mask);
		}
	}
	public struct CombinedHashCode
	{
		public const long Initial = 5381L;

		private long combinedHash;

		public long CombinedHash => combinedHash;

		public int CombinedHash32 => combinedHash.GetHashCode();

		public CombinedHashCode(long initial)
		{
			combinedHash = initial;
		}

		public void AddInt(int n)
		{
			combinedHash = ((combinedHash << 5) + combinedHash) ^ n;
		}

		public void AddObject(object obj)
		{
			if (obj != null)
			{
				AddInt(obj.GetHashCode());
			}
		}

		public void AddByteArray(byte[] array)
		{
			int num = array.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				AddInt(array[i]);
			}
		}
	}
	public enum DXUnitType
	{
		Pixel = 1,
		Point,
		Pica,
		Inch,
		Mm,
		Cm,
		Percentage,
		Em,
		Ex,
		Deg,
		Fd,
		Emu
	}
	public class StringUnitValueParser
	{
		public DXUnit GetUnit(string inputValue)
		{
			return GetUnit(inputValue, -32768f, 32767f);
		}

		protected internal DXUnit GetUnit(string inputValue, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			ValueInfo valueInfo = StringValueParser.TryParse(inputValue);
			if (valueInfo.IsValidNumber)
			{
				return new DXUnit(valueInfo.Value, GetTypeFromString(valueInfo.Unit), minValue, maxValue);
			}
			new ArgumentException("UnitValue", inputValue);
			return new DXUnit();
		}

		protected internal DXRotationUnit GetRotationUnitType(string inputValue, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			ValueInfo valueInfo = StringValueParser.TryParse(inputValue);
			if (valueInfo.IsValidNumber)
			{
				return new DXRotationUnit(valueInfo.Value, GetRotationUnitTypeFromString(valueInfo.Unit), minValue, maxValue);
			}
			new ArgumentException("UnitValue", inputValue);
			return new DXRotationUnit();
		}

		protected internal DXVmlUnit GetVmlUnitType(string inputValue, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			ValueInfo valueInfo = StringValueParser.TryParse(inputValue);
			if (valueInfo.IsValidNumber)
			{
				return new DXVmlUnit(valueInfo.Value, GetVmlUnitTypeFromString(valueInfo.Unit), minValue, maxValue);
			}
			new ArgumentException("UnitValue", inputValue);
			return new DXVmlUnit();
		}

		private static DXUnitType GetTypeFromString(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return DXUnitType.Pixel;
			}
			string text = value.ToUpperInvariant();
			if (text.StartsWith("%"))
			{
				return DXUnitType.Percentage;
			}
			return text.Substring(0, 2) switch
			{
				"PX" => DXUnitType.Pixel, 
				"PT" => DXUnitType.Point, 
				"PC" => DXUnitType.Pica, 
				"IN" => DXUnitType.Inch, 
				"MM" => DXUnitType.Mm, 
				"CM" => DXUnitType.Cm, 
				"EM" => DXUnitType.Em, 
				"EX" => DXUnitType.Ex, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("UnitType", value), 
			};
		}

		private static DXUnitType GetRotationUnitTypeFromString(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return DXUnitType.Deg;
			}
			string text = value.ToUpperInvariant();
			if (text == "FD")
			{
				return DXUnitType.Fd;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("UnitType", value);
		}

		private static DXUnitType GetVmlUnitTypeFromString(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return DXUnitType.Emu;
			}
			return value.ToUpperInvariant() switch
			{
				"PX" => DXUnitType.Pixel, 
				"PT" => DXUnitType.Point, 
				"PC" => DXUnitType.Pica, 
				"IN" => DXUnitType.Inch, 
				"MM" => DXUnitType.Mm, 
				"CM" => DXUnitType.Cm, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("UnitType", value), 
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class DXUnitBase
	{
		private readonly float value;

		private readonly DXUnitType type;

		public float Value => value;

		public DXUnitType Type => type;

		protected DXUnitBase(float value, DXUnitType type)
		{
			this.value = ObtainValue(value, type);
			this.type = type;
		}

		protected DXUnitBase(float value, DXUnitType type, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			ValidateValueRange(value, minValue, maxValue);
			this.value = ObtainValue(value, type);
			this.type = type;
		}

		protected DXUnitBase(int value, DXUnitType type, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			ValidateValueRange(value, minValue, maxValue);
			this.value = value;
			this.type = type;
		}

		protected DXUnitBase(string value, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			DXUnitBase dXUnitBase = Parse(value, minValue, maxValue);
			this.value = dXUnitBase.value;
			type = dXUnitBase.type;
		}

		protected abstract DXUnitBase Parse(string value, float minValue, float maxValue);

		private float ObtainValue(float value, DXUnitType type)
		{
			if (type == DXUnitType.Pixel || type == DXUnitType.Emu)
			{
				value = (int)value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void ValidateValueRange(float value, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			if (value < minValue || value > maxValue)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value");
			}
		}
	}
	public class DXUnit : DXUnitBase
	{
		public DXUnit()
			: base(0f, DXUnitType.Pixel)
		{
		}

		public DXUnit(float value)
			: base(value, DXUnitType.Pixel, -32768f, 32767f)
		{
		}

		public DXUnit(int value)
			: this(value, -32768f, 32767f)
		{
		}

		public DXUnit(int value, float minValue, float maxValue)
			: base(value, DXUnitType.Pixel, minValue, maxValue)
		{
		}

		public DXUnit(float value, DXUnitType type)
			: this(value, type, -32768f, 32767f)
		{
		}

		public DXUnit(float value, DXUnitType type, float minValue, float maxValue)
			: base(value, type, minValue, maxValue)
		{
		}

		public DXUnit(string value)
			: base(value, -32768f, 32767f)
		{
		}

		public DXUnit(string value, float minValue, float maxValue)
			: base(value, minValue, maxValue)
		{
		}

		protected override DXUnitBase Parse(string value, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			StringUnitValueParser stringUnitValueParser = new StringUnitValueParser();
			return stringUnitValueParser.GetUnit(value, minValue, maxValue);
		}
	}
	public class DXRotationUnit : DXUnitBase
	{
		public DXRotationUnit()
			: base(0f, DXUnitType.Deg)
		{
		}

		public DXRotationUnit(string value)
			: base(value, -2.1474836E+09f, 2.1474836E+09f)
		{
		}

		public DXRotationUnit(float value, DXUnitType type, float minValue, float maxValue)
			: base(value, type, minValue, maxValue)
		{
		}

		protected override DXUnitBase Parse(string value, float minValue, float maxValue)

		}

	public class DXVmlUnit : DXUnitBase
	{
		public DXVmlUnit()
			: base(0f, DXUnitType.Emu)
		{
		}

		public DXVmlUnit(string value)
			: base(value, -2.1474836E+09f, 2.1474836E+09f)
		{
		}

		public DXVmlUnit(float value, DXUnitType type)
			: base(value, type, -2.1474836E+09f, 2.1474836E+09f)
		{
		}

		public DXVmlUnit(float value, DXUnitType type, float minValue, float maxValue)
			: base(value, type, minValue, maxValue)
		{
		}

		protected override DXUnitBase Parse(string value, float minValue, float maxValue)
		{
			StringUnitValueParser stringUnitValueParser = new StringUnitValueParser();
			return stringUnitValueParser.GetVmlUnitType(value, minValue, maxValue);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (base.Type == DXUnitType.Emu || base.Type == DXUnitType.Pixel)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append((int)base.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(base.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(GetSuffix());
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private string GetSuffix()
		{
			return base.Type switch
			{
				DXUnitType.Cm => "cm", 
				DXUnitType.Mm => "mm", 
				DXUnitType.Inch => "in", 
				DXUnitType.Point => "pt", 
				DXUnitType.Pica => "pc", 
				DXUnitType.Pixel => "px", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class EnumeratorAdapter<T, U> : IEnumerator<T>, IDisposable, IEnumerator where U : T
	{
		private IEnumerator<U> innerEnumerator;

		public T Current => (T)(object)innerEnumerator.Current;

		object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

		public EnumeratorAdapter(IEnumerator<U> enumerator)
		{
			innerEnumerator = enumerator;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			innerEnumerator.Dispose();
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			return innerEnumerator.MoveNext();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			innerEnumerator.Reset();
		}
	}

	public class GraphicsToLayoutUnitsModifier : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly Graphics graphics;

		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter;

		private GraphicsUnit oldUnit;

		private float oldScale;

		private HdcDpiModifier hdcDpiModifier;

		private Matrix oldMatrix;

		public GraphicsToLayoutUnitsModifier(Graphics graphics, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter unitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)graphics, "graphics");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)unitConverter, "unitConverter");
			this.graphics = graphics;
			this.unitConverter = unitConverter;
			Apply();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Restore();
		}

		protected void Apply()
		{
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Expected O, but got Unknown
			oldUnit = graphics.PageUnit;
			oldScale = graphics.PageScale;
			oldMatrix = graphics.Transform;
			graphics.PageUnit = (GraphicsUnit)unitConverter.GraphicsPageUnit;
			graphics.PageScale = unitConverter.GraphicsPageScale;
			graphics.ResetTransform();
			if (SecurityHelper.IsUnmanagedCodeGrantedAndCanUseGetHdc)
			{
				hdcDpiModifier = new HdcDpiModifier(graphics, new Size(4096, 4096), (int)Math.Round(unitConverter.Dpi));
			}
		}

		protected void Restore()
		{
			try
			{
				if (hdcDpiModifier != null && SecurityHelper.IsUnmanagedCodeGrantedAndCanUseGetHdc)
				{
					hdcDpiModifier.Dispose();
				}
				graphics.PageUnit = oldUnit;
				graphics.PageScale = oldScale;
				graphics.ResetTransform();
				graphics.Transform = oldMatrix;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
	}

	public class List<T, U> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection where U : struct, IConvertToInt<U>
	{
		private static readonly U indexConverter;

		private readonly List<T> innerList;

		public List<T> InnerList => innerList;

		public int Capacity
		{
			get
			{
				return InnerList.Capacity;
			}
			set
			{
				InnerList.Capacity = value;
			}
		}

		public int Count => InnerList.Count;

		public T this[U index]
		{
			get
			{

	public static class OfficeAlgorithms
	{
		public static U BinarySearch<T, U>(List<T, U> list, IComparable<T> predicate) where U : struct, IConvertToInt<U>
		{
			U val = default(U);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num >> 1);
				int num4 = predicate.CompareTo(list.InnerList[num3]);
				if (num4 == 0)
				{
					return ((IConvertToInt<U>)val/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).FromInt(num3);
				}
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return ((IConvertToInt<U>)val/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).FromInt(~num);
		}
	}
	public static class ObjectRotationAngleCalculator
	{
		public static float CalculateAngle(PointF point, Rectangle objectBounds, float initialRotationAngle)
		{
			return CalculateAngle(point, objectBounds, initialRotationAngle, null);
		}

		public static float CalculateAngle(PointF point, Rectangle objectBounds, float initialRotationAngle, DXMatrix transformMatrix)
		{
			if (transformMatrix != null)
			{
				point = transformMatrix.TransformPoint(point);
			}
			Point point2 = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(objectBounds);
			point.X -= point2.X;
			point.Y -= point2.Y;
			if (point.X == 0f && point.Y == 0f)
			{
				return initialRotationAngle;
			}
			float num = (float)(180.0 * Math.Atan(point.X / point.Y) / Math.PI);
			if (point.Y > 0f)
			{
				num += 180f;
			}
			if (Math.Abs(num) == 90f)
			{
				num = 0f - num;
			}
			return SnapAngle(initialRotationAngle - num);
		}

		private static float SnapAngle(float angle)
		{
			if (KeyboardHandler.IsShiftPressed)
			{
				return SnapAngle(angle, 15, 7.5f);
			}
			return SnapAngle(angle, 90, 3f);
		}

		private static float SnapAngle(float angle, int step, float delta)
		{
			angle = NormalizeAngle(angle);
			for (int i = 0; i <= 360; i += step)
			{
				angle = CalculateSnap(angle, i, delta);
			}
			return NormalizeAngle(angle);
		}

		private static float NormalizeAngle(float angle)
		{
			angle %= 360f;
			if (angle < 0f)
			{
				angle += 360f;
			}
			return angle;
		}

		private static float CalculateSnap(float angle, float baseAngle, float delta)
		{
			if (baseAngle - delta <= angle && angle < baseAngle + delta)
			{
				return baseAngle;
			}
			return angle;
		}
	}

	public abstract class OfficeDrawingPartBase
	{
		public abstract int HeaderVersion { get; }

		public abstract int HeaderInstanceInfo { get; }

		public abstract int HeaderTypeCode { get; }

		public virtual int Length => GetSize();

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			if (ShouldWrite())
			{
				WriteHeader(writer);
				WriteCore(writer);
			}
		}

		protected internal void WriteHeader(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = new OfficeArtRecordHeader();
			officeArtRecordHeader.InstanceInfo = HeaderInstanceInfo;
			officeArtRecordHeader.Length = Length;
			officeArtRecordHeader.TypeCode = HeaderTypeCode;
			officeArtRecordHeader.Version = HeaderVersion;
			officeArtRecordHeader.Write(writer);
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteCore(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldWrite()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal abstract int GetSize();
	}
	public abstract class CompositeOfficeDrawingPartBase : OfficeDrawingPartBase
	{
		private readonly List<OfficeDrawingPartBase> items;

		public List<OfficeDrawingPartBase> Items => items;

		protected CompositeOfficeDrawingPartBase()
		{
			items = new List<OfficeDrawingPartBase>();
		}

		protected internal override void WriteCore(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			int count = Items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Items[i].Write(writer);
			}
		}

		protected internal override int GetSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int count = Items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (Items[i].ShouldWrite())
				{
					num += 8;
					num += Items[i].GetSize();
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class OfficeArtRecordHeader
	{
		public const int Size = 8;

		private int version;

		private int instanceInfo;

		private int typeCode;

		private int length;

		public int Version
		{
			get
			{
				return version;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				version = value;
			}
		}

		public int InstanceInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return instanceInfo;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				instanceInfo = value;
			}
		}

		public int TypeCode
		{
			get
			{
				return typeCode;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				typeCode = value;
			}
		}

		public int Length
		{
			get
			{
				return length;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				length = value;
			}
		}

		public static OfficeArtRecordHeader FromStream(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = new OfficeArtRecordHeader();
			officeArtRecordHeader.Read(reader);
			return officeArtRecordHeader;
		}

		protected internal void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			ushort num = reader.ReadUInt16();
			version = num & 0xF;
			instanceInfo = (num & 0xFFF0) >> 4;
			typeCode = reader.ReadUInt16();
			length = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			ushort value = (ushort)(version | (instanceInfo << 4));
			writer.Write(value);
			writer.Write((ushort)typeCode);
			writer.Write(length);
		}
	}
	public class OfficeArtDrawingContainer : CompositeOfficeDrawingPartBase
	{
		private OfficeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord fileDrawingBlock;

		private OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer blipContainer;

		private OfficeArtSplitMenuColorContainer splitMenuColorContainer;

		public override int HeaderInstanceInfo => 0;

		public override int HeaderTypeCode => 61440;

		public override int HeaderVersion => 15;

		public OfficeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord FileDrawingBlock => fileDrawingBlock;

		public OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer BlipContainer => blipContainer;

		public OfficeArtSplitMenuColorContainer SplitMenuColorContainer => splitMenuColorContainer;

		public static OfficeArtDrawingContainer FromStream(BinaryReader reader, BinaryReader embeddedReader)
		{
			OfficeArtDrawingContainer officeArtDrawingContainer = new OfficeArtDrawingContainer();
			officeArtDrawingContainer.Read(reader, embeddedReader);
			return officeArtDrawingContainer;
		}

		public OfficeArtDrawingContainer()
		{
			fileDrawingBlock = new OfficeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord();
			blipContainer = new OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer();
			splitMenuColorContainer = new OfficeArtSplitMenuColorContainer();
			base.Items.Add(fileDrawingBlock);
			base.Items.Add(blipContainer);
			base.Items.Add(splitMenuColorContainer);
		}

		protected internal void Read(BinaryReader reader, BinaryReader embeddedReader)
		{
			OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = OfficeArtRecordHeader.FromStream(reader);
			CheckHeader(officeArtRecordHeader);
			long num = reader.BaseStream.Position + officeArtRecordHeader.Length;
			while (reader.BaseStream.Position < num)
			{
				ParseHeader(reader, embeddedReader);
			}
		}

		private void CheckHeader(OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			if (header.Version != 15 || header.InstanceInfo != 0 || header.TypeCode != 61440)
			{
				OfficeArtExceptions.ThrowInvalidContent();
			}
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer, BinaryWriter embeddedWriter)
		{
			WriteHeader(writer);
			FileDrawingBlock.Write(writer);
			BlipContainer.Write(writer, embeddedWriter);
			SplitMenuColorContainer.Write(writer);
		}

		private void ParseHeader(BinaryReader reader, BinaryReader embeddedReader)
		{
			OfficeArtRecordHeader officeArtRecordHeader = OfficeArtRecordHeader.FromStream(reader);
			if (officeArtRecordHeader.TypeCode == 61446)
			{
				fileDrawingBlock = OfficeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord.FromStream(reader, officeArtRecordHeader);
			}
			else if (officeArtRecordHeader.TypeCode == 61441)
			{
				blipContainer = OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer.FromStream(reader, embeddedReader, officeArtRecordHeader);
			}
			else if (officeArtRecordHeader.TypeCode == 61726)
			{
				splitMenuColorContainer = OfficeArtSplitMenuColorContainer.FromStream(reader, officeArtRecordHeader);
			}
			else
			{
				reader.BaseStream.Seek(officeArtRecordHeader.Length, SeekOrigin.Current);
			}
		}
	}
	public class OfficeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord : OfficeDrawingPartBase
	{
		private const int mainDocumentClusterId = 1;

		private const int headerClusterId = 2;

		private const int headerVersion = 0;

		private const int headerInstanceInfo = 0;

		private const int headerTypeCode = 61446;

		private const int currentMaximumShapeID = 67098623;

		private const int idClusterSize = 8;

		private const int basePartSize = 16;

		private int mainDocumentPicturesCount;

		private int headerPicturesCount;

		public override int HeaderInstanceInfo => 0;

		public override int HeaderTypeCode => 61446;

		public override int HeaderVersion => 0;

		public int MainDocumentFloatingObjectsCount
		{
			get
			{
				return mainDocumentPicturesCount;
			}
			set
			{
				mainDocumentPicturesCount = value;
			}
		}

		public int HeaderFloatingObjectsCount
		{
			get
			{
				return headerPicturesCount;
			}
			set
			{
				headerPicturesCount = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasPicturesInHeader => HeaderFloatingObjectsCount > 0;

		public static OfficeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord FromStream(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			OfficeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord officeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord = new OfficeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord();
			officeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord.Read(reader, header);
			return officeArtFileDrawingGroupRecord;
		}

		protected internal void Read(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (num >= 67098623)
			{
				OfficeArtExceptions.ThrowInvalidContent();
			}
			int num2 = reader.ReadInt32() - 1;
			if (header.Length != num2 * 8 + 16)
			{
				OfficeArtExceptions.ThrowInvalidContent();
			}
			reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.BaseStream.Seek(num2 * 8, SeekOrigin.Current);
		}

		protected internal override void WriteCore(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(CalcMaxShapeIdentifier());
			writer.Write(CalcClustersCount() + 1);
			writer.Write(CalcShapesCount());
			writer.Write(CalcDrawingsCount());
			WriteClustersInfo(writer);
		}

		private void WriteClustersInfo(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(1);
			writer.Write(MainDocumentFloatingObjectsCount + 2);
			if (HasPicturesInHeader)
			{
				writer.Write(2);
				writer.Write(HeaderFloatingObjectsCount + 1);
			}
		}

		private int CalcMaxShapeIdentifier()
		{
			if (!HasPicturesInHeader)
			{
				return 1025 + MainDocumentFloatingObjectsCount + 1;
			}
			return 2048 + HeaderFloatingObjectsCount + 1;
		}

		private int CalcClustersCount()
		{
			if (!HasPicturesInHeader)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 2;
		}

		private int CalcShapesCount()
		{
			int num = MainDocumentFloatingObjectsCount + 1;
			if (HeaderFloatingObjectsCount > 0)
			{
				num += HeaderFloatingObjectsCount + 1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CalcDrawingsCount()
		{
			if (!HasPicturesInHeader)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 2;
		}

		protected internal override int GetSize()
		{
			return CalcClustersCount() * 8 + 16;
		}
	}
	public class OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer : OfficeDrawingPartBase
	{
		private List<BlipBase> blips;

		public override int HeaderInstanceInfo => Blips.Count;

		public override int HeaderTypeCode => 61441;

		public override int HeaderVersion => 15;

		public List<BlipBase> Blips => blips;

		public static OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer FromStream(BinaryReader reader, BinaryReader embeddedReader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer officeArtBlipStoreContainer = new OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer();
			officeArtBlipStoreContainer.Read(reader, embeddedReader, header);
			return officeArtBlipStoreContainer;
		}

		public OfficeArtBlipStoreContainer()
		{
			blips = new List<BlipBase>();
		}

		protected internal void Read(BinaryReader reader, BinaryReader embeddedReader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			long endPosition = reader.BaseStream.Position + header.Length;
			blips = BlipFactory.ReadAllBlips(reader, embeddedReader, endPosition);
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer, BinaryWriter embeddedWriter)
		{
			if (ShouldWrite())
			{
				WriteHeader(writer);
				WriteCore(writer, embeddedWriter);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void WriteCore(BinaryWriter writer, BinaryWriter embeddedWriter)
		{
			int count = Blips.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (Blips[i] is FileBlipStoreEntry fileBlipStoreEntry)
				{
					fileBlipStoreEntry.Write(writer, embeddedWriter);
				}
				else
				{
					Blips[i].Write(writer);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldWrite()
		{
			return Blips.Count > 0;
		}

		protected internal override int GetSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int count = Blips.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num += Blips[i].GetSize();
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

	public class OfficeColorRecord
	{
		private const uint maskDefault = 4278190080u;

		private const uint maskColorScheme = 134217728u;

		private const uint maskSystemColor = 268435456u;

		private const uint maskSchemeIndex = 255u;

		private const uint maskSystemIndex = 65535u;

		private const uint maskColorUse = 255u;

		private const uint maskTransform = 65280u;

		private const uint maskTransformValue = 16711680u;

		private uint data;

		public bool IsDefault => (data & 0xFF000000u) == 4278190080u;

		public bool SystemColorUsed
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsDefault)
				{
					return (data & 0x10000000) == 268435456;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool ColorSchemeUsed
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsDefault)
				{
					return (data & 0x8000000) == 134217728;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return DXColor.FromArgb((int)(data & 0xFF), (int)(data & 0xFF00) >> 8, (int)(data & 0xFF0000) >> 16);
			}
			set
			{
				data = (uint)(value.R | (value.G << 8) | (value.B << 16));
			}
		}

		public byte ColorSchemeIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (byte)(data & 0xFF);
			}
			set
			{
				data = (uint)(0x8000000 | value);
			}
		}

		public int SystemColorIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)(data & 0xFFFF);
			}
			set
			{
				data = (uint)(0x10000000 | ((ulong)value & 0xFFFFuL));
			}
		}

		public OfficeColorUse ColorUse
		{
			get
			{
				if (!SystemColorUsed)
				{
					return OfficeColorUse.None;
				}
				uint num = data & 0xFF;
				if (num < 240)
				{
					return OfficeColorUse.None;
				}
				return (OfficeColorUse)num;
			}
		}

		public OfficeColorTransform Transform
		{
			get
			{
				if (!SystemColorUsed)
				{
					return OfficeColorTransform.None;
				}
				return (OfficeColorTransform)(data & 0xFF00);
			}
		}

		public byte TransformValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!SystemColorUsed)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return (byte)((data & 0xFF0000) >> 16);
			}
		}

		public static OfficeColorRecord FromStream(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			OfficeColorRecord officeColorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord();
			officeColorRecord.Read(reader);
			return officeColorRecord;
		}

		public static OfficeColorRecord FromBytes(byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			OfficeColorRecord officeColorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord();
			officeColorRecord.ReadBytes(data, offset);
			return officeColorRecord;
		}

		public OfficeColorRecord()
		{
			data = uint.MaxValue;
		}

		public OfficeColorRecord(Color color)
		{
			Color = color;
		}

		public OfficeColorRecord(int colorIndex)
		{
			ColorSchemeIndex = (byte)colorIndex;
		}

		public OfficeColorRecord(OfficeColorUse colorUse, OfficeColorTransform transform, byte transformValue)
		{
			if (colorUse == OfficeColorUse.None)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("colorUse");
			}
			if (transform == OfficeColorTransform.None)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("transform");
			}
			data = (uint)(0x10000000 | (transformValue << 16) | ((int)transform << 8)) | (uint)colorUse;
		}

		protected internal void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			data = reader.ReadUInt32();
		}

		private void ReadBytes(byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			this.data = BitConverter.ToUInt32(data, offset);
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(data);
		}

		public byte[] GetBytes()
		{
			return BitConverter.GetBytes(data);
		}
	}

	public abstract class OfficeArtPropertiesBase : OfficeDrawingPartBase
	{
		private readonly List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> properties;

		public List<IOfficeDrawingProperty> Properties => properties;

		public override int HeaderInstanceInfo => Properties.Count;

		public override int HeaderVersion => 3;

		protected OfficeArtPropertiesBase()
		{
			properties = new List<IOfficeDrawingProperty>();
		}

		protected internal void Read(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			long position = reader.BaseStream.Position;
			int instanceInfo = header.InstanceInfo;
			for (int i = 0; i < instanceInfo; i++)
			{
				Properties.Add(OfficePropertiesFactory.CreateProperty(reader));
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < instanceInfo; j++)
			{
				IOfficeDrawingProperty officeDrawingProperty = Properties[j];
				if (officeDrawingProperty.Complex)
				{
					if (officeDrawingProperty is OfficeDrawingIntPropertyBase officeDrawingIntPropertyBase)
					{
						officeDrawingIntPropertyBase.SetComplexData(reader.ReadBytes(officeDrawingIntPropertyBase.Value));
					}
					else if (officeDrawingProperty is OfficeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase officeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase)
					{
						if (officeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase.Value > 6)
						{
							byte[] array = reader.ReadBytes(6);
							if (BitConverter.ToUInt16(array, 4) == 65520)
							{
								officeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase.Value += 6;
							}
							byte[] array2 = reader.ReadBytes(officeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase.Value - 6);
							byte[] array3 = new byte[officeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase.Value];
							Array.Copy(array, array3, 6);
							Array.Copy(array2, 0, array3, 6, array2.Length);
							officeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase.SetComplexData(array3);
						}
						else
						{
							officeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase.SetComplexData(reader.ReadBytes(officeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase.Value));
						}
					}
				}
				officeDrawingProperty.Execute(this);
			}
			reader.BaseStream.Seek(position + header.Length, SeekOrigin.Begin);
		}

		protected internal override void WriteCore(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			Properties.Sort(new OfficeDrawingPropertiesComparer());
			List<byte[]> list = new List<byte[]>();
			int count = Properties.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				IOfficeDrawingProperty officeDrawingProperty = Properties[i];
				if (officeDrawingProperty.Complex)
				{
					list.Add(officeDrawingProperty.ComplexData);
				}
				officeDrawingProperty.Write(writer);
			}
			count = list.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				writer.Write(list[j]);
			}
		}

		protected internal override int GetSize()
		{
			int count = properties.Count;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num += properties[i].Size;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal virtual void HandleGroupShapeBooleanProperties(DrawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties properties)
		{
		}

		public abstract void CreateProperties();
	}

		public bool UsePosV { get; set; }

		public bool IsCanvas { get; set; }

		public bool Filled { get; set; }

		public bool UseFilled { get; set; }

		public bool LayoutInCell { get; set; }

		public bool UseLayoutInCell { get; set; }

		public int PctHoriz { get; set; }

		public int PctVert { get; set; }

		public int PctHorizPos { get; set; }

		public int PctVertPos { get; set; }

		public bool PseudoInline { get; set; }

		public bool HorizRule { get; set; }

		public bool UseHorizRule { get; set; }

		public int AlignHR { get; set; }

		public int PctHR { get; set; }

		public int DxHeightHR { get; set; }

		public int DxWidthHR { get; set; }

		public bool StandardHR { get; set; }

		public bool UseStandardHR { get; set; }

		public bool NoShadeHR { get; set; }

		public bool UseNoShadeHR { get; set; }

		public DrawingGroupShape2SizeRelH.RelativeFrom SizeRelH { get; set; }

		public DrawingGroupShape2SizeRelV.RelativeFrom SizeRelV { get; set; }

		public DrawingGroupShapePosH.Msoph PosH { get; set; }

		public DrawingGroupShapePosV.Msopv PosV { get; set; }

		public DrawingGroupShapePosRelH.Msoprh PosRelH { get; set; }

		public DrawingGroupShapePosRelV.Msoprv PosRelV { get; set; }

		public bool PctHorizPosValid => PctHorizPos != -10001;

		public bool PctVertPosValid => PctVertPos != -10001;

		public static OfficeArtTertiaryProperties FromStream(BinaryReader reader, OfficeArtRecordHeader header)
		{
			OfficeArtTertiaryProperties officeArtTertiaryProperties = new OfficeArtTertiaryProperties();
			officeArtTertiaryProperties.Read(reader, header);
			return officeArtTertiaryProperties;
		}

		public OfficeArtTertiaryProperties()
		{
			PosRelH = DrawingGroupShapePosRelH.Msoprh.msoprhText;
			PosRelV = DrawingGroupShapePosRelV.Msoprv.msoprvText;
		}

		public OfficeArtTertiaryProperties(bool writeAlways)
			: this()
		{
			this.writeAlways = writeAlways;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldWrite()
		{
			if (!writeAlways)
			{
				return base.Properties.Count > 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void CreateProperties()
		{
			SetGroupShapePosHProperties();
			SetGroupShapePosRelHProperties();
			SetGroupShapePosVProperties();
			SetGroupShapePosRelVProperties();
			SetGroupShape2PctHorizProperties();
			SetGroupShape2PctVertProperties();
			SetGroupShape2SizeRelHProperties();
			SetGroupShape2SizeRelVProperties();
			SetGroupShapePctPosProperties();
			SetGroupShapeBooleanProperties();
			SetHRProperties();
			SetDiagramBooleanProperties();
			SetDiagramTypeBooleanProperties();
		}

		protected internal override void HandleGroupShapeBooleanProperties(DrawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties properties)
		{
			base.HandleGroupShapeBooleanProperties(properties);
			HorizRule = properties.HorizRule;
			UseHorizRule = properties.UseHorizRule;
			StandardHR = properties.StandardHR;
			UseStandardHR = properties.UseStandardHR;
			NoShadeHR = properties.NoShadeHR;
			UseNoShadeHR = properties.UseNoShadeHR;
		}

		private void SetGroupShapePctPosProperties()
		{
			if (PctHorizPos != 0 || PctVertPos != 0)
			{
				if (PctHorizPos != 0)
				{
					base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShape2PctHorizPos(PctHorizPos));
				}
				else
				{
					base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShape2PctHorizPos());
				}
				if (PctVertPos != 0)
				{
					base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShape2PctVertPos(PctVertPos));
				}
				else
				{
					base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShape2PctVertPos());
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupShape2PctHorizProperties()
		{
			if (UseRelativeWidth)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShape2PctHoriz(PctHoriz));
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupShape2PctVertProperties()
		{
			if (UseRelativeHeight)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShape2PctVert(PctVert));
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupShape2SizeRelHProperties()
		{
			if (UseRelativeWidth)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShape2SizeRelH(SizeRelH));
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupShape2SizeRelVProperties()
		{
			if (UseRelativeHeight)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShape2SizeRelV(SizeRelV));
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupShapeBooleanProperties()
		{
			DrawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties = new DrawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties();
			drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties.Value = 0;
			drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties.HorizRule = HorizRule;
			drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties.UseHorizRule = UseHorizRule;
			drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties.StandardHR = StandardHR;
			drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties.UseStandardHR = UseStandardHR;
			drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties.NoShadeHR = NoShadeHR;
			drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties.UseNoShadeHR = UseNoShadeHR;
			base.Properties.Add(drawingGroupShapeBooleanProperties);
		}

		private void SetHRProperties()
		{
			if (UseHorizRule && HorizRule)
			{
				SetAlignHRProperties();
				SetPctHRProperties();
				SetDxHeightHRProperties();
				SetDxWidthHRProperties();
			}
		}

		private void SetAlignHRProperties()
		{
			base.Properties.Add(new DrawingAlignHR(AlignHR));
		}

		private void SetPctHRProperties()
		{
			base.Properties.Add(new DrawingPctHR(PctHR));
		}

		private void SetDxHeightHRProperties()
		{
			base.Properties.Add(new DrawingDxHeightHR(DxHeightHR));
		}

		private void SetDxWidthHRProperties()
		{
			base.Properties.Add(new DrawingDxWidthHR(DxWidthHR));
		}

		private void SetGroupShapePosHProperties()
		{
			if (UsePosH)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShapePosH(PosH));
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupShapePosRelHProperties()
		{
			if (UsePosH)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShapePosRelH(PosRelH));
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupShapePosVProperties()
		{
			if (UsePosV)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShapePosV(PosV));
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupShapePosRelVProperties()
		{
			if (UsePosV)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DrawingGroupShapePosRelV(PosRelV));
			}
		}

		private void SetDiagramBooleanProperties()
		{
			base.Properties.Add(new DiagramBooleanProperties
			{
				PseudoInline = PseudoInline
			});
		}

		private void SetDiagramTypeBooleanProperties()
		{
			if (IsCanvas)
			{
				base.Properties.Add(new DiagramTypeBooleanProperties
				{
					IsCanvas = true
				});
			}
		}
	}

	public class OfficeDrawingPropertiesComparer : IComparer<IOfficeDrawingProperty>
	{
		public int Compare(IOfficeDrawingProperty x, IOfficeDrawingProperty y)
		{
			return x.Id.CompareTo(y.Id);
		}
	}

			infos.Add(new OfficeDrawingPropertyInfo(-16186, typeof(DrawingGeometryTextCSSFont)));
			infos.Add(new OfficeDrawingPropertyInfo(255, typeof(DrawingGeometryTextBooleanProperties)));
			int count = infos.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				propertyTypes.Add(infos[i].Identifier, BlipFactory.GetConstructor(infos[i].Type, new Type[0]));
				propertyIdentifiers.Add(infos[i].Type, infos[i].Identifier);
			}

		public static IOfficeDrawingProperty CreateProperty(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			ushort num = reader.ReadUInt16();
			short num2 = (short)num;
			if (!propertyTypes.TryGetValue(num2, out var value) && !propertyTypes.TryGetValue((short)(num2 | 0x4000), out value))
			{
				value = Empty;
			}
			OfficeDrawingPropertyBase officeDrawingPropertyBase = value.Invoke(new object[0]) as OfficeDrawingPropertyBase;
			bool complex = (num & 0x8000) != 0;
			officeDrawingPropertyBase.SetComplex(complex);
			officeDrawingPropertyBase.Read(reader);
			return officeDrawingPropertyBase;
		}

		public static short GetOpcodeByType(Type propertyType)
		{
			if (!propertyIdentifiers.TryGetValue(propertyType, out var value))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return value;
		}

	public abstract class OfficeDrawingPropertyBase : IOfficeDrawingProperty
	{
		private const int operationCodeSize = 2;

		private const int operandSize = 4;

		private bool complex;

		private byte[] complexData;

		private short id;

		public short Id => id;

		public virtual bool Complex => complex;

		public byte[] ComplexData => complexData;

		public int Size
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Complex)
				{
					return 6;
				}
				return 6 + ComplexData.Length;
			}
		}

		protected OfficeDrawingPropertyBase()
		{
			SetIdentifier();
			complexData = new byte[0];
		}

		public abstract void Read(BinaryReader reader);

		public abstract void Execute(OfficeArtPropertiesBase owner);

		public abstract void Write(BinaryWriter writer);

		public virtual void Merge(IOfficeDrawingProperty other)
		{
		}

		private void SetIdentifier()
		{
			short opcodeByType = OfficePropertiesFactory.GetOpcodeByType(GetType());
			id = (short)((ushort)opcodeByType & 0x3FFF);
		}

		protected internal void SetComplexData(byte[] data)
		{
			complexData = data;
		}

		protected internal void SetComplex(bool complex)
		{
			this.complex = complex;
		}
	}
	public interface IOfficeDrawingIntPropertyBase
	{
		int Value { get; set; }
	}
	public abstract class OfficeDrawingIntPropertyBase : OfficeDrawingPropertyBase
	{
		private int value;

		public int Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
			}
		}

		public override void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			value = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		public override void Execute(OfficeArtPropertiesBase owner)
		{
		}

		public override void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(OfficePropertiesFactory.GetOpcodeByType(GetType()));
			writer.Write(Value);
		}

		protected bool GetFlag(int mask)
		{
			return (Value & mask) == mask;
		}

		protected void SetFlag(int mask, bool flag)
		{
			if (flag)
			{
				Value |= mask;
			}
			else
			{
				Value &= ~mask;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class OfficeDrawingStringPropertyValueBase : OfficeDrawingIntPropertyBase
	{
		private string data;

		public override bool Complex => true;

		public string Data
		{
			get
			{
				return GetStringData();
			}
			set
			{
				SetStringData(value);
			}
		}

		private string GetStringData()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(data))
			{
				data = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(base.ComplexData, 0, base.ComplexData.Length);
			}
			return data;
		}

		private void SetStringData(string value)
		{
			if (!(data == value))
			{
				data = value;
				SetComplexData(Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(value));
				base.Value = base.ComplexData.Length;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class OfficeDrawingTerminatedStringPropertyValueBase : OfficeDrawingStringPropertyValueBase
	{
		public string TrimmedData => base.Data.TrimEnd(default(char));
	}
	public class OfficeDrawingFixedPointPropertyBase : OfficeDrawingPropertyBase
	{
		private double value;

		public double Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;

	public abstract class OfficeDrawingBooleanPropertyBase : OfficeDrawingIntPropertyBase
	{
		private const uint useMask = 4294901760u;

		public override void Merge(IOfficeDrawingProperty other)
		{
			if (other is OfficeDrawingBooleanPropertyBase officeDrawingBooleanPropertyBase)
			{
				uint num = (uint)officeDrawingBooleanPropertyBase.Value;
				uint num2 = (uint)base.Value;
				num &= ~(num2 & 0xFFFF0000u);
				uint num3 = (num & 0xFFFF0000u) >> 16;
				num &= 0xFFFF0000u | num3;
				num2 &= ~num3;
				num2 |= num;
				base.Value = (int)num2;
			}
		}
	}

	public static class OutlineHeadTailTypeConverter
	{
		public static OutlineHeadTailType GetOutlineHeadTailType(MsoLineEnd msoLineEnd)
		{
			return msoLineEnd switch
			{
				MsoLineEnd.ArrowEnd => OutlineHeadTailType.TriangleArrow, 
				MsoLineEnd.StealthEnd => OutlineHeadTailType.StealthArrow, 
				MsoLineEnd.DiamondEnd => OutlineHeadTailType.Diamond, 
				MsoLineEnd.OvalEnd => OutlineHeadTailType.Oval, 
				MsoLineEnd.OpenEnd => OutlineHeadTailType.Arrow, 
				_ => OutlineHeadTailType.None, 
			};
		}

		public static MsoLineEnd GetMsoLineEnd(OutlineHeadTailType outlineHeadTailType)
		{
			return outlineHeadTailType switch
			{
				OutlineHeadTailType.Arrow => MsoLineEnd.OpenEnd, 
				OutlineHeadTailType.Diamond => MsoLineEnd.DiamondEnd, 
				OutlineHeadTailType.Oval => MsoLineEnd.OvalEnd, 
				OutlineHeadTailType.StealthArrow => MsoLineEnd.StealthEnd, 
				OutlineHeadTailType.TriangleArrow => MsoLineEnd.ArrowEnd, 
				_ => MsoLineEnd.NoEnd, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class FixedPoint
	{
		private const double fractionalCoeff = 65536.0;

		private double value;

		public double Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
			}
		}

		public static FixedPoint FromStream(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			FixedPoint fixedPoint = new FixedPoint();
			fixedPoint.Read(reader);
			return fixedPoint;
		}

		public static FixedPoint FromBytes(byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			FixedPoint fixedPoint = new FixedPoint();
			ushort num = BitConverter.ToUInt16(data, offset);
			short num2 = BitConverter.ToInt16(data, offset + 2);
			fixedPoint.value = (double)num2 + (double)(int)num / 65536.0;
			return fixedPoint;
		}

		protected void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			ushort num = reader.ReadUInt16();
			short num2 = reader.ReadInt16();
			value = (double)num2 + (double)(int)num / 65536.0;
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			short num = (short)Value;
			if (Value - (double)num != 0.0 && Value < 0.0)
			{
				num--;
			}
			ushort num2 = (ushort)((Value - (double)num) * 65536.0);
			writer.Write(num2);
			writer.Write(num);
		}

		public byte[] GetBytes()
		{
			short num = (short)Value;
			if (Value - (double)num != 0.0 && num < 0)
			{
				num--;
			}
			ushort num2 = (ushort)((Value - (double)num) * 65536.0);
			uint num3 = (uint)((num << 16) | num2);
			return BitConverter.GetBytes(num3);
		}
	}

	public interface IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<T>
	{
		T[] GetElements();
	}
	public abstract class OfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<T> : OfficeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase, IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<T>
	{
		private const int MsoArrayHeaderSize = 6;

		public abstract int ElementSize { get; }

		public T[] GetElements()
		{
			if (base.ComplexData.Length < 6)
			{
				return new T[0];
			}
			int num = BitConverter.ToUInt16(base.ComplexData, 0);
			int num2 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(base.ComplexData, 4);
			if (num2 == 65520)
			{
				num2 = 4;
			}
			if (base.ComplexData.Length != num2 * num + 6)
			{
				return new T[0];
			}
			T[] array = new T[num];
			int num3 = 6;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ReadElement(num3, num2);
				num3 += num2;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public void SetElements(T[] elements)
		{
			if (elements.Length != 0)
			{
				ushort num = (ushort)ElementSize;
				byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)elements.Length);
				List<byte> list = new List<byte>(elements.Length * num + 6);
				list.AddRange(bytes);
				list.AddRange(bytes);
				list.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(num));
				foreach (T element in elements)
				{
					WriteElement(element, list);
				}
				SetComplexData(list.ToArray());
				base.Value = base.ComplexData.Length;
			}
		}

		public abstract T ReadElement(int offset, int size);

		public abstract void WriteElement(T element, List<byte> data);

		public override byte[] GetElementsData()
		{
			if (base.ComplexData.Length < 6)
			{
				return new byte[0];
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[base.ComplexData.Length - 6];
			Array.Copy(base.ComplexData, 6, array, 0, array.Length);
			return array;
		}
	}
	public abstract class OfficeDrawingMsoArrayPropertyBase : OfficeDrawingPropertyBase
	{
		public override bool Complex => true;

		public int Value { get; set; }

		public override void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			Value = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		public override void Execute(OfficeArtPropertiesBase owner)
		{
		}

		public override void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write((ushort)OfficePropertiesFactory.GetOpcodeByType(GetType()));
			writer.Write(Value);
		}

		public abstract byte[] GetElementsData();
	}
	public interface IDrawingGeometryPointArray : IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<DrawingGeometryPoint>
	{
	}
	public class DrawingGeometryPointArray : OfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<DrawingGeometryPoint>, IDrawingGeometryPointArray, IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<DrawingGeometryPoint>
	{
		public override int ElementSize => 8;

		public override DrawingGeometryPoint ReadElement(int offset, int size)
		{
			DrawingGeometryPoint drawingGeometryPoint = new DrawingGeometryPoint();
			switch (size)
			{
			case 4:
				drawingGeometryPoint.X = DrawingGeometryCoordinate.FromBytes(base.ComplexData, offset, 2);
				drawingGeometryPoint.Y = DrawingGeometryCoordinate.FromBytes(base.ComplexData, offset + 2, 2);
				break;
			case 8:
				drawingGeometryPoint.X = DrawingGeometryCoordinate.FromBytes(base.ComplexData, offset, 4);
				drawingGeometryPoint.Y = DrawingGeometryCoordinate.FromBytes(base.ComplexData, offset + 4, 4);
				break;
			}
			return drawingGeometryPoint;
		}

		public override void WriteElement(DrawingGeometryPoint element, List<byte> data)
		{
			data.AddRange(element.X.GetBytes());
			data.AddRange(element.Y.GetBytes());
		}
	}

	public class DrawingGeometryCoordinate
	{
		private const uint MinGuideIndex = 2147483648u;

		private const uint MaxGuideIndex = 2147483775u;

		public int Value { get; set; }

		public int GuideIndex { get; set; }

		public bool IsConstant => GuideIndex < 0;

		public static DrawingGeometryCoordinate FromBytes(byte[] bytes, int offset, int size)
		{
			DrawingGeometryCoordinate drawingGeometryCoordinate = new DrawingGeometryCoordinate();
			switch (size)
			{
			case 2:
				drawingGeometryCoordinate.Value = BitConverter.ToInt16(bytes, offset);
				break;
			case 4:
			{
				uint num = BitConverter.ToUInt32(bytes, offset);
				if (num >= 2147483648u && num <= 2147483775u)
				{
					drawingGeometryCoordinate.GuideIndex = (int)num - int.MinValue;
				}
				else
				{
					drawingGeometryCoordinate.Value = BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes, offset);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return drawingGeometryCoordinate;
		}

		public DrawingGeometryCoordinate()
		{
			GuideIndex = -1;
		}

		public byte[] GetBytes()
		{
			if (!IsConstant)
			{
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)(2147483648u + GuideIndex));
			}
			return BitConverter.GetBytes(Value);
		}
	}

	public interface IDrawingGeometryGuides : IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<ShapeGuide>
	{
	}
	public class DrawingGeometryGuides : OfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<ShapeGuide>, IDrawingGeometryGuides, IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<ShapeGuide>
	{
		public override int ElementSize => 8;

		public override ShapeGuide ReadElement(int offset, int size)
		{
			if (size != 8 || offset + size > base.ComplexData.Length)
			{
				return new ShapeGuide();
			}
			ShapeGuide shapeGuide = new ShapeGuide();
			ushort num = BitConverter.ToUInt16(base.ComplexData, offset);
			shapeGuide.CalculatedParam1 = (num & 0x2000) != 0;
			shapeGuide.CalculatedParam2 = (num & 0x4000) != 0;
			shapeGuide.CalculatedParam3 = (num & 0x8000) != 0;
			shapeGuide.Formula = (ShapeGuideFormula)(num & 0x1FFF);
			shapeGuide.Param1 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(base.ComplexData, offset + 2);
			shapeGuide.Param2 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(base.ComplexData, offset + 4);
			shapeGuide.Param3 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(base.ComplexData, offset + 6);
			return shapeGuide;
		}

		public override void WriteElement(ShapeGuide element, List<byte> data)
		{
			ushort num = (ushort)element.Formula;
			if (element.CalculatedParam1)
			{
				num |= 0x2000;
			}
			if (element.CalculatedParam2)
			{
				num |= 0x4000;
			}
			if (element.CalculatedParam3)
			{
				num |= 0x8000;
			}
			data.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(num));
			data.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)element.Param1));
			data.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)element.Param2));
			data.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)element.Param3));
		}
	}
	public class ShapeGuide
	{
		public ShapeGuideFormula Formula { get; set; }

		public bool CalculatedParam1 { get; set; }

		public bool CalculatedParam2 { get; set; }

		public bool CalculatedParam3 { get; set; }

		public int Param1 { get; set; }

		public int Param2 { get; set; }

		public int Param3 { get; set; }
	}

	public class MsoPathInfo
	{
		public MsoPathType PathType { get; set; }

		public MsoPathEscape PathEscape { get; set; }

		public int Segments { get; set; }

		public MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType pathType, int segments)
		{
			PathType = pathType;
			Segments = segments;
		}

		public MsoPathInfo(MsoPathEscape escapeType, int segments)
		{
			PathType = MsoPathType.Escape;
			PathEscape = escapeType;
			Segments = segments;
		}
	}
	public interface IDrawingGeometrySegmentInfo : IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<MsoPathInfo>
	{
	}
	public class DrawingGeometrySegmentInfo : OfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<MsoPathInfo>, IDrawingGeometrySegmentInfo, IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<MsoPathInfo>
	{
		private const int PathEscapeMask = 31;

		private const int PathTypeMask = 57344;

		public override int ElementSize => 2;

		public override MsoPathInfo ReadElement(int offset, int size)
		{
			if (size != 2)
			{
				return new MsoPathInfo(MsoPathType.End, 0);
			}
			MsoPathType msoPathType = (MsoPathType)(base.ComplexData[offset + 1] >> 5);
			int segments;
			if (msoPathType == MsoPathType.ClientEscape || msoPathType == MsoPathType.Escape)
			{
				MsoPathEscape escapeType = (MsoPathEscape)(base.ComplexData[offset + 1] & 0x1F);
				segments = base.ComplexData[offset];
				return new MsoPathInfo(escapeType, segments);
			}
			segments = BitConverter.ToInt16(base.ComplexData, offset) & -57345;
			return new MsoPathInfo(msoPathType, segments);
		}

		public override void WriteElement(MsoPathInfo element, List<byte> data)
		{
			ushort num = (ushort)((ushort)element.PathType << 13);
			if (element.PathType == MsoPathType.ClientEscape || element.PathType == MsoPathType.Escape)
			{
				num |= (ushort)((int)element.PathEscape << 8);
			}
			num |= (ushort)element.Segments;
			data.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(num));
		}
	}
	public interface IDrawingGeometryConnectionSitesDir : IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<FixedPoint>
	{
	}
	public class DrawingGeometryConnectionSitesDir : OfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<FixedPoint>, IDrawingGeometryConnectionSitesDir, IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<FixedPoint>
	{
		public override int ElementSize => 4;

		public override FixedPoint ReadElement(int offset, int size)
		{
			if (size != 4)
			{
				return new FixedPoint();
			}
			return FixedPoint.FromBytes(base.ComplexData, offset);
		}

		public override void WriteElement(FixedPoint element, List<byte> data)
		{
			data.AddRange(element.GetBytes());
		}
	}

	public static class DrawingGeometryAdjustValueFactory
	{
		public static DrawingGeometryAdjustValue CreateAdjustValue(int index)
		{
			return index switch
			{
				0 => new DrawingGeometryAdjustValue1(), 
				1 => new DrawingGeometryAdjustValue2(), 
				2 => new DrawingGeometryAdjustValue3(), 
				3 => new DrawingGeometryAdjustValue4(), 
				4 => new DrawingGeometryAdjustValue5(), 
				5 => new DrawingGeometryAdjustValue6(), 
				6 => new DrawingGeometryAdjustValue7(), 
				7 => new DrawingGeometryAdjustValue8(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class OfficeShadeColor
	{
		public const int Size = 8;

		private OfficeColorRecord colorRecord;

		private double position;

		public OfficeColorRecord ColorRecord
		{
			get
			{
				return colorRecord;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = new OfficeColorRecord();
				}
				colorRecord = value;
			}
		}

		public double Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0.0 || value > 1.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Position out of range 0.0...1.0!");
				}
				position = value;
			}
		}

		public OfficeShadeColor()
		{
			colorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord();
			position = 0.0;
		}

		public OfficeShadeColor(Color color, double position)
		{
			colorRecord = new OfficeColorRecord(color);
			Position = position;
		}

		public static OfficeShadeColor FromStream(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			OfficeShadeColor officeShadeColor = new OfficeShadeColor();
			officeShadeColor.Read(reader);
			return officeShadeColor;
		}

		public static OfficeShadeColor FromBytes(byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			OfficeShadeColor officeShadeColor = new OfficeShadeColor();
			officeShadeColor.ReadBytes(data, offset);
			return officeShadeColor;
		}

		private void ReadBytes(byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			colorRecord = OfficeColorRecord.FromBytes(data, offset);
			position = FixedPoint.FromBytes(data, offset + 4).Value;
		}

		protected void Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			colorRecord = OfficeColorRecord.FromStream(reader);
			position = FixedPoint.FromStream(reader).Value;
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			colorRecord.Write(writer);
			FixedPoint fixedPoint = new FixedPoint();
			fixedPoint.Value = position;
			fixedPoint.Write(writer);
		}
	}

	public static class OfficeArtPropertiesHelper
	{
		public static object GetPropertyByType(IEnumerable<object> prop, Type propertyType)
		{
			return prop.FirstOrDefault((object p) => propertyType.IsInstanceOfType(p));
		}

		public static IOfficeDrawingProperty GetPropertyByType(OfficeArtPropertiesBase prop, Type propertyType)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < prop.Properties.Count; i++)
			{
				if (propertyType.IsInstanceOfType(prop.Properties[i]))
				{
					return prop.Properties[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static TElement[] GetArrayOfElements<TElement, TType>(IEnumerable<object> properties) where TType : class, IOfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<TElement>
		{
			if (!(GetPropertyByType(properties, typeof(TType)) is TType val))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val.GetElements();
		}

		public static TElement[] GetArrayOfElements<TElement, TType>(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties) where TType : OfficeDrawingTypedMsoArrayPropertyBase<TElement>
		{
			if (!(GetPropertyByType(artProperties, typeof(TType)) is TType val))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val.GetElements();
		}

		public static void Merge(OfficeArtPropertiesBase artProperties, OfficeArtPropertiesBase commonArtProperties)
		{
			if (commonArtProperties == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < commonArtProperties.Properties.Count; i++)
			{
				IOfficeDrawingProperty officeDrawingProperty = commonArtProperties.Properties[i];
				IOfficeDrawingProperty propertyByType = GetPropertyByType(artProperties, officeDrawingProperty.GetType());
				if (propertyByType != null)
				{
					propertyByType.Merge(officeDrawingProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					artProperties.Properties.Add(officeDrawingProperty);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < artProperties.Properties.Count; j++)
			{
				artProperties.Properties[j].Execute(artProperties);
			}
		}

		public static OfficeDrawingPartBase FindPart(CompositeOfficeDrawingPartBase drawing, int headerTypeCode)
		{
			foreach (OfficeDrawingPartBase item in drawing.Items)
			{
				if (item.HeaderTypeCode == headerTypeCode)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class OfficeReferenceImage : OfficeReferenceImageBase<OfficeNativeImage>
	{
		private readonly OfficeNativeImage baseImage;

		private readonly IDocumentModel owner;

		protected internal override OfficeNativeImage InnerImage => baseImage;

		public override OfficeImage RootImage => InnerImage.RootImage;

		public OfficeNativeImage NativeRootImage => InnerImage;

		public override bool IsMetafile => InnerImage.IsMetafile;

		public override DXImage DXImage { get; }

		public OfficeReferenceImage(IDocumentModel owner, OfficeNativeImage baseImage)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)baseImage, "baseImage");
			this.baseImage = baseImage;
			this.owner = owner;
			Uri = baseImage.Uri;
			DXImage = baseImage.DXImage;
		}

		public new OfficeReferenceImage Clone(IDocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			return (OfficeReferenceImage)base.Clone(targetModel);
		}

		protected override OfficeImage CreateClone(IDocumentModel targetModel)
		{
			if (targetModel == owner && owner != null)
			{
				return new OfficeReferenceImage(owner, baseImage);
			}
			if (targetModel.GetImageById(baseImage.Id) is OfficeNativeImage officeNativeImage)
			{
				return new OfficeReferenceImage(owner, officeNativeImage);
			}
			OfficeNativeImage image = baseImage.Clone(targetModel);
			return targetModel.ImageCache.AddImage(image);
		}
	}

		public static PixelFormat ConvertPixelFormat(DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Gray1bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format1bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Gray4bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format4bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Gray8bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Indexed1bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format1bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Indexed4bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format4bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Indexed8bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.RGB24bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.RGB32bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bppPremultiplied)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format32bppPArgb;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.CMYK32bpp)
			{
				return (PixelFormat)8207;
			}
			return PixelFormat.Undefined;
		}
